items.en: … I… I can't… I can't believe it. I lost to you? But, rules are rules! Here, take this.

items.en: ...Oh, I’m so relieved... This is just so wonderful... Thank you so very, very much.

items.normEn: ...Oh, I’m so relieved... This is just so wonderful... Thank you so very, very much.

items.en: $playername$ if it's all right with you, I think Nebby and I would like to watch your Grand Trial.
items.zh: $playername$ 如果你同意的话，我想 Nebby 和我想观看你的大审判。
items.normEn: $playername$ if it's all right with you, I think Nebby and I would like to watch your Grand Trial.

items.en: $playername$, can you go to that island and look for anything that might be able to help us?
items.zh: $playername$，你能去那个岛上寻找任何可以帮助我们的东西吗？
items.normEn: $playername$, can you go to that island and look for anything that might be able to help us?

items.en: $playername$, if you ever have troubled or downright evil Pokémon, take them to the nearby Relic Stone. Its power, combined with the power of friendship you share with your Pokémon, may purify their souls.
items.zh: $playername$，如果你遇到过麻烦或彻头彻尾邪恶的神奇宝贝，请将它们带到附近的遗迹石。它的力量，加上你与神奇宝贝分享的友谊的力量，可以净化他们的灵魂。
items.normEn: $playername$, if you ever have troubled or downright evil Pokémon, take them to the nearby Relic Stone. Its power, combined with the power of friendship you share with your Pokémon, may purify their souls.

items.en: $playername$! Please help Nebby for me! But also... if you can... try to help Necrozma, like you did mother.
items.zh: $玩家名$！请帮帮我奈比！但同时……如果可以的话……尝试帮助奈克洛兹玛，就像你帮助母亲一样。
items.normEn: $playername$! Please help Nebby for me! But also... if you can... try to help Necrozma, like you did mother.

items.en: $playername$! Stop the president!!! If we don't, Alola will be flooded with beasts!
items.zh: $玩家名$！阻止总统！！！如果我们不这样做，阿罗拉就会被野兽淹没！
items.normEn: $playername$! Stop the president!!! If we don't, Alola will be flooded with beasts!

items.en: $playername$! Thank you for rescuing me from those fiends!
items.zh: $玩家名$！谢谢你把我从那些恶魔手中救了出来！
items.normEn: $playername$! Thank you for rescuing me from those fiends!

items.en: $playername$. Been a while, friend. And who might this be?
items.zh: $玩家名$。有一段时间了，朋友。这可能是谁？
items.normEn: $playername$. Been a while, friend. And who might this be?

items.en: $playername$... Don't worry about us... We'll be fine... Defeat Kyurem once and for all so we can live in peace.
items.zh: $playername$...别担心我们...我们会没事的...一劳永逸地击败酋雷姆，这样我们就可以和平生活了。
items.normEn: $playername$... Don't worry about us... We'll be fine... Defeat Kyurem once and for all so we can live in peace.

items.en: $playername$... you have done well in guiding Lillie. The path to the shrine is through the canyon.
items.zh: $playername$...你在指导莉莉方面做得很好。通往神社的小路要穿过峡谷。
items.normEn: $playername$... you have done well in guiding Lillie. The path to the shrine is through the canyon.

items.en: A Dragon-type Silvally Memory, you say? Rock on! I had a feeling it was something rare and powerful, but I never would have guessed it was a Silvally Memory! But now that I know what I have, I can't simply give it to you. I'm a rock star, not a trial captain! We're on stage and the crowd wants a show!
items.zh: 你说的是龙型希尔瓦利记忆？继续摇滚吧！我有一种感觉，这是一种罕见而强大的东西，但我万万没想到这是希尔瓦利的记忆！但既然我知道我拥有什么，我就不能简单地把它给你了。我是摇滚明星，不是审判队长！我们在舞台上，观众想要表演！
items.normEn: A Dragon-type Silvally Memory, you say? Rock on! I had a feeling it was something rare and powerful, but I never would have guessed it was a Silvally Memory! But now that I know what I have, I can't simply give it to you. I'm a rock star, not a trial captain! We're on stage and the crowd wants a show!

items.en: A perfect item for a perfect treasure hunter. Thanks for the assist!

items.zh: 一艘非常普通的护卫舰

items.en: A rampaging Yveltal is threatening the Diamond Domain! Help Diancie defeat it!

items.en: A rare egg is at the Sandgem Lab! Surely it should be easy to hatch one little egg, right?

items.en: A rare Pokémon is hiding somewhere inside this abandoned laboratory. You can catch it if you want. I have no interest in it.
items.zh: 一个稀有的神奇宝贝隐藏在这个废弃实验室的某个地方。如果你愿意的话，你可以抓住它。我对此没有兴趣。
items.normEn: A rare Pokémon is hiding somewhere inside this abandoned laboratory. You can catch it if you want. I have no interest in it.

items.en: A rare treasure like this deserves a careful keeper. That’s me!
items.zh: 像这样的稀世珍宝值得细心保管。这就是我！
items.normEn: A rare treasure like this deserves a careful keeper. That’s me!

items.en: A real hero, who battled alongside the Legendary Pokémon, Zacian and Zamazenta... I couldn't have dreamed of a better challenger to help increase my winning streak!
items.zh: 一位真正的英雄，与传奇神奇宝贝、扎西安和扎马森塔并肩作战……我想不到还有比这更好的挑战者来帮助我增加连胜！
items.normEn: A real hero, who battled alongside the Legendary Pokémon, Zacian and Zamazenta... I couldn't have dreamed of a better challenger to help increase my winning streak!

items.zh: 您从科学家吉迪恩那里找到的蓝宝石

items.zh: 一台调谐到节目的电视机，其中包含对新手训练者有用的提示。
items.normEn: A television set that is tuned to a program with useful tips for novice TRAINERS.

items.en: A tool only counts as used if its action is successful, meaning it accomplishes its intended task (e.g., mining layers or indicating tiles)
items.zh: 工具仅在其操作成功时才​​算已使用，这意味着它完成了预期任务（例如，挖掘层或指示图块）
items.normEn: A tool only counts as used if its action is successful, meaning it accomplishes its intended task (e.g., mining layers or indicating tiles)

items.zh: 一艘完全没有可疑之处的护卫舰

items.en: A trainer like you surely dreams of rare Pokémon. The more rare Pokémon you find from the Interdream Zone, the more we can explore to find others!
items.zh: 像您这样的训练家肯定梦想着稀有的神奇宝贝。您从 Interdream Zone 中找到的神奇宝贝越多，我们就越能探索并找到其他神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: A trainer like you surely dreams of rare Pokémon. The more rare Pokémon you find from the Interdream Zone, the more we can explore to find others!

items.en: A treasure this dazzling belongs with someone who appreciates its beauty.
items.zh: 如此耀眼的宝藏属于欣赏其美丽的人。
items.normEn: A treasure this dazzling belongs with someone who appreciates its beauty.

items.en: A trial-goer, huh? Figures. Look, I'm not gonna fight someone who is taking on Team Skull. So...go. Just go.
items.zh: 一个试炼者吧？数字。听着，我不会和那些正在对抗骷髅队的人战斗。所以...走吧。走吧。
items.normEn: A trial-goer, huh? Figures. Look, I'm not gonna fight someone who is taking on Team Skull. So...go. Just go.

items.en: A truly mythical Berry native to harsh northern lands. It was first created by a Pokémon believed to have shaped the world.
items.zh: 一种真正神秘的浆果，原产于严酷的北方土地。它最初是由一只被认为塑造了世界的神奇宝贝创造的。
items.normEn: A truly mythical Berry native to harsh northern lands. It was first created by a Pokémon believed to have shaped the world.

items.en: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows you your present location in the region.
items.zh: 非常方便的地图，可以随时查看。它甚至会向您显示您在该地区的当前位置。
items.normEn: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows you your present location in the region.

items.en: A virus sample collected from your starter Pokémon. Infect more Pokémon in the hatchery, and use the new Pokérus Poké Ball option to focus catching Contagious pokemon for a damage boost.
items.zh: 从你的入门神奇宝贝中收集的病毒样本。在孵化场感染更多神奇宝贝，并使用新的神奇宝贝球选项集中捕捉传染性神奇宝贝，以提高伤害。
items.normEn: A virus sample collected from your starter Pokémon. Infect more Pokémon in the hatchery, and use the new Pokérus Poké Ball option to focus catching Contagious pokemon for a damage boost.

items.en:
A Vivillon is hiding somewhere.
Only the strongest Challengers can reach it.
items.zh: 维维永藏在某处。只有最强的挑战者才能到达。
items.normEn: A Vivillon is hiding somewhere. Only the strongest Challengers can reach it.

items.en: A weaker combination of Boost, Rich and Surprise mulch.
items.zh: Boost、Rich 和 Surprise 覆盖物的较弱组合。
items.normEn: A weaker combination of Boost, Rich and Surprise mulch.

items.en: A wild ${...}${...} has wandered onto the farm!
items.zh: 一只野生 ${...}${...} 闯入了农场！
items.normEn: A wild ${...}${...} has wandered onto the farm!

items.en: A world of dreams and adventures with Pokémon awaits! Let's go!
items.zh: 充满神奇宝贝的梦想和冒险世界正等待着您！我们走吧！
items.normEn: A world of dreams and adventures with Pokémon awaits! Let's go!

items.en: A-anyway! It's definitely regal of it to have steeds... and that massive head does sort of resemble a crown! It's kingly enough, at any rate! Let's just call this a successful expedition! Smashin'!
items.zh: 总、无论如何！拥有骏马绝对是一件富丽堂皇的事……而且那巨大的头确实有点像王冠！无论如何，这已经足够王者了！我们姑且称这是一次成功的探险吧！粉碎！
items.normEn: A-anyway! It's definitely regal of it to have steeds... and that massive head does sort of resemble a crown! It's kingly enough, at any rate! Let's just call this a successful expedition! Smashin'!

items.en: According to my brochure, there's a pretty cave past these cliffs that's filled with them! It says reviving a Jaw Fossil can give you a Tyrunt, the perfect anniversary gift for my sweetie pie!
items.zh: 根据我的小册子，这些悬崖后面有一个漂亮的洞穴，里面充满了它们！上面说复活下颌化石可以给你一个暴君，这是送给我的甜心派的完美周年纪念礼物！
items.normEn: According to my brochure, there's a pretty cave past these cliffs that's filled with them! It says reviving a Jaw Fossil can give you a Tyrunt, the perfect anniversary gift for my sweetie pie!

items.en: According to my calculations, the ideal Pokémon to push around are Dwebble, Boldore, Forretress, Golem, and Steelix. Can you catch or hatch me some?
items.zh: 根据我的计算，最理想的神奇宝贝是 Dwebble、Boldore、Forretress、Golem 和 Steelix。你能抓一些或者孵化一些给我吗？
items.normEn: According to my calculations, the ideal Pokémon to push around are Dwebble, Boldore, Forretress, Golem, and Steelix. Can you catch or hatch me some?

items.en: According to my travel guide, this cave is filled with them! It says reviving a Sail Fossil can nab you an Amaura, the perfect anniversary gift for my pumpkin!
items.zh: 根据我的旅游指南，这个洞穴里充满了它们！上面说复活风帆化石可以给你带来 Amaura，这是送给我的南瓜的完美周年纪念礼物！
items.normEn: According to my travel guide, this cave is filled with them! It says reviving a Sail Fossil can nab you an Amaura, the perfect anniversary gift for my pumpkin!

items.en: According to the legend this fragment is known as the Crystallized Shadow and if you reunite Marshadow with it, Marshadow will unlock a hidden potential.
items.zh: 根据传说，这个碎片被称为“结晶之影”，如果你将玛夏多与它重新结合，玛夏多将解锁隐藏的潜力。
items.normEn: According to the legend this fragment is known as the Crystallized Shadow and if you reunite Marshadow with it, Marshadow will unlock a hidden potential.

items.en: According to them, a strange Pokémon's cries can be heard from a lake deep inside the cave.
items.zh: 据他们称，在洞穴深处的湖中可以听到奇怪的神奇宝贝的叫声。
items.normEn: According to them, a strange Pokémon's cries can be heard from a lake deep inside the cave.

items.en: According to your little list here its... uhm... this one! UB-03 Lighting. Xurkitree. These are some strange names you guys come up with.
items.zh: 根据你这里的小清单，它......呃......这个！ UB-03 照明。旭基树。这些是你们想出的一些奇怪的名字。
items.normEn: According to your little list here its... uhm... this one! UB-03 Lighting. Xurkitree. These are some strange names you guys come up with.

items.zh: 阿迦！你很强！我担心你的训练可能会遇到困难。

items.normEn: Actually, a strong trainer like you, I think might be interested in a nearby place I was just about to go to.

items.en: Actually, I just saw some purple and red Pokémon fly into the caves. Maybe that was Eternatus? I think this place might let it return to its Eternamax form. Maybe you can catch it!
items.zh: 事实上，我只是看到一些紫色和红色的神奇宝贝飞进了洞穴。也许那是永恒？我认为这个地方可能会让它恢复到永恒型。也许你能抓住它！
items.normEn: Actually, I just saw some purple and red Pokémon fly into the caves. Maybe that was Eternatus? I think this place might let it return to its Eternamax form. Maybe you can catch it!

items.en: Actually, it looks interested in you in particular. You should challenge it to a fight!
items.zh: 事实上，它看起来对你特别感兴趣。你应该向它挑战一场战斗！

items.en: Aether Branch Faba's ego is blocking your way. Defeat him in the Aether Foundation dungeon to get closer to Lusamine.

items.en: Aether president Lusamine has recruited Team Skull and is using Nebby to open an Ultra Wormhole. Stop her. Clear the Aether Foundation dungeon.
items.zh: Aether 总裁 Lusamine 招募了骷髅队，并利用 Nebby 打开超级虫洞。阻止她。清除以太基金会地下城。
items.normEn: Aether president Lusamine has recruited Team Skull and is using Nebby to open an Ultra Wormhole. Stop her. Clear the Aether Foundation dungeon.

items.en: After all those interruptions, it's finally time for the Championship match! Talk to Leon at Wyndon Stadium.
items.zh: 经历了这么多干扰之后，冠军赛终于到了！在温登体育场与莱昂交谈。
items.normEn: After all those interruptions, it's finally time for the Championship match! Talk to Leon at Wyndon Stadium.

items.en: After completing all of an island's trials, you will battle that island's kahuna in a Grand trial.
items.zh: 完成岛屿的所有试炼后，您将在大试炼中与该岛的魔王战斗。
items.normEn: After completing all of an island's trials, you will battle that island's kahuna in a Grand trial.

items.en: After growing both carrots, Calyrex has returned to Freezington. Talk to it.
items.zh: 种完两根胡萝卜后，卡里克斯回到了弗利青顿。和它说话。
items.normEn: After growing both carrots, Calyrex has returned to Freezington. Talk to it.

items.en: After leaving Sandgem, the Happiny went south-east, across the water. There's only one place it could be now...
items.zh: 离开桑德宝石后，幸福号向东南方向航行，穿过水域。现在只有一个地方可以...
items.normEn: After leaving Sandgem, the Happiny went south-east, across the water. There's only one place it could be now...

items.en: After paying the entrance fee, you will be able to walk around in the Safari Zone. To encounter Pokémon, you must either walk in the tall grass or walk into Pokémon that randomly appear on the map.
items.zh: 支付门票后，您就可以在野生动物园区四处走动。要遇到神奇宝贝，你必须走在高高的草丛中，或者走进地图上随机出现的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: After paying the entrance fee, you will be able to walk around in the Safari Zone. To encounter Pokémon, you must either walk in the tall grass or walk into Pokémon that randomly appear on the map.

items.en: After the battle they found something. A strange young girl, alone in the wilderness of Poni Island. They found me. It seems I came from another world as well. Not their world though. These creatures are strange to me too.
items.zh: 战斗结束后，他们发现了一些东西。一个奇怪的年轻女孩，独自在波尼岛的荒野中。他们找到了我。看来我也是从另一个世界来的。虽然不是他们的世界。这些生物对我来说也很奇怪。
items.normEn: After the battle they found something. A strange young girl, alone in the wilderness of Poni Island. They found me. It seems I came from another world as well. Not their world though. These creatures are strange to me too.

items.en: After the battle, Crabrawler evolved! I didn't even know he could do that. He's so different now. But I still love him. He's my best friend, and he's even better at rock smashing now!
items.zh: 战斗结束后，爬行者进化了！我什至不知道他能做到这一点。他现在很不一样了。但我仍然爱他。他是我最好的朋友，而且他现在砸石头的技术更出色了！
items.normEn: After the battle, Crabrawler evolved! I didn't even know he could do that. He's so different now. But I still love him. He's my best friend, and he's even better at rock smashing now!

items.en: After you caught three of the legendary golems it created, Regigigas appeared in Giant's Bed. Defeat and catch it!
items.zh: 当你抓住它创造的三个传奇魔像后，雷吉加斯出现在巨人的床上。打败并抓住它！
items.normEn: After you caught three of the legendary golems it created, Regigigas appeared in Giant's Bed. Defeat and catch it!

items.en: After your turn of the encounter, if it did not result in the encounter ending, the wild Pokémon will have a chance of running away.
items.zh: 在你的遭遇回合结束后，如果没有导致遭遇结束，野生神奇宝贝将有机会逃跑。
items.normEn: After your turn of the encounter, if it did not result in the encounter ending, the wild Pokémon will have a chance of running away.

items.en: Aggronite obtain method changed to Legendary loot in Rusturf Tunnel
items.zh: 锈石隧道中的 Aggronite 获取方法更改为传奇战利品
items.normEn: Aggronite obtain method changed to Legendary loot in Rusturf Tunnel

items.en: Ah, $playername$! It's good to see you again, though I wish it was under better circumstances.
items.zh: 啊，$playername$！很高兴再次见到你，尽管我希望是在更好的情况下。
items.normEn: Ah, $playername$! It's good to see you again, though I wish it was under better circumstances.

items.en: Ah, are you a strong trainer? I'd like to leave this to a Pokémon Ranger, but the ones in this region are far away, and the crooks could escape by the time they caught up!
items.zh: 啊，你是一个很强的训练家吗？我想把这个事情交给神奇宝贝游侠队处理，但是这个地区的游侠队距离很远，骗子追上来的时候就可能逃跑了！
items.normEn: Ah, are you a strong trainer? I'd like to leave this to a Pokémon Ranger, but the ones in this region are far away, and the crooks could escape by the time they caught up!

items.en: Ah, I am impressed by your prowess. With your strong will, I know you will overcome all life's obstacles. You are worthy of this Badge!
items.zh: 啊，你的实力让我印象深刻。我知道，凭借你坚强的意志，你将克服生活中的所有障碍。你值得拥有这枚徽章！
items.normEn: Ah, I am impressed by your prowess. With your strong will, I know you will overcome all life's obstacles. You are worthy of this Badge!

items.en: Ah, isn't Flabébé such an eye-catching Pokémon? All these different lovely colors…
items.zh: 啊，弗拉贝贝是不是很引人注目的神奇宝贝呢？所有这些不同的可爱颜色......
items.normEn: Ah, isn't Flabébé such an eye-catching Pokémon? All these different lovely colors…

items.en: Ah, Manaphy hatched, did it? Looks like all that running around you and Happiny did incubated it enough to hatch it.
items.zh: 啊，玛纳菲孵化了，是吗？看来你周围跑来跑去的人和幸福确实孵化了它足以孵化它。
items.normEn: Ah, Manaphy hatched, did it? Looks like all that running around you and Happiny did incubated it enough to hatch it.

items.en: Ah, my grandson mentioned a round, green Pokémon, wait not green, it's blue, a blue Pokémon that has leaves growing on its head.
items.zh: 啊，我孙子提到了一种圆形的、绿色的神奇宝贝，等等，不是绿色的，它是蓝色的，头上长着叶子的蓝色神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Ah, my grandson mentioned a round, green Pokémon, wait not green, it's blue, a blue Pokémon that has leaves growing on its head.

items.en: Ah, now I feel better! The world is vast...and I am small within it.
items.zh: 啊，现在我感觉好多了！世界很大，而我在其中却很渺小。
items.normEn: Ah, now I feel better! The world is vast...and I am small within it.

items.en: Ah, so that is Jigglypuff? Isn't it cute! That's so kind of you. Thanks! This Moon Stone is a token of my appreciation.
items.zh: 啊，那是吉格利帕夫吗？是不是很可爱！你真是太好了。谢谢！这块月亮石是我的谢意。
items.normEn: Ah, so that is Jigglypuff? Isn't it cute! That's so kind of you. Thanks! This Moon Stone is a token of my appreciation.

items.en: Ah, so this little puppy is Growlithe? I cannot begin to imagine its roaring! I'm so happy that you are doing all this for me. Thank you so much! I was saving this Fire Stone for a rainy day, but I want you to have it instead.
items.zh: 啊，这么说这只小狗就是Growlithe？我无法想象它的咆哮！我很高兴你为我做这一切。太感谢了！我本来想把这块火石留着以备不时之需，但我希望你能拥有它。
items.normEn: Ah, so this little puppy is Growlithe? I cannot begin to imagine its roaring! I'm so happy that you are doing all this for me. Thank you so much! I was saving this Fire Stone for a rainy day, but I want you to have it instead.

items.en: Ah, so you are the new trainer in the region? I've heard tales of your exploits. My name is Wallace. I was once the Gym Leader of Sootopolis, but something came up. So now, I've entrusted my mentor Juan with the Gym's operation.
items.zh: 啊，这么说你就是这个地区的新训练师了？我听说过你的功绩。我叫华莱士。我曾经是苏托波利斯的道馆馆主，但发生了一些事情。所以现在，我把道馆的运营委托给了我的导师胡安。
items.normEn: Ah, so you are the new trainer in the region? I've heard tales of your exploits. My name is Wallace. I was once the Gym Leader of Sootopolis, but something came up. So now, I've entrusted my mentor Juan with the Gym's operation.

items.en: Ah, the fabled GS Ball. Let me have a look.
items.zh: 啊，传说中的 GS 球。让我看看。
items.normEn: Ah, the fabled GS Ball. Let me have a look.

items.en: Ah, yes. A sturdy body, just as I expected. I hope this man doesn't mind that I make use of it for the time being.
items.zh: 啊，是的。坚固的身体，正如我所料。我希望这个男人不介意我暂时使用它。
items.normEn: Ah, yes. A sturdy body, just as I expected. I hope this man doesn't mind that I make use of it for the time being.

items.en: Ah, yes. Welcome! Welcome! Almost didn't see you there. I'm just so busy trying to get this darned thing to work. Once it's complete we can finally have a direct communications network between the Sevii Islands and Kanto!
items.zh: 啊，是的。欢迎！欢迎！差点没看到你。我正忙着让这该死的东西发挥作用。一旦完成，我们终于可以在塞维群岛和关东之间建立直接通信网络了！
items.normEn: Ah, yes. Welcome! Welcome! Almost didn't see you there. I'm just so busy trying to get this darned thing to work. Once it's complete we can finally have a direct communications network between the Sevii Islands and Kanto!

items.en: Ah, you brought it to me. Staryu is the name, you said? It's certainly shaped like a star. You are so kind for coming back with it! This Water Stone should be really useful to you.
items.zh: 啊，你把它带给我了。你说的是Staryu这个名字？它的形状确实像一颗星星。你带着它回来真是太好了！这块水石应该对你很有用。
items.normEn: Ah, you brought it to me. Staryu is the name, you said? It's certainly shaped like a star. You are so kind for coming back with it! This Water Stone should be really useful to you.

items.en: Ah, you must be travelers! Welcome to Phenac City! I am Es Cade, the Mayor. Now, you wanted to see me? Is there something that I may be able to assist you with?
items.zh: 啊，你们一定是旅行者！欢迎来到菲纳克城！我是市长埃斯·凯德。现在，你想见我吗？有什么我可以帮助您的吗？
items.normEn: Ah, you must be travelers! Welcome to Phenac City! I am Es Cade, the Mayor. Now, you wanted to see me? Is there something that I may be able to assist you with?

items.en: Ah, you're the one chasing after that Happiny? You look a bit puffed, are you okay?
items.zh: 啊，你就是那个追寻幸福的人吗？你看起来有点浮肿，没事吧？
items.normEn: Ah, you're the one chasing after that Happiny? You look a bit puffed, are you okay?

items.en: Ah, you've arrived. You now know much about Landorus, Tornadus and even Thundurus. Well done.
items.zh: 啊，你来了。现在你对 Landorus、Tornadus 甚至 Thundurus 已经了解很多了。干得好。
items.normEn: Ah, you've arrived. You now know much about Landorus, Tornadus and even Thundurus. Well done.

items.en: Ah! That statue of the hero in Motostoke! Sonia said something back then, didn't she... Though it turned out to be wrong, since there were actually two heroes and all that.
items.zh: 啊!摩托斯托克的英雄雕像！索尼娅当时说了些什么，不是吗……虽然结果是错的，因为实际上有两个英雄之类的。
items.normEn: Ah! That statue of the hero in Motostoke! Sonia said something back then, didn't she... Though it turned out to be wrong, since there were actually two heroes and all that.

items.en: Ah... it seems to be interested in you, $playername$. Would you like to take it with you?
items.zh: 啊...它似乎对你感兴趣，$playername$。您想随身携带吗？
items.normEn: Ah... it seems to be interested in you, $playername$. Would you like to take it with you?

items.en: Aha, you've caught Enamorus as well. And you know so much about her.
items.zh: 啊哈，你也抓住了迷恋者。而且你对她太了解了。
items.normEn: Aha, you've caught Enamorus as well. And you know so much about her.

items.en: Ahahaha, excellent! Very well, you are the winner. From you, I sense the brilliant shine of skill that will overcome all. However, compared with me or even Wallace, you are lacking in elegance. Perhaps I should make you a loan of my outfit? ... Hahaha, I merely jest! Rather than my clothes, I shall reward you with this, the Rain Badge.
items.zh: 啊哈哈哈，太棒了！很好，你是赢家。从你身上，我感受到了克服一切的技能的灿烂光芒。然而，与我甚至与华莱士相比，你却缺乏优雅。也许我应该借给你我的衣服？ ……哈哈哈，我只是开玩笑！我不会用我的衣服来奖励你，而是用这个，雨之徽章。
items.normEn: Ahahaha, excellent! Very well, you are the winner. From you, I sense the brilliant shine of skill that will overcome all. However, compared with me or even Wallace, you are lacking in elegance. Perhaps I should make you a loan of my outfit? ... Hahaha, I merely jest! Rather than my clothes, I shall reward you with this, the Rain Badge.

items.en: Ahem... If you want to take the lift up, you'll have to defeat us! This time we will show you the opulent Pokémon we have raised explicity for this battle!
items.zh: 咳咳……想要坐电梯就得打败我们！这次我们将向您展示我们为这场战斗明确饲养的丰富神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: Ahem... If you want to take the lift up, you'll have to defeat us! This time we will show you the opulent Pokémon we have raised explicity for this battle!

items.en: Ahh, I've had my coffee now and I feel great!
items.zh: 啊，我已经喝完咖啡了，感觉棒极了！
items.normEn: Ahh, I've had my coffee now and I feel great!

items.en: Ahhh, how incredible. Look how far you have come, dear trainer. Congratulations on another complete Pokédex.
items.zh: 啊啊，多么不可思议啊。看看你已经走了多远，亲爱的教练。恭喜又一张完整的图鉴。
items.normEn: Ahhh, how incredible. Look how far you have come, dear trainer. Congratulations on another complete Pokédex.

items.en: Ahoy! What brings you to this port?
items.zh: 哎哟！是什么让您来到这个港口？
items.normEn: Ahoy! What brings you to this port?

items.en: Aiyeeeeh! How dare you! How could I get bested by a mere child? Remember this! I'll get you back for this!
items.zh: 哎呀哎呀！你怎么敢！我怎么可能被一个小孩子打败呢？记住这一点！我一定会把你找回来的！
items.normEn: Aiyeeeeh! How dare you! How could I get bested by a mere child? Remember this! I'll get you back for this!

items.en: All badges now displayed in badge case when available
items.zh: 所有徽章现在都显示在徽章盒中（如有）
items.normEn: All badges now displayed in badge case when available

items.en: All buried treasures have been collected
items.zh: 所有埋藏的宝藏都已收集完毕
items.normEn: All buried treasures have been collected

items.en: All eggs will auto hatch when steps reached if Pokémon still in the queue
items.zh: 如果神奇宝贝仍在队列中，当达到步数时，所有鸡蛋都会自动孵化
items.normEn: All eggs will auto hatch when steps reached if Pokémon still in the queue

items.en: All Hoenn Pokémon should be obtainable now
items.zh: 所有丰缘神奇宝贝现在都应该可以获得
items.normEn: All Hoenn Pokémon should be obtainable now

items.en: All is quiet. Team Galactic isn't doing anything. Maybe they learned their lesson. Just keep traveling, I guess. Clear the Pastoria City Gym.
items.zh: 一切都很安静。银河队什么也没做。也许他们吸取了教训。我想，继续旅行吧。清理帕斯托里亚市体育馆。
items.normEn: All is quiet. Team Galactic isn't doing anything. Maybe they learned their lesson. Just keep traveling, I guess. Clear the Pastoria City Gym.

items.en: All kinds of Bug Pokémon can be found in the park! Each one can be caught for Contest Tokens, and more powerful Pokémon are worth more Tokens!
items.zh: 公园里可以找到各种昆虫神奇宝贝！每一只都可以捕获比赛代币，更强大的神奇宝贝价值更多代币！
items.normEn: All kinds of Bug Pokémon can be found in the park! Each one can be caught for Contest Tokens, and more powerful Pokémon are worth more Tokens!

items.en: All my other students ended up getting lost in the forest... Turns out finding Max Mushrooms was the least of their problems! It's a shame, but I guess everyone other than you will fail the trial...
items.zh: 我所有其他的学生最终都在森林里迷路了……结果发现寻找麦克斯蘑菇是他们最不重要的问题！真遗憾，不过我想除了你之外，所有人都会失败……
items.normEn: All my other students ended up getting lost in the forest... Turns out finding Max Mushrooms was the least of their problems! It's a shame, but I guess everyone other than you will fail the trial...

items.en: All of the Helpers have different step efficiencies and will hatch eggs faster or slower depending on their value.
items.zh: 所有助手都有不同的步骤效率，并且会根据其价值更快或更慢地孵化鸡蛋。
items.normEn: All of the Helpers have different step efficiencies and will hatch eggs faster or slower depending on their value.

items.en: All parts of the treasure are visible to the player, the treasure has been claimed
items.zh: 宝藏的所有部分对玩家可见，宝藏已被认领
items.normEn: All parts of the treasure are visible to the player, the treasure has been claimed

items.zh: 所有神奇宝贝都有抵抗力！

items.en: All Pokémon in this dungeon are resistant!
items.zh: 这个地下城中的所有神奇宝贝都具有抵抗力！
items.normEn: All Pokémon in this dungeon are resistant!

items.en: All Pokémon on this route are resistant!
items.zh: 这条路线上的所有神奇宝贝都有抵抗力！
items.normEn: All Pokémon on this route are resistant!

items.en: All right, enough! We'll leave like you wanted! We'll be happy to see the last of this boring island!
items.zh: 好吧，够了！我们会如你所愿离开！我们很高兴看到这个无聊岛屿的最后一面！
items.normEn: All right, enough! We'll leave like you wanted! We'll be happy to see the last of this boring island!

items.zh: 所有销售均为最终决定！

items.en: All that matters is… That I have used the Blue Orb to awaken Kyogre… And now… I will return this world to its natural state… The state that is best for Pokémon!
items.zh: 重要的是……我已经用蓝色宝珠唤醒了盖欧卡……而现在……我会让这个世界恢复到自然状态……最适合神奇宝贝的状态！
items.normEn: All that matters is… That I have used the Blue Orb to awaken Kyogre… And now… I will return this world to its natural state… The state that is best for Pokémon!

items.en: All that matters is... That I have used the red orb to awaken Groudon. And now... I will transform this planet to a land ideal for humanity.
items.zh: 重要的是……我已经用红色球体唤醒了固拉多。现在……我将把这个星球变成人类的理想之地。
items.normEn: All that matters is... That I have used the red orb to awaken Groudon. And now... I will transform this planet to a land ideal for humanity.

items.en: All These Flavors And You Choose To Be Cheesy
items.zh: 所有这些口味，你选择奶酪味
items.normEn: All These Flavors And You Choose To Be Cheesy

items.zh: 所有未使用的维生素均已退还。
阿利斯特的侧边存放健身房

items.en: Allow better control of which type of ball to use when capturing a Pokémon
items.zh: 捕捉神奇宝贝时可以更好地控制使用哪种类型的球
items.normEn: Allow better control of which type of ball to use when capturing a Pokémon

items.en: Allow me some time to arrange tickets for your next destination.
items.zh: 请给我一些时间来安排您下一个目的地的机票。
items.normEn: Allow me some time to arrange tickets for your next destination.

items.en: Allow me to explain something to you. This egg is meaningful only if we possess it.
items.zh: 请允许我向您解释一些事情。这个蛋只有我们拥有它才有意义。
items.normEn: Allow me to explain something to you. This egg is meaningful only if we possess it.

items.en: Allow the game to continue running while Day Care is open
items.zh: 允许游戏在日托中心开放时继续运行
items.normEn: Allow the game to continue running while Day Care is open

items.en: Allow the game to continue running while Farm is open
items.zh: 允许游戏在农场打开时继续运行
items.normEn: Allow the game to continue running while Farm is open

items.en: Allow the game to continue running while Underground is open
items.zh: 允许游戏在地下开放时继续运行
items.normEn: Allow the game to continue running while Underground is open

items.en: Allow using web workers for game ticks
items.zh: 允许使用网络工作者进行游戏刻度
items.normEn: Allow using web workers for game ticks

items.en: Allows ${...}-type Pokémon to use Z-Moves for the next battle. They then need to rest a bit.
items.zh: 允许$​​{...}型神奇宝贝在下一场战斗中使用Z招式。然后他们需要休息一下。
items.normEn: Allows ${...}-type Pokémon to use Z-Moves for the next battle. They then need to rest a bit.

items.en: Almost Clean Enough to Look Shiny
items.zh: 几乎干净到看起来有光泽
items.normEn: Almost Clean Enough to Look Shiny

items.en: Alola has been rebalanced and story quests revamped
items.zh: 阿罗拉已重新平衡，故事任务也已修改
items.normEn: Alola has been rebalanced and story quests revamped

items.en: Alola islands being inaccessible for some people
items.zh: 阿罗拉群岛对某些人来说无法进入
items.normEn: Alola islands being inaccessible for some people

items.en: Alright, you want the real truth? Some weird old dude told me this: "The other islands are locked behind part of a "Quest Line" You have to progress to unlock it."
items.zh: 好吧，你想要真相吗？一些奇怪的老家伙告诉我：“其他岛屿被锁在“任务线”的一部分后面，你必须进步才能解锁它。”
items.normEn: Alright, you want the real truth? Some weird old dude told me this: "The other islands are locked behind part of a "Quest Line" You have to progress to unlock it."

items.en: Alright, you want the real truth? Some weird old dude told me this: "The other islands are locked behind part of a Questline. You can unlock it at a Bulletin Board."
items.zh: 好吧，你想要真相吗？一些奇怪的老家伙告诉我：“其他岛屿被锁在任务线的一部分后面。你可以在公告牌上解锁它。”
items.normEn: Alright, you want the real truth? Some weird old dude told me this: "The other islands are locked behind part of a Questline. You can unlock it at a Bulletin Board."

items.en: Also, Thundurus: as it flies around, it fires bolts of lightning every which way. When a rainstorm lashes the Cobalt Coastlands, Tornadus may be about.
items.zh: 另外，雷霆龙：当它四处飞行时，它会向各个方向发射闪电。当暴风雨袭击钴海岸时，龙卷风可能即将来临。
items.normEn: Also, Thundurus: as it flies around, it fires bolts of lightning every which way. When a rainstorm lashes the Cobalt Coastlands, Tornadus may be about.

items.en: Also, while I was walking near A Tree Maybe I saw a guy dressed almost like an old Pokémon that doesn't exist anymore with a Silvally Memory.
items.zh: 另外，当我在一棵树附近散步时，也许我看到一个人穿着几乎像一个已经不存在的旧神奇宝贝，并且具有希尔瓦利记忆。
items.normEn: Also, while I was walking near A Tree Maybe I saw a guy dressed almost like an old Pokémon that doesn't exist anymore with a Silvally Memory.

items.en: Altar of the Sunne and Moone
items.normEn: Altar of the Sunne and Moone

items.en: Alternate Berrydex viewing mode (enabled in Display settings)
items.zh: 备用 Berrydex 查看模式（在显示设置中启用）
items.normEn: Alternate Berrydex viewing mode (enabled in Display settings)

items.en: Alternate Form Pokémon statistics shown correctly
items.zh: 正确显示替代形态神奇宝贝统计数据
items.normEn: Alternate Form Pokémon statistics shown correctly

items.en: Always add caught Shiny Pokémon to the Log Book
items.zh: 务必将捕获的闪亮神奇宝贝添加到日志中
items.normEn: Always add caught Shiny Pokémon to the Log Book

items.en: Always show total levels in Oak Item tooltips
items.zh: 始终在 Oak Item 工具提示中显示总级别
items.normEn: Always show total levels in Oak Item tooltips

items.en: Amazing, you even beat Dada! It's really clear that he is really amazed by your strength!
items.zh: 太棒了，你竟然打败了爸爸！看得出来，他真的很惊讶你的实力！
items.normEn: Amazing, you even beat Dada! It's really clear that he is really amazed by your strength!

items.en: Amazing! Next stop is Hoenn, enjoy the sunshine while you're there!
items.zh: 惊人的！下一站是丰缘，享受阳光吧！
items.normEn: Amazing! Next stop is Hoenn, enjoy the sunshine while you're there!

items.en: An Aipom dropped this while running away, I wonder what it is?
items.zh: 一只 Aipom 在逃跑时掉落了这个，我想知道这是什么？
items.normEn: An Aipom dropped this while running away, I wonder what it is?

items.en: An egg is ready to hatch!
items.zh: 一颗蛋已经准备好孵化了！
items.normEn: An egg is ready to hatch!

items.en: An egg. Can be hatched in the Day Care.
items.zh: 一个鸡蛋。可以在日托中心孵化。
items.normEn: An egg. Can be hatched in the Day Care.

items.en: An evolution item. See your Item Bag for more information.
items.zh: 进化物品。请参阅您的物品袋了解更多信息。
items.normEn: An evolution item. See your Item Bag for more information.

items.en: An ex-Go-Rock in Sandgem Town has turned to Pokémon Pinching, and wants to steal the egg first. But after all you've been through to get it, he's in for a rude awakening
items.zh: Sandgem 镇的一名前 Go-Rock 转向了神奇宝贝捏捏，并想先偷蛋。但在你经历了一切才得到它之后，他猛然醒悟
items.normEn: An ex-Go-Rock in Sandgem Town has turned to Pokémon Pinching, and wants to steal the egg first. But after all you've been through to get it, he's in for a rude awakening

items.en: An experimental specimen can be bought here: A Sudowoodo that is no longer weak against Water attacks!
items.zh: 可以在这里购买实验样本：对水攻击不再脆弱的 Sudowoodo！
items.normEn: An experimental specimen can be bought here: A Sudowoodo that is no longer weak against Water attacks!

items.en: An expert can use an energy potion to restore a portion of the time until they can perform their next action. When an expert is allowed to use multiple restores they will first use the best restore at their disposal.
items.zh: 专家可以使用能量药水来恢复部分时间，直到他们可以执行下一个动作。当专家被允许使用多个恢复时，他们将首先使用他们掌握的最佳恢复。
items.normEn: An expert can use an energy potion to restore a portion of the time until they can perform their next action. When an expert is allowed to use multiple restores they will first use the best restore at their disposal.

items.en: An old book about Sinnoh's history was recently discovered at the Canalave City Library, it may have useful information.
items.zh: 最近在卡纳拉夫市图书馆发现了一本关于神奥历史的旧书，里面可能有有用的信息。
items.normEn: An old book about Sinnoh's history was recently discovered at the Canalave City Library, it may have useful information.

items.en: An Ultra Beast is hiding somewhere...
items.normEn: An Ultra Beast is hiding somewhere...

items.en: and ${...} its click attack contribution by ${...}%
items.normEn: and ${...} its click attack contribution by ${...}%

items.en: And a girl with a Mudsdale on Exeggutor Island Hill.
items.zh: 还有一个在椰蛋岛山上喝着 Mudsdale 的女孩。
items.normEn: And a girl with a Mudsdale on Exeggutor Island Hill.

items.en: And do bring a Gengar of your own, won't you?
items.zh: 请带上你自己的耿鬼，好吗？
items.normEn: And do bring a Gengar of your own, won't you?

items.en: And don't bother looking for Professor Krane here, he's like long gone.
items.zh: 别费心在这里寻找克兰教授了，他就像早已消失了一样。
items.normEn: And don't bother looking for Professor Krane here, he's like long gone.

items.en: And for your second trial we have mushroom picking! I'm tasking you with finding three Max Mushrooms! They are red with a spiral pattern. I'm pretty sure they grow in dark, humid places! And with that, your next trial begins! I'm countin' on ya!
items.zh: 对于您的第二次尝试，我们有蘑菇采摘！我的任务是找到三个最大蘑菇！它们是红色的，带有螺旋图案。我很确定它们生长在黑暗潮湿的地方！就这样，你的下一次审判开始了！我指望你了！
items.normEn: And for your second trial we have mushroom picking! I'm tasking you with finding three Max Mushrooms! They are red with a spiral pattern. I'm pretty sure they grow in dark, humid places! And with that, your next trial begins! I'm countin' on ya!

items.en: And I even got my Pokéball throw perfect too!
items.zh: 我的精灵球投掷也很完美！
items.normEn: And I even got my Pokéball throw perfect too!

items.en: And I trust you'll be going too, right, Hop? I certainly hope losing to me didn't discourage you too much. Go on now, both of you! Go see how our Champion is doing!
items.zh: 我相信你也会去，对吧，霍普？我当然希望输给我并没有让你太沮丧。现在就继续吧，你们两个！快来看看我们的冠军表现如何吧！
items.normEn: And I trust you'll be going too, right, Hop? I certainly hope losing to me didn't discourage you too much. Go on now, both of you! Go see how our Champion is doing!

items.en: And if some of the rumours about Mega Stones are true... it'll be worth keeping track of those sorts of things.
items.zh: 如果有关巨型石头的一些谣言是真的……那么就值得跟踪这些事情。
items.normEn: And if some of the rumours about Mega Stones are true... it'll be worth keeping track of those sorts of things.

items.en: And Nebby! I'll have you stay in your bag, mister!
items.zh: 还有内比！我会让你留在你的包里，先生！
items.normEn: And Nebby! I'll have you stay in your bag, mister!

items.en: And now you're here, standing around these stones. Do you have any idea what they even are?
items.zh: 现在你在这里，站在这些石头周围。你知道它们是什么吗？
items.normEn: And now you're here, standing around these stones. Do you have any idea what they even are?

items.en: And now, it is time to tell you the rest. There is one more of that cohort. Come.
items.zh: 现在，是时候告诉你剩下的事情了。这一群体中还有一个。来。
items.normEn: And now, it is time to tell you the rest. There is one more of that cohort. Come.

items.en: And one more thing. It's not widely known, but it's a true fact; Chimecho are able to choose winning lottery tickets! Soo you see, my friend, just having a Chimecho with you, is a sure-fire ticket to happiness and success. Let Chimecho give you total peace and happiness, for a good price!
items.zh: 还有一件事。虽然这件事并不广为人知，但却是千真万确的事实； Chimecho可以选择中奖彩票！所以你看，我的朋友，只要有一个 Chimecho 和你在一起，就是一张通往幸福和成功的必经之路。让 Chimecho 给您带来完全的平静和幸福，而且价格实惠！
items.normEn: And one more thing. It's not widely known, but it's a true fact; Chimecho are able to choose winning lottery tickets! Soo you see, my friend, just having a Chimecho with you, is a sure-fire ticket to happiness and success. Let Chimecho give you total peace and happiness, for a good price!

items.en: And since you've conquered the Orange League, I suppose it should be safe to let you into Pinkan Mountain. Just be careful.
items.zh: 既然你已经征服了橙色联盟，我想让你进入平坎山应该是安全的。请小心。
items.normEn: And since you've conquered the Orange League, I suppose it should be safe to let you into Pinkan Mountain. Just be careful.

items.en: And so here we are. At the end. And back at the beginning.
items.zh: 我们就到这里了。在最后。又回到最初。
items.normEn: And so here we are. At the end. And back at the beginning.

items.en: And thank you too, $playername$! You've helped me gain so much confidence in myself. I am very grateful for that. I was able to achieve things I had never dreamed I could... Getting to meet you, traveling together with you... I'm so glad I got to be part of your journey!
items.zh: 也谢谢你，$playername$！你帮助我对自己有了很大的信心。我对此非常感激。我实现了我从未梦想过的事情...见到您，与您一起旅行...我很高兴能成为您旅程的一部分！
items.normEn: And thank you too, $playername$! You've helped me gain so much confidence in myself. I am very grateful for that. I was able to achieve things I had never dreamed I could... Getting to meet you, traveling together with you... I'm so glad I got to be part of your journey!

items.en: And the best part is you can keep doing it over and over and over again! The sky is the limit! Reach for the stars!
items.zh: 最好的部分是你可以一遍又一遍地重复这样做！天空是极限！伸手摘星！
items.normEn: And the best part is you can keep doing it over and over and over again! The sky is the limit! Reach for the stars!

items.en: And there's this pointy feathered one runnin' about in the Wild Area of Southern Galar!
items.zh: 在南伽勒尔的荒野里，有一只长着尖羽毛的鸟在奔跑！
items.normEn: And there's this pointy feathered one runnin' about in the Wild Area of Southern Galar!

items.en: And to that point... I have a suggestion. If you are able to capture me, it will prove your worth beyond any doubt, and I will lend you my strength on your journey. Once you have readied yourself, come face me!
items.zh: 对此……我有一个建议。如果你能抓住我，那将毫无疑问地证明你的价值，我将在你的旅途中为你提供力量。一旦你准备好了，就来面对我吧！
items.normEn: And to that point... I have a suggestion. If you are able to capture me, it will prove your worth beyond any doubt, and I will lend you my strength on your journey. Once you have readied yourself, come face me!

items.en: And what's really interesting is that they only show up to trainers who have already caught one of their species. Could it be they are aware enough to use that as an appraisal of trust?
items.zh: 真正有趣的是，它们只出现在已经捕捉到该物种之一的训练员面前。难道他们有足够的意识来用它来评估信任吗？
items.normEn: And what's really interesting is that they only show up to trainers who have already caught one of their species. Could it be they are aware enough to use that as an appraisal of trust?

items.en: And with you... another of your kind?
items.zh: 和你一起……另一个你的同类？
items.normEn: And with you... another of your kind?

items.en: And... seeing my buddy suffer like that made me consider how many new memories I've been taking for granted... I'm glad to have met you, Hau... everyone. Like Hau said, people can achieve more if they do something together. Thank you for reminding me of that.
items.zh: 而且......看到我的朋友那样受苦，让我想起了我一直认为理所当然的许多新回忆......我很高兴见到你，Hau......大家。就像 Hau 所说，如果人们一起做某事，就能取得更多成就。谢谢你提醒我这一点。
items.normEn: And... seeing my buddy suffer like that made me consider how many new memories I've been taking for granted... I'm glad to have met you, Hau... everyone. Like Hau said, people can achieve more if they do something together. Thank you for reminding me of that.

items.en: Animate town and dungeon background images
items.zh: 动画城镇和地牢背景图像
items.normEn: Animate town and dungeon background images

items.en: Another relic of the underground! Don’t worry, I’ll keep it safe from Team Rocket.
items.zh: 又一个地下遗迹！别担心，我会保护它免受火箭队的侵害。
items.normEn: Another relic of the underground! Don’t worry, I’ll keep it safe from Team Rocket.

items.en: Another two groups of Zarude are attacking you. Defeat them as well.
items.zh: 另外两群扎鲁德正在攻击你。也打败他们。
items.normEn: Another two groups of Zarude are attacking you. Defeat them as well.

items.zh: 接听正在响铃的 Holo Caster。

items.en: Any Calciums applied to Pokémon will give them an additional 1% of their base attack per hatch, but require 20 more steps.
items.zh: 任何应用于神奇宝贝的钙都会使它们每次孵化时获得额外 1% 的基础攻击力，但需要 20 个以上的步骤。
items.normEn: Any Calciums applied to Pokémon will give them an additional 1% of their base attack per hatch, but require 20 more steps.

items.en: Any Carbos applied to Pokémon will reduce the steps required per hatch.
items.zh: 应用于神奇宝贝的任何碳都会减少每次孵化所需的步骤。
items.normEn: Any Carbos applied to Pokémon will reduce the steps required per hatch.

items.en: Any new issues, suggestions or code contributions are always welcomed.
items.zh: 任何新问题、建议或代码贡献始终受到欢迎。
items.normEn: Any new issues, suggestions or code contributions are always welcomed.

items.en: any Pokémon that match its conditions, and catch all the rest.
items.zh: 任何符合其条件的神奇宝贝，并捕获其余所有神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: any Pokémon that match its conditions, and catch all the rest.

items.en: Any Proteins applied to Pokémon will give them an additional 1 attack per hatch, but require 20 more steps.
items.zh: 应用于 Pokémon 的任何蛋白质每次孵化都会使它们额外获得 1 次攻击，但还需要 20 个步骤。
items.normEn: Any Proteins applied to Pokémon will give them an additional 1 attack per hatch, but require 20 more steps.

items.en: Any Way To Get Rid of It?
items.zh: 有什么方法可以摆脱它吗？
items.normEn: Any Way To Get Rid of It?

items.en: Anyway what did you want to ask me? Hmm, if I've seen a Silvally Memory anywhere near? Sure, it's in my pocket right here. It even is coloured like a diamond! I wish I could trade it for some... hm? You're asking if we could do a trade? Sure, I'll sell it to you for 100,000 Diamonds, so I can buy my lovely fiancée-to-be an engagement ring. I'll always be here in the same place at all times, we can trade anytime you want.
items.zh: 无论如何，你想问我什么？嗯，我是否在附近见过西尔瓦利记忆？当然，它就在我的口袋里。它的颜色甚至像钻石一样！我希望我能用它换一些……嗯？你问我们是否可以做一笔交易？当然，我会以 100,000 钻石的价格卖给你，这样我就可以给我可爱的未婚妻买订婚戒指了。我会一直在同一个地方，我们可以随时进行交易。
items.normEn: Anyway what did you want to ask me? Hmm, if I've seen a Silvally Memory anywhere near? Sure, it's in my pocket right here. It even is coloured like a diamond! I wish I could trade it for some... hm? You're asking if we could do a trade? Sure, I'll sell it to you for 100,000 Diamonds, so I can buy my lovely fiancée-to-be an engagement ring. I'll always be here in the same place at all times, we can trade anytime you want.

items.en: Anyway, I'm gonna continue forward. I'll wait for you in Ambrette Town.
items.zh: 无论如何，我都会继续前进。我会在安布雷特镇等你。
items.normEn: Anyway, I'm gonna continue forward. I'll wait for you in Ambrette Town.

items.en: Anyway, in each of these Raid Dens, there's a Gigantamax Pokémon! You can't catch 'em though, they'll turn back to their regular form and run before you get the chance.
items.zh: 无论如何，在每个 Raid Dens 中，都有一个 Gigantamax 神奇宝贝！但你无法抓住它们，它们会在你有机会之前变回正常状态并逃跑。
items.normEn: Anyway, in each of these Raid Dens, there's a Gigantamax Pokémon! You can't catch 'em though, they'll turn back to their regular form and run before you get the chance.

items.en: Anyway, thanks for your help! Feel free to come over to Wyndon Stadium anytime if you fancy a match!
items.zh: 不管怎样，谢谢你的帮助！如果您喜欢观看比赛，请随时来温登体育场！
items.normEn: Anyway, thanks for your help! Feel free to come over to Wyndon Stadium anytime if you fancy a match!

items.en: Anyway. Can I ask you something? Do you know any farmers? I'm needing to plant more palm trees around here on Exeggutor Island but I don't have enough Farm Points to buy all the seeds I need. If I got in contact with a farmer I could get them for much cheaper or even free! Oh? You know how to use the Farm? So that means you have a lot of Farm Points, right? Good! How about you give me some of those Farm Points for this Silvally Memory? Ok, I'll be here taking care of the Exeggutor for a while so you can come and visit me anytime to do this trade.
items.zh: 反正。我能问你一件事吗？你认识农民吗？我需要在椰蛋岛附近种植更多棕榈树，但我没有足够的农场点数来购买我需要的所有种子。如果我与农民取得联系，我可以以更便宜甚至免费的价格获得它们！哦？你知道如何使用农场吗？这意味着你有很多农场点，对吗？好的！你给我一些用于这个希尔瓦利记忆的农场积分怎么样？好的，我会在这里照顾椰蛋树一段时间，这样你就可以随时来找我做这项交易。
items.normEn: Anyway. Can I ask you something? Do you know any farmers? I'm needing to plant more palm trees around here on Exeggutor Island but I don't have enough Farm Points to buy all the seeds I need. If I got in contact with a farmer I could get them for much cheaper or even free! Oh? You know how to use the Farm? So that means you have a lot of Farm Points, right? Good! How about you give me some of those Farm Points for this Silvally Memory? Ok, I'll be here taking care of the Exeggutor for a while so you can come and visit me anytime to do this trade.

items.en: Apparently a strange blue mouse-like Pokémon might be out there somewhere?
items.zh: 显然某个地方可能有一种奇怪的蓝色老鼠状神奇宝贝？
items.normEn: Apparently a strange blue mouse-like Pokémon might be out there somewhere?

items.en: Apparently defeating a strong creature there unleashes some energy.
items.zh: 显然击败那里的强大生物会释放出一些能量。
items.normEn: Apparently defeating a strong creature there unleashes some energy.

items.en: Apparently some kid released one of his Pokémon around here. That Pokémon, its partner, and for whatever reason, the Legendary Beasts from Johto have been seen roaming on {ROUTE_NAME}.
items.zh: 显然有一个孩子在这附近释放了他的一只神奇宝贝。人们看到那只神奇宝贝、它的伙伴，以及无论出于什么原因，来自城都的传奇野兽在 {ROUTE_NAME} 上漫游。
items.normEn: Apparently some kid released one of his Pokémon around here. That Pokémon, its partner, and for whatever reason, the Legendary Beasts from Johto have been seen roaming on {ROUTE_NAME}.

items.en: Apparently the ancient Pokémon escaped, and can be found roaming around Kanto!
items.zh: 显然，古老的神奇宝贝逃脱了，并且可以在关东地区找到它们！
items.normEn: Apparently the ancient Pokémon escaped, and can be found roaming around Kanto!

items.en: Apparently this secret room is only accessible via a secret entrance in Relic Passage. Relic Passage runs from Driftveil City all the way under the river to Relic Castle. It's very impressive. Once I'm done investigating this part of the ruin I'm definitely going to check it out!
items.zh: 显然这个秘密房间只能通过遗迹通道的秘密入口进入。遗迹通道从漂流城一直延伸到河下的遗迹城堡。这是非常令人印象深刻的。一旦我调查完这部分废墟，我一定会去看看！
items.normEn: Apparently this secret room is only accessible via a secret entrance in Relic Passage. Relic Passage runs from Driftveil City all the way under the river to Relic Castle. It's very impressive. Once I'm done investigating this part of the ruin I'm definitely going to check it out!

items.en: Apparently, these Pokémon can control energy or absorb energy, respectively. Xerneas gives life energy to plants and Pokémon, whereas Yveltal steals all of the spirits around it.
items.zh: 显然，这些神奇宝贝分别可以控制能量或吸收能量。泽尔尼亚斯为植物和神奇宝贝提供生命能量，而伊维尔塔尔则窃取周围的所有灵魂。
items.normEn: Apparently, these Pokémon can control energy or absorb energy, respectively. Xerneas gives life energy to plants and Pokémon, whereas Yveltal steals all of the spirits around it.

items.en: Applin absolutely loves Sweet and Tart treats.
items.zh: 阿普林非常喜欢甜食和酸食。
items.normEn: Applin absolutely loves Sweet and Tart treats.

items.zh: Aqua 和 Magma 领袖改造

items.en: Arceus granted you a part of its self, and the Legend Plate!
items.zh: 阿尔宙斯赐予了你自己的一部分，还有传说板！
items.normEn: Arceus granted you a part of its self, and the Legend Plate!

items.zh: 阿尔宙斯：神化的宝可梦

items.en: Archie and Maxie are still lurking somewhere in Hoenn, but without the Orbs I think they're mostly harmless. If you need some help smacking em down again, come get me!
items.zh: 阿奇和马克西仍然潜伏在丰缘的某个地方，但如果没有球体，我认为他们基本上是无害的。如果你需要帮助再次打击他们，就来找我吧！
items.normEn: Archie and Maxie are still lurking somewhere in Hoenn, but without the Orbs I think they're mostly harmless. If you need some help smacking em down again, come get me!

items.en: Are there cloud saves or accounts?
items.normEn: Are there cloud saves or accounts?

items.en: Are you looking for some Shards? You can find them in many Dungeons! Except in Viridian Forest and Mt. Moon. I've never found any Shards there for some reason.
items.zh: 您在寻找碎片吗？您可以在许多地下城中找到它们！除了常磐森林和月亮山。由于某种原因，我从未在那里找到过任何碎片。
items.normEn: Are you looking for some Shards? You can find them in many Dungeons! Except in Viridian Forest and Mt. Moon. I've never found any Shards there for some reason.

items.en:
Are you sure you want delete your save file?

To confirm, type "DELETE"
items.zh: 您确定要删除您的保存文件吗？要确认，请输入“删除”
items.normEn: Are you sure you want delete your save file? To confirm, type "DELETE"

items.en: Are you sure you want to delete "${...}"?
items.normEn: Are you sure you want to delete "${...}"?

items.en:
Are you sure you want to leave?

You can always return later and start off where you left.
items.zh: 您确定要离开吗？您随时可以稍后返回并从离开的地方开始。
items.normEn: Are you sure you want to leave? You can always return later and start off where you left.

items.en: Are you sure you want to refresh the quest list?
items.zh: 您确定要刷新任务列表吗？
items.normEn: Are you sure you want to refresh the quest list?

items.en: Are you sure you want to reset your filters to the default ones?
items.zh: 您确定要将过滤器重置为默认过滤器吗？
items.normEn: Are you sure you want to reset your filters to the default ones?

items.en:
Are you sure you want to reset your save?

This cannot be undone, so please make sure you have a backup first!
items.zh: 您确定要重置您的保存吗？此操作无法撤消，因此请先确保您有备份！
items.normEn: Are you sure you want to reset your save? This cannot be undone, so please make sure you have a backup first!

items.en: Are you sure you want to run away from this battle?
items.zh: 你确定要逃离这场战斗吗？
items.normEn: Are you sure you want to run away from this battle?

items.en: Are you sure you want to use ${...} ${...} on all plots?
items.zh: 您确定要在所有绘图上使用 ${...} ${...} 吗？
items.normEn: Are you sure you want to use ${...} ${...} on all plots?

items.en: Are you sure your Karp isn't flying-type?
items.zh: 你确定你的卡普不是飞行型的？
items.normEn: Are you sure your Karp isn't flying-type?

items.en:
Are you sure?

All Pokémon will be removed from your breeding queue.
items.zh: 你确定吗？所有神奇宝贝都将从您的繁殖队列中删除。
items.normEn: Are you sure? All Pokémon will be removed from your breeding queue.

items.en:
Are you sure?

You can start the quest again later but you will lose all progress!
items.zh: 你确定吗？您可以稍后再次开始任务，但您将失去所有进度！
items.normEn: Are you sure? You can start the quest again later but you will lose all progress!

items.en: Are you trying to fly to the stratosphere?
items.normEn: Are you trying to fly to the stratosphere?

items.zh: 区域完成状态突出显示

items.en: Argh! I can't believe I lost to someone like you! You can keep the key for now, but I'll get my revenge one day.
items.zh: 啊！我不敢相信我竟然输给了你这样的人！你暂时可以保留钥匙，但总有一天我会报仇的。
items.normEn: Argh! I can't believe I lost to someone like you! You can keep the key for now, but I'll get my revenge one day.

items.zh: 啊！瘸！愚蠢的！傻子！等离子啊啊啊！

items.en: Argh! With that Manaphy Egg, I thought even an ex-Go-Rock like me could live out the rest of my life in ease! That Happiny took the egg to the south-east, across the water. I wanted to pursue it, but Carvanha are not... comfortable to ride on.
items.zh: 啊！有了这个玛纳菲蛋，我想连我这样一个前摇滚乐手也能轻松地度过余生了！那个快乐带着蛋到了东南方，穿过了水。我想追求它，但卡瓦尼亚……骑起来不太舒服。
items.normEn: Argh! With that Manaphy Egg, I thought even an ex-Go-Rock like me could live out the rest of my life in ease! That Happiny took the egg to the south-east, across the water. I wanted to pursue it, but Carvanha are not... comfortable to ride on.

items.en: Around these parts, folks love to compete to see whose Magikarp can splash harder and jump higher! No other Pokémon are allowed to compete in these events. So, do your best to raise up some fine Magikarp!
items.zh: 在这些地方，人们喜欢比赛，看谁的鲤鱼溅得更厉害，跳得更高！不允许其他神奇宝贝参加这些赛事。所以，尽你最大的努力来养育一些优秀的鲤鱼王吧！
items.normEn: Around these parts, folks love to compete to see whose Magikarp can splash harder and jump higher! No other Pokémon are allowed to compete in these events. So, do your best to raise up some fine Magikarp!

items.en: Arrgh!! I lost again!? Blast it all! You ruined our plans for Silph! But Team Rocket will never fall! $playername$, never forget that all Pokémon exist for Team Rocket! I must go, but I shall return!
items.zh: 啊啊！！我又输了！？全部炸毁！你毁了我们对西尔夫的计划！但火箭队永远不会倒下！ $playername$，永远不要忘记所有神奇宝贝都是为火箭队而存在的！我必须走，但我会回来的！
items.normEn: Arrgh!! I lost again!? Blast it all! You ruined our plans for Silph! But Team Rocket will never fall! $playername$, never forget that all Pokémon exist for Team Rocket! I must go, but I shall return!

items.en: Arven wants to test you and himself. Defeat him at Poco Path Lighthouse
items.zh: 阿尔文想考验你和他自己。在波科路径灯塔击败他
items.normEn: Arven wants to test you and himself. Defeat him at Poco Path Lighthouse

items.en: As expected of the Champion... You took complete control of the situation.
items.zh: 不愧是冠军……你完全掌控了局势。
items.normEn: As expected of the Champion... You took complete control of the situation.

items.en: As for myself… I study Pokémon as a profession.
items.zh: 至于我自己……我以研究神奇宝贝为职业。
items.normEn: As for myself… I study Pokémon as a profession.

items.en: As for that reward I mentioned, I'll put these memories in the Memory Replicator so I can make some Silvally Memories for you. The machine isn't powerful enough to create the Memories out of nothing, though. I'll be needing you to grab some gems of the Memory's type so I can replicate the Memory and insert it into a Silvally for you. It needs some fine-tuning first so the amount needed won't be the same after the first trade.
items.zh: 至于我提到的奖励，我会将这些记忆放入记忆复制器中，这样我就可以为你制作一些银色记忆。不过，这台机器的功能还不足以从无到有地创造出记忆。我需要你去拿一些记忆类型的宝石，这样我就可以复制记忆并将其插入到席尔瓦利中。首先需要进行一些微调，以便第一次交易后所需的金额不会相同。
items.normEn: As for that reward I mentioned, I'll put these memories in the Memory Replicator so I can make some Silvally Memories for you. The machine isn't powerful enough to create the Memories out of nothing, though. I'll be needing you to grab some gems of the Memory's type so I can replicate the Memory and insert it into a Silvally for you. It needs some fine-tuning first so the amount needed won't be the same after the first trade.

items.en: As I said, that was one of the best battles I've ever had.
items.zh: 正如我所说，那是我经历过的最好的战斗之一。
items.normEn: As I said, that was one of the best battles I've ever had.

items.en: As new and rare types of Pokémon are discovered, park staff will add them to our rotation of potential stock!
items.zh: 随着新的和稀有类型的神奇宝贝被发现，公园工作人员会将它们添加到我们的潜在库存轮换中！
items.normEn: As new and rare types of Pokémon are discovered, park staff will add them to our rotation of potential stock!

items.en: As you may already know, I am both a Steel-type expert and a stickler for precision in combat. I desire nothing more than to elevate my team to the utmost degree of mastery. But in order to do so, I must face off against trainers of the highest caliber. That is where you come in, my friend! If you are prepared for the challenge, step forward and engage me in a duel for the ages!
items.zh: 你可能已经知道，我既是一名钢系专家，又是一个追求精确战斗的人。我唯一的愿望就是将我的团队提升到最高水平。但要做到这一点，我必须与最优秀的训练家对战。这就是你进来的地方，我的朋友！如果你做好了迎接挑战的准备，就站出来和我进行一场永恒的决斗吧！
items.normEn: As you may already know, I am both a Steel-type expert and a stickler for precision in combat. I desire nothing more than to elevate my team to the utmost degree of mastery. But in order to do so, I must face off against trainers of the highest caliber. That is where you come in, my friend! If you are prepared for the challenge, step forward and engage me in a duel for the ages!

items.en: As you perform actions, you will gain Safari XP and increase your Safari Level. If you catch a Pokémon, there is a chance an item will appear on the map.
items.zh: 当您执行操作时，您将获得 Safari XP 并提高您的 Safari 级别。如果你抓住了神奇宝贝，地图上就有可​​能出现一个物品。
items.normEn: As you perform actions, you will gain Safari XP and increase your Safari Level. If you catch a Pokémon, there is a chance an item will appear on the map.

items.zh: 阿什·凯彻姆·霍恩 (Ash Ketchum Hoenn)

items.en: Ash Ketchum wants to talk to you at the Master Dojo.
items.zh: 艾什·凯彻姆想在大师道场与你交谈。
items.normEn: Ash Ketchum wants to talk to you at the Master Dojo.

items.en: Ask around Gateon Port for clues about new Team Cipher activity.
items.zh: 向 Gateon Port 周围询问有关新 Team Cipher 活动的线索。
items.normEn: Ask around Gateon Port for clues about new Team Cipher activity.

items.en: Ask the Game Corner owner on Two Island about the meteorite.
items.zh: 向二岛的游戏角老板询问陨石的情况。
items.normEn: Ask the Game Corner owner on Two Island about the meteorite.

items.en: Ask the mysterious girl if she's okay.
items.zh: 询问神秘女孩是否还好。
items.normEn: Ask the mysterious girl if she's okay.

items.en: Astounding breakthroughs have been made since then. We can now store Pokémon eggs for longer and queue them up for breeding.
items.zh: 自那时以来，已经取得了惊人的突破。我们现在可以将神奇宝贝蛋储存更长时间并排队等待繁殖。
items.normEn: Astounding breakthroughs have been made since then. We can now store Pokémon eggs for longer and queue them up for breeding.

items.en: At any rate, I believe that a Trainer like you will be able to use both Alola's Legendary Pokémon and the fearsome power of Necrozma properly! I happen to know quite a bit about Pokémon fusion myself... But that is a different tale. Good luck in your battles!
items.zh: 无论如何，我相信像你这样的训练家一定能正确使用阿罗拉的传奇宝可梦和奈克洛兹玛的可怕力量！我自己碰巧对神奇宝贝融合了解很多……但那是另一个故事了。祝你战斗顺利！
items.normEn: At any rate, I believe that a Trainer like you will be able to use both Alola's Legendary Pokémon and the fearsome power of Necrozma properly! I happen to know quite a bit about Pokémon fusion myself... But that is a different tale. Good luck in your battles!

items.en: At any rate, I'm real thankful for all your help. There's so many more people coming here now there's more Gigantamax Pokémon to find.  It's been a lot of fun!
items.zh: 无论如何，我真的很感谢你们的帮助。现在有更多的人来到这里，有更多的超极巨化神奇宝贝等待寻找。很有趣！
items.normEn: At any rate, I'm real thankful for all your help. There's so many more people coming here now there's more Gigantamax Pokémon to find. It's been a lot of fun!

items.en: At first I'd taken Nebby with me, but I didn't have the courage to protect it myself. But I'm not that person anymore!
items.zh: 起初我带着Nebby，但我没有勇气自己保护它。但我已经不再是那个人了！
items.normEn: At first I'd taken Nebby with me, but I didn't have the courage to protect it myself. But I'm not that person anymore!

items.en: At Lake Acuity, ask Uxie about the Distortion World.
items.zh: 在敏锐湖，向 Uxie 询问扭曲世界的情况。
items.normEn: At Lake Acuity, ask Uxie about the Distortion World.

items.en: At Lake Valor, ask Azelf about the Distortion World.
items.zh: 在勇气湖，向阿泽尔夫询问扭曲世界的情况。
items.normEn: At Lake Valor, ask Azelf about the Distortion World.

items.en: At Lake Verity, ask Mesprit about the Distortion World.
items.zh: 在真实湖，向梅斯普利特询问扭曲世界的情况。
items.normEn: At Lake Verity, ask Mesprit about the Distortion World.

items.en: At least 1 part of the treasure is visible to the player
items.zh: 宝藏的至少 1 部分对玩家可见
items.normEn: At least 1 part of the treasure is visible to the player

items.en: At other times, the Primal Reversion of our own super-ancient Pokémon brought us to the brink of destruction. Each time, Lord Rayquaza has saved us from doom.
items.zh: 在其他时候，我们自己的超古代神奇宝贝的原始回归将我们带到了毁灭的边缘。每一次，烈空坐领主都将我们从厄运中拯救出来。
items.normEn: At other times, the Primal Reversion of our own super-ancient Pokémon brought us to the brink of destruction. Each time, Lord Rayquaza has saved us from doom.

items.en: At the Battle Frontier, you can test your skills against Trainers from all over the world.
items.zh: 在战斗前沿，您可以与来自世界各地的训练师一起测试您的技能。
items.normEn: At the Battle Frontier, you can test your skills against Trainers from all over the world.

items.en: Attack achievement no longer based on current region
items.zh: 攻击成就不再基于当前区域
items.normEn: Attack achievement no longer based on current region

items.en: Attack Achievements appearing again on reload
items.zh: 攻击成就在重新加载时再次出现
items.normEn: Attack Achievements appearing again on reload

items.en: Attack Bonus display value now includes additional attack modifiers
items.zh: 攻击加值显示值现在包括额外的攻击修正值
items.normEn: Attack Bonus display value now includes additional attack modifiers

items.en: Attack boosting held items now work correctly after transferring in Real Evolution
items.zh: 现在，在真实进化中转移后，攻击增强持有的物品可以正常工作
items.normEn: Attack boosting held items now work correctly after transferring in Real Evolution

items.en: Attack value shown on hover in Battle Frontier
items.zh: 战斗前沿中悬停时显示的攻击值
items.normEn: Attack value shown on hover in Battle Frontier

items.en: Attempt to fix svg image on map for older Safari versions
items.zh: 尝试修复旧版 Safari 地图上的 svg 图像
items.normEn: Attempt to fix svg image on map for older Safari versions

items.en: Attend the opening ceremony of the Millennium Festival near Lavaridge Town.
items.zh: 参加拉瓦里奇镇附近的千禧节开幕式。
items.normEn: Attend the opening ceremony of the Millennium Festival near Lavaridge Town.

items.en: Attracts Gigantamax Pokémon to the Max Lair
items.zh: 将超极巨化宝可梦吸引到最大巢穴
items.normEn: Attracts Gigantamax Pokémon to the Max Lair

items.en: Audino's excellent hearing lets it pick up even the quietest hints from Dream Orbs. If you can help the professor advance her research, I may be able to help you in return.
items.zh: Audino 出色的听力使其能够从 Dream Orbs 中接收到最安静的提示。如果你能帮助教授推进她的研究，我也许也能帮助你作为回报。
items.normEn: Audino's excellent hearing lets it pick up even the quietest hints from Dream Orbs. If you can help the professor advance her research, I may be able to help you in return.

items.en: Audio cue when Max Flow has been gathered
items.zh: 收集最大流量时的音频提示
items.normEn: Audio cue when Max Flow has been gathered

items.en: Auto refresh Daily Deals when upgrade purchased
items.zh: 购买升级时自动刷新每日优惠
items.normEn: Auto refresh Daily Deals when upgrade purchased

items.en: Automatically starting a new mine happens in the following cases:
items.zh: 自动启动新矿井发生在以下情况：
items.normEn: Automatically starting a new mine happens in the following cases:

items.en: Aw man, what was I doing?
items.normEn: Aw man, what was I doing?

items.en: Aww, come on! What a drag! But...I guess it was also kinda fun!
items.zh: 哇哦，来吧！真是太累了！但是……我想这也很有趣！
items.normEn: Aww, come on! What a drag! But...I guess it was also kinda fun!

items.en: Aww, man! I wanted to show off my Pokémon's best side more!
items.zh: 哇，伙计！我想更多地展示我的神奇宝贝最好的一面！
items.normEn: Aww, man! I wanted to show off my Pokémon's best side more!

items.en: Aww! It appeared to be caught!
items.normEn: Aww! It appeared to be caught!

items.en: Aye! At this here dock you can travel to faraway regions! But only ones you’ve travelled to before; I’ve heard the Professor has his own vessel to take ye’ to new lands!
items.zh: 是啊！在这个码头，您可以前往遥远的地区！但仅限于您以前去过的地方；我听说教授有他自己的船可以带你们去新的土地！
items.normEn: Aye! At this here dock you can travel to faraway regions! But only ones you’ve travelled to before; I’ve heard the Professor has his own vessel to take ye’ to new lands!

items.en: Baaah! I gotta get out of here!
items.normEn: Baaah! I gotta get out of here!

items.en: Baah, what's the use in fighting you?
items.normEn: Baah, what's the use in fighting you?

items.en: Babiri berry removed from Enigma pool
items.zh: 巴比里浆果从恩尼格玛池中移除
items.normEn: Babiri berry removed from Enigma pool

items.en: Baby Pokémon aren't considered evolutions but gifts.
items.zh: 小神奇宝贝不被视为进化，而是礼物。
items.normEn: Baby Pokémon aren't considered evolutions but gifts.

items.en: Baby Pokémon can now be obtained by breeding any evolution in the line
items.zh: 现在可以通过培育该系列的任何进化来获得小神奇宝贝
items.normEn: Baby Pokémon can now be obtained by breeding any evolution in the line

items.en: Back already? That didn't take very long.
items.zh: 已经回来了吗？这并没有花很长时间。
items.normEn: Back already? That didn't take very long.

items.en: Background settings Night and Dynamic added
items.zh: 添加了背景设置夜间和动态
items.normEn: Background settings Night and Dynamic added

items.en: Backgrounds should no longer overflow in breeding modal
items.zh: 背景不应再在育种模式中溢出
items.normEn: Backgrounds should no longer overflow in breeding modal

items.en: Bad news first. I didn't manage to open the ball. It's just stuck. No way to get in there. Better give up on it. This story ends here.
items.zh: 首先是坏消息。我没能把球打开。它只是卡住了。没有办法进去。最好放弃它。这个故事到这里就结束了。
items.normEn: Bad news first. I didn't manage to open the ball. It's just stuck. No way to get in there. Better give up on it. This story ends here.

items.en: Badge case split up by region
items.normEn: Badge case split up by region

items.en: Badge names should display correctly now
items.zh: 徽章名称现在应该正确显示
items.normEn: Badge names should display correctly now

items.en: Bah ha ha! I lost! You're pretty strong, aren't you? The way you battle really shows me how much you care about your Pokémon! Even if you've come because of a misunderstanding, as long as you have a will to learn... then you're welcome at the Master Dojo! I think we can all help each other become stronger! I'm happy you've come to join us!
items.zh: 呸哈哈哈！我输了！你很强，不是吗？你战斗的方式确实让我知道你有多么关心你的神奇宝贝！即使你是因为误会而来，只要你有学习的意愿……那么大师道场欢迎你！我想我们都可以互相帮助，变得更强！我很高兴你能加入我们！
items.normEn: Bah ha ha! I lost! You're pretty strong, aren't you? The way you battle really shows me how much you care about your Pokémon! Even if you've come because of a misunderstanding, as long as you have a will to learn... then you're welcome at the Master Dojo! I think we can all help each other become stronger! I'm happy you've come to join us!

items.en: Bah! No fair! Fine, you can take your precious Professor Krane. Get out of here!
items.zh: 呸!不公平！好吧，你可以带上你亲爱的克兰教授了。离开这里！
items.normEn: Bah! No fair! Fine, you can take your precious Professor Krane. Get out of here!

items.en: Bah! You younglings have no appreciation of the art of Berry farming!
items.zh: 呸!你们这些年轻人根本不懂浆果种植的艺术！
items.normEn: Bah! You younglings have no appreciation of the art of Berry farming!

items.en: Base wandering Pokémon no longer award EVs
items.zh: 基地徘徊的神奇宝贝不再奖励电动汽车
items.normEn: Base wandering Pokémon no longer award EVs

items.en: Based on the statues the sword and shield must have actually been two Pokémon, right?
items.zh: 从雕像来看，剑和盾肯定是两只神奇宝贝，对吧？
items.normEn: Based on the statues the sword and shield must have actually been two Pokémon, right?

items.en: Battery Discharge (Underground) can now be used without equipping the Cell Battery Oak Item
items.zh: 现在可以在不装备电池橡木物品的情况下使用电池放电（地下）
items.normEn: Battery Discharge (Underground) can now be used without equipping the Cell Battery Oak Item

items.en: Battle Café now affects map overlay colors
items.zh: 战斗咖啡馆现在影响地图叠加颜色
items.normEn: Battle Café now affects map overlay colors

items.en: Battle Frontier now saves your stage if you leave early
items.zh: 如果你提早离开，战斗前沿现在可以保存你的舞台
items.normEn: Battle Frontier now saves your stage if you leave early

items.zh: 战斗前沿现在始终使用晴朗天气
items.normEn: Battle Frontier now uses Clear weather at all times

items.zh: 战斗边境奖励神奇宝贝现在有机会闪亮
items.normEn: Battle Frontier reward Pokémon now have a chance to be shiny

items.en: Battle Gladion on Ula'ula one last time before ascending to the Pokémon League.
items.zh: 在晋升神奇宝贝联盟之前，在乌拉乌拉与格拉迪恩进行最后一次战斗。
items.normEn: Battle Gladion on Ula'ula one last time before ascending to the Pokémon League.

items.en: Battle Gym Leaders to earn badges
items.zh: 与道馆领袖对战以获得徽章
items.normEn: Battle Gym Leaders to earn badges

items.normEn: Battle item about to wear off

items.en: Battle item effect timers now display upto 99 hours
items.zh: 战斗物品效果计时器现在显示长达 99 小时
items.normEn: Battle item effect timers now display upto 99 hours

items.en: Battle items no longer always active
items.zh: 战斗物品不再始终有效
items.normEn: Battle items no longer always active

items.en: Battle through Team Cipher on Citadark Isle
items.zh: 在 Citadark 岛上与 Cipher 团队战斗
items.normEn: Battle through Team Cipher on Citadark Isle

items.zh: 在菲纳克城与新的密码苦工战斗。
items.normEn: Battle through the new Cipher Peons in Phenac City.

items.en: Battle through the Snagem Hideout and look for clues.
items.zh: 穿过斯纳吉姆藏身处并寻找线索。
items.normEn: Battle through the Snagem Hideout and look for clues.

items.zh: 战斗前沿最高阶段已完成
战斗边境总阶段已完成
战斗物品现在可以正确购买

items.en: Battles with friends are really, really exciting!
items.zh: 和朋友一起对战真的非常非常刺激！
items.normEn: Battles with friends are really, really exciting!

items.en: Battling with you is fun, but losing all the time doesn't really make me look all that good.
items.zh: 和你战斗很有趣，但一直失败并不会让我看起来那么好。
items.normEn: Battling with you is fun, but losing all the time doesn't really make me look all that good.

items.normEn: Be in-game for a total of ${...} seconds.

items.zh: 兽球只能用来捕捉究极异兽。你甚至不能尝试用它们对抗普通的神奇宝贝，任何其他类型的神奇宝贝球都无法对抗究极异兽。
items.normEn: Beast Balls can only be used to catch Ultra Beasts. You can't even try to use them against normal Pokémon, and any other Poké Ball type won't work against Ultra Beasts.

items.normEn: Beat the Team Flare Grunt once more!

items.en: Beat up the Team Skull grunts loitering on Hau'oli City's Dock.
items.zh: 击败在豪奥利城码头徘徊的骷髅队咕噜声。
items.normEn: Beat up the Team Skull grunts loitering on Hau'oli City's Dock.

items.en: Because of its hollow inside pocket, there isn't a lot to eat. What can be eaten is very sweet and delicious.
items.zh: 因为里面的口袋是空的，所以吃的东西并不多。能吃的东西都是非常香甜可口的。
items.normEn: Because of its hollow inside pocket, there isn't a lot to eat. What can be eaten is very sweet and delicious.

items.en: before you are able to travel between regions again.
items.zh: 在您能够再次在地区之间旅行之前。
items.normEn: before you are able to travel between regions again.

items.en: Before you could attempt to capture it, Enamorus fled to roam the region!
items.zh: 在您尝试捕获它之前，迷恋者已逃走并在该地区漫游！
items.normEn: Before you could attempt to capture it, Enamorus fled to roam the region!

items.en: Behold! Before you stands Urshifu! Sure to be unyielding armor that will shatter any blade turned against it... And it has mastered the styles of darkness and water!
items.zh: 看哪！你面前站着Urshifu！肯定是坚不可摧的盔甲，可以粉碎任何对抗它的利刃……而且它已经掌握了黑暗和水的风格！

items.zh: 能够尽早进入一些地下城

items.zh: 能够在野生动物区陷入诱饵债务

items.zh: 如果启用了图鉴挑战，就可以提前离开该地区

items.zh: 在道馆战斗时能够获胜和失败
items.normEn: Being able to win and lose when fighting a Gym

items.zh: 浆果不太可能产生自身突变

items.zh: 浆果不太可能使附近的地块发生变异

items.zh: 浆果可以与后面地区的浆果大师交易以换取其他有用的物品。

items.zh: 根据某些条件，浆果有机会引起突变并在空地上创造新的浆果物种。

items.zh: Berry 提示每天正确更新

items.zh: 比尔邀请你和他一起前往塞维群岛，建立与关东大陆的数字连接。

items.en: Bill's Grandpa has given you an Eevee, treat it well!
items.zh: 比尔的爷爷给了你一只伊布，好好对待它！
items.normEn: Bill's Grandpa has given you an Eevee, treat it well!

items.en: Bill's Grandpa wants you to catch a Pokémon that has a red sphere in its body and is shaped like a star.
items.zh: 比尔的爷爷希望你捕捉一只身体有红色球体、形状像星星的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Bill's Grandpa wants you to catch a Pokémon that has a red sphere in its body and is shaped like a star.

items.en: Bill's Grandpa wants you to catch a Pokémon that has a yellow body and red cheeks.
items.zh: 比尔的爷爷希望你捕捉一只黄色身体和红色脸颊的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Bill's Grandpa wants you to catch a Pokémon that has a yellow body and red cheeks.

items.en: Bill's Grandpa wants you to catch a Pokémon that is pink and like a balloon.
items.zh: 比尔的爷爷希望你捕捉一只粉红色的气球般的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Bill's Grandpa wants you to catch a Pokémon that is pink and like a balloon.

items.en: Bill's Grandpa wants you to catch a Pokémon that is round, blue, and has leaves growing on its head.
items.zh: 比尔的爷爷希望你捕捉一只圆形、蓝色、头上长有叶子的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Bill's Grandpa wants you to catch a Pokémon that is round, blue, and has leaves growing on its head.

items.en: Bill's Grandpa wants you to catch a Pokémon that is very loyal and supposedly roars pretty well.
items.zh: 比尔的爷爷希望你捕捉一只非常忠诚并且吼叫得很好的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Bill's Grandpa wants you to catch a Pokémon that is very loyal and supposedly roars pretty well.

items.en: Bill's Grandpa would like to have a battle with you!
items.zh: 比尔的爷爷想和你来一场战斗！
items.normEn: Bill's Grandpa would like to have a battle with you!

items.en: Bitter, but with a trace of sweetness, the Nanab Berry was the seventh to be discovered in the world.
items.zh: 纳纳布浆果苦涩，但带有一丝甜味，是世界上第七个被发现的浆果。
items.normEn: Bitter, but with a trace of sweetness, the Nanab Berry was the seventh to be discovered in the world.

items.en: Blaze Cassette replaced with Magma Stone
items.normEn: Blaze Cassette replaced with Magma Stone

items.en: Blegh! I've taken three soaks in the hot springs and I can still taste the soot!
items.zh: 布莱！我已经泡了三趟温泉了，还能闻到烟灰的味道！
items.normEn: Blegh! I've taken three soaks in the hot springs and I can still taste the soot!

items.en: Blue has contacted you, saying he knows something but wants a fight first. He is at Viridian City.
items.zh: Blue 已经联系了你，说他知道一些事情，但想先打一场。他在常磐城。
items.normEn: Blue has contacted you, saying he knows something but wants a fight first. He is at Viridian City.

items.en: Blue is getting in your way. Defeat him in Silph Co.
items.zh: 蓝色妨碍了你。在西尔夫公司击败他。
items.normEn: Blue is getting in your way. Defeat him in Silph Co.

items.zh: 蓝色是我最喜欢的颜色

items.en: Bonds... They really are important to us all, aren't they? When I'm acting, I think I'm always trying to forge a bond between myself and the character I'm playing.
items.zh: 债券……它们对我们所有人来说确实很重要，不是吗？当我表演时，我想我总是试图在自己和我扮演的角色之间建立联系。
items.normEn: Bonds... They really are important to us all, aren't they? When I'm acting, I think I'm always trying to forge a bond between myself and the character I'm playing.

items.zh: Boost Dungeon 代币略有增加

items.en: Boosts Wanderer catch rate by 10% and increases the chance of non-base Wanderers appearing. Available from Unova.
items.zh: 流浪者捕获率提高 10%，并增加非基地流浪者出现的几率。可从 Unova 购买。
items.normEn: Boosts Wanderer catch rate by 10% and increases the chance of non-base Wanderers appearing. Available from Unova.

items.en: Boss icon visible on light themes
items.zh: 浅色主题上可见的 Boss 图标
items.normEn: Boss icon visible on light themes

items.en: Both My Thumbs Are Green! This Can't Be Healthy
items.zh: 我的两个大拇指都绿了！这不可能是健康的
items.normEn: Both My Thumbs Are Green! This Can't Be Healthy

items.en: Bravo! Excellent! Your talent has brought you to the destination called Victory! Now, allow me to call Sneasler...
items.zh: 太棒了！出色的！你的才华已经把你带到了胜利的目的地！现在，请允许我给斯尼斯勒打电话……
items.normEn: Bravo! Excellent! Your talent has brought you to the destination called Victory! Now, allow me to call Sneasler...

items.en: Breeding display takes up less space on smaller screens now
items.zh: 现在，育种显示在较小的屏幕上占用的空间更少
items.normEn: Breeding display takes up less space on smaller screens now

items.en: Breeding has higher odds of obtaining a shiny Pokémon
items.zh: 繁殖获得闪亮宝可梦的几率更高
items.normEn: Breeding has higher odds of obtaining a shiny Pokémon

items.en: Bringing your save back over to the main game will very likely cause problems, whenever testing something new please re-import a fresh save file to avoid any bugs.
items.zh: 将您的保存带回主游戏很可能会导致问题，每当测试新内容时，请重新导入新的保存文件以避免任何错误。
items.normEn: Bringing your save back over to the main game will very likely cause problems, whenever testing something new please re-import a fresh save file to avoid any bugs.

btn btn-成功 小按钮 小字体

items.normEn: Buff P2 Lab, increase boss pool

items.en: Buffed bonus for the Cell Battery
items.normEn: Buffed bonus for the Cell Battery

items.zh: 增强捕捉神奇宝贝类型任务奖励
items.normEn: Buffed Capture Pokémon Type quest rewards

items.en: Buffed Dungeon Token gain in higher regions
items.zh: 增强了较高区域的地下城令牌增益
items.normEn: Buffed Dungeon Token gain in higher regions

items.en: Buffed egg steps for baby Pokémon
items.zh: 神奇宝贝宝宝的抛光蛋步
items.normEn: Buffed egg steps for baby Pokémon
