农场流浪宝可梦率提高
抛光 Pinkan 浆果收获率

items.en: Buffed Pokémon typed quest reward amounts
items.zh: 增强神奇宝贝类型的任务奖励金额
items.normEn: Buffed Pokémon typed quest reward amounts

items.en: Buffed shiny chance for Safari Zone
items.zh: 增加了 Safari Zone 的闪亮机会
items.normEn: Buffed shiny chance for Safari Zone

items.en: Bulletin Board, With misc quests available
items.normEn: Bulletin Board, With misc quests available

items.zh: 刻录驱动器盖诺塞克特

items.en: But be careful! If you defeat them, they will run away again!
items.zh: 但要小心！如果你打败了他们，他们就会再次逃跑！
items.normEn: But be careful! If you defeat them, they will run away again!

items.en: But don't worry, catching them all is only a matter of time. Just keep exploring and having fun and you'll encounter lots of different Pokémon, either in form, color, or even evolutions!
items.zh: 但不用担心，抓住它们只是时间问题。只要继续探索并享受乐趣，您就会遇到许多不同的神奇宝贝，无论是形状、颜色，甚至是进化！
items.normEn: But don't worry, catching them all is only a matter of time. Just keep exploring and having fun and you'll encounter lots of different Pokémon, either in form, color, or even evolutions!

items.en: But enough about me, what brings you here? Hmm, I can sense that you have a burning desire for something... Ah, it must be the Silvally Memory I found in the trail, am I right? It was a challenge to befriend that Mimikyu holding it. If you want it, you'll have to battle me first! Don't worry, I won't hold back just because we're friends. I want to see what you're made of! So, what do you say, ready to face the challenge?
items.zh: 但我已经说得够多了，是什么风把你吹到这里来的？嗯，我能感觉到你对某件事有着强烈的渴望……啊，这一定是我在小道中找到的希尔瓦利记忆吧？与拿着它的咪咪Q成为朋友是一个挑战。想要的话，就先跟我战斗吧！别担心，我不会因为我们是朋友而拒绝。我倒要看看你到底是个什么东西！那么，你说呢，准备好迎接挑战了吗？
items.normEn: But enough about me, what brings you here? Hmm, I can sense that you have a burning desire for something... Ah, it must be the Silvally Memory I found in the trail, am I right? It was a challenge to befriend that Mimikyu holding it. If you want it, you'll have to battle me first! Don't worry, I won't hold back just because we're friends. I want to see what you're made of! So, what do you say, ready to face the challenge?

items.en: But even though he is a sore loser, he will always give his opponent a shiny ball, as a reward for winning.
items.zh: 但即使他是一个痛苦的失败者，他总是会给对手一个闪亮的球，作为胜利的奖励。
items.normEn: But even though he is a sore loser, he will always give his opponent a shiny ball, as a reward for winning.

items.en: But first, wanna get involved in our regional Pokémon League? No? Maybe another time then.
items.zh: 但首先，想加入我们地区的神奇宝贝联盟吗？不？也许下次吧。
items.normEn: But first, wanna get involved in our regional Pokémon League? No? Maybe another time then.

items.en: But I didn't hold back! I gave it everything I've got...
items.zh: 但我没有忍住！我给了它我所拥有的一切...
items.normEn: But I didn't hold back! I gave it everything I've got...

items.en: But I will save her. I still have something I need to tell her. I am alive. Cosmog is alive.
items.zh: 但我会救她。我还有话要告诉她。我还活着。科斯莫格还活着。
items.normEn: But I will save her. I still have something I need to tell her. I am alive. Cosmog is alive.

items.en: But I'm in a bit of a pickle. The energy released by the Darkest Day is too much for us to contain.
items.zh: 但我有点进退两难。至暗之日释放的能量太多了，我们无法控制。
items.normEn: But I'm in a bit of a pickle. The energy released by the Darkest Day is too much for us to contain.

items.en: But I'm still going to activate the ultimate weapon! I'll just use my remote, here! Click-click! And the power is ON!
items.zh: 但我还是要激活终极武器！我就用我的遥控器吧！点击点击！并且电源已打开！
items.normEn: But I'm still going to activate the ultimate weapon! I'll just use my remote, here! Click-click! And the power is ON!

items.en: But if I focus on what I have in common with the character and put myself in her shoes, I might be able to understand her. It's the same for people, or Pokémon.
items.zh: 但如果我专注于我与这个角色的共同点并设身处地为她着想，我也许能够理解她。对于人或者神奇宝贝来说都是一样的。
items.normEn: But if I focus on what I have in common with the character and put myself in her shoes, I might be able to understand her. It's the same for people, or Pokémon.

items.en: But it contains everything, huh? I know all about it. About just what kinda energy you're using to fuel this rocket thing... The abominable technology humanity first thought up 3,000 years ago!
items.zh: 但它包含了一切，是吧？我知道这一切。关于你用什么样的能量来为这个火箭提供燃料……人类在 3000 年前首次想到的可恶技术！
items.normEn: But it contains everything, huh? I know all about it. About just what kinda energy you're using to fuel this rocket thing... The abominable technology humanity first thought up 3,000 years ago!

items.en: But it feels like we've been going in circles! The only reason I know we aren't is because every time we reach a similar crossroads, the mushrooms are in different places.
items.zh: 但感觉我们一直在兜圈子！我知道我们不是的唯一原因是因为每次我们到达类似的十字路口时，蘑菇都在不同的地方。
items.normEn: But it feels like we've been going in circles! The only reason I know we aren't is because every time we reach a similar crossroads, the mushrooms are in different places.

items.en: But it looks as though that time has already come. I'm sorry to ask this of you, but I need your help getting some materials for Devon Corporation's new rocket project. We think we can help Dr. Cozmo stop the incoming meteor.
items.zh: 但看起来那个时刻已经到来了。我很抱歉向你提出这个问题，但我需要你的帮助，为德文公司的新火箭项目获取一些材料。我们认为我们可以帮助科兹莫博士阻止即将到来的流星。
items.normEn: But it looks as though that time has already come. I'm sorry to ask this of you, but I need your help getting some materials for Devon Corporation's new rocket project. We think we can help Dr. Cozmo stop the incoming meteor.

items.en: But now that I have so many of them, their behaviour has taken a... regrettable turn.
items.zh: 但现在我有了这么多人，他们的行为发生了……令人遗憾的转变。
items.normEn: But now that I have so many of them, their behaviour has taken a... regrettable turn.

items.en: But please leave it alone! It has been through too much already!
items.zh: 但请别管它！已经经历了太多太多了！
items.normEn: But please leave it alone! It has been through too much already!

items.en: But recently, now that I've got so many Houndour, they have been acting rather curiously.
items.zh: 但最近，既然我养了这么多猎犬，它们的行为就变得相当奇怪。
items.normEn: But recently, now that I've got so many Houndour, they have been acting rather curiously.

items.en: But there's no need to worry. Based on our theory, we can at least guarantee that we will be sending the meteor away from our planet if the plan is successful. Not sure where it will go.
items.zh: 但无需担心。根据我们的理论，如果计划成功，我们至少可以保证将流星送离地球。不确定它会去哪里。
items.normEn: But there's no need to worry. Based on our theory, we can at least guarantee that we will be sending the meteor away from our planet if the plan is successful. Not sure where it will go.

items.en: But this doesn't look like the Renegade Pokémon from legend, it seems like some sort of altered form.
items.zh: 但这看起来并不像传说中的叛逆神奇宝贝，它看起来像是某种变形的形式。
items.normEn: But this doesn't look like the Renegade Pokémon from legend, it seems like some sort of altered form.

items.en: But truth be told, I didn't know that this thing could fly. I was not prepared for this.
items.zh: 但说实话，我不知道这东西能飞。我对此没有准备。
items.normEn: But truth be told, I didn't know that this thing could fly. I was not prepared for this.

items.en: But we are fresh from the tearing of the space-time rift. Until its aftereffects fade entirely, perhaps its best to keep our trio contained.
items.zh: 但我们刚刚经历过时空裂缝的撕裂。在其后遗症完全消退之前，也许最好还是控制住我们的三人组。
items.normEn: But we are fresh from the tearing of the space-time rift. Until its aftereffects fade entirely, perhaps its best to keep our trio contained.

items.en: But what of you? Are you making any progress with your...what do you call your studies of Pokémon? Surveying, was it?
items.zh: 但你呢？你对神奇宝贝的研究有进展吗？勘察，是吗？
items.normEn: But what of you? Are you making any progress with your...what do you call your studies of Pokémon? Surveying, was it?

items.en: But when you caught them, neither were using them. But they must still have them, right?
items.zh: 但当你抓住它们时，他们都没有使用它们。但他们一定还拥有它们，对吗？
items.normEn: But when you caught them, neither were using them. But they must still have them, right?

items.en: But you know what $playername$? Every time in this journey, you've shown me that it's possible... to do something.
items.zh: 但你知道$playername$ 是什么吗？在这段旅程中的每一次，你都向我展示了……做某事是可能的。
items.normEn: But you know what $playername$? Every time in this journey, you've shown me that it's possible... to do something.

items.en: But, I could never give Applin a Sweet or Tart Apple, that just seems so... wrong...
items.zh: 但是，我永远不能给阿普林一个甜苹果或酸苹果，这看起来太……错误了……
items.normEn: But, I could never give Applin a Sweet or Tart Apple, that just seems so... wrong...

items.en: But, there is a slight catch. For the link to work, the Machine needs a special gemstone. It's supposed to be on One Island, but I haven't found one yet. Who knows where it could be.
items.zh: 但是，有一个小问题。为了使链接发挥作用，机器需要特殊的宝石。应该是在One Island，不过我还没找到。谁知道它可能在哪里。
items.normEn: But, there is a slight catch. For the link to work, the Machine needs a special gemstone. It's supposed to be on One Island, but I haven't found one yet. Who knows where it could be.

items.en: But... I don't have a high enough Safari Level to find it.
items.zh: 但是...我没有足够高的 Safari 级别来找到它。
items.normEn: But... I don't have a high enough Safari Level to find it.

items.en: Butler has escaped through the Jagged Pass and hooked Jirachi up to some sort of machine. Fight him to free Jirachi.
items.zh: 巴特勒已经穿过锯齿通道逃脱，并将基拉祈连接到某种机器上。与他战斗以释放基拉祈。
items.normEn: Butler has escaped through the Jagged Pass and hooked Jirachi up to some sort of machine. Fight him to free Jirachi.

items.en: Butler has followed you to the Mt. Chimney Crater and is trying to kidnap Jirachi!
items.zh: 巴特勒跟踪你来到了烟囱山火山口，并试图绑架基拉祈！
items.normEn: Butler has followed you to the Mt. Chimney Crater and is trying to kidnap Jirachi!

items.en: Butler has revived Meta Groudon at Mt. Chimney Crater. Catch Meta Groudon.
items.zh: 巴特勒在烟囱火山口复活了​​梅塔·固拉多。抓住梅塔·固拉多。
items.normEn: Butler has revived Meta Groudon at Mt. Chimney Crater. Catch Meta Groudon.

items.en: Butler NPC in the A Meta Discovery quest line appearing in the wrong town
items.zh: 元发现任务线中的管家 NPC 出现在错误的城镇
items.normEn: Butler NPC in the A Meta Discovery quest line appearing in the wrong town

items.en: Butler's attempts to resurrect Groudon have gone terribly wrong! Fight the resulting abomination!
items.zh: 巴特勒复活固拉多的尝试彻底失败了！与由此产生的憎恶作斗争！
items.normEn: Butler's attempts to resurrect Groudon have gone terribly wrong! Fight the resulting abomination!

items.en: button to include it in the filter, and choose a value it must match.
items.zh: 按钮将其包含在过滤器中，然后选择一个必须匹配的值。
items.normEn: button to include it in the filter, and choose a value it must match.

items.en: Buttons added to achievement modal to jump to first and last pages
items.zh: 添加到成就模式的按钮可跳转到第一页和最后一页
items.normEn: Buttons added to achievement modal to jump to first and last pages

items.en: Buy the Dungeon Ticket from Viridian City Shop.
items.zh: 从常磐城商店购买地下城门票。
items.normEn: Buy the Dungeon Ticket from Viridian City Shop.

items.en: Buy the Electric Memory from Captain Sophocles with Pokédollars.
items.zh: 用神奇币从索福克勒斯船长那里购买电记忆。
items.normEn: Buy the Electric Memory from Captain Sophocles with Pokédollars.

items.en: Buy the Explorer Kit from Cinnabar Island Shop.
items.zh: 从朱砂岛商店购买探险家套件。
items.normEn: Buy the Explorer Kit from Cinnabar Island Shop.

items.en: Buy the Fire Memory from Captain Kiawe with Battle Points.
items.zh: 使用战斗点数从基亚威船长处购买火焰记忆。
items.normEn: Buy the Fire Memory from Captain Kiawe with Battle Points.

items.en: Buy the Grass Memory from Captain Mallow with Quest Points.
items.zh: 使用任务点从马洛船长那里购买草记忆。
items.normEn: Buy the Grass Memory from Captain Mallow with Quest Points.

items.en: Buy the Ground Memory from Kahuna Hapu with Farm Points.
items.zh: 使用农场点数从 Kahuna Hapu 购买地面记忆。
items.normEn: Buy the Ground Memory from Kahuna Hapu with Farm Points.

items.en: Buy the Ice Memory from Veteran Aristo with Diamonds.
items.zh: 用钻石从老兵阿里斯托那里购买冰记忆。
items.normEn: Buy the Ice Memory from Veteran Aristo with Diamonds.

items.en: Buy the Water Memory from Captain Lana with Dungeon Tokens.
items.zh: 使用地下城代币从拉娜船长那里购买水之记忆。
items.normEn: Buy the Water Memory from Captain Lana with Dungeon Tokens.

items.en: Buying multiple Pokémon at the shop now applies the correct amount of EVs
items.zh: 现在在商店购买多个神奇宝贝会应用正确数量的电动汽车
items.normEn: Buying multiple Pokémon at the shop now applies the correct amount of EVs

items.en: Bwah!! I had my breath held that whole battle!
items.zh: 哇！！整场战斗我都屏住了呼吸！
items.normEn: Bwah!! I had my breath held that whole battle!

items.en: Bwahahahaha! At last… AT LAST! I've finally done it!!! It hasn't even finished reversion, and it still has this much power!!! With this I can return everything to its natural beginning! It's time at last!
items.zh: 哇哈哈哈哈！终于……终于！我终于做到了！！！还没有完成逆转，竟然还有这么大的力量！！！有了这个我就能让一切回归自然！终于到时间了！
items.normEn: Bwahahahaha! At last… AT LAST! I've finally done it!!! It hasn't even finished reversion, and it still has this much power!!! With this I can return everything to its natural beginning! It's time at last!

items.en: By chance, have you spoken to Professor Burnet? She and Professor Kukui have been so kind, helping me investigate Nebby's origins. She's not here at the moment, but I'd like introduce you.
items.zh: 碰巧，你和伯内特教授谈过吗？她和库库伊教授非常友善，帮助我调查了内比的起源。她现在不在，但我想介绍一下你。
items.normEn: By chance, have you spoken to Professor Burnet? She and Professor Kukui have been so kind, helping me investigate Nebby's origins. She's not here at the moment, but I'd like introduce you.

items.en: By creating a warp hole in the path of the incoming meteoroid, we hope to be able to transport it somewhere far away from here....
items.zh: 通过在传入流星体的路径上创建一个扭曲洞，我们希望能够将其运送到远离这里的地方......
items.normEn: By creating a warp hole in the path of the incoming meteoroid, we hope to be able to transport it somewhere far away from here....

items.en: By the way, do you know of a sea Pokémon that has a red sphere on its body? You know, the one that's shaped like a star?
items.zh: 顺便问一下，你知道有一种身体上有红色球体的海洋神奇宝贝吗？你知道，那个形状像星星的吗？
items.normEn: By the way, do you know of a sea Pokémon that has a red sphere on its body? You know, the one that's shaped like a star?

items.en: By the way, I heard Frost Cavern has a lot of cool Pokémon, why don't you go check it out?

items.zh: Eternatus 已提升至 Eternamax 形态！抓住它，结束最黑暗的一天！
items.normEn: Eternatus has ascended to its Eternamax form! Catch it to put an end to the Darkest Day!

items.en: Eusine was here a second ago. He seemed very excited, but then he suddenly left. I don't know where he went, but he seemed to be particularly interested in the blue one.
items.zh: 尤辛一秒钟前还在这里。他看上去很兴奋，但随后却突然离开了。不知道他去了哪里，但他似乎对蓝色的特别感兴趣。
items.normEn: Eusine was here a second ago. He seemed very excited, but then he suddenly left. I don't know where he went, but he seemed to be particularly interested in the blue one.

items.en: EV bonus now taken into account for Breeding Effeciency sorting
items.zh: 育种效率排序现在考虑了 EV 奖励
items.normEn: EV bonus now taken into account for Breeding Effeciency sorting

items.en: Even frightful creatures like Pokémon can become powerful allies...
items.zh: 即使像神奇宝贝这样可怕的生物也可以成为强大的盟友......
items.normEn: Even frightful creatures like Pokémon can become powerful allies...

items.en: Even if I lose, I will not give up on justice for Team Plasma! That's all!
items.zh: 即使我输了，我也不会放弃等离子队的正义！就这样！
items.normEn: Even if I lose, I will not give up on justice for Team Plasma! That's all!

items.en: Even if she is...like that, Lusamine is still our mother. We can't just leave her in the beast's world.
items.zh: 即使她……那样，露莎米奈仍然是我们的母亲。我们不能把她留在野兽的世界里。
items.normEn: Even if she is...like that, Lusamine is still our mother. We can't just leave her in the beast's world.

items.en: Even if you don't remember details like how many times you've encountered a particular species in the wild, or how many times you've captured a Pokémon, your Pokédex does!
items.zh: 即使您不记得在野外遇到特定物种的次数，或者捕获神奇宝贝的次数等细节，您的图鉴也会记住！
items.normEn: Even if you don't remember details like how many times you've encountered a particular species in the wild, or how many times you've captured a Pokémon, your Pokédex does!

items.en: Even in places of constant rain and high humidity, this Berry's plant grows healthy and strong.
items.zh: 即使在持续降雨和高湿度的地方，这种浆果植物也能健康强壮地生长。
items.normEn: Even in places of constant rain and high humidity, this Berry's plant grows healthy and strong.

items.en: Even though I was defeated, I won't change my course. I will continue battling until I stand above all Trainers! Now move on and experience the true ferocity of the Elite Four.
items.zh: 即使我失败了，我也不会改变我的方针。我会继续战斗，直到超越所有训练家为止！现在继续前进，体验四强的真正凶猛。
items.normEn: Even though I was defeated, I won't change my course. I will continue battling until I stand above all Trainers! Now move on and experience the true ferocity of the Elite Four.

items.en: Even though it is bitter, it should be eaten peel and all. The hair on the peel cleans the stomach from the inside.
items.zh: 尽管它很苦，但还是应该连皮一起吃。果皮上的毛发从内部清洁胃。
items.normEn: Even though it is bitter, it should be eaten peel and all. The hair on the peel cleans the stomach from the inside.

items.en: Even though resources, space, and energy on this planet are limited, the number of people and Pokémon has increased to an unsustainable level. Whether it's money or energy, the ones who steal are the ones who win in this world.
items.zh: 尽管这个星球上的资源、空间和能源都是有限的，但人口和神奇宝贝的数量却增加到了不可持续的水平。无论是金钱还是精力，在这个世界上，偷窃的人就是胜利者。
items.normEn: Even though resources, space, and energy on this planet are limited, the number of people and Pokémon has increased to an unsustainable level. Whether it's money or energy, the ones who steal are the ones who win in this world.

items.en: Event Calendar - Halloween not included (purchased in Hammerlocke)
items.zh: 活动日历 - 不包括万圣节（在 Hammerlocke 购买）
items.normEn: Event Calendar - Halloween not included (purchased in Hammerlocke)

items.en: Event notifications showing way before event start
items.zh: 活动通知在活动开始前显示
items.normEn: Event notifications showing way before event start

items.zh: 活动神奇宝贝现在可以进化了

items.en: Event Pokémon no longer count towards achievements or being able to travel to next region
items.zh: 活动神奇宝贝不再计入成就或能够前往下一个区域
items.normEn: Event Pokémon no longer count towards achievements or being able to travel to next region

items.en: Event Pokémon no longer displayed in Pokédex
items.zh: 活动神奇宝贝不再显示在图鉴中
items.normEn: Event Pokémon no longer displayed in Pokédex

items.en: Ever since growing old I'm no longer the Pokémon Trainer that I used to be. Now I always like to keep my garden full of Kasib Berries.
items.zh: 自从老了之后，我就不再是以前的神奇宝贝训练家了。现在我总是喜欢让我的花园种满卡西布浆果。
items.normEn: Ever since growing old I'm no longer the Pokémon Trainer that I used to be. Now I always like to keep my garden full of Kasib Berries.

items.en: Ever since the incident at Aether Paradise, where you encountered UB-01 Symbiont, also known as Nihilego, we have heard reports of other Symbiont appearing in Alola. And other types of UBs too.
items.zh: 自从在以太天堂事件中遇到了 UB-01 共生体（也称为 Nihilego）之后，我们就听到了其他共生体出现在阿罗拉的报道。还有其他类型的 UB。
items.normEn: Ever since the incident at Aether Paradise, where you encountered UB-01 Symbiont, also known as Nihilego, we have heard reports of other Symbiont appearing in Alola. And other types of UBs too.

items.en: Everstone can now be used as a held item to prevent evolution
items.zh: 永恒石现在可以用作持有物品以防止进化
items.normEn: Everstone can now be used as a held item to prevent evolution

items.en: Every 10 Safari Levels, the animation will speed up by the following values:
items.zh: 每 10 个 Safari 级别，动画将加速以下值：
items.normEn: Every 10 Safari Levels, the animation will speed up by the following values:

items.en: Every day some of them glow red and emit a purple beam. It seems there are 10 a day, consistently, for some unknown reason. Here, download this app, and they'll show up on your map!
items.zh: 每天，其中一些会发出红光并发出紫色光束。由于某种未知的原因，似乎每天都有 10 个。在这里，下载这个应用程序，它们就会出现在您的地图上！
items.normEn: Every day some of them glow red and emit a purple beam. It seems there are 10 a day, consistently, for some unknown reason. Here, download this app, and they'll show up on your map!

items.en: Every dig uncovers a story... and this one’s staying with me.
items.zh: 每一次挖掘都会揭开一个故事……而这个故事就留在我身边。
items.normEn: Every dig uncovers a story... and this one’s staying with me.

items.en: Every so often, I'll snag an old fossil from the seafloor. It weirds me out to think of all the Pokémon that used to crawl around the ocean so many years ago, but it also reminds me that life is fleeting and precious.
items.zh: 每隔一段时间，我就会从海底捞到一块古老的化石。想起很多年前所有在海洋里爬行的神奇宝贝，我感到很奇怪，但它也提醒我，生命是短暂而宝贵的。
items.normEn: Every so often, I'll snag an old fossil from the seafloor. It weirds me out to think of all the Pokémon that used to crawl around the ocean so many years ago, but it also reminds me that life is fleeting and precious.

items.en: Everyone is finally safe again. Talk to Lillie.
items.zh: 大家终于又安全了。和莉莉说话。
items.normEn: Everyone is finally safe again. Talk to Lillie.

items.en: Everyone is finally safe. Talk to Lillie.
items.zh: 大家终于安全了。和莉莉说话。
items.normEn: Everyone is finally safe. Talk to Lillie.

items.en: Everyone knows what you did for us this week... They know you're the one who caught Eternatus and saved the future of the Galar region.
items.zh: 每个人都知道你这周为我们做了什么……他们知道你是抓住了永恒者并拯救了伽勒尔地区未来的人。
items.normEn: Everyone knows what you did for us this week... They know you're the one who caught Eternatus and saved the future of the Galar region.

items.en: EVs are unlocked after defeating the Distortion World dungeon in Sinnoh.
items.zh: 击败神奥的扭曲世界地下城后，电动车将被解锁。
items.normEn: EVs are unlocked after defeating the Distortion World dungeon in Sinnoh.

items.en: EVs can be gained in a variety of ways, but are primarily gained by capturing (not breeding) Pokémon.
items.zh: EV 可以通过多种方式获得，但主要是通过捕获（而不是繁殖）神奇宝贝来获得。
items.normEn: EVs can be gained in a variety of ways, but are primarily gained by capturing (not breeding) Pokémon.

items.en: Examine the crystalline cocoon Butler gave you while at the Mt. Chimney Crater.
items.zh: 检查巴特勒在烟囱火山口时给你的水晶茧。
items.normEn: Examine the crystalline cocoon Butler gave you while at the Mt. Chimney Crater.

items.en: Examine the first Primal Mural in Granite Cave.
items.zh: 检查花岗岩洞穴中的第一幅原始壁画。
items.normEn: Examine the first Primal Mural in Granite Cave.

items.en: Examine the second Primal Mural in Granite Cave.
items.zh: 检查花岗岩洞穴中的第二幅原始壁画。
items.normEn: Examine the second Primal Mural in Granite Cave.

items.en: Excellent! I can feel the fire of your convictions burning deep within your heart! I tried to save people--and the world--with the profit from this lab. But my efforts had no effect... This world will eventually reach the point of no return... Saving the lives of all is impossible. Only the chosen ones will obtain a ticket to tomorrow. Do you want to have a ticket? Or, do you want to stop me? Show me in battle!
items.zh: 出色的！我能感觉到你内心深处信念之火在燃烧！我试图用这个实验室的利润来拯救人们——以及世界。但我的努力没有效果……这个世界终将走向不归路……拯救所有人的生命是不可能的。只有被选中的人才能获得明天的门票。你想买票吗？或者说，你想阻止我吗？让我在战斗中看看！
items.normEn: Excellent! I can feel the fire of your convictions burning deep within your heart! I tried to save people--and the world--with the profit from this lab. But my efforts had no effect... This world will eventually reach the point of no return... Saving the lives of all is impossible. Only the chosen ones will obtain a ticket to tomorrow. Do you want to have a ticket? Or, do you want to stop me? Show me in battle!

items.en: Excuse me! I'm stuck out here on the ice, can you give me a quick push?
items.zh: 打扰一下！我被困在冰面上了，你能帮我推一下吗？
items.normEn: Excuse me! I'm stuck out here on the ice, can you give me a quick push?

items.en: Experts are characters you can hire to assist with mining tasks. They perform actions at certain timing intervals and become more efficient as they level up. Each of them bring their own powerful tools, so their actions will not affect the durability of your tools.
items.zh: 专家是您可以雇佣来协助采矿任务的角色。他们以一定的时间间隔执行行动，并随着等级的提高而变得更加高效。他们每个人都带着自己强大的工具，所以他们的行为不会影响你工具的耐用性。
items.normEn: Experts are characters you can hire to assist with mining tasks. They perform actions at certain timing intervals and become more efficient as they level up. Each of them bring their own powerful tools, so their actions will not affect the durability of your tools.

items.en: Experts start out inexperienced and will pick the most efficient tool
items.zh: 专家一开始缺乏经验，会选择最有效的工具
items.normEn: Experts start out inexperienced and will pick the most efficient tool

items.normEn: Explore Hoenn by defeating Pokémon on the hinted routes to release the Regi Trio.

items.zh: 对于每个级别过去的级别

items.en: For example, if you click on the empty ball next to the word "Caught" and assign a Poké Ball, you will then start throwing Poké Balls at Pokémon you've already caught before. This can be very useful if you need Dungeon Tokens.
items.zh: 例如，如果您单击“捕获”一词旁边的空球并分配一个神奇宝贝球，您将开始向您之前已经捕获的神奇宝贝投掷神奇宝贝球。如果您需要地下城令牌，这会非常有用。
items.normEn: For example, if you click on the empty ball next to the word "Caught" and assign a Poké Ball, you will then start throwing Poké Balls at Pokémon you've already caught before. This can be very useful if you need Dungeon Tokens.

items.en: For example, you can whip up a Vanilla Alcremie, by spinning clockwise for less than 5 seconds, during the day. Piece of cake! There’s a unique form for each Sweet under this circumstance, so bake it till you make it!
items.zh: 例如，您可以在白天顺时针旋转不到 5 秒来制作香草 Alcremie。小菜一碟！在这种情况下，每种糖果都有独特的形式，所以请烘烤直到成功！
items.normEn: For example, you can whip up a Vanilla Alcremie, by spinning clockwise for less than 5 seconds, during the day. Piece of cake! There’s a unique form for each Sweet under this circumstance, so bake it till you make it!

items.en: For example: in Sinnoh, there is a 50% chance to obtain Pokémon from the Sinnoh egg pool, a 25% chance to obtain Pokémon from the Hoenn egg pool, and a 12.5% chance to obtain Pokémon from both the Kanto and Johto egg pools.
items.zh: 例如：在神奥，神奥蛋池有50%的几率获得神奇宝贝，丰缘蛋池有25%的几率获得神奇宝贝，关东和城都蛋池都有12.5%的几率获得神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: For example: in Sinnoh, there is a 50% chance to obtain Pokémon from the Sinnoh egg pool, a 25% chance to obtain Pokémon from the Hoenn egg pool, and a 12.5% chance to obtain Pokémon from both the Kanto and Johto egg pools.

items.en: For instance, if you wanted to know what is used for a shiny Rattata, when you already have a normal Rattata, you would turn on the "Shiny" and "Caught" toggles, but leave the others off.
items.zh: 例如，如果您想知道闪亮拉达的用途，当您已经拥有普通拉达时，您可以打开“闪亮”和“捕获”开关，但关闭其他开关。
items.normEn: For instance, if you wanted to know what is used for a shiny Rattata, when you already have a normal Rattata, you would turn on the "Shiny" and "Caught" toggles, but leave the others off.

items.en: For me, victory is using the ultimate weapon. In order to do that, I need to reclaim the Legendary Pokémon's power and send that power to that weapon once again.
items.zh: 对我来说，胜利就是使用终极武器。为了做到这一点，我需要收回传说神奇宝贝的力量并将其再次发送到那把武器上。
items.normEn: For me, victory is using the ultimate weapon. In order to do that, I need to reclaim the Legendary Pokémon's power and send that power to that weapon once again.

items.en: For now, I think we can help each other out. I need you to introduce me to your rival, May. If you do that, I'll tell you my plan to stop the meteor.
items.zh: 现在，我想我们可以互相帮助。我需要你把我介绍给你的对手梅。如果你这么做了，我就会告诉你我阻止流星的计划。
items.normEn: For now, I think we can help each other out. I need you to introduce me to your rival, May. If you do that, I'll tell you my plan to stop the meteor.

items.en: For players' Pokémon with two types, only the most efficient type is applied
items.zh: 对于玩家拥有两种类型的神奇宝贝，仅应用效率最高的类型
items.normEn: For players' Pokémon with two types, only the most efficient type is applied

items.en: For some mysterious reason, they only evolve when trained in a specific area of the wild area known as the Dusty Bowl.
items.zh: 由于某种神秘的原因，它们只有在野外的一个特定区域（称为“尘土飞扬的碗”）中训练时才会进化。
items.normEn: For some mysterious reason, they only evolve when trained in a specific area of the wild area known as the Dusty Bowl.

items.en: For some people, Pokémon are pets. Other use them for battling.

items.normEn: For some people, Pokémon are pets. Other use them for battling.

items.en: For someone so obsessed with beauty he seems to really care about filth... Anyway, the Poké Ball Factory sounds like a fun place, let's go check it out.
items.zh: 对于一个如此痴迷于美丽的人来说，他似乎真的很在乎肮脏……不管怎样，神奇宝贝球工厂听起来是一个有趣的地方，我们去看看吧。
items.normEn: For someone so obsessed with beauty he seems to really care about filth... Anyway, the Poké Ball Factory sounds like a fun place, let's go check it out.

items.zh: 无论如何，我建议不要去这些地方。太湿、太热、太……丛林。为什么不留在这里？喝杯咖啡吧！享受这座城市！

items.en: Give me your name, Trainer. $playername$, eh? That's a fine name. I like the way you handled yourself in battle. Perhaps we'll meet again someday.
items.zh: 告诉我你的名字，教练。 $playername$，嗯？这是一个很好的名字。我喜欢你在战斗中的处理方式。也许有一天我们会再次见面。
items.normEn: Give me your name, Trainer. $playername$, eh? That's a fine name. I like the way you handled yourself in battle. Perhaps we'll meet again someday.

items.zh: 给你的捕获率带来奖励
items.normEn: Gives a bonus to your catchrate

items.en: Gladion gave you a Master Ball!
items.zh: Gladion 给了你一个大师球！
items.normEn: Gladion gave you a Master Ball!

items.en: Glorious! The trust that you share with your honorable Pokémon surpasses even mine!
items.zh: 辉煌！你对尊贵的宝可梦的信任甚至超过了我！
items.normEn: Glorious! The trust that you share with your honorable Pokémon surpasses even mine!

items.en: Go ahead. Since I met you in Ecruteak City, I've sort of known that Suicune would choose you.
items.zh: 前进。自从我在伊克鲁提克市遇见你以来，我就知道水君会选择你。
items.normEn: Go ahead. Since I met you in Ecruteak City, I've sort of known that Suicune would choose you.

items.en: Go back to Pallet Town and say bye to mom.
items.zh: 回到托盘镇，跟妈妈说再见。
items.normEn: Go back to Pallet Town and say bye to mom.

items.en: Go back to the Max Lair to tell Peonia what happened.
items.zh: 回到马克斯巢穴告诉佩妮娅发生了什么事。
items.normEn: Go back to the Max Lair to tell Peonia what happened.

items.normEn: Go show Gladion those memories you've bought in the Aether Foundation

items.zh: 去以太基金会与格拉迪恩交谈并告诉他你已经恢复了所有的希尔瓦利记忆！
items.normEn: Go talk to Gladion in the Aether Foundation and tell him you've recovered all the Silvally Memories!

items.en: Go to Clifford Industries in Goldenrod City to demand some answers.
items.zh: 前往金金市的克利福德工业公司寻求答案。
items.normEn: Go to Clifford Industries in Goldenrod City to demand some answers.

items.zh: 前往丰缘神奇宝贝联盟领取 Eon 门票。
items.normEn: Go to Hoenn Pokémon League to claim your Eon ticket.

items.en: Go to Hoppy Town and share their love for Magikarp.
items.zh: 前往 Hoppy Town 分享他们对鲤鱼王的热爱。
items.normEn: Go to Hoppy Town and share their love for Magikarp.

items.en: Going to the breeder will no longer send you to route 5
items.zh: 去找饲养员不再会把你送到5号公路
items.normEn: Going to the breeder will no longer send you to route 5

items.en: Gone and got stronger again, have you? Ah well! Hats off to you-in more ways than one!
items.zh: 走了又变得更强了，不是吗？啊好吧！以多种方式向您致敬！
items.normEn: Gone and got stronger again, have you? Ah well! Hats off to you-in more ways than one!

items.en: Good job on rounding up those creatures, kid.
items.zh: 孩子，围捕这些生物干得好。
items.normEn: Good job on rounding up those creatures, kid.

items.en: Good luck with your island challenge!
items.normEn: Good luck with your island challenge!

items.en: Good news first then, I managed to open the ball! And there was a Celebi inside! Bad news, the Celebi immediately left. It just flew away.
items.zh: 首先是好消息，我成功把球打开了！里面还有雪拉比！坏消息是，雪拉比人立刻离开了。它就这样飞走了。
items.normEn: Good news first then, I managed to open the ball! And there was a Celebi inside! Bad news, the Celebi immediately left. It just flew away.

items.en: Good of you to come see me. I need you to pick up something for me. A special kind of Poké Ball, found by Professor Ivy. She lives on one of the Sevii Islands, east of Three Island.
items.zh: 你能来看我真好。我需要你帮我拿点东西。艾薇教授发现的一种特殊的精灵球。她住在三岛以东的塞维群岛之一。
items.normEn: Good of you to come see me. I need you to pick up something for me. A special kind of Poké Ball, found by Professor Ivy. She lives on one of the Sevii Islands, east of Three Island.

items.en: Good, good! You two are just the best of friends now, aren't you? Kubfu's really become more confident. How wonderful! I daresay I think you're both ready.
items.zh: 好，好！你们两个现在只是最好的朋友，不是吗？库布确实变得更加自信了。多么美妙啊！我敢说我认为你们都准备好了。
items.normEn: Good, good! You two are just the best of friends now, aren't you? Kubfu's really become more confident. How wonderful! I daresay I think you're both ready.

items.en: Good! And this is from me! The Ultra Recon Squad asked me to develop a device that would be able to control Necrozma. But I improved it to my own liking! And now it is a device that makes it possible to draw out even more power from Necrozma!
items.zh: 好的！这是我的！超级侦察队要求我开发一种能够控制奈克洛兹玛的装置。但我根据自己的喜好改进了它！现在，它是一种可以从奈克洛兹玛汲取更多力量的装置！
items.normEn: Good! And this is from me! The Ultra Recon Squad asked me to develop a device that would be able to control Necrozma. But I improved it to my own liking! And now it is a device that makes it possible to draw out even more power from Necrozma!

items.en: Good! Now then... The first thing for you to do is become best friends with Kubfu! You need to build trust! Kubfu hasn't really had a chance to explore the world outside the dojo, so... Maybe it'll help you become better friends if you train alongside it!
items.zh: 好的！那么现在...你要做的第一件事就是与 Kubfu 成为最好的朋友！你需要建立信任！ Kubfu 还没有真正有机会探索道场之外的世界，所以...如果你和它一起训练，也许它会帮助你成为更好的朋友！
items.normEn: Good! Now then... The first thing for you to do is become best friends with Kubfu! You need to build trust! Kubfu hasn't really had a chance to explore the world outside the dojo, so... Maybe it'll help you become better friends if you train alongside it!

items.en: Great Marsh Safari Zone in Sinnoh
items.zh: 神奥大沼泽野生动物区
items.normEn: Great Marsh Safari Zone in Sinnoh

items.en: Great, you found it! Now if you could release it... hmm? It seems to like you. Well, if it wants to stay with you, that's its choice, so I guess it's fine.
items.zh: 太棒了，你找到了！现在如果你可以释放它......嗯？看来很喜欢你啊。好吧，如果它想和你在一起，那是它的选择，所以我想没关系。
items.normEn: Great, you found it! Now if you could release it... hmm? It seems to like you. Well, if it wants to stay with you, that's its choice, so I guess it's fine.

items.en: Great! My friend's name is Koko, tell him I sent you. This battle shouldn't take me too long, so come ask for my help if you need it!
items.zh: 伟大的！我朋友的名字叫科科，告诉他是我派你来的。这场战斗不会花我太长时间，有需要的话就来找我帮忙吧！
items.normEn: Great! My friend's name is Koko, tell him I sent you. This battle shouldn't take me too long, so come ask for my help if you need it!

items.zh: 绿色和紫色宝石代欧奇希斯

items.en: Greetings, $playername$. I assume you couldn't find much, but I was able to find that Kyurem has been seen near Lacunosa Town. We should check it out immediately, before it decides to attack. You go ahead, I'll warn the others.
items.zh: 你好，$playername$。我猜你找不到太多，但我发现酋雷姆在拉库诺萨镇附近出现过。我们应该在它决定攻击之前立即检查它。你先走吧，我会警告其他人的。
items.normEn: Greetings, $playername$. I assume you couldn't find much, but I was able to find that Kyurem has been seen near Lacunosa Town. We should check it out immediately, before it decides to attack. You go ahead, I'll warn the others.

items.en: Greetings, $playername$. May I help you with something? Oh, you're looking for things called Silvally Memories? Something like this one?
items.zh: 你好，$playername$。我可以帮你做点什么吗？哦，您正在寻找名为 Silvally Memories 的东西吗？像这样的东西吗？
items.normEn: Greetings, $playername$. May I help you with something? Oh, you're looking for things called Silvally Memories? Something like this one?

items.en: Greetings, may I ask who are you? Oh, you're a friend of the Old Man? That's great, and he sent you here to find me, I assume.
items.zh: 您好，请问您是谁？哦，你是老​​头子的朋友吗？太好了，我想他派你来这里找我。
items.normEn: Greetings, may I ask who are you? Oh, you're a friend of the Old Man? That's great, and he sent you here to find me, I assume.

items.en: Greetings. Captain Ilima here. In every locale where a captain holds his or her trials, you will encounter a particularly strong boss, known as a Totem Pokémon. To clear a Trial, all you have to do is defeat these Pokémon!
items.zh: 问候。伊利马队长在这里。在队长进行试炼的每个地点，你都会遇到一个特别强大的老板，被称为图腾神奇宝贝。要通过试炼，你所要做的就是击败这些神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: Greetings. Captain Ilima here. In every locale where a captain holds his or her trials, you will encounter a particularly strong boss, known as a Totem Pokémon. To clear a Trial, all you have to do is defeat these Pokémon!

items.en: Groudon and Kyogre, the two Pokémon wreaking havoc in Sootopolis City, are considered to be Super-Ancient Pokémon. But there aren't just two Super-Ancient Pokémon. Somewhere, there is a Super-Ancient Pokémon named Rayquaza. It's said that it was Rayquaza that becalmed the two combatants in the distant past.
items.zh: 固拉多和盖欧卡这两只在苏托波利斯市肆虐的神奇宝贝被认为是超古代神奇宝贝。但超古代神奇宝贝不只是两只。在某个地方，有一只名为烈空坐的超古代神奇宝贝。据说，在遥远的过去，正是烈空坐让这两位战斗者陷入了平静。
items.normEn: Groudon and Kyogre, the two Pokémon wreaking havoc in Sootopolis City, are considered to be Super-Ancient Pokémon. But there aren't just two Super-Ancient Pokémon. Somewhere, there is a Super-Ancient Pokémon named Rayquaza. It's said that it was Rayquaza that becalmed the two combatants in the distant past.

items.en: Groudon reverts to its Primal form when the sun is harsh, and Kyogre reverts to its Primal form in the rain.
items.zh: 当阳光强烈时，固拉多会恢复原始形态，而盖欧卡则会在雨中恢复原始形态。
items.normEn: Groudon reverts to its Primal form when the sun is harsh, and Kyogre reverts to its Primal form in the rain.

items.normEn: Growing these Berries will soften the ground around it, increasing the chances of replanting.

items.en: Guess ya got me. Hook, line and sinker!
items.zh: 我猜你明白我的意思了。钩子、线和坠子！
items.normEn: Guess ya got me. Hook, line and sinker!

items.normEn: Gyms and Dungeons in the Johto and Hoenn regions have been buffed
