items.en: H-h-how can this be?! How could this child... If you're looking for Cosmog, I suppose it might be downstairs.
items.zh: 呼、呼、怎么会这样？！这孩子怎么可能……如果你要找科斯莫格，我想它可能就在楼下。
items.normEn: H-h-how can this be?! How could this child... If you're looking for Cosmog, I suppose it might be downstairs.

items.en: Ha ha! You're too much for me! You're really something, aren't you?
items.zh: 哈哈！你对我来说太过分了！你真的很了不起，不是吗？
items.normEn: Ha ha! You're too much for me! You're really something, aren't you?

items.en: Ha! That was a truly intense fight!
items.zh: 哈!那真是一场激烈的战斗！
items.normEn: Ha! That was a truly intense fight!

items.en: Ha! That was a truly intense fight. You have won! As proof, here is the Earth Badge!
items.zh: 哈!那真是一场激烈的战斗。你赢了！作为证据，这是地球徽章！
items.normEn: Ha! That was a truly intense fight. You have won! As proof, here is the Earth Badge!

items.en: Ha! You've certainly grown, haven't you? And to think, not long ago you would've run and hid behind me the moment you got scared! Indeed, no matter how old I get, witnessing someone grow always brings joy to my heart. Urshifu! And you as well! Thank you both, from the bottom of my heart.
items.zh: 哈!你确实成长了，不是吗？想一想，不久前你一害怕就会跑到我身后躲起来！确实，无论我多大了，见证某人的成长总是让我心里感到高兴。乌什夫！还有你！谢谢你们两位，我从心底里感谢你们。
items.normEn: Ha! You've certainly grown, haven't you? And to think, not long ago you would've run and hid behind me the moment you got scared! Indeed, no matter how old I get, witnessing someone grow always brings joy to my heart. Urshifu! And you as well! Thank you both, from the bottom of my heart.

items.en: Hahaha, that was one of the best battles I've ever had.
items.zh: 哈哈哈，这是我经历过的最精彩的战斗之一。
items.normEn: Hahaha, that was one of the best battles I've ever had.

items.en: Hahahaha! Now our plan can really start! Prepare for trouble, and make it double, because you just built us a profit machine!
items.zh: 哈哈哈哈！现在我们的计划可以真正开始了！做好应对麻烦的准备，并使其加倍，因为您刚刚为我们打造了一台利润机器！
items.normEn: Hahahaha! Now our plan can really start! Prepare for trouble, and make it double, because you just built us a profit machine!

items.en: Halloween! event can now be activated with the Event Calendar
items.zh: 万圣节！现在可以使用事件日历激活事件
items.normEn: Halloween! event can now be activated with the Event Calendar

items.en: Halve xp needed to upgrade Oak items
items.zh: 升级橡树物品所需的经验值减半
items.normEn: Halve xp needed to upgrade Oak items

items.en: Hang on--you really caught up to all three of them dodgy birds? Multiple times each? That's pretty impressive!
items.zh: 等等——你真的追上了这三只狡猾的鸟吗？每次都多次？这真是令人印象深刻！
items.normEn: Hang on--you really caught up to all three of them dodgy birds? Multiple times each? That's pretty impressive!

items.en: Hang on-I recognize you! You're that kid who was able to beat my dad earlier, right? That's impressive, he's no pushover!
items.zh: 等一下——我认出你了！你就是刚才那个能打败我爸爸的孩子吧？真是令人印象深刻，他不是一个容易被欺负的人！
items.normEn: Hang on-I recognize you! You're that kid who was able to beat my dad earlier, right? That's impressive, he's no pushover!

items.en: Hang on, did you guys see something? Oh, over there, it's Celebi! It must have come now things are peaceful here. It looks like it wants to play!
items.zh: 等等，你们看到了什么吗？哦，那边，是雪拉比！现在这里一切都平静了，它一定已经到来了。看起来很想玩啊！
items.normEn: Hang on, did you guys see something? Oh, over there, it's Celebi! It must have come now things are peaceful here. It looks like it wants to play!

items.en: Hang on, this island is strictly off limits! Pinkan is a protected Pokémon reserve. How did you get here?
items.zh: 等等，这个岛是严格禁止进入的！ Pinkan 是一个受保护的神奇宝贝保护区。你是怎么到这里来的？
items.normEn: Hang on, this island is strictly off limits! Pinkan is a protected Pokémon reserve. How did you get here?

items.en: Hang on, this looks a lot like when uncle Rose started the Darkest Day! You were the one who stopped that whole thing, right? You should probably get going!
items.zh: 等一下，这看起来很像罗斯叔叔开始《至暗之日》时的情况！是你阻止了整件事，对吧？你也许应该出发了！
items.normEn: Hang on, this looks a lot like when uncle Rose started the Darkest Day! You were the one who stopped that whole thing, right? You should probably get going!

items.en: Happy to work for you! Let me know when you're hiring again!
items.zh: 很高兴为您工作！当你再次招聘时请告诉我！
items.normEn: Happy to work for you! Let me know when you're hiring again!

items.en: Hapu has permitted you to visit sacred ground. Find the other flute by clearing Exeggutor Island Hill.
items.zh: 哈普允许你参观圣地。通过清理椰蛋岛山找到另一支笛子。
items.normEn: Hapu has permitted you to visit sacred ground. Find the other flute by clearing Exeggutor Island Hill.

items.en: Harness the power of the Millennium Comet and make a wish!
items.zh: 利用千年彗星的力量许愿吧！
items.normEn: Harness the power of the Millennium Comet and make a wish!

items.en: Harvest rates for berries with a 0.5 harvest rate
items.zh: 收获率 0.5 的浆果的收获率
items.normEn: Harvest rates for berries with a 0.5 harvest rate

items.en: Has a chance to duplicate a collected treasure. Keeps attempting to duplicate until it fails a chance
items.zh: 有机会复制已收集的宝藏。不断尝试复制，直到失败为止
items.normEn: Has a chance to duplicate a collected treasure. Keeps attempting to duplicate until it fails a chance

items.en: Hatched display value not updating in hatchery
items.zh: 孵化场中的孵化显示值未更新
items.normEn: Hatched display value not updating in hatchery

items.en: Hatchery and Protein list not sorting
items.zh: 孵化场和蛋白质列表未排序
items.normEn: Hatchery and Protein list not sorting

items.en: Hatchery and Protein list now sort independently of Party
items.zh: 孵化场和蛋白质列表现在独立于派对进行排序
items.normEn: Hatchery and Protein list now sort independently of Party

items.en: Hatchery eggs will display in a row of 4 when module is in the middle columnn
items.zh: 当模块位于中间栏时，孵化场鸡蛋将显示为 4 行
items.normEn: Hatchery eggs will display in a row of 4 when module is in the middle columnn

items.en: Hatchery filters are now saved upon reload
items.zh: 孵化场过滤器现在在重新加载时保存
items.normEn: Hatchery filters are now saved upon reload

items.en: Hatchery Helpers will help out by automatically breeding your Pokémon for you.
items.zh: 孵化场助手将通过自动为您培育您的神奇宝贝来提供帮助。
items.normEn: Hatchery Helpers will help out by automatically breeding your Pokémon for you.

items.en: Hatchery queue not filling empty slots occasionally
items.zh: 孵化场队列偶尔无法填满空位
items.normEn: Hatchery queue not filling empty slots occasionally

items.en: Hatchery search no longer uses Regex by default
items.zh: 默认情况下，孵化场搜索不再使用正则表达式
items.normEn: Hatchery search no longer uses Regex by default

items.en: Hatchery should no longer cause lag when hatching
items.zh: 孵化场在孵化时不应再造成滞后
items.normEn: Hatchery should no longer cause lag when hatching

items.en: Hatchery steps given from Unvoa dungeons
items.zh: Unvoa 地牢给出的孵化场步骤
items.normEn: Hatchery steps given from Unvoa dungeons

items.en: Hatchery, battle, and clicking performance optimizations
items.zh: 孵化场、战斗和点击性能优化
items.normEn: Hatchery, battle, and clicking performance optimizations

items.en: Hatching a Pokémon you've already caught will give it a small attack boost.
items.zh: 孵化你已经捕获的神奇宝贝会使其攻击力小幅提升。
items.normEn: Hatching a Pokémon you've already caught will give it a small attack boost.

items.en: Hatching a shiny Pokémon now awards 5x the normal attack gained
items.zh: 孵化闪亮的神奇宝贝现在奖励普通攻击力的 5 倍
items.normEn: Hatching a shiny Pokémon now awards 5x the normal attack gained

items.en: Hatching a shiny Pokémon will grant it 5 times the usual attack gain. Note that this bonus does not apply to every hatch of existing shiny pokemon. In other words, if you breed a shiny Pokémon, it will only receive the bonus if it hatches shiny again.
items.zh: 孵化闪亮的神奇宝贝将使其攻击增益达到平时的 5 倍。请注意，此奖励并不适用于现有闪亮神奇宝贝的每次孵化。换句话说，如果你培育了一只闪亮的神奇宝贝，它只有在再次孵化出闪亮的时候才会获得奖励。
items.normEn: Hatching a shiny Pokémon will grant it 5 times the usual attack gain. Note that this bonus does not apply to every hatch of existing shiny pokemon. In other words, if you breed a shiny Pokémon, it will only receive the bonus if it hatches shiny again.

items.zh: 孵化新神奇宝贝会导致错误
已解锁 ${...} 种不同的浆果类型。

items.en: Have ${...} or more Special Events active simultaneously.
items.zh: 同时进行 ${...} 或更多特别活动。
items.normEn: Have ${...} or more Special Events active simultaneously.

items.zh: 拥有 10 只对 Pokérus 具有抵抗力的神奇宝贝。
拥有 250 只对 Pokérus 具有抵抗力的神奇宝贝。
拥有 50 只对 Pokérus 具有抵抗力的神奇宝贝。
拥有 500 只对 Pokérus 具有抵抗力的神奇宝贝。
同时开展 9 个特别活动。

items.en: Have a total of 100 Light Balls.
items.normEn: Have a total of 100 Light Balls.

items.en: Have all 6 Flutes active for 60 minutes.
items.zh: 让所有 6 个长笛都处于活动状态 60 分钟。
items.normEn: Have all 6 Flutes active for 60 minutes.

items.en: Have all Battle Café flavors resistant to Pokérus.
items.zh: 让所有 Battle Café 口味都能抵抗 Pokérus。
items.normEn: Have all Battle Café flavors resistant to Pokérus.

items.en: Have all Flutes active for a total of ${...} minutes.
items.zh: 让所有长笛都处于活动状态，总计 ${...} 分钟。
items.normEn: Have all Flutes active for a total of ${...} minutes.

items.en: Have all movable UI modules in one column.
items.zh: 将所有可移动 UI 模块放在一列中。
items.normEn: Have all movable UI modules in one column.

items.en: Have at least 20 Pokéball Filters at one time.
items.zh: 一次至少拥有 20 个精灵球过滤器。
items.normEn: Have at least 20 Pokéball Filters at one time.

items.en: Have at least x${...} Pokéball Filters.
items.zh: 至少拥有 x${...} 个精灵球过滤器。
items.normEn: Have at least x${...} Pokéball Filters.

items.en: Have I a seen a Silvally Memory? Yes, I have. If you want it, I could sell it to you. The price is 125 million Dungeon Tokens. I'll be here for a long time, so you can get the Dungeon Tokens and come back later if you need to.
items.zh: 我见过《席尔瓦利的记忆》吗？是的，我有。如果你想要的话我可以卖给你。价格为1.25亿地下城代币。我会在这里呆很长一段时间，所以你可以拿到地下城令牌，如果需要的话稍后再回来。
items.normEn: Have I a seen a Silvally Memory? Yes, I have. If you want it, I could sell it to you. The price is 125 million Dungeon Tokens. I'll be here for a long time, so you can get the Dungeon Tokens and come back later if you need to.

items.en: Have I got a deal just for you!
items.zh: 我有专门为你做的交易吗？
items.normEn: Have I got a deal just for you!

items.en: Have Phanpy newly hatched and at level below 21, or 51 if you cleared the Team Rocket's Hideout 250 times or more.
items.zh: 拥有新孵化的 Phanpy，且等级低于 21，如果您清除了火箭队藏身处 250 次或以上，则等级低于 51。
items.normEn: Have Phanpy newly hatched and at level below 21, or 51 if you cleared the Team Rocket's Hideout 250 times or more.

items.en: Have the game open for an entire year.
items.normEn: Have the game open for an entire year.

items.en: Have you gotten even stronger than you were in Lacunosa Town? How, in such a brief amount of time...
items.zh: 你变得比在拉库诺萨镇时更强大了吗？怎么在这么短的时间内……
items.normEn: Have you gotten even stronger than you were in Lacunosa Town? How, in such a brief amount of time...

items.en: Have you seen the Pinkan Berries? That is what makes all the Pokémon on this island turn pink.
items.zh: 你见过 Pinkan 浆果吗？这就是岛上所有神奇宝贝都变成粉红色的原因。
items.normEn: Have you seen the Pinkan Berries? That is what makes all the Pokémon on this island turn pink.

items.en: Have you seen this crazy broadcast on TV?
items.zh: 你在电视上看过这样疯狂的转播吗？
items.normEn: Have you seen this crazy broadcast on TV?

items.en: Have you seen this? It's horrific. Absolutely despicable.
items.zh: 你见过这个吗？太可怕了。绝对是卑鄙的。
items.normEn: Have you seen this? It's horrific. Absolutely despicable.

items.en: Have you spotted a blue bird walking around with an Arrokuda in its throat? It’s quite a daft Pokémon, but it sure is hungry! I guess if it trains near water it tries to swallow Arrokudas, but they always get stuck in its throat.
items.zh: 你有没有发现一只蓝鸟喉咙里叼着阿罗库达走来走去？这是一只相当愚蠢的神奇宝贝，但它确实很饿！我猜想，如果它在水附近训练，它会试图吞下阿罗库达，但它们总是卡在它的喉咙里。
items.normEn: Have you spotted a blue bird walking around with an Arrokuda in its throat? It’s quite a daft Pokémon, but it sure is hungry! I guess if it trains near water it tries to swallow Arrokudas, but they always get stuck in its throat.

items.en: Having lost, I have no right to say anything… Go face your next challenge!
items.zh: 输了，我已经没有权利说什么了……去迎接下一个挑战吧！
items.normEn: Having lost, I have no right to say anything… Go face your next challenge!

items.en: He is a sore loser, poor boy. But he always comes back next day!
items.zh: 他是一个痛苦的失败者，可怜的孩子。但他总是第二天就回来！
items.normEn: He is a sore loser, poor boy. But he always comes back next day!

items.en: He is trying to sell overpriced Magikarps to clueless children.
items.zh: 他正试图将高价的鲤鱼卖给无知的孩子们。
items.normEn: He is trying to sell overpriced Magikarps to clueless children.

items.en: He wants you to know that he will have an additional eight slots ready by the time you reach Sinnoh.
items.zh: 他想让你知道，当你到达神奥时，他会准备好额外的八个位置。
items.normEn: He wants you to know that he will have an additional eight slots ready by the time you reach Sinnoh.

items.en: He was such a weirdo. He kept telling her how everything should be beautiful forever and how he would end the world in an instant so that beauty never fades.
items.zh: 他真是个怪人。他不断地告诉她，一切应该永远美丽，他将如何在一瞬间结束世界，让美丽永不褪色。
items.normEn: He was such a weirdo. He kept telling her how everything should be beautiful forever and how he would end the world in an instant so that beauty never fades.

items.en: He's usually out to sea, but you can find him in Sea Mauville if the weather is too stormy to sail.
items.zh: 他通常出海，但如果天气太大而无法航行，您可以在 Sea Mauville 找到他。
items.normEn: He's usually out to sea, but you can find him in Sea Mauville if the weather is too stormy to sail.

items.en: Heh, yeah, maybe you did get a bit tougher since last time.
items.zh: 呵呵，是啊，也许自上次以来你确实变得更强硬了一些。
items.normEn: Heh, yeah, maybe you did get a bit tougher since last time.

items.en: Heh. Let us have an elegant battle worthy of being called a finale. Prepare to sink into despair...and into the weird battlefield beneath your feet!
items.zh: 呵呵。让我们来一场堪称大结局的优雅之战吧。准备好陷入绝望……并进入脚下的诡异战场吧！
items.normEn: Heh. Let us have an elegant battle worthy of being called a finale. Prepare to sink into despair...and into the weird battlefield beneath your feet!

items.en: Heh... You got me good, kid. Hope I don't get in trouble with the girl for this. You should go tell that young filly Mina that you're done with what she asked you to do.
items.zh: 呵呵...你对我很好，孩子。希望我不会因此而给那个女孩带来麻烦。你应该去告诉那匹年轻的母马米娜，你已经完成了她要求你做的事情。
items.normEn: Heh... You got me good, kid. Hope I don't get in trouble with the girl for this. You should go tell that young filly Mina that you're done with what she asked you to do.

items.en: Heh... You know, this experience really brought it home for me again that there is still so much about this world that I do not know. Thank you, $playername$ for all your help.
items.zh: 呵呵……你知道吗，这次经历真是让我再次体会到，这个世界还有那么多我不知道的事情。谢谢你，$playername$ 的所有帮助。
items.normEn: Heh... You know, this experience really brought it home for me again that there is still so much about this world that I do not know. Thank you, $playername$ for all your help.

items.en: Held Item menu searching and display improvements
items.zh: 持有物品菜单搜索和显示改进
items.normEn: Held Item menu searching and display improvements

items.en:
Held items are one time use only.
Removed items will be lost.
Are you sure you want to remove it?
items.zh: 持有的物品只能使用一次。移除的物品将会丢失。您确定要删除它吗？
items.normEn: Held items are one time use only. Removed items will be lost. Are you sure you want to remove it?

items.zh: 持有物品隐藏持有宠物小精灵
持有项目隐藏持有此项目

items.en: Helix fossil now displays correctly when mining in the Underground
items.zh: 在地下采矿时，螺旋化石现在可以正确显示
items.normEn: Helix fossil now displays correctly when mining in the Underground

items.en: Hello $playername$! Do you remember the Pokémon Lysandre mentioned in that café? Kalos's Legendary Pokémon are called... Xerneas and Yveltal!
items.zh: 你好$playername$！你还记得那家咖啡馆里提到的神奇宝贝莱桑德尔吗？卡洛斯的传奇神奇宝贝叫做……哲尔尼亚斯和伊维尔塔尔！
items.normEn: Hello $playername$! Do you remember the Pokémon Lysandre mentioned in that café? Kalos's Legendary Pokémon are called... Xerneas and Yveltal!

items.en: Hello again, $playername$! I see you're interested in these murals as well? They seem to be about Groudon and Kyogre.
items.zh: 再次你好，$playername$！我看你也对这些壁画感兴趣？它们似乎是关于固拉多和盖欧卡的。
items.normEn: Hello again, $playername$! I see you're interested in these murals as well? They seem to be about Groudon and Kyogre.

items.en: Hello again, $playername$! It's been a while since you last visited!
items.zh: 再次你好，$playername$！距离您上次访问已经有一段时间了！
items.normEn: Hello again, $playername$! It's been a while since you last visited!

items.en: Hello again, $playername$. I can see by the look on your face that this is not just a social call.
items.zh: 再次问好，$playername$。从你脸上的表情我可以看出这不仅仅是一次社交电话。
items.normEn: Hello again, $playername$. I can see by the look on your face that this is not just a social call.

items.en: Hello again, I see you are treating Eevee very well.
items.zh: 你好，我看到你对伊布很好。
items.normEn: Hello again, I see you are treating Eevee very well.

items.en: Hello again! I see you too found a way around the giant cliff.
items.zh: 又好！我看到你也找到了绕过巨大悬崖的方法。
items.normEn: Hello again! I see you too found a way around the giant cliff.

items.en: Hello again! I see you too found your way to these ancient ruins!
items.zh: 又好！我看到你也找到了通往这些古代遗迹的路！
items.normEn: Hello again! I see you too found your way to these ancient ruins!

items.en: Hello kiddo. You must be $playername$, nice to meet you.
items.zh: 你好孩子。您一定是$playername$，很高兴认识您。
items.normEn: Hello kiddo. You must be $playername$, nice to meet you.

items.en: Hello stranger. I'm afraid the Game Corner is currently closed.
items.zh: 你好陌生人。恐怕游戏角目前已关闭。
items.normEn: Hello stranger. I'm afraid the Game Corner is currently closed.

items.en: Hello there champ! Fancy seeing you here.
items.zh: 你好，冠军！很高兴在这里见到你。
items.normEn: Hello there champ! Fancy seeing you here.

items.en: Hello there, $playername$! Have you perchance caught sight of my advertisement? I'm on the lookout for a formidable opponent to assist me in honing my Pokémon's skills. And let me assure you, the rewards are quite substantial! Should you best me in battle, you shall be granted a most wondrous prize: a Silvally Memory that I found inside the Hokulani Observatory.
items.zh: 你好，$playername$！您可能看到我的广告了吗？我正在寻找一个强大的对手来帮助我磨练我的神奇宝贝的技能。我向你保证，奖励是相当丰厚的！如果你在战斗中击败了我，你将获得最奇妙的奖品：我在霍库拉尼天文台内发现的希尔瓦利记忆。
items.normEn: Hello there, $playername$! Have you perchance caught sight of my advertisement? I'm on the lookout for a formidable opponent to assist me in honing my Pokémon's skills. And let me assure you, the rewards are quite substantial! Should you best me in battle, you shall be granted a most wondrous prize: a Silvally Memory that I found inside the Hokulani Observatory.

items.en: Hello there, $playername$! Today is a beautiful day for a walk. I found this disk while walking around. I'm not so sure what it is, but it's an interesting find. What brings you here? Oh, you're here looking for this disk. Well, I can give it to you if you beat me in battle! What do you say? Fantastic!
items.zh: 你好，$playername$！今天是散步的好日子。我在四处走动时发现了这张磁盘。我不太确定它是什么，但这是一个有趣的发现。是什么风把你吹到这里来的？哦，你正在这里寻找这张磁盘。好吧，如果你在战斗中击败我，我可以给你！你怎么说？极好的！
items.normEn: Hello there, $playername$! Today is a beautiful day for a walk. I found this disk while walking around. I'm not so sure what it is, but it's an interesting find. What brings you here? Oh, you're here looking for this disk. Well, I can give it to you if you beat me in battle! What do you say? Fantastic!

items.en: Hello there, Leon! Just letting you know...
items.zh: 你好，莱昂！只是让你知道...
items.normEn: Hello there, Leon! Just letting you know...

items.en: Hello there. There's a wonderful breeze blowing out here today. The glistening Flyinium Z... It's yours now. Use it well.
items.zh: 你好呀。今天这里吹着阵阵微风。闪闪发光的 Flyinium Z...现在是你的了。好好利用它。
items.normEn: Hello there. There's a wonderful breeze blowing out here today. The glistening Flyinium Z... It's yours now. Use it well.

items.en: Hello young one, have you come here to learn of Sinnoh’s mysteries?
items.zh: 小朋友你好，你来这里是为了了解神奥的奥秘吗？
items.normEn: Hello young one, have you come here to learn of Sinnoh’s mysteries?

items.en: Hello, $playername$! It's good to see you again, but I have some dire news.
items.zh: 你好，$playername$！很高兴再次见到你，但我有一些可怕的消息。
items.normEn: Hello, $playername$! It's good to see you again, but I have some dire news.

items.en: Hello, $playername$! My name is Baraz, and my people have a complicated history with Hoopa.
items.zh: 你好，$playername$！我叫巴拉兹，我的人民与胡帕有着复杂的历史。
items.normEn: Hello, $playername$! My name is Baraz, and my people have a complicated history with Hoopa.

items.en: Hello, $playername$. Are you done with your battle against Hau on Route 3? We should all head back to Iki Town, now.
items.zh: 你好，$playername$。你在 3 号公路上与 Hau 的战斗结束了吗？我们现在该回壹岐镇了。
items.normEn: Hello, $playername$. Are you done with your battle against Hau on Route 3? We should all head back to Iki Town, now.

items.en: Hello, $playername$. Here to do my trial again? Oh, I see you're looking for Silvally Memories. Well, I have just the right thing for you. Here, take it.
items.zh: 你好，$playername$。来这里再试一次吗？哦，我知道你正在寻找《西尔瓦利的回忆》。好吧，我有适合你的东西。在这里，拿走吧。
items.normEn: Hello, $playername$. Here to do my trial again? Oh, I see you're looking for Silvally Memories. Well, I have just the right thing for you. Here, take it.

items.en: Hello, there! Welcome to the world of Pokémon!
items.zh: 你好呀！欢迎来到神奇宝贝的世界！
items.normEn: Hello, there! Welcome to the world of Pokémon!

items.en: Hello, who are you, may I ask? You say you were sent here by Cobalion to reunite the Swords of Justice? I'm sorry dear, you'll have to create a much more believable lie to deceive me. I'm not so easily fooled.
items.zh: 你好，请问你是谁？你说你是Cobalion派来这里重聚正义之剑的？对不起，亲爱的，你必须编造一个更可信的谎言来欺骗我。我没那么容易被骗。
items.normEn: Hello, who are you, may I ask? You say you were sent here by Cobalion to reunite the Swords of Justice? I'm sorry dear, you'll have to create a much more believable lie to deceive me. I'm not so easily fooled.

items.en: Hello! Would you like a seat indoors or on the patio? We have a lovely view of the museum, it used to double as a Gym you know! Business may have slowed down since the new Normal Gym moved to Aspertia, but our ex-Gym Leader Lenora is still at it with her husband restoring fossils!
items.zh: 你好！您想要室内座位还是露台座位？我们可以看到博物馆的美丽景色，它曾经兼作健身房，你知道的！自从新的普通道馆搬到阿斯佩蒂亚以来，生意可能已经放缓，但我们的前道馆馆长莱诺拉仍然和她的丈夫一起修复化石！
items.normEn: Hello! Would you like a seat indoors or on the patio? We have a lovely view of the museum, it used to double as a Gym you know! Business may have slowed down since the new Normal Gym moved to Aspertia, but our ex-Gym Leader Lenora is still at it with her husband restoring fossils!

items.en: Hello? Is that you, $playername$? It's me. Steven. Have you been doing well?
items.zh: 你好？是你吗，$playername$？这就是我。史蒂文.你过得好吗？
items.normEn: Hello? Is that you, $playername$? It's me. Steven. Have you been doing well?

items.en: Hello. You want to know what I'm doing in this pointless dead end cave?
items.zh: 你好。你想知道我在这个毫无意义的死胡同山洞里做什么吗？
items.normEn: Hello. You want to know what I'm doing in this pointless dead end cave?

items.en: Hello... Isn't the spring weather so relaxing? I adore how lovely the blooming flowers look during this time of year...
items.zh: 哈喽……春天的天气是不是很轻松呢？我很喜欢每年这个时候盛开的花朵看起来多么可爱......
items.normEn: Hello... Isn't the spring weather so relaxing? I adore how lovely the blooming flowers look during this time of year...

items.en: Help Arven search for the Herba Mystica.
items.zh: 帮助阿尔文寻找神秘草。
items.normEn: Help Arven search for the Herba Mystica.

items.en: Help Butler's wish come true, responsibly.
items.zh: 负责任地帮助巴特勒实现愿望。
items.normEn: Help Butler's wish come true, responsibly.

items.zh: 帮助卡西奥佩娅解散星际队。

items.en: Help Dr. Splash unlock the full potential of your Magikarp.
items.zh: 帮助 Splash 博士释放您的鲤鱼王的全部潜力。
items.normEn: Help Dr. Splash unlock the full potential of your Magikarp.

items.en: Help Gladion restore his Silvally's memories.
items.zh: 帮助格拉迪奥恢复他的席尔瓦利的记忆。
items.normEn: Help Gladion restore his Silvally's memories.

items.en: Help Koraidon and Miraidon find their homes in the mysterious Area Zero.
items.zh: 帮助 Koraidon 和 Miraidon 在神秘的零区找到他们的家。
items.normEn: Help Koraidon and Miraidon find their homes in the mysterious Area Zero.

items.en: Help Lillie and Nebby on Akala Island and meet some friendly faces.
items.zh: 帮助阿卡拉岛上的莉莉和内比并结识一些友好的面孔。
items.normEn: Help Lillie and Nebby on Akala Island and meet some friendly faces.

items.en: Help Lillie get through to her mother! Defeat Lusamine at the Altar of the Sunne and Moone.
items.zh: 帮助莉莉与她的母亲取得联系！在苏尼和穆恩祭坛击败卢莎米奈。
items.normEn: Help Lillie get through to her mother! Defeat Lusamine at the Altar of the Sunne and Moone.

items.en: Help Lorelei with Team Rocket Grunts by clearing Icefall Cave on Four Island.
items.zh: 帮助罗蕾莱和火箭队士兵清理四岛的冰瀑布洞。
items.normEn: Help Lorelei with Team Rocket Grunts by clearing Icefall Cave on Four Island.

items.en: Help make Pokeclicker even better! Contribute to the project by sharing your ideas on our Github:
items.zh: 帮助 Pokeclicker 变得更好！通过在我们的 Github 上分享您的想法来为该项目做出贡献：
items.normEn: Help make Pokeclicker even better! Contribute to the project by sharing your ideas on our Github:

items.en: Help Team Rocket build a theme park on Pinkan Island?
items.zh: 帮助火箭队在平坎岛建造主题公园？
items.normEn: Help Team Rocket build a theme park on Pinkan Island?

items.en: Help Team Rocket recruit some Pinkan Pokémon
items.zh: 帮助火箭队招募一些 Pinkan 神奇宝贝
items.normEn: Help Team Rocket recruit some Pinkan Pokémon

items.en: Help the ancient king of Galar, Calyrex, return to its former glory.
items.zh: 帮助古老的加勒尔国王卡里克斯恢复昔日的辉煌。
items.normEn: Help the ancient king of Galar, Calyrex, return to its former glory.

items.en: Help Zero find an entrance to the Distortion World.
items.zh: 帮助零找到扭曲世界的入口。
items.normEn: Help Zero find an entrance to the Distortion World.

items.en: Helps attract rarer species. Gooed Pokémon are more likely to be caught.
items.zh: 有助于吸引稀有物种。被粘住的神奇宝贝更有可能被抓住。
items.normEn: Helps attract rarer species. Gooed Pokémon are more likely to be caught.

items.en: Her company, when I have the pleasure, is of great help, she ferries me hither and yon across Hisui. But I'll leave her in your care for now, I suppose.
items.zh: 当我有幸的时候，她的陪伴给了我很大的帮助，她载着我穿越翡翠城。但我想我现在会把她交给你照顾。
items.normEn: Her company, when I have the pleasure, is of great help, she ferries me hither and yon across Hisui. But I'll leave her in your care for now, I suppose.

items.en: Here are the descriptions of them. You should look for:
items.zh: 以下是它们的描述。您应该寻找：
items.normEn: Here are the descriptions of them. You should look for:

items.en: Here we don't have gyms. We have the Island Challenge. On each of our four islands you will complete one or more trials.
items.zh: 我们这里没有健身房。我们有岛屿挑战赛。在我们的四个岛屿中的每一个上，您都将完成一项或多项试验。
items.normEn: Here we don't have gyms. We have the Island Challenge. On each of our four islands you will complete one or more trials.

items.en: Here you will be battling through many stages to earn Battle Points.
items.zh: 在这里，您将通过许多阶段的战斗来赚取战斗积分。
items.normEn: Here you will be battling through many stages to earn Battle Points.

items.en: Here, let me show you how it works.
items.zh: 在这里，让我向您展示它是如何工作的。
items.normEn: Here, let me show you how it works.

items.en: Here, take my ferry pass. It will let you get to all of the Sevii Islands. Please, I can't do it without your help.
items.zh: 在这里，拿走我的渡轮通行证。它将让您到达所有塞维群岛。拜托，没有你的帮助我做不到。
items.normEn: Here, take my ferry pass. It will let you get to all of the Sevii Islands. Please, I can't do it without your help.

items.en: Here, take this space suit! I put it together from parts I... Er... Borrowed from the Aqua and Magma Hideouts. It should keep you safe while you accompany Mega Rayquaza into space.
items.zh: 来，穿上这件太空服！我把它从我……呃……从阿夸和岩浆藏身处借来的部分拼凑起来。当你陪伴 Mega Rayquaza 进入太空时，它应该能保证你的安全。
items.normEn: Here, take this space suit! I put it together from parts I... Er... Borrowed from the Aqua and Magma Hideouts. It should keep you safe while you accompany Mega Rayquaza into space.

items.en: Here, this is the Rising Badge... Hurry up! Take it!
items.zh: 这儿，这是崛起徽章……快点！拿走吧！
items.normEn: Here, this is the Rising Badge... Hurry up! Take it!

items.en: Here, you can have MINDY'S-GIFT for all I care! I pity whoever decides to trade with her in the future.
items.zh: 在这里，您可以得到我关心的明迪礼物！我很遗憾将来谁决定与她进行交易。
items.normEn: Here, you can have MINDY'S-GIFT for all I care! I pity whoever decides to trade with her in the future.

items.en: Here. Take this Master Ball with you. I'm counting on you to help Lillie. This is the least I can do.
items.zh: 这里。随身携带这个大师球。我指望你能帮助莉莉。这是我至少能做的。
items.normEn: Here. Take this Master Ball with you. I'm counting on you to help Lillie. This is the least I can do.

items.en: Hey $playername$! I found a button! I'm gonna press it!
items.zh: 嘿$playername$！我发现了一个按钮！我要按一下！
items.normEn: Hey $playername$! I found a button! I'm gonna press it!

items.en: Hey did you know about the Millennium Comet? We can see it in the sky right now, and it only comes around once every thousand years!
items.zh: 嘿，你知道千年彗星吗？我们现在就可以在天空中看到它，而且它每千年才出现一次！
items.normEn: Hey did you know about the Millennium Comet? We can see it in the sky right now, and it only comes around once every thousand years!

items.en: Hey kid, you look new! Let me offer some advice: Battle Items like X Attack can be acquired along Routes, inside Dungeons and in Shops!
items.zh: 嘿孩子，你看起来很新！让我提供一些建议：像 X Attack 这样的战斗物品可以沿着路线、地下城和商店获得！
items.normEn: Hey kid, you look new! Let me offer some advice: Battle Items like X Attack can be acquired along Routes, inside Dungeons and in Shops!

items.en: Hey newcomer! I see you are the Hoenn Champion. You must be an amazing Trainer!
items.zh: 嘿新人！我看你是丰缘冠军。你一定是一位了不起的教练！
items.normEn: Hey newcomer! I see you are the Hoenn Champion. You must be an amazing Trainer!

items.en: Hey there, $playername$! Have you checked out the trail behind the Thrifty Megamart lately? It's been pretty wild! I ventured there the other day and stumbled upon a Mimikyu holding a Silvally Memory. It was quite a challenge to retrieve it, but I managed to befriend it and recover the disk eventually. I love the thrill of exploring new places and discovering new stuff, don't you?
items.zh: 嘿，$playername$！您最近查看过 Thrifty Megamart 后面的踪迹吗？这真是太疯狂了！前几天我冒险去那里，偶然发现了一个拿着希尔瓦利记忆的密拟丘。检索它是一个相当大的挑战，但我设法与它成为朋友并最终恢复了磁盘。我喜欢探索新地方和发现新事物的快感，你不是吗？
items.normEn: Hey there, $playername$! Have you checked out the trail behind the Thrifty Megamart lately? It's been pretty wild! I ventured there the other day and stumbled upon a Mimikyu holding a Silvally Memory. It was quite a challenge to retrieve it, but I managed to befriend it and recover the disk eventually. I love the thrill of exploring new places and discovering new stuff, don't you?

items.en: Hey there, $playername$! I gotta say, you've done something truly incredible. You've brought back every single one of Silvally's lost memories. I expected nothing less from the Champion. I can't even imagine how long all that must have taken you. Silvally's back to normal and I can't thank you enough.
items.zh: 嘿，$playername$！我得说，你做了一件真正令人难以置信的事情。你已经找回了西尔瓦利丢失的所有记忆。我对冠军的期望丝毫不减。我什至无法想象这一切花了你多长时间。西尔瓦利已经恢复正常了，我对你感激不尽。
items.normEn: Hey there, $playername$! I gotta say, you've done something truly incredible. You've brought back every single one of Silvally's lost memories. I expected nothing less from the Champion. I can't even imagine how long all that must have taken you. Silvally's back to normal and I can't thank you enough.

items.en: Hey there! I'm one of Professor Sycamore's assistants. If you've made it to Kalos, you probably have a pretty impressive Pokédex by now, right?
items.zh: 嘿！我是 Sycamore 教授的助手之一。如果你已经到达卡洛斯，你现在可能已经拥有了令人印象深刻的图鉴，对吧？
items.normEn: Hey there! I'm one of Professor Sycamore's assistants. If you've made it to Kalos, you probably have a pretty impressive Pokédex by now, right?

items.en: Hey there! Welcome back! Looks like you nailed the trial! Congrats on finding the Max Mushrooms! Trial number two was no problem for you!
items.zh: 嘿！欢迎回来！看起来你已经完成了审判！恭喜您找到最大蘑菇！第二次试验对你来说没问题！
items.normEn: Hey there! Welcome back! Looks like you nailed the trial! Congrats on finding the Max Mushrooms! Trial number two was no problem for you!

items.en: Hey there! You're a fresh face 'round these parts, aren'tcha!
items.zh: 嘿！你在这些地方是一张新面孔，不是吗！
items.normEn: Hey there! You're a fresh face 'round these parts, aren'tcha!

items.en: Hey trainer, look at these footprints! Huh, I’ve never seen footprints like these before… They look like they came from two different Pokémon, and I saw two blurs, one red and one blue, quickly fly away just as I exited the Pokémon Center.
items.zh: 嘿教练，看看这些脚印！呃，我从来没有见过这样的脚印……它们看起来像是来自两只不同的神奇宝贝，我刚走出神奇宝贝中心，就看到一红一蓝的两道模糊的东西飞快地飞走了。
items.normEn: Hey trainer, look at these footprints! Huh, I’ve never seen footprints like these before… They look like they came from two different Pokémon, and I saw two blurs, one red and one blue, quickly fly away just as I exited the Pokémon Center.

items.en: Hey uh.... twerp. Would you happen to have any Dungeon Tokens? We've, uh, run out.
items.zh: 嘿呃....笨蛋。你碰巧有地下城令牌吗？我们已经，呃，用完了。
items.normEn: Hey uh.... twerp. Would you happen to have any Dungeon Tokens? We've, uh, run out.

items.en: Hey, $playername$! According to Prof. Rowan's research, 90% of all Pokémon are somehow tied to evolution! Yup, you can also see a Pokémon's evolution line in your Pokédex.
items.zh: 嘿，$playername$！根据罗文教授的研究，90% 的神奇宝贝都与进化有关！是的，您还可以在图鉴中看到神奇宝贝的进化线。
items.normEn: Hey, $playername$! According to Prof. Rowan's research, 90% of all Pokémon are somehow tied to evolution! Yup, you can also see a Pokémon's evolution line in your Pokédex.

items.en: Hey, $playername$! How are you doing? I've been doing great, except that my equipment is getting old and rusted. I would like to buy some more, but I don't have enough money to buy any right now.
items.zh: 嘿，$playername$！你好吗？我一直做得很好，只是我的设备越来越旧、生锈了。我想再买一些，但我现在没有足够的钱去买。
items.normEn: Hey, $playername$! How are you doing? I've been doing great, except that my equipment is getting old and rusted. I would like to buy some more, but I don't have enough money to buy any right now.

items.en: Hey, $playername$. How's it going? Looking for a rematch, or did you come here explore the Poni Island secrets? Oh, I see. You're looking for a Silvally Memory. I found a memory in the ground here, so I took it and studied it a bit. All I could find out is that it was from some Silvally. I also found another memory while helping Mina out with her trial. I gave it to her, but I'm not sure if she found out how it works.
items.zh: 嘿，$playername$。怎么样了？想要重赛，还是来这里探索波尼岛的秘密？我懂了。您正在寻找西尔瓦利记忆。我在这里的地下发现了一段记忆，所以我把它拿过来研究了一下。我所能找到的只是那是来自某个席尔瓦利的人。在帮助米娜完成审判的过程中，我还发现了另一段记忆。我把它给了她，但我不确定她是否知道它是如何工作的。
items.normEn: Hey, $playername$. How's it going? Looking for a rematch, or did you come here explore the Poni Island secrets? Oh, I see. You're looking for a Silvally Memory. I found a memory in the ground here, so I took it and studied it a bit. All I could find out is that it was from some Silvally. I also found another memory while helping Mina out with her trial. I gave it to her, but I'm not sure if she found out how it works.

items.en: Hey, $playername$. It's not your fault Kyurem fled, but I'm thinking it has probably gone into hiding. We should search the Giant Chasm for its lair at once.
items.zh: 嘿，$playername$。酋雷姆逃跑不是你的错，但我想它可能已经躲起来了。我们应该立即在巨大裂缝中寻找它的巢穴。
items.normEn: Hey, $playername$. It's not your fault Kyurem fled, but I'm thinking it has probably gone into hiding. We should search the Giant Chasm for its lair at once.

items.en: Hey, $playername$. Looking for a battle? Hm, ok. Can I say something to you anyway? It will be quick. I want to propose to my girlfriend, but I can't afford the ring she really wants. It's so expensive, and I feel guilty not being able to give her what she deserves. I don't know what to do! Maybe I could pick up some extra work to hire more Miners for some Diamonds.
items.zh: 嘿，$playername$。寻找战斗？嗯，好吧。我可以对你说点什么吗？会很快的。我想向我的女朋友求婚，但我买不起她真正想要的戒指。它是如此昂贵，我为无法给她她应得的东西而感到内疚。我不知道该怎么办！也许我可以做一些额外的工作来雇佣更多的矿工来开采一些钻石。
items.normEn: Hey, $playername$. Looking for a battle? Hm, ok. Can I say something to you anyway? It will be quick. I want to propose to my girlfriend, but I can't afford the ring she really wants. It's so expensive, and I feel guilty not being able to give her what she deserves. I don't know what to do! Maybe I could pick up some extra work to hire more Miners for some Diamonds.

items.en: Hey, Chief! I was talking to the locals and they mentioned some weird purple and yellow ruins at Three-Point Pass. You should go check 'em out!
items.zh: 嘿，酋长！我和当地人交谈时，他们提到了三点山口有一些奇怪的紫色和黄色废墟。你应该去看看！
items.normEn: Hey, Chief! I was talking to the locals and they mentioned some weird purple and yellow ruins at Three-Point Pass. You should go check 'em out!

items.en: Hey, Chief! I was talking to the locals and they mentioned they had seen some bird Pokémon that looked like the legendary birds of Kanto at that ultra-mega-massive tree in the middle of Ballimere Lake!
items.zh: 嘿，酋长！我和当地人交谈时，他们提到他们在巴利米尔湖中央的那棵超大树上看到了一些看起来像关东传说中的鸟类的鸟类神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: Hey, Chief! I was talking to the locals and they mentioned they had seen some bird Pokémon that looked like the legendary birds of Kanto at that ultra-mega-massive tree in the middle of Ballimere Lake!

items.en: Hey, Chief! I was talking to the locals and they were talking about some ancient king Pokémon! They also mentioned a couple of horsey Pokémon that it was ultra-mega-close to. There's a statue of it outside and I've heard this rock I've been using as a pillow is part of it!
items.zh: 嘿，酋长！我正在和当地人交谈，他们正在谈论一些古老的国王神奇宝贝！他们还提到了一些与它非常接近的马神奇宝贝。外面有一尊它的雕像，我听说我一直用作枕头的这块石头就是它的一部分！
items.normEn: Hey, Chief! I was talking to the locals and they were talking about some ancient king Pokémon! They also mentioned a couple of horsey Pokémon that it was ultra-mega-close to. There's a statue of it outside and I've heard this rock I've been using as a pillow is part of it!

items.en: Hey, good job on chasing away those Pokémon. My name is Professor Lund and I'm leading the science team in this area.
items.zh: 嘿，干得好，赶走了那些神奇宝贝。我是隆德教授，我领导着这一领域的科学团队。
items.normEn: Hey, good job on chasing away those Pokémon. My name is Professor Lund and I'm leading the science team in this area.

items.en: Hey, good to see ya here. How are you doing? I'm doing well, but I need some Battle Points. I need to get more materials for a school project, but I'm not sure how I will get Battle Points in Alola, since the Battle Frontier is only in the Hoenn region. And I don't know anyone who could get them and deliver them to me.
items.zh: 嘿，很高兴在这里见到你。你好吗？我做得很好，但我需要一些战斗点数。我需要为学校项目获取更多材料，但我不确定如何在阿罗拉获得战斗点，因为战斗前沿仅在丰缘地区。我不知道有谁能得到它们并将它们交给我。
items.normEn: Hey, good to see ya here. How are you doing? I'm doing well, but I need some Battle Points. I need to get more materials for a school project, but I'm not sure how I will get Battle Points in Alola, since the Battle Frontier is only in the Hoenn region. And I don't know anyone who could get them and deliver them to me.

items.en: Hey, hey, did you hear? A group of students saw some super rare Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}!
items.zh: 嘿嘿嘿，你听到了吗？一群学生在{ROUTE_NAME}上看到了一些超级稀有的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: Hey, hey, did you hear? A group of students saw some super rare Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}!

items.en: Hey, I see you're back. Did you find any Silvally Memories? Oh, I see you found 4 of them, and in surprisingly relevant places too. Let me give them to Silvally.
items.zh: 嘿，我看到你回来了。你找到西尔瓦利的回忆了吗？哦，我看到你找到了其中的 4 个，而且还在令人惊讶的相关地方。让我把它们交给西尔瓦利。
items.normEn: Hey, I see you're back. Did you find any Silvally Memories? Oh, I see you found 4 of them, and in surprisingly relevant places too. Let me give them to Silvally.

items.en: Hey, kiddo. What are you doing here? Just visiting Akala Island? Cus y'know lots of tourists come here to see the Battle Royal. So, what're you doing here? Looking for something?
items.zh: 嘿，小鬼。你在这里做什么？刚刚游览阿卡拉岛？因为你知道很多游客来这里观看皇家大战。那么，你在这里做什么？在找东西吗？
items.normEn: Hey, kiddo. What are you doing here? Just visiting Akala Island? Cus y'know lots of tourists come here to see the Battle Royal. So, what're you doing here? Looking for something?

items.en: Hey, welcome to the Lush Jungle! How are you doing today? I'm not so good. I wanted to try a new ingredient to see if it attracts Lurantis, but it costs too much. Like, a lot of Quest Points. I just can't afford it.
items.zh: 嘿，欢迎来到茂密的丛林！你今天怎么样？我没那么好。我想尝试一种新成分，看看它是否能吸引鲁兰蒂斯，但它的成本太高了。就像很多任务点一样。我就是买不起。
items.normEn: Hey, welcome to the Lush Jungle! How are you doing today? I'm not so good. I wanted to try a new ingredient to see if it attracts Lurantis, but it costs too much. Like, a lot of Quest Points. I just can't afford it.

items.en: Hey, welcome to the Pal Park! Have you been to my Dad’s Safari Zone in Kanto? We don’t have as many Pokémon here, but I’ve heard that a flower Pokémon found here can bloom when it’s sunny outside!
items.zh: 嘿，欢迎来到帕尔公园！你去过我爸爸在关东的野生动物园吗？我们这里的神奇宝贝不多，但我听说这里发现的花神奇宝贝在外面阳光明媚的时候会开花！
items.normEn: Hey, welcome to the Pal Park! Have you been to my Dad’s Safari Zone in Kanto? We don’t have as many Pokémon here, but I’ve heard that a flower Pokémon found here can bloom when it’s sunny outside!

items.en: Hey, what gives? I was just trying to relax here!
items.zh: 嘿，什么给？我只是想在这里放松一下！
items.normEn: Hey, what gives? I was just trying to relax here!

items.en: Hey, what's that purple glow? It looks to be around... Hammerlocke?
items.zh: 嘿，那紫色的光芒是什么？它看起来就在……Hammerlocke 附近？
items.normEn: Hey, what's that purple glow? It looks to be around... Hammerlocke?

items.en: Hey, would you mind letting minnow when you want to rematch?
items.zh: 嘿，当你想重赛时，你介意让米诺鱼吗？
items.normEn: Hey, would you mind letting minnow when you want to rematch?

items.en: Hey, you found me on my vacation! Did you see my Pikachu? Looks like it ate some of the berries here. Maybe you can find some other Pikachu like it hiding around here?
items.zh: 嘿，你在我度假时找到了我！你看到我的皮卡丘了吗？看起来它吃了这里的一些浆果。也许你能在这里找到其他像它一样的皮卡丘？
items.normEn: Hey, you found me on my vacation! Did you see my Pikachu? Looks like it ate some of the berries here. Maybe you can find some other Pikachu like it hiding around here?

items.en: Hey, you were a really great partner! It was really nice doing this mission with you, and you seem like a strong trainer, so if you want me to join your team, I'll be waiting at Victory Road!
items.zh: 嘿，你真是一个很棒的合作伙伴！和你一起做这个任务真是太好了，而且你看起来是个很强的训练家，所以如果你想让我加入你的团队，我会在胜利路等着！
items.normEn: Hey, you were a really great partner! It was really nice doing this mission with you, and you seem like a strong trainer, so if you want me to join your team, I'll be waiting at Victory Road!

items.en: Hey! I didn't expect to see you again here. Fancy a ba-. Actually, no, I'd like to ask a favour of you; a friend of mine living in Glimwood Tangle called me asking for some help.
items.zh: 嘿！没想到会在这里再次见到你。喜欢一个巴-。事实上，不，我想请你帮个忙；我的一位住在格林伍德坦格尔的朋友打电话给我寻求帮助。
items.normEn: Hey! I didn't expect to see you again here. Fancy a ba-. Actually, no, I'd like to ask a favour of you; a friend of mine living in Glimwood Tangle called me asking for some help.

items.en: Hey! I wasn't done watching my cute Li'l Pokémon yet!
items.zh: 嘿！我还没看完我可爱的小神奇宝贝呢！
items.normEn: Hey! I wasn't done watching my cute Li'l Pokémon yet!

items.en: Hey! My bad, my bad! It just dawned on me that you're brand-new to the Isle of Armor! I bet you have no idea where to even begin looking for Max Mushrooms! C'mon--let's go for a walk, and I'll show you some mushroom hot spots.
items.zh: 嘿！我的坏事，我的坏事！我突然意识到你是盔甲岛的新手！我敢打赌您不知道从哪里开始寻找最大蘑菇！来吧——我们去散步吧，我带你去看看一些蘑菇热点。
items.normEn: Hey! My bad, my bad! It just dawned on me that you're brand-new to the Isle of Armor! I bet you have no idea where to even begin looking for Max Mushrooms! C'mon--let's go for a walk, and I'll show you some mushroom hot spots.

items.en: Hey! Take it easy! You won already!
items.normEn: Hey! Take it easy! You won already!

items.en: Hey! This snoop's been listening in!
items.zh: 嘿！这个窥探者一直在偷听！
items.normEn: Hey! This snoop's been listening in!

items.en: Hey... The actions that you're taking now... Are they based on the ideals you cling to? Or are they based on actual truths? And if they are... How much of the truth do you think you know?
items.zh: 嘿……你现在采取的行动……是基于你所坚持的理想吗？或者它们是基于真实的事实？如果他们是……你认为你了解多少真相？
items.normEn: Hey... The actions that you're taking now... Are they based on the ideals you cling to? Or are they based on actual truths? And if they are... How much of the truth do you think you know?

items.en: Hi $playername$, I just saw Diantha, a really cool and pretty actress, talking with a funny looking guy with orange spiky hair.
items.zh: 嗨，$playername$，我刚刚看到 Diantha，一位非常酷且漂亮的女演员，正在和一个长相滑稽、留着橙色尖刺头发的家伙交谈。
items.normEn: Hi $playername$, I just saw Diantha, a really cool and pretty actress, talking with a funny looking guy with orange spiky hair.

items.en: Hi, $playername$. How are you doing? I'm not doing so well right now.
items.zh: 嗨，$playername$。你好吗？我现在过得不太好。
items.normEn: Hi, $playername$. How are you doing? I'm not doing so well right now.

items.en: Hi! I'm collecting shells while I fish. There's a lot of neat stuff lying around here.
items.zh: 你好！我一边钓鱼一边收集贝壳。这里有很多整洁的东西。
items.normEn: Hi! I'm collecting shells while I fish. There's a lot of neat stuff lying around here.

items.en: Hide alternate forms from Pokédex that have not yet been caught
items.zh: 隐藏图鉴中尚未被发现的替代形态
items.normEn: Hide alternate forms from Pokédex that have not yet been caught

items.en: Hide Evolution Stones from future regions in the items menu
items.zh: 在项目菜单中隐藏未来区域的进化石
items.normEn: Hide Evolution Stones from future regions in the items menu

items.en: Hide future region forms from Battle Frontier
items.zh: 从《Battle Frontier》中隐藏未来的区域形态
items.normEn: Hide future region forms from Battle Frontier

items.en: Hide locked berries in trade window
items.zh: 将锁定的浆果隐藏在贸易窗口中
items.normEn: Hide locked berries in trade window

items.zh: 隐藏持有物品的神奇宝贝
隐藏持有该物品的神奇宝贝
隐藏具有最大维生素的神奇宝贝
隐藏具有最大维生素的神奇宝贝

items.en: Hide Quest Menu on full questslots
items.zh: 在完整任务栏隐藏任务菜单
items.normEn: Hide Quest Menu on full questslots

items.en: Hide the extended controls for less clutter while still being able to plant and harvest Berries or disable the module completely in the settings.
items.zh: 隐藏扩展控件以减少混乱，同时仍然能够种植和收获浆果或在设置中完全禁用该模块。
items.normEn: Hide the extended controls for less clutter while still being able to plant and harvest Berries or disable the module completely in the settings.

items.en: Hide unobtainable achievements when running challenge modes
items.zh: 运行挑战模式时隐藏无法获得的成就
items.normEn: Hide unobtainable achievements when running challenge modes

items.zh: 通往托盘镇的高速公路
雇用一名地下城指南（测试版）

items.en: His precious recovery operation must be finished by now. Today, we will leave quietly. But don't you forget us!
items.zh: 他宝贵的康复手术现在必须完成了。今天，我们将悄悄离开。但你别忘了我们！
items.normEn: His precious recovery operation must be finished by now. Today, we will leave quietly. But don't you forget us!

items.en: Hm, hm, hm. Well, seems like it's true. It really is just like the wall painting there. This one shows Primal Reversion... While that one shows Mega Evolution... I guess that proves it once and for all.
items.zh: 嗯，嗯，嗯。嗯，看来是真的。真的就像那里的壁画一样。这个显示的是原始回归……而那个显示的是超级进化……我想这一劳永逸地证明了这一点。
items.normEn: Hm, hm, hm. Well, seems like it's true. It really is just like the wall painting there. This one shows Primal Reversion... While that one shows Mega Evolution... I guess that proves it once and for all.

items.en: Hm! Excellent! You have caught your first Pokémon!
items.zh: 嗯！出色的！您捕获了您的第一只神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: Hm! Excellent! You have caught your first Pokémon!

items.en: Hm? You know Bill? He's my grandson. He's not here right now. He does something with PCs, so I'm house-sitting.
items.zh: 嗯？你认识比尔吗？他是我的孙子。他现在不在这儿。他用电脑做一些事情，所以我负责看管家务。
items.normEn: Hm? You know Bill? He's my grandson. He's not here right now. He does something with PCs, so I'm house-sitting.

items.en: Hm. I just can't figure this out. There's clearly something inside, but I just can't get the darned thing to open.
items.zh: 嗯。我就是想不通。里面显然有什么东西，但我就是打不开那该死的东西。
items.normEn: Hm. I just can't figure this out. There's clearly something inside, but I just can't get the darned thing to open.

items.en: Hmm? Who are you? Oh, so Ash sent you to help me? That's great!
items.zh: 唔？你是谁？哦，所以阿什派你来帮助我？那太棒了！
items.normEn: Hmm? Who are you? Oh, so Ash sent you to help me? That's great!

items.en: Hmm. Maybe you should train against Dark and Water-types. It will be useful for it to know their weaknesses, since they will be its own weaknesses when it evolves.
items.zh: 唔。也许你应该针对黑暗型和水型进行训练。了解它们的弱点对它来说是有用的，因为当它进化时它们将成为它自己的弱点。
items.normEn: Hmm. Maybe you should train against Dark and Water-types. It will be useful for it to know their weaknesses, since they will be its own weaknesses when it evolves.

items.en: Hmm... Perhaps now we know they are in this area, it would be better to search for them?
items.zh: 嗯……或许现在知道他们就在这片区域，不如去寻找一下？
items.normEn: Hmm... Perhaps now we know they are in this area, it would be better to search for them?

items.en: Hmm... Who exactly were the heroes that bathed here?
items.zh: 嗯……在这里沐浴的英雄到底是谁？
items.normEn: Hmm... Who exactly were the heroes that bathed here?

items.en: Hmmm… Oh! Sorry, I didn’t see you there! Sometimes the strangest things wash up on this beach, so I just got caught up in the search.
items.zh: 嗯……哦！抱歉，我没在那里看到你！有时最奇怪的东西会被冲到这个海滩上，所以我就陷入了搜索之中。
items.normEn: Hmmm… Oh! Sorry, I didn’t see you there! Sometimes the strangest things wash up on this beach, so I just got caught up in the search.

items.en: Hmmph! You're pretty strong. I'll give you that. But mess with anyone in Team Skull again, and I'll show you how serious I can get.
items.zh: 哼！你很强啊。我会给你那个。但如果你再跟骷髅队里的任何人打交道，我就会告诉你我能变得多么认真。
items.normEn: Hmmph! You're pretty strong. I'll give you that. But mess with anyone in Team Skull again, and I'll show you how serious I can get.

items.en: Hmmph. Guess you are pretty tough. Now I understand why my Grunts waste so much time battling kids. But if you want us to return the Pokémon, then you'll have to come to us. Alone. The boss is dying to meet you, hmmph! See you at our base in Po Town!
items.zh: 哼。猜猜你一定很坚强。现在我明白为什么我的咕噜们浪费这么多时间和孩子们战斗了。但如果你想让我们归还神奇宝贝，那么你就必须来找我们。独自的。老大很想见见你，哼！我们蒲镇基地见！
items.normEn: Hmmph. Guess you are pretty tough. Now I understand why my Grunts waste so much time battling kids. But if you want us to return the Pokémon, then you'll have to come to us. Alone. The boss is dying to meet you, hmmph! See you at our base in Po Town!

items.en: Hmph! I'll have you know defeating me won't do you any good, anyway.
items.zh: 哼！我会让你知道，无论如何，打败我对你没有任何好处。
items.normEn: Hmph! I'll have you know defeating me won't do you any good, anyway.

items.en: Hmph... It's not like me to slip up like that. I've got to keep fighting stronger opponents. Looks like I'm still not ready...
items.zh: 哼……我可不像我会犯这样的错误。我必须继续与更强大的对手战斗。看来我还没准备好...
items.normEn: Hmph... It's not like me to slip up like that. I've got to keep fighting stronger opponents. Looks like I'm still not ready...

items.en: Ho-Oh came down from the Tin Tower and revived those Pokémon. They became the Legendary Beasts. Some say these Beasts still inhabit the basement of the Burned Tower.
items.zh: 凤王从锡塔下来并复活了那些神奇宝贝。他们成为了传说中的神兽。有人说这些野兽仍然居住在烧毁之塔的地下室。
items.normEn: Ho-Oh came down from the Tin Tower and revived those Pokémon. They became the Legendary Beasts. Some say these Beasts still inhabit the basement of the Burned Tower.

items.en: Hohoho! You must be the $playername$ I'm hearing so much about you from my.... employees.
items.zh: 嗬嗬！你一定是$playername$，我从我的……员工那里听到了很多关于你的消息。
items.normEn: Hohoho! You must be the $playername$ I'm hearing so much about you from my.... employees.

items.en: Hold the phone... The chairman was talking about the Darkest Day. That's the thing where the sky went all dark once, ages and ages ago, right? What does he mean, he's bringing that about? And where did we even hear that name...?
items.zh: 挂断电话……主席正在谈论至暗之日。这就是很久很久以前天空完全黑暗的事情，对吗？他要这么做是什么意思？我们在哪里听说过这个名字......？
items.normEn: Hold the phone... The chairman was talking about the Darkest Day. That's the thing where the sky went all dark once, ages and ages ago, right? What does he mean, he's bringing that about? And where did we even hear that name...?

items.en: Hold up a sec! *wheeze*... *wheeze*... Hellooo, what's this?! Three Max Mushrooms in one spot? Here I thought I'd need to go find them one by one! I saw those mushrooms first! I swear! I've been at the dojo longer and all. Sooo... It's only fair you let me have 'em. Riiight?
items.zh: 等一下！ *喘息*... *喘息*...喂，这是什么？！一处最多三个蘑菇？我想我得一一去找他们了！我首先看到那些蘑菇！我发誓！我在道场呆的时间更长了。苏...你让我拥有它们才公平。对吧？
items.normEn: Hold up a sec! *wheeze*... *wheeze*... Hellooo, what's this?! Three Max Mushrooms in one spot? Here I thought I'd need to go find them one by one! I saw those mushrooms first! I swear! I've been at the dojo longer and all. Sooo... It's only fair you let me have 'em. Riiight?

items.en: Hooaahhh! You clown! Always gettin' all up in my business! If it's gonna be like that, I'm outta here! The Southern Island's gotta be more fun than this.
items.zh: 呼啊啊！你这个小丑！总是全力以赴地做我的事！如果真是这样的话，我就离开这里了！南岛一定比这更有趣。
items.normEn: Hooaahhh! You clown! Always gettin' all up in my business! If it's gonna be like that, I'm outta here! The Southern Island's gotta be more fun than this.

items.en: Hoopa is up to something mischievous...
items.normEn: Hoopa is up to something mischievous...

items.en: Hop wants to fight you one more time at Slumbering Weald Shrine.
items.zh: 霍普想在沉睡的荒野神殿与你再战一次。
items.normEn: Hop wants to fight you one more time at Slumbering Weald Shrine.

items.en: Hopefully fixed some values becoming NaN
items.zh: 希望修复一些值变成 NaN
items.normEn: Hopefully fixed some values becoming NaN

items.en: Hopefully I'll have a Gengar soon...
items.zh: 希望我很快就能拥有耿鬼……
items.normEn: Hopefully I'll have a Gengar soon...

items.en: Hopefully you can finally catch up to this Happiny at Hearthome City. Ask around for any witnesses.
items.zh: 希望你最终能在心家城赶上这份幸福。四处询问是否有目击证人。
items.normEn: Hopefully you can finally catch up to this Happiny at Hearthome City. Ask around for any witnesses.

items.zh: 打开 Poké Mart 商店的热键
items.normEn: Hotkey to open Poké Mart shop

items.normEn: Hotkey to open the quest list

items.zh: 为橡木项目模式添加热键（O 打开，数字键切换项目）
items.normEn: Hotkeys added for oak items modal (O to open, number keys to toggle items)

items.en: Hotkeys added for Pokéball selector modal (P + number to open, number keys to toggle items)
items.zh: 为 Pokéball 选择器模式添加了热键（P + 数字键打开，数字键切换项目）
items.normEn: Hotkeys added for Pokéball selector modal (P + number to open, number keys to toggle items)

items.en: Hotkeys will no longer activate while focused on inputs
items.zh: 专注于输入时热键将不再激活
items.normEn: Hotkeys will no longer activate while focused on inputs

items.zh: 将鼠标悬停在神奇宝贝攻击值上

items.en: How 'bout clearin' em 10 times each, and see if you find anythin' to open up the ruins at Three-Point Pass.
items.zh: 每次清理 10 次，看看是否能找到任何东西来打开三点通道的废墟。
items.normEn: How 'bout clearin' em 10 times each, and see if you find anythin' to open up the ruins at Three-Point Pass.

items.en: How about a trade? I will give you the Memory if you give me some Quest Points, how 'bout that? Ok, I'll be here in the Lush Jungle for a while, so you can get Quest Points and come back later to do the trade if you need to.
items.zh: 做个交易怎么样？如果你给我一些任务点，我就给你记忆，怎么样？好的，我会在茂密的丛林待一段时间，这样你就可以获得任务点数，如果需要的话稍后再回来进行交易。
items.normEn: How about a trade? I will give you the Memory if you give me some Quest Points, how 'bout that? Ok, I'll be here in the Lush Jungle for a while, so you can get Quest Points and come back later to do the trade if you need to.

items.en: How can I get more Berries?
items.zh: 我怎样才能获得更多浆果？
items.normEn: How can I get more Berries?

items.en: How can I help with development?
items.normEn: How can I help with development?

items.en: How did you find me? Cobalion told me this place was well hidden! Anyways, what do you want from me? Cobalion wants to reunite the Swords of Justice? Do you think I'm dumb enough to fall for lies of a human?
items.zh: 你是怎么找到我的？ Cobalion 告诉我这个地方隐藏得很好！无论如何，你想从我这里得到什么？ Cobalion想要让正义之剑重聚？你以为我傻到会被人类的谎言所欺骗吗？
items.normEn: How did you find me? Cobalion told me this place was well hidden! Anyways, what do you want from me? Cobalion wants to reunite the Swords of Justice? Do you think I'm dumb enough to fall for lies of a human?

items.zh: 如何进化需要物品才能进化的神奇宝贝？
items.normEn: How do I evolve Pokémon that require an item to evolve?

items.normEn: How do I get Dungeon Tokens?

items.zh: 如何增加我的点击攻击？

items.zh: 如何让地下城变得更小？

items.zh: 如何获得某些神奇宝贝？

items.zh: 如何解锁地下城的地下城指南（测试版）？

items.zh: 如何在地下城中解锁 Flash？

items.zh: 如何解锁道馆的自动战斗选项？

items.zh: 地牢中的地板如何运作？
items.normEn: How do the floors in dungeons work?

items.en: How have things been for you? Oh, is that right? You've caught more Pokémon. Do you know what? Maybe I can be useful to you. I'm modifying the Network Machine right now. I'm changing it so it can handle trades over long distances. When I get finished, you'll be trading for exotic Pokémon from Trainers far away.
items.zh: 你过得怎么样？哦，是吗？您捕获了更多神奇宝贝。你知道什么吗？也许我对你有用。我现在正在修改网络机器。我正在对其进行更改，以便它可以处理长距离交易。当我完成后，你将可以从远处的训练师处交易奇异的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: How have things been for you? Oh, is that right? You've caught more Pokémon. Do you know what? Maybe I can be useful to you. I'm modifying the Network Machine right now. I'm changing it so it can handle trades over long distances. When I get finished, you'll be trading for exotic Pokémon from Trainers far away.

items.en: How is this possible?! I've never seen a trainer so strong! But, no matter! Surely I've bought Gorigan enough time.
items.zh: 这怎么可能？！我从来没有见过这么强的教练！但是，没关系！当然，我已经为高里根争取了足够的时间。
items.normEn: How is this possible?! I've never seen a trainer so strong! But, no matter! Surely I've bought Gorigan enough time.

items.en: How many Oak Item slots are available?
items.zh: 有多少个可用的橡木物品槽位？
items.normEn: How many Oak Item slots are available?

items.en: How, how, how dare you! Don't you dare think you'll get away with your latest outrage! One of these days, I will take great pleasure in kicking you about with my elegant dance steps! Oh, and I'm not giving up our Shadow Pokémon plan!
items.zh: 你怎么、你、你怎么敢！你敢不敢认为你最近的暴行就能逃脱惩罚！有一天，我会很高兴用我优雅的舞步踢你一脚！哦，我不会放弃我们的影子神奇宝贝计划！
items.normEn: How, how, how dare you! Don't you dare think you'll get away with your latest outrage! One of these days, I will take great pleasure in kicking you about with my elegant dance steps! Oh, and I'm not giving up our Shadow Pokémon plan!

items.en: How?!? My Rattata is in the top percentage of all Rattata!
items.zh: 如何？！？我的拉达在所有拉达中都是名列前茅的！
items.normEn: How?!? My Rattata is in the top percentage of all Rattata!

items.en: However, I do have an interest in you! I want to taste your power. Defeat me, and I'll let you search for the rare Pokémon.
items.zh: 不过，我确实对你有兴趣！我想尝尝你的力量。打败我，我就可以让你寻找稀有的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: However, I do have an interest in you! I want to taste your power. Defeat me, and I'll let you search for the rare Pokémon.

items.en: However, we've realized that we will need more energy than originally anticipated to control the process properly... I'm sorry to ask this of you, but we will need one more Meteorite Shard. There should be one at Meteor Falls.
items.zh: 然而，我们已经意识到，我们需要比最初预期更多的能量来正确控制该过程……很抱歉向您提出这个问题，但我们还需要一块陨石碎片。流星瀑布应该有一个。
items.normEn: However, we've realized that we will need more energy than originally anticipated to control the process properly... I'm sorry to ask this of you, but we will need one more Meteorite Shard. There should be one at Meteor Falls.

items.en: However, your very own Pokémon legend is about to unfold!
items.zh: 然而，你自己的神奇宝贝传奇即将展开！
items.normEn: However, your very own Pokémon legend is about to unfold!

items.en: However! They'll each drop a stone called a Wishing Piece. If you gather enough of those stones here, more Gigantamax Pokémon'll show up! Dunno which ones, probably just your luck.
items.zh: 然而！他们每人都会掉落一块称为“许愿碎片”的石头。如果你在这里收集足够多的石头，就会出现更多超极巨化神奇宝贝！不知道是哪些，可能只是你的运气。
items.normEn: However! They'll each drop a stone called a Wishing Piece. If you gather enough of those stones here, more Gigantamax Pokémon'll show up! Dunno which ones, probably just your luck.

items.en: Hoy thar, matey! What's that? You lookin' for Cap'n Stern, are ya? That ol' Jack Tar! A loose cannon 'e is! You'll only see 'im ashore in a Thunderstorm. 'E'll say it's all due to protocol but the trut' is lightnin' scares 'im stem to stern! Didn' 'ear that from me 'ough...
items.zh: 嘿，伙计！那是什么？你在找斯特恩船长，是吗？那个老杰克·塔尔！是一门松散的大炮！你只会在雷暴天气中看到他上岸。 “我会说这都是礼节性的，但事实是，我从头到尾都感到害怕！”没从我嘴里听到这个吗……
items.normEn: Hoy thar, matey! What's that? You lookin' for Cap'n Stern, are ya? That ol' Jack Tar! A loose cannon 'e is! You'll only see 'im ashore in a Thunderstorm. 'E'll say it's all due to protocol but the trut' is lightnin' scares 'im stem to stern! Didn' 'ear that from me 'ough...

items.en: Hrm, yes! I see that gleam in your eye! It may look expensive now, but the treasures you'll find in the Underground are priceless! And what's more- with each new region you travel to, the more adept you will become at identifying new curios!
items.zh: 嗯，是的！我看到你眼中的光芒！现在看起来可能很贵，但你在地下找到的宝藏是无价的！更重要的是，随着您前往的每个新地区，您将更加善于识别新的古玩！
items.normEn: Hrm, yes! I see that gleam in your eye! It may look expensive now, but the treasures you'll find in the Underground are priceless! And what's more- with each new region you travel to, the more adept you will become at identifying new curios!

items.en: Huff... huff... we should have been out of the forest by now!
items.zh: 呼……呼……我们现在应该已经走出森林了！
items.normEn: Huff... huff... we should have been out of the forest by now!

items.en: Hugh thinks some Team Plasma Grunts in Nimbasa City are stealing Pokémon. Defeat the grunts.
items.zh: 休认为宁巴萨市的一些等离子队士兵正在偷走神奇宝贝。击败咕噜声。
items.normEn: Hugh thinks some Team Plasma Grunts in Nimbasa City are stealing Pokémon. Defeat the grunts.

items.en: Huh, what? Why'd you have to win?
items.zh: 呃，什么？为什么一定要赢？
items.normEn: Huh, what? Why'd you have to win?

items.en: Huh? Closer observation reveals that the subject is a trainer. Ergo, the subject is not a burglar! Ahaha! Chobin wishes you spoke up right away. You're $playername$? Chobin apologizes for jumping to the wrong conclusion.
items.zh: 啊？仔细观察发现，对象是一名训练员。因此，对象不是窃贼！啊哈哈！乔宾希望你立即说出来。你是$playername$？乔宾为仓促得出错误结论而道歉。
items.normEn: Huh? Closer observation reveals that the subject is a trainer. Ergo, the subject is not a burglar! Ahaha! Chobin wishes you spoke up right away. You're $playername$? Chobin apologizes for jumping to the wrong conclusion.

items.en: Huh? Oh, hi. I forgot to say, congrats on catching Zacian and Zamazenta!
items.zh: 啊？哦，嗨。我忘了说，恭喜你抓住了扎西安和扎马森塔！
items.normEn: Huh? Oh, hi. I forgot to say, congrats on catching Zacian and Zamazenta!

items.en: Huh? Oh, you're that trainer from before?! Chobin wishes you spoke up right away.
items.zh: 啊？哦，你就是之前那个训练家吗？！乔宾希望你立即说出来。
items.normEn: Huh? Oh, you're that trainer from before?! Chobin wishes you spoke up right away.

items.en: Huh? They ran off and are trying to blend in with the local Pokémon population. Find those Santa Jynx and collect more Christmas presents!
items.zh: 啊？他们逃跑了并试图融入当地的神奇宝贝群体。找到那些圣诞老人并收集更多圣诞礼物！
items.normEn: Huh? They ran off and are trying to blend in with the local Pokémon population. Find those Santa Jynx and collect more Christmas presents!

items.en: Huh? Well how 'bout that, Chief! Looks like that was the last bit of the grand Peony Adven-tour that I had for you! Whoooooo! Now this is an occasion! What's the word? Ultra-mega-epic! Your passion for all this caught me off guard, Chief...
items.zh: 啊？那么，怎么样，酋长！看起来这就是我为你准备的牡丹降临之旅的最后一部分了！呜呜呜！现在这是一个机会！词是什么？超大型史诗！你对这一切的热情让我措手不及，酋长……
items.normEn: Huh? Well how 'bout that, Chief! Looks like that was the last bit of the grand Peony Adven-tour that I had for you! Whoooooo! Now this is an occasion! What's the word? Ultra-mega-epic! Your passion for all this caught me off guard, Chief...

items.en: Huh? What are you doing in here? A what? Silvally Memory? I think I have what you're looking for. Yeah, I have it, if you want to see it. Anyways, I was just passing by and decided to visit this place again.
items.zh: 啊？你在这里做什么？一个什么？西尔瓦利记忆？我想我有你要找的东西。是的，我有，如果你想看的话。不管怎样，我只是路过，决定再次访问这个地方。
items.normEn: Huh? What are you doing in here? A what? Silvally Memory? I think I have what you're looking for. Yeah, I have it, if you want to see it. Anyways, I was just passing by and decided to visit this place again.

items.en: Huh? What're you doing here in the woods? Nobody ever comes in here, since this is the forest where Zacian and Zamazenta rested. It's the best place to do a bit of thinking, since it's so quiet and all.
items.zh: 啊？你在树林里做什么？从来没有人进来过这里，因为这是扎西安和扎马森塔休息的森林。这是思考的最佳场所，因为这里非常安静。
items.normEn: Huh? What're you doing here in the woods? Nobody ever comes in here, since this is the forest where Zacian and Zamazenta rested. It's the best place to do a bit of thinking, since it's so quiet and all.

items.en: Huh? You need medicine? Your Pokémon appear to be fine. Is something worrying you?
items.zh: 啊？你需要药吗？你的神奇宝贝看起来没问题。有什么事让你担心吗？
items.normEn: Huh? You need medicine? Your Pokémon appear to be fine. Is something worrying you?

items.en: Humph! At least you're raising your Pokémon!
items.zh: 哼!至少你正在抚养你的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: Humph! At least you're raising your Pokémon!

items.en: Humph! You have proven your worth! Here! Take the Soul Badge!
items.zh: 哼!你已经证明了你的价值！这里！拿走灵魂徽章！
items.normEn: Humph! You have proven your worth! Here! Take the Soul Badge!

items.en: Humph! Your struggle to get here was all in vain! The Shadow Pokémon we produced have already been moved elsewhere. And that, of course, includes the ultimate Shadow Pokémon I created for the boss! Wahahahah!
items.zh: 哼!你到达这里的努力都是徒劳的！我们生产的暗影宝可梦已经被转移到其他地方了。当然，其中包括我为 Boss 创建的终极暗影神奇宝贝！哇哈哈哈！
items.normEn: Humph! Your struggle to get here was all in vain! The Shadow Pokémon we produced have already been moved elsewhere. And that, of course, includes the ultimate Shadow Pokémon I created for the boss! Wahahahah!

items.en: I adore wolf Pokémon! The most precious of all have to be the brave little Electrike - I've gathered five hundred of the darlings in my home.
items.zh: 我喜欢狼宝可梦！其中最珍贵的一定是勇敢的小电动车——我在家里收集了五百只宝贝。
items.normEn: I adore wolf Pokémon! The most precious of all have to be the brave little Electrike - I've gathered five hundred of the darlings in my home.

items.en: I always seem to run out of Great Balls. Luckly this shop always have them in stock!
items.zh: 我似乎总是没有好球。幸运的是这家商店总是有库存！
items.normEn: I always seem to run out of Great Balls. Luckly this shop always have them in stock!

items.en: I am Calyrex. I am also known as the King of Bountiful Harvests. I have borrowed this man's body in order to thank you in person for restoring my statue...so to speak.
items.zh: 我是卡莱克斯。我也被称为五谷丰登王。我借用这个人的身体，是为了当面感谢你修复了我的雕像……可以这么说。
items.normEn: I am Calyrex. I am also known as the King of Bountiful Harvests. I have borrowed this man's body in order to thank you in person for restoring my statue...so to speak.

items.en: I am dumbfounded! So very, very strong! You, your Pokémon, so strong! Your power is admirable! I shall honor it with this Gym Badge!"
items.zh: 我傻眼了！所以非常非常强！你，你的神奇宝贝，好强啊！你的力量令人钦佩！我将用这枚道馆徽章来纪念它！”
items.normEn: I am dumbfounded! So very, very strong! You, your Pokémon, so strong! Your power is admirable! I shall honor it with this Gym Badge!"

items.en: I am Evice, and I shall rule the world!
items.zh: 我是伊维斯，我将统治世界！
items.normEn: I am Evice, and I shall rule the world!

items.en: I Am Getting Good at Questing!
items.normEn: I Am Getting Good at Questing!

items.en: I am Howard Clifford, CEO of Clifford Industries. I hear you have been investigating both my company, and a mysterious drug called R.
items.zh: 我是克利福德工业公司首席执行官霍华德·克利福德。我听说你一直在调查我的公司和一种叫做 R 的神秘药物。
items.normEn: I am Howard Clifford, CEO of Clifford Industries. I hear you have been investigating both my company, and a mysterious drug called R.

items.en: I am Lysandre. I've tried to learn as much about Pokémon as I can to help build a brighter future. Professor Sycamore has taught me so much.
items.zh: 我是莱桑德尔。我尝试尽可能多地了解神奇宝贝，以帮助建立更光明的未来。 Sycamore 教授教会了我很多东西。
items.normEn: I am Lysandre. I've tried to learn as much about Pokémon as I can to help build a brighter future. Professor Sycamore has taught me so much.

items.en: I am so grateful to you for helping us out of that dangerous spot. Come on. Into the bag, Nebby.
items.zh: 我非常感谢你帮助我们脱离了那个危险的地方。快点。放进袋子里，内比。
items.normEn: I am so grateful to you for helping us out of that dangerous spot. Come on. Into the bag, Nebby.

items.en: I am the lead scientist specializing in all things related to Unown. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask. Our study has revealed three key patterns regarding the appearance of Unown:
items.zh: 我是专门研究与 Unown 相关的所有事物的首席科学家。如果您有任何疑问，请随时询问。我们的研究揭示了有关 Unown 外观的三种关键模式：
items.normEn: I am the lead scientist specializing in all things related to Unown. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask. Our study has revealed three key patterns regarding the appearance of Unown:

items.en: I believe Necrozma may drop a crystal of its own light, as well. Although I doubt it can make any use of it in its current state. Perhaps if it was already fused with the light of Solgaleo or Lunala....
items.zh: 我相信奈克洛兹玛也可能会掉落一颗自身发光的水晶。尽管我怀疑它在目前的状态下能否发挥作用。也许如果它已经与索尔迦雷欧或露奈雅拉的光芒融合的话……
items.normEn: I believe Necrozma may drop a crystal of its own light, as well. Although I doubt it can make any use of it in its current state. Perhaps if it was already fused with the light of Solgaleo or Lunala....

items.en: I bet he forget to tell you that although all Battle Items only last for 30 seconds, they can stack and last for days! Now scram!
items.zh: 我敢打赌他忘了告诉你，虽然所有战斗物品只能持续 30 秒，但它们可以堆叠并持续数天！现在滚吧！
items.normEn: I bet he forget to tell you that although all Battle Items only last for 30 seconds, they can stack and last for days! Now scram!

items.en: I Can Do It This Time!
items.normEn: I Can Do It This Time!

items.en: I can do this all day
items.normEn: I can do this all day

items.en: I can feel the fire of your convictions burning deep within your heart!
items.zh: 我能感觉到你内心深处信念之火在燃烧！
items.normEn: I can feel the fire of your convictions burning deep within your heart!

items.en: I can only hold off two! Pick the one you want to fight!
items.zh: 我只能挡住两个！选择你想战斗的人！
items.normEn: I can only hold off two! Pick the one you want to fight!

items.en: I can point out which Pokémon have been corrupted, or turned into "Shadow Pokémon", and you can confiscate them from evildoers using your Pokéballs.
items.zh: 我可以指出哪些神奇宝贝已经被破坏，或者变成了“影子神奇宝贝”，你可以用你的神奇宝贝球从邪恶的人那里没收它们。
items.normEn: I can point out which Pokémon have been corrupted, or turned into "Shadow Pokémon", and you can confiscate them from evildoers using your Pokéballs.

items.en: I can see what Lillie saw in you now... You've been a true inspiration to me too. I hope our paths cross again someday. Until then... See you around.
items.zh: 我现在可以看到莉莉在你身上看到了什么……你也对我来说是一个真正的灵感。我希望有一天我们的道路能够再次相遇。在那之前...再见。
items.normEn: I can see what Lillie saw in you now... You've been a true inspiration to me too. I hope our paths cross again someday. Until then... See you around.

items.en: I can see why you made it so far in the Indigo League, and I bet you'll do pretty well in the Orange League.
items.zh: 我明白你为什么能在靛蓝联赛中取得如此大的成绩，而且我打赌你在橙色联赛中也会表现得很好。
items.normEn: I can see why you made it so far in the Indigo League, and I bet you'll do pretty well in the Orange League.

items.en: I can try the experiment again using what was learned from the previous failure, but I will need your help. If we are successful, I will give you the opportunity to catch the resulting Meta Groudon to you.
items.zh: 我可以利用从上次失败中学到的东西再次尝试这个实验，但我需要你的帮助。如果我们成功了，我会给你机会抓住最终的元固拉多。
items.normEn: I can try the experiment again using what was learned from the previous failure, but I will need your help. If we are successful, I will give you the opportunity to catch the resulting Meta Groudon to you.

items.en: I can’t be missing out on much anyways, what could be more perfect than my Applin!
items.zh: 无论如何，我不能错过太多，还有什么比我的 Applin 更完美的呢！
items.normEn: I can’t be missing out on much anyways, what could be more perfect than my Applin!

items.en: I can't believe it! The Black and White Kyurem I went to all the trouble of preparing! How irritating! Now I have to go recapture Kyurem, don't I? But first, I'll take down this disgusting Trainer with my own hand! This time I WILL succeed! No matter what they try, no one will be able to stop me!
items.zh: 我简直不敢相信！黑白酋雷姆是我费尽心思准备的！真烦人！现在我必须去夺回酋雷姆，不是吗？但首先，我要亲手打倒这个恶心的训练家！这次我一定会成功的！无论他们如何尝试，没有人能够阻止我！
items.normEn: I can't believe it! The Black and White Kyurem I went to all the trouble of preparing! How irritating! Now I have to go recapture Kyurem, don't I? But first, I'll take down this disgusting Trainer with my own hand! This time I WILL succeed! No matter what they try, no one will be able to stop me!

items.en: I can't believe you beat up the boss! Better get out of here before he comes back!
items.zh: 我不敢相信你竟然殴打了老板！最好在他回来之前离开这里！
items.normEn: I can't believe you beat up the boss! Better get out of here before he comes back!

items.en: I can't figure out how I'm supposed to get inside. Let me tell you, I found this place. Don't look so envious, will you?
items.zh: 我不知道该怎么进去。让我告诉你，我找到了这个地方。别露出那么羡慕的表情好吗？
items.normEn: I can't figure out how I'm supposed to get inside. Let me tell you, I found this place. Don't look so envious, will you?

items.en: I Can't Hold All These Vitamins!
items.zh: 我无法承受所有这些维生素！
items.normEn: I Can't Hold All These Vitamins!

items.en: I can't hold off all ${...}! Please pick the Pokémon you want to fight!
items.zh: 我无法阻止所有${...}！请选择你想对战的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: I can't hold off all ${...}! Please pick the Pokémon you want to fight!

items.en: I can't quite remember what Quest Level we were at, but it was probably 16 or higher.
items.zh: 我不太记得我们当时的任务等级是多少，但可能是 16 级或更高。
items.normEn: I can't quite remember what Quest Level we were at, but it was probably 16 or higher.

items.en: I can't think of a better trainer for this Celebi.
items.zh: 我想不出还有比这更好的雪拉比训练师了。
items.normEn: I can't think of a better trainer for this Celebi.

items.en: I caught this Snom on Steamdrift Way and we’ve become really good mates.
items.zh: 我在 Steamdrift Way 上遇见了这只 Snom，我们成了非常好的伙伴。
items.normEn: I caught this Snom on Steamdrift Way and we’ve become really good mates.

items.en: I could not enter the dungeon anymore. Here is a refund.
items.zh: 我无法再进入地牢了。这里是退款。
items.normEn: I could not enter the dungeon anymore. Here is a refund.

items.en: I couldn't achieve victory for my partner... I won't let myself forget this frustration!
items.zh: 我没能为我的伙伴取得胜利……我不会让自己忘记这种挫败感！
items.normEn: I couldn't achieve victory for my partner... I won't let myself forget this frustration!

items.en: I couldn't even draw out my team's real strength... How pathetic!
items.zh: 连自己队伍的真正实力都抽不出来……真是可怜啊！
items.normEn: I couldn't even draw out my team's real strength... How pathetic!

items.en: I couldn't get it done. Don't worry about it, my precious Pokémon... You've gotta finish Mina's trial, right? Are you going to Aether House?
items.zh: 我无法完成它。别担心，我亲爱的神奇宝贝……你必须完成米娜的试炼，对吧？你要去以太屋吗？
items.normEn: I couldn't get it done. Don't worry about it, my precious Pokémon... You've gotta finish Mina's trial, right? Are you going to Aether House?

items.en: I couldn't have been defeated by some random Trainer from who knows where!
items.zh: 我不可能被某个不知道从哪里来的随机训练师打败！
items.normEn: I couldn't have been defeated by some random Trainer from who knows where!

items.en: I couldn't wait anymore for you to report about your progress, so I asked around and discovered you were coming here.
items.zh: 我等不及你报告你的进展了，所以我四处打听，发现你要来这里。
items.normEn: I couldn't wait anymore for you to report about your progress, so I asked around and discovered you were coming here.

items.en: I couldn't win, but at least I was able to show everyone how great Fairy types are.
items.zh: 虽然没能赢，但至少可以让大家见识一下妖精系的厉害。
items.normEn: I couldn't win, but at least I was able to show everyone how great Fairy types are.

items.en: I did see a Happiny like that. They were heading north, across Route 204.
items.zh: 我确实见过这样的幸福。他们正向北行驶，穿过 204 号公路。
items.normEn: I did see a Happiny like that. They were heading north, across Route 204.

items.en: I didn't expect there to be such a gap between you and me, mate...
items.zh: 没想到你我之间的差距竟然如此之大……
items.normEn: I didn't expect there to be such a gap between you and me, mate...

items.en: I do know where she is, but I can't just tell you. If you can defeat me, you may be worthy of knowing.
items.zh: 我确实知道她在哪里，但我不能直接告诉你。如果你能打败我，你也许就值得认识了。
items.normEn: I do know where she is, but I can't just tell you. If you can defeat me, you may be worthy of knowing.

items.en: I do not know what you plan to do, but Zinnia will continue to follow her convictions to the very end. This may cost her her life, but she is dedicated. Please, help her if you can.
items.zh: 我不知道你打算做什么，但百日草会继续坚持自己的信念到底。这可能会夺去她的生命，但她很奉献。如果可以的话，请帮助她。
items.normEn: I do not know what you plan to do, but Zinnia will continue to follow her convictions to the very end. This may cost her her life, but she is dedicated. Please, help her if you can.

items.en: I do tend to ramble on, I know. I love to make speeches. But I think I can stop talking now. I think the Champion should have captured Eternatus by now. If you're curious, you can take the lift up.
items.zh: 我知道，我确实倾向于胡言乱语。我喜欢演讲。但我想我现在可以停止说话了。我认为冠军现在应该已经占领了永恒。如果你好奇的话，可以乘电梯上去。
items.normEn: I do tend to ramble on, I know. I love to make speeches. But I think I can stop talking now. I think the Champion should have captured Eternatus by now. If you're curious, you can take the lift up.

items.en: I don't even have time to go and pick up an important package. A meteorite, found by the owner of the game corner on Two Island. It contains important materials for my machine.
items.zh: 我什至没有时间去取一个重要的包裹。陨石，是二岛游戏角的主人发现的。它包含我的机器的重要材料。
items.normEn: I don't even have time to go and pick up an important package. A meteorite, found by the owner of the game corner on Two Island. It contains important materials for my machine.

items.en: I don't get it! How'd I lose?!
items.zh: 我不明白！我怎么就输了？！
items.normEn: I don't get it! How'd I lose?!

items.en: I don't have enough Quest Points to buy a Linking Cord, but a girl named Mindy from Snowpoint City offered to trade me her Haunter for a Medicham.
items.zh: 我没有足够的任务点来购买连接线，但是来自雪点城的一个名叫明迪的女孩提出用她的鬼魂来交换我的医疗。
items.normEn: I don't have enough Quest Points to buy a Linking Cord, but a girl named Mindy from Snowpoint City offered to trade me her Haunter for a Medicham.

items.en: I don't have time to listen to people explain stuff I already know.
items.zh: 我没有时间听人们解释我已经知道的东西。
items.normEn: I don't have time to listen to people explain stuff I already know.

items.en: I don't know how to use it, so you can keep it.
items.zh: 我不知道怎么用，所以你可以保留它。
items.normEn: I don't know how to use it, so you can keep it.

items.en: I Don't Know if I Can Handle the Next Batch of Shinies
items.zh: 我不知道我是否能处理下一批闪亮的东西
items.normEn: I Don't Know if I Can Handle the Next Batch of Shinies

items.en: I don't know if it will really summon the Legendary Pokémon, but we can at least try! Thank you for coming this far with me, $playername$!
items.zh: 我不知道它是否真的能召唤传说中的神奇宝贝，但我们至少可以尝试一下！谢谢你陪我走到这一步，$playername$！
items.normEn: I don't know if it will really summon the Legendary Pokémon, but we can at least try! Thank you for coming this far with me, $playername$!
