items.en: I don't know if these rusty old things will really be able to stop the Darkest Day, but... Well, I guess it can't hurt to have them along! Let's hope they bring us some good luck!
items.zh: 我不知道这些生锈的老东西是否真的能够阻止至暗之日，但是……好吧，我想拥有它们也没什么坏处！希望他们能给我们带来好运！
items.normEn: I don't know if these rusty old things will really be able to stop the Darkest Day, but... Well, I guess it can't hurt to have them along! Let's hope they bring us some good luck!

items.en: I don't know what half those words mean. All I know is I can't go back to Kanto with the rest of the gang. This sucks.
items.zh: 我不知道这半句话是什么意思。我只知道我不能和其他人一起回到关东。这太糟糕了。
items.normEn: I don't know what half those words mean. All I know is I can't go back to Kanto with the rest of the gang. This sucks.

items.en: I don't know who else to trust with this. It's very important and very valuable.
items.zh: 我不知道这件事还能相信谁。这非常重要，也非常有价值。
items.normEn: I don't know who else to trust with this. It's very important and very valuable.

items.en: I don't see the same look in your eyes that I saw when we first met on Akala Island. Have you had some experiences that you'll carry with you in your heart forever? Well, it's time for you to move on.
items.zh: 我在你眼中看不到我们第一次在阿卡拉岛见面时的表情。你有没有经历过一些让你永远铭记在心的经历？好吧，你是时候继续前进了。
items.normEn: I don't see the same look in your eyes that I saw when we first met on Akala Island. Have you had some experiences that you'll carry with you in your heart forever? Well, it's time for you to move on.

items.en: I Don't Think I'll Ever Be Able To Go Back to the Commoner's Great Ball
items.zh: 我想我再也无法回到平民的盛大舞会了
items.normEn: I Don't Think I'll Ever Be Able To Go Back to the Commoner's Great Ball

items.en: I don't want to do any of these
items.normEn: I don't want to do any of these

items.en: I doubt he'd be interested in talking to you unless you could help him find a way to get there... Can't the lake guardians help you with that?
items.zh: 我怀疑他会有兴趣和你说话，除非你能帮他找到到达那里的方法……湖水守护者不能帮你吗？
items.normEn: I doubt he'd be interested in talking to you unless you could help him find a way to get there... Can't the lake guardians help you with that?

items.en: I dunno what your plans are round these parts, but you'd best keep an eye out for some of them dang ole Shadow Pokémon. Give a stranger enough of a whooping an' ya might see yourself face to face with one in a dungeon next time!
items.zh: 我不知道你对这些部分有什么计划，但你最好留意其中的一些暗影神奇宝贝。给一个陌生人足够的欢呼，下次你可能会在地牢里看到自己与陌生人面对面！
items.normEn: I dunno what your plans are round these parts, but you'd best keep an eye out for some of them dang ole Shadow Pokémon. Give a stranger enough of a whooping an' ya might see yourself face to face with one in a dungeon next time!

items.en: I ended up getting lost, and then I saw this outfit, and it was the last one they had in stock, so I bought it... Hah...
items.zh: 结果我迷路了，然后我看到了这件衣服，而且是他们最后一件库存了，所以我就买了……哈……
items.normEn: I ended up getting lost, and then I saw this outfit, and it was the last one they had in stock, so I bought it... Hah...

items.en: I feel like there's so much I have to do now... to save Nebby... to save my mother... That's why I'm going to try my hardest! This is my Z-Powered form! Come on! Let's show the world what we can really do!
items.zh: 我觉得我现在有很多事情要做......为了拯救Nebby......为了拯救我的母亲......这就是为什么我要尽我最大的努力！这是我的 Z 动力形态！快点！让我们向世界展示我们真正能做什么！
items.normEn: I feel like there's so much I have to do now... to save Nebby... to save my mother... That's why I'm going to try my hardest! This is my Z-Powered form! Come on! Let's show the world what we can really do!

items.en: I fell behind, but only by an inch.
items.zh: 我落后了，但只落后了一英寸。
items.normEn: I fell behind, but only by an inch.

items.en: I forgive you for chasing me around. I'm going to take some time off with a long vacation on a tropical island! Before I go, though, I'm gonna release Greninja. I think it's best for him to have experiences with other trainers. If you want to see if that could be you, he'll be roaming the region.
items.zh: 我原谅你对我的追赶。我要去热带岛屿度个长假！不过，在我走之前，我要释放Greninja。我认为他最好有其他教练的经验。如果你想看看那人是否是你，他会在该地区漫游。
items.normEn: I forgive you for chasing me around. I'm going to take some time off with a long vacation on a tropical island! Before I go, though, I'm gonna release Greninja. I think it's best for him to have experiences with other trainers. If you want to see if that could be you, he'll be roaming the region.

items.en: I found Detective Pikachu's partner some days ago injured on the side of the road, and have nursed him back to health. I hope this reunion will suffice.
items.zh: 前几天我在路边发现了大侦探皮卡丘的搭档受伤了，并对其进行了护理。我希望这次重聚就足够了。
items.normEn: I found Detective Pikachu's partner some days ago injured on the side of the road, and have nursed him back to health. I hope this reunion will suffice.

items.en: I found it while helping Mallow with her trial. If you want it, you can have it. It's useless to me anyway.
items.zh: 我在帮助马洛进行审判时发现了它。如果你想要它，你就可以拥有它。反正对我来说没什么用。
items.normEn: I found it while helping Mallow with her trial. If you want it, you can have it. It's useless to me anyway.

items.en: I found that while getting back here after helping Ilima in the Verdant Cavern. If you need it, I can give it to you. Here it is. Oh, also Kahuna Olivia told me she found one of these on Akala Island somewhere. Maybe you should go and ask her for it too. She'll probably give it to you as she also doesn't know what it is.
items.zh: 我在翠绿洞穴帮助伊利马后回到这里时发现了这一点。如果你需要的话我可以给你。这里是。哦，卡胡娜·奥利维亚还告诉我她在阿卡拉岛的某个地方发现了其中一个。也许你也应该去问她要。她可能会把它给你，因为她也不知道它是什么。
items.normEn: I found that while getting back here after helping Ilima in the Verdant Cavern. If you need it, I can give it to you. Here it is. Oh, also Kahuna Olivia told me she found one of these on Akala Island somewhere. Maybe you should go and ask her for it too. She'll probably give it to you as she also doesn't know what it is.

items.en: I found this Clone Mewtwo left behind. Can you take care of it?
items.zh: 我发现了这个克隆人超梦留下的东西。你能照顾好它吗？
items.normEn: I found this Clone Mewtwo left behind. Can you take care of it?

items.en: I get it... Facing trials helps you grow close to your team. I think that's absolutely wonderful!
items.zh: 我明白了……面对考验可以帮助你与团队更加亲近。我认为这绝对是美妙的！
items.normEn: I get it... Facing trials helps you grow close to your team. I think that's absolutely wonderful!

items.en: I Got a Few Shiny Voltorb! Oh, Wait...
items.zh: 我有一些闪亮的 Voltorb！哦，等等...
items.normEn: I Got a Few Shiny Voltorb! Oh, Wait...

items.en: I got it! This ought to do the trick.
items.zh: 我得到了它！这应该可以解决问题。
items.normEn: I got it! This ought to do the trick.

items.en: I guess I'm not ready for the Pokémon League if I'm losing to you! Darn it! You watch, though! I'll get tougher and win my way through the Pokémon League! Because I'm going to become the Champion, the toughest Trainer! You'd better not lose to anyone before me!
items.zh: 如果我输给了你，我想我还没有准备好参加神奇宝贝联盟！该死的！不过你看吧！我会变得更加坚强，在宝可梦联盟中取得胜利！因为我要成为冠军，最强的训练家！你最好不要输给我之前的任何人！
items.normEn: I guess I'm not ready for the Pokémon League if I'm losing to you! Darn it! You watch, though! I'll get tougher and win my way through the Pokémon League! Because I'm going to become the Champion, the toughest Trainer! You'd better not lose to anyone before me!

items.en: I had a big suprise when he reached level 20 though!
items.zh: 当他达到20级时，我还是大吃一惊！
items.normEn: I had a big suprise when he reached level 20 though!

items.en: I had fun at the Kalos Power Plant. Of course, we could have generated electricity with Team Flare's technology, too, you know. We just didn't think it justified the cost. To create a world for us and us alone, we have to play it smart, you see.
items.zh: 我在卡洛斯发电厂玩得很开心。当然，我们也可以利用 Flare 团队的技术来发电，你知道的。我们只是认为这不值得付出代价。你看，为了为我们自己创造一个世界，我们必须聪明地行事。
items.normEn: I had fun at the Kalos Power Plant. Of course, we could have generated electricity with Team Flare's technology, too, you know. We just didn't think it justified the cost. To create a world for us and us alone, we have to play it smart, you see.

items.en: I had to be sure. Sure that you're ready for what's coming...
items.zh: 我必须确定。确保您已准备好迎接即将发生的事情......
items.normEn: I had to be sure. Sure that you're ready for what's coming...

items.en: I happen to know that there are some Yellow and Blue Shards in Diglett's Cave. Just look inside the chests!
items.zh: 我碰巧知道迪格利特的洞穴里有一些黄色和蓝色的碎片。只要看看箱子里面就知道了！
items.normEn: I happen to know that there are some Yellow and Blue Shards in Diglett's Cave. Just look inside the chests!

items.en: I hate to admit it, but you win. You're amazing! I'm starting to understand why Suicune was keeping an eye on you. I'm going to keep searching for Suicune. I have a feeling we'll see each other again. See you around!
items.zh: 我不愿意承认，但你赢了。你太棒了！我开始明白为什么水君会盯着你了。我要继续寻找水君。我有预感我们会再次见面。再见！
items.normEn: I hate to admit it, but you win. You're amazing! I'm starting to understand why Suicune was keeping an eye on you. I'm going to keep searching for Suicune. I have a feeling we'll see each other again. See you around!

items.en: I hate to admit it, but... You're a good trainer. Awww. How unlucky. I don't happen to be the one holding the DNA Splicers. I was just buying time for the others to escape. Cheerio, bye-bye, whatever.
items.zh: 我不愿意承认，但是……你是一个很好的教练。噢。多么不幸啊。我恰好不是持有 DNA 拼接器的人。我只是为其他人逃跑争取时间。干杯，再见，无论如何。
items.normEn: I hate to admit it, but... You're a good trainer. Awww. How unlucky. I don't happen to be the one holding the DNA Splicers. I was just buying time for the others to escape. Cheerio, bye-bye, whatever.

items.en: I have a feeling it'll come back here, but it shouldn't be a problem if it can't return to its Eternamax form here, right?
items.zh: 我有预感它会回到这里，但如果它不能在这里恢复到它的永恒形态，那应该不是什么问题，对吧？
items.normEn: I have a feeling it'll come back here, but it shouldn't be a problem if it can't return to its Eternamax form here, right?

items.en: I have a feeling you will put it to great use. You're different from those Team Flare people.
items.zh: 我有预感你会充分利用它。你和那些闪焰队的人不一样。
items.normEn: I have a feeling you will put it to great use. You're different from those Team Flare people.

items.en: I have been helping Professor Burnet explore the Interdream Zone with the help of my Audino.
items.zh: 我一直在我的 Audino 的帮助下帮助伯内特教授探索 Interdream Zone。
items.normEn: I have been helping Professor Burnet explore the Interdream Zone with the help of my Audino.

items.en: I have been investigating the behavior of Kecleon, the Color Swap Pokémon.
items.zh: 我一直在调查变色神奇宝贝 Kecleon 的行为。
items.normEn: I have been investigating the behavior of Kecleon, the Color Swap Pokémon.

items.en: I have been preparing for the Millennium Festival my whole life, and have big plans for the wish-granting powers it possesses.
items.zh: 我一生都在为千禧年做准备，对千禧年的如愿力有着宏伟的计划。
items.normEn: I have been preparing for the Millennium Festival my whole life, and have big plans for the wish-granting powers it possesses.

items.en: I have been seeing a lot of strange activity around the Seafloor Cavern recently. Whirlpools, thunderstorms, and all nature of strange beasts.
items.zh: 最近我在海底洞穴周围看到了很多奇怪的活动。漩涡，雷暴，各种异兽。
items.normEn: I have been seeing a lot of strange activity around the Seafloor Cavern recently. Whirlpools, thunderstorms, and all nature of strange beasts.

items.en: I have been studying Cosmoem and noticed that it needs the light from either the sun or the moon to reach its fullest potential.
items.zh: 我一直在研究 Cosmoem，并注意到它需要来自太阳或月亮的光才能发挥其最大潜力。
items.normEn: I have been studying Cosmoem and noticed that it needs the light from either the sun or the moon to reach its fullest potential.

items.en: I have burned down to nothing! Not even ashes remain! You have earned the VolcanoBadge.
items.zh: 我已经被烧得一无所有了！连骨灰都没有留下！您已获得火山徽章。
items.normEn: I have burned down to nothing! Not even ashes remain! You have earned the VolcanoBadge.

items.en: I have come to this region to search for a Prison Bottle, in which the spirit of a powerful Hoopa is bound.
items.zh: 我来到这个地区是为了寻找一个监狱之瓶，里面束缚着强大的胡帕的灵魂。
items.normEn: I have come to this region to search for a Prison Bottle, in which the spirit of a powerful Hoopa is bound.

items.en: I have discovered that a critical part of any Magikarp training program is pushing other Pokémon around in a field. This form of exercise rounds out the muscle groups and really boosts performance.
items.zh: 我发现鲤鱼王训练计划的一个关键部分就是在田野里推动其他神奇宝贝。这种锻炼形式可以锻炼肌肉群，真正提高运动表现。
items.normEn: I have discovered that a critical part of any Magikarp training program is pushing other Pokémon around in a field. This form of exercise rounds out the muscle groups and really boosts performance.

items.en: I have found what appears to be a crystalline cocoon that contains Jirachi, the Wish Pokémon! I would be honored if you would take this cocoon as thanks for helping me. Legend has it that Jirachi will appear for a trainer who is pure of heart and grant them a wish!
items.zh: 我发现了一个看起来像水晶茧的东西，里面装着愿望神奇宝贝基拉祈！如果您能收下这个茧来感谢您对我的帮助，我将不胜荣幸。传说基拉祈会为心地纯洁的训练家出现，实现他们的愿望！
items.normEn: I have found what appears to be a crystalline cocoon that contains Jirachi, the Wish Pokémon! I would be honored if you would take this cocoon as thanks for helping me. Legend has it that Jirachi will appear for a trainer who is pure of heart and grant them a wish!

items.en: I have heard that Rayquaza once lived high atop the Sky Pillar, maybe that's where it is now?
items.zh: 听说烈空坐曾经住在天柱高处，也许现在就在那里？
items.normEn: I have heard that Rayquaza once lived high atop the Sky Pillar, maybe that's where it is now?

items.en: I have made myself at home here. I hope Glutton can do the same. Please catch this Guzzlord. End this once and for all.
items.zh: 我在这里感到宾至如归。我希望Glutton也能这样做。请抓住这个Guzzlord。一劳永逸地结束这一切。
items.normEn: I have made myself at home here. I hope Glutton can do the same. Please catch this Guzzlord. End this once and for all.

items.en: I have passed on to you all there is to pass. Where history goes from here...I leave to you and your companions to see through.
items.zh: 我已经把要传递的一切都传递给你了。历史将何去何从……就留给你和你的同伴们去看看吧。
items.normEn: I have passed on to you all there is to pass. Where history goes from here...I leave to you and your companions to see through.

items.en: I have reason to believe that a high ranking official in the company is manufacturing this drug, but have been unable to get to the bottom of it myself.
items.zh: 我有理由相信该公司的一位高级官员正在制造这种药物，但我自己一直无法查清真相。
items.normEn: I have reason to believe that a high ranking official in the company is manufacturing this drug, but have been unable to get to the bottom of it myself.

items.en: I have so many Gracidea right now, so i'll sell you one.
items.zh: 我现在有很多格拉西迪亚，所以我就卖给你一只。
items.normEn: I have so many Gracidea right now, so i'll sell you one.

items.en: I have some good news for you though! It seems that those you've already caught will show up less often. That should make it easier to catch 'em all!
items.zh: 不过我有一些好消息要告诉你！看来你已经抓到的那些人会出现得更少了。这应该会让你更容易抓住他们！
items.normEn: I have some good news for you though! It seems that those you've already caught will show up less often. That should make it easier to catch 'em all!

items.en: I have spent weeks finding the perfect fishing spot for Feebas, and finally got some! For a special low price, I'll sell you one!
items.zh: 我花了几周的时间为 Feebas 寻找完美的钓鱼地点，终于找到了一些！我以特别低的价格卖给你一个！
items.normEn: I have spent weeks finding the perfect fishing spot for Feebas, and finally got some! For a special low price, I'll sell you one!

items.en: I have to find one! I just have to!
items.zh: 我必须找到一个！我只得这么做！
items.normEn: I have to find one! I just have to!

items.en: I haven't seen Professor Krane around here, but hopefully this will be of some use to you.
items.zh: 我在这里没有见过克兰教授，但希望这对你有用。
items.normEn: I haven't seen Professor Krane around here, but hopefully this will be of some use to you.

items.en: I hear that when you equip them with powerful Drive devices, they change forms!
items.zh: 听说给它们配备强大的驱动装置后，它们就会改变形态！
items.normEn: I hear that when you equip them with powerful Drive devices, they change forms!

items.en: I hear they are weaker than normal Pokémon but can hold a fancy incense. If you manage to purify their souls, they'll get a wee bit stronger!
items.zh: 我听说它们比普通神奇宝贝弱，但可以持有精美的香。如果你能净化他们的灵魂，他们就会变得更强一些！
items.normEn: I hear they are weaker than normal Pokémon but can hold a fancy incense. If you manage to purify their souls, they'll get a wee bit stronger!

items.en: I hear word of an exotic region on the horizon, but there has been no word yet when the blimp will be able to reach such faraway lands.
items.zh: 我听说地平线上有一个奇异的地区，但目前还没有消息说飞艇何时能够到达如此遥远的土地。
items.normEn: I hear word of an exotic region on the horizon, but there has been no word yet when the blimp will be able to reach such faraway lands.

items.en: I heard from Professor Elm that you had just conquered the Johto Pokémon League! Congratulations!
items.zh: 我听艾尔姆教授说你刚刚征服了城都宝可梦联盟！恭喜！
items.normEn: I heard from Professor Elm that you had just conquered the Johto Pokémon League! Congratulations!

items.en: I heard from Professor Rowan that you had just conquered the Sinnoh Pokémon League! Congratulations!
items.zh: 我听罗文教授说你刚刚征服了神奥神奇宝贝联盟！恭喜！
items.normEn: I heard from Professor Rowan that you had just conquered the Sinnoh Pokémon League! Congratulations!

items.en: I heard he's in Glittering Cave but I also saw some weird guys in orange going there. Will you come with me and check it out?
items.zh: 我听说他在闪闪发光的洞穴里，但我也看到一些奇怪的橙色衣服的家伙去了那里。你能跟我一起去看看吗？
items.normEn: I heard he's in Glittering Cave but I also saw some weird guys in orange going there. Will you come with me and check it out?

items.en: I heard the Pokémon League is crawling with tough Trainers. I have to figure out how to get past them. You should quit dawdling and get a move on!
items.zh: 我听说神奇宝贝联盟里到处都是强硬的训练家。我必须想办法摆脱他们。你应该停止磨磨蹭蹭，继续前进！
items.normEn: I heard the Pokémon League is crawling with tough Trainers. I have to figure out how to get past them. You should quit dawdling and get a move on!

items.en: I heard there was a stone hidden in the Friend Safari that makes Scizor stronger!
items.zh: 听说Friend Safari里藏着一块石头，可以让Scizor变得更强！
items.normEn: I heard there was a stone hidden in the Friend Safari that makes Scizor stronger!

items.en: I heard there was a stone hidden in the Safari Zone that makes Pinsir stronger!
items.zh: 听说野生动物园里藏着一块石头，可以让平西尔变得更强！
items.normEn: I heard there was a stone hidden in the Safari Zone that makes Pinsir stronger!

items.en: I hope they don't come back!
items.normEn: I hope they don't come back!

items.en: I imagine you must be quite shocked. This is a communication mode that Devon is still currently developing. It comes installed on every Holo Caster. I thought I would only use it if I needed to contact you urgently.
items.zh: 我想你一定很震惊。这是Devon目前仍在开发的一种沟通模式。它安装在每个 Holo Caster 上。我以为只有当我需要紧急联系你时我才会使用它。
items.normEn: I imagine you must be quite shocked. This is a communication mode that Devon is still currently developing. It comes installed on every Holo Caster. I thought I would only use it if I needed to contact you urgently.

items.en: I imagine you've noticed some hexagonal rock formations on your journey, right? Those are called Raid Dens. You can find them in the mainland's Wild Area, the Isle of Armor, and here in the Crown Tundra.
items.zh: 我想您在旅途中注意到了一些六边形岩层，对吧？这些被称为袭击巢穴。你可以在大陆的荒野、盔甲岛和皇冠苔原找到它们。
items.normEn: I imagine you've noticed some hexagonal rock formations on your journey, right? Those are called Raid Dens. You can find them in the mainland's Wild Area, the Isle of Armor, and here in the Crown Tundra.

items.en: I implore you to consider what we need to do to change the world into a new, beautiful world!
items.zh: 我恳请您考虑一下我们需要做什么才能将世界变成一个新的、美丽的世界！
items.normEn: I implore you to consider what we need to do to change the world into a new, beautiful world!

items.en: I just want to climb into a hole... Well, I guess it'd be more like falling from here.
items.zh: 我只想爬进洞里……好吧，我想这更像是从这里掉下来。
items.normEn: I just want to climb into a hole... Well, I guess it'd be more like falling from here.

items.en: I just wanted to go for a stroll on my own, to see what it must feel like to be a Trainer... So Hapu and I went our separate ways... but then Nebby tried to get out of my bag...
items.zh: 我只是想自己去散步，看看成为一名训练师的感觉……所以哈普和我分道扬镳……但后来内比试图从我的包里拿出来……
items.normEn: I just wanted to go for a stroll on my own, to see what it must feel like to be a Trainer... So Hapu and I went our separate ways... but then Nebby tried to get out of my bag...

items.en: I knew I smelled something fishy...
items.zh: 我知道我闻到了一股鱼腥味……
items.normEn: I knew I smelled something fishy...

items.en: I knew it! I knew that Celebi was in there! Well, I didn't actually know. I had a feeling.
items.zh: 我就知道！我知道雪拉比就在那里！好吧，我其实不知道。我有一种感觉。
items.normEn: I knew it! I knew that Celebi was in there! Well, I didn't actually know. I had a feeling.

items.en: I know a lot of useful stuff. Like the odds of finding a shiny Pokémon or how to increase Click Attack.
items.zh: 我知道很多有用的东西。比如找到闪亮神奇宝贝的几率或如何增加点击攻击力。
items.normEn: I know a lot of useful stuff. Like the odds of finding a shiny Pokémon or how to increase Click Attack.

items.en: I know just the man for the job! Kurt, a Poké Ball expert. He lives in Azalea Town, in Johto. Please deliver the GS Ball to him.
items.zh: 我认识最适合这份工作的人！库尔特，精灵球专家。他住在城都县的杜鹃花町。请把GS球交给他。
items.normEn: I know just the man for the job! Kurt, a Poké Ball expert. He lives in Azalea Town, in Johto. Please deliver the GS Ball to him.

items.en: I know not why these three have chosen to show themselves. Perhaps the cause lies with the space-time rift...or simply within their own whims...
items.zh: 我不知道这三个人为什么选择展示自己。或许是时空裂缝……或者只是他们自己的一时兴起……
items.normEn: I know not why these three have chosen to show themselves. Perhaps the cause lies with the space-time rift...or simply within their own whims...

items.en: I know that reckless one, Linoone, will only evolve during the night time here. But, I also think I’ve seen its evolution wandering across the lake if you have a way to cross.
items.zh: 我知道，鲁莽的利诺涅，只会在夜间进化。但是，我也认为我已经看到了它在湖上徘徊的演变，如果你有办法穿越的话。
items.normEn: I know that reckless one, Linoone, will only evolve during the night time here. But, I also think I’ve seen its evolution wandering across the lake if you have a way to cross.

items.en: I know the Plusle you're looking for, it got taken by the infamous dance machine, Miror B.
items.zh: 我知道你要找的 Plusle，它被臭名昭著的舞蹈机器 Miror B 拿走了。
items.normEn: I know the Plusle you're looking for, it got taken by the infamous dance machine, Miror B.

items.en: I know... I know... It's tiny... But raise it with diligence, and it'll become strong enough to see you through any battle, just like a suit of armor. No opponent will be able to get past it!
items.zh: 我知道……我知道……它很小……但只要勤奋地养大它，它就会变得足够强大，可以帮助你度过任何战斗，就像一套盔甲一样。没有任何对手能够突破它！
items.normEn: I know... I know... It's tiny... But raise it with diligence, and it'll become strong enough to see you through any battle, just like a suit of armor. No opponent will be able to get past it!

items.en: I let myself in. Hope you don't mind.
items.zh: 我自己进去了。希望你不要介意。
items.normEn: I let myself in. Hope you don't mind.

items.en: I like Pokémon but I'm not as knowledgeable as my grandson. My grandson Bill told me about a Pokémon that is pink and like a balloon.
items.zh: 我喜欢神奇宝贝，但我的知识不如我的孙子。我的孙子比尔告诉我有一种神奇宝贝，它是粉红色的，像气球一样。
items.normEn: I like Pokémon but I'm not as knowledgeable as my grandson. My grandson Bill told me about a Pokémon that is pink and like a balloon.

items.en: I like sneaking snacks inside the Battle Royal Dome. One time I snuck in pancakes and there were two trainers from Kanto who both had a Pikachu. I ended up sharing some with one.
items.zh: 我喜欢在皇家圆顶之战中偷偷吃零食。有一次我偷偷溜进煎饼，发现有两个来自关东的训练师，他们都有一只皮卡丘。我最终与一个人分享了一些。
items.normEn: I like sneaking snacks inside the Battle Royal Dome. One time I snuck in pancakes and there were two trainers from Kanto who both had a Pikachu. I ended up sharing some with one.

items.en: I lost because of my karpal tunnel...
items.zh: 我因为卡巴隧道而输了...
items.normEn: I lost because of my karpal tunnel...

items.en: I lost with the most beautiful and toughest of the bug Pokémon... We lost because I wasn't good enough... That's it! Back to training camp! Let's hear it for me! No... That was wrong... Anyway... Go on to the next room! Three Trainers are waiting for you. They are all tougher than me.
items.zh: 我输给了最美丽、最难对付的虫子神奇宝贝……我们输了，因为我不够好……就是这样！回到训练营！给我听听吧！不……那是错误的……总之……去隔壁房间吧！三位训练师正在等你。他们都比我坚强。
items.normEn: I lost with the most beautiful and toughest of the bug Pokémon... We lost because I wasn't good enough... That's it! Back to training camp! Let's hear it for me! No... That was wrong... Anyway... Go on to the next room! Three Trainers are waiting for you. They are all tougher than me.

items.en: I love cats very much, but dogs aren't so bad either.
items.zh: 我非常喜欢猫，但狗也不错。
items.normEn: I love cats very much, but dogs aren't so bad either.

items.en: I love Oricorio. I can tell you all about it!
items.zh: 我爱奥里科里奥。我可以告诉你一切！
items.normEn: I love Oricorio. I can tell you all about it!

items.en: I love shopping! When I come in, the cashiers know I want tons of items.
items.zh: 我喜欢购物！当我进来时，收银员知道我想要很多东西。
items.normEn: I love shopping! When I come in, the cashiers know I want tons of items.

items.en: I love Sweet and Tart Apples! Oh, this is Applin! He isn’t a snack, but helps me make all sorts of dishes!
items.zh: 我喜欢甜又酸的苹果！哦，这是阿普林！他不是零食，却帮我做各种菜！
items.normEn: I love Sweet and Tart Apples! Oh, this is Applin! He isn’t a snack, but helps me make all sorts of dishes!

items.en: I may proudly be the strongest member of this Gym, but I was totally washed away!
items.zh: 我可能自豪地成为这个道馆最强的成员，但我完全被冲垮了！
items.normEn: I may proudly be the strongest member of this Gym, but I was totally washed away!

items.en: I might have lost, but I still look good. Maybe I should snap a quick selfie...
items.zh: 我可能输了，但我看起来仍然很好。也许我应该快速拍一张自拍照……
items.normEn: I might have lost, but I still look good. Maybe I should snap a quick selfie...

items.en: I might've said it before, but you're really tough! Wasn't it hard for you to raise your Pokémon to be so good? I guess that's a measure of how much you love your Pokémon. In recognition of that, I proudly grant you this!"
items.zh: 我之前可能已经说过了，但你真的很坚强！你把自己的神奇宝贝养到这么优秀不是很难吗？我想这可以衡量你有多爱你的神奇宝贝。为了认识到这一点，我自豪地授予你这个！”
items.normEn: I might've said it before, but you're really tough! Wasn't it hard for you to raise your Pokémon to be so good? I guess that's a measure of how much you love your Pokémon. In recognition of that, I proudly grant you this!"

items.en: I MUST find a Sail Fossil! Nothing will get in the way of making my sunshine happy! She's taught me that anything is possible with the power of love!
items.zh: 我一定要找到风帆化石！没有什么能阻止我的阳光快乐！她教会了我，只要有爱的力量，一切皆有可能！
items.normEn: I MUST find a Sail Fossil! Nothing will get in the way of making my sunshine happy! She's taught me that anything is possible with the power of love!

items.en: I must find one! I simply must!
items.zh: 我一定要找到一个！我就是必须！
items.normEn: I must find one! I simply must!

items.en: I need to find more sunken treasures...
items.zh: 我需要找到更多沉没的宝藏......
items.normEn: I need to find more sunken treasures...

items.en: I need your assistance in learning more about the newly discovered Pokémon that has really sent me and other Pokémon researchers into quite a tizzy.
items.zh: 我需要你的帮助来了解更多关于新发现的神奇宝贝的信息，这确实让我和其他神奇宝贝研究人员感到非常兴奋。
items.normEn: I need your assistance in learning more about the newly discovered Pokémon that has really sent me and other Pokémon researchers into quite a tizzy.

items.en: I once read that, deep within the Distortion World, there is an object capable of carrying the realm's power. Maybe, if you train Giratina while it has such object equipped, it can turn into its true form.
items.zh: 我曾经读到过，在扭曲世界的深处，有一个物体能够承载领域的力量。也许，如果你在骑拉帝纳装备了这种物品的情况下对其进行训练，它就可以变成它的真实形态。
items.normEn: I once read that, deep within the Distortion World, there is an object capable of carrying the realm's power. Maybe, if you train Giratina while it has such object equipped, it can turn into its true form.

items.en: I once reigned over these lands as king, but now I have lost all but a fraction of my former strength. Even my loyal steeds have abandoned me.
items.zh: 我曾经作为国王统治着这片土地，但现在我已经失去了以前的力量，只剩下一小部分。就连我忠实的战马也抛弃了我。
items.normEn: I once reigned over these lands as king, but now I have lost all but a fraction of my former strength. Even my loyal steeds have abandoned me.

items.en: I only brought enough Quest Points for one Soothe Bell. It's so hard to choose...
items.zh: 我只带了足够购买一台安抚铃的任务点。真是太难选择了...
items.normEn: I only brought enough Quest Points for one Soothe Bell. It's so hard to choose...

items.en: I promise you, we will obtain useful information about those sinister Pokémon. While we do so, I heartily recommend that you visit our Stadium, the symbol of our civic pride!
items.zh: 我向你保证，我们会获得有关那些险恶的神奇宝贝的有用信息。在我们这样做的同时，我衷心建议您参观我们的体育场，它是我们公民自豪感的象征！
items.normEn: I promise you, we will obtain useful information about those sinister Pokémon. While we do so, I heartily recommend that you visit our Stadium, the symbol of our civic pride!

items.en: I really appreciate being able to see your outstanding progress, thank you! Sinnoh is next up.
items.zh: 非常感谢能够看到您的进步，谢谢！接下来是神奥。
items.normEn: I really appreciate being able to see your outstanding progress, thank you! Sinnoh is next up.

items.en: I really do wish I could have seen the Championship Match between you two. And I'm terribly sorry to have ruined the whole Gym Challenge and everything!
items.zh: 我真的希望我能看到你们两个之间的冠军赛。我非常抱歉毁了整个健身房挑战赛和一切！
items.normEn: I really do wish I could have seen the Championship Match between you two. And I'm terribly sorry to have ruined the whole Gym Challenge and everything!

items.en: I recently traded with my friend Mindy expecting to get a Gengar. Instead, her Haunter came with this useless rock! I can't believe she would do this to me!
items.zh: 我最近和我的朋友 Mindy 进行交易，希望得到 Gengar。相反，她的鬼魂带着这块没用的石头来了！我不敢相信她会这样对我！
items.normEn: I recently traded with my friend Mindy expecting to get a Gengar. Instead, her Haunter came with this useless rock! I can't believe she would do this to me!

items.en: I remember the battle I had with you on Route 103. That battle helped you become this strong, didn't it?
items.zh: 我记得在103号公路上和你的那场战斗，那场战斗让你变得如此强大，不是吗？
items.normEn: I remember the battle I had with you on Route 103. That battle helped you become this strong, didn't it?

items.en: I remember, back in the day, it was the Guardian of Ilex Forest. It was a playful Pokémon. It loved playing with children.
items.zh: 我记得，当年，是冬青林的守护者。这是一只顽皮的神奇宝贝。它喜欢和孩​​子们一起玩。
items.normEn: I remember, back in the day, it was the Guardian of Ilex Forest. It was a playful Pokémon. It loved playing with children.

items.en: I repeat. We will use the ultimate weapon and wipe the slate clean. I'm sorry, those of you who are not members of Team Flare, but this is adieu to you all.
items.zh: 我重复一遍。我们将使用终极武器，将历史抹去。很抱歉，你们中的一些人不是 Flare 团队的成员，但这是对你们所有人的告别。
items.normEn: I repeat. We will use the ultimate weapon and wipe the slate clean. I'm sorry, those of you who are not members of Team Flare, but this is adieu to you all.

items.en: I saw it! Did you see it?! I saw you go in there! I don't know what you did in the Burned Tower, but three great Beasts came running out of there!
items.zh: 我看到了！你看到了吗？！我看见你进去了！我不知道你在焚毁塔里做了什么，但是三头巨兽从那里跑了出来！
items.normEn: I saw it! Did you see it?! I saw you go in there! I don't know what you did in the Burned Tower, but three great Beasts came running out of there!

items.en: I saw my partner liked it a lot! Maybe you should try the same one day!
items.zh: 我看到我的伙伴非常喜欢它！也许有一天你应该尝试同样的事情！
items.normEn: I saw my partner liked it a lot! Maybe you should try the same one day!

items.en: I see now... Poké Balls are simply your tool of choice, not products of disregard for Pokémon. You still understand the Pokémon and trust them as partners. I feel better putting my trust in you now, I think.
items.zh: 我现在明白了……神奇宝贝球只是你选择的工具，而不是忽视神奇宝贝的产物。您仍然了解神奇宝贝并信任它们作为合作伙伴。我想我现在更信任你了。
items.normEn: I see now... Poké Balls are simply your tool of choice, not products of disregard for Pokémon. You still understand the Pokémon and trust them as partners. I feel better putting my trust in you now, I think.

items.en: I see that you raise Pokémon with utmost care. A child like you would never understand what I hope to achieve. I shall step aside this time! I hope we meet again...
items.zh: 我看到你非常用心地抚养神奇宝贝。像你这样的孩子永远不会理解我希望实现什么。这次我就退到一边去吧！我希望我们能再次见面...
items.normEn: I see that you raise Pokémon with utmost care. A child like you would never understand what I hope to achieve. I shall step aside this time! I hope we meet again...

items.en: I see you are carrying a Gem Case. Here at the museum we study space, fossils and gems!
items.zh: 我看到你带着一个宝石盒。在博物馆，我们研究太空、化石和宝石！
items.normEn: I see you are carrying a Gem Case. Here at the museum we study space, fossils and gems!

items.en: I see you can be trusted with the mysteries of the sea!
items.zh: 我发现你可以相信海洋的奥秘！
items.normEn: I see you can be trusted with the mysteries of the sea!

items.en: I see you've recovered more of the Silvally Memories. Thanks for helping me recover them. Silvally appreciates it too. How did it go, getting them back?
items.zh: 我发现你已经恢复了更多的希尔瓦利记忆。感谢您帮助我恢复它们。西尔瓦利也很欣赏这一点。把他们带回来，进展如何？
items.normEn: I see you've recovered more of the Silvally Memories. Thanks for helping me recover them. Silvally appreciates it too. How did it go, getting them back?

items.en: I see... Well, that's fine. I wasn't really trying all that hard anyway.
items.zh: 我明白了……嗯，没关系。无论如何，我并没有真的那么努力。
items.normEn: I see... Well, that's fine. I wasn't really trying all that hard anyway.

items.en: I seem to have lost my way in the forest. Can you show me the way out?
items.zh: 我好像在森林里迷了路。你能告诉我出去的路吗？
items.normEn: I seem to have lost my way in the forest. Can you show me the way out?

items.en: I sense the presence of rare Pokémon at the {ROUTE_NAME}! Hurry, before the fates intervene!
items.zh: 我感觉到{ROUTE_NAME}上有稀有神奇宝贝！快点，在命运干预之前！
items.normEn: I sense the presence of rare Pokémon at the {ROUTE_NAME}! Hurry, before the fates intervene!

items.en: I sent my husband to buy tickets for the aquarium but it was all a ploy to get some alone time so I can find him a Pokémon fossil found only here in Kalos!
items.zh: 我派我丈夫去买水族馆的门票，但这完全是一个策略，我想获得一些独处的时间，这样我就可以给他找到一块只有在卡洛斯发现的神奇宝贝化石！
items.normEn: I sent my husband to buy tickets for the aquarium but it was all a ploy to get some alone time so I can find him a Pokémon fossil found only here in Kalos!

items.en: I shall forget that I ever battled with you. Yes, that's what I'll do. Ohohohoh!
items.zh: 我会忘记我曾与你战斗过。是的，这就是我要做的。噢噢噢！
items.normEn: I shall forget that I ever battled with you. Yes, that's what I'll do. Ohohohoh!

items.en: I shall store my memory of you and your Pokémon forever away within my heart.
items.zh: 我会把关于你和你的神奇宝贝的记忆永远储存在我的心里。
items.normEn: I shall store my memory of you and your Pokémon forever away within my heart.

items.en: I Should Buy a Poké Mart
items.zh: 我应该买一个 Poké Mart
items.normEn: I Should Buy a Poké Mart

items.en: I Should Open My Own Pokémon Center
items.zh: 我应该开设自己的神奇宝贝中心
items.normEn: I Should Open My Own Pokémon Center

items.en: I should tell you, Dada is much stronger than the rest of the Zarude. Have a good fight, both of you!
items.zh: 我应该告诉你，达达比其他扎鲁德人要强大得多。祝你们俩好好战斗！
items.normEn: I should tell you, Dada is much stronger than the rest of the Zarude. Have a good fight, both of you!

items.en: I shouldn't have done something this strenuous right after eating… I'll need to get some new Shadow Pokémon from Team Snagem.
items.zh: 我不应该在吃完饭后就做这么费力的事情……我需要从 Snagem 团队那里得到一些新的暗影神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: I shouldn't have done something this strenuous right after eating… I'll need to get some new Shadow Pokémon from Team Snagem.

items.en: I spotted a bunch of roaming Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}!
items.zh: 我在 {ROUTE_NAME} 上发现了一群漫游的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: I spotted a bunch of roaming Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}!

items.en: I still can't even beat you, my true rival... But I think I'm starting to see the light!
items.zh: 我仍然无法击败你，我真正的对手……但我想我已经开始看到曙光了！
items.normEn: I still can't even beat you, my true rival... But I think I'm starting to see the light!

items.en: I subjected you to everything I could muster. But my efforts failed. I must hone my skills. Go on to the next room, and put your abilities to the test!
items.zh: 我让你尽我所能。但我的努力失败了。我必须磨练我的技能。前往下一个房间，测试一下你的能力！
items.normEn: I subjected you to everything I could muster. But my efforts failed. I must hone my skills. Go on to the next room, and put your abilities to the test!

items.en: I sure do love candy. The rarer, the better!
items.zh: 我确实很喜欢糖果。越稀有越好！
items.normEn: I sure do love candy. The rarer, the better!

items.en: I swapped out some of my Proteins for the new Vitamins, but then I was left with a bunch of extra Protein I couldn't use.
items.zh: 我用一些蛋白质换成了新的维生素，但后来我留下了一堆我无法使用的额外蛋白质。
items.normEn: I swapped out some of my Proteins for the new Vitamins, but then I was left with a bunch of extra Protein I couldn't use.

items.en: I think Eevee is gonna be better with you than with me. I'm sure that, with you, Eevee is gonna grow up healthy and strong!
items.zh: 我认为伊布和你在一起比和我在一起会更好。我相信，有你在，伊布一定会健康强壮地成长！
items.normEn: I think Eevee is gonna be better with you than with me. I'm sure that, with you, Eevee is gonna grow up healthy and strong!

items.en: I think Eternatus absorbed the leftover power it used to transform the first time to do so again. There's none left now, though, so that should be the last time. It flew south...
items.zh: 我认为永恒号吸收了第一次改造时剩余的力量，以便再次进行改造。不过现在已经没有了，所以这应该是最后一次了。它向南飞去...
items.normEn: I think Eternatus absorbed the leftover power it used to transform the first time to do so again. There's none left now, though, so that should be the last time. It flew south...

items.en: I think I know what's in there... Better give Oak a call.
items.zh: 我想我知道里面有什么...最好给奥克打电话。
items.normEn: I think I know what's in there... Better give Oak a call.

items.en: I think I’ll have to look more into the history of the Slumbering Weald.
items.zh: 我想我必须更多地研究沉睡原野的历史。
items.normEn: I think I’ll have to look more into the history of the Slumbering Weald.

items.en: I think I've seen that stone before - it was on a book of an old legend about the sea.
items.zh: 我想我以前见过那块石头——它出现在一本关于海洋的古老传说的书中。
items.normEn: I think I've seen that stone before - it was on a book of an old legend about the sea.

items.en: I think it went something like... "When the Prince of the Seas is born, all of his kin will come to this region to celebrate."
items.zh: 我觉得大概是这样的……“当海洋王子出生时，他所有的亲戚都会来到这个地区庆祝。”
items.normEn: I think it went something like... "When the Prince of the Seas is born, all of his kin will come to this region to celebrate."

items.en: I think it's time I brought about the Darkest Day. For the sake of Galar's future, of course!
items.zh: 我想是时候带来“至暗之日”了。当然是为了伽勒尔的未来！
items.normEn: I think it's time I brought about the Darkest Day. For the sake of Galar's future, of course!

items.en: I think Nebby might be interested in visiting the Ruins of Life. Apparently they house the sacred guardian of Akala Island. I wondered if you'd like to come with us when we go to visit the ruins. I'll be here if you decide you want to come.
items.zh: 我想内比可能有兴趣参观生命废墟。显然，他们居住着阿卡拉岛的神圣守护者。我想知道我们去参观遗址时你是否愿意和我们一起去。如果你决定要来的话我会在这里。
items.normEn: I think Nebby might be interested in visiting the Ruins of Life. Apparently they house the sacred guardian of Akala Island. I wondered if you'd like to come with us when we go to visit the ruins. I'll be here if you decide you want to come.

items.en: I think that would be for the best. Once you capture them, I would appreciate it if you could bring them to the Crown Shrine at the mountain's peak.
items.zh: 我认为那是最好的。一旦你捕获了他们，如果你能将他们带到山顶的皇冠神社，我将不胜感激。
items.normEn: I think that would be for the best. Once you capture them, I would appreciate it if you could bring them to the Crown Shrine at the mountain's peak.

items.en: I think they should all be weakened enough that you can catch 'em now!
items.zh: 我认为他们都应该被削弱到你​​现在就可以抓住他们了！
items.normEn: I think they should all be weakened enough that you can catch 'em now!

items.en: I think you took breaking the ice a little too literally...
items.zh: 我觉得你把打破僵局看得有点太字面意思了……
items.normEn: I think you took breaking the ice a little too literally...

items.en: I thought that friendship was all Snom needed to evolve, but I kept trying to give it a Soothe Bell during the day and nothing happened!
items.zh: 我以为 Snom 进化所需的全部就是友谊，但白天我一直试图给它敲响安抚铃，但什么也没发生！
items.normEn: I thought that friendship was all Snom needed to evolve, but I kept trying to give it a Soothe Bell during the day and nothing happened!

items.en: I thought... But I'm supposed to be the one who saves the world...
items.zh: 我以为……但我应该是拯救世界的人……
items.normEn: I thought... But I'm supposed to be the one who saves the world...

items.en: I told my wife I was going buy tickets for the aquarium in the town back there but little did she know it was a white lie so I could search for a Pokémon fossil found only here in Kalos!
items.zh: 我告诉我的妻子我要去那里买镇上水族馆的门票，但她几乎不知道这是一个善意的谎言，这样我就可以寻找只在卡洛斯发现的神奇宝贝化石！
items.normEn: I told my wife I was going buy tickets for the aquarium in the town back there but little did she know it was a white lie so I could search for a Pokémon fossil found only here in Kalos!

items.en: I told you. There's nothing suspicious going on here. We aren't stealing any Pokémon.
items.zh: 我告诉你了。这里没有什么可疑的事情发生。我们不会偷任何神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: I told you. There's nothing suspicious going on here. We aren't stealing any Pokémon.

items.en: I took you for granted, and so I lost. As proof of your victory, I confer on you this... the official Pokémon League BoulderBadge.
items.zh: 我把你视为理所当然，所以我输了。作为你胜利的证明，我授予你这个……官方的神奇宝贝联盟 BoulderBadge。
items.normEn: I took you for granted, and so I lost. As proof of your victory, I confer on you this... the official Pokémon League BoulderBadge.

items.en: I traveled here all the way from Goldenrod to buy a Soothe Bell for my Eevee.
items.zh: 我从 Goldenrod 一路来到这里，为我的 Eevee 买了一个 Soothe Bell。
items.normEn: I traveled here all the way from Goldenrod to buy a Soothe Bell for my Eevee.

items.en: I tried to capture it, but it barrelled right through my Capture Disc's trail! It went for Hearthome City. It wasn't showing any signs of slowing down yet.
items.zh: 我试图捕捉它，但它径直穿过我的捕捉光盘的踪迹！它去了心家城。目前还没有显示出任何放缓的迹象。
items.normEn: I tried to capture it, but it barrelled right through my Capture Disc's trail! It went for Hearthome City. It wasn't showing any signs of slowing down yet.

items.en: I understand your concern, though. I will order an investigation at once.
items.zh: 不过我理解你的担忧。我会立即下令进行调查。
items.normEn: I understand your concern, though. I will order an investigation at once.

items.en: I used to have my Pokémon maxed out on Protein, but then I found out about the new Vitamins!
items.zh: 我曾经让我的神奇宝贝蛋白质含量达到极限，但后来我发现了新的维生素！
items.normEn: I used to have my Pokémon maxed out on Protein, but then I found out about the new Vitamins!

items.en: I Want To Be Ready for the Next Region
items.zh: 我想为下一个地区做好准备
items.normEn: I Want To Be Ready for the Next Region

items.en: I want to be the kind of person who gives... But in this world, some foolish humans exist who would show their strength by taking what isn't theirs. They're filth!
items.zh: 我想成为那种给予的人……但是，在这个世界上，存在着一些愚蠢的人类，他们会通过夺取不属于自己的东西来显示自己的力量。他们是肮脏的！
items.normEn: I want to be the kind of person who gives... But in this world, some foolish humans exist who would show their strength by taking what isn't theirs. They're filth!

items.en: I want to help my brother! I've got to! But I can't even manage to beat you, so what sort of help could I ever be...?
items.zh: 我想帮助我的兄弟！我必须这么做！但我连打败你都做不到，那我还能帮什么忙呢……？
items.normEn: I want to help my brother! I've got to! But I can't even manage to beat you, so what sort of help could I ever be...?

items.en: I want to tell you more, but first you must prove you are worthy.
items.zh: 我想告诉你更多，但首先你必须证明你是值得的。
items.normEn: I want to tell you more, but first you must prove you are worthy.

items.en: I want you to have this Pokémon for saving us.
items.zh: 我希望你拥有这只神奇宝贝来拯救我们。
items.normEn: I want you to have this Pokémon for saving us.

items.en: I was concerned so I ascended. And what do I find but the Legendary Pokémon... and a strange hole in the sky.
items.zh: 我很担心，所以我就上去了。除了传说中的神奇宝贝……和天空中一个奇怪的洞之外，我还能找到什么呢？
items.normEn: I was concerned so I ascended. And what do I find but the Legendary Pokémon... and a strange hole in the sky.

items.en: I was doing some exploring in Mt. Coronet last week, and my Nosepass gained a lot of levels.
items.zh: 上周我在皇冠山进行了一些探索，我的Nosepass提升了很多等级。
items.normEn: I was doing some exploring in Mt. Coronet last week, and my Nosepass gained a lot of levels.

items.en: I was just finishing up my shift at the Café Cabin when a little pink puffball ran past! It was heading south, for the ruins down there.
items.zh: 我刚刚在咖啡厅下班，这时一只粉红色的小马勃跑了过来！它正在向南行驶，前往那里的废墟。
items.normEn: I was just finishing up my shift at the Café Cabin when a little pink puffball ran past! It was heading south, for the ruins down there.

items.en: I was just minding my own business, when a little pink thing knocked me right over! By the time I got up, it was long gone, racing for the Eterna Forest.
items.zh: 我正忙着自己的事，突然一个粉红色的小东西把我撞倒了！当我起身时，它早已消失，正在向永恒森林飞驰而去。
items.normEn: I was just minding my own business, when a little pink thing knocked me right over! By the time I got up, it was long gone, racing for the Eterna Forest.

items.en: I was just watching my favorite show, The National Gymquirer. It was a live segment! Some hot shot trainer from Kanto defeated Drayden! It was amazing! That trainer is so cool! Drayden is like unbeatable.
items.zh: 我刚刚在看我最喜欢的节目《国家健身询问者》。这是一个现场片段！来自关东的热门训练家击败了德雷登！太棒了！那个教练太帅了！德雷登就像是无与伦比的。
items.normEn: I was just watching my favorite show, The National Gymquirer. It was a live segment! Some hot shot trainer from Kanto defeated Drayden! It was amazing! That trainer is so cool! Drayden is like unbeatable.

items.en: I was robbed in the forest to the north. Please, you have to hurry!
items.zh: 我在北边的森林里被抢劫了。拜托，你一定要快点！
items.normEn: I was robbed in the forest to the north. Please, you have to hurry!

items.en: I was robbed of a precious Pokémon Egg by the Go-Rock Squad! The egg was coloured a transparent blue...  Like the colour of the sea!
items.zh: 我被摇滚小队抢走了珍贵的神奇宝贝蛋！蛋的颜色是透明的蓝色……就像大海的颜色！
items.normEn: I was robbed of a precious Pokémon Egg by the Go-Rock Squad! The egg was coloured a transparent blue... Like the colour of the sea!

items.en: I was so impressed by your toughness! Because you are so tough, I'll let you be the first member in my fan club! Doesn't that so make your day?
items.zh: 你的坚强给我留下了深刻的印象！因为你这么厉害，我就让你成为我粉丝俱乐部的第一位会员！这不是让你很高兴吗？
items.normEn: I was so impressed by your toughness! Because you are so tough, I'll let you be the first member in my fan club! Doesn't that so make your day?

items.en: I was thinking, Bill told me about a Pokémon that is very loyal to its trainer. It's supposed to roar well.
items.zh: 我在想，比尔告诉我有一种对训练师非常忠诚的神奇宝贝。应该会很好地咆哮。
items.normEn: I was thinking, Bill told me about a Pokémon that is very loyal to its trainer. It's supposed to roar well.

items.en: I was worried its trainer had lost it, so I came here to ask around. I hope you catch up to it soon.
items.zh: 我担心它的训练师把它弄丢了，就来这里打听。我希望你能尽快赶上它。
items.normEn: I was worried its trainer had lost it, so I came here to ask around. I hope you catch up to it soon.

items.en: I will beat you next time! Any fin is possible if you believe in it!
items.zh: 下次我一定会打败你的！只要你相信，任何鳍都是可能的！
items.normEn: I will beat you next time! Any fin is possible if you believe in it!

items.en: I WILL find a Jaw Fossil! Nothing will get in the way of seeing my booboo's smile! Anything is possible with the power of love! And don't you forget that either!
items.zh: 我会找到下巴化石！没有什么可以妨碍看到我的宝贝的微笑！有了爱的力量，一切皆有可能！你也不要忘记这一点！
items.normEn: I WILL find a Jaw Fossil! Nothing will get in the way of seeing my booboo's smile! Anything is possible with the power of love! And don't you forget that either!

items.en: I will jump away from this battle!
items.normEn: I will jump away from this battle!

items.en: I will need some time to figure this out. Please come back later.
items.zh: 我需要一些时间来解决这个问题。请稍后再回来。
items.normEn: I will need some time to figure this out. Please come back later.

items.en: I will suggest that you only do 3 spins a day if you don’t want to end up sick! You might be able to try more, when you get more experienced with a flavour...
items.zh: 如果您不想生病，我建议您每天只旋转 3 次！当你对某种口味更有经验时，你也许可以尝试更多……
items.normEn: I will suggest that you only do 3 spins a day if you don’t want to end up sick! You might be able to try more, when you get more experienced with a flavour...

items.en: I wish a Pidgeotto would steal me away about now...
items.zh: 我希望现在有一只比比鸟能把我偷走……
items.normEn: I wish a Pidgeotto would steal me away about now...

items.en: I Wonder How Much Is Down There...
items.normEn: I Wonder How Much Is Down There...

items.en: I wonder what you'll feel the next time you find one.
items.zh: 我想知道下次你找到它时会有什么感觉。
items.normEn: I wonder what you'll feel the next time you find one.

items.en: I wonder why that is? Maybe it doesn't work during the day?
items.zh: 我想知道这是为什么？也许白天不工作？
items.normEn: I wonder why that is? Maybe it doesn't work during the day?

items.en: I wonder... Are there people even stronger than you out in the world, with Pokémon stronger than yours? I'll just have to find out for myself I suppose! Here! The treasure I promised you.
items.zh: 我想知道……这世界上还有比你更强的人吗，还有比你更强的神奇宝贝吗？我想我必须亲自找出答案！这里！我答应给你的宝藏。
items.normEn: I wonder... Are there people even stronger than you out in the world, with Pokémon stronger than yours? I'll just have to find out for myself I suppose! Here! The treasure I promised you.

items.en: I work as Professor Kukui's assistant. He's told me to show you around the island, so come along now.
items.zh: 我是库库伊教授的助手。他让我带你环岛一周，所以现在就跟来吧。
items.normEn: I work as Professor Kukui's assistant. He's told me to show you around the island, so come along now.

items.en: I worry it might attack the city out of fear.
items.zh: 我担心它可能会出于恐惧而袭击这座城市。
items.normEn: I worry it might attack the city out of fear.

items.en: I would ask you to go, but I'm sure you're really busy either dealing with Team Flare or the Pokémon League challenge.
items.zh: 我想邀请你去，但我确信你真的很忙，要么忙于处理耀斑队，要么忙于神奇宝贝联盟的挑战。
items.normEn: I would ask you to go, but I'm sure you're really busy either dealing with Team Flare or the Pokémon League challenge.

items.en: I would go myself, but I promised one of the students here a battle and I don't want to bail on them. Would you be able to go for me?
items.zh: 我本来想自己去，但我向这里的一名学生承诺一场战斗，我不想放弃他们。你能去接我吗？
items.normEn: I would go myself, but I promised one of the students here a battle and I don't want to bail on them. Would you be able to go for me?

items.en: I would really like to meet one, can you stop by if you capture one, please?
items.zh: 我真的很想见见一个，如果你抓到一个，可以过来吗？
items.normEn: I would really like to meet one, can you stop by if you capture one, please?

items.en: I, the Champion, fall in defeat… That was wonderful work. You were elegant, infuriatingly so. And yet it was utterly glorious! Kudos to you! You are a truly noble Pokémon Trainer!
items.zh: 我，冠军，失败了……那真是太棒了。你优雅得令人恼火。但它却是极其荣耀的！向你致敬！你是一位真正高贵的神奇宝贝训练家！
items.normEn: I, the Champion, fall in defeat… That was wonderful work. You were elegant, infuriatingly so. And yet it was utterly glorious! Kudos to you! You are a truly noble Pokémon Trainer!

items.en: I, the Great Butler, thank you for all of your help in fulfilling my greatest wish!
items.zh: 我，大管家，感谢你们为我实现最大的愿望所提供的一切帮助！
items.normEn: I, the Great Butler, thank you for all of your help in fulfilling my greatest wish!

items.en: I, the Great Butler, thank you for dealing with Team Rocket!
items.zh: 我大管家，谢谢你对付火箭队！
items.normEn: I, the Great Butler, thank you for dealing with Team Rocket!

items.en: I, the Great Butler, thank you for saving me from the wrath of Meta Groudon.
items.zh: 我，大管家，感谢您将我从梅塔·固拉多的愤怒中拯救出来。
items.normEn: I, the Great Butler, thank you for saving me from the wrath of Meta Groudon.

items.en: I... I'm not crying. That's enough about me! You're going to keep looking for exotic Pokémon, right? I wish you the best of luck!
items.zh: 我……我没有哭。我就够了！你会继续寻找奇异的神奇宝贝，对吗？祝您好运！
items.normEn: I... I'm not crying. That's enough about me! You're going to keep looking for exotic Pokémon, right? I wish you the best of luck!

items.en: I...I've been wanting to thank you for saving Nebby that day. Back then I was so desperate... It hasn't all been easy... but I'm really glad that I came to Alola! I've decided I'm going to become a real Trainer and meet all kinds of wonderful Pokémon!
items.zh: 我……我一直想感谢你那天救了内比。那时候我很绝望……这一切并不容易……但我真的很高兴我来到了阿罗拉！我决定要成为一名真正的训练家，去认识各种奇妙的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: I...I've been wanting to thank you for saving Nebby that day. Back then I was so desperate... It hasn't all been easy... but I'm really glad that I came to Alola! I've decided I'm going to become a real Trainer and meet all kinds of wonderful Pokémon!

items.en: I'd imagine they'd be in the same areas you chased 'em about in.
items.zh: 我想他们会在你追赶他们的地方。
items.normEn: I'd imagine they'd be in the same areas you chased 'em about in.

items.en: I'd seen it in a movie... this man singing and dancing in the rain. I had to try it for myself. Mother was so shocked that she ran right out after me. And then...she smiled... and danced with me. But... then she changed. And I couldn't do anything...
items.zh: 我在电影里看过……这个男人在雨中唱歌跳舞。我必须亲自尝试一下。妈妈大吃一惊，连忙追了出去。然后……她微笑着……和我一起跳舞。但……后来她变了。而我却什么也做不了...
items.normEn: I'd seen it in a movie... this man singing and dancing in the rain. I had to try it for myself. Mother was so shocked that she ran right out after me. And then...she smiled... and danced with me. But... then she changed. And I couldn't do anything...

items.en: I'll always be here to explain it again if you forget.
items.zh: 如果你忘记了，我会一直在这里再次解释。
items.normEn: I'll always be here to explain it again if you forget.

items.en: I'll await your arrival on Exeggutor Island, if training is something you desire before challenging this beast.
items.zh: 如果你在挑战这头野兽之前想要接受训练的话，我会在椰蛋岛等待你的到来。
items.normEn: I'll await your arrival on Exeggutor Island, if training is something you desire before challenging this beast.

items.en: I'll be taking the Legendary Pokémon back now! This time, I won't lose.
items.zh: 我现在就要把传说的宝可梦带回来！这一次，我不会再输了。
items.normEn: I'll be taking the Legendary Pokémon back now! This time, I won't lose.

items.en: I'll be waiting for you inside.
items.normEn: I'll be waiting for you inside.

items.en: I'll be waiting here until you're ready to join us to the Ruins of Life. I've heard that there is a group of terrible people called Team Skull who try to steal Pokémon. We need to be careful if we want to escape the notice of such a collection of villains... Isn't that right, $playername$?
items.zh: 我会在这里等你，直到你准备好加入我们前往生命废墟。我听说有一群可怕的人，叫做骷髅队，他们试图偷走神奇宝贝。如果我们想逃避这样一群恶棍的注意，我们就得小心了……是吗，$playername$？
items.normEn: I'll be waiting here until you're ready to join us to the Ruins of Life. I've heard that there is a group of terrible people called Team Skull who try to steal Pokémon. We need to be careful if we want to escape the notice of such a collection of villains... Isn't that right, $playername$?

items.en: I'll consider your worth only if you prove your strength and can beat me in battle!
items.zh: 只有你证明了自己的实力，能够在战斗中击败我，我才会考虑你的价值！
items.normEn: I'll consider your worth only if you prove your strength and can beat me in battle!

items.en: I'll give you that Pikachu costume my Inkay was wearing for some?
items.zh: 我可以给你我 Inkay 穿的皮卡丘服装吗？
items.normEn: I'll give you that Pikachu costume my Inkay was wearing for some?

items.en: I'll let you have a super secret Pokémon. For the right price! Buying this pokemon Takes No Effort, you should Value it.
items.zh: 我会让你拥有一只超级秘密的神奇宝贝。以合适的价格！购买这个神奇宝贝不费吹灰之力，你应该珍惜它。
items.normEn: I'll let you have a super secret Pokémon. For the right price! Buying this pokemon Takes No Effort, you should Value it.

items.en: I'll let you keep the Memories you've found in the meantime so you keep track of your progress.
items.zh: 我会让你同时保留你找到的记忆，以便你跟踪你的进展。
items.normEn: I'll let you keep the Memories you've found in the meantime so you keep track of your progress.

items.en: I'll let you owe me this one time. But you have to promise you will think of my plan next time. If you see XD001 you will so want to help me. I'll so be waiting for you!
items.zh: 我就让你欠我这一次。但你必须保证下次你会考虑我的计划。如果您看到 XD001，您一定会很想帮助我。我就这样等你吧！
items.normEn: I'll let you owe me this one time. But you have to promise you will think of my plan next time. If you see XD001 you will so want to help me. I'll so be waiting for you!

items.en: I'm a bit skeptical of his wares, especially since his shop isn't on any maps.
items.zh: 我对他的商品有点怀疑，特别是因为他的商店不在任何地图上。
items.normEn: I'm a bit skeptical of his wares, especially since his shop isn't on any maps.

items.en: I'm a descendant of the king's younger brother. That being said, that story is 3,000 years old, so it might not be entirely reliable.
items.zh: 我是国王弟弟的后裔。话虽这么说，这个故事已有 3000 年的历史，所以它可能并不完全可靠。
items.normEn: I'm a descendant of the king's younger brother. That being said, that story is 3,000 years old, so it might not be entirely reliable.

items.en: I'm afraid I can't allow you into Pinkan Mountain though. The Pokémon there are extremely territorial.
items.zh: 不过恐怕我不能让你进入平坎山。那里的神奇宝贝的领地意识极强。
items.normEn: I'm afraid I can't allow you into Pinkan Mountain though. The Pokémon there are extremely territorial.

items.en: I'm an awesome dancer… But I can't win in battles!
items.zh: 我是一名出色的舞者……但我无法在战斗中获胜！
items.normEn: I'm an awesome dancer… But I can't win in battles!

items.en: I'm getting more old than my rod...
items.zh: 我已经比我的鱼竿还老了...
items.normEn: I'm getting more old than my rod...

items.en: I'm glad Celebi has been released from that wretched prison and has found a home with a great young trainer like yourself. I'm going back to Kanto.
items.zh: 我很高兴雪拉比从那座悲惨的监狱中被释放，并找到了一个家，有一个像你这样伟大的年轻教练。我要回关东了
items.normEn: I'm glad Celebi has been released from that wretched prison and has found a home with a great young trainer like yourself. I'm going back to Kanto.

items.en: I'm glad to be back in the city after so long at the Power Plant; it's so dusty out there!
items.zh: 我很高兴在发电厂呆了这么久之后回到这座城市；外面灰尘太多了！
items.normEn: I'm glad to be back in the city after so long at the Power Plant; it's so dusty out there!

items.en: I'm glad to hear Lostelle is all right. You can hand the meteorite to me. Bill, thank you for your assistance, I'll take it from here. I can see that your friend is eager to get back to Kanto and challenge the Pokémon League.
items.zh: 我很高兴听到洛斯泰尔没事。你可以把陨石交给我。比尔，谢谢你的帮助，我会从这里开始。我看得出来，你的朋友很想回到关东挑战神奇宝贝联盟。
items.normEn: I'm glad to hear Lostelle is all right. You can hand the meteorite to me. Bill, thank you for your assistance, I'll take it from here. I can see that your friend is eager to get back to Kanto and challenge the Pokémon League.

items.en: I'm going to go back to Aether Paradise for a bit to help my mother recover. I need to see for myself that she'll be all right, but before that... $playername$! Won't you have a battle with me?
items.zh: 我要回以太乐园一段时间，帮助我母亲康复。我需要亲眼看看她会没事，但在那之前...$playername$！难道你不和我来一场战斗吗？
items.normEn: I'm going to go back to Aether Paradise for a bit to help my mother recover. I need to see for myself that she'll be all right, but before that... $playername$! Won't you have a battle with me?

items.en: I'm going to need some sand for sandbags, springs for a jump counter, wood for a pell post, rocks and ice for smashing, a TON of Pokéballs, electricity generation...
items.zh: 我需要一些沙子做沙袋，弹簧做跳跃计数器，木头做咒语柱，石头和冰用来粉碎，大量的精灵球，发电......
items.normEn: I'm going to need some sand for sandbags, springs for a jump counter, wood for a pell post, rocks and ice for smashing, a TON of Pokéballs, electricity generation...

items.en: I'm gonna pinch that Pokémon first, so if you want to try and stop me, you'll have to get through my Pokémon!
items.zh: 我会先捏住那只神奇宝贝，所以如果你想阻止我，就必须先穿过我的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: I'm gonna pinch that Pokémon first, so if you want to try and stop me, you'll have to get through my Pokémon!

items.en: I'm here to tell you about sightings of monsters on Ula'ula Island. I missed some big Kahuna meeting we were all supposed to go to, so I got stuck as the messenger.
items.zh: 我来这里是为了告诉你乌拉乌拉岛上怪物的目击事件。我错过了一些我们都应该参加的大型 Kahuna 会议，所以我被困在信使的位置上。
items.normEn: I'm here to tell you about sightings of monsters on Ula'ula Island. I missed some big Kahuna meeting we were all supposed to go to, so I got stuck as the messenger.

items.en: I'm hunting for rare stones! If I find any extras, I'll sell you some!
items.zh: 我正在寻找稀有宝石！如果我找到多余的东西，我就卖给你！
items.normEn: I'm hunting for rare stones! If I find any extras, I'll sell you some!

items.en: I'm looking for a strange Pichu, have you seen it? According to rumors, its favorite hiding spots are chests...
items.zh: 我在寻找一个奇怪的皮丘，你看到了吗？据传言，它最喜欢的藏身之处是箱子……
items.normEn: I'm looking for a strange Pichu, have you seen it? According to rumors, its favorite hiding spots are chests...

items.en: I'm moving on up and ahead! I'm going to the Pokémon League to boot out the Elite Four! I'll become the world's most powerful Trainer! Well, good luck to you! Don't sweat it! Smell ya!
items.zh: 我要继续前进！我要去神奇宝贝联盟淘汰精英四人组！我要成为世界上最强的训练家！好吧，祝你好运！别出汗！闻闻呀！
items.normEn: I'm moving on up and ahead! I'm going to the Pokémon League to boot out the Elite Four! I'll become the world's most powerful Trainer! Well, good luck to you! Don't sweat it! Smell ya!

items.en: I'm not fond of this outcome, but at least it's still better than plowing fields for the Galaxy Team!
items.zh: 我不喜欢这样的结果，但至少还是比给银河队犁地好！
items.normEn: I'm not fond of this outcome, but at least it's still better than plowing fields for the Galaxy Team!

items.en: I'm not good enough yet... All right. This Badge is yours.
items.zh: 我还不够好...好吧。这枚徽章是你的。
items.normEn: I'm not good enough yet... All right. This Badge is yours.

items.en: I'm not holding a single thing back anymore. Time to settle this-fair and square! Oh, and maybe watch your step... Looks like some Toxic Spikes somehow got on the Battle Court!
items.zh: 我不再保留任何事情了。是时候公平公正地解决这件事了！哦，也许要小心你的脚步......看起来一些有毒尖刺不知何故进入了战斗场！
items.normEn: I'm not holding a single thing back anymore. Time to settle this-fair and square! Oh, and maybe watch your step... Looks like some Toxic Spikes somehow got on the Battle Court!

items.en: I'm often regarded as the first real roadblock of the Gym Challenge, and yet you defeated me! Clearly, your talent surpassed my many years of experience. I still have much to learn!
items.zh: 我经常被认为是道馆挑战的第一道真正的障碍，但你却打败了我！显然，你的才华超越了我多年的经验。我还有很多东西要学！
items.normEn: I'm often regarded as the first real roadblock of the Gym Challenge, and yet you defeated me! Clearly, your talent surpassed my many years of experience. I still have much to learn!

items.en: I'm really sorry, it seems you'll have to fight off these ones as well.
items.zh: 真的很抱歉，看来你也得和这些人战斗了。
items.normEn: I'm really sorry, it seems you'll have to fight off these ones as well.

items.en: I'm satisfied that I was able to battle to my heart's content. I would like to confer on you the title “Eldes's Top Rival.”
items.zh: 我很满意自己能够尽情地战斗。我想授予你“埃尔德斯顶级对手”的称号。
items.normEn: I'm satisfied that I was able to battle to my heart's content. I would like to confer on you the title “Eldes's Top Rival.”

items.en: I'm selling some peculiar stones for gems at my new shop, the Stone Emporium. Let me know if anything there strikes your fancy!
items.zh: 我在我的新商店“石头商场”里出售一些奇特的宝石。如果有什么让您感兴趣，请告诉我！
items.normEn: I'm selling some peculiar stones for gems at my new shop, the Stone Emporium. Let me know if anything there strikes your fancy!

items.en: I'm selling some unusual stones for gems. Let me know if any of them strike your fancy!
items.zh: 我正在出售一些不寻常的宝石作为宝石。如果其中任何一个符合您的喜好，请告诉我！
items.normEn: I'm selling some unusual stones for gems. Let me know if any of them strike your fancy!

items.en: I'm shocked... You have a Pokédex, but you still don't know... you really don't know anything about Pokémon connected to Gengar, do you?
items.zh: 我很震惊......你有一个神奇宝贝图鉴，但你仍然不知道......你真的不知道任何关于与耿鬼有关的神奇宝贝，是吗？
items.normEn: I'm shocked... You have a Pokédex, but you still don't know... you really don't know anything about Pokémon connected to Gengar, do you?

items.en: I'm so happy for them, all of that training in Mt. Coronet must have paid off!
items.zh: 我为他们感到高兴，所有在皇冠山的训练一定得到了回报！
items.normEn: I'm so happy for them, all of that training in Mt. Coronet must have paid off!

items.en: I'm sorry it's come to this. But it's you who forced my hand, Leon. You refused to listen!
items.zh: 很抱歉事情发展到这一步。但是你逼我的，莱昂。你拒绝听！
items.normEn: I'm sorry it's come to this. But it's you who forced my hand, Leon. You refused to listen!

items.en: I'm still house-sitting for my grandson, I'm sure he's doing well.
items.zh: 我还在照顾我的孙子，我确信他过得很好。
items.normEn: I'm still house-sitting for my grandson, I'm sure he's doing well.

items.en: I'm still no match for you... You know, it's because I met you that I was able to get this far... But our journey's just getting started. Who knows what heights we'll reach!
items.zh: 我还是不是你的对手……你知道，正是因为遇见了你，我才能走到这一步……但我们的旅程才刚刚开始。谁知道我们会达到什么高度！
items.normEn: I'm still no match for you... You know, it's because I met you that I was able to get this far... But our journey's just getting started. Who knows what heights we'll reach!

items.en: I'm supposed to meet my sisters, but the streets here just aren't safe! Can you protect me from Team Rocket?
items.zh: 我应该去见我的姐妹们，但这里的街道就是不安全！你能保护我免受火箭队的伤害吗？
items.normEn: I'm supposed to meet my sisters, but the streets here just aren't safe! Can you protect me from Team Rocket?

items.en: I’m sure if you go to these places you’ll find many unique and powerful Pokémon!
items.zh: 我相信如果你去这些地方，你会发现许多独特而强大的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: I’m sure if you go to these places you’ll find many unique and powerful Pokémon!

items.en: I'm sure the UBs will truly flourish in the company of a competent trainer like yourself. It'll be much better for them than being locked up in some stuffy lab. Just be sure to let us know how they are doing.
items.zh: 我相信，在像您这样有能力的培训师的陪伴下，UB 将会真正蓬勃发展。这对他们来说比被关在闷热的实验室里要好得多。请务必让我们知道他们的情况。
items.normEn: I'm sure the UBs will truly flourish in the company of a competent trainer like yourself. It'll be much better for them than being locked up in some stuffy lab. Just be sure to let us know how they are doing.

items.en: I'm sure you'll have noticed that there's quite a few Gigantamax Pokémon. As more get here, it's going to get progressively harder to find the one you want.
items.zh: 我相信你会注意到有很多超极巨化神奇宝贝。随着越来越多的人来到这里，找到你想要的人会变得越来越困难。
items.normEn: I'm sure you'll have noticed that there's quite a few Gigantamax Pokémon. As more get here, it's going to get progressively harder to find the one you want.

items.en: I’m too busy playing gigs to scamper around with Snom in the evening!
items.zh: 我太忙于演出了，晚上没有时间和 Snom 一起到处跑！
items.normEn: I’m too busy playing gigs to scamper around with Snom in the evening!

items.en: I'm upset I couldn't win! But you know what? More than that, I'm happy! I mean, come on. By having a serious battle, you and your Pokémon, and me and my Pokémon, we all got to know one another better than before! Yep, we sure did! OK, let's go!
items.zh: 没能获胜我很沮丧！但你知道吗？更重要的是，我很高兴！我的意思是，来吧。通过一场认真的战斗，你和你的神奇宝贝，我和我的神奇宝贝，我们都比以前更加了解彼此了！是的，我们确实做到了！好的，我们走吧！
items.normEn: I'm upset I couldn't win! But you know what? More than that, I'm happy! I mean, come on. By having a serious battle, you and your Pokémon, and me and my Pokémon, we all got to know one another better than before! Yep, we sure did! OK, let's go!

items.en: I'm very grateful that you accepted my invitation. My name is Looker. This here is my boss, Chief Anabel, head of the UB Taskforce.
items.zh: 我非常感谢你接受我的邀请。我的名字是看者。这是我的老板，Anabel 酋长，UB 特别小组的负责人。
items.normEn: I'm very grateful that you accepted my invitation. My name is Looker. This here is my boss, Chief Anabel, head of the UB Taskforce.

items.en: I'm...I'm speechless! You've done me in!
items.zh: 我……我无语了！你已经把我搞垮了！
items.normEn: I'm...I'm speechless! You've done me in!

items.en: I’ve also heard that the Battle Frontier may have some secrets relevant to Deoxys and its forms… but I’m not strong enough to find out...
items.zh: 我还听说，战斗前沿可能有一些与代欧奇希斯及其形态相关的秘密……但我还没有强大到能够查明……
items.normEn: I’ve also heard that the Battle Frontier may have some secrets relevant to Deoxys and its forms… but I’m not strong enough to find out...

items.en: I've also heard that the Pokémon in the Isle of Armor to the East, and the Crown Tundra to the South, are also like this.
items.zh: 我还听说东边的铠甲岛和南边的皇冠苔原的神奇宝贝也是这样。
items.normEn: I've also heard that the Pokémon in the Isle of Armor to the East, and the Crown Tundra to the South, are also like this.

items.en: I've been debating asking someone else to collect five hundred of their own Electrike and investigate, but if it can call such a fearsome pack with its presence alone, I don't imagine anyone less than Diantha herself could handle it.
items.zh: 我一直在考虑让其他人收集五百辆他们自己的电动车并进行调查，但如果它能够单独召唤出如此可怕的包，我不认为除了黛安莎本人之外还有人可以处理它。
items.normEn: I've been debating asking someone else to collect five hundred of their own Electrike and investigate, but if it can call such a fearsome pack with its presence alone, I don't imagine anyone less than Diantha herself could handle it.

items.en: I've been doing some research on this R compound, and have reason to believe it is being manufactured or used in research at the P2 Lab in Unova.
items.zh: 我一直在对这种 R 化合物进行一些研究，并且有理由相信它正在 Unova 的 P2 实验室中制造或用于研究。
items.normEn: I've been doing some research on this R compound, and have reason to believe it is being manufactured or used in research at the P2 Lab in Unova.

items.en: I've been finding ways to grow Snover Berries using humane methods.
items.zh: 我一直在寻找使用人道方法种植斯诺弗浆果的方法。
items.normEn: I've been finding ways to grow Snover Berries using humane methods.

items.en: I've been studying the Galarian form of Yamask.
items.zh: 我一直在研究 Yamask 的加拉利安形式。
items.normEn: I've been studying the Galarian form of Yamask.

items.en: I've been waiting for the S. S. Libra to come into port for HOURS!
items.zh: 我已经等待 S.S. Libra 进港几个小时了！
items.normEn: I've been waiting for the S. S. Libra to come into port for HOURS!

items.en: I've decided. I'll battle you as a trainer to earn Suicune's respect! Come on! Let's battle now!
items.zh: 我已经决定了我会以训练家的身份与你战斗，赢得水君的尊重！快点！现在就来战斗吧！
items.normEn: I've decided. I'll battle you as a trainer to earn Suicune's respect! Come on! Let's battle now!

items.en: I've dug a tunnel to Pinkan Island! Though, I think I'll need to rest for a while first... You go on ahead.
items.zh: 我挖了一条通往平坎岛的隧道！不过，我想我需要先休息一会儿……你继续吧。
items.normEn: I've dug a tunnel to Pinkan Island! Though, I think I'll need to rest for a while first... You go on ahead.

items.en: I've Got My Hands Full With All of These
items.zh: 我已经忙完了所有这些
items.normEn: I've Got My Hands Full With All of These

items.en: I've heard a Pokémon detective is sniffing around here for mysteries! He might be interested in an enigmatic berry, too.
items.zh: 我听说有一位宝可梦侦探在这里四处搜寻谜团！他可能也对一种神秘的浆果感兴趣。
items.normEn: I've heard a Pokémon detective is sniffing around here for mysteries! He might be interested in an enigmatic berry, too.

items.en: I've heard its evolutionary line loves damp conditions, and apparently if you train a Sliggoo during rainy or foggy weather something marvelous happens!
items.zh: 我听说它的进化线喜欢潮湿的环境，显然如果你在雨天或雾天训练斯利古，就会发生奇妙的事情！
items.normEn: I've heard its evolutionary line loves damp conditions, and apparently if you train a Sliggoo during rainy or foggy weather something marvelous happens!

items.en: I've heard Molayne wanted to brush up on his training a bit. He's at the Royal Avenue, and he's also offering a strange reward which I presume is a Silvally Memory.
items.zh: 我听说莫兰想要温习一下他的训练。他在皇家大道，而且还提供了一个奇怪的奖励，我猜是希尔瓦利记忆。
items.normEn: I've heard Molayne wanted to brush up on his training a bit. He's at the Royal Avenue, and he's also offering a strange reward which I presume is a Silvally Memory.

items.en: I've heard of a Berry that can appear in a field of Babiri when Snover are around.
items.zh: 我听说当斯诺弗在附近时，巴比里的田野里会出现一种浆果。
items.normEn: I've heard of a Berry that can appear in a field of Babiri when Snover are around.

items.en: I've heard of a Berry that only appears after a Berry plant has withered, but is repelled by Colbur plants.
items.zh: 我听说有一种浆果，只有在浆果植物枯萎后才会出现，但会被科尔伯植物排斥。
items.normEn: I've heard of a Berry that only appears after a Berry plant has withered, but is repelled by Colbur plants.

items.en: I've heard of a Berry that only appears after a Shiny Pokémon wanders and is caught near open soil.
items.zh: 我听说过一种浆果，只会在闪亮的神奇宝贝徘徊并在开阔的土壤附近被捕获后才会出现。
items.normEn: I've heard of a Berry that only appears after a Shiny Pokémon wanders and is caught near open soil.

items.en: I've heard of a Berry that only appears in the driest of fields.
items.zh: 我听说过一种浆果只出现在最干燥的田野里。
items.normEn: I've heard of a Berry that only appears in the driest of fields.

items.en: I've heard of a Berry that only appears in the most bitter of fields.
items.zh: 我听说过一种浆果只出现在最苦的田地里。
items.normEn: I've heard of a Berry that only appears in the most bitter of fields.

items.en: I've heard of a Berry that only appears in the most sour of fields.
items.zh: 我听说过一种浆果只出现在最酸的田地里。
items.normEn: I've heard of a Berry that only appears in the most sour of fields.

items.en: I've heard of a Berry that only appears in the sweetest of fields.
items.zh: 我听说有一种浆果只出现在最甜美的田野里。
items.normEn: I've heard of a Berry that only appears in the sweetest of fields.

items.en: I've heard tell of a secret room in this ruin. A room that supposedly contains a very rare Pokémon.
items.zh: 我听说这片废墟里有一个秘密房间。一个据说包含非常稀有的神奇宝贝的房间。
items.normEn: I've heard tell of a secret room in this ruin. A room that supposedly contains a very rare Pokémon.

items.en: I've heard that ${...} Berries can spontaneously change!
items.zh: 我听说 ${...} 浆果可以自发变化！
items.normEn: I've heard that ${...} Berries can spontaneously change!

items.en: I've heard that a Cornn berry will change if its surroundings get extremely dry!
items.zh: 我听说如果周围环境变得极度干燥，玉米浆果就会发生变化！
items.normEn: I've heard that a Cornn berry will change if its surroundings get extremely dry!

items.en: I've heard that a hidden realm lies beneath this cave, ruled by a Pokémon Princess. She might come out for a powerful and helpful trainer.
items.zh: 我听说这个洞穴下面有一个隐藏的国度，由一位神奇宝贝公主统治。她可能会寻求一位强大而乐于助人的教练。
items.normEn: I've heard that a hidden realm lies beneath this cave, ruled by a Pokémon Princess. She might come out for a powerful and helpful trainer.

items.en: I've heard that a Magost berry will change if its surroundings get extremely sweet!
items.zh: 我听说，如果周围的环境变得非常甜的话，魔神浆果就会发生变化！
items.normEn: I've heard that a Magost berry will change if its surroundings get extremely sweet!

items.en: I've heard that a Nomel berry will change if its surroundings get extremely sour!
items.zh: 我听说诺梅尔浆果如果周围环境变得非常酸的话就会发生变化！
items.normEn: I've heard that a Nomel berry will change if its surroundings get extremely sour!

items.en: I've heard that a Rabuta berry will change if its surroundings get extremely bitter!
items.zh: 我听说如果周围的环境变得非常苦，拉布塔浆果就会发生变化！
items.normEn: I've heard that a Rabuta berry will change if its surroundings get extremely bitter!

items.en: I've heard that a rare Pokémon sometimes hides in the chests here. I was told that it is incredibly rare, but can't be found anywhere else!
items.zh: 我听说这里的箱子里有时会藏着稀有的神奇宝贝。有人告诉我，这是非常罕见的，但在其他地方找不到！
items.normEn: I've heard that a rare Pokémon sometimes hides in the chests here. I was told that it is incredibly rare, but can't be found anywhere else!

items.en: I've heard that a special Berry can appear after being surrounded by Rindo Berries!
items.zh: 听说被林多浆果包围后，会出现一种特殊的浆果！
items.normEn: I've heard that a special Berry can appear after being surrounded by Rindo Berries!

items.en: I've heard that a special Berry can appear after being surrounded by Shuca and Charti Berries!
items.zh: 听说被舒卡和查蒂浆果包围后，会出现一种特殊的浆果！
items.normEn: I've heard that a special Berry can appear after being surrounded by Shuca and Charti Berries!

items.en: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings get too bitter!
items.zh: 听说周围环境太苦的话，就会出现特殊的浆果！
items.normEn: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings get too bitter!

items.en: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings get too dry!
items.zh: 听说周围太干燥的话，就会出现特殊的浆果！
items.normEn: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings get too dry!

items.en: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings get too sour!
items.zh: 听说周围环境太酸的话，就会出现特殊的浆果！
items.normEn: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings get too sour!

items.en: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings get too spicy!
items.zh: 听说周围环境太辣的话，就会出现特殊的浆果！
items.normEn: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings get too spicy!

items.en: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings get too sweet!
items.zh: 听说周围的环境太甜的话，就会出现特殊的浆果！
items.normEn: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings get too sweet!

items.en: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings match its flavor profile! If I recall, it tasted a little dry and fairly bitter at the same time.
items.zh: 听说周围的环境与其味道相匹配的话，就会出现一种特殊的浆果！如果我记得的话，它尝起来有点干，同时又相当苦。
items.normEn: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings match its flavor profile! If I recall, it tasted a little dry and fairly bitter at the same time.

items.en: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings match its flavor profile! If I recall, it tasted a little spicy and fairly bitter at the same time.
items.zh: 听说周围的环境与其味道相匹配的话，就会出现一种特殊的浆果！如果我记得的话，它尝起来有点辣，同时又相当苦。
items.normEn: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings match its flavor profile! If I recall, it tasted a little spicy and fairly bitter at the same time.

items.en: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings match its flavor profile! If I recall, it tasted a little spicy, a little sweet, and a little sour at the same time.
items.zh: 听说周围的环境与其味道相匹配的话，就会出现一种特殊的浆果！我记得，味道有点辣，有点甜，同时又有点酸。
items.normEn: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings match its flavor profile! If I recall, it tasted a little spicy, a little sweet, and a little sour at the same time.

items.en: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings match its flavor profile! If I recall, it tasted fairly spicy, dry, and bitter at the same time.
items.zh: 听说周围的环境与其味道相匹配的话，就会出现一种特殊的浆果！如果我记得的话，它的味道相当辣，干，同时又苦。
items.normEn: I've heard that a special Berry can appear if its surroundings match its flavor profile! If I recall, it tasted fairly spicy, dry, and bitter at the same time.

items.en: I've heard that a Tamato berry will change if its surroundings get extremely spicy!
items.zh: 我听说如果周围的环境变得非常辣，塔玛托浆果就会发生变化！
items.normEn: I've heard that a Tamato berry will change if its surroundings get extremely spicy!

items.en: I've heard that Chople Berries will turn into a different Berry if surrounded by more than two of their own kind.
items.zh: 我听说如果乔普尔浆果周围有两个以上同类浆果，它就会变成另一种浆果。
items.normEn: I've heard that Chople Berries will turn into a different Berry if surrounded by more than two of their own kind.
