items.en: I've heard that growing ${...} Berries can spread a new Berry into nearby empty plots!
items.zh: 我听说种植 ${...} 浆果可以将新浆果传播到附近的空地上！
items.normEn: I've heard that growing ${...} Berries can spread a new Berry into nearby empty plots!

items.en: I've heard that growing ${...} Berries near each other will produce something interesting!
items.zh: 我听说将 ${...} 浆果靠近种植会产生一些有趣的东西！
items.normEn: I've heard that growing ${...} Berries near each other will produce something interesting!

items.en: I've heard that growing a Passho Berry alone will cause it to change!
items.zh: 我听说仅种植帕索浆果就会使它发生变化！
items.normEn: I've heard that growing a Passho Berry alone will cause it to change!

items.en: I've heard that if you beat a Dungeon a lot then the stuff you find in chests gets even more awesome.
items.zh: 我听说如果你多次通关地下城，那么你在宝箱中找到的东西就会变得更加棒。
items.normEn: I've heard that if you beat a Dungeon a lot then the stuff you find in chests gets even more awesome.

items.en: I've heard that there's a legendary Berry that only appears when fully surrounded by the 8 different Berries that wild Pokémon hold!
items.zh: 我听说有一种传说中的浆果，只有在被野生神奇宝贝持有的 8 种不同浆果完全包围时才会出现！
items.normEn: I've heard that there's a legendary Berry that only appears when fully surrounded by the 8 different Berries that wild Pokémon hold!

items.en: I've heard that there's a special Pink Berry that only appears when surrounded by a bunch of different types of Pink Berries!
items.zh: 我听说有一种特殊的粉红色浆果，只有在被一堆不同类型的粉红色浆果包围时才会出现！
items.normEn: I've heard that there's a special Pink Berry that only appears when surrounded by a bunch of different types of Pink Berries!

items.en: I've heard that using the ${...} can cause ${...} Berries to change!
items.zh: 我听说使用 ${...} 会导致 ${...} 浆果发生变化！
items.normEn: I've heard that using the ${...} can cause ${...} Berries to change!

items.en: I’ve heard there are some very strong Pokémon in there.
items.zh: 我听说那里有一些非常强大的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: I’ve heard there are some very strong Pokémon in there.

items.en: I've heard there is a cave you can find if you go out on the ocean a little ways.
items.zh: 我听说只要往海上走一小段路就能找到一个洞穴。
items.normEn: I've heard there is a cave you can find if you go out on the ocean a little ways.

items.en: I’ve heard there’s been sightings of a never-before-seen, super strong Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}! You should go check it out!
items.zh: 我听说{ROUTE_NAME}上出现了前所未见的超强神奇宝贝！你应该去看看！
items.normEn: I’ve heard there’s been sightings of a never-before-seen, super strong Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}! You should go check it out!

items.en: I've just been told of the foul plan Volo had concocted. Well, think no more on that scoundrel. Just another tale of passion burning too bright and consuming its bearer. This is what happens, if you allow it to.
items.zh: 我刚刚得知沃洛策划的邪恶计划。好吧，别再想那个恶棍了。这又是一个关于激情燃烧得太猛烈并吞噬其承载者的故事。如果你允许的话，就会发生这样的情况。
items.normEn: I've just been told of the foul plan Volo had concocted. Well, think no more on that scoundrel. Just another tale of passion burning too bright and consuming its bearer. This is what happens, if you allow it to.

items.en: I've never heard it myself. Apparently it only happens on Fridays.
items.zh: 我自己从来没有听说过。显然它只发生在周五。
items.normEn: I've never heard it myself. Apparently it only happens on Fridays.

items.en: I've never seen it, but supposedly it works just like any other evolution item.
items.zh: 我从未见过它，但据说它的作用就像任何其他进化物品一样。
items.normEn: I've never seen it, but supposedly it works just like any other evolution item.

items.en: icon for a description of what the filter will catch.
items.zh: 图标，用于描述过滤器将捕获的内容。
items.normEn: icon for a description of what the filter will catch.

items.en: If a large enough volume of this Berry is boiled down, its bitterness fades away. It makes a good jam.
items.zh: 如果将足够多的这种浆果煮沸，它的苦味就会消失。它是一种很好的果酱。
items.normEn: If a large enough volume of this Berry is boiled down, its bitterness fades away. It makes a good jam.

items.en: If a meteor appeared in that world because of the use of this warp hole technology, they would be unable to save themselves! We can't do that to the other world! We have to solve this problem a different way!
items.zh: 如果因为使用了这种时空技术而在那个世界出现了流星，他们就无法自救了！我们不能对另一个世界这样做！我们必须以不同的方式解决这个问题！
items.normEn: If a meteor appeared in that world because of the use of this warp hole technology, they would be unable to save themselves! We can't do that to the other world! We have to solve this problem a different way!

items.en: If all I think about is how I'm nothing like a character, then I'll just hate playing it.
items.zh: 如果我只想到我一点也不像一个角色，那么我就会讨厌扮演这个角色。
items.normEn: If all I think about is how I'm nothing like a character, then I'll just hate playing it.

items.en: If everything were straightforward, what meaning would there be in living as long as we do?
items.zh: 如果一切都是那么简单，那么我们活着还有什么意义呢？
items.normEn: If everything were straightforward, what meaning would there be in living as long as we do?

items.en: If I breed a shiny Pokémon, will it still stay shiny?
items.zh: 如果我培育出闪亮的神奇宝贝，它还会保持闪亮吗？
items.normEn: If I breed a shiny Pokémon, will it still stay shiny?

items.en: If I can't sell the Sapphire, it's worthless! Go ahead, take it!
items.zh: 如果我不能卖掉蓝宝石，它就毫无价值了！来吧，拿走它！
items.normEn: If I can't sell the Sapphire, it's worthless! Go ahead, take it!

items.en: If I evolve a shiny Pokémon, will the evolution be shiny?
items.zh: 如果我进化出闪亮的神奇宝贝，进化后会发光吗？
items.normEn: If I evolve a shiny Pokémon, will the evolution be shiny?

items.en: If I try mutating different berries maybe I can catch new Pokémon while saving my Quest Points!
items.zh: 如果我尝试变异不同的浆果，也许我可以捕捉新的神奇宝贝，同时节省我的任务点！
items.normEn: If I try mutating different berries maybe I can catch new Pokémon while saving my Quest Points!

items.en: If it means the strength must be brought out by the interactions between Pokémon and Trainers, then so be it! If it means you have to use a merciless approach, like Team Plasma's, and force out all of the Pokémon's power, then so be it! And yes, if the entire world is destroyed as a result, then so be it...
items.zh: 如果这意味着力量必须通过神奇宝贝和训练家之间的互动来发挥出来，那就这样吧！如果这意味着你必须使用无情的方法，就像等离子队那样，并强制消除神奇宝贝的所有力量，那就这样吧！是的，如果整个世界因此而毁灭，那就这样吧……
items.normEn: If it means the strength must be brought out by the interactions between Pokémon and Trainers, then so be it! If it means you have to use a merciless approach, like Team Plasma's, and force out all of the Pokémon's power, then so be it! And yes, if the entire world is destroyed as a result, then so be it...

items.en: If it wants to play I'm sure a great trainer such as yourself can figure out a way that you can be friends and play all the time!
items.zh: 如果它想玩，我相信像您这样优秀的训练师可以找到一种方法，让你们可以成为朋友并一直玩！
items.normEn: If it wants to play I'm sure a great trainer such as yourself can figure out a way that you can be friends and play all the time!

items.en: If my eyes didn't deceive me, I saw a rare Pokémon at {ROUTE_NAME}. Go and see if you can find it if you're interested.
items.zh: 如果我的眼睛没有欺骗我，我在{ROUTE_NAME}看到了一只稀有的神奇宝贝。有兴趣的话就去看看能不能找到。
items.normEn: If my eyes didn't deceive me, I saw a rare Pokémon at {ROUTE_NAME}. Go and see if you can find it if you're interested.

items.en: If such a Pokémon existed, Professor Krane at the Pokémon HQ Lab would know about it.
items.zh: 如果存在这样的神奇宝贝，神奇宝贝总部实验室的克兰教授就会知道它。
items.normEn: If such a Pokémon existed, Professor Krane at the Pokémon HQ Lab would know about it.

items.en: If the base Pokémon had a Held Item, it will be carried over to the evolution unless the item is incompatible. For example, Light Ball won't be transferred to a Raichu but a Magnet will.
items.zh: 如果基础神奇宝贝有持有物品，除非该物品不兼容，否则它将被带到进化中。例如，光球不会转移到雷丘，但磁铁会。
items.normEn: If the base Pokémon had a Held Item, it will be carried over to the evolution unless the item is incompatible. For example, Light Ball won't be transferred to a Raichu but a Magnet will.

items.en: If the challenge is deactivated, the EVs will get multiplied back.
items.zh: 如果挑战被取消，电动汽车将成倍增加。
items.normEn: If the challenge is deactivated, the EVs will get multiplied back.

items.en: If the leaves grow longer and curlier than average, this Berry will have a somewhat-bitter taste.
items.zh: 如果叶子比一般叶子长得更长、更卷曲，那么这种浆果的味道就会有点苦。
items.normEn: If the leaves grow longer and curlier than average, this Berry will have a somewhat-bitter taste.

items.en: If they don’t find their specific mine, they will find a
items.zh: 如果他们找不到特定的矿井，他们会找到一个
items.normEn: If they don’t find their specific mine, they will find a

items.en: If they run out of energy, they won't do any work for that cycle, but will regenerate some energy instead. If there's no work to do currently, they will also regenerate some energy. Firing them will allow them to recover energy at the same rate as if they were still hired.
items.zh: 如果它们耗尽了能量，它们将不会在该周期中做任何工作，而是会再生一些能量。如果当前没有工作可做，它们也会再生一些能量。解雇他们将使他们以与仍受雇时相同的速度恢复能量。
items.normEn: If they run out of energy, they won't do any work for that cycle, but will regenerate some energy instead. If there's no work to do currently, they will also regenerate some energy. Firing them will allow them to recover energy at the same rate as if they were still hired.

items.en: If this does not work, you can copy the contents of the save and paste it into a '.txt' file
items.zh: 如果这不起作用，您可以复制保存的内容并将其粘贴到“.txt”文件中
items.normEn: If this does not work, you can copy the contents of the save and paste it into a '.txt' file

items.en: If ya feel like meetin' 'im, the fine folks at the Weather Insitute can tell you when the next storm's brewin'.
items.zh: 如果您想见见他，气象研究所的优秀人员可以告诉您下一场风暴何时酝酿。
items.normEn: If ya feel like meetin' 'im, the fine folks at the Weather Insitute can tell you when the next storm's brewin'.

items.en: If you defeat enough Mimikyu, you might find one with a busted costume roaming around.
items.zh: 如果你打败了足够多的咪咪Q，你可能会发现一个穿着破烂服装的人在四处游荡。
items.normEn: If you defeat enough Mimikyu, you might find one with a busted costume roaming around.

items.en: If you don't mind me asking… Do you feel anything in particular when you look up at this wall? A primal world, lost thousands of years in the past… A Legendary Pokémon of tremendous power became humanity's greatest threat…
items.zh: 如果你不介意我问……当你抬头看这面墙时，有什么特别的感觉吗？一个消失了数千年的原始世界……一只拥有巨大力量的传奇神奇宝贝成为了人类最大的威胁……
items.normEn: If you don't mind me asking… Do you feel anything in particular when you look up at this wall? A primal world, lost thousands of years in the past… A Legendary Pokémon of tremendous power became humanity's greatest threat…

items.en: If you encounter a new Pokémon that is also shiny, the higher tier ball will be selected
items.zh: 如果您遇到同样闪亮的新神奇宝贝，将选择更高级别的球
items.normEn: If you encounter a new Pokémon that is also shiny, the higher tier ball will be selected

items.en: If you encounter that Pokémon and catch it, would you, please, bring it here?
items.zh: 如果你遇到了那个神奇宝贝并抓住了它，请你把它带到这里来吗？
items.normEn: If you encounter that Pokémon and catch it, would you, please, bring it here?

items.en: If you get totally lost, just wander around. You will find the right path eventually.
items.zh: 如果你完全迷路了，那就到处走走吧。你最终会找到正确的道路。
items.normEn: If you get totally lost, just wander around. You will find the right path eventually.

items.en: If you give it to your Shaymin, it can change form!
items.zh: 如果你把它交给你的 Shaymin，它可以改变形态！
items.normEn: If you give it to your Shaymin, it can change form!

items.en: If you have a Pokémon with Pokérus, try catching more of that type of Pokémon. When he got back from his next trip, oddly enough Wailmer seemed stronger than ever!
items.zh: 如果您有带有 Pokérus 的神奇宝贝，请尝试捕捉更多该类型的神奇宝贝。奇怪的是，当他下次旅行回来时，韦尔默似乎比以前更坚强了！
items.normEn: If you have a Pokémon with Pokérus, try catching more of that type of Pokémon. When he got back from his next trip, oddly enough Wailmer seemed stronger than ever!

items.en: If you have DNA splicers, perhaps you can make Kyurem whole again.
items.zh: 如果你有 DNA 拼接器，也许你可以让酋雷姆再次完整。
items.normEn: If you have DNA splicers, perhaps you can make Kyurem whole again.

items.en: If you help him with that, I'm sure he'll join you!
items.zh: 如果你帮助他，我相信他会加入你！
items.normEn: If you help him with that, I'm sure he'll join you!

items.en: If You Like It, Then You Should've Put a Ring on It
items.zh: 如果你喜欢它，那么你应该给它戴上戒指
items.normEn: If You Like It, Then You Should've Put a Ring on It

items.en: If you need this Memory, let's battle. I miss the times when you got in the way of my plans for Team Skull and I used to battle you. I'm not gonna lose this time.
items.zh: 如果你需要这份记忆，那就战斗吧。我怀念那些你妨碍我骷髅队计划的时光，我曾经与你战斗。这次我不会再输了
items.normEn: If you need this Memory, let's battle. I miss the times when you got in the way of my plans for Team Skull and I used to battle you. I'm not gonna lose this time.

items.en: If you obtained it by accident, please report it as a bug.
items.zh: 如果您意外获得它，请将其报告为错误。
items.normEn: If you obtained it by accident, please report it as a bug.

items.en: If you take down Team Rocket's leader one more time they will surely never come back from this! Clear Viridian City Gym.
items.zh: 如果你再打倒火箭队的队长，他们肯定就再也回不来了！清除常磐城道馆。
items.normEn: If you take down Team Rocket's leader one more time they will surely never come back from this! Clear Viridian City Gym.

items.en: If you train with your Pokémon, you will gain spiritual energy, or "Flow". You can use this Flow to purify your Pokémon.
items.zh: 如果你与你的神奇宝贝一起训练，你将获得精神能量，或“流动”。您可以使用此流程来净化您的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: If you train with your Pokémon, you will gain spiritual energy, or "Flow". You can use this Flow to purify your Pokémon.

items.en: If you want it that bad, you gotta earn it. I won't just hand it over to you. I'm starting from scratch as a Pokémon Trainer and doing it right this time, so you gotta show me what you're made of, in a battle. You and your Pokémon against me and mine! Are you up for the challenge, kid?
items.zh: 如果你那么想要它，你就必须赢得它。我不会只把它交给你。我从零开始担任神奇宝贝训练师，这次做得很好，所以你必须在战斗中向我展示你的实力。你和你的神奇宝贝对抗我和我的！孩子，你准备好迎接挑战了吗？
items.normEn: If you want it that bad, you gotta earn it. I won't just hand it over to you. I'm starting from scratch as a Pokémon Trainer and doing it right this time, so you gotta show me what you're made of, in a battle. You and your Pokémon against me and mine! Are you up for the challenge, kid?

items.en: If you want this Silvally Memory, you have to defeat me in a burning hot battle! It won't be easy, mind you. My babies are dying to play a set, and I won't be holding back! But if you truly have what it takes to be the champion, then you should be up for the challenge, yeah? Right on! Let's rock!
items.zh: 如果你想要这份希尔瓦利记忆，就必须在一场激烈的战斗中击败我！请注意，这并不容易。我的宝宝们非常想玩一套，我不会退缩的！但如果你真的有成为冠军的能力，那么你应该准备好迎接挑战，是吗？就在！让我们摇滚吧！
items.normEn: If you want this Silvally Memory, you have to defeat me in a burning hot battle! It won't be easy, mind you. My babies are dying to play a set, and I won't be holding back! But if you truly have what it takes to be the champion, then you should be up for the challenge, yeah? Right on! Let's rock!

items.en: If you want to catch it in that form, you would probably be best trying to attract it with a berry that electric Pokémon like.
items.zh: 如果你想以这种形式捕捉它，你最好尝试用电动神奇宝贝喜欢的浆果来吸引它。
items.normEn: If you want to catch it in that form, you would probably be best trying to attract it with a berry that electric Pokémon like.

items.en: If you want to change my mind... you will have to encounter at least 666 wild Gastly, 444 wild Haunter, and 13 wild Gengar.
items.zh: 如果你想改变我的想法……你至少要遇到666只野生恶鬼，444只野生鬼魂，13只野生耿鬼。
items.normEn: If you want to change my mind... you will have to encounter at least 666 wild Gastly, 444 wild Haunter, and 13 wild Gengar.

items.en: If you want to collect them all, wait for the weather to change.
items.zh: 如果你想收集全部，请等待天气变化。
items.normEn: If you want to collect them all, wait for the weather to change.

items.en: If you want to prove you can deal with such dangerous Pokémon safely, I suggest defeating the Orange League.
items.zh: 如果你想证明你可以安全地对付如此危险的神奇宝贝，我建议击败橙色联盟。
items.normEn: If you want to prove you can deal with such dangerous Pokémon safely, I suggest defeating the Orange League.

items.en: If you want to remove a Berry plant before it is fully grown, you can use a Shovel to uproot it. This will consume the Shovel. Using it on a ripe Berry, however, will function the same as a normal harvest, and the Shovel will not be consumed!
items.zh: 如果您想在浆果植物完全生长之前将其移除，可以使用铲子将其连根拔起。这会消耗铲子。然而，在成熟的浆果上使用它，其功能与正常收获相同，并且铲子不会被消耗！
items.normEn: If you want to remove a Berry plant before it is fully grown, you can use a Shovel to uproot it. This will consume the Shovel. Using it on a ripe Berry, however, will function the same as a normal harvest, and the Shovel will not be consumed!

items.en: If you want to remove a mulch, you can use Mulch Shovels. Using one will remove the full mulch effect, regardless of the time remaining.
items.zh: 如果您想去除覆盖物，可以使用覆盖物铲。无论剩余时间如何，使用一个都会消除完全覆盖效果。
items.normEn: If you want to remove a mulch, you can use Mulch Shovels. Using one will remove the full mulch effect, regardless of the time remaining.

items.en: If you wish to make use of them, you will require light from Solgaleo and Lunala respectively. I believe that they may drop the crystallised form of this light if you defeat them in battle! I believe each of them will be able to make good use of their own light, as well.
items.zh: 如果你想利用它们，你将分别需要索尔迦雷欧和月娜拉的光。我相信如果你在战斗中击败他们，他们可能会掉落这种光的结晶！我相信他们每个人也能够充分利用自己的光芒。
items.normEn: If you wish to make use of them, you will require light from Solgaleo and Lunala respectively. I believe that they may drop the crystallised form of this light if you defeat them in battle! I believe each of them will be able to make good use of their own light, as well.

items.en: If you won't leave, we'll have to remove you.
items.zh: 如果你不离开，我们就不得不把你开除。
items.normEn: If you won't leave, we'll have to remove you.

items.en: If you're here, it means you've heard the same news that I have: a meteor is headed towards this island.
items.zh: 如果你在这里，这意味着你听到了和我一样的消息：一颗流星正飞向这个岛屿。
items.normEn: If you're here, it means you've heard the same news that I have: a meteor is headed towards this island.

items.en: If you're interested, you should go take a look!
items.zh: 如果你有兴趣，你应该去看看！
items.normEn: If you're interested, you should go take a look!

items.en: If you're searching for the yellow and blue kinds, look no further than the Farm!
items.zh: 如果您正在寻找黄色和蓝色品种，农场就是您的最佳选择！
items.normEn: If you're searching for the yellow and blue kinds, look no further than the Farm!

items.en: Illegal activity is afoot. Clear the Rocket Game Corner in Celadon City.
items.zh: 非法活动正在进行中。清除青瓷城的火箭游戏角。
items.normEn: Illegal activity is afoot. Clear the Rocket Game Corner in Celadon City.

items.en: Importing this save will cause errors
items.zh: 导入此保存会导致错误
items.normEn: Importing this save will cause errors

items.en: Importing this save will cause errors!
items.normEn: Importing this save will cause errors!

items.en: Impressive! Your Pokémon fought with great courage. I can tell that you've trained your Pokémon well.
items.zh: 感人的！你的神奇宝贝勇敢地战斗。我看得出你的神奇宝贝训练得很好。
items.normEn: Impressive! Your Pokémon fought with great courage. I can tell that you've trained your Pokémon well.

items.zh: 感人的。你的功力是引人注目的。

items.en: Improved Hatchery and Pokédex loading times
items.zh: 改进了孵化场和图鉴加载时间
items.normEn: Improved Hatchery and Pokédex loading times

items.en: Improved load times for Pokédex and Hatchery
items.zh: 改进了 Pokédex 和 Hatchery 的加载时间
items.normEn: Improved load times for Pokédex and Hatchery

items.en: In addition, this is the Colress Machine No. 1199, officially dubbed the N-Lunarizer! It makes it possible for Necrozma to fuse with the light of the Legendary Pokémon, Lunala!
items.zh: 另外，这就是Colress Machine No.1199，正式名称为N-Lunarizer！它使奈克洛兹玛能够与传奇神奇宝贝露娜拉的光融合！
items.normEn: In addition, this is the Colress Machine No. 1199, officially dubbed the N-Lunarizer! It makes it possible for Necrozma to fuse with the light of the Legendary Pokémon, Lunala!

items.en: In all of Orre, I've never seen a Pokémon Trainer of your caliber. You appear to be the biggest threat to Cipher. To make sure my underlings watch you with caution, I give you the title “Cipher's Biggest Enemy.”
items.zh: 在整个欧雷，我从未见过像你这样水平的神奇宝贝训练家。你似乎是 Cipher 的最大威胁。为了确保我的下属小心翼翼地看着你，我给你起了“Cipher最大的敌人”的称号。
items.normEn: In all of Orre, I've never seen a Pokémon Trainer of your caliber. You appear to be the biggest threat to Cipher. To make sure my underlings watch you with caution, I give you the title “Cipher's Biggest Enemy.”

items.en: In any case, everyone in town will run away from you until you get yourself a Magikarp. So, go catch one, or fish one at the Pond. Then, the residents may be willing to talk to you.
items.zh: 无论如何，镇上的每个人都会逃离你，直到你得到一只鲤鱼王。所以，去池塘钓一只吧。然后，居民可能愿意与您交谈。
items.normEn: In any case, everyone in town will run away from you until you get yourself a Magikarp. So, go catch one, or fish one at the Pond. Then, the residents may be willing to talk to you.

items.en: In days of old, people worked the top-shaped pieces of this Berry free and used them as toys.
items.zh: 在过去，人们将这种浆果的顶部形状的碎片自由加工，并将其用作玩具。
items.normEn: In days of old, people worked the top-shaped pieces of this Berry free and used them as toys.

items.en: In its transformed state, Rayquaza's power was more devastating than ever before, overcoming even the super-ancient Pokémon with all their primal power.
items.zh: 在变形状态下，烈空坐的力量比以往任何时候都更具破坏性，甚至可以用它们所有的原始力量击败超古代神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: In its transformed state, Rayquaza's power was more devastating than ever before, overcoming even the super-ancient Pokémon with all their primal power.

items.en: In more normal times, I would bid you to let these three fly free as is their nature.
items.zh: 在正常情况下，我会请求你让这三个人按照他们的本性自由飞翔。
items.normEn: In more normal times, I would bid you to let these three fly free as is their nature.

items.en: In my spare time I like to play this kickass browser game. It takes ages to get all the best stuff.
items.zh: 在业余时间，我喜欢玩这个强大的浏览器游戏。需要很长时间才能获得所有最好的东西。
items.normEn: In my spare time I like to play this kickass browser game. It takes ages to get all the best stuff.

items.en: In my time in captivity, I learned that the new Grand Master of Team Cipher has used a powerful Shadow Pokémon to kidnap all the trainers and Pokémon from the S. S. Libra and has taken them to Citadark Island!
items.zh: 在我被囚禁期间，我得知密码队的新任大师使用强大的暗影神奇宝贝从S.S. Libra绑架了所有训练师和神奇宝贝，并将他们带到了Citadark岛！
items.normEn: In my time in captivity, I learned that the new Grand Master of Team Cipher has used a powerful Shadow Pokémon to kidnap all the trainers and Pokémon from the S. S. Libra and has taken them to Citadark Island!

items.en: In order to get the berries that mutate while using some Oak Items you can buy them in Johto berry master once you have unlocked the berry that evolves to them.
items.zh: 为了获得在使用一些橡树物品时变异的浆果，一旦你解锁了进化成它们的浆果，你可以在城都浆果大师中购买它们。
items.normEn: In order to get the berries that mutate while using some Oak Items you can buy them in Johto berry master once you have unlocked the berry that evolves to them.

items.en: In order to move on you will need to capture all available Pokémon from the current region!
items.zh: 为了继续前进，您需要捕获当前地区所有可用的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: In order to move on you will need to capture all available Pokémon from the current region!

items.en: In reality, those stones that line Route 10 are the graves of Pokémon. When the ultimate weapon was used to end that horrible war over 3,000 years ago, it stole the lives of all those Pokémon. Their lives were the price of peace then. And if we want to make our own wishes come true today, we in Team Flare also have to sacrifice something precious.
items.zh: 事实上，10号公路两旁的那些石头是神奇宝贝的坟墓。当终极武器被用来结束 3000 多年前那场可怕的战争时，它夺走了所有神奇宝贝的生命。他们的生命是当时和平的代价。而今天，如果我们想要实现自己的愿望，我们耀焰战队也必须牺牲一些宝贵的东西。
items.normEn: In reality, those stones that line Route 10 are the graves of Pokémon. When the ultimate weapon was used to end that horrible war over 3,000 years ago, it stole the lives of all those Pokémon. Their lives were the price of peace then. And if we want to make our own wishes come true today, we in Team Flare also have to sacrifice something precious.

items.en: In some scenario, multiple of your filters may meet all of their conditions, but only one can be used to choose a ball for catching.
items.zh: 在某些情况下，多个过滤器可能满足所有条件，但只有一个可以用于选择要接球的球。
items.normEn: In some scenario, multiple of your filters may meet all of their conditions, but only one can be used to choose a ball for catching.

items.en: In the farm you can plant and harvest Berries.
items.zh: 在农场里，您可以种植和收获浆果。
items.normEn: In the farm you can plant and harvest Berries.

items.en: In the near future, when I become the Governor of Orre, I shall appoint you as my official secretary. Let that be a motivation for you to constantly better your skills!
items.zh: 在不久的将来，当我成为奥尔州长时，我将任命你为我的正式秘书。让它成为你不断提高技能的动力！
items.normEn: In the near future, when I become the Governor of Orre, I shall appoint you as my official secretary. Let that be a motivation for you to constantly better your skills!

items.en: Include base farm timer during altered berry growth times
items.zh: 在改变浆果生长时间期间包括基础农场计时器
items.normEn: Include base farm timer during altered berry growth times

items.en: Including the 3 already here, there are 33 Gigantamax Pokémon. I imagine you'll need more than 200 Wishing Pieces to get all of 'em to show up.
items.zh: 加上已经在这里的 3 只，超极巨化神奇宝贝共有 33 只。我想你需要 200 多个许愿碎片才能让它们全部出现。
items.normEn: Including the 3 already here, there are 33 Gigantamax Pokémon. I imagine you'll need more than 200 Wishing Pieces to get all of 'em to show up.

items.en: Incorrect egg steps for several Pokémon
items.zh: 多个神奇宝贝的蛋步骤不正确
items.normEn: Incorrect egg steps for several Pokémon

items.en: Incorrect regions for some evolution items
items.zh: 某些进化项目的区域不正确
items.normEn: Incorrect regions for some evolution items

items.zh: 地牢中显示的训练师不正确

items.en: Increase dungeon tokens received when catching Pokémon
items.zh: 增加捕捉神奇宝贝时收到的地下城代币
items.normEn: Increase dungeon tokens received when catching Pokémon

items.en: Increase Farm wandering Pokémon shiny chance
items.zh: 增加农场流浪神奇宝贝闪亮的机会
items.normEn: Increase Farm wandering Pokémon shiny chance

items.en: Increase shiny chance for dungeon Pokémon
items.zh: 增加地下城神奇宝贝的闪亮几率
items.normEn: Increase shiny chance for dungeon Pokémon

items.en: Increase shiny chance when using an evolution item
items.zh: 使用进化物品时增加闪亮的机会
items.normEn: Increase shiny chance when using an evolution item

items.zh: 增加一些通知的显示时间

items.en: Increased catch rate at night time or in dungeons
items.zh: 夜间或地牢中的捕获率提高
items.normEn: Increased catch rate at night time or in dungeons

items.en: Increased catch rate by the light of the moon
items.normEn: Increased catch rate by the light of the moon

items.en: Increased catch rate for Pokémon captured more times, plus higher EV gains
items.zh: 提高了神奇宝贝的捕获率，捕获了更多次，并且获得了更高的 EV 增益
items.normEn: Increased catch rate for Pokémon captured more times, plus higher EV gains

items.en: Increased catch rate in water environments
items.zh: 提高水环境中的捕获率
items.normEn: Increased catch rate in water environments

items.en: Increased catch rate on earlier routes
items.zh: 提高早期路线的捕获率
items.normEn: Increased catch rate on earlier routes

items.en: Increased catch rate on fished Pokémon
items.zh: 提高了捕获的神奇宝贝的捕获率
items.normEn: Increased catch rate on fished Pokémon

items.en: Increased catch rate on routes with less Pokémon defeated
items.zh: 击败神奇宝贝较少的路线上的捕获率提高
items.normEn: Increased catch rate on routes with less Pokémon defeated

items.en: Increased catch rate on routes with more Pokémon defeated
items.zh: 打败更多神奇宝贝的路线上的捕获率提高
items.normEn: Increased catch rate on routes with more Pokémon defeated

items.en: Increased chance of undiscovered fossils appearing in the Underground
items.zh: 地下出现未被发现的化石的机会增加
items.normEn: Increased chance of undiscovered fossils appearing in the Underground

items.en: Increased roamer odds on specific routes changing every 8 hours, NPCs in certain towns will tell you the current route
items.zh: 每8小时改变一次特定路线的漫游几率增加，某些城镇的NPC会告诉你当前的路线
items.normEn: Increased roamer odds on specific routes changing every 8 hours, NPCs in certain towns will tell you the current route

items.zh: 增加了 Gem 图标的大小

items.en: Increases Berry harvest rate and replant chances.
items.zh: 提高浆果收获率和重新种植的机会。
items.normEn: Increases Berry harvest rate and replant chances.

items.en: Increases chance for Pokémon to drop rare hold items and chance to multiply loot from dungeon chests, for 30 seconds.
items.zh: 增加神奇宝贝掉落稀有物品的几率以及从地下城宝箱中获得大量战利品的几率，持续 30 秒。
items.normEn: Increases chance for Pokémon to drop rare hold items and chance to multiply loot from dungeon chests, for 30 seconds.

items.en: Increases the chance of berry mutations
items.normEn: Increases the chance of berry mutations

items.zh: 增加覆盖物的持续时间

items.en: Increases the growth rate of Berry plants.
items.zh: 提高浆果植物的生长速度。
items.normEn: Increases the growth rate of Berry plants.

items.en: Increases the minimum and maximum amount of treasures that can be found in a mine
items.zh: 增加矿井中可找到的宝藏的最小和最大数量
items.normEn: Increases the minimum and maximum amount of treasures that can be found in a mine

items.en: Increases the number of Berries harvested.
items.normEn: Increases the number of Berries harvested.

items.en: Increases the number of tiles the Bomb tool can target
items.zh: 增加炸弹工具可以瞄准的图块数量
items.normEn: Increases the number of tiles the Bomb tool can target

items.en: Increases the number of tiles the Bomb tool will mine
items.zh: 增加炸弹工具将挖掘的瓷砖数量
items.normEn: Increases the number of tiles the Bomb tool will mine

items.en: Increases the rate at which tools gain durability
items.zh: 提高工具获得耐用性的速度
items.normEn: Increases the rate at which tools gain durability

items.en: Indeed, even you can hardly expect to live for all time, surely, but she will be in your care for now.
items.zh: 确实，即使你也很难指望永远活着，但她现在会由你照顾。
items.normEn: Indeed, even you can hardly expect to live for all time, surely, but she will be in your care for now.

items.en: Indeed? Well, Hisui still holds more fascinating Pokémon.
items.zh: 的确？嗯，翡翠还拥有更迷人的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Indeed? Well, Hisui still holds more fascinating Pokémon.

items.en: Indicate HP buff when opening chests in Dungeons
items.zh: 在地下城中打开宝箱时显示生命值增益
items.normEn: Indicate HP buff when opening chests in Dungeons

items.en: Indicates a ${...}x${...} grid where at least one tile contains a treasure. The grid shrinks by two tiles in each direction every ${...} levels.
items.zh: 表示 ${...}x${...} 网格，其中至少有一个图块包含宝藏。每 ${...} 层，网格在每个方向上缩小两个图块。
items.normEn: Indicates a ${...}x${...} grid where at least one tile contains a treasure. The grid shrinks by two tiles in each direction every ${...} levels.

items.zh: 用 Pokérus 感染 1,000 个 Pokémon。
用 Pokérus 感染 100 个 Pokémon。
用 Pokérus 感染 20 个 Pokémon。
用 Pokérus 感染 250 个 Pokémon。
用 Pokérus 感染 50 个 Pokémon。

items.en: Instead of trying to make something outta nothing, you'd rather repeat the mistakes of the past, straight up? No, you're gonna add new mistakes on top—that really takes the cake. You guys need some imagination.
items.zh: 与其尝试从无到有，你宁愿直接重复过去的错误？不，你会在上面添加新的错误——这确实很困难。你们需要一点想象力。
items.normEn: Instead of trying to make something outta nothing, you'd rather repeat the mistakes of the past, straight up? No, you're gonna add new mistakes on top—that really takes the cake. You guys need some imagination.

items.en: Interacting with a Wanderer will earn you Farm Points whether you catch it or not. Successfully capturing one will net you Dungeon Tokens.
items.zh: 无论你是否抓住它，与流浪者互动都会为你赢得农场积分。成功捕获一个将为您带来地下城代币。
items.normEn: Interacting with a Wanderer will earn you Farm Points whether you catch it or not. Successfully capturing one will net you Dungeon Tokens.

items.en: Interrogate Hunter Doken in the Pyrite Building to find out who has taken Plusle, and where to.
items.zh: 审问黄铁矿大厦的猎人多肯，找出谁拿走了 Plusle，以及去了哪里。
items.normEn: Interrogate Hunter Doken in the Pyrite Building to find out who has taken Plusle, and where to.

items.en: Introduction to some gameplay elements added for new players
items.zh: 为新玩家添加的一些游戏元素介绍
items.normEn: Introduction to some gameplay elements added for new players

items.en: Invalid reset function used for '${...}' lazyLoad
items.zh: 用于“${...}”lazyLoad 的重置函数无效
items.normEn: Invalid reset function used for '${...}' lazyLoad

items.en: Invalidly-typed data detected in hatchery queue: ${...}
items.zh: 在孵化场队列中检测到无效类型的数据：${...}
items.normEn: Invalidly-typed data detected in hatchery queue: ${...}

items.en: Investigate Mt. Pyre for the source of the disturbances.
items.normEn: Investigate Mt. Pyre for the source of the disturbances.

items.en: Investigate the basement of the P2 Laboratory.
items.zh: 调查 P2 实验室的地下室。
items.normEn: Investigate the basement of the P2 Laboratory.

items.en: Investigate the commotion in Sootopolis City.
items.zh: 调查苏托波利斯市的骚乱。
items.normEn: Investigate the commotion in Sootopolis City.

items.en: Investigate the hidden message at the end of the Sealed Chamber maze.
items.zh: 调查密封室迷宫尽头的隐藏信息。
items.normEn: Investigate the hidden message at the end of the Sealed Chamber maze.

items.en: Investigate the legends surrounding the strange Burned Tower in Ecruteak City.
items.zh: 调查有关埃克鲁泰克市奇怪的烧毁之塔的传说。
items.normEn: Investigate the legends surrounding the strange Burned Tower in Ecruteak City.

items.zh: 调查完全普通的护卫舰。

items.en: Investigate the shrine in Ilex Forest.
items.zh: 调查冬青森林中的神社。
items.normEn: Investigate the shrine in Ilex Forest.

items.en: Investigate the strange markings in the Sealed Chamber.
items.zh: 调查密封室中的奇怪标记。
items.normEn: Investigate the strange markings in the Sealed Chamber.

items.en: Investigate the Time Distortion in Tohjo Falls.
items.zh: 调查东条瀑布的时间扭曲。
items.normEn: Investigate the Time Distortion in Tohjo Falls.

items.en: Is it... you're not here for me? You're here for $playername$? That's no fair! I'm the chosen one!
items.zh: 难道……你不是来找我的吗？你来这里是为了$playername$？这不公平！我就是被选中的人！
items.normEn: Is it... you're not here for me? You're here for $playername$? That's no fair! I'm the chosen one!

items.zh: 那个工作人员在外面吗？

items.en: Is That How I Use This?
items.normEn: Is That How I Use This?

items.en: Isn't your whole "thing" being helpful? We want to build a theme park to help fund the Pinkan Reserve, but this meddlesome twerp named Ash keeps getting in the way. He's even electrocuted us with his damn Pikachu!
items.zh: 难道你的整个“事情”没有帮助吗？我们想建造一个主题公园来为 Pinkan 保护区提供资金，但这个名叫 Ash 的爱管闲事的傻瓜一直在阻碍我们。他甚至用他那该死的皮卡丘电死了我们！
items.normEn: Isn't your whole "thing" being helpful? We want to build a theme park to help fund the Pinkan Reserve, but this meddlesome twerp named Ash keeps getting in the way. He's even electrocuted us with his damn Pikachu!

items.en: It also prevents Kasib from mutating.
items.zh: 它还可以防止 Kasib 发生突变。
items.normEn: It also prevents Kasib from mutating.

items.en: It appears you are not strong enough to defeat ${...}.
items.zh: 看来你还没有强大到足以击败${...}。
items.normEn: It appears you are not strong enough to defeat ${...}.

items.en: It can be found at a very cold place.
items.zh: 它可以在非常寒冷的地方找到。
items.normEn: It can be found at a very cold place.

items.en: It can't be! How could I have lost? I need to apologize to my partner...
items.zh: 不可能！我怎么会输呢？我要向我的伴侣道歉……
items.normEn: It can't be! How could I have lost? I need to apologize to my partner...

items.en: It changed form and flew off in the direction of the sea. Defeat Anomaly Mewtwo yet again.
items.zh: 它身形一变，朝着大海的方向飞去。再次击败异常超梦。
items.normEn: It changed form and flew off in the direction of the sea. Defeat Anomaly Mewtwo yet again.

items.en: It changes forms when the weather is drastically different.
items.zh: 当天气急剧变化时，它会改变形式。
items.normEn: It changes forms when the weather is drastically different.

items.en: It didn't mention it once? That's a shame.
items.zh: 一次都没提过吗？太可惜了。
items.normEn: It didn't mention it once? That's a shame.

items.en: It doesn't bother us a bit if Pokémon win or lose.
items.zh: 神奇宝贝的输赢对我们来说一点也不影响。
items.normEn: It doesn't bother us a bit if Pokémon win or lose.

items.en: It doesn't bother us a bit if the stolen Pokémon cry or beg.
items.zh: 如果被偷走的神奇宝贝哭泣或乞求，我们一点也不介意。
items.normEn: It doesn't bother us a bit if the stolen Pokémon cry or beg.

items.en: It doesn't bother us a bit if we have to use another Pokémon after one is defeated.
items.zh: 如果我们在打败一只神奇宝贝后不得不使用另一只神奇宝贝，这并不会打扰我们。
items.normEn: It doesn't bother us a bit if we have to use another Pokémon after one is defeated.

items.en: It doesn't matter though. There is no rest for us. Captain Mina is here with news, but she insists on battling you before she'll tell us anything.
items.zh: 不过没关系。我们没有休息。米娜队长带来了消息，但她坚持在告诉我们任何事情之前先与你战斗。
items.normEn: It doesn't matter though. There is no rest for us. Captain Mina is here with news, but she insists on battling you before she'll tell us anything.

items.en: It escaped to the west. Defeat Anomaly Mewtwo again.
items.zh: 它逃到了西方。再次击败异常超梦。
items.normEn: It escaped to the west. Defeat Anomaly Mewtwo again.

items.en: It flew off to a faraway region to hide in a large city. Defeat Anomaly Mewtwo yet again.
items.zh: 它飞到了很远的地方，躲进了一座大城市。再次击败异常超梦。
items.normEn: It flew off to a faraway region to hide in a large city. Defeat Anomaly Mewtwo yet again.

items.en: It flew off to the peak of a great mountain. Defeat Anomaly Mewtwo yet again.
items.zh: 它飞向了一座大山的山顶。再次击败异常超梦。
items.normEn: It flew off to the peak of a great mountain. Defeat Anomaly Mewtwo yet again.

items.en: It got lost in the desert sand.
items.normEn: It got lost in the desert sand.

items.en: It had a blue egg on its belly - I've definitely seen an egg like that before, back in Fiore.
items.zh: 它的腹部有一个蓝色的蛋——我以前在菲奥雷肯定见过这样的蛋。
items.normEn: It had a blue egg on its belly - I've definitely seen an egg like that before, back in Fiore.

items.en: It has a tendency to expand into nearby plots.
items.zh: 它有扩展到附近地块的趋势。
items.normEn: It has a tendency to expand into nearby plots.

items.en: It has a tendency to overtake nearby plants.
items.zh: 它有超越附近植物的趋势。
items.normEn: It has a tendency to overtake nearby plants.

items.en: It has a vibrant pink pigment, and it is found in such abundance on Pinkan Island that all Pokémon found there are colored Pink!
items.zh: 它具有鲜艳的粉红色颜料，在平坎岛上的数量如此之多，以至于在那里发现的所有神奇宝贝都是粉红色的！
items.normEn: It has a vibrant pink pigment, and it is found in such abundance on Pinkan Island that all Pokémon found there are colored Pink!

items.en: It has been said that Mewtwo can Mega Evolve. Search for clues on how to find its Mega Stones, so you can control this unrivaled power.
items.zh: 据说超梦可以超级进化。寻找有关如何找到超级宝石的线索，这样您就可以控制这种无与伦比的力量。
items.normEn: It has been said that Mewtwo can Mega Evolve. Search for clues on how to find its Mega Stones, so you can control this unrivaled power.

items.en: It has been spotted at some Lakes.
items.zh: 人们在一些湖泊中发现了它。
items.normEn: It has been spotted at some Lakes.

items.en: It has been spotted dancing in the moonlight.
items.zh: 有人发现它在月光下跳舞。
items.normEn: It has been spotted dancing in the moonlight.

items.en: It has been spotted in a swamp.
items.zh: 人们在沼泽地里发现了它。
items.normEn: It has been spotted in a swamp.

items.en: It has only just awoken... Where is it getting so much power from? And how much more will it gain when it does undergo Primal Reversion... C-continue your readings! Then report back!
items.zh: 它才刚刚苏醒……它哪里来的这么多力量？当它真正经历原始回归时，它会获得多少更多的东西……继续你的阅读！然后回来汇报！
items.normEn: It has only just awoken... Where is it getting so much power from? And how much more will it gain when it does undergo Primal Reversion... C-continue your readings! Then report back!

items.en: It hides in a dark Forest.
items.zh: 它隐藏在黑暗的森林中。
items.normEn: It hides in a dark Forest.

items.en: It is often used for pickles because of its very dry flavor. It can also be eaten raw for its provocative taste.
items.zh: 由于其味道非常干燥，因此常用于泡菜。由于其刺激性的味道，它也可以生吃。
items.normEn: It is often used for pickles because of its very dry flavor. It can also be eaten raw for its provocative taste.

items.en: It is said that this Berry grew lumps to help Pokémon grip it, allowing propagation farther afield.
items.zh: 据说这种浆果会长出肿块来帮助神奇宝贝抓住它，从而可以传播到更远的地方。
items.normEn: It is said that this Berry grew lumps to help Pokémon grip it, allowing propagation farther afield.

items.en: It is said that when Marshadow is defeated, it sometimes leaves behind a rare crystallized fragment of its shadow.
items.zh: 据说，当玛夏多被击败时，它有时会留下一块罕见的影子结晶碎片。
items.normEn: It is said that when Marshadow is defeated, it sometimes leaves behind a rare crystallized fragment of its shadow.

items.en: It is said that when the sour skin is peeled, this spicy Berry can be crushed to make medicine.
items.zh: 据说，剥去酸皮后，这种辛辣的浆果可以压碎入药。
items.normEn: It is said that when the sour skin is peeled, this spicy Berry can be crushed to make medicine.

items.en: it just allows you to enter codes received from the Discord bot.
items.zh: 它只允许您输入从 Discord 机器人收到的代码。
items.normEn: it just allows you to enter codes received from the Discord bot.

items.en: It looks like you've found Cobalion! Talk to them.
items.zh: 看来您找到了 Cobalion！与他们交谈。
items.normEn: It looks like you've found Cobalion! Talk to them.

items.en: It only counts as spinning, if you spin for some time...
items.zh: 它只算旋转，如果你旋转一段时间......
items.normEn: It only counts as spinning, if you spin for some time...

items.en: It only shows up amongst the most beautiful flowers.
items.zh: 它只出现在最美丽的花朵中。
items.normEn: It only shows up amongst the most beautiful flowers.

items.en: It ran right through here and went across Route 211, straight for Mt. Coronet.
items.zh: 就从这里穿过，穿过211国道，直奔皇冠山。
items.normEn: It ran right through here and went across Route 211, straight for Mt. Coronet.

items.en: It seems as though you have hit a roadblock in your Berry progress. Focus on other areas before returning.
items.zh: 看来你在 Berry 的进步中遇到了障碍。返回之前专注于其他领域。
items.normEn: It seems as though you have hit a roadblock in your Berry progress. Focus on other areas before returning.

items.en: It seems Green is irritated that you caught Mewtwo before she could. Defeat her in Cerulean Cave.
items.zh: 格林似乎对你抢在超梦之前抓住她感到恼火。在蔚蓝洞窟击败她。
items.normEn: It seems Green is irritated that you caught Mewtwo before she could. Defeat her in Cerulean Cave.

items.en: It seems Hau is outside on Route 3. Are you two having another battle?
items.zh: 豪好像就在3号公路外面。你们两个又在打架吗？
items.normEn: It seems Hau is outside on Route 3. Are you two having another battle?

items.en: It seems like this Dungeon's Genesect is choosing its Drive based on the Moon Cycle!
items.zh: 看来这个地下城的盖诺塞克特正在根据月球周期来选择驱动力！
items.normEn: It seems like this Dungeon's Genesect is choosing its Drive based on the Moon Cycle!

items.en: It seems Mustard still wants to talk to you? Talk to Mustard again at the Master Dojo.
items.zh: 看来芥末还想跟你说话？在大师道场再次与芥末交谈。
items.normEn: It seems Mustard still wants to talk to you? Talk to Mustard again at the Master Dojo.

items.en: It seems my ninja techniques will soon be consigned to history...
items.zh: 看来我的忍术很快就要成为历史了……
items.normEn: It seems my ninja techniques will soon be consigned to history...

items.en: It seems something is going on in Hammerlocke! Talk to Leon in Energy Plant.
items.zh: 哈默洛克似乎发生了什么事！与能源工厂的莱昂交谈。
items.normEn: It seems something is going on in Hammerlocke! Talk to Leon in Energy Plant.

items.en: It seems that Team Flare Grunt is holding the scientist captive, free him!
items.zh: 看来耀斑步兵队正在囚禁这位科学家，快释放他！
items.normEn: It seems that Team Flare Grunt is holding the scientist captive, free him!

items.en: It seems that... Suicune prefers a hilly place near water... Somewhere north. I don't know exactly where, yet. It will be just you and me! Who'll find it first? I challenge you!
items.zh: 看来……水君更喜欢靠近水的丘陵地带……北方的某个地方。我还不知道具体在哪里。只剩下你和我了！谁会先找到它？我挑战你！
items.normEn: It seems that... Suicune prefers a hilly place near water... Somewhere north. I don't know exactly where, yet. It will be just you and me! Who'll find it first? I challenge you!

items.en: It seems the undertow pulled me under... But I had a great time battling with you! You've earned this!
items.zh: 似乎是被一股暗流卷入了水中……不过，我和你战斗得很开心！这是你应得的！
items.normEn: It seems the undertow pulled me under... But I had a great time battling with you! You've earned this!

items.en: It seems they do not evolve into Galarian Cofagrigus, but a completely different Pokémon instead.
items.zh: 看来它们并没有进化成加拉利安科法格里格斯，而是完全不同的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: It seems they do not evolve into Galarian Cofagrigus, but a completely different Pokémon instead.

items.en: It seems to like hot places.
items.zh: 看来它很喜欢炎热的地方。
items.normEn: It seems to like hot places.

items.en: It seems you're pretty strong, $playername$. We'll let you help us since you were able to defeat us in a battle. Now, onto the plan. We'll start by searching for clues on where Kyurem might attack, so you'll start by looking around the Giant Chasm. Good luck in your endeavour, report back with your findings.
items.zh: 看起来你很强大，$playername$。既然你能在战斗中击败我们，我们就让你帮助我们。现在，开始执行计划。我们将首先寻找酋雷姆可能攻击地点的线索，所以你首先要环顾巨型裂谷。祝你一切顺利，报告你的发现。
items.normEn: It seems you're pretty strong, $playername$. We'll let you help us since you were able to defeat us in a battle. Now, onto the plan. We'll start by searching for clues on where Kyurem might attack, so you'll start by looking around the Giant Chasm. Good luck in your endeavour, report back with your findings.

items.en: It sounds like you encountered a Time Distortion. Celebi is sensitive to time, it must be distressed. I have heard rumors of something similar going on at Tohjo Falls. Maybe if you clear up that Time Distortion, Celebi will want to come out to play?
items.zh: 听起来你遇到了时间扭曲。雪拉比对时间很敏感，一定很心疼吧。我听说东城瀑布也发生过类似的事情。也许如果你清除了时间扭曲，雪拉比就会想出来玩？
items.normEn: It sounds like you encountered a Time Distortion. Celebi is sensitive to time, it must be distressed. I have heard rumors of something similar going on at Tohjo Falls. Maybe if you clear up that Time Distortion, Celebi will want to come out to play?

items.en: It takes a very experienced trainer to find it, though.
items.zh: 不过，需要非常有经验的培训师才能找到它。
items.normEn: It takes a very experienced trainer to find it, though.

items.en: It takes longer to grow than Berries such as Cheri. The smaller Berries taste better.
items.zh: 它的生长时间比樱桃等浆果更长。浆果越小味道越好。
items.normEn: It takes longer to grow than Berries such as Cheri. The smaller Berries taste better.

items.en: It usually lurks around the deepest layers of Mistralton Cave so you might be able to find it by exploring around here.
items.zh: 它通常潜伏在米斯特拉尔顿洞穴的最深处，因此您可以通过在这里探索来找到它。
items.normEn: It usually lurks around the deepest layers of Mistralton Cave so you might be able to find it by exploring around here.

items.en: It was a great sight to behold. They all went in different directions. I think they are just roaming the region now. My friend Trevor in Blackthorn City can tell you more.
items.zh: 这是一个很棒的景象。他们都走向了不同的方向。我认为他们现在只是在该地区漫游。我在黑荆棘城的朋友特雷弗可以告诉你更多。
items.normEn: It was a great sight to behold. They all went in different directions. I think they are just roaming the region now. My friend Trevor in Blackthorn City can tell you more.

items.en: It was an ambush! You have been followed to Nuvema Town, defeat the mysterious attackers and escape!
items.zh: 这是一场伏击！你被跟踪到努韦玛镇，击败神秘袭击者并逃脱！
items.normEn: It was an ambush! You have been followed to Nuvema Town, defeat the mysterious attackers and escape!

items.en: It was especially close to a kid named Samuel Oak. When he suddenly moved to Kanto, Celebi was quite sad. He never even said goodbye! I wonder what became of that boy. Maybe he knows more of where Celebi is right now. They certainly have Unfinished Business.
items.zh: 它与一个名叫塞缪尔·奥克的孩子尤其接近。当他突然搬到关东时，雪拉比相当伤心。他甚至没有说过再见！我想知道那个男孩后来怎么样了。也许他更清楚雪拉比现在在哪里。他们当然还有未竟的事业。
items.normEn: It was especially close to a kid named Samuel Oak. When he suddenly moved to Kanto, Celebi was quite sad. He never even said goodbye! I wonder what became of that boy. Maybe he knows more of where Celebi is right now. They certainly have Unfinished Business.

items.en: It will also only refund Vitamins you bought after hitting the price cap.
items.zh: 它还只会退还您在达到价格上限后购买的维生素。
items.normEn: It will also only refund Vitamins you bought after hitting the price cap.

items.en: It's a cave system just to the north of here, called the Max Lair. It's the only known place where you can catch wild Gigantamax Pokémon!
items.zh: 这是这里北面的一个洞穴系统，称为麦克斯巢穴。这是唯一已知的可以捕捉野生超极巨神奇宝贝的地方！
items.normEn: It's a cave system just to the north of here, called the Max Lair. It's the only known place where you can catch wild Gigantamax Pokémon!

items.en: It's a Pikachu on a surfboard!
items.zh: 这是冲浪板上的皮卡丘！
items.normEn: It's a Pikachu on a surfboard!

items.en: It's all because you ruffians had to go and save Galar from Eternatus!
items.zh: 这都是因为你们这些恶棍必须去从永恒之手手中拯救伽勒尔！
items.normEn: It's all because you ruffians had to go and save Galar from Eternatus!

items.en: It's been a while. You must be a formidable Trainer indeed if you are able to get Necrozma as one of your allies.
items.zh: 已经有一段时间了。如果你能让奈克洛兹玛成为你的盟友，你一定是一位强大的训练家。
items.normEn: It's been a while. You must be a formidable Trainer indeed if you are able to get Necrozma as one of your allies.

items.en: It's currently in a City full of Electric-type Pokémon.
items.zh: 它目前位于一个充满电属性神奇宝贝的城市中。
items.normEn: It's currently in a City full of Electric-type Pokémon.

items.en: It's currently raining heavily with thunder.
items.zh: 目前正下着大雨，还夹杂着雷声。
items.normEn: It's currently raining heavily with thunder.

items.en: It's flying around an overgrown place full of dreams.
items.zh: 它在充满梦想的杂草丛生的地方飞行。
items.normEn: It's flying around an overgrown place full of dreams.

items.en: It's frustrating to me as a member of the Elite Four, but it seems your strength is the real deal.
items.zh: 作为四强的一员，这让我很沮丧，但看来你的实力是货真价实的。
items.normEn: It's frustrating to me as a member of the Elite Four, but it seems your strength is the real deal.

items.en: It's hiding at a dark place.
items.zh: 它躲在一个黑暗的地方。
items.normEn: It's hiding at a dark place.

items.en: It's high up in the sky.
items.normEn: It's high up in the sky.

items.en: It's not like I've seen them or anything. Your friend Looker knew them from the description though. UB-04 Blade and UB-04 Blaster he called them. Kartana and Celesteela.
items.zh: 我好像没见过他们什么的。不过你的朋友 Looker 从描述中认识了他们。他称它们为 UB-04 Blade 和 UB-04 Blaster。卡塔娜和塞莱斯蒂拉。
items.normEn: It's not like I've seen them or anything. Your friend Looker knew them from the description though. UB-04 Blade and UB-04 Blaster he called them. Kartana and Celesteela.

items.en: It's obvious that the old history was better! It was right!
items.zh: 很明显，老历史更好！没错！
items.normEn: It's obvious that the old history was better! It was right!

items.en: It's on a collision course with an island north of Route 131. I've been tasked with finding a way to stop this meteor.
items.zh: 它正在与 131 号公路以北的一座岛屿相撞。我的任务是找到阻止这颗流星的方法。
items.normEn: It's on a collision course with an island north of Route 131. I've been tasked with finding a way to stop this meteor.

items.en: It's out on the other side of the forest! Just watch where you're going in the forest, 'K? It's easy to get lost! Anyhoo... Good luck with the hunt for Max Mushrooms! Catch you back at the dojo!
items.zh: 它在森林的另一边！只要注意你要在森林里去哪里，'K？很容易迷路！无论如何...祝你狩猎麦克斯蘑菇好运！到道场来接你！
items.normEn: It's out on the other side of the forest! Just watch where you're going in the forest, 'K? It's easy to get lost! Anyhoo... Good luck with the hunt for Max Mushrooms! Catch you back at the dojo!

items.en: It's over... Fools with no vision will continue to befoul this beautiful world. They will go on until the only thing left to do is squabble over the remaining scraps of hope...
items.zh: 结束了……没有远见的傻瓜将继续玷污这个美丽的世界。他们会继续下去，直到唯一能做的就是为剩下的希望而争吵……
items.normEn: It's over... Fools with no vision will continue to befoul this beautiful world. They will go on until the only thing left to do is squabble over the remaining scraps of hope...

items.en: It's sitting on a swaying pillar.
items.zh: 它坐在一根摇晃的柱子上。
items.normEn: It's sitting on a swaying pillar.

items.zh: 周围都是强大的宝可梦。

items.en: It's too bad, but it can't be helped... In order to solve the energy issue as soon as possible, we awakened Eternatus. But we couldn't control it. The Champion came to aid me, even at the cost of abandoning the match. Indeed, just like a knight in shining armor coming to rescue a princess from a dragon!
items.zh: 可惜了，但也没办法……为了尽快解决能源问题，我们觉醒了永恒。但我们无法控制它。冠军来帮助我，甚至不惜放弃比赛。确实，就像一位穿着闪亮盔甲的骑士从恶龙手中拯救公主一样！
items.normEn: It's too bad, but it can't be helped... In order to solve the energy issue as soon as possible, we awakened Eternatus. But we couldn't control it. The Champion came to aid me, even at the cost of abandoning the match. Indeed, just like a knight in shining armor coming to rescue a princess from a dragon!

items.en: It's truly spectacular... We're going to move the gemstone to our laboratory in Hoenn. If you like you can come with us, our lab is near the Battle Frontier. While we analyze the Gemstone you can use the local facilities.
items.zh: 这真是太壮观了……我们要把宝石搬到丰缘的实验室。如果你愿意的话可以跟我们一起去，我们的实验室就在战争边境附近。当我们分析宝石时，您可以使用当地的设施。
items.normEn: It's truly spectacular... We're going to move the gemstone to our laboratory in Hoenn. If you like you can come with us, our lab is near the Battle Frontier. While we analyze the Gemstone you can use the local facilities.

items.en: It's visiting an abandoned and spooky place.
items.zh: 它正在参观一个废弃而阴森的地方。
items.normEn: It's visiting an abandoned and spooky place.

items.en: It's weird, but… I don't get that down when I lose to you.
items.zh: 这很奇怪，但是……当我输给你时我就无法理解这一点。
items.normEn: It's weird, but… I don't get that down when I lose to you.

items.en: Item '${...}' created with invalid nonpositive base price, defaulting to Infinity
items.zh: 使用无效的非正基本价格创建的商品“${...}”，默认为无穷大
items.normEn: Item '${...}' created with invalid nonpositive base price, defaulting to Infinity

items.en: Item Bag & Pokedex entry UI refresh
items.zh: 物品袋和图鉴入口 UI 刷新
items.normEn: Item Bag & Pokedex entry UI refresh

items.en: Item is locked for selling, you first have to unlock it.
items.zh: 物品已锁定出售，您首先必须将其解锁。
items.normEn: Item is locked for selling, you first have to unlock it.

items.en: Item magnet now works in dungeons
items.zh: 物品磁铁现在可以在地下城中使用
items.normEn: Item magnet now works in dungeons

items.zh: 物品查找器没有找到我！

items.en: Items like these hold secrets. I’ll study this one closely.
items.zh: 诸如此类的物品都蕴藏着秘密。我会仔细研究这个。
items.normEn: Items like these hold secrets. I’ll study this one closely.

items.en: Its dryness is quite strong. As a result, its true deliciousness can't be appreciated by just eating one or two.
items.zh: 它的干燥性相当强。因此，它真正的美味不是吃一两颗就能体会到的。
items.normEn: Its dryness is quite strong. As a result, its true deliciousness can't be appreciated by just eating one or two.

items.en: Jackpot ×${...}! ${...} found an extra ${...} in the Mine!
items.normEn: Jackpot ×${...}! ${...} found an extra ${...} in the Mine!

items.en: Jackpot! ${...} found an extra ${...} in the Mine!
items.zh: 大奖！ ${...} 在矿井中发现了额外的 ${...}！
items.normEn: Jackpot! ${...} found an extra ${...} in the Mine!

items.en: Jasmine's Ampharos seems to be sick!
items.zh: 茉莉的安法洛斯好像生病了！
items.normEn: Jasmine's Ampharos seems to be sick!

items.en: Jirachi has escaped in the chaos and is roaming Hoenn. Catch Jirachi.
items.zh: 基拉祈在混乱中逃脱并在丰缘漫游。抓住基拉祈。
items.normEn: Jirachi has escaped in the chaos and is roaming Hoenn. Catch Jirachi.

items.en: Join the Discord server to join the conversation:
items.zh: 加入 Discord 服务器以加入对话：
items.normEn: Join the Discord server to join the conversation:

items.zh: Jump Champ 的精英联盟健身房
Jump Champ 的豪华联盟健身房
Jump Champ 的 Ultra League 健身房

items.en: Just as Alola has multiple islands, its dungeons have multiple floors! Hurry to the ladder to find your way to the next floor.
items.zh: 正如阿罗拉有多个岛屿一样，它的地下城也有多层！赶紧爬上梯子，找到通往下一层的路。
items.normEn: Just as Alola has multiple islands, its dungeons have multiple floors! Hurry to the ladder to find your way to the next floor.

items.en: Just as I'd expected! You are really drawing forth your Pokémon's power!... I suppose that's it. If winning in battles is strength, then believing that your Pokémon will come back and waiting for its return is also strength. Doing what you think is right no matter what anyone else says, like these guys do, is strength, too.
items.zh: 正如我所料！你真的在发挥你的神奇宝贝的力量！……我想就是这样。如果说战斗获胜是力量，那么相信自己的神奇宝贝会回来并等待它的回归也是力量。不管别人怎么说，做你认为正确的事情，就像这些人所做的那样，也是一种力量。
items.normEn: Just as I'd expected! You are really drawing forth your Pokémon's power!... I suppose that's it. If winning in battles is strength, then believing that your Pokémon will come back and waiting for its return is also strength. Doing what you think is right no matter what anyone else says, like these guys do, is strength, too.

items.en: Just Keep Swimming Just Keep Swimming - Oooo Shiny!
items.zh: Just Keep Swim Just Keep Swim - Oooo Shiny！
items.normEn: Just Keep Swimming Just Keep Swimming - Oooo Shiny!

items.en: Just last week a weird blue stone with a red center showed up. A rather slow-looking guy with a slowpoke found it first, and took it to the Pokémon Lab.
items.zh: 就在上周，一块带有红色中心的奇怪的蓝色宝石出现了。一个看起来很慢的家伙第一个发现了它，并把它带到了神奇宝贝实验室。
items.normEn: Just last week a weird blue stone with a red center showed up. A rather slow-looking guy with a slowpoke found it first, and took it to the Pokémon Lab.

items.en: Just last week they had an exhibit on a prehistoric bird and turtle! There was quite the crowd!
items.zh: 就在上周，他们举办了一场史前鸟类和海龟展览！现场人潮相当多！
items.normEn: Just last week they had an exhibit on a prehistoric bird and turtle! There was quite the crowd!

items.en: Just Making Sure No Rare Pokémon Flees
items.zh: 只是确保没有稀有神奇宝贝逃跑
items.normEn: Just Making Sure No Rare Pokémon Flees

items.en: Just what have you got that I don't?
items.normEn: Just what have you got that I don't?

items.en: Just when things were startin' to heat up, yo, I got surrounded by Diglett and beat up, yo!
items.zh: 正当事情开始升温的时候，哟，我被迪格利特包围了，殴打了，哟！
items.normEn: Just when things were startin' to heat up, yo, I got surrounded by Diglett and beat up, yo!

items.en: Just when you have him cornered, Evice calls in a helicopter. Watch him escape the Realgam Colosseum.
items.zh: 就在你把他逼到绝境时，埃维斯叫来了一架直升机。看着他逃离 Realgam 斗兽场。
items.normEn: Just when you have him cornered, Evice calls in a helicopter. Watch him escape the Realgam Colosseum.

items.en: Kahuna Hapu gave me that as a gift. She even told me how to use it, but I couldn't afford to buy a Silvally. You can keep it.
items.zh: 卡胡纳·哈普（Kahuna Hapu）把它作为礼物送给了我。她甚至告诉我如何使用它，但我买不起 Silvally。你可以保留它。
items.normEn: Kahuna Hapu gave me that as a gift. She even told me how to use it, but I couldn't afford to buy a Silvally. You can keep it.

items.en: Kahuna Nanu is challenging you to a Grand Trial in Malie City! Test your strength before you go to Aether by defeating him.
items.zh: Kahuna Nanu 正在马利市向您发起大审判！在前往以太之前击败他来测试你的力量。
items.normEn: Kahuna Nanu is challenging you to a Grand Trial in Malie City! Test your strength before you go to Aether by defeating him.

items.en: Kalos is beautiful right now! There will be no foolish actions if the number of people and Pokémon do not increase. That being said, the future isn't decided. You can't be sure each day will be like the one before.
items.zh: 卡洛斯现在很漂亮！如果人和神奇宝贝的数量不增加，就不会有愚蠢的行为。话虽如此，未来尚未决定。你无法确定每一天都会像前一天一样。
items.normEn: Kalos is beautiful right now! There will be no foolish actions if the number of people and Pokémon do not increase. That being said, the future isn't decided. You can't be sure each day will be like the one before.

items.en: Kanto Berry Master will no longer give duplicate Enigma Berry directional hints
items.zh: 关东浆果大师将不再给出重复的谜浆果方向提示
items.normEn: Kanto Berry Master will no longer give duplicate Enigma Berry directional hints

items.en: Kanto dock ship not showing on client
items.zh: 关东码头船未显示在客户端上
items.normEn: Kanto dock ship not showing on client

items.zh: 卡林的快速联盟健身房
添加了 Kecleon 全球战斗

items.en: Keep ‘em outside where they belong! I’ve heard those machines can attract Pokémon with Held Items more often, and even more so in Dungeons!
items.zh: 把它们放在它们所属的地方外面！我听说这些机器可以更频繁地吸引带有持有物品的神奇宝贝，在地下城中更是如此！
items.normEn: Keep ‘em outside where they belong! I’ve heard those machines can attract Pokémon with Held Items more often, and even more so in Dungeons!

items.en: Keep an eye out for new faces in familiar places!
items.zh: 在熟悉的地方留意新面孔！
items.normEn: Keep an eye out for new faces in familiar places!

items.en: Keep an eye out if you come across any of them.
items.zh: 如果您遇到其中任何一个，请留意。
items.normEn: Keep an eye out if you come across any of them.

items.en: Keep asking around and following the Happiny Egg-thief! It was heading south, towards Solaceon Town.
items.zh: 继续四处打听并追踪快乐蛋贼！它正向南行驶，前往索拉森镇。
items.normEn: Keep asking around and following the Happiny Egg-thief! It was heading south, towards Solaceon Town.

items.en: Keep chasing the Go-Rock Squad through the Eterna Forest, but... didn't they already pass that tree?
items.zh: 继续追着摇滚小队穿过永恒森林，但是……他们不是已经过了那棵树了吗？
items.normEn: Keep chasing the Go-Rock Squad through the Eterna Forest, but... didn't they already pass that tree?

items.en: Key Stone pricing adjusted - starts low and increases after each purchase until reaching a cap
items.zh: Key Stone 定价调整 - 起始价格较低，每次购买后价格上涨，直至达到上限
items.normEn: Key Stone pricing adjusted - starts low and increases after each purchase until reaching a cap

items.en: Kid, I have a deal for you! And for you alone. Here's your chance. I will sell you the secret Magikarp... For an unbelievable price.
items.zh: 孩子，我有一个交易给你！并且只为你一个人。这是你的机会。我会以令人难以置信的价格卖给你秘密的鲤鱼王。
items.normEn: Kid, I have a deal for you! And for you alone. Here's your chance. I will sell you the secret Magikarp... For an unbelievable price.

items.en: Kimono Girl Miki has given you a package containing 50 Ultra Balls.
items.zh: 和服女孩 Miki 给了你一个包含 50 个超级球的包裹。
items.normEn: Kimono Girl Miki has given you a package containing 50 Ultra Balls.

items.en: Knows the path to the boss, avoids random encounters when possible.
items.zh: 知道通往boss的路径，尽可能避免随机遭遇。
items.normEn: Knows the path to the boss, avoids random encounters when possible.

items.en: Knows the shortest path to the boss!
items.normEn: Knows the shortest path to the boss!

items.en: Kyogre and Groudon are rumored to live deep within this very cave, but they are unlikely to show themselves to any normal trainer. Maybe the champion of Hoenn could earn their respect.
items.zh: 据传盖欧卡和固拉多就住在这个洞穴的深处，但他们不太可能在任何普通训练师面前露面。也许丰缘的冠军可以赢得他们的尊重。
items.normEn: Kyogre and Groudon are rumored to live deep within this very cave, but they are unlikely to show themselves to any normal trainer. Maybe the champion of Hoenn could earn their respect.

items.en: Kyogre and Groudon will only appear in their dungeon after defeating the Hoenn Elite 4
items.zh: 盖欧卡和固拉多只有在击败丰缘精英 4 后才会出现在他们的地下城中
items.normEn: Kyogre and Groudon will only appear in their dungeon after defeating the Hoenn Elite 4

items.zh: 酋雷姆形态现在可以获得

items.en: Kyurem has injured the Swords of Justice, go check on Cobalion.
items.zh: 酋雷姆伤害了正义之剑，去看看科巴拉恩吧。
items.normEn: Kyurem has injured the Swords of Justice, go check on Cobalion.

items.en: Kyurem is probably hiding in the Giant Chasm. Find its lair.
items.zh: 酋雷姆很可能就藏在巨大裂缝中。找到它的巢穴。
items.normEn: Kyurem is probably hiding in the Giant Chasm. Find its lair.

items.en: Lag caused by sorting by Pokémon attack
items.zh: 因神奇宝贝攻击造成的排序延迟
items.normEn: Lag caused by sorting by Pokémon attack

items.en: Lake of the Sunne and Moone
items.normEn: Lake of the Sunne and Moone

items.en: Lake Valor's guardian was taken. Better try again at the next lake. Clear Lake Verity.
items.zh: 英勇湖的守护者被带走。最好在下一个湖再试一次。清澈的真实湖。
items.normEn: Lake Valor's guardian was taken. Better try again at the next lake. Clear Lake Verity.

items.en: Lake Verity's guardian was also taken. Only one lake remains. Clear Lake Acuity.
items.zh: 惟真湖的守护者也被带走。仅存一湖。清澈的湖敏锐度。
items.normEn: Lake Verity's guardian was also taken. Only one lake remains. Clear Lake Acuity.

items.en: Land vs Water questline in Hoenn
items.zh: 丰缘的陆地与水任务线
items.normEn: Land vs Water questline in Hoenn

items.en: Last I saw, she was headed towards Mt. Chimney. Hopefully she messes up Maxie's day too! At least she didn't take the.... uuh...
items.zh: 我上次看到时，她正朝烟囱山走去。希望她也把马克西的一天搞砸了！至少她没有接受……呃……
items.normEn: Last I saw, she was headed towards Mt. Chimney. Hopefully she messes up Maxie's day too! At least she didn't take the.... uuh...

items.en: Last time they were spotted they just roamed around, causing all kinds of mischief. According to my books anyway. I'm sure that amazing trainer from the TV will want to catch these mighty forces of nature.
items.zh: 上次被发现时，它们只是四处游荡，造成各种恶作剧。无论如何，根据我的书。我确信电视上那位出色的训练师会想要捕捉这些强大的自然力量。
items.normEn: Last time they were spotted they just roamed around, causing all kinds of mischief. According to my books anyway. I'm sure that amazing trainer from the TV will want to catch these mighty forces of nature.

items.en: Lastly, Landorus, the Pokémon hailed as the Guardian of the Fields. It seems it can be glimpsed in the Obsidian Fieldlands. Perhaps you'd be so good as to catch it for me?
items.zh: 最后是被称为大地守护者的神奇宝贝 Landorus。似乎可以在黑曜石平原中瞥见它。也许你愿意帮我抓住它？
items.normEn: Lastly, Landorus, the Pokémon hailed as the Guardian of the Fields. It seems it can be glimpsed in the Obsidian Fieldlands. Perhaps you'd be so good as to catch it for me?

items.zh: 拉帝亚斯还是拉帝欧斯

items.en: Learn about the powerful Pokémon discovered under the P2 Laboratory.
items.zh: 了解 P2 实验室发现的强大神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Learn about the powerful Pokémon discovered under the P2 Laboratory.

items.en: Learn more about Nebby's origins with Lillie on Ula'Ula Island.
items.zh: 了解更多有关纳比与乌拉乌拉岛上的莉莉的起源的信息。
items.normEn: Learn more about Nebby's origins with Lillie on Ula'Ula Island.

items.en: Learn more about the heroes who stopped The Darkest Day.
items.zh: 了解有关阻止“至暗之日”的英雄的更多信息。
items.normEn: Learn more about the heroes who stopped The Darkest Day.

items.en: Learn the legend of the Millennium Comet from Butler near Lavaridge Town.
items.zh: 向拉瓦里奇镇附近的巴特勒了解千年彗星的传说。
items.normEn: Learn the legend of the Millennium Comet from Butler near Lavaridge Town.

items.en: Leave button won't appear in Dungeon until the player has moved
items.zh: 在玩家移动之前，离开按钮不会出现在地牢中
items.normEn: Leave button won't appear in Dungeon until the player has moved

items.en: Leave me alone. I need my coffee.
items.zh: 请别打扰我。我需要我的咖啡。
items.normEn: Leave me alone. I need my coffee.

items.en:
Leave the dungeon?

Current progress will be lost, but you will keep any items obtained from chests.
items.zh: 离开地牢？当前进度将会丢失，但您将保留从箱子中获得的所有物品。
items.normEn: Leave the dungeon? Current progress will be lost, but you will keep any items obtained from chests.

items.en: Left click to give, Right click to take
items.zh: 左键点击给予，右键点击获取
items.normEn: Left click to give, Right click to take

items.zh: 左-左-右-右-A-B-A-B - 嘿，一百万！

items.en: Legends of Pokémon appearing from the Ultra Wormhole also exist and are called Ultra Beasts, but it's all legends and folktales. It's hard to know how much is true.
items.zh: 从究极虫洞中出现的神奇宝贝的传说也存在，被称为究极异兽，但那都是传说和民间故事。很难知道有多少是真实的。
items.normEn: Legends of Pokémon appearing from the Ultra Wormhole also exist and are called Ultra Beasts, but it's all legends and folktales. It's hard to know how much is true.

items.en: Legends say Kyurem is missing a part of itself. It is waiting for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with Truth or Ideals.
items.zh: 传说酋雷姆失去了自身的一部分。它正在等待英雄用真理或理想来填补它身体缺失的部分。
items.normEn: Legends say Kyurem is missing a part of itself. It is waiting for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with Truth or Ideals.

items.en: Legends say that when the Brass Tower burned down and became the Burned Tower, three unnamed Pokémon perished in the flames...
items.zh: 传说，当黄铜塔被烧毁并成为烧毁的塔时，三只无名的神奇宝贝在火焰中丧生......
items.normEn: Legends say that when the Brass Tower burned down and became the Burned Tower, three unnamed Pokémon perished in the flames...

items.en: Legends tell of a mysterious Berry that only appears in a field of ${...} Berries.
items.zh: 传说有一种神秘的浆果，只出现在 ${...} 浆果田里。
items.normEn: Legends tell of a mysterious Berry that only appears in a field of ${...} Berries.

items.en: Legends tell of a mysterious Berry that only appears while surrounded by all types of Berries.
items.zh: 传说有一种神秘的浆果，只有在被各种浆果包围时才会出现。
items.normEn: Legends tell of a mysterious Berry that only appears while surrounded by all types of Berries.

items.en: Leon failed to capture Eternatus. Defeat it before it can cause any more damage!
items.zh: 莱昂未能捕获永恒。在它造成更多伤害之前击败它！
items.normEn: Leon failed to capture Eternatus. Defeat it before it can cause any more damage!

items.en: Let me guess, you're after this Silvally Memory I found around here, aren't you? I can tell by the way you carry yourself. You're not like the rest of the tourists and challengers who come here just for a sightseeing or a battle. You're on a mission, right?
items.zh: 让我猜猜，你正在寻找我在这里找到的西尔瓦利记忆，不是吗？从你的举止我就能看出来。你不像其他游客和挑战者那样来这里只是为了观光或战斗。你正在执行任务，对吧？
items.normEn: Let me guess, you're after this Silvally Memory I found around here, aren't you? I can tell by the way you carry yourself. You're not like the rest of the tourists and challengers who come here just for a sightseeing or a battle. You're on a mission, right?

items.en: Let me see your progress...Ah, fantastic, as usual!
items.zh: 让我看看你的进步...啊，太棒了，和往常一样！
items.normEn: Let me see your progress...Ah, fantastic, as usual!

items.en: Let me tell you though, in my youth, I was strong enough to beat Viridian City's Gym, so don't expect me to be a pushover.
items.zh: 不过我告诉你，在我年轻的时候，我的实力足以击败常磐城的道馆，所以你别指望我是个容易被欺负的人。
items.normEn: Let me tell you though, in my youth, I was strong enough to beat Viridian City's Gym, so don't expect me to be a pushover.

items.en: Let's go back to the Slumbering Weald! If we're lucky, we'll find something that can help!
items.zh: 让我们回到沉睡的森林吧！如果幸运的话，我们会找到一些有用的东西！
items.normEn: Let's go back to the Slumbering Weald! If we're lucky, we'll find something that can help!

items.en: Let's Go mons not showing in Pokémon list
items.zh: Let's Go mons 未出现在神奇宝贝列表中
items.normEn: Let's Go mons not showing in Pokémon list

items.en: Let's make a deal first though: If I defeat you, you'll let us do our experiments on that thing and leave us alone forever, but if you defeat me I'll give that Memory to you. Sounds like a deal? Then let's see if you can take the new Faba!
items.zh: 不过，我们先做个协议：如果我打败了你，你就让我们对那东西进行实验，然后永远别打扰我们，但如果你打败了我，我就把那段记忆给你。听起来像是一笔交易？那就看看你能不能拿下新蚕豆吧！
items.normEn: Let's make a deal first though: If I defeat you, you'll let us do our experiments on that thing and leave us alone forever, but if you defeat me I'll give that Memory to you. Sounds like a deal? Then let's see if you can take the new Faba!

items.en: Let's make one thing clear: I didn't lose! You may have won...but there's a difference!
items.zh: 让我们澄清一件事：我没有输！你可能赢了……但有区别！
items.normEn: Let's make one thing clear: I didn't lose! You may have won...but there's a difference!

items.en: Let's See How High the Catch Rate Becomes
items.normEn: Let's See How High the Catch Rate Becomes

items.en: Let's see if we can find out more in Pyrite Town.
items.zh: 让我们看看能否在黄铁矿镇找到更多信息。
items.normEn: Let's see if we can find out more in Pyrite Town.

items.en: Let's Try Some Other Helpers Too?
items.zh: 我们也试试其他一些助手吗？
items.normEn: Let's Try Some Other Helpers Too?

items.en: Level 1 Oak Item to the maximum level.
items.normEn: Level 1 Oak Item to the maximum level.

items.en: Level 11 Oak Items to the maximum level.
items.normEn: Level 11 Oak Items to the maximum level.

items.en: Level 3 Oak Items to the maximum level.
items.normEn: Level 3 Oak Items to the maximum level.

items.en: Level 8 Oak Items to the maximum level.
items.normEn: Level 8 Oak Items to the maximum level.

items.en: Level all 12 Oak Items to the maximum level.
items.zh: 将所有 12 个橡木物品升级至最高级别。
items.normEn: Level all 12 Oak Items to the maximum level.

items.en: Level up Kubfu in both of the Towers of Two Fists to obtain Urshifu!
items.zh: 在双拳之塔中升级 Kubfu 以获得 Urshifu！
items.normEn: Level up Kubfu in both of the Towers of Two Fists to obtain Urshifu!

items.en: Lillie has run into a Team Skull grunt at Aether House. Politely beat up his Pokémon.
items.zh: 莉莉在以太之家遇到了骷髅队的步兵。礼貌地殴打了他的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Lillie has run into a Team Skull grunt at Aether House. Politely beat up his Pokémon.

items.en: Lillie needs your help. Continue past Route 3 and clear Melemele Meadow.
items.zh: 莉莉需要你的帮助。继续经过 3 号公路并清理 Melemele Meadow。
items.normEn: Lillie needs your help. Continue past Route 3 and clear Melemele Meadow.

items.en: Lillie still has something on her mind. Talk to her in Iki Town.
items.zh: 莉莉心里还有事。在壹岐镇与她交谈。
items.normEn: Lillie still has something on her mind. Talk to her in Iki Town.

items.en: Lillie? And she plans to visit Ula'ula's ruins? Well, that's some fine initiative. I'd be happy to show her the way whenever she'd like to go.
items.zh: 莉莉？她计划参观乌拉乌拉的废墟吗？嗯，这是一个很好的举措。每当她想去的时候，我很乐意为她带路。
items.normEn: Lillie? And she plans to visit Ula'ula's ruins? Well, that's some fine initiative. I'd be happy to show her the way whenever she'd like to go.

items.en: Limit maximum Quest Points for Dungeon and Gym quests
items.zh: 限制地下城和道馆任务的最大任务点数
items.normEn: Limit maximum Quest Points for Dungeon and Gym quests

items.en: Links on the Save Selector screen will now open in a new tab
items.zh: 保存选择器屏幕上的链接现在将在新选项卡中打开
items.normEn: Links on the Save Selector screen will now open in a new tab

items.en: Listen here! Neither I nor Skuntank admit defeat to you just yet-our challenge to you still stands!
items.zh: 听这里！我和臭鼬都不承认输给你——我们对你的挑战仍然存在！
items.normEn: Listen here! Neither I nor Skuntank admit defeat to you just yet-our challenge to you still stands!

items.en: Listen well! We swore to be loyal to Lord Ghetsis since he saved us! The only thing we want is the world Lord Ghetsis desires! Even if we lose, Lord Ghetsis simply has to win...
items.zh: 好好听！自从盖齐斯勋爵救了我们之后，我们就发誓效忠他！我们唯一想要的就是盖西斯勋爵所渴望的世界！即使我们输了，盖齐斯大人也必须赢……
items.normEn: Listen well! We swore to be loyal to Lord Ghetsis since he saved us! The only thing we want is the world Lord Ghetsis desires! Even if we lose, Lord Ghetsis simply has to win...

items.en: Listen, trainer who will face Lysandre. A terribly long time ago... There was a man and a Pokémon. A war began. The man's beloved Pokémon took part in the war.
items.zh: 听着，即将面对莱桑德尔的训练师。很久以前……有一个男人和一只神奇宝贝。一场战争开始了。男人心爱的神奇宝贝参加了战争。
items.normEn: Listen, trainer who will face Lysandre. A terribly long time ago... There was a man and a Pokémon. A war began. The man's beloved Pokémon took part in the war.

items.en: Lo and behold, here in Galar the Farfetch’d wield thick, tough leeks for battle!
items.zh: 你瞧，在伽勒尔，法费奇在战斗中挥舞着又粗又硬的韭菜！
items.normEn: Lo and behold, here in Galar the Farfetch’d wield thick, tough leeks for battle!

items.en: Locate the Ruby. Clear Ruby Path in Mt. Ember.
items.zh: 找到红宝石。清理余烬山的红宝石之路。
items.normEn: Locate the Ruby. Clear Ruby Path in Mt. Ember.

items.en: Locations of several Pokémon have been adjusted

items.zh: 现在可以按事件类型过滤日志
items.normEn: Log book can now be filtered by event type

items.zh: 农场的日志流浪神奇宝贝

items.en: Long ago, Cosmog was called the child of the stars. Its powers seem to have some connection with Ultra Wormholes.
items.zh: 很久以前，科斯莫格被称为星星之子。它的力量似乎与究极虫洞有某种联系。
items.normEn: Long ago, Cosmog was called the child of the stars. Its powers seem to have some connection with Ultra Wormholes.

items.en: Long, long ago, the king of Kalos sought to take everything for his own, and he created a terrible weapon. Then the fire of destruction was unleashed... That is the legend that has been passed down.
items.zh: 很久很久以前，卡洛斯国王试图将一切据为己有，他创造了一种可怕的武器。然后毁灭之火被释放出来……那就是流传下来的传说。
items.normEn: Long, long ago, the king of Kalos sought to take everything for his own, and he created a terrible weapon. Then the fire of destruction was unleashed... That is the legend that has been passed down.

items.en: Look at the two of you. I think this might just work out. No, I am quite sure of it!
items.zh: 看看你们两个。我想这可能会成功。不，我非常确定！
items.normEn: Look at the two of you. I think this might just work out. No, I am quite sure of it!

items.en: Look for Blue's old rival in Cerulean Cave
items.zh: 去蔚蓝洞窟寻找小蓝的老对手
items.normEn: Look for Blue's old rival in Cerulean Cave

items.en: Looker will stay here to coordinate reinforcements if needed. You can ask him about the special Beast Balls you will be using on this mission. I have given you a couple of them, but they are expensive so you will have to pitch in if you need more.
items.zh: 如果需要的话，卢克将留在这里协调增援。你可以向他询问你将在这次任务中使用的特殊兽球。我已经给了你几个，但它们很贵，所以如果你需要更多，你就得帮忙了。
items.normEn: Looker will stay here to coordinate reinforcements if needed. You can ask him about the special Beast Balls you will be using on this mission. I have given you a couple of them, but they are expensive so you will have to pitch in if you need more.

items.en: Looker's informants told us about monster sightings on Poni Island. It seems UB Assembly and UB Burst, Stakataka and Blacephalon, have taken up residence.
items.zh: Looker 的线人告诉我们有关波尼岛怪物目击事件。 UB Assembly 和 UB Burst、Stakataka 和 Blacephalon 似乎已经入驻。
items.normEn: Looker's informants told us about monster sightings on Poni Island. It seems UB Assembly and UB Burst, Stakataka and Blacephalon, have taken up residence.

items.en: Looks like another piece for my ultimate collection!
items.zh: 看起来像是我终极收藏的另一件作品！
items.normEn: Looks like another piece for my ultimate collection!

items.en: Looks like Cobalion has seen Kyurem near Lacunosa Town. Go there and defeat Kyurem before it hurts any citizens.
items.zh: 看起来Cobalion在拉库诺萨镇附近看到了酋雷姆。前往那里并在酋雷姆伤害任何公民之前击败它。
items.normEn: Looks like Cobalion has seen Kyurem near Lacunosa Town. Go there and defeat Kyurem before it hurts any citizens.

items.en: Looks like I’ve struck crystal gold! Finders keepers, right?
items.zh: 看来我挖到了水晶金！发现者守门员，对吗？
items.normEn: Looks like I’ve struck crystal gold! Finders keepers, right?

items.en: Looks like I’ve uncovered another legendary find. I’ll hold onto it for safekeeping.
items.zh: 看来我又发现了一个传奇的发现。我会妥善保管它。
items.normEn: Looks like I’ve uncovered another legendary find. I’ll hold onto it for safekeeping.

items.en: Looks like that didn't do it. But don't lose your hopes yet! I was just told that Regigigas appeared in Giant's Bed! Probably somethin' to do with you catching those other three. Anyway! You should go on and catch it!
items.zh: 看来这并没有做到。但不要失去希望！我刚刚听说雷吉加斯出现在巨人之床上！可能和你抓住另外三个人有关。反正！你应该继续追赶它！
items.normEn: Looks like that didn't do it. But don't lose your hopes yet! I was just told that Regigigas appeared in Giant's Bed! Probably somethin' to do with you catching those other three. Anyway! You should go on and catch it!

items.en: Lostelle has been found. Return to the Game Corner owner on Two Island.
items.zh: 洛斯泰尔被发现了。返回到两岛的游戏角所有者那里。
items.normEn: Lostelle has been found. Return to the Game Corner owner on Two Island.

items.en: Lots of people come through here to take a stroll, and some come from far away to participate in our Bug Catching Contest!
items.zh: 很多人经过这里散步，也有远道而来参加我们的捉虫大赛的！
items.normEn: Lots of people come through here to take a stroll, and some come from far away to participate in our Bug Catching Contest!

items.en: Luckily I was able to use the code REFUND-VITAMINS to get my money back! Too bad it only has one use though...

items.normEn: Luckily I was able to use the code REFUND-VITAMINS to get my money back! Too bad it only has one use though...

items.normEn: Luckily my Ampharos was already strong enough to use it!
