items.zh: Lucky Punch 持有的物品直到伽勒尔才可用
items.normEn: Lucky Punch held item not available until Galar

items.en: Lucky! ${...} found an extra ${...} in the Mine!
items.zh: 幸运的！ ${...} 在矿井中发现了额外的 ${...}！
items.normEn: Lucky! ${...} found an extra ${...} in the Mine!

items.en: Lusamine is using Nebby to open an Ultra Wormhole! Defeat her in the Aether Foundation dungeon to put a stop to this.
items.zh: 露莎米奈正在利用内比打开究极虫洞！在以太基金会地牢中击败她以阻止这一切。
items.normEn: Lusamine is using Nebby to open an Ultra Wormhole! Defeat her in the Aether Foundation dungeon to put a stop to this.

items.en: Lusamine's interference summoned not one, but two Necrozma! That egotistical woman! You have driven one away and our Pokémon is safe, but the other is still in possession of that girl's "Nebby" and has taken on its true form!
items.zh: 露莎米奈的干扰召唤出的不是一只，而是两只奈克洛兹玛！那个自私的女人！你赶走了一只，我们的神奇宝贝安全了，但另一只仍然拥有那个女孩的“Nebby”并且呈现出它的真实形态！
items.normEn: Lusamine's interference summoned not one, but two Necrozma! That egotistical woman! You have driven one away and our Pokémon is safe, but the other is still in possession of that girl's "Nebby" and has taken on its true form!

items.en: Lysandre appears menacingly in front of you in Team Flare Secret HQ. He doesn't seem fazed about you subsiding both legendary Pokémon.
items.zh: 莱桑德尔（Lysandre）威胁性地出现在耀斑小队秘密总部的你面前。他似乎并不担心你资助两只传奇神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Lysandre appears menacingly in front of you in Team Flare Secret HQ. He doesn't seem fazed about you subsiding both legendary Pokémon.

items.en: Lysandre is calling you while you are standing in Coumarine City, pick up the phone.
items.zh: 当你站在香豆城时，莱桑德尔正在给你打电话，请拿起电话。
items.normEn: Lysandre is calling you while you are standing in Coumarine City, pick up the phone.

items.en: Lysandre is giving an important speech through the TV News. Watch it in Anistar City.
items.zh: 莱桑德尔正在通过电视新闻发表重要演讲。在安妮斯塔城观看。
items.normEn: Lysandre is giving an important speech through the TV News. Watch it in Anistar City.

items.en: Man! I lost... You've become way too tough! But, I'm gonna get stronger, too!
items.zh: 男人！我输了……你太强硬了！但是，我也会变得更强！
items.normEn: Man! I lost... You've become way too tough! But, I'm gonna get stronger, too!

items.en: Man! I was really having fun doing these crimes.

items.zh: 我可以请你帮我拿点药吗？请？
items.normEn: May I ask you to get some medicine for me? Please?

items.en: Maybe beating the Pokémon isn't enough. Try catching some of these Psychic Pokémon.
items.zh: 也许击败神奇宝贝还不够。尝试捕捉一些通灵神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Maybe beating the Pokémon isn't enough. Try catching some of these Psychic Pokémon.

items.en: Maybe if you can prove yourself by conquering that island, you could find Cresselia roaming around the region...
items.zh: 也许如果你能通过征服那个岛屿来证明自己，你会发现克雷色利亚在该地区漫游......
items.normEn: Maybe if you can prove yourself by conquering that island, you could find Cresselia roaming around the region...

items.en: Maybe if you caught them, the other ruins would open? What? You already have? Well, it might be worth doing it again, anyway.
items.zh: 也许如果你抓住了他们，其他遗迹就会打开？什么？你已经有了？好吧，无论如何，也许值得再做一次。
items.normEn: Maybe if you caught them, the other ruins would open? What? You already have? Well, it might be worth doing it again, anyway.

items.en: Maybe Just a Few More for the Bunker
items.zh: 也许只是为了掩体再多一些
items.normEn: Maybe Just a Few More for the Bunker

items.en: Maybe my mask... kept me from seeing just how strong you really are...
items.zh: 也许是我的面具……让我看不到你到底有多坚强……
items.normEn: Maybe my mask... kept me from seeing just how strong you really are...

items.en: Maybe once all the regions are added that will be version
items.zh: 也许一旦添加了所有区域，这将是版本
items.normEn: Maybe once all the regions are added that will be version

items.en: Maybe the Pokémon themselves really are still asleep somewhere. So it seems we're on our own if we want to go help Lee. This is all the help we've got!
items.zh: 也许神奇宝贝本身真的还在某个地方沉睡着。所以看来如果我们想帮助李的话就只能靠我们自己了。这就是我们能得到的全部帮助了！
items.normEn: Maybe the Pokémon themselves really are still asleep somewhere. So it seems we're on our own if we want to go help Lee. This is all the help we've got!

items.en: Maybe they're regional variants or somethin'? At any rate, that's good enough for me. Let's call this expedition a success!
items.zh: 也许它们是区域变体或其他什么？无论如何，这对我来说已经足够好了。预祝本次考察取得圆满成功！
items.normEn: Maybe they're regional variants or somethin'? At any rate, that's good enough for me. Let's call this expedition a success!

items.en: Mayor Karp will be proud of you!
items.zh: 卡普市长将为你感到骄傲！
items.normEn: Mayor Karp will be proud of you!

items.en: Me an' my team gave it our best. Let's meet up again for a battle some time...
items.zh: 我和我的团队竭尽全力。有时间我们再见面，再战吧……
items.normEn: Me an' my team gave it our best. Let's meet up again for a battle some time...

items.en: Me and my buddy Slowpoke are trying to catch a Happiny that just went running into Mt. Coronet.
items.zh: 我和我的伙伴呆呆兽正试图抓住一只刚刚跑进皇冠山的快乐鱼。
items.normEn: Me and my buddy Slowpoke are trying to catch a Happiny that just went running into Mt. Coronet.

items.en: Meanwhile the high-speed form races to different Dungeons all across Unova.
items.zh: 与此同时，高速形态正在前往合众国各地的不同地下城。
items.normEn: Meanwhile the high-speed form races to different Dungeons all across Unova.

items.normEn: Meet the Kimono Girls at the Ecruteak Dance Theatre.

items.en: Meet the Kimono Girls at the Whirl Islands.
items.zh: 在惠尔群岛认识和服女孩。
items.normEn: Meet the Kimono Girls at the Whirl Islands.

items.en: Meet up with investigative journalist Lucy Stevens in Hearthome City
items.zh: 在心之城与调查记者露西·史蒂文斯会面
items.normEn: Meet up with investigative journalist Lucy Stevens in Hearthome City

items.en: Meet up with Rui again in Phenac City.
items.zh: 在菲纳克市再次与瑞见面。
items.normEn: Meet up with Rui again in Phenac City.

items.en: Meet up with the Swords of Justice at Moor of Icirrus and talk to Cobalion.
items.zh: 在伊西鲁斯摩尔与正义之剑会面并与科巴里恩交谈。
items.normEn: Meet up with the Swords of Justice at Moor of Icirrus and talk to Cobalion.

items.zh: 超级神奇宝贝现在拥有与其基本形态相同的蛋步
items.normEn: Mega Pokémon now have the same egg steps as their base form

items.zh: 梅莱梅莱岛的居民曾见过卡希莉每天在十克拉山上散步，她可能在其中一次散步中发现了席尔瓦利的记忆。
items.normEn: Melemele Island inhabitants have seen Kahili taking daily walks on Ten Carat Hill, she might've found a Silvally Memory during one of those walks.

items.zh: 麦斯普利特和克雷色利亚现在正在神奥漫游
items.normEn: Mesprit and Cresselia are now roaming in Sinnoh

items.en: Meta Groudon has been revived! It is safely contained in this crater. Catch it whenever you are ready!
items.zh: 梅塔·固拉多复活了！它被安全地容纳在这个陨石坑中。只要你准备好就抓住它！
items.normEn: Meta Groudon has been revived! It is safely contained in this crater. Catch it whenever you are ready!

items.en: Mewtwo has created an army of Clones. Please help me fight them, I have to save Pikachu!
items.zh: 超梦创造了一支克隆人军队。请帮我对抗他们，我必须拯救皮卡丘！
items.normEn: Mewtwo has created an army of Clones. Please help me fight them, I have to save Pikachu!

items.en: Mewtwo wishes to find a place it can live undisturbed. You know of such a place, but it seems unwilling to listen. Defeat Anomaly Mewtwo near Cerulean Cave so you may attempt to talk to it.
items.zh: 超梦希望找到一个可以不受干扰地生活的地方。你知道有这样的地方，但似乎不愿意听。在蔚蓝洞穴附近击败异常超梦，这样你就可以尝试与它交谈。
items.normEn: Mewtwo wishes to find a place it can live undisturbed. You know of such a place, but it seems unwilling to listen. Defeat Anomaly Mewtwo near Cerulean Cave so you may attempt to talk to it.

items.en: Mewtwo's Clones have escaped and are Roaming freely across Kanto. Will you help us track them down? It's for a good cause, we swear.
items.zh: 超梦的克隆人已经逃脱并在关东自由漫游。你能帮我们追踪他们吗？我们发誓，这是有充分理由的。
items.normEn: Mewtwo's Clones have escaped and are Roaming freely across Kanto. Will you help us track them down? It's for a good cause, we swear.

items.en: Milcery can evolve when you spin around with it, while treating it to a Sweet.
items.zh: 当你带着它旋转并把它当作糖果时，牛奶就会进化。
items.normEn: Milcery can evolve when you spin around with it, while treating it to a Sweet.

items.normEn: Millis and Argus Steel fled but their Aegislash stayed behind. Look for it in Shalour City and find out what it wants!

items.en: Monitor and interact with the farm in a limited capacity without opening the full modal. Harvest or plant Berries, apply mulch, use shovels, and lock/unlock plots with the extended controls.
items.zh: 在不打开完整模式的情况下，以有限的能力监控农场并与之互动。收获或种植浆果、施加覆盖物、使用铲子以及使用扩展控件锁定/解锁地块。
items.normEn: Monitor and interact with the farm in a limited capacity without opening the full modal. Harvest or plant Berries, apply mulch, use shovels, and lock/unlock plots with the extended controls.

items.en: Moon Phases rotate daily and influence the catch rate of Moon Balls. Additionally, some Pokémon move around according to the current phase.
items.zh: 月相每天旋转并影响月球的捕获率。此外，一些神奇宝贝会根据当前阶段移动。
items.normEn: Moon Phases rotate daily and influence the catch rate of Moon Balls. Additionally, some Pokémon move around according to the current phase.

items.en: More Farm Hands can be unlocked through shops and unlocking unique Berries.
items.zh: 可以通过商店和解锁独特的浆果来解锁更多农场帮手。
items.normEn: More Farm Hands can be unlocked through shops and unlocking unique Berries.

items.en: More filters and sorting options added
items.zh: 添加了更多过滤器和排序选项
items.normEn: More filters and sorting options added

items.en: More Hatchery Helpers can be unlocked through shops and hatching more Pokémon
items.zh: 可以通过商店解锁更多孵化助手并孵化更多神奇宝贝
items.normEn: More Hatchery Helpers can be unlocked through shops and hatching more Pokémon

items.zh: 更多获得 EV 的方法

items.normEn: More notification settings have been added

items.normEn: More NPCs added around the regions

items.en: More NPCs in towns around Johto and Hoenn
items.zh: 城都和丰缘周边城镇有更多 NPC
items.normEn: More NPCs in towns around Johto and Hoenn

items.zh: 增加更多离线进度奖励

items.en: More Pokémon added to typed eggs
items.zh: 更多神奇宝贝添加到打字蛋中

添加了更多神奇宝贝持有的物品

items.zh: 城都、丰缘、神奥新增更多商店和商品
items.normEn: More stores and items added in Johto, Hoenn and Sinnoh

items.en: More than any statue of a hero or old tapestry, these ruins made in truly ancient times must show us the real truth.
items.zh: 这些真正古代建造的废墟比任何英雄雕像或古老挂毯都更能向我们展示真正的真相。
items.normEn: More than any statue of a hero or old tapestry, these ruins made in truly ancient times must show us the real truth.

items.en: More than six Pokémon can now hold held items at a time
items.zh: 超过六只神奇宝贝现在可以同时持有物品
items.normEn: More than six Pokémon can now hold held items at a time

items.zh: 更重要的是，我们还是名人！

items.en: More! I require more! Show me your Stored Power!
items.zh: 更多的！我需要更多！让我看看你储存的力量！
items.normEn: More! I require more! Show me your Stored Power!

items.en: Most impressive! I wouldn't expect any less from a challenger endorsed by the strongest Champion ever to grace our beloved Galar region!
items.zh: 最令人印象深刻！我对一位得到有史以来最强冠军认可的挑战者的期望不会降低，他会为我们心爱的伽勒尔地区增光添彩！
items.normEn: Most impressive! I wouldn't expect any less from a challenger endorsed by the strongest Champion ever to grace our beloved Galar region!

items.en: Mother! Do not sacrifice Cosmog for that beast's sake! Please... Stop... If Nebby isn't— If you make it use up too much of its power... you don't understand what will happen! If you use too much of its power, it will die!
items.zh: 母亲！不要为了那只野兽而牺牲科斯莫格！拜托...停下来...如果纳比不是——如果你让它消耗太多的力量...你不明白会发生什么！如果你使用太多它的力量，它就会死！
items.normEn: Mother! Do not sacrifice Cosmog for that beast's sake! Please... Stop... If Nebby isn't— If you make it use up too much of its power... you don't understand what will happen! If you use too much of its power, it will die!

items.en: Mother! You mustn't open the Ultra Wormhole. You cannot let the beasts run wild!
items.zh: 母亲！你不能打开究极虫洞。不能让野兽肆意妄为！
items.normEn: Mother! You mustn't open the Ultra Wormhole. You cannot let the beasts run wild!

items.zh: 将河马从 210 号公路移至 214 号公路

items.en: Move Pokémon from this category to another category.
items.zh: 将神奇宝贝从这个类别移动到另一个类别。
items.normEn: Move Pokémon from this category to another category.

items.en: Move some dungeons to be standalone
items.zh: 将一些地下城移动为独立的
items.normEn: Move some dungeons to be standalone

items.en: Moved a few dungeons out of towns
items.zh: 将一些地牢移出了城镇
items.normEn: Moved a few dungeons out of towns

items.en: Moved sell all button in Underground to the Treasures tab
items.zh: 将地下的全部出售按钮移至“宝藏”选项卡
items.normEn: Moved sell all button in Underground to the Treasures tab

items.en: Moved shiny icon further into the corner in the Day Care view, to make it easier to spot already shiny Pokémon
items.zh: 将闪亮图标移至日托视图的角落，以便更容易发现已经闪亮的神奇宝贝
items.normEn: Moved shiny icon further into the corner in the Day Care view, to make it easier to spot already shiny Pokémon

items.en: Moves, items... Use them well, and the world will open up to you!
items.zh: 招式、物品……用好它们，世界就会向你敞开！
items.normEn: Moves, items... Use them well, and the world will open up to you!

items.en: Mt. Chimney dungeon is now more powerful
items.zh: 烟囱山地牢现在更加强大
items.normEn: Mt. Chimney dungeon is now more powerful

items.en: Mulches can be bought in later regions from Berry Masters. They last 5 minutes each and can be stacked. However, you cannot combine multiple types of mulch on the same plot!
items.zh: 覆盖物可以在后面的地区从浆果大师处购买。每个持续 5 分钟，并且可以堆叠。但是，您不能在同一块土地上组合使用多种类型的覆盖物！
items.normEn: Mulches can be bought in later regions from Berry Masters. They last 5 minutes each and can be stacked. However, you cannot combine multiple types of mulch on the same plot!

items.en: Multiple tiers of flash in Dungeons
items.normEn: Multiple tiers of flash in Dungeons

items.en: Multipliers tab in the Statistics menu
items.normEn: Multipliers tab in the Statistics menu

items.zh: 以前肯定遇到过奈克洛兹玛。

items.en: Must have played the Moon Flute during Emissary of Light quest line
items.zh: 必须在光之使者任务线中演奏过月笛
items.normEn: Must have played the Moon Flute during Emissary of Light quest line

items.en: Must have played the Sun Flute during Emissary of Light quest line
items.zh: 必须在光之使者任务线中演奏过太阳笛
items.normEn: Must have played the Sun Flute during Emissary of Light quest line

items.en: Mustard wants to test your ability at the Master Dojo. Defeat him.
items.zh: 芥末想要在大师道场测试一下你的能力。打败他。
items.normEn: Mustard wants to test your ability at the Master Dojo. Defeat him.

items.en: Mutate and harvest 1 Pinkan Berry at the farm.
items.zh: 在农场变异并收获 1 个 Pinkan 浆果。
items.normEn: Mutate and harvest 1 Pinkan Berry at the farm.

items.en: My Ampharos has gotten a boost since a friendly soul gave me an Ampharosite!
items.zh: 自从一个友好的灵魂给了我一个安法罗斯石以来，我的安法罗斯石得到了提升！
items.normEn: My Ampharos has gotten a boost since a friendly soul gave me an Ampharosite!

items.en: My daughter Lostelle is missing. She likes to pick berries in the Berry Forest on Three Island. She does it all the time. But this time she hasn't come back. Please go find her.
items.zh: 我的女儿洛斯泰尔失踪了。她喜欢在三岛的浆果林采摘浆果。她一直这样做。但这一次她还没有回来。请去找她。
items.normEn: My daughter Lostelle is missing. She likes to pick berries in the Berry Forest on Three Island. She does it all the time. But this time she hasn't come back. Please go find her.

items.en: My eyes didn't deceive me. Thanks to your help, Sootopolis...
items.zh: 我的眼睛没有欺骗我。感谢您的帮助，Sootopolis...
items.normEn: My eyes didn't deceive me. Thanks to your help, Sootopolis...

items.en: My favourite contestant had a big reveal for us this week!
items.zh: 我最喜欢的参赛者本周为我们揭晓了重大消息！
items.normEn: My favourite contestant had a big reveal for us this week!

items.en: My friend was taking their Eevee on a walk through Eterna Forest, and it suddenly evolved!
items.zh: 我的朋友带着他们的伊布在永恒森林里散步，它突然进化了！
items.normEn: My friend was taking their Eevee on a walk through Eterna Forest, and it suddenly evolved!

items.en: My game isn't running at full speed when the window isn't active.
items.zh: 当窗口未激活时，我的游戏无法全速运行。
items.normEn: My game isn't running at full speed when the window isn't active.

items.en: My grandfather died suddenly some years back, and we were left without a kahuna on Poni. So I set out on my own sort of island challenge, traveling Alola and trying to grow stronger. Lillie. The kahuna you wished to meet is now here.
items.zh: 几年前，我的祖父突然去世，我们在波尼岛上失去了一个卡胡纳。因此，我开始了自己的岛屿挑战，前往阿罗拉并努力变得更强。莉莉。你想见到的卡胡纳现在就在这里。
items.normEn: My grandfather died suddenly some years back, and we were left without a kahuna on Poni. So I set out on my own sort of island challenge, traveling Alola and trying to grow stronger. Lillie. The kahuna you wished to meet is now here.

items.en: My grandfather might know more about them, he's a smart guy. Let's go see him in Agate Village!
items.zh: 我的祖父可能对他们了解更多，他是个聪明人。我们去玛瑙村看看他吧！
items.normEn: My grandfather might know more about them, he's a smart guy. Let's go see him in Agate Village!

items.en: My house! My car! MY LAWN! What did those Team Skull kids do!?
items.zh: 我的房子！我的车！我的草坪！那些骷髅队的孩子们做了什么！？
items.normEn: My house! My car! MY LAWN! What did those Team Skull kids do!?

items.en: My Kantonian Farfetch’d would never evolve no matter how many fresh Leeks I gave it.
items.zh: 无论我给它多少新鲜韭菜，我的 Kantonian Farfetch 都永远不会进化。
items.normEn: My Kantonian Farfetch’d would never evolve no matter how many fresh Leeks I gave it.

items.en: My Key Stone is gone. I left it in the house when I went out, and it just disappeared. What in the world is going on? If someone like that ever shows up again... I've gotta protect my mom and dad. You be careful, too!
items.zh: 我的钥匙石不见了。我出去的时候把它留在家里了，然后它就消失了。世界上到底发生了什么事？如果这样的人再出现的话……我一定要保护我的爸爸妈妈。你也小心点吧！
items.normEn: My Key Stone is gone. I left it in the house when I went out, and it just disappeared. What in the world is going on? If someone like that ever shows up again... I've gotta protect my mom and dad. You be careful, too!

items.en: My laboratory equipment can convert the energy of dreams you experience while sleeping, or "Offline" into orbs. We can then open these orbs and see what your mind experienced in the Interdream Zone.
items.zh: 我的实验室设备可以将你在睡眠时或“离线”时经历的梦的能量转化为球体。然后我们可以打开这些球体，看看你的思想在梦间区域经历了什么。
items.normEn: My laboratory equipment can convert the energy of dreams you experience while sleeping, or "Offline" into orbs. We can then open these orbs and see what your mind experienced in the Interdream Zone.

items.en: My Magikarp might not jump high but it's fast enough to win the Naskarp Cup.
items.zh: 我的鲤鱼可能跳不高，但它的速度足以赢得纳斯卡普杯。
items.normEn: My Magikarp might not jump high but it's fast enough to win the Naskarp Cup.

items.en: My matches are always sold out, but this... I've never seen a crowd this wild!
items.zh: 我的比赛总是卖完，但这...我从来没有见过如此疯狂的人群！
items.normEn: My matches are always sold out, but this... I've never seen a crowd this wild!

items.en: My mate told me a story of a Pikachu getting lodged in the gluttonous bird’s gullet while it was gorging in a thunderstorm! But that sounds ridiculous! How would it not be bothered by the big rat in its throat? It would drive me mad.
items.zh: 我的伙伴给我讲了一个皮卡丘在暴风雨中狼吞虎咽时被困在贪吃鸟食道里的故事！但这听起来很荒谬！它怎么会不被喉咙里的大老鼠烦扰呢？这会让我发疯的。
items.normEn: My mate told me a story of a Pikachu getting lodged in the gluttonous bird’s gullet while it was gorging in a thunderstorm! But that sounds ridiculous! How would it not be bothered by the big rat in its throat? It would drive me mad.

items.en: My mother is— She's selfish. She lavishes her love only on those she deems worthy, not caring whether it is wanted or not.
items.zh: 我的母亲是——她很自私。她只把爱倾注在她认为值得的人身上，而不关心是否需要。
items.normEn: My mother is— She's selfish. She lavishes her love only on those she deems worthy, not caring whether it is wanted or not.

items.en: My name is Oak. People affectionately refer to me as the Pokémon Professor.
items.zh: 我的名字是奥克。人们亲切地称我为“神奇宝贝教授”。
items.normEn: My name is Oak. People affectionately refer to me as the Pokémon Professor.

items.en: My name is Rui, by the way. I'm a psychic of sorts, on a mission to save Pokémon who have had their souls corrupted by some evil folks in Orre.
items.zh: 顺便说一句，我叫瑞。我是某种通灵者，肩负着拯救灵魂被奥雷邪恶之人腐蚀的神奇宝贝的使命。
items.normEn: My name is Rui, by the way. I'm a psychic of sorts, on a mission to save Pokémon who have had their souls corrupted by some evil folks in Orre.

items.en: My old friend Newton used to study the Distortion World, he was working on opening a gate to it. I've heard that you were able to enter the Distortion World from a portal at the top of Mt. Coronet, so I was wondering if you could help me open a new portal to fulfill my friend's wish.
items.zh: 我的老朋友牛顿曾经研究过扭曲世界，他正在致力于打开通往扭曲世界的大门。我听说你可以从皇冠山山顶的传送门进入扭曲世界，所以我想知道你是否可以帮我打开一个新的传送门，以完成我朋友的愿望。
items.normEn: My old friend Newton used to study the Distortion World, he was working on opening a gate to it. I've heard that you were able to enter the Distortion World from a portal at the top of Mt. Coronet, so I was wondering if you could help me open a new portal to fulfill my friend's wish.

items.en: My partner Lucario evolved from a Riolu during daytime when I used a Soothe Bell.
items.zh: 我的伙伴路卡利欧在白天使用安抚铃时从利欧鲁进化而来。
items.normEn: My partner Lucario evolved from a Riolu during daytime when I used a Soothe Bell.

items.en: My partner Medicham and I are always training to become the strongest in the world.
items.zh: 我和我的搭档麦迪查姆一直在训练，以成为世界上最强的人。
items.normEn: My partner Medicham and I are always training to become the strongest in the world.

items.en: My people have passed down a story of another world, much like our own. In this other world, the world took a different path. The war in Kalos 3000 years ago never happened, and Mega Evolution is not known there.
items.zh: 我的人民流传着另一个世界的故事，就像我们自己的世界一样。在另一个世界，世界走上了不同的道路。 3000年前的卡洛斯战争从未发生过，那里也不知道Mega进化。
items.normEn: My people have passed down a story of another world, much like our own. In this other world, the world took a different path. The war in Kalos 3000 years ago never happened, and Mega Evolution is not known there.

items.en: My plans for complete and total world domination foiled yet again? No! It mustn't be! I couldn't have been defeated by some random Trainer from who knows where!
items.zh: 我彻底统治世界的计划再次挫败？不！不应该是这样！我不可能被某个不知道从哪里来的随机训练师打败！
items.normEn: My plans for complete and total world domination foiled yet again? No! It mustn't be! I couldn't have been defeated by some random Trainer from who knows where!

items.en: My Pokémon and the challenger's Pokémon. Everyone battled even though they were hurt... Thank you.
items.zh: 我的神奇宝贝和挑战者的神奇宝贝。每个人都在战斗，即使他们受伤了……谢谢你们。
items.normEn: My Pokémon and the challenger's Pokémon. Everyone battled even though they were hurt... Thank you.

items.en: My researchers tell me that since their defeat, Groudon and Kyogre have been reverting to their primal forms in the Cave of Origin during Harsh Sunlight and Rainy weather.
items.zh: 我的研究人员告诉我，自从他们被击败后，固拉多和盖欧卡在严酷的阳光和阴雨天气期间一直在起源之洞中恢复到原始形态。
items.normEn: My researchers tell me that since their defeat, Groudon and Kyogre have been reverting to their primal forms in the Cave of Origin during Harsh Sunlight and Rainy weather.

items.en: My researchers tell me that there is a mural carved into the wall of Granite Cave that has some information about "Primal Reversion". Can you find it, and report back?
items.zh: 我的研究人员告诉我，花岗岩洞穴的墙壁上刻有一幅壁画，上面有一些关于“原始回归”的信息。你能找到它并回来报告吗？
items.normEn: My researchers tell me that there is a mural carved into the wall of Granite Cave that has some information about "Primal Reversion". Can you find it, and report back?

items.en: My Shovel Is Starting To Crack
items.normEn: My Shovel Is Starting To Crack

items.en: My sisters Zuki and Naoko tell me you have helped them, and I thank you. Please help find my other two sisters, Sayo and Kuni. Please accept this as a token of my gratitude.
items.zh: 我的姐妹 Zuki 和 Naoko 告诉我你帮助了她们，我谢谢你。请帮助找到我的另外两个姐妹，Sayo 和 Kuni。请接受此作为我的谢意。
items.normEn: My sisters Zuki and Naoko tell me you have helped them, and I thank you. Please help find my other two sisters, Sayo and Kuni. Please accept this as a token of my gratitude.

items.en: My Slowpoke's gone ahead, I hope I can catch up to them soon.
items.zh: 我的呆呆兽已经领先了，我希望我能很快赶上他们。
items.normEn: My Slowpoke's gone ahead, I hope I can catch up to them soon.

items.en: My strategy goes right to pot when I've got all these bad thoughts running through my head...
items.zh: 当我脑子里闪过所有这些不好的想法时，我的策略就很正确......
items.normEn: My strategy goes right to pot when I've got all these bad thoughts running through my head...

items.en: My sweet Lostelle! I'm so glad you're all right.
items.zh: 我可爱的洛斯特尔！我很高兴你没事。
items.normEn: My sweet Lostelle! I'm so glad you're all right.

items.en: My thanks to you and your Pokémon. These grunts are always bothering me and my trial site. You... you're the trainer who cleared the Trainers' School so effortlessly! Allow me to see if you're ready for my trial!
items.zh: 我感谢你和你的神奇宝贝。这些咕哝声总是困扰着我和我的试用现场。你……你就是那个轻松通过训练师学校的训练师！让我看看你是否准备好接受我的审判！
items.normEn: My thanks to you and your Pokémon. These grunts are always bothering me and my trial site. You... you're the trainer who cleared the Trainers' School so effortlessly! Allow me to see if you're ready for my trial!

items.en: My time as Champion is over... But what a champion time it's been! Thank you for the greatest battle I've ever had!
items.zh: 我作为冠军的时代结束了……但这真是一个冠军时代！谢谢你给我带来了我经历过的最伟大的战斗！
items.normEn: My time as Champion is over... But what a champion time it's been! Thank you for the greatest battle I've ever had!

items.en: My training's still not good enough...? My Pokémon are so weak, it makes me frustrated... But I can feel that they are getting better after each battle.................. Tch! They're still too weak! I need to give them more training...
items.zh: 我的训练还是不够好……？我的神奇宝贝太弱了，这让我很沮丧……但我能感觉到他们在每次战斗后都在进步…………哎呀！他们还是太弱了！我需要给他们更多的训练...
items.normEn: My training's still not good enough...? My Pokémon are so weak, it makes me frustrated... But I can feel that they are getting better after each battle.................. Tch! They're still too weak! I need to give them more training...

items.en: My trial is in this town. Right there, inside my very own houseboat. Normally you'd have to clear my trial to find our kahuna on Exeggutor Island, but I guess you took care of some things, huh?
items.zh: 我的审判就在这个镇上。就在那里，在我自己的船屋内。通常你必须完成我的试炼才能在椰蛋岛找到我们的卡胡纳，但我猜你已经处理了一些事情，是吧？
items.normEn: My trial is in this town. Right there, inside my very own houseboat. Normally you'd have to clear my trial to find our kahuna on Exeggutor Island, but I guess you took care of some things, huh?

items.en: My trusty Crabrawler was with me. He was smashing some rocks that were blocking the path, having a grand ol' time like usual, when suddenly we were attacked by a wild Pokémon!
items.zh: 我值得信赖的爬行者和我在一起。他正在砸碎一些挡路的石头，像往常一样玩得很开心，突然我们被一只野生神奇宝贝袭击了！
items.normEn: My trusty Crabrawler was with me. He was smashing some rocks that were blocking the path, having a grand ol' time like usual, when suddenly we were attacked by a wild Pokémon!

items.en: My wish was to resurrect Groudon for Team Magma, but it proved too difficult, and you have showed me that it would be irresponsible to put that much power in the hands of evil doers.
items.zh: 我的愿望是为岩浆队复活固拉多，但事实证明这太困难了，而且你向我表明，将如此大的权力交给邪恶的人是不负责任的。
items.normEn: My wish was to resurrect Groudon for Team Magma, but it proved too difficult, and you have showed me that it would be irresponsible to put that much power in the hands of evil doers.

items.en: My, my. That certainly was a battle worth seeing. I must be honest with you. I never imagined that you would get this far.
items.zh: 我的，我的。这确实是一场值得一看的战斗。我必须对你诚实。我从没想过你会走到这一步。
items.normEn: My, my. That certainly was a battle worth seeing. I must be honest with you. I never imagined that you would get this far.

items.en: Mystery egg can now hatch Pokémon from the Dragon Egg pool
items.zh: 神秘蛋现在可以从龙蛋池中孵化神奇宝贝
items.normEn: Mystery egg can now hatch Pokémon from the Dragon Egg pool

items.en: Mystery Eggs can hatch Pokémon from both their own exclusive pool and all other typed egg pools. The exclusive Pokémon are listed below.
items.zh: 神秘蛋可以从自己的专属蛋池和所有其他类型的蛋池中孵化神奇宝贝。下面列出了独家神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Mystery Eggs can hatch Pokémon from both their own exclusive pool and all other typed egg pools. The exclusive Pokémon are listed below.

items.en: Mystery Gift quest line has been replaced by a Gift NPC; requirements are unchanged
items.zh: 神秘礼物任务线已被礼物 NPC 取代；要求不变
items.normEn: Mystery Gift quest line has been replaced by a Gift NPC; requirements are unchanged

items.en: Naah! Just kidding! Imagine though, how disappointing that would be. What an anticlimax!
items.zh: 不！只是在开玩笑！但想象一下，这将是多么令人失望。多么虎头蛇尾啊！
items.normEn: Naah! Just kidding! Imagine though, how disappointing that would be. What an anticlimax!

items.en: Nature is full of wonders, and this is one I simply must preserve.
items.zh: 大自然充满了奇迹，而这正是我必须保护的。
items.normEn: Nature is full of wonders, and this is one I simply must preserve.

items.en: Nature's gifts came together as one in this Berry. It has a wondrous mix of flavors that spread in the mouth.
items.zh: 大自然的恩赐在这个浆果中融为一体。它有一种奇妙的混合味道，在口中扩散。
items.normEn: Nature's gifts came together as one in this Berry. It has a wondrous mix of flavors that spread in the mouth.

items.en: Navigate the maze inside the Sealed Chamber.
items.zh: 在密封室内的迷宫中导航。
items.normEn: Navigate the maze inside the Sealed Chamber.

items.en: Nebby changed forms... and it's not moving...
items.zh: 内比改变了形态……但它没有动……
items.normEn: Nebby changed forms... and it's not moving...

items.en: Nebby escaped into a hole! Clear the Seaward Cave dungeon.
items.zh: 纳比逃进洞里了！清除 Seaward Cave 地牢。
items.normEn: Nebby escaped into a hole! Clear the Seaward Cave dungeon.

items.en: Nebby is... Its real home is far away from here. And I want to help it get home. Thank you for helping me. The two of us will be heading to the next island as well!
items.zh: 内比是……它真正的家离这里很远。我想帮助它回家。谢谢你帮助我。我们两个也要去下一个岛！
items.normEn: Nebby is... Its real home is far away from here. And I want to help it get home. Thank you for helping me. The two of us will be heading to the next island as well!

items.en: Nebby ran off into the meadow here... What if a wild Pokémon attacks it? It doesn't have any moves it can use to battle!
items.zh: 纳比跑到了这里的草地上……如果野生神奇宝贝攻击它怎么办？它没有任何可以用来战斗的动作！
items.normEn: Nebby ran off into the meadow here... What if a wild Pokémon attacks it? It doesn't have any moves it can use to battle!

items.en: Nebby seems fond of the ruins for some reason, so I keep visiting them and hoping that maybe I will find some clue to help it get back to its home... But I don't have any idea how to do that...
items.zh: 出于某种原因，内比似乎很喜欢这些废墟，所以我一直拜访它们，希望也许我能找到一些线索来帮助它回到它的家……但我不知道该怎么做……
items.normEn: Nebby seems fond of the ruins for some reason, so I keep visiting them and hoping that maybe I will find some clue to help it get back to its home... But I don't have any idea how to do that...

items.en: Nebby! Oh thank goodness you're safe. Thank you $playername$, let me heal your Poké- No? Um, very well then.
items.zh: 内比！哦，谢天谢地，你很安全。谢谢你$playername$，让我治愈你的神奇宝贝-不？嗯，那么很好。
items.normEn: Nebby! Oh thank goodness you're safe. Thank you $playername$, let me heal your Poké- No? Um, very well then.

items.en: Nebby. Please. I need to see my mother!
items.normEn: Nebby. Please. I need to see my mother!

items.en: Nebby... all I ever wanted to do was to help you get back to your own home... But instead you helped me, over and over... I got the chance to finally talk with my mother. Thank you... Thank you so much!
items.zh: 内比……我一直想做的就是帮助你回到自己的家……但你却一次又一次地帮助我……我终于有机会和我妈妈说话了。谢谢...非常感谢！
items.normEn: Nebby... all I ever wanted to do was to help you get back to your own home... But instead you helped me, over and over... I got the chance to finally talk with my mother. Thank you... Thank you so much!

items.en: Nebby's Pokémon species, Cosmog, used to be known as the child of the stars. Its modern name was coined by a researcher in Aether Paradise!
items.zh: 纳比的神奇宝贝种类科斯莫格曾经被称为星星之子。它的现代名字是以太天堂的一位研究员创造的！
items.normEn: Nebby's Pokémon species, Cosmog, used to be known as the child of the stars. Its modern name was coined by a researcher in Aether Paradise!

items.en: Necrozma shone with such blinding light, as it used to, only to lose that light all over again... It seems to have fled somewhere now. We are grateful to you, human of Alola. May we all eventually be awash in light again.
items.zh: 奈克洛兹玛一如既往地闪耀着耀眼的光芒，但又再次失去了光芒……它现在似乎已经逃到了某个地方。我们感谢你，阿罗拉的人类。愿我们最终再次沐浴在光明之中。
items.normEn: Necrozma shone with such blinding light, as it used to, only to lose that light all over again... It seems to have fled somewhere now. We are grateful to you, human of Alola. May we all eventually be awash in light again.

items.en: Necrozma... It seems like it is also suffering somehow... It seems to hurt it, to be without its light...
items.zh: 奈克洛兹玛……似乎它也在遭受着某种痛苦……似乎伤害了它，没有了它的光芒……
items.normEn: Necrozma... It seems like it is also suffering somehow... It seems to hurt it, to be without its light...

items.en: Necrozma...and us ourselves... we have both suffered so many long years in this darkness, living a life we did not wish for...
items.zh: 奈克洛兹玛……还有我们自己……我们都在这黑暗中受苦了这么多年，过着我们不希望的生活……
items.normEn: Necrozma...and us ourselves... we have both suffered so many long years in this darkness, living a life we did not wish for...

items.zh: 需要至少 ${...} 攻击才能进行超级进化。
items.normEn: Needs at least ${...} attack to Mega Evolve.

items.zh: Nerfed 地下城令牌在地下城中获得

items.en: Never before have I seen a Trainer command Pokémon with more grace than I... In recognition of your prowess, I present to you this Gym Badge.
items.zh: 我从来没有见过训练家比我更优雅地指挥神奇宝贝......为了表彰你的实力，我向你赠送这个道馆徽章。
items.normEn: Never before have I seen a Trainer command Pokémon with more grace than I... In recognition of your prowess, I present to you this Gym Badge.

items.en: Never you mind that, get outta here!
items.normEn: Never you mind that, get outta here!

items.zh: 新的捕获过滤器最初启用

items.en:
New challenge mode added: Regional Attack Debuff.

Lowers Pokémon attack based on native region and highest reached region.

This is the default and recommended way to play, but is now an optional challenge.

Please choose if you would like this challenge mode to be enabled or disabled (cannot be re-enabled later)
items.zh: 添加了新的挑战模式：区域攻击减益。根据出生地区和最高到达地区降低神奇宝贝的攻击力。这是默认和推荐的游戏方式，但现在是可选的挑战。请选择您是否希望启用或禁用此挑战模式（以后无法重新启用）
items.normEn: New challenge mode added: Regional Attack Debuff. Lowers Pokémon attack based on native region and highest reached region. This is the default and recommended way to play, but is now an optional challenge. Please choose if you would like this challenge mode to be enabled or disabled (cannot be re-enabled later)

items.en:
New challenge mode added: Require Complete Pokédex.

Requires a complete regional pokédex before moving on to the next region.

This is the default and recommended way to play, but is now an optional challenge.

Please choose if you would like this challenge mode to be enabled or disabled (cannot be re-enabled later)
items.zh: 添加了新的挑战模式：需要完整的图鉴。在进入下一个地区之前需要完整的地区图鉴。这是默认和推荐的游戏方式，但现在是可选的挑战。请选择您是否希望启用或禁用此挑战模式（以后无法重新启用）
items.normEn: New challenge mode added: Require Complete Pokédex. Requires a complete regional pokédex before moving on to the next region. This is the default and recommended way to play, but is now an optional challenge. Please choose if you would like this challenge mode to be enabled or disabled (cannot be re-enabled later)

items.en:
New challenge mode added: Slow EVs.

Diminishes the rate at which EVs are gained.

This is an optional challenge and is NOT the recommended way to play.

Please choose if you would like this challenge mode to be disabled or enabled.

Can be disabled later. Can NOT be enabled later!
items.zh: 添加了新的挑战模式：慢速电动汽车。降低获得电动汽车的速度。这是一个可选的挑战，不是推荐的游戏方式。请选择您是否希望禁用或启用此挑战模式。可以稍后禁用。以后无法启用！
items.normEn: New challenge mode added: Slow EVs. Diminishes the rate at which EVs are gained. This is an optional challenge and is NOT the recommended way to play. Please choose if you would like this challenge mode to be disabled or enabled. Can be disabled later. Can NOT be enabled later!

items.zh: 新的一天消息不再出现在新的保存中
items.normEn: New day message no longer appears on new saves

items.zh: 孵化场添加了新的显示选项
items.normEn: New display options added to Hatchery

items.zh: Discord 商店提供新的孵化场助手

items.zh: 添加了新的神奇球类型，可以通过与城都浆果大师交易获得
items.normEn: New Pokéball types added, Can be obtained by trading with the Johto Berry Master

items.en: New Pokémon you capture, shinies obtained, Pokémon made resistant to Pokérus, and Purified Pokémon all increase your click attack.
items.zh: 您捕获的新神奇宝贝、获得的闪光、对神奇宝贝有抵抗力的神奇宝贝以及纯化的神奇宝贝都会增加您的点击攻击力。
items.normEn: New Pokémon you capture, shinies obtained, Pokémon made resistant to Pokérus, and Purified Pokémon all increase your click attack.

items.zh: 为任务模式添加了新设置
items.normEn: New setting added for quest modal

items.zh: 如果地铁未解锁，则不会显示新的地铁交易通知
items.normEn: New Underground deals notification not shown if Underground not unlocked

items.en: Next stop is Unova! I've always wanted to visit Castelia City, personally...
items.zh: 下一站是合众国！我一直想去卡斯特利亚市亲自参观一下......
items.normEn: Next stop is Unova! I've always wanted to visit Castelia City, personally...

items.en: Nice job, guys. Here are your Spike Shell badges, guys.
items.zh: 干得好，伙计们。伙计们，这是你们的 Spike Shell 徽章。
items.normEn: Nice job, guys. Here are your Spike Shell badges, guys.

items.en: Nice! How'd you come up with that kind of battle plan? You gotta tell me!
items.zh: 好的！你是怎么想出这样的作战计划的？你得告诉我！
items.normEn: Nice! How'd you come up with that kind of battle plan? You gotta tell me!

items.en: Nice! Well, it would be nice. Now we have all these berries and Pinkan Pokémon, but nowhere to put 'em all!
items.zh: 好的！嗯，那就太好了。现在我们拥有了所有这些浆果和 Pinkan 神奇宝贝，但无处放置它们！
items.normEn: Nice! Well, it would be nice. Now we have all these berries and Pinkan Pokémon, but nowhere to put 'em all!

items.en: Nickname and categories now transfer in Real Evolution
items.zh: 昵称和类别现已在 Real Evolution 中转移
items.normEn: Nickname and categories now transfer in Real Evolution

items.en: Nihilego has been spotted at Wela Volcano Park and Diglett's Tunnel!
items.zh: Nihilego 已在韦拉火山公园和迪格利特隧道被发现！
items.normEn: Nihilego has been spotted at Wela Volcano Park and Diglett's Tunnel!

items.en: Niiice! Real nice! Ohhh, I really felt that one! Full points to you! That settles it! You get this Meteorite Shard as a reward!
items.zh: 尼采！真不错！呵呵，我真的有这种感觉！满分给你！这样就解决了！您将获得这个陨石碎片作为奖励！
items.normEn: Niiice! Real nice! Ohhh, I really felt that one! Full points to you! That settles it! You get this Meteorite Shard as a reward!

items.en: No experts hired. You're on your own!
items.zh: 没有聘请专家。你就靠你自己了！
items.normEn: No experts hired. You're on your own!

items.en: No more impossible quest when doing challenges
items.zh: 挑战时不再有不可能的任务
items.normEn: No more impossible quest when doing challenges

items.en: No more Mega Stones in berry trades
items.zh: 浆果交易中不再有巨型石头
items.normEn: No more Mega Stones in berry trades

items.en: No Pokémon in the World Can Run Away From Me Now!
items.zh: 现在世界上没有神奇宝贝能从我身边逃脱了！
items.normEn: No Pokémon in the World Can Run Away From Me Now!

items.en: No Shadow Pokémon in the Party
items.zh: 队伍中没有暗影宝可梦
items.normEn: No Shadow Pokémon in the Party

items.en: No sign of Shadow Pokémon so far. Fight trainers at the Pyrite Building to flush out the criminals.
items.zh: 到目前为止还没有影子神奇宝贝的迹象。在黄铁矿大楼与训练师战斗，消灭罪犯。
items.normEn: No sign of Shadow Pokémon so far. Fight trainers at the Pyrite Building to flush out the criminals.

items.en: No time to waste - I'll see you at the Canalave Library!
items.zh: 没有时间可以浪费了 - 我们在卡纳拉夫图书馆见！
items.normEn: No time to waste - I'll see you at the Canalave Library!

items.en: No way you beat us! Wow, we are lame. Probability is just probability after all... Absolutes do not exist. But enough already! We've already stolen the Poké Balls, Great Balls, and Ultra Balls. Let's call it good and leave.
items.zh: 你怎么可能打败我们！哇，我们是瘸子。概率毕竟只是概率……绝对不存在。但已经够了！我们已经偷走了神奇宝贝球、伟大球和超级球。我们就说这很好然后离开吧。
items.normEn: No way you beat us! Wow, we are lame. Probability is just probability after all... Absolutes do not exist. But enough already! We've already stolen the Poké Balls, Great Balls, and Ultra Balls. Let's call it good and leave.

items.en: No, all of Hoenn was saved. On behalf of the people, I thank you.
items.zh: 不，整个丰缘都得救了。我代表人民向你们表示感谢。
items.normEn: No, all of Hoenn was saved. On behalf of the people, I thank you.

items.en: No, I didn't learn this from talking to ghosts, don't be silly. There's a FAQ button in the Start Menu. It's very useful.
items.zh: 不，我不是从和鬼魂交谈中学到这个的，别傻了。开始菜单中有一个常见问题解答按钮。这非常有用。
items.normEn: No, I didn't learn this from talking to ghosts, don't be silly. There's a FAQ button in the Start Menu. It's very useful.

items.en: No, what WE have long wished for. What?! The heat is greater than simulations predicted? It will be a risk to our own safety if it continues?! That cannot be...
items.zh: 不，这是我们长期以来的愿望。什么？！热量比模拟预测的要大？如果再这样下去，我们的人身安全就会受到威胁吗？！那不可能是...
items.normEn: No, what WE have long wished for. What?! The heat is greater than simulations predicted? It will be a risk to our own safety if it continues?! That cannot be...

items.en: No, you will need to obtain the evolution's shiny via a different method.
items.zh: 不，您需要通过不同的方法获得进化的光泽。
items.normEn: No, you will need to obtain the evolution's shiny via a different method.

items.en: No! At this rate, I... I won't be able to protect the Plasma Frigate! P-P-P-Plasmaaaa!
items.zh: 不！照这样下去，我……我就保护不了等离子护卫舰了！等离子啊啊啊！
items.normEn: No! At this rate, I... I won't be able to protect the Plasma Frigate! P-P-P-Plasmaaaa!

items.en: NO! That can't be! You beat me at my best! After all that work to become the League Champ? My reign is over already? It's not fair!
items.zh: 不！那不可能！你用尽全力击败了我！经过所有努力成为联赛冠军？我的统治已经结束了吗？这不公平！
items.normEn: NO! That can't be! You beat me at my best! After all that work to become the League Champ? My reign is over already? It's not fair!

items.en: No? There's no other way, I'm sorry...
items.zh: 不？没有别的办法了，抱歉……
items.normEn: No? There's no other way, I'm sorry...

items.en: No. Your file is saved in your browser data. We recommend making frequent backups of your save data.
items.zh: 不会。您的文件保存在您的浏览器数据中。我们建议经常备份您的保存数据。
items.normEn: No. Your file is saved in your browser data. We recommend making frequent backups of your save data.
