items.zh: 跳舞还不够！如果您希望完成米娜的审判，接下来您应该前往霍库拉尼天文台。当喷火龙成为您的骑乘神奇宝贝之一时，乌拉乌拉就在您的身边！
items.normEn: Not enough dancing! If you're hoping to complete Mina's trial, you should make for Hokulani Observatory next. Ula'Ula is only a stone's throw away when Charizard is one of your Ride Pokémon!

items.en: Not implemented for ignoreRouteInCalculations = true on first region route
items.zh: 未在第一个区域路线上实现ignoreRouteInCalculations = true
items.normEn: Not implemented for ignoreRouteInCalculations = true on first region route

items.en: Not just strong... TOO strong! Not ordinary, indeed. Whatever, it doesn't matter, we already tested what we wanted to know. The Abomasnow from this cavern is a fine specimen. The more we agitate it, the stronger its Snow Warning ability becomes, making the snow fall even more furiously. Whoever has the most energy will come out on top! And it's Team Flare, and only Team Flare who will survive!
items.zh: 不只是强……太强了！确实不普通。不管怎样，没关系，我们已经测试了我们想知道的内容。这个洞穴中的阿博马斯雪是一个很好的标本。我们越搅动它，它的雪警能力就越强，雪花下得就越猛烈。谁的能量最多，谁就会脱颖而出！这是闪焰队，也只有闪焰队才能生存！
items.normEn: Not just strong... TOO strong! Not ordinary, indeed. Whatever, it doesn't matter, we already tested what we wanted to know. The Abomasnow from this cavern is a fine specimen. The more we agitate it, the stronger its Snow Warning ability becomes, making the snow fall even more furiously. Whoever has the most energy will come out on top! And it's Team Flare, and only Team Flare who will survive!

items.en: Not just that, but those Pokémon appear to be holding a sword and shield as if they were using them!
items.zh: 不仅如此，那些神奇宝贝似乎还拿着剑和盾，就像在使用它们一样！
items.normEn: Not just that, but those Pokémon appear to be holding a sword and shield as if they were using them!

items.en: Not much use in having two of the same Mega Stone, so she might be willing to give one up. If you want to find her, you should check out Cerulean Cave.
items.zh: 拥有两块相同的巨石并没有多大用处，所以她可能愿意放弃一颗。如果你想找到她，你应该去蔚蓝洞窟看看。
items.normEn: Not much use in having two of the same Mega Stone, so she might be willing to give one up. If you want to find her, you should check out Cerulean Cave.

items.en: Note that progress does not automatically carry over between devices.
items.zh: 请注意，进度不会自动在设备之间延续。
items.normEn: Note that progress does not automatically carry over between devices.

items.en: NOTE: Base attack is the value your Pokémon originally has at level 100, before any breeding buffs.
items.zh: 注意：基础攻击力是指你的神奇宝贝在 100 级时的初始值（不包括任何繁殖增益）。
items.normEn: NOTE: Base attack is the value your Pokémon originally has at level 100, before any breeding buffs.

items.en: Note: The auto-restart triggered by the player digging up the last item
items.zh: 注：玩家挖到最后一个物品会触发自动重启
items.normEn: Note: The auto-restart triggered by the player digging up the last item

items.en: Note: there is no click damage in the Battle Frontier.
items.zh: 注意：战斗前沿中没有点击伤害。
items.normEn: Note: there is no click damage in the Battle Frontier.

items.en: Note: This step happens before calculating a potential discovery time
items.zh: 注意：此步骤发生在计算潜在发现时间之前
items.normEn: Note: This step happens before calculating a potential discovery time

items.en: Notification and sounds settings now grouped
items.zh: 通知和声音设置现已分组
items.normEn: Notification and sounds settings now grouped

items.en: Notification for when the Purify Chamber is ready
items.zh: 净化室准备就绪时的通知
items.normEn: Notification for when the Purify Chamber is ready

items.en: Now listen! It is vital that this world becomes a better place. The people and Pokémon chosen to make the world better must work tirelessly to achieve this goal.
items.zh: 现在听！让这个世界变得更加美好至关重要。选择让世界变得更美好的人民和神奇宝贝必须不懈努力以实现这一目标。
items.normEn: Now listen! It is vital that this world becomes a better place. The people and Pokémon chosen to make the world better must work tirelessly to achieve this goal.

items.en: Now Shinies Won't Run Away So Easily!
items.zh: 现在Shinies不会那么容易逃跑了！
items.normEn: Now Shinies Won't Run Away So Easily!

items.en: Now that I've seen just what kind of strength you possess as the greatest of challengers...crushing you into the dirt will show everyone just how strong their Champion truly is!
items.zh: 现在我已经看到了你作为最伟大的挑战者所拥有的力量……将你碾碎将让每个人都知道他们的冠军真正有多强大！
items.normEn: Now that I've seen just what kind of strength you possess as the greatest of challengers...crushing you into the dirt will show everyone just how strong their Champion truly is!

items.en: Now that it has finally unlocked, catch Regieleki and Regidrago in the Split-Decision Ruins!
items.zh: 现在它终于解锁了，在分裂决策废墟中抓住雷吉莱基和雷吉德拉戈吧！
items.normEn: Now that it has finally unlocked, catch Regieleki and Regidrago in the Split-Decision Ruins!

items.en: Now that Team Flare is not in the Poké Ball Factory anymore, talk with the Director that you just saved.
items.zh: 现在耀斑队已经不在精灵球工厂了，请与你刚刚救下的总监交谈。
items.normEn: Now that Team Flare is not in the Poké Ball Factory anymore, talk with the Director that you just saved.

items.en: Now that the laboratory and training program are up and running, I'll be very busy!
items.zh: 现在实验室和培训项目都已经启动并运行了，我会很忙的！
items.normEn: Now that the laboratory and training program are up and running, I'll be very busy!

items.en: Now that the situation has calmed down talk to the local scientists about the Green Gemstone.
items.zh: 现在情况已经平静下来，与当地科学家谈论绿色宝石。
items.normEn: Now that the situation has calmed down talk to the local scientists about the Green Gemstone.

items.en: Now that their battle is over, the Super-Ancient Pokémon have retreated to rest and recuperate. You will likely find Rayquaza back in the Sky Pillar.
items.zh: 现在战斗结束了，超古代神奇宝贝们都已经撤退去休息养伤了。你很可能会在天空之柱中找到烈空坐。
items.normEn: Now that their battle is over, the Super-Ancient Pokémon have retreated to rest and recuperate. You will likely find Rayquaza back in the Sky Pillar.

items.en: Now that they have calmed down, Zacian and Zamazenta seem to be willing to let you try to catch them!
items.zh: 现在他们已经平静下来了，扎西安和扎马森塔似乎愿意让你尝试抓住他们！
items.normEn: Now that they have calmed down, Zacian and Zamazenta seem to be willing to let you try to catch them!

items.en: Now that things are calmer in Hoenn, I've decided to keep an eye on Kyogre and Groudon and make sure they don't cause any more trouble.
items.zh: 现在丰缘的局势已经平静下来，我决定密切关注盖欧卡和固拉多，确保他们不会再造成任何麻烦。
items.normEn: Now that things are calmer in Hoenn, I've decided to keep an eye on Kyogre and Groudon and make sure they don't cause any more trouble.

items.en: Now that you have captured both of its steeds, talk to Calyrex at the Crown Shrine.
items.zh: 现在你已经捕获了它的两匹战马，接下来与皇冠神殿的卡里莱克斯交谈。
items.normEn: Now that you have captured both of its steeds, talk to Calyrex at the Crown Shrine.

items.en: Now that you have captured Calyrex, go report back to Peony!
items.zh: 现在你已经捕获了Calyrex，去向Peony报告吧！
items.normEn: Now that you have captured Calyrex, go report back to Peony!

items.en: Now that you have captured Galarian Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres, go report back to Peony!
items.zh: 现在你已经捕获了加拉瑞尔急冻鸟、闪电鸟和莫尔特雷斯，去向牡丹报告吧！
items.normEn: Now that you have captured Galarian Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres, go report back to Peony!

items.en: Now that you have found and caught Glastrier and Spectrier, Calyrex wants to challenge you at Crown Shrine. Catch it!
items.zh: 现在你已经找到并抓住了格拉斯特里尔和幽灵人，卡里雷克斯想在皇冠神殿向你挑战。抓住它！
items.normEn: Now that you have found and caught Glastrier and Spectrier, Calyrex wants to challenge you at Crown Shrine. Catch it!

items.en: Now that you know where to find Virizion, search for them in Pinwheel Forest.
items.zh: 现在您知道在哪里可以找到 Virizion，请在风车森林中搜索它们。
items.normEn: Now that you know where to find Virizion, search for them in Pinwheel Forest.

items.en: Now that you learnt what the ultimate weapon is able to do, you need to stop it. Team Flare Xerosic is in the way in Lumiose City, defeat him!
items.zh: 现在你已经了解了终极武器的威力，你需要阻止它。 Flare Xerosic 队在卢米奥塞市挡路，击败他！
items.normEn: Now that you learnt what the ultimate weapon is able to do, you need to stop it. Team Flare Xerosic is in the way in Lumiose City, defeat him!

items.en: Now that you've found and brought back Terrakion, you should probably look for Virizion. Virizion usually likes to meditate to the sound of nature, so Pinwheel Forest might be a good place to search in. Good luck, and report back once you've found each other.
items.zh: 现在你已经找到并带回了 Terrakion，你可能应该寻找 Virizion。维里吉翁通常喜欢冥想大自然的声音，所以风车森林可能是一个搜索的好地方。祝你好运，找到对方后立即报告。
items.normEn: Now that you've found and brought back Terrakion, you should probably look for Virizion. Virizion usually likes to meditate to the sound of nature, so Pinwheel Forest might be a good place to search in. Good luck, and report back once you've found each other.

items.en: Now that you've found Virizion, tell them to meet the others at the Moor of Icirrus.
items.zh: 现在你已经找到了维里吉安，告诉他们在伊西鲁斯荒原与其他人见面。
items.normEn: Now that you've found Virizion, tell them to meet the others at the Moor of Icirrus.

items.en: Now that you've gathered all of the Grass Gems, talk to Virizion in Pinwheel Forest once again.
items.zh: 现在你已经收集了所有的草宝石，再次与风车森林的维里吉恩交谈。
items.normEn: Now that you've gathered all of the Grass Gems, talk to Virizion in Pinwheel Forest once again.

items.en: Now that you've proven you're strong enough to help, take Cobalion's advice and search for Kyurem in the Giant Chasm.
items.zh: 既然你已经证明自己有足够的力量来提供帮助，那就听从柯巴里恩的建议，在巨大裂缝中寻找酋雷姆吧。
items.normEn: Now that you've proven you're strong enough to help, take Cobalion's advice and search for Kyurem in the Giant Chasm.

items.en: Now that's a shocker! You're the real deal, kid! Fine, then, take the ThunderBadge!
items.zh: 现在真是令人震惊！你真是货真价实的孩子！好吧，那么，拿下 ThunderBadge！
items.normEn: Now that's a shocker! You're the real deal, kid! Fine, then, take the ThunderBadge!

items.en: Now then! If you want Kubfu to become stronger... there are special training grounds just for Kubfu! Prepare yourselves for the...Towers of Two Fists! The blue tower is the Tower of Waters! And the red tower is the Tower of Darkness!
items.zh: 那么现在！如果你想让库布变得更强……这里有专门为库布准备的训练场！为……两拳之塔做好准备！蓝色的塔就是水之塔！而红色的塔就是黑暗之塔！
items.normEn: Now then! If you want Kubfu to become stronger... there are special training grounds just for Kubfu! Prepare yourselves for the...Towers of Two Fists! The blue tower is the Tower of Waters! And the red tower is the Tower of Darkness!

items.en: Now then! The dojo's at max capacity! It's time to really start our training! You'll all be facing three trials. And there's more! The person who completes the three trials will receive the secret armor of this dojo!
items.zh: 那么现在！道场已满员！是时候真正开始我们的训练了！你们都将面临三项考验。还有更多！完成三关考验的人，将会获得这个道场的秘铠！
items.normEn: Now then! The dojo's at max capacity! It's time to really start our training! You'll all be facing three trials. And there's more! The person who completes the three trials will receive the secret armor of this dojo!

items.en: Now then... Come on out! This Pokémon is in fact the secret armor of the Master Dojo! Say hello to...Kubfu!
items.zh: 那么现在... 出来吧！这只神奇宝贝实际上是大师道场的秘密装甲！向...库布问好！
items.normEn: Now then... Come on out! This Pokémon is in fact the secret armor of the Master Dojo! Say hello to...Kubfu!

items.en: Now we can get us some Pinkan's for the theme park! Would you mind defeating 500 Pinkan Pokémon in the forest and out in the plains? We'll do the catching, you just need to beat 'em
items.zh: 现在我们可以为主题公园购买一些 Pinkan 了！您介意在森林和平原上击败 500 只 Pinkan 神奇宝贝吗？我们来抓，你只需要打败他们
items.normEn: Now we can get us some Pinkan's for the theme park! Would you mind defeating 500 Pinkan Pokémon in the forest and out in the plains? We'll do the catching, you just need to beat 'em

items.en: Now you've muddied the path, continue the Eterna Forest chase!
items.zh: 现在你已经把路弄脏了，继续永恒森林的追逐吧！
items.normEn: Now you've muddied the path, continue the Eterna Forest chase!

items.en: Now, enough chit-chat. UB-02 Absorption and UB-02 Beauty, Buzzwole and Pheromosa, have been sighted on Melemele Island. You know what to do!
items.zh: 现在，闲聊够了。 UB-02 吸收和 UB-02 美丽、Buzzwole 和 Pheromosa 已在 Melemele 岛上被发现。你知道该怎么做！
items.normEn: Now, enough chit-chat. UB-02 Absorption and UB-02 Beauty, Buzzwole and Pheromosa, have been sighted on Melemele Island. You know what to do!

items.en: Now, how about one more battle? I insist.
items.zh: 现在，再打一场怎么样？我坚持。
items.normEn: Now, how about one more battle? I insist.

items.en: Now, I give you permission to catch it!
items.normEn: Now, I give you permission to catch it!

items.en: Now, let's discuss the plan. Wait, you want to help too? You should know this will be a very dangerous mission, $playername$. We may not be able to fully protect you from the dangers we may face. The only way we can be sure of your safety is if you can hold your own against all three of us in battle. If you succeed, we will happily accept your assistance, but should you fail, then I apologise, but we cannot allow you to join the mission. What say you? Shall we spar?
items.zh: 现在，我们来讨论一下这个计划。等等，你也想帮忙吗？你应该知道这将是一个非常危险的任务，$playername$。我们可能无法完全保护您免受我们可能面临的危险。我们确保你安全的唯一方法就是你能在战斗中对抗我们三个人。如果你成功了，我们会很乐意接受你的协助，但如果你失败了，那么我很抱歉，但我们不能允许你加入任务。你说什么？我们要切磋一下吗？
items.normEn: Now, let's discuss the plan. Wait, you want to help too? You should know this will be a very dangerous mission, $playername$. We may not be able to fully protect you from the dangers we may face. The only way we can be sure of your safety is if you can hold your own against all three of us in battle. If you succeed, we will happily accept your assistance, but should you fail, then I apologise, but we cannot allow you to join the mission. What say you? Shall we spar?

items.en: Now, the Psychic Badge. A testament to your skill. Proof of your power.
items.zh: 现在，心灵徽章。对你技能的证明。证明你的力量。
items.normEn: Now, the Psychic Badge. A testament to your skill. Proof of your power.

items.en: Nowadays only Pokémon really use the Hero’s Bath...
items.zh: 现在只有神奇宝贝真正使用英雄之浴......
items.normEn: Nowadays only Pokémon really use the Hero’s Bath...

items.en: NPCs now in towns, will provide dialog that will help the player complete their Pokédex
items.zh: 现在城镇中的 NPC 将提供对话，帮助玩家完成他们的图鉴
items.normEn: NPCs now in towns, will provide dialog that will help the player complete their Pokédex

items.en: Number keys (1-9) can now be used to start Pokémon League battles
items.zh: 现在可以使用数字键（1-9）开始神奇宝贝联盟战斗
items.normEn: Number keys (1-9) can now be used to start Pokémon League battles

items.en: Number keys can now be used to select a save on the save selection menu
items.zh: 现在可以使用数字键在保存选择菜单上选择保存
items.normEn: Number keys can now be used to select a save on the save selection menu

items.en: Number of bosses in legendary dungeons rebalanced
items.zh: 传奇地下城中的 Boss 数量重新平衡
items.normEn: Number of bosses in legendary dungeons rebalanced

items.en: O-o-o-oh, my! Shadow Pokémon? And they attack people?! Now if that were true, that would be truly frightening. However, that is a little hard to believe.
items.zh: 哦，哦，天啊！影子宝可梦？他们还攻击人？！如果这是真的，那真是太可怕了。然而，这有点难以置信。
items.normEn: O-o-o-oh, my! Shadow Pokémon? And they attack people?! Now if that were true, that would be truly frightening. However, that is a little hard to believe.

items.zh: 橡树物品现在有 5 个装载

items.en: Oak items upgraded currency shows correct currency
items.zh: 橡木物品升级货币显示正确的货币
items.normEn: Oak items upgraded currency shows correct currency

items.zh: 获得 1,000 个地下城代币。
获得 1,000,000 个地下城代币。
获得 10,000 个地下城代币。
获得 100 个地下城代币。
获得 100,000 个地下城代币。
获得 100,000,000 个地下城代币。
获得所有 ${...} 巨型宝石。

items.en: Obtain and redeem a code from the PokéClicker Discord server.
items.zh: 从 PokéClicker Discord 服务器获取并兑换代码。
items.normEn: Obtain and redeem a code from the PokéClicker Discord server.

items.en: Obtain Mythic-tier loot from a debuffed dungeon. Loot that ignores debuff does not count.
items.zh: 从减益的地牢中获得神话级战利品。忽略减益效果的战利品不算在内。
items.normEn: Obtain Mythic-tier loot from a debuffed dungeon. Loot that ignores debuff does not count.

items.en: Obtain the items Captain Stern needs to upgrade the Submarine.
items.zh: 获得斯特恩船长升级潜艇所需的物品。
items.normEn: Obtain the items Captain Stern needs to upgrade the Submarine.

items.en: Obtain the Secret Armor of the Master Dojo.
items.zh: 获得道场大师的秘密铠甲。
items.normEn: Obtain the Secret Armor of the Master Dojo.

items.zh: 获得你的第一个大师球。
获得你的第一块巨型石头。
获得你的第一个超级球。
获得你的第一个维生素。

items.en: Of course you don't! You know nothing about the legend of 3000 years ago that says...
items.zh: 你当然不知道！你对3000年前的传说一无所知：
items.normEn: Of course you don't! You know nothing about the legend of 3000 years ago that says...

items.en: of that experience, rounded to the nearest tenth.
items.zh: 的经验，四舍五入到最接近的十分之一。
items.normEn: of that experience, rounded to the nearest tenth.

items.zh: 珍妮警官的 Pinkan 贸易店

items.en: Offline progress message not shown on new game creation
items.zh: 新游戏创建时不显示离线进度消息
items.normEn: Offline progress message not shown on new game creation

items.zh: 奥格彭（陆地化炉火面具）

items.en: Oh $playername$, you made it here. I wanted to learn about fossils so I went to the fossil lab, but the head scientist is not here.
items.zh: 哦$playername$，你成功了。我想了解化石，所以我去了化石实验室，但首席科学家不在这里。
items.normEn: Oh $playername$, you made it here. I wanted to learn about fossils so I went to the fossil lab, but the head scientist is not here.

items.en: Oh and also, I've heard of more sightings of strange disks across the region. I think they might be the Silvally Memories we're looking for. If you're ever lost, I got descriptions of them.
items.zh: 哦，还有，我听说在该地区发现了更多奇怪的圆盘。我想它们可能就是我们要找的《席尔瓦利回忆》。如果你迷路了，我有关于它们的描述。
items.normEn: Oh and also, I've heard of more sightings of strange disks across the region. I think they might be the Silvally Memories we're looking for. If you're ever lost, I got descriptions of them.

items.en: Oh hello there trainer! What do you mean we're not supposed to be here? We toootally got permission from Officer Jenny!
items.zh: 噢，教练你好！你说我们不应该在这里是什么意思？我们也得到了珍妮警官的许可！
items.normEn: Oh hello there trainer! What do you mean we're not supposed to be here? We toootally got permission from Officer Jenny!

items.en: Oh hey! Still chasing that Happiny, huh?
items.zh: 哦嘿！还在追那个幸福吧？
items.normEn: Oh hey! Still chasing that Happiny, huh?

items.en: Oh ho ho! You're wonderful! Your Pokémon are amazing.
items.zh: 哦嗬嗬！你太棒了！你的神奇宝贝太棒了。
items.normEn: Oh ho ho! You're wonderful! Your Pokémon are amazing.

items.en: Oh hoo… You are very strong indeed! I guess it's no surprise I lost. Here! Take this Insect Badge! I think it'll suit you!
items.zh: 呵呵……你确实很强啊！我想我输了并不奇怪。这里！收下这个昆虫徽章吧！我想它会适合你！
items.normEn: Oh hoo… You are very strong indeed! I guess it's no surprise I lost. Here! Take this Insect Badge! I think it'll suit you!

items.en: Oh it's you again! Got some Pinkan Berries to trade?
items.zh: 噢，又是你！有一些 Pinkan 浆果可以交易吗？
items.normEn: Oh it's you again! Got some Pinkan Berries to trade?

items.en: Oh my goodness, Nebby! To think you would be the emissary of the moon, Lunala!
items.zh: 天啊，内比！没想到你会成为月亮的使者，露娜拉！
items.normEn: Oh my goodness, Nebby! To think you would be the emissary of the moon, Lunala!

items.en: Oh my goodness, Nebby! To think you would be the emissary of the sun, Solgaleo!
items.zh: 天啊，内比！没想到你竟然是太阳的使者，索尔迦雷欧！
items.normEn: Oh my goodness, Nebby! To think you would be the emissary of the sun, Solgaleo!

items.en: Oh no, you're not gonna let more boulders stop you now. Catch or hatch 50 Fighting-types and smash right through them.
items.zh: 哦，不，你现在不会让更多的巨石阻止你了。捕捉或孵化 50 种战斗类型并直接粉碎它们。
items.normEn: Oh no, you're not gonna let more boulders stop you now. Catch or hatch 50 Fighting-types and smash right through them.

items.en: Oh no! Officer Jenny has showed up. She's not happy! No time to plead your case, it's time to battle!
items.zh: 哦不！珍妮警官出现了。她不高兴！没有时间为你辩护，是时候战斗了！
items.normEn: Oh no! Officer Jenny has showed up. She's not happy! No time to plead your case, it's time to battle!

items.en: Oh No! We got ambushed by these Pokémon!
items.zh: 哦不！我们被这些神奇宝贝伏击了！
items.normEn: Oh No! We got ambushed by these Pokémon!

items.en: Oh that business in the sewers? Yes, we should not have gone in there. Very unfortunate situation. A complete misunderstanding. We were just curious about what was down there.
items.zh: 哦，下水道里的事？是的，我们不应该进去。非常不幸的情况。完全是一场误会。我们只是好奇那里到底有什么。
items.normEn: Oh that business in the sewers? Yes, we should not have gone in there. Very unfortunate situation. A complete misunderstanding. We were just curious about what was down there.

items.en: Oh uh... forget I said that. Zinnia's already gone. I have no idea where she went, but another Draconid or even an ancient Sootopolitan might know. Maybe try talking to Wallace?
items.zh: 哦呃...忘记我说过了。百日草已经走了。我不知道她去了哪里，但另一个天龙族甚至古代的苏托波利斯人可能知道。也许尝试和华莱士谈谈？
items.normEn: Oh uh... forget I said that. Zinnia's already gone. I have no idea where she went, but another Draconid or even an ancient Sootopolitan might know. Maybe try talking to Wallace?

items.en: Oh you're good! You might just have a shot, here are some Beast Balls. Go hunt down those strange Ultra Beasts! If you need more Beast Balls, you can buy them here.
items.zh: 噢，你很好！你可以尝试一下，这里有一些野兽球。去追捕那些奇怪的究极异兽吧！如果您需要更多的兽珠，可以在这里购买。
items.normEn: Oh you're good! You might just have a shot, here are some Beast Balls. Go hunt down those strange Ultra Beasts! If you need more Beast Balls, you can buy them here.

items.en: Oh, $playername$, I didn't see you there. And you brought the Meteorite Shard with you. Well done!
items.zh: 哦，$playername$，我没在那里看到你。你还带着陨石碎片。干得好！
items.normEn: Oh, $playername$, I didn't see you there. And you brought the Meteorite Shard with you. Well done!

items.en: Oh, also, Dada said he would be interested in travelling with you. Although, he also said he needed to deal with the shortage of Quest Points the tribe is dealing with right now.
items.zh: 哦，还有，爸爸说他有兴趣和你一起去旅行。不过，他也表示，他需要解决部落目前任务点短缺的问题。
items.normEn: Oh, also, Dada said he would be interested in travelling with you. Although, he also said he needed to deal with the shortage of Quest Points the tribe is dealing with right now.

items.en: Oh, and here, $playername$. Some Revives. It's the least I can do after all the running around I've made you do.
items.zh: 哦，这里是$playername$。有些复活了。在我让你跑来跑去之后，这是我至少能做的了。
items.normEn: Oh, and here, $playername$. Some Revives. It's the least I can do after all the running around I've made you do.

items.en: Oh, and my father was asking about you. Look out for him in Rustboro City.
items.zh: 哦，我父亲也在问你的事。在拉斯特伯勒市留意他。
items.normEn: Oh, and my father was asking about you. Look out for him in Rustboro City.

items.en: Oh, another regional Pokédex completed so soon?
items.zh: 哦，又一个地区图鉴这么快就完成了？
items.normEn: Oh, another regional Pokédex completed so soon?

items.en: Oh, Bonnie... When will you learn there's no shame in losing? I'm glad whenever I get to learn something new thanks to strong challengers like you here.
items.zh: 哦，邦妮……你什么时候才能知道失败并不可耻？每当我能学到新东西时，我都很高兴，感谢像你这样强大的挑战者。
items.normEn: Oh, Bonnie... When will you learn there's no shame in losing? I'm glad whenever I get to learn something new thanks to strong challengers like you here.

items.en: Oh, but I hadn't had the chance to tell you! Congrats on your victory! Honestly... I never thought you'd manage to beat my brother. The greatest Champion Galar ever had! He was undefeatable till you came around! It's actually still pretty hard to believe...
items.zh: 哦，但我还没有机会告诉你！恭喜你的胜利！说实话……我没想到你能打败我哥哥。伽勒尔有史以来最伟大的冠军！在你出现之前，他是不可战胜的！其实还是很难相信...
items.normEn: Oh, but I hadn't had the chance to tell you! Congrats on your victory! Honestly... I never thought you'd manage to beat my brother. The greatest Champion Galar ever had! He was undefeatable till you came around! It's actually still pretty hard to believe...

items.en: Oh, Dada! Zaruza Zaru? Zaru. This is the Zarude that raised me, Dada. He says he was impressed watching you fight, and wants to fight you as well.
items.zh: 哦，达达！扎鲁扎扎鲁？扎鲁。这就是养育我的扎鲁德，达达。他说他对你的战斗印象深刻，并且也想和你战斗。
items.normEn: Oh, Dada! Zaruza Zaru? Zaru. This is the Zarude that raised me, Dada. He says he was impressed watching you fight, and wants to fight you as well.

items.en: Oh, dear me. Do you fail to understand still? You're such an innocent child. At times, I am the affable mayor of Phenac... And at others, I am the secret boss of the criminal syndicate Cipher!
items.zh: 哦，亲爱的我。你还不明白吗？你真是个天真无邪的孩子。有时，我是和蔼可亲的菲纳克市长……有时，我是犯罪集团 Cipher 的秘密老大！
items.normEn: Oh, dear me. Do you fail to understand still? You're such an innocent child. At times, I am the affable mayor of Phenac... And at others, I am the secret boss of the criminal syndicate Cipher!

items.en: Oh, dear me. That sure was a quick battle... I do hope you'll come back again sometime!
items.zh: 哦，亲爱的我。这确实是一场快速的战斗……我真的希望你能有一天再次回来！
items.normEn: Oh, dear me. That sure was a quick battle... I do hope you'll come back again sometime!

items.en: Oh, hello! Say, have you ever heard of Cresselia? Once when I was really little I had a really bad dream I couldn’t wake up from, but then a kind trainer went to an island near here and got help from Cresselia to cure me!
items.zh: 哦，你好！话说，你听说过克雷色利亚吗？有一次，当我很小的时候，我做了一个非常糟糕的梦，无法醒来，但后来一位善良的训练师去了附近的一个岛屿，并得到了克雷色利亚的帮助来治愈我！
items.normEn: Oh, hello! Say, have you ever heard of Cresselia? Once when I was really little I had a really bad dream I couldn’t wake up from, but then a kind trainer went to an island near here and got help from Cresselia to cure me!

items.en: Oh, I know! Why don't you become one of my Pokémon, together with Mewtwo?
items.zh: 哦，我知道！你为什么不和超梦一起成为我的神奇宝贝之一呢？
items.normEn: Oh, I know! Why don't you become one of my Pokémon, together with Mewtwo?

items.en: Oh, I see, that's quite the problem... Still, you said they're all out cold for now, right? In that case, we should have time for a battle!
items.zh: 哦，我明白了，这确实是个问题……不过，你说他们现在都冷了，对吧？既然如此，我们就应该有时间去战斗！
items.normEn: Oh, I see, that's quite the problem... Still, you said they're all out cold for now, right? In that case, we should have time for a battle!

items.en: Oh, I should just Imprison myself for this!
items.zh: 哦，我应该为此囚禁自己！
items.normEn: Oh, I should just Imprison myself for this!

items.en: Oh, it looks like a group of Zarude from the tribe are here..... They... are angry, they think you caught Zarude against its will. I'll try and talk sense into them,
items.zh: 哦，看来部落里有一群扎鲁德来了……他们……很生气，他们认为你违背了扎鲁德的意愿抓到了它。我会试着跟他们讲道理
items.normEn: Oh, it looks like a group of Zarude from the tribe are here..... They... are angry, they think you caught Zarude against its will. I'll try and talk sense into them,

items.en: Oh, it's you. I thought the professor would help when I put my request up at the Bulletin Board, but the Champion's even better.
items.zh: 哦，是你。我以为当我在公告板上提出请求时教授会提供帮助，但冠军更好。
items.normEn: Oh, it's you. I thought the professor would help when I put my request up at the Bulletin Board, but the Champion's even better.

items.en: Oh, my next Pokémon's gonna make short work-- Huh? That was my last one?
items.zh: 哦，我的下一个神奇宝贝很快就会成功——嗯？那是我最后一次吗？
items.normEn: Oh, my next Pokémon's gonna make short work-- Huh? That was my last one?

items.en: Oh, my! You're quite adept at instructing your Pokémon in battle! My goodness, that was fun!
items.zh: 哦，天哪！你非常擅长在战斗中指挥你的神奇宝贝！天哪，真有趣！
items.normEn: Oh, my! You're quite adept at instructing your Pokémon in battle! My goodness, that was fun!

items.en: Oh, my! You're something special, child!
items.normEn: Oh, my! You're something special, child!

items.en: Oh, never mind me! I'm just babbling about my own things. Let's have a battle the next we meet, shall we? I'm looking forward to it!
items.zh: 噢，别管我！我只是闲聊我自己的事情。下次见面我们来一场战斗吧？我很期待！
items.normEn: Oh, never mind me! I'm just babbling about my own things. Let's have a battle the next we meet, shall we? I'm looking forward to it!

items.en: Oh, Silvally Memory? The thing that's shaped like a disk? I have one right here, but I'm not sure how it works. Wait, I just got an idea, what about a trade? I'll trade the Memory for some Battle Points. I'll be here for a while, probably long enough for you to take a trip to the Hoenn region to get some Battle Points.
items.zh: 哦，西尔瓦利记忆？那个形状像圆盘的东西？我这里有一个，但我不确定它是如何工作的。等等，我有个主意，交易怎么样？我会用记忆换取一些战斗点数。我会在这里待一段时间，可能足够你去丰缘地区旅行以获得一些战斗点数。
items.normEn: Oh, Silvally Memory? The thing that's shaped like a disk? I have one right here, but I'm not sure how it works. Wait, I just got an idea, what about a trade? I'll trade the Memory for some Battle Points. I'll be here for a while, probably long enough for you to take a trip to the Hoenn region to get some Battle Points.

items.en: Oh, the Pokémon was called Oddish? It is adorable! Thank you so much for bringing it to me! Please, accept this Leaf Stone.
items.zh: 哦，神奇宝贝被称为Oddish？真可爱！非常感谢你把它带给我！请收下这块叶石。
items.normEn: Oh, the Pokémon was called Oddish? It is adorable! Thank you so much for bringing it to me! Please, accept this Leaf Stone.

items.en: Oh, what I would pay to add it to my collection! But money is of no help here. I bet Grant would be willing to part with it if I challenge him enough times and prove my skills to him.
items.zh: 哦，我愿意付出什么代价才能将它添加到我的收藏中！但钱在这里并没有什么帮助。我敢打赌，如果我挑战他足够多并向他证明我的技能，格兰特会愿意放弃它。
items.normEn: Oh, what I would pay to add it to my collection! But money is of no help here. I bet Grant would be willing to part with it if I challenge him enough times and prove my skills to him.

items.en: Oh, whatever! Who cares about all of that? It's time for me to get some sweet revenge... with style!
items.zh: 哦，无论如何！谁关心这一切？是时候让我来一场甜蜜的复仇了……有风格！
items.normEn: Oh, whatever! Who cares about all of that? It's time for me to get some sweet revenge... with style!

items.en: Oh, where are my manners! Hi there! Have some Rare Candies! I'm Burnet, a professor who researches Ultra Wormholes. They sometimes appear in the skies of Alola and give off similar signals to Cosmog's powers.
items.zh: 噢，我的礼貌到哪里去了！你好呀！来点稀有糖果吧！我是伯内特，一位研究超级虫洞的教授。它们有时会出现在阿罗拉的天空中，并发出与科斯莫格的力量类似的信号。
items.normEn: Oh, where are my manners! Hi there! Have some Rare Candies! I'm Burnet, a professor who researches Ultra Wormholes. They sometimes appear in the skies of Alola and give off similar signals to Cosmog's powers.

items.en: Oh, whoops! You're not a Pokémon! Sorry, it's so dark in here, I saw you and thought you were some kind of Pokémon.
items.zh: 哦，哎呀！你不是神奇宝贝！抱歉，这里太黑了，我看到你还以为你是某种神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Oh, whoops! You're not a Pokémon! Sorry, it's so dark in here, I saw you and thought you were some kind of Pokémon.

items.en: Oh, yeah... Returns not accepted, got that?
items.zh: 哦，是的...退货不被接受，明白吗？
items.normEn: Oh, yeah... Returns not accepted, got that?

items.en: Oh, you came from the Forest! That Old Chateau is so creepy, isn’t it? I’ve heard that trainers that catch the weird ghost in the TV have found ghosts in other appliances. Even lawnmowers!
items.zh: 哦，你来自森林！那个老城堡太令人毛骨悚然了，不是吗？我听说那些在电视中发现怪异鬼魂的培训师也在其他电器中发现了鬼魂。甚至割草机！
items.normEn: Oh, you came from the Forest! That Old Chateau is so creepy, isn’t it? I’ve heard that trainers that catch the weird ghost in the TV have found ghosts in other appliances. Even lawnmowers!

items.en: Oh, you have already encountered them? And you are busy with the Orange League?
items.zh: 哦，你已经遇到过他们吗？你正忙于橙色联盟吗？
items.normEn: Oh, you have already encountered them? And you are busy with the Orange League?

items.en: Oh, you want us to return them? Then perhaps we should settle this with a battle?
items.zh: 哦，你想让我们归还它们吗？那么或许我们应该用一场战斗来解决这个问题？
items.normEn: Oh, you want us to return them? Then perhaps we should settle this with a battle?

items.en: Oh, you're asking if I have a Silvally Memory? You mean from that weird fusion-like Pokémon? Yeah, I do. It has a weird green coloration on it, which weirdly enough reminds me of Pokémon resistant to Electric attacks and weak against Fire attacks.
items.zh: 哦，你是问我有没有希尔瓦利记忆？你是说那个奇怪的融合型神奇宝贝吗？是的，我愿意。它上面有一种奇怪的绿色，这很奇怪，让我想起神奇宝贝对电攻击有抵抗力，但对火攻击却很弱。
items.normEn: Oh, you're asking if I have a Silvally Memory? You mean from that weird fusion-like Pokémon? Yeah, I do. It has a weird green coloration on it, which weirdly enough reminds me of Pokémon resistant to Electric attacks and weak against Fire attacks.

items.en: Oh, you're back? And you've brought the 5,000 Grass Gems. I'm impressed. Very well, you've earned my trust. So, Cobalion wants us to meet at the Moor of Icirrus to reunite the Swords of Justice? Sounds just like the old Cobalion I remember. I'll make my way there now, you should come too. I'm sure your assistance is still desired.
items.zh: 哦，你回来了？你还带来了 5000 颗草宝石。我印象深刻。很好，你赢得了我的信任。那么，Cobalion 希望我们在伊西鲁斯摩尔人会面，重新团结正义之剑？听起来就像我记忆中的旧 Cobalion。我现在就去那里，你也应该来。我确信仍然需要您的帮助。
items.normEn: Oh, you're back? And you've brought the 5,000 Grass Gems. I'm impressed. Very well, you've earned my trust. So, Cobalion wants us to meet at the Moor of Icirrus to reunite the Swords of Justice? Sounds just like the old Cobalion I remember. I'll make my way there now, you should come too. I'm sure your assistance is still desired.

items.en: Oh, you're looking for something called a Silvally Memory and Hala told you I found one? Do you mean this thing?
items.zh: 哦，你正在寻找一种叫做席尔瓦利记忆的东西，而哈拉告诉你我找到了一个？你是说这个东西吗？
items.normEn: Oh, you're looking for something called a Silvally Memory and Hala told you I found one? Do you mean this thing?

items.en: Oh, you've found all the fossil Pokémon native to Kalos! We tried too, but our search ended in failure. No, that's not entirely true...!
items.zh: 哦，您已经找到了卡洛斯本土的所有神奇宝贝化石！我们也尝试过，但我们的搜寻以失败告终。不，这并不完全正确......！
items.normEn: Oh, you've found all the fossil Pokémon native to Kalos! We tried too, but our search ended in failure. No, that's not entirely true...!

items.en: Oh! Been a while, friends. The kahuna? Hrmm. Well, I suppose the time might be right now... All right. Let us all proceed to the ruins. You stick with me, you two.
items.zh: 哦！好久不见了，朋友们。卡胡纳？嗯。嗯，我想现在可能是时候了……好吧。让我们一起前往废墟吧。你们两个，跟我一起吧。
items.normEn: Oh! Been a while, friends. The kahuna? Hrmm. Well, I suppose the time might be right now... All right. Let us all proceed to the ruins. You stick with me, you two.

items.en: Oh! Hi! You're not a member of Team Rocket! You came to save us? Why thank you!
items.zh: 哦！你好！你不是火箭队的成员！你是来救我们的吗？为什么要谢谢你！
items.normEn: Oh! Hi! You're not a member of Team Rocket! You came to save us? Why thank you!

items.en: Oh! I concede defeat. You are remarkably strong. I must confer on you the RainbowBadge.
items.zh: 哦！我认输了。你非常坚强。我必须授予你彩虹徽章。
items.normEn: Oh! I concede defeat. You are remarkably strong. I must confer on you the RainbowBadge.

items.en: Oh! I don’t get visitors often. My husband is a sailor who visits faraway lands… he always tells me these fantastic things.
items.zh: 哦！我不经常接待访客。我的丈夫是一名水手，经常到访遥远的地方……他总是告诉我这些奇妙的事情。
items.normEn: Oh! I don’t get visitors often. My husband is a sailor who visits faraway lands… he always tells me these fantastic things.

items.en: Oh! I have been defeated! Alack, alay! Lady Korrina gave a terrible display! This is it. I must give up my title and admit that your strength far exceeds-- Just teasing! But here's your Badge. Boy, you'll be rolling in 'em soon!
items.zh: 哦！我被打败了！哎呀，哎呀！科琳娜女士表现得很糟糕！就是这样。我必须放弃我的头衔，承认你的实力远远超过——开玩笑！但这是你的徽章。孩子，你很快就会在他们身上打滚了！
items.normEn: Oh! I have been defeated! Alack, alay! Lady Korrina gave a terrible display! This is it. I must give up my title and admit that your strength far exceeds-- Just teasing! But here's your Badge. Boy, you'll be rolling in 'em soon!

items.en: Oh! I'm sorry, I almost dozed off. I was reminiscing about my stroll in Viridian Forest earlier today. I came across the loveliest patch of flowers over there and...
items.zh: 哦！对不起，我差点打瞌睡了。我回忆起今天早些时候在常磐森林漫步的情景。我在那里发现了最美丽的一片花，然后……
items.normEn: Oh! I'm sorry, I almost dozed off. I was reminiscing about my stroll in Viridian Forest earlier today. I came across the loveliest patch of flowers over there and...

items.en: Oh! Klara and Avery! You two look out of breath... But you have some Max Mushrooms, so it looks like you both pass the second trial as well!
items.zh: 哦！克拉拉和艾弗里！你们看起来都气喘吁吁了……不过你们有一些麦克斯蘑菇，看来你们也都通过了第二次考验！
items.normEn: Oh! Klara and Avery! You two look out of breath... But you have some Max Mushrooms, so it looks like you both pass the second trial as well!

items.en: Oh! Th-that's... Thank you! You're simply amazing. ... ... ... ... Um... May I ask one more giant favor of you?
items.zh: 哦！那、那是……谢谢！你真是太棒了。 …………嗯……我可以再拜托你一个大忙吗？
items.normEn: Oh! Th-that's... Thank you! You're simply amazing. ... ... ... ... Um... May I ask one more giant favor of you?

items.en: Oh! Welcome, welcome. Do you by any chance have any Meteorites? No? Ah well, I’m studying the Pokémon Deoxys and I’ve heard that a Meteorite can cause it to change forms!
items.zh: 哦！欢迎，欢迎。你有陨石吗？不？啊，好吧，我正在研究神奇宝贝代欧奇希斯，我听说陨石可以让它改变形态！
items.normEn: Oh! Welcome, welcome. Do you by any chance have any Meteorites? No? Ah well, I’m studying the Pokémon Deoxys and I’ve heard that a Meteorite can cause it to change forms!

items.en: Oh! You've already met Professor Sycamore, how wonderful! That is a wonderful thing, indeed. You are one of the chosen ones.
items.zh: 哦！你已经认识了Sycamore教授，太棒了！这确实是一件美妙的事情。你是被选中的人之一。
items.normEn: Oh! You've already met Professor Sycamore, how wonderful! That is a wonderful thing, indeed. You are one of the chosen ones.

items.en: Oh? Some of your Pokémon may find an extra egg if left in the hatchery. Would you care to find out what baby will hatch?
items.zh: 哦？如果你的一些神奇宝贝留在孵化场，可能会发现额外的蛋。你想知道会孵出什么宝宝吗？
items.normEn: Oh? Some of your Pokémon may find an extra egg if left in the hatchery. Would you care to find out what baby will hatch?

items.en: Oh... How can this be? My...my Pokémon...
items.zh: 哦……怎么会这样？我的……我的宝可梦……
items.normEn: Oh... How can this be? My...my Pokémon...

items.en: Oh... I guess I was trying too hard... I... I've only recently become a Gym Leader. I tried too hard to be someone I'm not. I have to do things my natural way. If I don't, my Pokémon will be confused. Thanks for teaching me that. For that, you deserve this.
items.zh: 哦...我想我太努力了...我...我最近才成为道馆馆长。我太努力地想成为一个不是我的人。我必须以自然的方式做事。如果我不这样做，我的神奇宝贝就会感到困惑。谢谢你教我这一点。为此，你应得的。
items.normEn: Oh... I guess I was trying too hard... I... I've only recently become a Gym Leader. I tried too hard to be someone I'm not. I have to do things my natural way. If I don't, my Pokémon will be confused. Thanks for teaching me that. For that, you deserve this.

items.en: Oh... Oh, thank goodness! So...you're also one of the professor's acquaintances? It's nice to meet you...
items.zh: 噢……噢，谢天谢地！那么……你也是教授的熟人之一？很高兴认识你...
items.normEn: Oh... Oh, thank goodness! So...you're also one of the professor's acquaintances? It's nice to meet you...

items.en: Oh...um...yes! You can call me Lillie. I know it's too much for me to ask it, but... Do you think you could see us back to town?
items.zh: 哦……嗯……是的！你可以叫我莉莉。我知道这个要求对我来说太过分了，但是……你认为你能送我们回城吗？
items.normEn: Oh...um...yes! You can call me Lillie. I know it's too much for me to ask it, but... Do you think you could see us back to town?

items.zh: 哦哦...我高贵的神奇宝贝...

items.en: OK, I Have Enough Attack Already...
items.zh: 好吧，我的攻击力已经够了……
items.normEn: OK, I Have Enough Attack Already...

items.en: OK, OK! I get my R from a guy at Clifford Industries, in Goldenrod City.
items.zh: 好的，好的！我的 R 是从金罗德市克利福德工业公司的一个人那里得到的。
items.normEn: OK, OK! I get my R from a guy at Clifford Industries, in Goldenrod City.

items.en: OK, so I lost... but I got to see a lot of the good points of you and your Pokémon!
items.zh: 好吧，所以我输了……但我看到了你和你的神奇宝贝的很多优点！
items.normEn: OK, so I lost... but I got to see a lot of the good points of you and your Pokémon!

items.en: Okay Fine, I Can Do a Few More
items.normEn: Okay Fine, I Can Do a Few More

items.en: Okay, this is good... I did it! I linked up with Lanette! I did it! I've managed to link up with Trainers in the Hoenn region! Finally, the Network Machine is fully operational! I owe it all to you! Thanks to you, my dream came true...
items.zh: 好吧，这很好……我做到了！我和拉内特联系上了！我做到了！我已经成功与丰缘地区的训练家取得联系了！网络机器终于全面投入使用了！这一切都是我欠你的！谢谢你，我的梦想成真了……
items.normEn: Okay, this is good... I did it! I linked up with Lanette! I did it! I've managed to link up with Trainers in the Hoenn region! Finally, the Network Machine is fully operational! I owe it all to you! Thanks to you, my dream came true...

items.en: Okay! It seems they finally understand. I'm really sorry for all the trouble they caused for you.
items.zh: 好的！看来他们终于明白了。对于他们给你带来的麻烦，我真的很抱歉。
items.normEn: Okay! It seems they finally understand. I'm really sorry for all the trouble they caused for you.

items.en: Okay... It's great that you were able to knock them all out without hurting them too much, but I don't think I'll be able to calm all of them on my own when they wake up.
items.zh: 好吧……很高兴你能够在不伤害他们太多的情况下将他们全部击倒，但我认为当他们醒来时我无法独自安抚他们所有人。
items.normEn: Okay... It's great that you were able to knock them all out without hurting them too much, but I don't think I'll be able to calm all of them on my own when they wake up.

items.en: Old man Nanu has been looking after our grand trials up until now. I'm the captain and all, so I've gotta come up with a trial.
items.zh: 纳努老人至今一直在照顾我们的大试炼。我是队长，所以我必须想出一个办法。
items.normEn: Old man Nanu has been looking after our grand trials up until now. I'm the captain and all, so I've gotta come up with a trial.

items.en: Old Oak apparently had an encounter with this Celebi back when he was still young Oak. And he's here! He might know where the Celebi went, you should have a chat with him.
items.zh: 老橡树显然在还是年轻橡树的时候就曾遇到过这个雪拉比。他来了！他可能知道雪拉比去了哪里，你应该和他谈谈。
items.normEn: Old Oak apparently had an encounter with this Celebi back when he was still young Oak. And he's here! He might know where the Celebi went, you should have a chat with him.

items.en: Old Quests will no longer give a notification when completed once they are refreshed
items.zh: 旧任务刷新后完成后不再提示
items.normEn: Old Quests will no longer give a notification when completed once they are refreshed

items.en: On screen Safari Zone controls not working
items.zh: 屏幕上的 Safari Zone 控件不起作用
items.normEn: On screen Safari Zone controls not working

items.en: On the news, they are getting more reports of roaming Pokémon appearing on {ROUTE_NAME}!
items.zh: 在新闻中，他们收到了更多有关漫游神奇宝贝出现在 {ROUTE_NAME} 上的报道！
items.normEn: On the news, they are getting more reports of roaming Pokémon appearing on {ROUTE_NAME}!

items.en: On the search for mysteries of the sea, eh? Well then I have one whale of a tale for you! But are yeh worthy?
items.zh: 寻找海洋的奥秘，是吗？那么我有一个关于鲸鱼的故事给你听！但你们值得吗？
items.normEn: On the search for mysteries of the sea, eh? Well then I have one whale of a tale for you! But are yeh worthy?

items.en: On this island, Pokémon have changed over the years. I am here to study them.
items.zh: 在这个岛上，神奇宝贝多年来发生了变化。我来这里是为了研究它们。
items.normEn: On this island, Pokémon have changed over the years. I am here to study them.

items.en: Once again we will use the legendary Dragon-type Pokémon and we will rule the Unova region!
items.zh: 我们将再次使用传说中的龙系神奇宝贝，统治合众地区！
items.normEn: Once again we will use the legendary Dragon-type Pokémon and we will rule the Unova region!

items.en: Once fully grown, the Berry plant can be manually harvested with a click or by a hired Farm Hand. Both methods will yield Farm Points.
items.zh: 一旦完全成熟，浆果植物就可以通过点击或由雇佣的农场工人手动收获。两种方法都会产生农场积分。
items.normEn: Once fully grown, the Berry plant can be manually harvested with a click or by a hired Farm Hand. Both methods will yield Farm Points.

items.en: Once I finish it you'll have a way to get to get to that island too, so make sure to come back later!
items.zh: 一旦我完成它，你也将有办法到达那个岛，所以一定要稍后再回来！
items.normEn: Once I finish it you'll have a way to get to get to that island too, so make sure to come back later!

items.en: Once my Galarian Farfetch’d was holding a Leek.. Blimey, I was surprised how quickly he transformed into a noble ally! With the Leek growing into a mighty stalk for battle!
items.zh: 有一次我的加拉瑞法奇拿着一根韭葱……天哪，我很惊讶他这么快就变成了一个高贵的盟友！韭菜长成参战的大茎！
items.normEn: Once my Galarian Farfetch’d was holding a Leek.. Blimey, I was surprised how quickly he transformed into a noble ally! With the Leek growing into a mighty stalk for battle!

items.en: Once you are done, you could come back at dusk. Maybe you can do something about it...
items.zh: 完成后，你可以在黄昏时回来。也许你可以做点什么......
items.normEn: Once you are done, you could come back at dusk. Maybe you can do something about it...

items.en: Once you go to the next region, you will not be able to go back to previous regions until you reach the dock.
items.zh: 一旦您前往下一个区域，您将无法返回之前的区域，直到到达码头。
items.normEn: Once you go to the next region, you will not be able to go back to previous regions until you reach the dock.

items.en: Once you have obtained a Held Item, visit your Item Bag. They are most often found in Dungeons, but some, like the Wonder Chest, are for sale!
items.zh: 获得持有物品后，请访问您的物品袋。它们最常见于地下城，但有些，如神奇宝箱，是出售的！
items.normEn: Once you have obtained a Held Item, visit your Item Bag. They are most often found in Dungeons, but some, like the Wonder Chest, are for sale!

items.en: One ball left, one chance to make it shine
items.zh: 还剩下一颗球，一次让它闪耀的机会
items.normEn: One ball left, one chance to make it shine

items.en: One bite of this very tender Berry fills the mouth with its sweet and tangy flavor.
items.zh: 咬一口这种非常嫩的浆果，口腔中就会充满甜味和浓郁的味道。
items.normEn: One bite of this very tender Berry fills the mouth with its sweet and tangy flavor.

items.en: One column to rule them all
items.normEn: One column to rule them all

items.en: One day I was tending to my Passho berries and a Squirtle suddenly appeared! If only I knew about this before spending all of my Quest Points on Water Eggs..
items.zh: 有一天，我正在照料我的帕绍浆果，一只杰尼龟突然出现了！如果我在把所有任务点花在水蛋上之前知道这一点就好了……
items.normEn: One day I was tending to my Passho berries and a Squirtle suddenly appeared! If only I knew about this before spending all of my Quest Points on Water Eggs..

items.en: One day, I forgot to harvest them, and within its withered husk, I found a small stone that enabled my Banette to perform a Mega Evolution.
items.zh: 有一天，我忘了收割它们，在它枯萎的外壳中，我发现了一块小石头，可以让我的巴内特进行超级进化。
items.normEn: One day, I forgot to harvest them, and within its withered husk, I found a small stone that enabled my Banette to perform a Mega Evolution.

items.zh: 一个是岛屿天堂，另一个是冰冻荒原。
items.normEn: One is an island paradise, the other a freezing wasteland.

items.zh: 其他一名学生表示，他们在 {ROUTE_NAME} 上看到了一种罕见的神奇宝贝。可能值得一看。

items.normEn: One of the pushing Pokémons Dr. Splash asked you for his laboratory

items.en: One step closer to victory: Clear Mount Lanakila!
items.zh: 距离胜利又近了一步：清除拉纳基拉山！
items.normEn: One step closer to victory: Clear Mount Lanakila!

items.en: One time he came back and his Wailmer looked funny. We took it to the Pokécenter and they said it had caught some weird virus called Pokérus!
items.zh: 有一次他回来时，他的哭声看上去很滑稽。我们把它带到 Pokécenter，他们说它感染了一种叫做 Pokérus 的奇怪病毒！
items.normEn: One time he came back and his Wailmer looked funny. We took it to the Pokécenter and they said it had caught some weird virus called Pokérus!

items.en: Only the toughest trainers in Orre are allowed to fight here! I'm just watching until I get stronger.
items.zh: 只有奥雷最厉害的训练师才被允许在这里战斗！我只是看着，直到我变得更强。
items.normEn: Only the toughest trainers in Orre are allowed to fight here! I'm just watching until I get stronger.

items.en: Only those who beat the champion are strong enough to face them!
items.zh: 只有击败过冠军的人才有足够的实力去面对他们！
items.normEn: Only those who beat the champion are strong enough to face them!

items.en: Oof. I'd kind of forgotten how strong you are.
items.zh: 钱币。我差点忘了你有多坚强。
items.normEn: Oof. I'd kind of forgotten how strong you are.

items.en: Ooh, I so hate to say this! I can't beat you right now. Master Greevil will so be cross with me but… But that's okay.
items.zh: 哦，我真讨厌说这个！我现在打不过你。贪魔大师会对我很生气，但是……不过没关系。
items.normEn: Ooh, I so hate to say this! I can't beat you right now. Master Greevil will so be cross with me but… But that's okay.

items.en: Ooh, this is as radiant as a Legendary Pokémon! Definitely keeping it.
items.zh: 噢，这就像传说中的神奇宝贝一样光芒四射！绝对要保留它。
items.normEn: Ooh, this is as radiant as a Legendary Pokémon! Definitely keeping it.

items.en: Oops! I keep finding myself caught up in observing the way the Pokémon use their moves...
items.zh: 哎呀！我一直发现自己陷入了观察神奇宝贝使用动作的方式......
items.normEn: Oops! I keep finding myself caught up in observing the way the Pokémon use their moves...

items.zh: 在新选项卡中打开链接
items.normEn: Open links in a new tab

items.zh: 或者完成所有任务以获得奖励
items.normEn: Or complete all quests for a bonus

items.en: or download the offline Windows client:
items.normEn: or download the offline Windows client:

items.en: Or go to Konikoni City down south. You might even meet our kahuna there!
items.zh: 或者前往南部的科尼科尼市。您甚至可能会在那里遇到我们的卡胡纳！
items.normEn: Or go to Konikoni City down south. You might even meet our kahuna there!

items.en: or interacting with the plot in any way.
items.zh: 或以任何方式与情节互动。
items.normEn: or interacting with the plot in any way.

items.en: Orre dungeons have an updated encounter display
items.zh: 奥雷地下城有更新的遭遇显示
items.normEn: Orre dungeons have an updated encounter display

items.zh: Orre Poké 地点无法访问

items.en: Other berries will now be tasked in Quests
items.zh: 其他浆果现在将在任务中承担任务
items.normEn: Other berries will now be tasked in Quests

items.en: Other Deoxys forms obtainable in the Battle Frontier
items.zh: 战斗前沿中可获得的其他代欧奇希斯形态
items.normEn: Other Deoxys forms obtainable in the Battle Frontier

items.en: Other factors that will multiply damage value include flutes, battle items, and weather. Gems can be used to change the effectiveness and weakness multipliers as well.
items.zh: 其他会增加伤害值的因素包括长笛、战斗物品和天气。宝石也可用于改变有效性和弱点乘数。
items.normEn: Other factors that will multiply damage value include flutes, battle items, and weather. Gems can be used to change the effectiveness and weakness multipliers as well.

items.en: Otherwise you can download the Windows client from here:
items.zh: 否则，您可以从此处下载 Windows 客户端：
items.normEn: Otherwise you can download the Windows client from here:

items.en: Otherwise, after some time being fully grown, the Berry plant will wither away, dropping half of the expected Berries, though it may also be re-planted automatically.
items.zh: 否则，在完全生长一段时间后，浆果植物会枯萎，掉落一半预期的浆果，尽管它也可能会自动重新种植。
items.normEn: Otherwise, after some time being fully grown, the Berry plant will wither away, dropping half of the expected Berries, though it may also be re-planted automatically.

items.en: Our ancestors were greedy, though. They sought to control all of Necrozma's light... They hurt Necrozma... They left it incomplete, and in such a state, it went mad with fury... And so our light was stolen by Necrozma. Now, the one that wields light to its will... It would steal all of Alola's light!
items.zh: 但我们的祖先却很贪婪。他们试图控制奈克洛兹玛的所有光芒……他们伤害了奈克洛兹玛……他们让它不完整，在这种状态下，它因愤怒而疯狂……所以我们的光被奈克洛兹玛偷走了。现在，那个随心所欲地运用光的人……它会偷走阿罗拉所有的光！
items.normEn: Our ancestors were greedy, though. They sought to control all of Necrozma's light... They hurt Necrozma... They left it incomplete, and in such a state, it went mad with fury... And so our light was stolen by Necrozma. Now, the one that wields light to its will... It would steal all of Alola's light!

items.en: Our company's records indicate that a meteor landed in Granite Cave thousands of years ago. Can you search the area for fragments of that meteor?
items.zh: 我们公司的记录显示，数千年前一颗流星曾降落在花岗岩洞穴中。你能在该地区搜寻那颗流星的碎片吗？
items.normEn: Our company's records indicate that a meteor landed in Granite Cave thousands of years ago. Can you search the area for fragments of that meteor?

items.en: Our favorite way to train is by doing quests. Someday my Medicham even found a Mega Stone while claiming some.
items.zh: 我们最喜欢的训练方式是做任务。有一天，我的麦迪查姆在领取一些时甚至发现了一块巨型石头。
items.normEn: Our favorite way to train is by doing quests. Someday my Medicham even found a Mega Stone while claiming some.

items.en: Our final target is UB-05 Glutton. Guzzlord. It is very dangerous. You must not underestimate this beast.
items.zh: 我们的最终目标是UB-05暴食者。古兹领主。这是非常危险的。你绝对不能低估这只野兽。
items.normEn: Our final target is UB-05 Glutton. Guzzlord. It is very dangerous. You must not underestimate this beast.

items.en: Our great ancestors once lived here, too. The ancestors who passed down through me the knowledge of how to protect the world... How to avert the threat that will appear from space, as long was foretold... From a place higher even than the heavens...
items.zh: 我们伟大的祖先也曾经住在这里。祖先们通过我传承了如何保护世界的知识……如何避免来自太空的威胁，正如预言的那样……来自比天空更高的地方……
items.normEn: Our great ancestors once lived here, too. The ancestors who passed down through me the knowledge of how to protect the world... How to avert the threat that will appear from space, as long was foretold... From a place higher even than the heavens...

items.en: Our island is a special place, home to Magikarp patterns that aren't found anywhere else in the world! Collect and raise them all to increase your jump power and take on our league champion!
items.zh: 我们的岛屿是一个特殊的地方，这里有世界上其他任何地方都找不到的鲤鱼图案！收集并饲养它们以增强你的跳跃能力并挑战我们的联赛冠军！
items.normEn: Our island is a special place, home to Magikarp patterns that aren't found anywhere else in the world! Collect and raise them all to increase your jump power and take on our league champion!

items.en: Our Marnie’s Morpeko is so cute, don’tcha think?
items.zh: 我们的玛妮的莫佩科太可爱了，你不觉得吗？
items.normEn: Our Marnie’s Morpeko is so cute, don’tcha think?

items.en: Our only real tourist attraction is the Relic Stone north of town. Just passing by it is enough to make you feel calmer.
items.zh: 我们唯一真正的旅游景点是镇北的遗迹石。仅仅只是路过这里，就足以让你的心情平静下来。
items.normEn: Our only real tourist attraction is the Relic Stone north of town. Just passing by it is enough to make you feel calmer.

items.en: Our park staff stocks the Safari with different hard-to-find Pokémon every day. Many of these Pokémon can't be caught anywhere else in the world!
items.zh: 我们的公园工作人员每天都会在野生动物园里储备各种难以找到的神奇宝贝。其中许多神奇宝贝是在世界其他地方无法捕获的！
items.normEn: Our park staff stocks the Safari with different hard-to-find Pokémon every day. Many of these Pokémon can't be caught anywhere else in the world!

items.zh: 我们的计划就泡汤了！撤退！

items.en: Our research indicates a higher concentration of roaming Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}!
items.zh: 我们的研究表明，{ROUTE_NAME} 上的漫游神奇宝贝更加集中！
items.normEn: Our research indicates a higher concentration of roaming Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}!

items.en: Our sources indicate that roaming Pokémon are gathering on {ROUTE_NAME}!
items.zh: 我们的消息来源表明，漫游神奇宝贝正在{ROUTE_NAME}上聚集！
items.normEn: Our sources indicate that roaming Pokémon are gathering on {ROUTE_NAME}!

items.en: Our Ultra Megalopolis was once a world filled with light... Necrozma was called the Blinding One, and it gave us all the energy we needed.
items.zh: 我们的超级都市曾经是一个充满光明的世界……奈克洛兹玛被称为致盲者，它给了我们所需的所有能量。
items.normEn: Our Ultra Megalopolis was once a world filled with light... Necrozma was called the Blinding One, and it gave us all the energy we needed.

items.en: Out of all the dog-like Pokémon, I think Rockruff is definitely the most adorable. And it even has three evolutions! One during the day, one at night and one in between, from 5 to 6 o'clock.
items.zh: 在所有像狗一样的神奇宝贝中，我认为洛克拉夫绝对是最可爱的。而且它还有三种进化！白天一场，晚上一场，五点到六点之间一场。
items.normEn: Out of all the dog-like Pokémon, I think Rockruff is definitely the most adorable. And it even has three evolutions! One during the day, one at night and one in between, from 5 to 6 o'clock.

items.en: Outstanding! I'm tough as an iceberg, but you smashed me through and through!
items.zh: 杰出的！我坚强得像一座冰山，但你却把我彻底粉碎了！
items.normEn: Outstanding! I'm tough as an iceberg, but you smashed me through and through!

items.en: Owowow! Okay, okay, I got it! You can have your stupid egg!
items.zh: 哇哇哇！好吧好吧，我明白了！你可以吃你的傻蛋了！
items.normEn: Owowow! Okay, okay, I got it! You can have your stupid egg!

items.en: Palaeontologist Token can now be traded for Diamonds
items.zh: 古生物学家代币现在可以兑换钻石
items.normEn: Palaeontologist Token can now be traded for Diamonds

items.zh: 编辑前的 Paldea 动态背景

items.en: Palkia was captured in the Origin Ball and returned to its base form!
items.zh: 帕路奇犽被捕获在源球之中，恢复了原始形态！
items.normEn: Palkia was captured in the Origin Ball and returned to its base form!

items.en: Penny has revealed herself to be Cassiopeia. Defeat her at Naranjuva Academy.
items.zh: 佩妮透露自己就是卡西奥佩娅。在纳兰朱瓦学院击败她。
items.normEn: Penny has revealed herself to be Cassiopeia. Defeat her at Naranjuva Academy.

items.en: Peony told you of a peculiar ruin located at Three-Point Pass. Explore the area to find it.
items.zh: 牡丹告诉你，三点关有一处奇特的遗迹。探索该地区以找到它。
items.normEn: Peony told you of a peculiar ruin located at Three-Point Pass. Explore the area to find it.

items.en: Peony's daughter, Peonia, wants to talk to you in Freezington.
items.zh: 佩妮的女儿佩妮娅想在弗利青顿和你谈谈。
items.normEn: Peony's daughter, Peonia, wants to talk to you in Freezington.

items.en: People can be divided into two groups. Those who give... And those who take... It's just as how the Kalos region's two Legendary Pokémon gave life and took life.
items.zh: 人们可以分为两类。给予的人……和索取的人……就像卡洛斯地区的两只传奇神奇宝贝给予生命和夺走生命一样。
items.normEn: People can be divided into two groups. Those who give... And those who take... It's just as how the Kalos region's two Legendary Pokémon gave life and took life.

items.en: People cannot survive all on their own. They have got to help one another out. Same for Pokémon, too. That is what my grandfather used to say.
items.zh: 人不能完全靠自己生存。他们必须互相帮助。神奇宝贝也一样。这是我祖父曾经说过的。
items.normEn: People cannot survive all on their own. They have got to help one another out. Same for Pokémon, too. That is what my grandfather used to say.

items.en: People from Ula'ula have seen Guzma walking around Po Town, so I suspect he might've found a Silvally Memory. Go ask him in Po Town.
items.zh: 乌拉乌拉的人见过古兹马在波镇附近行走，所以我怀疑他可能找到了希尔瓦利记忆。去蒲镇问他吧。
items.normEn: People from Ula'ula have seen Guzma walking around Po Town, so I suspect he might've found a Silvally Memory. Go ask him in Po Town.

items.en: People say they have truly mystical powers, but that they require Gems of different types to use. Also, using more Flutes at the same time costs more Gems to use.
items.zh: 人们说他们拥有真正的神秘力量，但他们需要不同类型的宝石才能使用。此外，同时使用更多的笛子需要花费更多的宝石。
items.normEn: People say they have truly mystical powers, but that they require Gems of different types to use. Also, using more Flutes at the same time costs more Gems to use.

items.en: per level, up to a maximum of
items.normEn: per level, up to a maximum of

items.en: Perhaps it is time that we stop taking matters into our own hands and instead start relying on others. Must we start by putting our faith in you?
items.zh: 也许我们是时候停止把事情掌握在自己手中，而开始依赖他人了。我们必须首先信任你吗？
items.normEn: Perhaps it is time that we stop taking matters into our own hands and instead start relying on others. Must we start by putting our faith in you?

items.en: Perhaps when their duty was completed, they went into some kind of sleep?
items.zh: 也许当他们的职责完成后，他们就进入了某种睡眠状态？
items.normEn: Perhaps when their duty was completed, they went into some kind of sleep?

items.en: Pesky Roamers, I Need to One-Shot Routes for Them...
items.zh: 讨厌的漫游者，我需要为他们提供一次性路线......
items.normEn: Pesky Roamers, I Need to One-Shot Routes for Them...

items.en: Pfft, I Don't Need a Bike Voucher
items.normEn: Pfft, I Don't Need a Bike Voucher

items.en: Phew... That was an Exeggutor, wasn't it? This island is full of them! I think that they should all clear out once we get past them.
items.zh: 唷……那是一颗椰蛋，不是吗？这个岛上到处都是它们！我认为一旦我们越过了他们，他们就应该全部清除了。
items.normEn: Phew... That was an Exeggutor, wasn't it? This island is full of them! I think that they should all clear out once we get past them.

items.en: Phew... That was awesome! That was a really great battle! I had a blast fighting you!
items.zh: 唷……太棒了！那真是一场伟大的战斗！我和你战斗的时候很开心！
items.normEn: Phew... That was awesome! That was a really great battle! I had a blast fighting you!

items.en: Phew… You're really somethin'! Li'l whippersnapper Trainers who pack a real punch keep showin' up one after another. Mrmph. Here! Take this!
items.zh: 唷……你真是了不起！实力强劲的自命不凡训练家不断涌现。先生。这里！拿着这个！
items.normEn: Phew… You're really somethin'! Li'l whippersnapper Trainers who pack a real punch keep showin' up one after another. Mrmph. Here! Take this!

items.zh: 等离子啊啊啊！等离子啊啊！！

items.zh: 加上盔甲岛上的一只看起来火热的家伙！

items.zh: 而且看起来那些神奇宝贝正在等你，现在他们已经平静下来了。

items.en: Pokémon... Shall no longer exist. Pokémon are wonderful beings. Humans have worked with Pokémon, and we have helped each other flourish. But precisely because of that, they will inevitably become tools for war and theft!
items.zh: 神奇宝贝……将不复存在。神奇宝贝是奇妙的存在。人类与神奇宝贝合作，我们互相帮助，共同繁荣。但也正因为如此，它们必然成为战争和盗窃的工具！

items.en: See, my Silvally has been acting strange lately, almost as if it's back to being haunted by its traumatizing past, the poor thing. Silvally are unique Pokémon who can download memories from artificial disks to change their type, but my Silvally's own memories somehow got mixed in with them. I need to get the disks back and recover its memories. That's where you come in.
items.zh: 看，我的席尔瓦利最近表现得很奇怪，几乎就像它又被过去的创伤所困扰一样，可怜的东西。席瓦利是独特的神奇宝贝，可以从人造磁盘下载记忆来改变其类型，但我的席瓦利自己的记忆不知何故与它们混合在一起。我需要取回磁盘并恢复其记忆。这就是你进来的地方。
items.normEn: See, my Silvally has been acting strange lately, almost as if it's back to being haunted by its traumatizing past, the poor thing. Silvally are unique Pokémon who can download memories from artificial disks to change their type, but my Silvally's own memories somehow got mixed in with them. I need to get the disks back and recover its memories. That's where you come in.

items.normEn: Since some of these Trainers come from far away, you may see Pokémon that you might not be able to catch yet.

items.en: Since then, lots of people have helped by contributing code via GitHub.
items.zh: 从那时起，许多人通过 GitHub 贡献代码来提供帮助。
items.normEn: Since then, lots of people have helped by contributing code via GitHub.

items.en: Since times long gone, Hoenn has repeatedly suffered great disasters. At times, the destruction took the form of a huge meteoroid, which fell upon our land from distant space.
items.zh: 自古以来，丰缘屡遭大祸。有时，破坏会以巨大的流星体的形式从遥远的太空落在我们的土地上。
items.normEn: Since times long gone, Hoenn has repeatedly suffered great disasters. At times, the destruction took the form of a huge meteoroid, which fell upon our land from distant space.

items.en: Sitrus came from the same family as Oran. It is larger and smoother-tasting than Oran.
items.zh: 西特鲁斯和奥兰来自同一个家庭。它比奥兰更大、味道更顺滑。
items.normEn: Sitrus came from the same family as Oran. It is larger and smoother-tasting than Oran.

items.en: Sketchy theme checkboxes and close icons should display correctly now
items.zh: 粗略的主题复选框和关闭图标现在应该正确显示
items.normEn: Sketchy theme checkboxes and close icons should display correctly now

items.en: Slower growth berry auras now only affects matured plants
items.zh: 生长缓慢的浆果光环现在只影响成熟的植物
items.normEn: Slower growth berry auras now only affects matured plants

items.en: Snagging this powerful Shadow Pokémon will be hard, take this Master Ball!
items.zh: 想要抓住这只强大的暗影宝可梦是很困难的，拿走这个大师球吧！
items.normEn: Snagging this powerful Shadow Pokémon will be hard, take this Master Ball!

items.zh: 斯诺拉克斯 12 号路线
斯诺拉克斯 16 号路线
斯诺弗（浆果）+ 主世界

items.en: Snover are happy to let you pick their berries.  They then wander away into the wilderness. Please be kind to them!
items.zh: Snover 很乐意让您采摘他们的浆果。然后他们就流浪到旷野。请善待他们！
items.normEn: Snover are happy to let you pick their berries. They then wander away into the wilderness. Please be kind to them!

items.en: So everything is over now, right? Right? Go beat Anistar City Gym!
items.zh: 所以现在一切都结束了，对吗？正确的？去打败安妮斯塔城市健身房吧！
items.normEn: So everything is over now, right? Right? Go beat Anistar City Gym!

items.en: So far I've found two that I relate to, a kind of flower-looking thing and one that looks like a bug pincer.
items.zh: 到目前为止，我已经找到了两种与我相关的东西，一种看起来像花，另一种看起来像虫钳。
items.normEn: So far I've found two that I relate to, a kind of flower-looking thing and one that looks like a bug pincer.

items.en: So Giovanni was there at the Falls while you were dealing with that mess at the Radio Tower? If only we had known, we could have had him arrested right then and there.
items.zh: 那么当你在无线电塔处理混乱的时候，乔瓦尼就在瀑布吗？如果我们知道的话，我们就可以当场逮捕他。
items.normEn: So Giovanni was there at the Falls while you were dealing with that mess at the Radio Tower? If only we had known, we could have had him arrested right then and there.

items.en: So Hapu lives here on Poni Island? Let's go, $playername$! She can help us find the kahuna! It will be good to see her and Mudsdale again!
items.zh: 那么哈普就住在波尼岛吗？走吧，$playername$！她可以帮助我们找到卡胡纳！很高兴再次见到她和穆兹代尔！
items.normEn: So Hapu lives here on Poni Island? Let's go, $playername$! She can help us find the kahuna! It will be good to see her and Mudsdale again!

items.en: So in the ancient world, their primal forms once held this much power…? The super-ancient Pokémon… What terrible strength… But this appearance here… It seems somehow different from Mega Evolution, but somehow related.
items.zh: 那么在远古世界，他们的原始形态曾经拥有过如此大的力量……？超古代神奇宝贝……好可怕的实力……不过这里的这个样子……似乎和超级进化有些不同，却又有些关联。
items.normEn: So in the ancient world, their primal forms once held this much power…? The super-ancient Pokémon… What terrible strength… But this appearance here… It seems somehow different from Mega Evolution, but somehow related.

items.en: So it really was Eternatus again? Given that the purple glow has vanished, I guess you've already taken care of it. Congrats!
items.zh: 那么这真的又是永恒吗？鉴于紫色光芒已经消失，我猜你已经处理掉了。恭喜！
items.normEn: So it really was Eternatus again? Given that the purple glow has vanished, I guess you've already taken care of it. Congrats!

items.en: So long as you're not helping those Rocket clowns, we'll let you trade for some of those rare Pinkan Pokémon that have only just come to the island.
items.zh: 只要你不帮助那些火箭小丑，我们就会让你交易一些刚刚来到岛上的稀有平坎神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: So long as you're not helping those Rocket clowns, we'll let you trade for some of those rare Pinkan Pokémon that have only just come to the island.

items.en: So spicy is the Spelon Berry that, Fire type or not, Pokémon will try to breathe fire after eating a single one.
items.zh: 斯佩隆浆果太辣了，无论是否是火系，神奇宝贝在吃了一颗后都会尝试喷火。
items.normEn: So spicy is the Spelon Berry that, Fire type or not, Pokémon will try to breathe fire after eating a single one.

items.en: So that didn't work? Well, I heard there are some legendary Pokémon in those ruins, called Regirock, Regice, and Registeel. Apparently they'll show up to people who have done enough explorin' in their ruins.
items.zh: 那么这不起作用吗？嗯，我听说那些遗迹里有一些传说中的神奇宝贝，叫做雷吉洛克、雷吉斯和雷吉斯钢。显然，他们会出现在那些在废墟中进行了足够探索的人们面前。
items.normEn: So that didn't work? Well, I heard there are some legendary Pokémon in those ruins, called Regirock, Regice, and Registeel. Apparently they'll show up to people who have done enough explorin' in their ruins.

items.en: So that's them is it? I can definitely see the resemblance, but they don't seem quite the same...
items.zh: 那么就是他们了是吗？我确实可以看到相似之处，但它们看起来并不完全相同......
items.normEn: So that's them is it? I can definitely see the resemblance, but they don't seem quite the same...

items.en: So the foundation really was working together with Team Skull? Lillie, Gladion, and Lusamine all are a family?! This is, like, way too mind-blowing to think about right now. $playername$! Let's knock some skulls together for now!
items.zh: 那么基金会真的在与骷髅队合作吗？莉莉艾、格拉迪翁、露莎米奈竟然是一家人？！现在想想，这实在是太令人兴奋了。 $玩家名$！现在让我们一起敲一些头骨吧！
items.normEn: So the foundation really was working together with Team Skull? Lillie, Gladion, and Lusamine all are a family?! This is, like, way too mind-blowing to think about right now. $playername$! Let's knock some skulls together for now!

items.en: So THESE were the mighty Xerneas and Yveltal?! I expected more from Pokémon called legend! You desire help from people? YOU need help from a human?
items.zh: 这就是强大的哲尔尼亚斯和伊维尔塔尔？！我对传说中的神奇宝贝更加期待！你需要人们的帮助吗？您需要人类的帮助吗？
items.normEn: So THESE were the mighty Xerneas and Yveltal?! I expected more from Pokémon called legend! You desire help from people? YOU need help from a human?

items.en: So they wouldn't open... That's annoyin'. Well, there are also 3 more ruins, 2 at opposite ends of Giant's Bed, and one at Snowslide Slope. Maybe you should have a look at those?
items.zh: 所以他们不会打开...这很烦人。嗯，还有 3 个废墟，2 个在巨人床的两端，1 个在雪滑坡。也许你应该看看那些？
items.normEn: So they wouldn't open... That's annoyin'. Well, there are also 3 more ruins, 2 at opposite ends of Giant's Bed, and one at Snowslide Slope. Maybe you should have a look at those?

items.en: So this is it then? The GS Ball. I can see why old Oak wants me to have a crack at it.
items.zh: 那么就是这样了吗？ GS 球。我明白为什么老奥克想让我尝试一下。
items.normEn: So this is it then? The GS Ball. I can see why old Oak wants me to have a crack at it.

items.en: So this is the gem that forms a pair with the Ruby... You've gone through a lot to get this, didn't you? You don't have to tell me. I know it wasn't easy. Thank you so much! Now it's my turn to work for you! Please give me a little time.
items.zh: 这就是与红宝石成对的宝石……为了得到这个，你经历了很多，不是吗？你不必告诉我。我知道这并不容易。太感谢了！现在轮到我为你工作了！请给我一点时间。
items.normEn: So this is the gem that forms a pair with the Ruby... You've gone through a lot to get this, didn't you? You don't have to tell me. I know it wasn't easy. Thank you so much! Now it's my turn to work for you! Please give me a little time.

items.en: So this is what has come of human technology and of hope and blood and sweat and tears and... Well, the list gets kinda long and boring.
items.zh: 这就是人类技术、希望、鲜血、汗水和泪水所带来的一切……好吧，这个清单有点长而且无聊。
items.normEn: So this is what has come of human technology and of hope and blood and sweat and tears and... Well, the list gets kinda long and boring.

items.en: So this is what it means to draw forth the power hidden in your Pokémon! To me, whether Team Plasma wins or whether you win will decide how the relationship between people and Pokémon should be! You'd better hurry, they have already captured the legendary Dragon-type Pokémon! Good luck in your battle!
items.zh: 这就是激发神奇宝贝中隐藏的力量的意义！对我来说，等离子队获胜或者你获胜将决定人与神奇宝贝之间的关系应该如何！你得快点，他们已经捕获了传说中的龙系神奇宝贝了！祝你战斗顺利！
items.normEn: So this is what it means to draw forth the power hidden in your Pokémon! To me, whether Team Plasma wins or whether you win will decide how the relationship between people and Pokémon should be! You'd better hurry, they have already captured the legendary Dragon-type Pokémon! Good luck in your battle!

items.en: So you can't learn everything just from the Pokédex... I see!
items.zh: 所以你不能仅仅从图鉴中学到所有东西……我明白了！
items.normEn: So you can't learn everything just from the Pokédex... I see!

items.en: So you defeated Ghetsis. Interesting. You must be a very strong trainer.
items.zh: 所以你打败了盖西斯。有趣的。你一定是一位非常强大的训练家。
items.normEn: So you defeated Ghetsis. Interesting. You must be a very strong trainer.

items.en: So you will be taking part in the festival battle? I'll be sure to watch you and Hau.
items.zh: 那么你会参加祭典之战吗？我一定会看着你和Hau的。
items.normEn: So you will be taking part in the festival battle? I'll be sure to watch you and Hau.

items.en: So you're not with them? Okay... Just don't help those criminals in the future, got it? Looks like some new Pinkan Pokémon have made their way to the island, if you bring us some Pinkan Berries we'll trade you for them.
items.zh: 那么你不和他们在一起吗？好吧……以后不要再帮助那些罪犯了，明白了吗？看起来一些新的 Pinkan 神奇宝贝已经来到了岛上，如果你给我们带来一些 Pinkan 浆果，我们就会用你换取它们。
items.normEn: So you're not with them? Okay... Just don't help those criminals in the future, got it? Looks like some new Pinkan Pokémon have made their way to the island, if you bring us some Pinkan Berries we'll trade you for them.

items.en: So you're once again planning to claim that this is best for humanity, or best for the whole darn world? It's a snap of your fingers to repeat the sins of the past.
items.zh: 所以你又打算声称这对人类来说是最好的，或者对整个世界来说是最好的？重蹈过去的罪孽，只是弹指一挥间。
items.normEn: So you're once again planning to claim that this is best for humanity, or best for the whole darn world? It's a snap of your fingers to repeat the sins of the past.

items.en: So you're really leaving on your very own Pokémon journey. I'm so proud of you. Let me give you some words of wisdom for your travels.
items.zh: 所以你真的要开始你自己的神奇宝贝之旅了。我为你感到骄傲。让我给你一些旅行中的智慧之言。
items.normEn: So you're really leaving on your very own Pokémon journey. I'm so proud of you. Let me give you some words of wisdom for your travels.

items.en: So, do you think... Would you be up for one more battle?
items.zh: 那么，您认为...您愿意再打一场战斗吗？
items.normEn: So, do you think... Would you be up for one more battle?

items.en: So, how can I help you? Oh, you're looking for a Silvally Memory? I have been keeping one of them here and doing a little bit of testing to find out how it works. Maybe we could make a trade. I'll trade the Silvally Memory for some Pokédollars. I'll be trying to figure out how it works, so you can go get Pokédollars and come back later to trade if you need to.
items.zh: 那么，我能为您提供什么帮助呢？哦，您在寻找《西尔瓦利记忆》吗？我一直把其中一个放在这里，并做了一些测试来了解它是如何工作的。也许我们可以做笔交易。我会用席尔瓦利记忆换一些神奇币。我会尝试弄清楚它是如何运作的，这样你就可以去获取 Pokédollars，如果需要的话稍后再回来进行交易。
items.normEn: So, how can I help you? Oh, you're looking for a Silvally Memory? I have been keeping one of them here and doing a little bit of testing to find out how it works. Maybe we could make a trade. I'll trade the Silvally Memory for some Pokédollars. I'll be trying to figure out how it works, so you can go get Pokédollars and come back later to trade if you need to.

items.en: So, I'm part of a tribe of Pokémon called Zarude, I was raised by them despite being a human. One of them has gone missing, I've been told they were seen roaming, completely lost, around the Isle of Armor.
items.zh: 所以，我是神奇宝贝部落扎鲁德的一员，尽管我是人类，但我还是被他们抚养长大的。其中一人失踪了，有人告诉我有人看到他们在阿莫岛周围漫游，完全迷路了。
items.normEn: So, I'm part of a tribe of Pokémon called Zarude, I was raised by them despite being a human. One of them has gone missing, I've been told they were seen roaming, completely lost, around the Isle of Armor.

items.en: So, you said you want to know where you might find Mewtwo's Mega Stones, right?
items.zh: 那么，你说你想知道在哪里可以找到超梦的巨型石头，对吗？
items.normEn: So, you said you want to know where you might find Mewtwo's Mega Stones, right?

items.en: So, you’ve managed to calm the Aura Duo… Quite the feat. But your Xerneas… it seems to have entered a dormant state. That form you see now is but a shadow of its true power. To awaken its full potential, you must strengthen its bond through training. Only then, when its strength has grown a hundredfold, will the light of its true form shine once more.
items.zh: 所以，你已经成功地让 Aura Duo 平静下来了……这真是太棒了。但你的哲尔尼亚斯……似乎进入了休眠状态。你现在看到的形式只是其真正力量的影子。为了充分发挥它的潜力，你必须通过训练来加强它的联系。只有当它的力量增长百倍之时，它的真身之光才会再次闪耀。
items.normEn: So, you’ve managed to calm the Aura Duo… Quite the feat. But your Xerneas… it seems to have entered a dormant state. That form you see now is but a shadow of its true power. To awaken its full potential, you must strengthen its bond through training. Only then, when its strength has grown a hundredfold, will the light of its true form shine once more.

items.en: So… I lost… It seems that I still have much more to learn… I understand. The Pokémon League's rules state that Trainers are to be given this if they defeat a Gym Leader. Please accept the official Pokémon League Stone Badge.
items.zh: 所以……我输了……看来我还有很多东西要学……我明白了。神奇宝贝联盟的规则规定，如果训练师击败道馆馆长，他们将获得此奖励。请接受官方的神奇宝贝联盟石徽章。
items.normEn: So… I lost… It seems that I still have much more to learn… I understand. The Pokémon League's rules state that Trainers are to be given this if they defeat a Gym Leader. Please accept the official Pokémon League Stone Badge.

items.en: So.... Maybe if you keep defeating them, they'll occasionally drop them?
items.zh: 那么……也许如果你不断击败他们，他们偶尔会掉落它们？
items.normEn: So.... Maybe if you keep defeating them, they'll occasionally drop them?

items.en: Softlock from Safari Ticket and Shard Case if the user refreshed the page after obtaining a badge
items.zh: 如果用户在获得徽章后刷新页面，则 Safari Ticket 和 Shard Case 会出现软锁
items.normEn: Softlock from Safari Ticket and Shard Case if the user refreshed the page after obtaining a badge

items.zh: 索尔迦雷欧（光芒四射的太阳）

items.zh: 一些成就出现在错误的类别中

items.zh: 一些成就未显示为已完成
items.normEn: Some achievements not showing as completed

items.zh: 一些冒险家报告了 42 号公路上的犯罪活动。据称，火箭队正试图偷走刚出生的 Phanpy……
items.normEn: Some adventurers reported criminal activities on route 42. Team Rocket are allegedly attempting to steal newborn Phanpy...

items.zh: 一些战斗背景图像没有显示，现在应该正确显示
items.normEn: Some battle background images were not showing, they should now appear correctly

items.en: Some berries can be obtained as Pokémon drops or from dungeon chests, but most are obtained through mutation on the Farm.
items.zh: 有些浆果可以通过神奇宝贝掉落或地牢箱获得，但大多数是通过农场的突变获得的。
items.normEn: Some berries can be obtained as Pokémon drops or from dungeon chests, but most are obtained through mutation on the Farm.

items.zh: 一些浆果光环会增加或减少遇到流浪神奇宝贝的几率。

items.zh: 一些过滤器选项和默认过滤器在游戏开始时是隐藏的，当它们变得相关时将解锁。
items.normEn: Some filter options and default filters are hidden at the start of the game, and will unlock as they become relevant.

items.en: Some folks have been corrupting their Pokémon and making them commit totally jank acts.
items.zh: 有些人一直在腐蚀他们的神奇宝贝，让他们做出完全垃圾的行为。
items.normEn: Some folks have been corrupting their Pokémon and making them commit totally jank acts.

items.en: Some Fossils appearing in the underground too early
items.zh: 一些化石过早出现在地下
items.normEn: Some Fossils appearing in the underground too early

items.en: Some guy in a weird white outfit was chasing a Happiny!
items.zh: 一个穿着奇怪的白色衣服的家伙正在追逐幸福！
items.normEn: Some guy in a weird white outfit was chasing a Happiny!

items.en: Some Gyms and Dungeons HP buffed
items.zh: 一些道馆和地下城的生命值得到增强
items.normEn: Some Gyms and Dungeons HP buffed

items.zh: 有些物品只有达到一定的 Safari 级别后才可用。

items.zh: 某些项目在通知中的名称中显示 _
items.normEn: Some items showing _ in their name in notifications

items.zh: 某些位置未显示为锁定状态
items.normEn: Some locations not showing as locked
