items.zh: 一些超级进化现已可用
items.normEn: Some mega evolutions are now available

items.zh: 一些小的 Discord 集成

items.en: Some nasty villains are up to no good.
items.normEn: Some nasty villains are up to no good.

items.en: Some Nice Help for the Day Care
items.normEn: Some Nice Help for the Day Care

items.zh: 一些通知包含额外的 .人物

items.en: Some of them have been carrying small but powerful items known as Key Stones. These have the power to let Pokémon Mega Evolve! You may have experienced something like that in Kalos, but it's new to us here.
items.zh: 他们中的一些人携带着小而强大的物品，称为钥匙石。这些拥有让神奇宝贝超级进化的力量！您可能在卡洛斯经历过类似的事情，但对我们来说这是新的。
items.normEn: Some of them have been carrying small but powerful items known as Key Stones. These have the power to let Pokémon Mega Evolve! You may have experienced something like that in Kalos, but it's new to us here.

items.en: Some old man tried to teach me how to catch Pokémon earlier. I just shouted
items.zh: 一些老人试图教我如何早点捕捉神奇宝贝。我刚刚喊了一声
items.normEn: Some old man tried to teach me how to catch Pokémon earlier. I just shouted

items.en: Some people from Akala Island have seen some people in white suits with a lot of boxes travelling to the southwest of the island.
items.zh: 一些来自阿卡拉岛的人曾看到一些穿着白色西装的人带着很多箱子前往该岛的西南部。
items.normEn: Some people from Akala Island have seen some people in white suits with a lot of boxes travelling to the southwest of the island.

items.en: Some people from Poni Island have seen Plumeria walking around with some old Team Skull grunts around the Vast Poni Canyon. That is really suspicious, so they probably found something rare or presumably a Silvally Memory.
items.zh: 一些来自波尼岛的人曾看到 Plumeria 和一些老骷髅队在广阔的波尼峡谷周围走来走去。这确实很可疑，所以他们可能发现了一些罕见的东西，或者可能是西尔瓦利记忆。
items.normEn: Some people from Poni Island have seen Plumeria walking around with some old Team Skull grunts around the Vast Poni Canyon. That is really suspicious, so they probably found something rare or presumably a Silvally Memory.

items.en: Some people not being able to create a new save
items.zh: 有些人无法创建新的保存
items.normEn: Some people not being able to create a new save

items.en: Some people want to talk to you.
items.normEn: Some people want to talk to you.

items.en: Some Pokémon babies, only from Day Care they come! Hatch! Hatch! Hatch!
items.zh: 有些神奇宝贝宝宝是来自托儿所的！孵化！孵化！孵化！
items.normEn: Some Pokémon babies, only from Day Care they come! Hatch! Hatch! Hatch!

items.en: Some Pokémon can only be obtained by breeding.
items.zh: 有些神奇宝贝只能通过培育来获得。
items.normEn: Some Pokémon can only be obtained by breeding.

items.en: Some Pokémon evolve when exposed to a Linking Cord, or sent through a trade.
items.zh: 有些神奇宝贝在接触连接线或通过交易发送时会进化。
items.normEn: Some Pokémon evolve when exposed to a Linking Cord, or sent through a trade.

items.zh: 一些神奇宝贝等级速度类型

items.en: Some Pokémon now have a chance to drop rare items upon defeat
items.zh: 一些神奇宝贝现在有机会在失败时掉落稀有物品
items.normEn: Some Pokémon now have a chance to drop rare items upon defeat

items.en: Some Pokémon silhouettes showing colors when not obtained yet
items.zh: 一些尚未获得的神奇宝贝轮廓会显示颜色
items.normEn: Some Pokémon silhouettes showing colors when not obtained yet

items.en: Some Pokémon were not counted towards the catch a type quests
items.zh: 一些神奇宝贝不计入捕捉类型任务
items.normEn: Some Pokémon were not counted towards the catch a type quests

items.en: Some quest lines not starting when they should have
items.zh: 有些任务线没有在应该开始的时候开始
items.normEn: Some quest lines not starting when they should have

items.zh: 一些任务线步骤导致玩家被卡住
items.normEn: Some questline steps causing players to be stuck

items.en: Some requirements for routes and towns
items.zh: 对路线和城镇的一些要求
items.normEn: Some requirements for routes and towns

items.en: Some Roaming Pokémon will only appear after certain requirements have been met
items.zh: 一些漫游神奇宝贝只有在满足某些要求后才会出现
items.normEn: Some Roaming Pokémon will only appear after certain requirements have been met

items.en: Some Sinnoh and Alola stones added to Underground
items.zh: 一些神奥和阿罗拉石头被添加到地下
items.normEn: Some Sinnoh and Alola stones added to Underground

items.en: Some strange eggs have been seen around Kanto. Go look for it! Maybe Erika knows more?
items.zh: 在关东地区发现了一些奇怪的鸡蛋。去找吧！也许埃里卡知道更多？
items.normEn: Some strange eggs have been seen around Kanto. Go look for it! Maybe Erika knows more?

items.en: Some Team Plasma Grunts were seen entering the Castelia Sewers. Clear Castelia Sewers.
items.zh: 有人看到一些等离子队士兵进入卡斯特利亚下水道。清理卡斯特利亚下水道。
items.normEn: Some Team Plasma Grunts were seen entering the Castelia Sewers. Clear Castelia Sewers.

items.zh: 一些教练图片无法加载

items.en: Some Trial Sites are protected by different Pokémon depending on the time of day. The difficulty of each Trial isn't affected by these changes, but it makes for quite the interesting observance!
items.zh: 一些试用地点根据一天中的时间受到不同神奇宝贝的保护。每个试炼的难度不会受到这些变化的影响，但它却带来了相当有趣的遵守！
items.normEn: Some Trial Sites are protected by different Pokémon depending on the time of day. The difficulty of each Trial isn't affected by these changes, but it makes for quite the interesting observance!

items.en: Some unknown bird Pokémon have been sighted near Dyna Tree Hill in Ballimere Lake. Explore the area to see for yourself.
items.zh: 在巴利米尔湖的戴纳树山附近发现了一些未知的鸟类神奇宝贝。亲自探索该地区。
items.normEn: Some unknown bird Pokémon have been sighted near Dyna Tree Hill in Ballimere Lake. Explore the area to see for yourself.

items.en: Some very rare Pokémon have been sighted on {ROUTE_NAME}. I hope we can learn more about them.
items.zh: 在{ROUTE_NAME}上发现了一些非常稀有的神奇宝贝。我希望我们能够更多地了解他们。
items.normEn: Some very rare Pokémon have been sighted on {ROUTE_NAME}. I hope we can learn more about them.

items.en: Someone to hire in your Daycare.
items.zh: 您的日托中心雇用的人。
items.normEn: Someone to hire in your Daycare.

items.en: Someone told me that training an Eevee on Route 217 will make it evolve.
items.zh: 有人告诉我，在 217 号公路上训练伊布将会使其进化。
items.normEn: Someone told me that training an Eevee on Route 217 will make it evolve.

items.en: Something amazing happened on top of Mt. Coronet. We could see it all the way from here. I'm sure everyone in the entire region saw it.
items.zh: 皇冠山顶上发生了一件奇妙的事情。从这里我们可以一路看到它。我相信整个地区的每个人都看到了。
items.normEn: Something amazing happened on top of Mt. Coronet. We could see it all the way from here. I'm sure everyone in the entire region saw it.

items.zh: 奇妙的事情刚刚发生了！

items.en: Sometimes a cool singing Pokémon shows up and joins in on our set. I’ve heard that trainers as strong as the Champion have found it roaming around the region looking for Pokémon battles… but even I wouldn’t challenge it to a Music battle.
items.zh: 有时，会唱歌的神奇宝贝会出现并加入我们的场景。我听说像冠军一样强大的训练家发现它在该地区漫游，寻找神奇宝贝对战……但即使是我也不会挑战它进行音乐对战。
items.normEn: Sometimes a cool singing Pokémon shows up and joins in on our set. I’ve heard that trainers as strong as the Champion have found it roaming around the region looking for Pokémon battles… but even I wouldn’t challenge it to a Music battle.

items.en: Sometimes I find some weird stuff out in the sand, sometimes even Pokémon hiding in Chests. Like this one time in Relic Castle, I found a Pokémon that looks like a statue that I've never seen before!
items.zh: 有时我会在沙子里发现一些奇怪的东西，有时甚至会在箱子里发现神奇宝贝。就像这次在遗迹城堡里，我发现了一只像雕像一样的神奇宝贝，我以前从未见过！
items.normEn: Sometimes I find some weird stuff out in the sand, sometimes even Pokémon hiding in Chests. Like this one time in Relic Castle, I found a Pokémon that looks like a statue that I've never seen before!

items.en: Sordward and Shielbert are forcing Pokémon to rampage in Galar's Stadiums. First is a Tsareena in Turffield Stadium. Defeat it.
items.zh: 索德沃德和希尔伯特迫使神奇宝贝在伽勒尔的体育场内横冲直撞。第一个是特菲尔德体育场的 Tsareena。打败它。
items.normEn: Sordward and Shielbert are forcing Pokémon to rampage in Galar's Stadiums. First is a Tsareena in Turffield Stadium. Defeat it.

items.en: Sordward and Shielbert are trying to steal the Wishing Stars at Professor Magnolia's Lab in Wedgehurst. Stop them.
items.zh: 索德沃德和希尔伯特正试图窃取位于韦奇赫斯特的木兰教授实验室的许愿星。阻止他们。
items.normEn: Sordward and Shielbert are trying to steal the Wishing Stars at Professor Magnolia's Lab in Wedgehurst. Stop them.

items.en: Sordward and Shielbert are trying to use the Rusted Sword and Shield to make Zacian and Zamazenta go on a rampage in Energy Plant. Stop them.
items.zh: 索德沃德和希尔伯特试图使用生锈的剑和盾牌让扎西安和扎马森塔在能源工厂横冲直撞。阻止他们。
items.normEn: Sordward and Shielbert are trying to use the Rusted Sword and Shield to make Zacian and Zamazenta go on a rampage in Energy Plant. Stop them.

items.en: Sordward and Shielbert have forced a Conkeldurr and a Dusknoir to rampage in Stow-on-Side Stadium. Defeat them both.
items.zh: 索德沃德和希尔伯特迫使康克尔杜尔和黑夜人在斯托赛德体育场横冲直撞。击败他们两个。
items.normEn: Sordward and Shielbert have forced a Conkeldurr and a Dusknoir to rampage in Stow-on-Side Stadium. Defeat them both.

items.en: Sordward and Shielbert have forced a Gigalith and a Froslass to rampage in Circhester Stadium. Defeat them both
items.zh: 索德沃德和希尔伯特迫使巨石人和弗罗斯拉斯在瑟切斯特体育场横冲直撞。击败他们两个
items.normEn: Sordward and Shielbert have forced a Gigalith and a Froslass to rampage in Circhester Stadium. Defeat them both

items.en: Sordward and Shielbert have forced a Gyarados to rampage in Hulbury Stadium. Defeat it as well.
items.zh: 索德沃德和希尔伯特迫使暴鲤龙在赫尔伯里体育场横冲直撞。打败它也一样。
items.normEn: Sordward and Shielbert have forced a Gyarados to rampage in Hulbury Stadium. Defeat it as well.

items.en: Sordward and Shielbert have forced a Haxorus to rampage in Hammerlocke Stadium. Hopefully this is the last one.
items.zh: 索德沃德和希尔伯特迫使哈克索鲁斯在哈默洛克体育场横冲直撞。希望这是最后一次。
items.normEn: Sordward and Shielbert have forced a Haxorus to rampage in Hammerlocke Stadium. Hopefully this is the last one.

items.en: Sordward and Shielbert have forced a Torkoal to rampage in Motostoke Stadium. Defeat it as well.
items.zh: 索德沃德和希尔伯特迫使一只托考尔人在摩托斯托克体育场横冲直撞。打败它也一样。
items.normEn: Sordward and Shielbert have forced a Torkoal to rampage in Motostoke Stadium. Defeat it as well.

items.en: Sound not remembering previously set volume
items.zh: 声音不记得之前设置的音量
items.normEn: Sound not remembering previously set volume

items.en: Sounds will now play if enabled even if the notification is disabled
items.zh: 即使禁用通知，如果启用，现在也会播放声音
items.normEn: Sounds will now play if enabled even if the notification is disabled

items.en: Speak to Cogita at Ancient Retreat.
items.zh: 与古代静修处的科吉塔交谈。
items.normEn: Speak to Cogita at Ancient Retreat.

items.en: Speak to Cogita in Galaxy Hall.
items.zh: 与银河大厅的科吉塔交谈。
items.normEn: Speak to Cogita in Galaxy Hall.

items.en: Speak to Professor Hastings in Sandgem Town.
items.zh: 与桑杰姆镇的黑斯廷斯教授交谈。
items.normEn: Speak to Professor Hastings in Sandgem Town.

items.en: Speak to the Go-Rock Commander in the Eterna Forest.
items.zh: 与埃特纳森林中的摇滚指挥官交谈。
items.normEn: Speak to the Go-Rock Commander in the Eterna Forest.

items.en: Speak with Celio on One Island in Sevii.
items.zh: 与塞维岛上的西利奥交谈。
items.normEn: Speak with Celio on One Island in Sevii.

items.en: Speaking of peculiar Pokémon, I found this unusual variant of Dodrio on an island in this area. Hmm. If you want, you could buy it from me. I am needing some research funds.
items.zh: 说到奇特的神奇宝贝，我在这个地区的一座岛上发现了这种不寻常的多德里奥变种。唔。如果你想要的话，可以向我购买。我需要一些研究资金。
items.normEn: Speaking of peculiar Pokémon, I found this unusual variant of Dodrio on an island in this area. Hmm. If you want, you could buy it from me. I am needing some research funds.

items.en: Speaking of Pokémon! How's your Pokédex coming along? Wow! You have so many Pokémon that can evolve!
items.zh: 说到神奇宝贝！你的图鉴进展如何了？哇！你有很多可以进化的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: Speaking of Pokémon! How's your Pokédex coming along? Wow! You have so many Pokémon that can evolve!

items.en: Speaking of which, I stumbled upon a gnarly disk in my travels recently. It was unlike any music disk I had ever seen before, it has a rockin' dark blue coloration. But for all its uniqueness, I can't make out what it is, see?
items.zh: 说到这里，我最近在旅行中偶然发现了一个粗糙的磁盘。它与我以前见过的任何音乐光盘不同，它具有摇滚的深蓝色。但尽管它很独特，我还是看不出它是什么，明白吗？
items.normEn: Speaking of which, I stumbled upon a gnarly disk in my travels recently. It was unlike any music disk I had ever seen before, it has a rockin' dark blue coloration. But for all its uniqueness, I can't make out what it is, see?

items.en: Speaking of, our very own Kanto is home to three: the Helix Fossil, Dome Fossil, and Old Amber! You can revive them into living Pokémon using techniques developed by the Devon Corporation and a research laboratory on Cinnabar Island! There are also other scientists around the Pokémon world who can revive Fossils using these techniques.
items.zh: 说到这里，我们自己的关东拥有三种化石：螺旋化石、圆顶化石和老琥珀！您可以使用德文郡公司和朱砂岛研究实验室开发的技术将它们复活为活的神奇宝贝！神奇宝贝世界中还有其他科学家可以使用这些技术复活化石。
items.normEn: Speaking of, our very own Kanto is home to three: the Helix Fossil, Dome Fossil, and Old Amber! You can revive them into living Pokémon using techniques developed by the Devon Corporation and a research laboratory on Cinnabar Island! There are also other scientists around the Pokémon world who can revive Fossils using these techniques.

items.en: Special events can now appear in game
items.zh: 特殊事件现在可以出现在游戏中
items.normEn: Special events can now appear in game

items.en: Spectrier and Glastrier are now roaming the Crown Tundra. Catch them when the opportunity arises!
items.zh: 斯佩特里尔和格拉斯特里尔现在正在皇冠苔原上漫游。当机会出现时抓住他们！
items.normEn: Spectrier and Glastrier are now roaming the Crown Tundra. Catch them when the opportunity arises!

items.en: Splendid! You are quite the Trainer!
items.zh: 灿烂！你真是个训练家啊！
items.normEn: Splendid! You are quite the Trainer!

items.en: Spooky Pokémon are trick-or-treating for a limited time around Kanto, Johto and Hoenn.
items.zh: 幽灵神奇宝贝在关东、城都和丰缘地区限时举办“不给糖就捣蛋”活动。
items.normEn: Spooky Pokémon are trick-or-treating for a limited time around Kanto, Johto and Hoenn.

items.en: Sprinklotad Oak Item changed to boost mulch duration. Its level progress has also been reset.
items.zh: 喷洒橡树物品已更改以增加覆盖物的持续时间。其等级进度也已重置。
items.normEn: Sprinklotad Oak Item changed to boost mulch duration. Its level progress has also been reset.

items.zh: 农场中显示的发芽图像

items.zh: 阶段 ${...} 需要在战斗前沿完成。
items.normEn: Stage ${...} needs to be completed at the Battle Frontier.

items.zh: 从最近的检查点开始（阶段

items.zh: 开始菜单包含 Wiki 的链接
items.normEn: Start Menu contains a link to the Wiki

items.en: Start menu visible while loading screen shown
items.zh: 显示加载屏幕时可见开始菜单
items.normEn: Start menu visible while loading screen shown

items.en: Start reuniting the Swords of Justice once again. You should probably start looking for Terrakion around Unova's Victory Road.
items.zh: 再次开始重新团结正义之剑。你或许应该开始在合众胜利路周围寻找泰拉基昂。
items.normEn: Start reuniting the Swords of Justice once again. You should probably start looking for Terrakion around Unova's Victory Road.

items.en: Start your Island Challenge at Professor Kukui's Lab.
items.zh: 在库库伊教授的实验室开始你的岛屿挑战。
items.normEn: Start your Island Challenge at Professor Kukui's Lab.

items.en: Start your search for Silvally's memories by asking important people around Alola.
items.zh: 通过询问阿罗拉周围的重要人物来开始寻找西尔瓦利的记忆。
items.normEn: Start your search for Silvally's memories by asking important people around Alola.

items.en: Starter modal appearing multiple times when grass type picked
items.zh: 选择草类型时，启动模式会多次出现
items.normEn: Starter modal appearing multiple times when grass type picked

items.zh: 首发者未获得 Pokérus 状态

items.en: Starting '${...}' early will cost you ${...} Quest Points for 24 hours of event time.
items.zh: 提早开始“${...}”将花费您 24 小时活动时间内的 ${...} 任务积分。
items.normEn: Starting '${...}' early will cost you ${...} Quest Points for 24 hours of event time.

items.en: Starts first content in the town
items.zh: 开始城镇中的第一个内容
items.normEn: Starts first content in the town

items.en: Statistics can now be viewed from the Start Menu
items.zh: 现在可以从“开始”菜单查看统计信息
items.normEn: Statistics can now be viewed from the Start Menu

items.en: Steer clear of the Alolan version of Golem, its electrical fields are too dangerous to use.
items.zh: 避开阿罗拉版本的傀儡，它的电场太危险而无法使用。
items.normEn: Steer clear of the Alolan version of Golem, its electrical fields are too dangerous to use.

items.en: Step right up! Get your Chimecho while they last! Chimecho, a very rare Pokémon indeed, with a voice that's both beautiful and powerful. Look closer! I see it bringing a smile to your face, just gazing into those loving eyes! They say these are the most gentle, healing eyes in the Pokémon kingdom.
items.zh: 直接站起来吧！趁着 Chimecho 送完为止！ Chimecho，确实是一种非常罕见的神奇宝贝，声音既美丽又强大。仔细看看！我看到它给你带来微笑，只是凝视着那双充满爱意的眼睛！他们说这是神奇宝贝王国中最温柔、最治愈的眼睛。
items.normEn: Step right up! Get your Chimecho while they last! Chimecho, a very rare Pokémon indeed, with a voice that's both beautiful and powerful. Look closer! I see it bringing a smile to your face, just gazing into those loving eyes! They say these are the most gentle, healing eyes in the Pokémon kingdom.

items.en: Still in tip top shape I see. Good. That means you're strong enough to take out this monster I heard about on Akala Island.
items.zh: 我看仍然处于最佳状态。好的。这意味着你有足够的力量消灭我在阿卡拉岛上听说过的这个怪物。
items.normEn: Still in tip top shape I see. Good. That means you're strong enough to take out this monster I heard about on Akala Island.

items.en: Still! Those two managed to bring an end to the Darkest Day with the sword and shield Pokémon! Sonia thought the Pokémon might still be sleeping somewhere though, right?
items.zh: 仍然！两人用剑与盾的神奇宝贝成功结束了至暗之日！索尼娅认为神奇宝贝可能还在某个地方睡觉，对吗？
items.normEn: Still! Those two managed to bring an end to the Darkest Day with the sword and shield Pokémon! Sonia thought the Pokémon might still be sleeping somewhere though, right?

items.en: Stone evolutions will now only show the Pokéball if all possible evolutions have been caught
items.zh: 如果所有可能的进化都被捕获，石头进化现在只会显示精灵球
items.normEn: Stone evolutions will now only show the Pokéball if all possible evolutions have been caught

items.en: Stones now work with multiple evolutions
items.zh: 石头现在可以进行多种进化
items.normEn: Stones now work with multiple evolutions

items.en: Stop Bede from destroying the mural!
items.normEn: Stop Bede from destroying the mural!

items.en: Stop by the Battle Café, we sell all the Sweets you’ll need!
items.zh: 前往 Battle Café，我们出售您需要的所有糖果！
items.normEn: Stop by the Battle Café, we sell all the Sweets you’ll need!

items.en: Stop right there! I remember you! You're the one who foiled our fossil-finding plans!
items.zh: 就停在那里！我记得你！你就是挫败我们寻找化石计划的人！
items.normEn: Stop right there! I remember you! You're the one who foiled our fossil-finding plans!

items.en: Stop right there! This is the sacred land of Magikarp Jump. I can tell there is something suspicious about you... Yeah, I see! You have no Magikarp! How did you even make it this far without the best Pokémon, anyway?
items.zh: 就停在那里！这里是鲤鱼跳的圣地。我看得出来你有些可疑……是的，我明白了！你没有鲤鱼王！无论如何，在没有最好的神奇宝贝的情况下，你是如何做到这一点的呢？
items.normEn: Stop right there! This is the sacred land of Magikarp Jump. I can tell there is something suspicious about you... Yeah, I see! You have no Magikarp! How did you even make it this far without the best Pokémon, anyway?

items.en: Stop Team Aqua at the Weather Institute.
items.zh: 在气象研究所阻止 Aqua 队。
items.normEn: Stop Team Aqua at the Weather Institute.

items.en: Stop Team Flare Boss Lysandre in Team Flare Secret HQ once and for all!!
items.zh: 在Team Flare秘密总部一劳永逸地阻止Team Flare Boss Lysandre！
items.normEn: Stop Team Flare Boss Lysandre in Team Flare Secret HQ once and for all!!

items.en: Stop Team Magma at Mt. Chimney Crater.
items.zh: 在烟囱火山口阻止岩浆队。
items.normEn: Stop Team Magma at Mt. Chimney Crater.

items.en: Stop the Eater of Light from absorbing all light in Alola. Defeat Ultra Necrozma at the Altar of the Sunne and Moone.
items.zh: 阻止噬光者吸收阿罗拉的所有光线。在苏尼和穆恩祭坛击败究极奈克洛兹玛。
items.normEn: Stop the Eater of Light from absorbing all light in Alola. Defeat Ultra Necrozma at the Altar of the Sunne and Moone.

items.en: Stop the return of the Darkest Day!
items.normEn: Stop the return of the Darkest Day!

items.en: Stop the weapons from making a mess.
items.normEn: Stop the weapons from making a mess.

items.en: Stops Berry growth and auras. Mutations will still occur while berries are frozen.
items.zh: 阻止浆果生长和光环。当浆果被冷冻时，突变仍然会发生。
items.normEn: Stops Berry growth and auras. Mutations will still occur while berries are frozen.

items.en: Stops Berry growth and auras. Mutations will still occur while Berries are frozen.
items.zh: 阻止浆果生长和光环。当浆果被冷冻时，突变仍然会发生。
items.normEn: Stops Berry growth and auras. Mutations will still occur while Berries are frozen.

items.en: Stops the holder from evolving due to level or a stone being used. Also prevents new baby Pokémon from hatching.
items.zh: 阻止持有者因等级或使用的石头而进化。还可以防止新的神奇宝贝宝宝孵化。
items.normEn: Stops the holder from evolving due to level or a stone being used. Also prevents new baby Pokémon from hatching.

items.en: Strong Pokémon. Weak Pokémon. That is only the selfish perception of people. Truly skilled Trainers should try to win with the Pokémon they love best. I like your style. You understand what's important. Go on — — the Champion is waiting.
items.zh: 强力的宝可梦。弱小的神奇宝贝。这只是人们自私的看法。真正熟练的训练家应该尝试用他们最喜欢的神奇宝贝来获胜。我喜欢你的风格。你明白什么是重要的。继续吧——冠军正在等待。
items.normEn: Strong Pokémon. Weak Pokémon. That is only the selfish perception of people. Truly skilled Trainers should try to win with the Pokémon they love best. I like your style. You understand what's important. Go on — — the Champion is waiting.

items.en: Such as Tornadus... In every direction it flies, stirring up tremendous storms as it goes. When a blizzard batters the Alabaster Icelands, Tornadus may be about.
items.zh: 比如龙卷风……它向各个方向飞去，所过之处都掀起巨大的风暴。当暴风雪袭击雪花石膏冰岛时，龙卷风可能即将来临。
items.normEn: Such as Tornadus... In every direction it flies, stirring up tremendous storms as it goes. When a blizzard batters the Alabaster Icelands, Tornadus may be about.

items.zh: 这么强的实力！我在《惊魂记》里！
添加了 Sudowoodo 主世界战斗

items.en: Suicune is beautiful and grand. And it races through towns and roads at simply awesome speeds. It's wonderful... I want to see Suicune up close....
items.zh: 水君美丽而宏伟。它以惊人的速度穿过城镇和道路。太棒了……我想近距离看看水君……
items.normEn: Suicune is beautiful and grand. And it races through towns and roads at simply awesome speeds. It's wonderful... I want to see Suicune up close....

items.en: Suicune... How brave it is! How refreshing it is! How beautiful it is! And how quickly it moves! It seems to be heading east.
items.zh: 水君……好勇敢啊！多么令人耳目一新啊！多么美丽呀！而且它移动得多么快啊！看来是往东走。
items.normEn: Suicune... How brave it is! How refreshing it is! How beautiful it is! And how quickly it moves! It seems to be heading east.

items.en: Suicune... I won't stop following you until I've found out what you're after... You hear me!
items.zh: 水君……我不会停止跟踪你，直到我发现你在追寻什么……你听我说！
items.normEn: Suicune... I won't stop following you until I've found out what you're after... You hear me!

items.en: Sup. Ya like jazz? No? Well then you should check out me and my band at the Sonata Cafe where we never play Jazz.
items.zh: 高级。你喜欢爵士乐吗？不？那么你应该去索纳塔咖啡馆看看我和我的乐队，那里我们从不演奏爵士乐。
items.normEn: Sup. Ya like jazz? No? Well then you should check out me and my band at the Sonata Cafe where we never play Jazz.

items.en: Supplies are limited, reserve your spot on a cruise to the Southern Island!
items.zh: 供应有限，请预订前往南岛的游轮位置！
items.normEn: Supplies are limited, reserve your spot on a cruise to the Southern Island!

items.en: Sure enough, when it comes to you and Pokémon, the quality of the ingredients shines forth! Once you defeat Lana do you want to go to Wela Volcano Park with two pretty pals like us?
items.zh: 果然，当谈到你和神奇宝贝时，食材的品质就凸显出来了！一旦你打败了拉娜，你想和我们两个漂亮的朋友一起去韦拉火山公园吗？
items.normEn: Sure enough, when it comes to you and Pokémon, the quality of the ingredients shines forth! Once you defeat Lana do you want to go to Wela Volcano Park with two pretty pals like us?

items.zh: 与菲纳克市市长谈谈你一直在打击的罪犯。
items.normEn: Talk to the Mayor of Phenac City about the criminals you have been fighting.

items.en: Talk to the mysterious figure at the Sky Pillar.
items.zh: 与天柱上的神秘人物交谈。
items.normEn: Talk to the mysterious figure at the Sky Pillar.

items.en: Talk to the Old Man in Mistralton Cave for clues on where the Swords of Justice are.
items.zh: 与米斯特拉尔顿洞穴的老人交谈，寻找有关正义之剑所在位置的线索。
items.normEn: Talk to the Old Man in Mistralton Cave for clues on where the Swords of Justice are.

items.en: Talk to the Old Man in Viridian City to learn about catching.
items.zh: 与常磐城的老人交谈，学习捕捉的知识。
items.normEn: Talk to the Old Man in Viridian City to learn about catching.

items.en: Talk to the Pharmacist in Cianwood City.
items.zh: 与 Cianwood 城的药剂师交谈。
items.normEn: Talk to the Pharmacist in Cianwood City.

items.en: Talk to the wealthy Mr. Verich at Gateon Port to learn more about the S. S. Libra.
items.zh: 与 Gateon 港口的富有的 Verich 先生交谈，了解有关 S.S. Libra 的更多信息。
items.normEn: Talk to the wealthy Mr. Verich at Gateon Port to learn more about the S. S. Libra.

items.en: Talk to Wallace in Sootopolis City.
items.zh: 与苏托波利斯市的华莱士交谈。
items.normEn: Talk to Wallace in Sootopolis City.

items.en: Talk to Wallace in the Cave of Origin about the aftermath of the battle.
items.zh: 与起源洞穴中的华莱士谈论战斗的后果。
items.normEn: Talk to Wallace in the Cave of Origin about the aftermath of the battle.

items.en: Talk to Wallace in the Cave of Origin to learn how to stop Kyogre and Groudon from fighting.
items.zh: 在起源洞穴中与华莱士交谈，了解如何阻止盖欧卡和固拉多的战斗。
items.normEn: Talk to Wallace in the Cave of Origin to learn how to stop Kyogre and Groudon from fighting.

items.en: Talk to Wally and answer your ringing Holo Caster in Petalburg City.
items.zh: 与沃利交谈并接听佩塔堡市响铃的全息施法者的电话。
items.normEn: Talk to Wally and answer your ringing Holo Caster in Petalburg City.

items.en: Talk to Zero in Sendoff Spring.
items.normEn: Talk to Zero in Sendoff Spring.

items.en: Talk to Zero in the Fight Area.
items.normEn: Talk to Zero in the Fight Area.

items.en: Talk to Zinnia at the Mossdeep Space Center.
items.zh: 与莫斯迪普太空中心的百日草交谈。
items.normEn: Talk to Zinnia at the Mossdeep Space Center.

items.en: Talk to Zinnia at the Sky Pillar.
items.zh: 与天空之柱的百日草交谈。
items.normEn: Talk to Zinnia at the Sky Pillar.

items.en: Talk to Zinnia in Granite Cave.
items.zh: 与花岗岩洞穴中的百日草交谈。
items.normEn: Talk to Zinnia in Granite Cave.

items.en: Tanoby Ruins dungeon is now considered a water environment
items.zh: 塔诺比遗址地牢现在被认为是水环境
items.normEn: Tanoby Ruins dungeon is now considered a water environment

items.en: Team Aqua's leader Archie escaped from their hideout. Find him in the Seafloor Cavern and put a stop to this once and for all!
items.zh: 阿克娅队的队长阿奇从他们的藏身处逃了出来。在海底洞穴中找到他并一劳永逸地阻止这一切！
items.normEn: Team Aqua's leader Archie escaped from their hideout. Find him in the Seafloor Cavern and put a stop to this once and for all!

items.en: Team Cipher has returned to Orre. Stop their new evil plan!
items.zh: 密码小队已返回奥尔。阻止他们新的邪恶计划！
items.normEn: Team Cipher has returned to Orre. Stop their new evil plan!

items.en: Team Cipher has taken over Realgam Tower! Fight to kick them out!
items.zh: Cipher 队已经占领 Realgam Tower！奋力将他们赶出去！
items.normEn: Team Cipher has taken over Realgam Tower! Fight to kick them out!

items.en: Team Cipher's leaders have holed up in the Realgam Colosseum. Fight them to end this once and for all!
items.zh: Cipher 团队的领导者躲藏在 Realgam 竞技场中。与他们战斗，一劳永逸地结束这一切！
items.normEn: Team Cipher's leaders have holed up in the Realgam Colosseum. Fight them to end this once and for all!

items.zh: 耀斑队 Boss 莱桑德尔
耀斑队 Boss 莱桑德尔 1
耀斑队 Boss 莱桑德尔 2
团队 Flare 咕噜二人组

items.en: Team Flare will revive the ultimate weapon, eliminate everyone who isn't in our group, and return the world to a beautiful, natural state.
items.zh: 耀斑小队将复活终极武器，消灭所有不属于我们队伍的人，让世界恢复美丽、自然的状态。
items.normEn: Team Flare will revive the ultimate weapon, eliminate everyone who isn't in our group, and return the world to a beautiful, natural state.

items.en: Team Galactic is kidnapping Pokémon now. Clear Team Galactic Eterna Building in Eterna City.
items.zh: 银河队现在正在绑架神奇宝贝。清除永恒之城银河团队大楼。
items.normEn: Team Galactic is kidnapping Pokémon now. Clear Team Galactic Eterna Building in Eterna City.

items.en: Team Galactic is stealing energy. Clear Valley Windworks.
items.zh: 银河队正在窃取能量。清谷风厂。
items.normEn: Team Galactic is stealing energy. Clear Valley Windworks.

items.zh: Magma 和 Aqua 团队管理员

items.en: Team Plasma has fled the scene with the stolen DNA Splicers. Find and clear out the Plasma Frigate.
items.zh: 等离子队带着被盗的 DNA 拼接器逃离了现场。找到并清除等离子护卫舰。
items.normEn: Team Plasma has fled the scene with the stolen DNA Splicers. Find and clear out the Plasma Frigate.

items.en: Team Plasma has stolen the DNA Splicers and is assaulting the city with an army of grunts and shadows! Defend against the Team Plasma Assault!
items.zh: 等离子队偷走了 DNA 拼接器，并用一支由咕噜声和暗影组成的军队攻击这座城市！抵御等离子队的进攻！
items.normEn: Team Plasma has stolen the DNA Splicers and is assaulting the city with an army of grunts and shadows! Defend against the Team Plasma Assault!

items.en: Team Plasma's leader Ghetsis plans on using the DNA Splicers on Kyurem in Giant Chasm. Clear the dungeon to end his evil plans.
items.zh: 等离子队的领导者盖齐斯计划在巨型裂谷的酋雷姆上使用 DNA 拼接器。清理地牢以结束他的邪恶计划。
items.normEn: Team Plasma's leader Ghetsis plans on using the DNA Splicers on Kyurem in Giant Chasm. Clear the dungeon to end his evil plans.

items.en: Team Rainbow Rocket has stolen the Meltan research! Defeat them to get it back!
items.zh: 彩虹火箭队窃取了美录坦的研究成果！击败他们，夺回它！
items.normEn: Team Rainbow Rocket has stolen the Meltan research! Defeat them to get it back!

items.zh: 火箭队执行官阿丽亚娜

items.en: Team Rocket has occupied Silph Co. Clear Silph Co. in Saffron City once more to foil their plans.
items.zh: 火箭队再次占领了西尔夫公司。清除西尔夫公司位于藏红花城，以挫败他们的计划。
items.normEn: Team Rocket has occupied Silph Co. Clear Silph Co. in Saffron City once more to foil their plans.

items.en: Team Rocket has occupied Silph Co. Clear Silph Co. in Saffron City to find the Card Key.
items.zh: 火箭队已经占领了西尔夫公司。清除藏红花城的西尔夫公司来寻找卡钥匙。
items.normEn: Team Rocket has occupied Silph Co. Clear Silph Co. in Saffron City to find the Card Key.

items.en: Team Rocket is up to no good again!
items.normEn: Team Rocket is up to no good again!

items.zh: 火箭队的 Pinkan 主题公园
火箭队的 Pinkan 主题公园

items.en: Team Skull are being annoying again. Settle the score with them near Vast Poni Canyon.
items.zh: 骷髅队又惹麻烦了。在广阔的波尼峡谷附近与他们算账。
items.normEn: Team Skull are being annoying again. Settle the score with them near Vast Poni Canyon.

items.en: Team Skull are being annoying. Get rid of them. Beat their boss Guzma in the Malie Garden dungeon.
items.zh: 骷髅队很烦人。摆脱他们。在马利花园地牢中击败他们的老大古兹马。
items.normEn: Team Skull are being annoying. Get rid of them. Beat their boss Guzma in the Malie Garden dungeon.

items.en: Team Skull are trying to steal a bus stop sign on Route 10! This misdeed won't go unpunished!
items.zh: 骷髅队正试图窃取 10 号公路上的公交车站标志！这种恶行不会逍遥法外！
items.normEn: Team Skull are trying to steal a bus stop sign on Route 10! This misdeed won't go unpunished!

items.en: Team Skull Grunts A and B
items.zh: 骷髅队咕噜声 A 和 B
items.normEn: Team Skull Grunts A and B

items.en: Team Skull have stolen Nebby! Battle Gladion at Aether House.
items.zh: 骷髅队偷走了内比！以太之家的战斗格拉迪恩。
items.normEn: Team Skull have stolen Nebby! Battle Gladion at Aether House.

items.en: Team Skull have stolen the Yungoos from Aether House. Raid their base. Clear the Po Town dungeon.
items.zh: 骷髅队从以太屋偷走了云古斯。袭击他们的基地。清除波镇地牢。
items.normEn: Team Skull have stolen the Yungoos from Aether House. Raid their base. Clear the Po Town dungeon.

items.en: Team Skull is causing trouble on Route 6! Looks like they haven't learned their lesson.
items.zh: 骷髅队在 6 号公路上制造麻烦！看来他们还没有吸取教训。
items.normEn: Team Skull is causing trouble on Route 6! Looks like they haven't learned their lesson.

items.en: Teams Aqua and Magma have been trying to unlock the Primal power of Groudon and Kyogre.
items.zh: 阿克娅队和岩浆队一直在尝试释放固拉多和盖欧卡的原始力量。
items.normEn: Teams Aqua and Magma have been trying to unlock the Primal power of Groudon and Kyogre.

items.en: Tedious...bothersome...child...You should...just be quiet...and give me...the Key Stone! Bah! I need a vacation somewhere warm.
items.zh: 乏味……麻烦……孩子……你应该……安静点……然后给我……钥匙石！呸!我需要一个温暖的地方度假。
items.normEn: Tedious...bothersome...child...You should...just be quiet...and give me...the Key Stone! Bah! I need a vacation somewhere warm.

items.en: Tell Peony about your encounter with the birds resembling Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres.
items.zh: 告诉 Peony 你与 Articuno、Zapdos 和 Moltres 等鸟类的遭遇。
items.normEn: Tell Peony about your encounter with the birds resembling Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres.

items.en: Tell you what, I'll show Zinnia around town for a little bit, you should go see the Professor. He had some interesting news.
items.zh: 告诉你吧，我会带百日草在城里逛一会儿，你应该去见教授。他有一些有趣的消息。
items.normEn: Tell you what, I'll show Zinnia around town for a little bit, you should go see the Professor. He had some interesting news.

items.en: Tell you what. Anyone who was able to catch up to a Slowpoke at least once gets a pass! Our new student here really outdid themselves, so it's only fair everyone else gets another chance. Try to make a comeback, everybody!
items.zh: 告诉你什么。任何能够至少追上呆呆兽一次的人都会获得通行证！我们的新学生确实超越了自己，所以其他人再获得一次机会是公平的。大家努力复出吧！
items.normEn: Tell you what. Anyone who was able to catch up to a Slowpoke at least once gets a pass! Our new student here really outdid themselves, so it's only fair everyone else gets another chance. Try to make a comeback, everybody!

items.en: Ten years ago, a very similar incident occured. Looker and his team were assigned to fight Guzzlord. Nanu was there too. They lost. Looker lost a colleague that day.
items.zh: 十年前，曾发生过类似的事件。 Looker 和他的团队被派去对抗 Guzzlord。纳努也在场。他们输了。那天，Looker 失去了一位同事。
items.normEn: Ten years ago, a very similar incident occured. Looker and his team were assigned to fight Guzzlord. Nanu was there too. They lost. Looker lost a colleague that day.

items.en: Th-that noggin's MASSIVE! I-is that the King of Bountiful Harvests? The one calling the shots around here? Huh? I could swear I've seen it before... Or then again, maybe not...
items.zh: 那个——那个脑袋太大了！这、这就是五谷丰登之王吗？是这里发号施令的人吗？啊？我可以发誓我以前见过它……或者话又说回来，也许没有……
items.normEn: Th-that noggin's MASSIVE! I-is that the King of Bountiful Harvests? The one calling the shots around here? Huh? I could swear I've seen it before... Or then again, maybe not...

items.en: Thank you both for saving me from those goons. They were disrupting the peace and tranquility of this whole area.
items.zh: 谢谢你们把我从那些暴徒手中救了出来。他们正在破坏整个地区的和平与安宁。
items.normEn: Thank you both for saving me from those goons. They were disrupting the peace and tranquility of this whole area.

items.en: Thank you for all your help, $playername$. You really were a great ally, and I hope we can meet again. As thanks for helping us, I'll be waiting for you in Mistralton Cave if you'd wish for me to join your team.
items.zh: 感谢您的帮助，$playername$。你真是一位伟大的盟友，我希望我们能再次见面。为了感谢您对我们的帮助，如果您希望我加入您的团队，我会在米斯特拉尔顿洞穴等您。
items.normEn: Thank you for all your help, $playername$. You really were a great ally, and I hope we can meet again. As thanks for helping us, I'll be waiting for you in Mistralton Cave if you'd wish for me to join your team.

items.en: Thank you for all your help!
items.normEn: Thank you for all your help!

items.en: Thank you for bringing it, this will really help our plan to stop the meteor. Our current plan involves using the Infinity Energy within our rocket, combined with the life energy of humans found in Key Stones.
items.zh: 谢谢你带来它，这对我们阻止流星的计划确实有帮助。我们目前的计划涉及使用火箭内的无限能量，结合钥匙石中发现的人类生命能量。
items.normEn: Thank you for bringing it, this will really help our plan to stop the meteor. Our current plan involves using the Infinity Energy within our rocket, combined with the life energy of humans found in Key Stones.

items.en: Thank you for everything you've done for the Draconid people, Hoenn, and me personally.
items.zh: 感谢您为天龙人、Hoenn 和我个人所做的一切。
items.normEn: Thank you for everything you've done for the Draconid people, Hoenn, and me personally.

items.en: Thank you for finding the hidden Kecleons for me! Please accept this picture of a camouflaged Kecleon as your reward.
items.zh: 感谢您为我找到了隐藏的 Kecleons！请接受这张伪装的 Kecleon 的照片作为您的奖励。
items.normEn: Thank you for finding the hidden Kecleons for me! Please accept this picture of a camouflaged Kecleon as your reward.

items.en: Thank you for reserving your Eon Ticket!
items.zh: 感谢您预订 Eon 门票！
items.normEn: Thank you for reserving your Eon Ticket!

items.en: Thank you for the battle. I can now accept you as the Champion. It's painful to admit, but I've come to realise a few of my weaknesses. But I'll keep getting stronger. I'll reach the pinnacle of what Fairy types can do.
items.zh: 谢谢你的战斗。我现在可以接受你作为冠军了。承认这一点很痛苦，但我逐渐认识到自己的一些弱点。但我会继续变得更强。我一定会达到妖精类型的巅峰。
items.normEn: Thank you for the battle. I can now accept you as the Champion. It's painful to admit, but I've come to realise a few of my weaknesses. But I'll keep getting stronger. I'll reach the pinnacle of what Fairy types can do.

items.en: Thank you for the berries! These should be enough for my experiments.
items.zh: 谢谢你的浆果！这些对于我的实验来说应该足够了。
items.normEn: Thank you for the berries! These should be enough for my experiments.

items.en: Thank you for your help at the Slowpoke Well! You have something for me?
items.zh: 感谢您在呆呆之井的帮助！你有东西给我吗？
items.normEn: Thank you for your help at the Slowpoke Well! You have something for me?

items.en: Thank you for your help in growing these carrots. It is my belief that they will draw my loyal steeds back to me...
items.zh: 感谢您帮助种植这些胡萝卜。我相信他们会把我忠诚的战马拉回到我身边......
items.normEn: Thank you for your help in growing these carrots. It is my belief that they will draw my loyal steeds back to me...

items.en: Thank you for your help saving the Diamond Domain. I will be waiting for you in Reflection Cave.
items.zh: 感谢您帮助拯救钻石领域。我会在倒影洞等你。
items.normEn: Thank you for your help saving the Diamond Domain. I will be waiting for you in Reflection Cave.

items.en: Thank you for your help. I have little to offer you in return, but perhaps this will help.
items.zh: 感谢您的帮助。我无法给你什么回报，但这也许会有所帮助。
items.normEn: Thank you for your help. I have little to offer you in return, but perhaps this will help.

items.en: Thank you so much $playername$! Now I can finally buy that rod I've always wanted!
items.zh: 非常感谢你$playername$！现在我终于可以买到我一直想要的那根鱼竿了！
items.normEn: Thank you so much $playername$! Now I can finally buy that rod I've always wanted!

items.en: Thank you so much, $playername$... those strange people suddenly attacked me, demanding that I hand over my Key Stone! The truth is that I couldn't give it to them even if I wanted to.
items.zh: 太谢谢你了，$playername$...那些奇怪的人突然攻击我，要求我交出钥匙石！事实是，即使我愿意，我也无法给他们。
items.normEn: Thank you so much, $playername$... those strange people suddenly attacked me, demanding that I hand over my Key Stone! The truth is that I couldn't give it to them even if I wanted to.

items.en: Thank you very much for battling with me. Now I finally feel free…
items.zh: 非常感谢你和我一起战斗。现在我终于感到自由了……
items.normEn: Thank you very much for battling with me. Now I finally feel free…

items.en: Thank you very much kind stranger. Please take the Meteorite.
items.zh: 非常感谢这位好心的陌生人。请拿走陨石。
items.normEn: Thank you very much kind stranger. Please take the Meteorite.

items.en: Thank you, $playername$, for saving our town from Team Cipher once again.
items.zh: 谢谢你，$playername$，再次从 Team Cipher 手中拯救了我们的城镇。
items.normEn: Thank you, $playername$, for saving our town from Team Cipher once again.

items.en: Thank you, $playername$! Now I'll go buy some new equipment for my laboratory.
items.zh: 谢谢你，$playername$！现在我要去为我的实验室购买一些新设备。
items.normEn: Thank you, $playername$! Now I'll go buy some new equipment for my laboratory.

items.en: Thank you, $playername$! Your heroics have saved Hoenn once again!
items.zh: 谢谢你，$playername$！你们的英雄事迹再次拯救了丰缘！
items.normEn: Thank you, $playername$! Your heroics have saved Hoenn once again!

items.en: Thank you, $playername$. I'll go to the market and buy the new ingredients right now!
items.zh: 谢谢你，$playername$。我现在就去市场买新的食材！
items.normEn: Thank you, $playername$. I'll go to the market and buy the new ingredients right now!

items.en: Thank you, $playername$. Your assistance with reuniting the Swords of Justice is greatly appreciated.
items.zh: 谢谢你，$playername$。非常感谢您为重新统一正义之剑提供的帮助。
items.normEn: Thank you, $playername$. Your assistance with reuniting the Swords of Justice is greatly appreciated.

items.en: Thank you, dear. Now then... That is an impressive machine. Snap your fingers, the asteroid vanishes, and we all live happily ever after? It's a good thing you saved it from those Aqua and Magma thugs.
items.zh: 谢谢你亲爱的。那么……那是一台令人印象深刻的机器。打个响指，小行星就消失了，我们就从此过上幸福的生活了吗？幸好你从那些阿克娅和岩浆暴徒手中救了它。
items.normEn: Thank you, dear. Now then... That is an impressive machine. Snap your fingers, the asteroid vanishes, and we all live happily ever after? It's a good thing you saved it from those Aqua and Magma thugs.

items.en: Thank you. But this is awful... I was born and raised here on these islands. I had no idea that those horrible criminals were loose here…
items.zh: 谢谢。但这太可怕了……我在这些岛屿上出生和长大。我不知道那些可怕的罪犯竟然在这里逍遥法外……
items.normEn: Thank you. But this is awful... I was born and raised here on these islands. I had no idea that those horrible criminals were loose here…

items.en: Thanks for battling with me again! I've reignited my passion to battle after a nice, long break! ....Did one of the Pikachu here steal my Pikachu's hat? Oh well. I have spares. It'll be somewhere around here if you want it.
items.zh: 谢谢你再次与我战斗！经过一段美好而漫长的休息后，我重新燃起了战斗的热情！ ....这里的皮卡丘偷了我皮卡丘的帽子吗？那好吧。我有备件。如果你想要的话它就在这附近的某个地方。
items.normEn: Thanks for battling with me again! I've reignited my passion to battle after a nice, long break! ....Did one of the Pikachu here steal my Pikachu's hat? Oh well. I have spares. It'll be somewhere around here if you want it.

items.en: Thanks for getting all the supplies together, $playername$!
items.zh: 感谢您将所有物资收集在一起，$playername$！
items.normEn: Thanks for getting all the supplies together, $playername$!

items.en:
Thanks for hiring me,
I won't let you down!
items.zh: 感谢您雇用我，我不会让您失望的！
items.normEn: Thanks for hiring me, I won't let you down!

items.en: Thanks for letting me out! I thought I was done for!
items.zh: 谢谢你让我出去！我以为我完蛋了！
items.normEn: Thanks for letting me out! I thought I was done for!

items.en:
Thanks for the work.
Let me know when you're hiring again!
items.zh: 谢谢你的工作。当你再次招聘时请告诉我！
items.normEn: Thanks for the work. Let me know when you're hiring again!

items.en: Thanks for your help, kid! I'll stick along with you until our next mystery comes along.
items.zh: 谢谢你的帮助，孩子！我会一直陪着你，直到我们的下一个谜团出现。
items.normEn: Thanks for your help, kid! I'll stick along with you until our next mystery comes along.

items.en: Thanks to recent breakthroughs in the field of alloying and electroplating, we have discovered a way to coat some Pokémon in metal!
items.zh: 由于最近在合金和电镀领域取得的突破，我们发现了一种给一些神奇宝贝涂上金属的方法！
items.normEn: Thanks to recent breakthroughs in the field of alloying and electroplating, we have discovered a way to coat some Pokémon in metal!

items.en: Thanks, $playername$. I'll be going to the market to buy the project supplies this instant.
items.zh: 谢谢，$playername$。我马上就去市场购买工程物资。
items.normEn: Thanks, $playername$. I'll be going to the market to buy the project supplies this instant.

items.en: Thanks, mate. I'm really glad you were the one here with me.
items.zh: 谢谢，伙计。我真的很高兴你是和我在一起的人。
items.normEn: Thanks, mate. I'm really glad you were the one here with me.

items.en: That aside! The reason I have been traveling all over Unova and battling many Pokémon Trainers is because I was testing the viability of this approach to bringing out the full strength of Pokémon. In that respect, you've done an amazing job.
items.zh: 抛开这一点！我之所以在合众国各地旅行并与许多神奇宝贝训练师战斗，是因为我正在测试这种方法的可行性，以发挥神奇宝贝的全部力量。在这方面，你做得非常出色。
items.normEn: That aside! The reason I have been traveling all over Unova and battling many Pokémon Trainers is because I was testing the viability of this approach to bringing out the full strength of Pokémon. In that respect, you've done an amazing job.

items.en: That battle has made me feel really glad you were my first challenger as a Gym Leader… I give you this in honor of the strength you and your Pokémon showed!
items.zh: 那场战斗让我感到非常高兴你是我作为道馆馆长的第一个挑战者......我给你这个是为了纪念你和你的神奇宝贝所表现出的力量！
items.normEn: That battle has made me feel really glad you were my first challenger as a Gym Leader… I give you this in honor of the strength you and your Pokémon showed!

items.en: That battle scared the karp out of me!
items.normEn: That battle scared the karp out of me!

items.en: That Celebi is an old friend of mine. Back in the day it liked to hang out at the old shrine in Ilex Forest. You should go check it out and try to catch Celebi.
items.zh: 那个雪拉比是我的老朋友。以前它喜欢在冬青林的古老神社里闲逛。你应该去看看并尝试抓住雪拉比。
items.normEn: That Celebi is an old friend of mine. Back in the day it liked to hang out at the old shrine in Ilex Forest. You should go check it out and try to catch Celebi.

items.en: That day I learned that I should frequently download a save.
items.zh: 那天我知道我应该经常下载存档。
items.normEn: That day I learned that I should frequently download a save.

items.en: That didn't work either. Talk to Baraz in Kiloude City.
items.zh: 那也没用。与基卢德市的巴拉兹交谈。
items.normEn: That didn't work either. Talk to Baraz in Kiloude City.

items.en: That didn't work. Talk to Baraz in Kiloude City.
items.zh: 那行不通。与基卢德市的巴拉兹交谈。
items.normEn: That didn't work. Talk to Baraz in Kiloude City.

items.en: That Dragon twerp stole my Key Stone, there's no way I can win without it. Looks like you're after her too, huh?
items.zh: 那个龙族偷了我的钥匙石，没有它我就不可能获胜。看来你也在追她，是吗？
items.normEn: That Dragon twerp stole my Key Stone, there's no way I can win without it. Looks like you're after her too, huh?

items.en: That Explorer Kit is a must-have for any Fossil Fanatic! Why, it's how I found my very first Old Amber.
items.zh: 该探索者套件是任何化石狂热者的必备品！哎呀，我就是这样找到我的第一块老琥珀的。
items.normEn: That Explorer Kit is a must-have for any Fossil Fanatic! Why, it's how I found my very first Old Amber.

items.en: That glittering Meteorite that you've got there... Hmm... It's sure giving off some vibes. I'd keep a tight hold on it if I were you, along with that shard I just gave you.
items.zh: 你那里的那颗闪闪发光的陨石……嗯……它肯定会散发出一些共鸣。如果我是你，我会紧紧抓住它，还有我刚刚给你的碎片。
items.normEn: That glittering Meteorite that you've got there... Hmm... It's sure giving off some vibes. I'd keep a tight hold on it if I were you, along with that shard I just gave you.

items.en: That is truly wonderful. With that power, you can steer your future in a better direction!
items.zh: 这真是太棒了。有了这份力量，你就能引导你的未来走向更好的方向！
items.normEn: That is truly wonderful. With that power, you can steer your future in a better direction!

items.en: That is where you come in. The Champion of Alola. We do not have the battle power, but hopefully you do. Please allow Anabel to test your battle ability to ensure that you can handle this job.
items.zh: 这就是你进来的地方。阿罗拉的冠军。我们没有战斗力，但希望你有。请让安娜贝尔测试一下你的战斗能力，以确保你能够胜任这份工作。
items.normEn: That is where you come in. The Champion of Alola. We do not have the battle power, but hopefully you do. Please allow Anabel to test your battle ability to ensure that you can handle this job.

items.en: That Kukui... He certainly found an interesting Trainer for me to face!
items.zh: 那个库库伊……果然是给我找了一个有趣的训练家来面对啊！
items.normEn: That Kukui... He certainly found an interesting Trainer for me to face!

items.en: That looked like a Togepi!... well, maybe not. Anyway, there is a big Egg Hunt going on in the woods south of Rustboro in Hoenn; maybe you should take a look?
items.zh: 那看起来像 Togepi！...好吧，也许不是。无论如何，在丰缘市拉斯特伯勒以南的树林里，正在举行一场大型的寻蛋活动；也许你应该看一下？
items.normEn: That looked like a Togepi!... well, maybe not. Anyway, there is a big Egg Hunt going on in the woods south of Rustboro in Hoenn; maybe you should take a look?

items.en: That loosened me up. I'm ready for the Pokémon League! You need more practice! But hey, you know that! I'm out of here. Smell ya!
items.zh: 这让我松了口气。我已经准备好参加神奇宝贝联盟了！你需要更多的练习！但是嘿，你知道的！我要离开这里了闻闻呀！
items.normEn: That loosened me up. I'm ready for the Pokémon League! You need more practice! But hey, you know that! I'm out of here. Smell ya!

items.en: That Lusamine! We will need you to leave us in peace so that we may do our job. Please don't get in our way. Leave Cosmog to us.
items.zh: 那个露莎米奈！我们需要您让我们安静下来，以便我们能够完成我们的工作。请不要妨碍我们。把 Cosmog 交给我们吧。
items.normEn: That Lusamine! We will need you to leave us in peace so that we may do our job. Please don't get in our way. Leave Cosmog to us.

items.en: That must have been the Pokémon known as Sudowoodo. Our research is insufficient to define what it means to be a Pokémon Trainer... We'll never be able to stop the Blinding One like this...
items.zh: 那一定是被称为“须藤木多”的神奇宝贝。我们的研究不足以定义成为一名神奇宝贝训练师意味着什么......我们永远无法像这样阻止致盲者......
items.normEn: That must have been the Pokémon known as Sudowoodo. Our research is insufficient to define what it means to be a Pokémon Trainer... We'll never be able to stop the Blinding One like this...

items.en: That one you have come to collect... You must know that it is able to warp away when threatened, but the holes that are created when it does so leave a path open to dangerous beings. Be careful of who you trust it to.
items.zh: 你来收集的那个……你必须知道，当受到威胁时，它能够扭曲离开，但是当它这样做时所产生的洞为危险生物留下了一条道路。小心你信任的人。
items.normEn: That one you have come to collect... You must know that it is able to warp away when threatened, but the holes that are created when it does so leave a path open to dangerous beings. Be careful of who you trust it to.

items.en: That Pokémon must have destroyed the generator... quick grab everything you can find and help us repair it.
items.zh: 那只神奇宝贝肯定毁坏了发电机……快点拿走你能找到的所有东西并帮助我们修复它。
items.normEn: That Pokémon must have destroyed the generator... quick grab everything you can find and help us repair it.

items.en: That Pokémon was really something else! Here, I'll give you this Electrium Z to reward you for beating it.
items.zh: 那个神奇宝贝真是不一样啊！在这里，我会给你这个 Electrium Z 作为你击败它的奖励。
items.normEn: That Pokémon was really something else! Here, I'll give you this Electrium Z to reward you for beating it.

items.en: That settles it! We're taking the sword and shield. Though...wow, would you look at the state of these things? They seem like they might fall to pieces if you so much as look at 'em funny.
items.zh: 这样就解决了！我们拿着剑和盾。不过……哇，你能看看这些东西的状态吗？如果你用滑稽的眼光看待它们，它们似乎就会碎成碎片。
items.normEn: That settles it! We're taking the sword and shield. Though...wow, would you look at the state of these things? They seem like they might fall to pieces if you so much as look at 'em funny.

items.en: That strength of yours doesn't bend easily!
items.zh: 你的力量可不是轻易就能屈服的！
items.normEn: That strength of yours doesn't bend easily!

items.en: That video stream... That was from Hammerlocke Stadium, right? What in the world did the chairman do...?
items.zh: 那个视频流……是来自哈默洛克体育场，对吧？主席到底做了什么……？
items.normEn: That video stream... That was from Hammerlocke Stadium, right? What in the world did the chairman do...?

items.en: That was a delight! Nice battling, love!
items.zh: 那真是令人高兴！战斗精彩，爱！
items.normEn: That was a delight! Nice battling, love!

items.zh: 那真是一场有趣的战斗！

items.en: That was a nice rematch. You sure are a strong Pokémon trainer! I'll beat you next time!
items.zh: 那是一场精彩的复赛。你真是一位强大的神奇宝贝训练家！下次我一定会打败你的！
items.normEn: That was a nice rematch. You sure are a strong Pokémon trainer! I'll beat you next time!

items.en: That was everything I hoped for and more!
items.zh: 这就是我所希望的一切，甚至更多！
items.normEn: That was everything I hoped for and more!

items.en: That was excellent. Truly, an outstanding battle. You gave the support your Pokémon needed to maximize their power. And you guided them with certainty to secure victory. You have both passion and calculating coolness. Together, you and your Pokémon can overcome any challenge that may come your way. Those are the impressions I got from our battle. I'm glad I got to take part in the crowning of Sinnoh's new Champion!
items.zh: 那太好了。确实，这是一场出色的战斗。您为您的神奇宝贝提供了最大限度发挥其力量所需的支持。您坚定地引导他们取得胜利。你既有激情，又有精于算计的冷静。您和您的神奇宝贝可以一起克服可能遇到的任何挑战。这些是我从我们的战斗中得到的印象。我很高兴能够参加神奥新冠军的加冕！
items.normEn: That was excellent. Truly, an outstanding battle. You gave the support your Pokémon needed to maximize their power. And you guided them with certainty to secure victory. You have both passion and calculating coolness. Together, you and your Pokémon can overcome any challenge that may come your way. Those are the impressions I got from our battle. I'm glad I got to take part in the crowning of Sinnoh's new Champion!

items.en: That was so close! I thought I could corner it by ambushing it here... But running on the water... is beyond me. Still, I am starting to see a pattern. Suicune prefers water! That means...
items.zh: 太接近了！我以为我可以在这里伏击它，把它逼入绝境……但是在水面上奔跑……是我无法做到的。尽管如此，我开始看到一种模式。水君更喜欢水！这意味着...
items.normEn: That was so close! I thought I could corner it by ambushing it here... But running on the water... is beyond me. Still, I am starting to see a pattern. Suicune prefers water! That means...

items.en: That would be big news, sure to be reported on local bulletin boards!
items.zh: 这将是一个大新闻，肯定会在当地的公告板上报道！
items.normEn: That would be big news, sure to be reported on local bulletin boards!

items.en: That's a pretty great picture. You and your Pokémon! You're a great Pokémon Trainer! So here you go! A piece of Fairium Z for you!
items.zh: 这是一幅非常棒的图画。你和你的神奇宝贝！你是一位出色的神奇宝贝训练师！那么就到这里吧！送给您一件 Fairium Z！
items.normEn: That's a pretty great picture. You and your Pokémon! You're a great Pokémon Trainer! So here you go! A piece of Fairium Z for you!

items.en: That's another regional Pokédex completed! Fantastic.
items.zh: 这又完成了一份区域图鉴！极好的。
items.normEn: That's another regional Pokédex completed! Fantastic.

items.en: That's it! I hate to admit it, but you are a Pokémon master!
items.zh: 就是这样！我不愿意承认，但你是神奇宝贝大师！
items.normEn: That's it! I hate to admit it, but you are a Pokémon master!

items.en: That's it! I'm sure it's got to be the Slumbering Weald! Those illusions you tried to fight off that day—they must've been the Pokémon that are supposed to be sleeping there!
items.zh: 就是这样！我确信那一定是沉睡的森林！那天你试图击退的那些幻象——它们一定是应该睡在那里的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: That's it! I'm sure it's got to be the Slumbering Weald! Those illusions you tried to fight off that day—they must've been the Pokémon that are supposed to be sleeping there!

items.en: That's not all! Just look at the way Chimecho's tail swings and sways with the wind, like a weeping willow in a summer breeze. In really hot weather, it will act like a fan to help you cool off. And when it's cold outside, your Chimecho can wrap itself around your neck like a scarf, to keep you warm.
items.zh: 这还不是全部！看看Chimecho的尾巴随风摇摆的样子，就像夏日微风中的垂柳。在炎热的天气里，它会像风扇一样帮助您降温。当外面寒冷时，您的 Chimecho 可以像围巾一样包裹在您的脖子上，为您保暖。
items.normEn: That's not all! Just look at the way Chimecho's tail swings and sways with the wind, like a weeping willow in a summer breeze. In really hot weather, it will act like a fan to help you cool off. And when it's cold outside, your Chimecho can wrap itself around your neck like a scarf, to keep you warm.

items.en: That's right. Haunter is one of those Pokemon.
items.zh: 这是正确的。 Haunter 是这些神奇宝贝之一。
items.normEn: That's right. Haunter is one of those Pokemon.

items.en: That's some Shady Pokémon! Do You Want to Sell Them?
items.zh: 那是一些阴暗的神奇宝贝！你想卖掉它们吗？
items.normEn: That's some Shady Pokémon! Do You Want to Sell Them?

items.en: That's what I would expect from a Trainer doing the island challenge. I felt the bond between you and your Pokémon!
items.zh: 这就是我对进行岛屿挑战的训练师的期望。我感受到了你和你的神奇宝贝之间的羁绊！
items.normEn: That's what I would expect from a Trainer doing the island challenge. I felt the bond between you and your Pokémon!

items.en: That's why I decided the only way to save the world was to take it all for myself. I don't expect that I will ever make you understand how I think and feel...
items.zh: 这就是为什么我决定拯救世界的唯一方法就是将一切据为己有。我不指望我能让你理解我的想法和感受......
items.normEn: That's why I decided the only way to save the world was to take it all for myself. I don't expect that I will ever make you understand how I think and feel...

items.en: The "Caught Not Shadow" Pokédex filter will now only show Pokémon with a shadow form
items.zh: “抓不到影子” Pokédex 过滤器现在只会显示影子形态的 Pokémon
items.normEn: The "Caught Not Shadow" Pokédex filter will now only show Pokémon with a shadow form

items.en: The "Enabled" toggle allows you to turn a filter off. Disabled filters will be grayed out in the filter list on the main game screen, and also in the Test Filters tab. The "Inverted" toggle, when turned on, will make that filter
items.zh: “启用”开关允许您关闭过滤器。禁用的过滤器将在主游戏屏幕的过滤器列表以及“测试过滤器”选项卡中显示为灰色。打开“反转”开关后，该过滤器将
items.normEn: The "Enabled" toggle allows you to turn a filter off. Disabled filters will be grayed out in the filter list on the main game screen, and also in the Test Filters tab. The "Inverted" toggle, when turned on, will make that filter

items.en: The ${...}'s effect is about to wear off!
items.normEn: The ${...}'s effect is about to wear off!

items.en: The achievements related to leveling up these items will disappear, and the percentages will be distributed among the other general achievements.
items.zh: 与升级这些项目相关的成就将消失，百分比将分配到其他一般成就中。
items.normEn: The achievements related to leveling up these items will disappear, and the percentages will be distributed among the other general achievements.

items.en: The Aipoms dropped some sort of vial while they were running away. It looks like they were headed towards the Radio Tower. Find it!
items.zh: 艾波姆夫妇在逃跑时掉落了某种小瓶。看起来他们正在前往无线电塔。找到它！
items.normEn: The Aipoms dropped some sort of vial while they were running away. It looks like they were headed towards the Radio Tower. Find it!

items.en: The Alola region is now available
items.normEn: The Alola region is now available

items.en: The amount of treasure a player can find is random, between the minimum (inclusive) and maximum (inclusive), and increases as their Underground Level increases:
items.zh: 玩家可以找到的宝藏数量是随机的，介于最小（含）和最大（含）之间，并且随着地下等级的增加而增加：
items.normEn: The amount of treasure a player can find is random, between the minimum (inclusive) and maximum (inclusive), and increases as their Underground Level increases:

items.en: The attracted Bug Pokémon decrease the amount of harvestable Berries in nearby plants.
items.zh: 被吸引的虫子宝可梦会减少附近植物中可收获的浆果数量。
items.normEn: The attracted Bug Pokémon decrease the amount of harvestable Berries in nearby plants.

items.en: The Battery is a system that charges up as you or your expert mines tiles.
items.zh: 电池是一个在您或您的专家开采瓷砖时充电的系统。
items.normEn: The Battery is a system that charges up as you or your expert mines tiles.

items.en: The battlefield out the back of the Dojo is being used at the moment, so let's battle out in front of the Dojo.
items.zh: 现在道场后面的战场正在使用，所以我们就到道场前面去战斗吧。
items.normEn: The battlefield out the back of the Dojo is being used at the moment, so let's battle out in front of the Dojo.

items.en: The best fishing rod for catching wild water Pokémon.
items.zh: 捕捉野生水神奇宝贝的最佳钓鱼竿。
items.normEn: The best fishing rod for catching wild water Pokémon.

items.en: The Birds of the Dyna Tree
items.normEn: The Birds of the Dyna Tree

items.en: The boss is gonna be so mad!
items.normEn: The boss is gonna be so mad!

items.en: The boss of Team Galactic has been spotted in Celestic Town!
items.zh: 银河队的老大被发现在天界镇！
items.normEn: The boss of Team Galactic has been spotted in Celestic Town!

items.en: The boss said to take a look around here and call him if I found anything cool!
items.zh: 老板说去看看这里，如果发现什么好东西就给他打电话！
items.normEn: The boss said to take a look around here and call him if I found anything cool!

items.en: The boss's dream of creating a beautiful world will come true! Add it all up, and it equals... a victory for our SCIENCE!
items.zh: 老板创造美好世界的梦想将会实现！所有这些加起来，就等于……我们科学的胜利！
items.normEn: The boss's dream of creating a beautiful world will come true! Add it all up, and it equals... a victory for our SCIENCE!

items.en: The Cake Is a Lie, but the Grind Is Real
items.zh: 蛋糕是谎言，但研磨是真实的
items.normEn: The Cake Is a Lie, but the Grind Is Real

items.en: The cake is not a lie
items.normEn: The cake is not a lie

items.en: The carving with nine dots on the top row says "STRAIGHT".
items.zh: 最上面一行有九个点的雕刻写着“STRAIGHT”。
items.normEn: The carving with nine dots on the top row says "STRAIGHT".

items.en: The carving with six dots on the top row says "RIGHT".
items.zh: 最上面一排有六个点的雕刻写着“RIGHT”。
items.normEn: The carving with six dots on the top row says "RIGHT".

items.en: The Cell Battery Oak Item will now gain points each time you find an item
items.zh: 现在，每次找到物品时，电池橡木物品都会获得积分
items.normEn: The Cell Battery Oak Item will now gain points each time you find an item

items.en: The Championship Match is about to start, but Chairman Rose is broadcasting something to the Stadium? Listen to the broadcast.
items.zh: 冠军赛即将开始，罗斯主席却在向球场广播什么？收听广播。
items.normEn: The Championship Match is about to start, but Chairman Rose is broadcasting something to the Stadium? Listen to the broadcast.

items.en: The chance to encounter a roaming Pokémon is
items.zh: 遇到漫游神奇宝贝的机会是
items.normEn: The chance to encounter a roaming Pokémon is

items.en: The charts on the gemstone analysis were off the charts while you were fighting. We are this close to solving the mystery.
items.zh: 当你战斗时，宝石分析图表已经超出了图表。我们距离解开这个谜团已经很近了。
items.normEn: The charts on the gemstone analysis were off the charts while you were fighting. We are this close to solving the mystery.

items.en: The chosen Lorekeeper, standing before a stone that shone with rainbow light, offered up a wish to the great one. And Lord Rayquaza's body was suffused with a brilliant light and transformed.
items.zh: 被选中的博学者站在一块闪烁着彩虹光芒的石头前，向伟大的人许下一个愿望。而烈空坐大人的身体，也泛着绚丽的光芒，发生了变化。
items.normEn: The chosen Lorekeeper, standing before a stone that shone with rainbow light, offered up a wish to the great one. And Lord Rayquaza's body was suffused with a brilliant light and transformed.

items.en: The cluster of drupelets that make up this Berry pop rhythmically if the Berry is handled roughly.
items.zh: 如果浆果处理不当，则组成浆果的小核果簇会有节奏地爆裂。
items.normEn: The cluster of drupelets that make up this Berry pop rhythmically if the Berry is handled roughly.

items.en: The cost displayed is how much you will be charged per hatch.
items.zh: 显示的成本是每次孵化需要支付的费用。
items.normEn: The cost displayed is how much you will be charged per hatch.

items.en: The costume often gets busted on battles. It will then spend all night patching it. Poor guy...
items.zh: 这套服装经常在战斗中被破坏。然后它会花整晚的时间来修补它。可怜的家伙...
items.normEn: The costume often gets busted on battles. It will then spend all night patching it. Poor guy...

items.en: The damage you do against an enemy Pokémon is the sum of the attack of all Pokémon the player has, after type effectiveness, type weakness, and other multipliers are applied.
items.zh: 你对敌方神奇宝贝造成的伤害是玩家拥有的所有神奇宝贝的攻击力的总和，在应用类型有效性、类型弱点和其他乘数后。
items.normEn: The damage you do against an enemy Pokémon is the sum of the attack of all Pokémon the player has, after type effectiveness, type weakness, and other multipliers are applied.

items.en: The disciple has surpassed the master. I have nothing more to teach you.
items.zh: 弟子已经超越了师父。我没有什么可以教你的了。
items.normEn: The disciple has surpassed the master. I have nothing more to teach you.

items.en: The discovery time is calculated as follows:
items.normEn: The discovery time is calculated as follows:

items.en: The Distortion World? Hold on, I think I've heard that name before, there was a guy around here named Zero looking for a way to enter that place.
items.zh: 扭曲的世界？等一下，我想我以前听说过这个名字，这里有一个名叫零的家伙正在寻找进入那个地方的方法。
items.normEn: The Distortion World? Hold on, I think I've heard that name before, there was a guy around here named Zero looking for a way to enter that place.

items.en: The egg hatched after your battle with the egg-nappers! Bring Manaphy back to Hastings in Canalave City, and close off this mission for good.
items.zh: 与蛋打蛋者战斗后，蛋孵化了！将玛纳菲带回卡纳拉夫城的黑斯廷斯，并永远结束这次任务。
items.normEn: The egg hatched after your battle with the egg-nappers! Bring Manaphy back to Hastings in Canalave City, and close off this mission for good.

items.en: The egg was stolen again - this time by a Happiny who belongs to a little girl here. It went eastward at top speed - it's probably left this city far behind it now.
items.zh: 鸡蛋又被偷了——这次是属于这里一个小女孩的幸福。它以最快的速度向东行驶——现在可能已经把这座城市远远地抛在了后面。
items.normEn: The egg was stolen again - this time by a Happiny who belongs to a little girl here. It went eastward at top speed - it's probably left this city far behind it now.

items.en: The eggs ran away! Talk to the egg hunter in Petalburg Woods.
items.zh: 鸡蛋跑了！与佩塔堡森林的彩蛋猎人交谈。
items.normEn: The eggs ran away! Talk to the egg hunter in Petalburg Woods.

items.en: The energy core of the Diamond domain
items.normEn: The energy core of the Diamond domain

items.en: The EV damage multiplier is multiplicative, and scales linearly until 1.5x (50 EVs). The bonus thereafter has diminishing returns relative to the number of EVs gained, but has no limit.
items.zh: EV 伤害乘数是倍增的，并且线性缩放直至 1.5 倍（50 EV）。此后的奖金相对于获得的电动汽车数量而言收益递减，但没有限制。
items.normEn: The EV damage multiplier is multiplicative, and scales linearly until 1.5x (50 EVs). The bonus thereafter has diminishing returns relative to the number of EVs gained, but has no limit.

items.en: The Farm shortcut will be hidden when the Farm module is enabled.
items.zh: 当农场模块启用时，农场快捷方式将被隐藏。
items.normEn: The Farm shortcut will be hidden when the Farm module is enabled.

items.en: The first carving says DESERT. There is a desert near Route 111, right?
items.zh: 第一个雕刻上写着“沙漠”。 111号公路附近有一片沙漠吧？
items.normEn: The first carving says DESERT. There is a desert near Route 111, right?

items.en: The first step in unlocking this potential will be to formulate the perfect diet. Can you gather some berries for me to experiment with?
items.zh: 释放这种潜力的第一步是制定完美的饮食。你能采集一些浆果给我做实验吗？
items.normEn: The first step in unlocking this potential will be to formulate the perfect diet. Can you gather some berries for me to experiment with?

items.en: The first step of the Tutorial must first be completed.
items.zh: 必须首先完成教程的第一步。
items.normEn: The first step of the Tutorial must first be completed.

items.en: The flesh underneath the Custap Berry's tough skin is sweet and creamy soft.
items.zh: Custap Berry 坚韧的外皮下的果肉甜美而柔滑。
items.normEn: The flesh underneath the Custap Berry's tough skin is sweet and creamy soft.

items.en: The flower grows at the tip of this Berry. It attracts Bug Pokémon by letting its stringy petals stream out.
items.zh: 这朵花长在浆果的顶端。它通过流出细丝状的花瓣来吸引虫子宝可梦。
items.normEn: The flower grows at the tip of this Berry. It attracts Bug Pokémon by letting its stringy petals stream out.

items.en: The Flute Trader in Fallarbor Town has been paying me to go collect soot to make Flutes, but I'm sick of it.
items.zh: 法拉伯镇的长笛商人一直付钱让我去收集烟灰来制作长笛，但我已经厌倦了。
items.normEn: The Flute Trader in Fallarbor Town has been paying me to go collect soot to make Flutes, but I'm sick of it.

items.en: The Frigate is gone. Nothing to do but move forward. Clear route 13.
items.zh: 护卫舰不见了。没有什么可做的，只能继续前进。畅通13号路线。
items.normEn: The Frigate is gone. Nothing to do but move forward. Clear route 13.

items.en: The Galar region is now available
items.normEn: The Galar region is now available

items.en: The game must ${...}be in the ${...} state
items.normEn: The game must ${...}be in the ${...} state

items.en: The generator isn't working. Look around for scraps to repair it.
items.zh: 发电机不工作。四处寻找碎片来修复它。
items.normEn: The generator isn't working. Look around for scraps to repair it.

items.en: The GitHub repo is located here:
items.normEn: The GitHub repo is located here:

items.en: The Go-Rock Squad are definitely going in circles, but they're too dumb to realise it. Interrogate one on their method of navigating the Eterna Forest!
items.zh: 摇滚小队肯定是在兜圈子，但他们太笨了，没有意识到这一点。询问他们在永恒森林中航行的方法！
items.normEn: The Go-Rock Squad are definitely going in circles, but they're too dumb to realise it. Interrogate one on their method of navigating the Eterna Forest!

items.en: The Go-Rock Squad was already beaten once. That was probably their very last gasp of trouble-making.
items.zh: 摇滚小队已经被打败过一次了。这可能是他们制造麻烦的最后一口气。
items.normEn: The Go-Rock Squad was already beaten once. That was probably their very last gasp of trouble-making.

items.en: The Go-Rock Squad were troublemakers the Pokémon Rangers dealt with in my home region. I don't know why they took it, but the Go-Rock Squad is trying to regroup!
items.zh: Go-Rock 小队是神奇宝贝游骑兵队在我家乡对付的麻烦制造者。我不知道他们为什么要拿走它，但摇滚小队正在尝试重新集结！
items.normEn: The Go-Rock Squad were troublemakers the Pokémon Rangers dealt with in my home region. I don't know why they took it, but the Go-Rock Squad is trying to regroup!

items.en: The Go-Rock Squad's future looks bleak...
items.zh: Go-Rock Squad 的未来看起来很黯淡……
items.normEn: The Go-Rock Squad's future looks bleak...

items.en: The golden light was dispelled from Arcanine, calming it.
items.zh: 奥卡尼恩身上的金光被驱散，平静下来。
items.normEn: The golden light was dispelled from Arcanine, calming it.

items.en: The golden light was dispelled from Avalugg, calming it.
items.zh: 阿瓦鲁格身上的金光被驱散，平静下来。
items.normEn: The golden light was dispelled from Avalugg, calming it.

items.en: The golden light was dispelled from Electrode, calming it.
items.zh: 金光从电极上消散，让它平静下来。
items.normEn: The golden light was dispelled from Electrode, calming it.

items.en: The golden light was dispelled from Kleavor, calming it.
items.zh: 金光从克利沃身上消散，平静下来。
items.normEn: The golden light was dispelled from Kleavor, calming it.

items.en: The golden light was dispelled from Lilligant, calming it.
items.zh: 金色光芒从莉莉甘特身上消散，让莉莉甘特平静下来。
items.normEn: The golden light was dispelled from Lilligant, calming it.

items.en: The grateful radio director gave you a Master Ball!
items.zh: 感激的电台导演给了你一个大师球！
items.normEn: The grateful radio director gave you a Master Ball!

items.en: The Greatest Collection of All Time
items.zh: 有史以来最伟大的收藏
items.normEn: The Greatest Collection of All Time

items.en: The grown-up flavor and dreamy sweetness of this Berry make it a favorite of Pokémon everywhere.
items.zh: 这种浆果的成熟风味和梦幻般的甜味使其成为各地神奇宝贝的最爱。
items.normEn: The grown-up flavor and dreamy sweetness of this Berry make it a favorite of Pokémon everywhere.

items.en: The Gym Leader is tough, but you... Are you even human?! I tried to use the same combination as you, and yet...
items.zh: 道馆馆主很强悍，但你……你还是人吗？！我尝试使用与你相同的组合，但......
items.normEn: The Gym Leader is tough, but you... Are you even human?! I tried to use the same combination as you, and yet...

items.en: The Happiny fled from Oreburgh and headed west, through the Oreburgh Gate. Search for another witness on the far side.
items.zh: 幸福号从奥勒堡逃出，通过奥勒堡门向西行驶。在另一边寻找另一位目击者。
items.normEn: The Happiny fled from Oreburgh and headed west, through the Oreburgh Gate. Search for another witness on the far side.

items.en: The Happiny headed north out of Jubilife! Ask for witnesses in the next town.
items.zh: 幸福号从禧年号出发向北行驶！询问下一个城镇的目击者。
items.normEn: The Happiny headed north out of Jubilife! Ask for witnesses in the next town.

items.en: The Happiny went north, through the Eterna Forest. Ask if anyone's seen it in Eterna City.
items.zh: 幸福号向北行驶，穿过永恒森林。问问有人在永恒城见过吗？
items.normEn: The Happiny went north, through the Eterna Forest. Ask if anyone's seen it in Eterna City.

items.en: The Happiny went through Mt. Coronet again? This time it went west through the Southern path. Ask around for witnesses on the other side.
items.zh: 幸福号又穿越皇冠山了？这次是沿南道向西行。四处询问另一边的目击者。
items.normEn: The Happiny went through Mt. Coronet again? This time it went west through the Southern path. Ask around for witnesses on the other side.

items.en: The hull needs some new Metal Coating, the ballast tanks need filled with Mystic Water, and some Heat Rocks are needed for a dive that deep.
items.zh: 船体需要一些新的金属涂层，压载舱需要充满神秘水，并且需要一些热石才能潜水到那么深。
items.normEn: The hull needs some new Metal Coating, the ballast tanks need filled with Mystic Water, and some Heat Rocks are needed for a dive that deep.

items.en: The informant is finally willing to "talk", find out what he has to say.
items.zh: 线人终于愿意“说话”了，听听他要说什么。
items.normEn: The informant is finally willing to "talk", find out what he has to say.

items.en: The informant is proving hard to convince. Time to get physical!
items.zh: 事实证明，该线人很难令人信服。是时候锻炼身体了！
items.normEn: The informant is proving hard to convince. Time to get physical!

items.en: The Kanto Berry Master in Cerulean City will provide daily hints about how to mutate the various berries.
items.zh: 华蓝市的关东浆果大师每天都会提供有关如何使各种浆果发生变异的提示。
items.normEn: The Kanto Berry Master in Cerulean City will provide daily hints about how to mutate the various berries.

items.en: The Kids Yearn for the Mines
items.normEn: The Kids Yearn for the Mines

items.en: The Kimono Girls of Ecruteak City need help.
items.zh: 埃克鲁泰克市的和服女孩需要帮助。
items.normEn: The Kimono Girls of Ecruteak City need help.

items.en: The Kimono Girls of Ecruteak City wish to speak with you again.
items.zh: 埃克鲁泰克市的和服女孩希望再次与您交谈。
items.normEn: The Kimono Girls of Ecruteak City wish to speak with you again.

items.en: The lake guardians have been rescued, but Cyrus has used them to forge the Red Chain. He is taking it to the top of Mount Coronet. Follow him! Clear Spear Pillar.
items.zh: 湖泊守护者已获救，但赛勒斯利用他们铸造了红链。他正带着它登上皇冠山的山顶。跟着他！透明矛柱。
items.normEn: The lake guardians have been rescued, but Cyrus has used them to forge the Red Chain. He is taking it to the top of Mount Coronet. Follow him! Clear Spear Pillar.

items.en: The last piece of equipment needed is a Tackle Machine. I have a prototype here, but it needs to be calibrated.
items.zh: 最后需要的设备是钓具机。我这里有一个原型，但需要校准。
items.normEn: The last piece of equipment needed is a Tackle Machine. I have a prototype here, but it needs to be calibrated.

items.en: The legendary dragons of Dragonspiral Tower are said to embody these very concepts. They sometimes leave a piece of their DNA behind after a battle.
items.zh: 据说龙螺旋塔的传说中的龙就体现了这些概念。他们有时会在战斗后留下一段 DNA。
items.normEn: The legendary dragons of Dragonspiral Tower are said to embody these very concepts. They sometimes leave a piece of their DNA behind after a battle.

items.en: The Lighthouse Pokémon is in trouble? I'll prepare some medicine right now but it will take some time!
items.zh: 灯塔宝可梦遇到麻烦了？我现在就去准备一些药，不过需要一些时间！
items.normEn: The Lighthouse Pokémon is in trouble? I'll prepare some medicine right now but it will take some time!

items.en: The lives of many Pokémon were taken to restore its life. The resurrected Pokémon left the man.
items.zh: 为了恢复它的生命，许多神奇宝贝的生命被夺走。复活的神奇宝贝离开了男人。
items.normEn: The lives of many Pokémon were taken to restore its life. The resurrected Pokémon left the man.

items.en: The man had suffered too much. His rage had not subsided. He turned the machine into the ultimate weapon. The man became a bringer of destruction that ended the war.
items.zh: 这个男人承受了太多的痛苦。他的怒火还没有平息。他把机器变成了终极武器。这个人成为了结束战争的破坏者。
items.normEn: The man had suffered too much. His rage had not subsided. He turned the machine into the ultimate weapon. The man became a bringer of destruction that ended the war.

items.en: The markings at the entrance to the Sealed Chamber seem to say that some sort of secret is inside. Try to find more braille messages, and I can decode them for you!
items.zh: 密封室入口处的标记似乎表明里面隐藏着某种秘密。尝试找到更多盲文消息，我可以为您解码！
items.normEn: The markings at the entrance to the Sealed Chamber seem to say that some sort of secret is inside. Try to find more braille messages, and I can decode them for you!

items.en: The Mischief Pokémon unleashes his tricks upon the world.
items.zh: 恶作剧神奇宝贝向世界施展他的诡计。
items.normEn: The Mischief Pokémon unleashes his tricks upon the world.

items.en: The more this Berry absorbs energy from sunlight, the more vividly colorful it grows.
items.zh: 这种浆果从阳光中吸收的能量越多，它生长的色彩就越鲜艳。
items.normEn: The more this Berry absorbs energy from sunlight, the more vividly colorful it grows.

items.en: The mural was destroyed! See what you can learn by inspecting the ruins and speaking to the bystander.
items.zh: 壁画被毁了！看看通过检查废墟并与旁观者交谈可以学到什么。
items.normEn: The mural was destroyed! See what you can learn by inspecting the ruins and speaking to the bystander.

items.en: The mysteries of the Ultra Wormhole and Ultra Beasts...  I would be very happy if I could somehow unravel them!
items.zh: 究极虫洞和究极异兽的奥秘……如果能解开的话我会很高兴！
items.normEn: The mysteries of the Ultra Wormhole and Ultra Beasts... I would be very happy if I could somehow unravel them!

items.en: The only thing you can do is watch Lord Ghetsis use Kyurem to freeze Unova solid. That's all...
items.zh: 你唯一能做的就是看着盖齐斯勋爵使用酋雷姆将合众冻结成固体。就这样...
items.normEn: The only thing you can do is watch Lord Ghetsis use Kyurem to freeze Unova solid. That's all...

items.en: The original game was developed by @IshaD#1866, who has since decided to stop work on this project.
items.zh: 最初的游戏是由 @IshaD#1866 开发的，他后来决定停止该项目的工作。
items.normEn: The original game was developed by @IshaD#1866, who has since decided to stop work on this project.

items.en: The people of this place are in danger, you must fight them off!
items.zh: 这里的人们正处于危险之中，你必须与他们战斗！
items.normEn: The people of this place are in danger, you must fight them off!

items.en: The Pharmacist said he needs some time to finish Amphys medicine. Clear the Cianwood City Gym in the meantime.
items.zh: 药剂师说他需要一些时间才能完成安菲斯药物。同时清理 Cianwood 城市体育馆。
items.normEn: The Pharmacist said he needs some time to finish Amphys medicine. Clear the Cianwood City Gym in the meantime.

items.en: The plan was so simple. One of our grunts pre-planted a bunch of big red mushrooms with yellow spots to make a path out of the forest and to our hideout.
items.zh: 计划就是这么简单。我们的一个步兵预先种下了一堆带有黄色斑点的红色大蘑菇，作为一条从森林到我们藏身之处的道路。
items.normEn: The plan was so simple. One of our grunts pre-planted a bunch of big red mushrooms with yellow spots to make a path out of the forest and to our hideout.

items.en: The Poké Ball Factory Director has given you a Master Ball!
items.zh: 精灵球工厂厂长给了你一颗大师球！
items.normEn: The Poké Ball Factory Director has given you a Master Ball!

items.en: The PokéManiacs in Union Cave are restless. They have been ranting and raving about a weekly visitor.
items.zh: 联合洞窟的神奇宝贝们焦躁不安。他们一直在对每周的访客大喊大叫。
items.normEn: The PokéManiacs in Union Cave are restless. They have been ranting and raving about a weekly visitor.

items.en: The Pokémon died. The man wanted to bring the Pokémon back. No matter what it took. The man built a machine to give it life and succeeded.
items.zh: 神奇宝贝死了。男人想要把神奇宝贝带回来。不管付出了什么。这个人建造了一台机器并赋予它生命并成功了。
items.normEn: The Pokémon died. The man wanted to bring the Pokémon back. No matter what it took. The man built a machine to give it life and succeeded.

items.en: The Pokémon in the Wild Area are very finicky, and many of them only appear in certain weathers.
items.zh: 荒野中的神奇宝贝非常挑剔，其中许多只在特定天气下出现。
items.normEn: The Pokémon in the Wild Area are very finicky, and many of them only appear in certain weathers.

items.en: The Pokémon seems to be avoiding the area this year.
items.zh: 神奇宝贝今年似乎避开了这个地区。
items.normEn: The Pokémon seems to be avoiding the area this year.

items.en: The Pokémon you just fought has possessed Peony. Talk to it.
items.zh: 你刚才对战的神奇宝贝已经附身于牡丹。和它说话。
items.normEn: The Pokémon you just fought has possessed Peony. Talk to it.

items.en: The potent mix of bitter and sour in this Berry seems to promote digestion. The flower is white and beautiful.
items.zh: 这种浆果中苦味和酸味的有效混合似乎可以促进消化。花是白色的，很美丽。
items.normEn: The potent mix of bitter and sour in this Berry seems to promote digestion. The flower is white and beautiful.

items.en: The power of Grass has wilted... What an incredible Gym Challenger!
items.zh: 草的力量已经枯萎了……真是不可思议的道馆挑战者啊！
items.normEn: The power of Grass has wilted... What an incredible Gym Challenger!
