items.en: The power of the Legendary Pokémon... The power to grant life to all around it... The power to steal life from all around it... It's a mysterious ability that even scientists like us haven't been able to really decode. What d'you think will happen to the world if we fuel the ultimate weapon with something like that?
items.zh: 传说中的神奇宝贝的力量……赋予周围生命的力量……窃取周围生命的力量……这是连我们这样的科学家都无法真正破解的神秘能力。如果我们用这样的东西为终极武器提供燃料，你认为世界会发生什么？
items.normEn: The power of the Legendary Pokémon... The power to grant life to all around it... The power to steal life from all around it... It's a mysterious ability that even scientists like us haven't been able to really decode. What d'you think will happen to the world if we fuel the ultimate weapon with something like that?

items.en: The President of Silph Co. has rewarded you with a Master Ball!
items.zh: Silph公司的总裁奖励了你一个大师球！
items.normEn: The President of Silph Co. has rewarded you with a Master Ball!

items.en: The Red Genesect has crashed into the P2 Lab and escaped underground. Start digging to learn more.
items.zh: 红色盖诺赛克特撞入 P2 实验室并逃出地下。开始挖掘以了解更多信息。
items.normEn: The Red Genesect has crashed into the P2 Lab and escaped underground. Start digging to learn more.

items.en: The Red Genesect is trying to escape the Castelia Sewers, stop it!
items.zh: 红色盖诺赛克特正试图逃离卡斯特利亚下水道，阻止它！
items.normEn: The Red Genesect is trying to escape the Castelia Sewers, stop it!

items.en: The restore rate of your tools depends on your Underground level.
items.zh: 你的工具的恢复率取决于你的地下等级。
items.normEn: The restore rate of your tools depends on your Underground level.

items.en: The rock is covered in moss. It feels pleasantly cool.
items.zh: 岩石上长满了青苔。感觉凉爽宜人。
items.normEn: The rock is covered in moss. It feels pleasantly cool.

items.en: The rock is encrusted in ice. It is freezing to touch.
items.zh: 岩石上结满了冰。摸起来很冷。
items.normEn: The rock is encrusted in ice. It is freezing to touch.

items.en: The ruins are still locked, report to Peony.
items.zh: 废墟还锁着，向牡丹报告。
items.normEn: The ruins are still locked, report to Peony.

items.en: The ruins were locked, go report back to Peony.
items.zh: 废墟被锁了，去向牡丹报告吧。
items.normEn: The ruins were locked, go report back to Peony.

items.en: The Safari Zone uses a different method of encountering and capturing Pokémon, and it contains several unique Pokémon.
items.zh: 野生动物区使用不同的方法来遭遇和捕获神奇宝贝，并且包含几种独特的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: The Safari Zone uses a different method of encountering and capturing Pokémon, and it contains several unique Pokémon.

items.en: The same behavior affects nearby plants, causing additional mutations.
items.zh: 同样的行为也会影响附近的植物，导致额外的突变。
items.normEn: The same behavior affects nearby plants, causing additional mutations.

items.en: The same energy promotes the growth of nearby Berries.
items.zh: 同样的能量促进附近浆果的生长。
items.normEn: The same energy promotes the growth of nearby Berries.

items.en: The scent of this Berry plant attracts wild Pokémon.
items.zh: 这种浆果植物的气味会吸引野生神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: The scent of this Berry plant attracts wild Pokémon.

items.en: The scent of this Berry plant repels wild Pokémon.
items.zh: 这种浆果植物的气味可以驱除野生神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: The scent of this Berry plant repels wild Pokémon.

items.en: The scientist you met at Giant Chasm is looking for you at the Battle Frontier.
items.zh: 你在巨大峡谷遇到的科学家正在战斗前沿寻找你。
items.normEn: The scientist you met at Giant Chasm is looking for you at the Battle Frontier.

items.en: The second carving says ISLAND. There are a lot of islands on Route 105.
items.zh: 第二个雕刻上写着“岛屿”。 105号公路上有很多岛屿。
items.normEn: The second carving says ISLAND. There are a lot of islands on Route 105.

items.en: The Sinnoh region is now available
items.normEn: The Sinnoh region is now available

items.en: The sound of these Berries attracts rare wild Pokémon.
items.zh: 这些浆果的声音会吸引稀有的野生神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: The sound of these Berries attracts rare wild Pokémon.

items.en: The spirits tell me roaming Pokémon have been spotted on {ROUTE_NAME}!
items.zh: 灵魂告诉我在 {ROUTE_NAME} 上发现了漫游的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: The spirits tell me roaming Pokémon have been spotted on {ROUTE_NAME}!

items.en: The Stadium here isn't even open yet, I think the Mayor was just trying to get rid of us.
items.zh: 这里的体育场还没有开放，我想市长只是想赶走我们。
items.normEn: The Stadium here isn't even open yet, I think the Mayor was just trying to get rid of us.

items.en: The Start Menu also has a button to open the Wiki.
items.zh: 开始菜单还有一个用于打开 Wiki 的按钮。
items.normEn: The Start Menu also has a button to open the Wiki.

items.en: The strength of the debuff is based on your highest region, not the region you are battling in.
items.zh: 减益效果的强度取决于您的最高区域，而不是您正在战斗的区域。
items.normEn: The strength of the debuff is based on your highest region, not the region you are battling in.

items.en: The Sun Flute and the Moon Flute. When sounded together, it's said that they can call the Legendary Pokémon... That is, if you believe in old myths, anyway. I found one of them downstairs and gave it to Lillie.
items.zh: 日笛和月笛。当一起响起时，据说它们可以召唤传说中的神奇宝贝……也就是说，如果你相信古老的神话的话。我在楼下找到了其中一张，交给了莉莉。
items.normEn: The Sun Flute and the Moon Flute. When sounded together, it's said that they can call the Legendary Pokémon... That is, if you believe in old myths, anyway. I found one of them downstairs and gave it to Lillie.

items.en: The sweetness-laden pulp has just the hint of a hard-edged and fragrant bite to it.
items.zh: 充满甜味的果肉有一丝硬边和芳香的味道。
items.normEn: The sweetness-laden pulp has just the hint of a hard-edged and fragrant bite to it.

items.en: The Swords of Justice all depart for their homes to wait for your arrival. Go catch your new friends and add them to your team!
items.zh: 正义之剑们都启程回家等待你的到来。去认识你的新朋友并将他们添加到你的团队中吧！
items.normEn: The Swords of Justice all depart for their homes to wait for your arrival. Go catch your new friends and add them to your team!

items.en: The Swords of Justice sense something bad is about to happen, will you be able to help them out?
items.zh: 正义之剑察觉到不好的事情即将发生，你能帮助他们吗？
items.normEn: The Swords of Justice sense something bad is about to happen, will you be able to help them out?

items.en: The terror aroused by that power is clear to see in this ancient artwork. You know who might know more about this? Captain Stern, a sailor who works for my father.
items.zh: 这种力量所引发的恐怖在这件古老的艺术品中清晰可见。你知道谁可能对此了解更多吗？斯特恩船长，一名为我父亲工作的水手。
items.normEn: The terror aroused by that power is clear to see in this ancient artwork. You know who might know more about this? Captain Stern, a sailor who works for my father.

items.en: The testing is complete. I see no problem at all with your skills. Rather I would have to praise you for them. Welcome to the team!
items.zh: 测试完成。我看你的技术一点问题都没有。相反，我不得不赞扬你。欢迎加入团队！
items.normEn: The testing is complete. I see no problem at all with your skills. Rather I would have to praise you for them. Welcome to the team!

items.en: The third carving says ANCIENT. I remember seeing some ancient ruins on Route 120.
items.zh: 第三个雕刻上写着“古代”。我记得在120号公路上看到过一些古代遗迹。
items.normEn: The third carving says ANCIENT. I remember seeing some ancient ruins on Route 120.

items.en: The Time Distortion seems to have cleared up. Celebi should be happy now. You should go check out the Shrine again.
items.zh: 时间扭曲似乎已经消除了。雪拉比现在应该很高兴吧。你应该再去神社看看。
items.normEn: The Time Distortion seems to have cleared up. Celebi should be happy now. You should go check out the Shrine again.

items.en: The translation cache is only available by default in development builds. To cache translatable text in this game version, add "?translationCache=true" to the end of the URL and reload the game.
items.zh: 翻译缓存仅在开发版本中默认可用。要在此游戏版本中缓存可翻译文本，请将“?translationCache=true”添加到 URL 末尾并重新加载游戏。
items.normEn: The translation cache is only available by default in development builds. To cache translatable text in this game version, add "?translationCache=true" to the end of the URL and reload the game.

items.en: The ultimate weapon is reborn! The poisonous flower has bloomed! All shall perish! Except for Team Flare! Look at Geosenge! It has bloomed in Geosenge Town!
items.zh: 终极武器重生！毒花绽放了！一切都将灭亡！除了火焰队！看看乔森吉！巨杉镇的花开了！
items.normEn: The ultimate weapon is reborn! The poisonous flower has bloomed! All shall perish! Except for Team Flare! Look at Geosenge! It has bloomed in Geosenge Town!

items.en: The ultimate weapon was activated in Geosenge Town! Go to the Team Flare Secret HQ to put a stop to it! First step: Beating Team Flare Aliana.
items.zh: 终极武器在巨石镇启动！前往耀斑小队秘密总部阻止它！第一步：击败 Flare Aliana 队。
items.normEn: The ultimate weapon was activated in Geosenge Town! Go to the Team Flare Secret HQ to put a stop to it! First step: Beating Team Flare Aliana.

items.en: The ultimate weapon's flower has finally bloomed above the soil. Don't you find its beauty captivating? As we speak, it draws its energy from the Legendary Pokémon.
items.zh: 究极兵器之花终于在大地之上绽放。你不觉得它的美丽令人着迷吗？正如我们所说，它从传奇神奇宝贝中汲取能量。
items.normEn: The ultimate weapon's flower has finally bloomed above the soil. Don't you find its beauty captivating? As we speak, it draws its energy from the Legendary Pokémon.

items.en: The Ultra Recon Squad is awaiting a battle in Seaward Cave. Show them the thrill of the fight!
items.zh: 超级侦察小队正在临海洞穴等待战斗。向他们展示战斗的快感！
items.normEn: The Ultra Recon Squad is awaiting a battle in Seaward Cave. Show them the thrill of the fight!

items.en: The Ultra Recon Squad is investigating an oddly familiar tree. Go check it out on Route 5.
items.zh: 超级侦察队正在调查一棵奇怪的熟悉的树。去5号公路看看吧。
items.normEn: The Ultra Recon Squad is investigating an oddly familiar tree. Go check it out on Route 5.

items.en: The Unova region is now available!
items.normEn: The Unova region is now available!

items.en: The victor has been decided! The one to complete the third trial is you, our newest student! You gave it your best and triumphed, even when faced with an unfair challenge. To you, who has completed all the trials... I grant the secret armor of the Master Dojo!
items.zh: 胜负已定！完成第三次试炼的人就是你，我们的新学员！即使面对不公平的挑战，你也尽了最大努力并取得了胜利。完成所有试炼的你……我赐予大师道场的秘密铠甲！
items.normEn: The victor has been decided! The one to complete the third trial is you, our newest student! You gave it your best and triumphed, even when faced with an unfair challenge. To you, who has completed all the trials... I grant the secret armor of the Master Dojo!

items.en: The way my Magikarp performed is a-trout-cious!
items.zh: 我的鲤鱼王的表演方式真是——鳟鱼！
items.normEn: The way my Magikarp performed is a-trout-cious!

items.en: The weather is clear and pleasant.
items.normEn: The weather is clear and pleasant.

items.en: Their prized Magneton had evolved into a Magnezone!
items.zh: 他们珍贵的 Magneton 已进化为 Magnezone！
items.normEn: Their prized Magneton had evolved into a Magnezone!

items.en: Then my programme got interrupted by an emergency broadcast. A report on the first confirmed sightings of Tornadus and Thundurus in over twenty-five years! I've read so much about them, they are my favorites.
items.zh: 然后我的节目被紧急广播打断了。关于二十五年来首次确认看到龙卷风和雷雨云的报告！我读了很多关于他们的文章，他们是我的最爱。
items.normEn: Then my programme got interrupted by an emergency broadcast. A report on the first confirmed sightings of Tornadus and Thundurus in over twenty-five years! I've read so much about them, they are my favorites.

items.en: Then one day, all my progress was gone. I don't know exactly what happened. Something updated, some cookies got cleaned up, I don't know. I had to start all over from the beginning.
items.zh: 然后有一天，我所有的进步都消失了。我不知道到底发生了什么。更新了一些东西，一些cookie被清理了，我不知道。我必须从头开始。
items.normEn: Then one day, all my progress was gone. I don't know exactly what happened. Something updated, some cookies got cleaned up, I don't know. I had to start all over from the beginning.

items.en: There are 2 other ruins like this, one in Johto, and one in Sinnoh. I have heard that in each ruins, there are forms that only appear there. For example, the forms that resemble a question mark and an exclamation point have only been seen here.
items.zh: 类似的遗址还有两处，一处位于城都，一处位于神奥。听说，每一座遗迹中，都有只出现在那里的身影。比如类似问号、感叹号的形式，只在这里见过。
items.normEn: There are 2 other ruins like this, one in Johto, and one in Sinnoh. I have heard that in each ruins, there are forms that only appear there. For example, the forms that resemble a question mark and an exclamation point have only been seen here.

items.en: There are a few carvings inside this maze. The carving with five dots on the top row says "LEFT".
items.zh: 这个迷宫里面有一些雕刻。最上面一行有五个点的雕刻写着“左”。
items.normEn: There are a few carvings inside this maze. The carving with five dots on the top row says "LEFT".

items.en: There are a few hidden near the city. If you can find them all, I will give you a wonderful prize!
items.zh: 有一些隐藏在城市附近。如果你能找到全部，我会给你一份精美的奖品！
items.normEn: There are a few hidden near the city. If you can find them all, I will give you a wonderful prize!

items.en: There are a few things you should know before you depart:
items.zh: 出发前您应该了解以下几件事：
items.normEn: There are a few things you should know before you depart:

items.en: There are currently no plans for a "final release".
items.zh: 目前还没有“最终版本”的计划。
items.normEn: There are currently no plans for a "final release".

items.en: There are even some Pokémon, namely Cramorant and Eiscue, that only appear in certain forms depending on weather.
items.zh: 甚至还有一些神奇宝贝，即克拉莫兰特和艾斯库，只会根据天气以某些形式出现。
items.normEn: There are even some Pokémon, namely Cramorant and Eiscue, that only appear in certain forms depending on weather.

items.en: There are many more regions to explore!
items.zh: 还有更多地区可供探索！
items.normEn: There are many more regions to explore!

items.en: There are many Pokémon in Galar that I heard look completely different in other regions of the world! They can also evolve in unique ways!
items.zh: 听说伽勒尔有很多神奇宝贝在世界其他地区看起来完全不一样！它们还可以以独特的方式进化！
items.normEn: There are many Pokémon in Galar that I heard look completely different in other regions of the world! They can also evolve in unique ways!

items.en: There are many threats in this world, and I think we will both be safer if we work together!
items.zh: 这个世界上有很多威胁，我想如果我们共同努力，我们都会更安全！
items.normEn: There are many threats in this world, and I think we will both be safer if we work together!

items.en: There are more tiers to Alcremie than I can count. Mix up the direction, duration, time of day, and the given Sweet to discover all the flavours there are to find.
items.zh: Alcremie 的层级多得我数不过来。混合方向、持续时间、一天中的时间和给定的糖果来发现所有可以找到的口味。
items.normEn: There are more tiers to Alcremie than I can count. Mix up the direction, duration, time of day, and the given Sweet to discover all the flavours there are to find.

items.en: There are more Z Crystals on Ula'ula. Find the Trial Site hidden in Haina Desert after clearing the Route.
items.zh: 乌拉乌拉上有更多 Z 水晶。清理路线后找到隐藏在海纳沙漠中的审判地点。
items.normEn: There are more Z Crystals on Ula'ula. Find the Trial Site hidden in Haina Desert after clearing the Route.

items.en: There are no more rampaging Pokémon for now and Marnie wants to battle you in Spikemuth.
items.zh: 现在已经没有狂暴的神奇宝贝了，玛妮想在斯派克穆斯与你战斗。
items.normEn: There are no more rampaging Pokémon for now and Marnie wants to battle you in Spikemuth.

items.en: There are rumors that the energy calls some legendary birds to roam Kalos!
items.zh: 有传言称，这种能量会召唤一些传说中的鸟类在卡洛斯漫游！
items.normEn: There are rumors that the energy calls some legendary birds to roam Kalos!

items.en: There are six different types of mines you can search for in the Underground. Understanding their unique properties and the discovery times involved is crucial for efficient mining. The Underground Glossary can be found at the bottom of this page.
items.zh: 您可以在地下寻找六种不同类型的地雷。了解它们的独特性质和所涉及的发现时间对于高效采矿至关重要。地下术语表可以在本页底部找到。
items.normEn: There are six different types of mines you can search for in the Underground. Understanding their unique properties and the discovery times involved is crucial for efficient mining. The Underground Glossary can be found at the bottom of this page.

items.en: There are some areas around Galar that you can only reach after beating the Champion.
items.zh: 伽勒尔周围有一些区域只有在击败冠军后才能到达。
items.normEn: There are some areas around Galar that you can only reach after beating the Champion.

items.en: There are some singularly stunning individuals down at {ROUTE_NAME}! Some Magikarp with real personality!
items.zh: {ROUTE_NAME} 上有一些令人惊叹的人物！一些具有真正个性的鲤鱼王！
items.normEn: There are some singularly stunning individuals down at {ROUTE_NAME}! Some Magikarp with real personality!

items.en: There are some things that seem out of reach no matter how hard you try. However, it's important that you never give up--no matter the opponent or the odds. I could tell from our battle that you and your Pokémon understand that. To commemorate such an impressive show of teamwork, please accept the Cliff Badge!
items.zh: 有些事情，无论你多么努力，似乎都遥不可及。然而，重要的是你永远不要放弃——无论对手如何，胜算如何。从我们的战斗中我可以看出你和你的神奇宝贝都明白这一点。为了纪念如此令人印象深刻的团队合作表现，请接受悬崖徽章！
items.normEn: There are some things that seem out of reach no matter how hard you try. However, it's important that you never give up--no matter the opponent or the odds. I could tell from our battle that you and your Pokémon understand that. To commemorate such an impressive show of teamwork, please accept the Cliff Badge!

items.en: There are still Clones left in Mewtwos army! Help me fight them!
items.zh: 超梦的军队里还剩下克隆人！帮我对抗他们！
items.normEn: There are still Clones left in Mewtwos army! Help me fight them!

items.en: There are two types of mutations:
items.normEn: There are two types of mutations:

items.en: There haven't been any new reports of Ultra Beasts in Alola, but I did see something strange over in Ten Carat Hill. It was black, yet shining. It seemed to be fleeing, no doubt about that. Must have been in a weakened state. Was it involved in some kind of battle? If you find it, I doubt it will have much energy left.
items.zh: 阿罗拉还没有新的究极异兽的报道，但我在十克拉丘陵确实看到了一些奇怪的东西。它是黑色的，但却闪闪发光。毫无疑问，它似乎正在逃跑。应该是处于虚弱状态。是不是卷入了某种战斗？如果你找到它，我怀疑它还会剩下多少能量。
items.normEn: There haven't been any new reports of Ultra Beasts in Alola, but I did see something strange over in Ten Carat Hill. It was black, yet shining. It seemed to be fleeing, no doubt about that. Must have been in a weakened state. Was it involved in some kind of battle? If you find it, I doubt it will have much energy left.

items.en: There haven't been any reports of roaming Pokémon around ${...} lately.
items.zh: 最近没有关于神奇宝贝在 ${...} 附近漫游的报告。
items.normEn: There haven't been any reports of roaming Pokémon around ${...} lately.

items.en: There is a ceremony held for the Legendary Pokémon at the Altar of the Sunne and Moone that uses two particular flutes. Ho! You already have the one. The other is said to be held on Exeggutor Island.
items.zh: 在苏尼和月恩的祭坛上，使用两支特殊的笛子为传说中的神奇宝贝举行了仪式。嗬！你已经拥有了。据说另一场是在椰蛋岛举行的。
items.normEn: There is a ceremony held for the Legendary Pokémon at the Altar of the Sunne and Moone that uses two particular flutes. Ho! You already have the one. The other is said to be held on Exeggutor Island.

items.en: There is a journalist in Hearthome City who may be able to help us both. Please make contact with her and report anything you find back to me.
items.zh: 心之城有一位记者，或许可以帮助我们俩。请与她联系并将您发现的任何情况报告给我。
items.normEn: There is a journalist in Hearthome City who may be able to help us both. Please make contact with her and report anything you find back to me.

items.en: There is a maximum of 3 active slots.
items.zh: 最多有 3 个活动插槽。
items.normEn: There is a maximum of 3 active slots.

items.en: There is a stone near Agate Village that can purify the souls of Pokémon, yes indeed.
items.zh: 玛瑙村附近有一块石头，确实可以净化神奇宝贝的灵魂。
items.normEn: There is a stone near Agate Village that can purify the souls of Pokémon, yes indeed.

items.en: There is no limit to breeding, so this will be your main source of attack gain.
items.zh: 繁殖没有限制，所以这将是你攻击增益的主要来源。
items.normEn: There is no limit to breeding, so this will be your main source of attack gain.

items.en: There is no more time to waste. UB-01 Symbiont, Nihilego, has been spotted on Akala Island! I will protect the nearby population centers, you must go and confront the Beast!
items.zh: 没有更多的时间可以浪费了。 UB-01 共生体 Nihilego 已在阿卡拉岛被发现！我会保护附近的人口中心，你必须去对抗野兽！
items.normEn: There is no more time to waste. UB-01 Symbiont, Nihilego, has been spotted on Akala Island! I will protect the nearby population centers, you must go and confront the Beast!

items.en: There is no regional attack debuff or weather effects.
items.zh: 没有区域攻击减益或天气影响。
items.normEn: There is no regional attack debuff or weather effects.

items.en: There is one more thing I would like to ask you, would you battle this old man? I promise I'll make it worth your while. Let's go outside.
items.zh: 我还有一件事想问你，你愿意和这个老头战斗吗？我保证我会让你的时间值得。我们到外面去吧。
items.normEn: There is one more thing I would like to ask you, would you battle this old man? I promise I'll make it worth your while. Let's go outside.

items.en: There is one more Z Crystal on Ten Carat Hill. Find the Trial Site and claim it!
items.zh: 十克拉山上还有一颗 Z 水晶。找到试用网站并领取它！
items.normEn: There is one more Z Crystal on Ten Carat Hill. Find the Trial Site and claim it!

items.en: There is someone I would like to go with you, it's my partner, Eevee.
items.zh: 我想和你一起去的人是我的搭档伊布。
items.normEn: There is someone I would like to go with you, it's my partner, Eevee.

items.en: There is something I've discovered researching the Manaphy stories here. Apparently, Manaphy can be bred to produce an entirely different species of Pokémon!
items.zh: 我在研究玛纳菲故事时发现了一些东西。显然，玛纳霏可以培育出完全不同种类的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: There is something I've discovered researching the Manaphy stories here. Apparently, Manaphy can be bred to produce an entirely different species of Pokémon!

items.en: There is still so much I don't know. Do I just not have what it takes?
items.zh: 还有很多我不知道的事情。我只是不具备所需的条件吗？
items.normEn: There is still so much I don't know. Do I just not have what it takes?

items.en: There seems to be a big fuss about a new discovery in the Giant Chasm. Try finding it.
items.zh: 巨大峡谷的新发现似乎引起了很大的轰动。尝试找到它。
items.normEn: There seems to be a big fuss about a new discovery in the Giant Chasm. Try finding it.

items.en: There were rampaging Pokémon at Ballonlea Stadium, but Bede already defeated them. There are no more rampaging Pokémon for now, and he wants to battle.
items.zh: 巴隆利体育场里有狂暴的神奇宝贝，但贝德已经打败了它们。现在已经没有狂暴的神奇宝贝了，他想要战斗。
items.normEn: There were rampaging Pokémon at Ballonlea Stadium, but Bede already defeated them. There are no more rampaging Pokémon for now, and he wants to battle.

items.en: There's a definite bond between you and your Pokémon, too. I didn't recognize it, so it's only natural that I lost. Yup, I'd like to see how far your bond will carry you. Go ahead, move to the next room.
items.zh: 你和你的神奇宝贝之间也有明确的联系。我没认出来，所以我输了也是理所当然的。是的，我想看看你的纽带能带你走多远。继续，移动到下一个房间。
items.normEn: There's a definite bond between you and your Pokémon, too. I didn't recognize it, so it's only natural that I lost. Yup, I'd like to see how far your bond will carry you. Go ahead, move to the next room.

items.en: There's a few in this city that need help. Can you come with me though? I'm worried more shady guys will show up.
items.zh: 这个城市里有一些人需要帮助。你能跟我一起去吗？我担心更多的黑手会出现。
items.normEn: There's a few in this city that need help. Can you come with me though? I'm worried more shady guys will show up.

items.en: There’s a legend that a mythical Wish Pokémon awakens when it passes over us. If you’re as strong as the Champion, maybe you’ll find it roaming around Hoenn granting wishes!
items.zh: 有一个传说，传说中的许愿宝可梦在从我们头顶掠过时就会苏醒。如果你和冠军一样强大，也许你会发现它在丰缘地区漫游，实现你的愿望！
items.normEn: There’s a legend that a mythical Wish Pokémon awakens when it passes over us. If you’re as strong as the Champion, maybe you’ll find it roaming around Hoenn granting wishes!

items.en: There's a lot more, but that should get you started.
items.zh: 还有更多内容，但这应该可以帮助您开始。
items.normEn: There's a lot more, but that should get you started.

items.en: There's a lot of rumors buzzing around about the S. S. Libra, but if you ask me, it's long gone and may never be found.
items.zh: 关于 S.S. Libra 有很多谣言，但如果你问我，它早已消失，可能永远不会被发现。
items.normEn: There's a lot of rumors buzzing around about the S. S. Libra, but if you ask me, it's long gone and may never be found.

items.en: There's a mysterious berry that requires ${...}
items.zh: 有一种神秘的浆果，需要 ${...}
items.normEn: There's a mysterious berry that requires ${...}

items.en: There's a mysterious berry that requires ${...}.
items.zh: 有一种神秘的浆果，需要${...}。
items.normEn: There's a mysterious berry that requires ${...}.

items.en: There's an ancient legend here on Akala Island that tells of Marshadow.
items.zh: 阿卡拉岛上有一个关于玛夏多的古老传说。
items.normEn: There's an ancient legend here on Akala Island that tells of Marshadow.

items.en: There's an old book with myths about Alola's Legendary Pokémon here. It seems to suggest they came from another world and brought life to an heir that was to be protected by the island guardians.
items.zh: 这里有一本古老的书，记载着阿罗拉的传说宝可梦的神话。这似乎表明他们来自另一个世界，并为一位受岛屿守护者保护的继承人带来了生命。
items.normEn: There's an old book with myths about Alola's Legendary Pokémon here. It seems to suggest they came from another world and brought life to an heir that was to be protected by the island guardians.

items.en: There's an old submarine around here that I've been working on upgrading to go explore the lowest parts of that cavern, but need some help getting the parts.
items.zh: 这里有一艘旧潜艇，我一直在对其进行升级，以探索该洞穴的最低部分，但需要一些帮助来获取零件。
items.normEn: There's an old submarine around here that I've been working on upgrading to go explore the lowest parts of that cavern, but need some help getting the parts.

items.en: There's been a lot of crime around here recently. But nothing I can't handle!
items.zh: 最近这里发生了很多犯罪事件。但没有什么是我处理不了的！
items.normEn: There's been a lot of crime around here recently. But nothing I can't handle!

items.en: There's been a lot of hubbub and excitement in the region since the Mossdeep Space Center announced that a meteor was headed our way. This has lead to a lot of new faces in Hoenn.
items.zh: 自从莫斯迪普航天中心宣布一颗流星正向我们袭来以来，该地区充满了喧闹和兴奋。这给丰缘市带来了很多新面孔。
items.normEn: There's been a lot of hubbub and excitement in the region since the Mossdeep Space Center announced that a meteor was headed our way. This has lead to a lot of new faces in Hoenn.

items.en: There's been some recent sightings of roaming Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}!
items.zh: 最近在{ROUTE_NAME}上看到了一些漫游的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: There's been some recent sightings of roaming Pokémon on {ROUTE_NAME}!

items.en: There's no such thing as a cold night in my house, no sir! The most fierce chill of winter is completely defeated by their warm, cozy presence.
items.zh: 我家里不存在寒冷的夜晚，不，先生！冬季最严酷的寒冷被它们温暖、舒适的存在完全击败。
items.normEn: There's no such thing as a cold night in my house, no sir! The most fierce chill of winter is completely defeated by their warm, cozy presence.

items.en: There's no way I can beat you!
items.normEn: There's no way I can beat you!

items.en: There's only one Pokémon who could keep the Prison Bottle from us for so long: Hoopa!
items.zh: 只有一只神奇宝贝可以让监狱瓶远离我们这么久：胡帕！
items.normEn: There's only one Pokémon who could keep the Prison Bottle from us for so long: Hoopa!

items.en: There's rumors of more Team Cipher activity at Mt. Battle. Go investigate!
items.zh: 有传言称，密码团队将在巴特尔山进行更多活动。去调查吧！
items.normEn: There's rumors of more Team Cipher activity at Mt. Battle. Go investigate!

items.en: There's some salesman offering rare fish east of New Mauville, out on the water.
items.zh: 在新莫维尔以东的水面上，有一些推销员在出售珍稀鱼类。
items.normEn: There's some salesman offering rare fish east of New Mauville, out on the water.

items.en: There's something suspicious going on here, but I'm not sure what our next move is here.
items.zh: 这里发生了一些可疑的事情，但我不确定我们的下一步行动是什么。
items.normEn: There's something suspicious going on here, but I'm not sure what our next move is here.

items.en: There's this fancy graceful one's apparently flyin' about the Crown Tundra!
items.zh: 这只优雅优雅的小鸟显然正在皇冠苔原上飞翔！
items.normEn: There's this fancy graceful one's apparently flyin' about the Crown Tundra!

items.en: These berries make catching efforts worth more.
items.zh: 这些浆果使捕捉的努力变得更有价值。
items.normEn: These berries make catching efforts worth more.

items.en: These efficiencies will gain a bonus based on how many times you've used the helper to hatch eggs.
items.zh: 这些效率将根据您使用助手孵化鸡蛋的次数而获得奖励。
items.normEn: These efficiencies will gain a bonus based on how many times you've used the helper to hatch eggs.

items.en: These elusive Pokémon are Blue and Red and White all over, and our reporters will give you the latest updates as we try to discern their identity and location!
items.zh: 这些难以捉摸的神奇宝贝全身都是蓝色、红色和白色，我们的记者将在尝试辨别它们的身份和位置时为您提供最新消息！
items.normEn: These elusive Pokémon are Blue and Red and White all over, and our reporters will give you the latest updates as we try to discern their identity and location!

items.en: These items can be used in the
items.normEn: These items can be used in the

items.en: These mutations can start to happen at Taller stage.
items.zh: 这些突变可以在较高阶段开始发生。
items.normEn: These mutations can start to happen at Taller stage.

items.en: These mutations only happen at Ripe stage.
items.zh: 这些突变只发生在成熟阶段。
items.normEn: These mutations only happen at Ripe stage.

items.en: These Pokémon are perfect! I'll put them out back in the training fields.
items.zh: 这些神奇宝贝太完美了！我会把他们放回训练场。
items.normEn: These Pokémon are perfect! I'll put them out back in the training fields.

items.zh: 这些神奇宝贝一定是生病了

items.en: They also have a high-speed form, which I hear has been sighted across Unova.
items.zh: 它们还有一种高速形态，我听说在合众国上空都曾看到过它们。
items.normEn: They also have a high-speed form, which I hear has been sighted across Unova.

items.en: They are all tough trainers, so you might need to train more to defeat them.
items.zh: 他们都是强硬的训练家，所以你可能需要更多的训练才能击败他们。
items.normEn: They are all tough trainers, so you might need to train more to defeat them.

items.en: They are certainly very dangerous, but it doesn't seem like they are a threat to the region anymore.
items.zh: 他们确实非常危险，但似乎不再对该地区构成威胁。
items.normEn: They are certainly very dangerous, but it doesn't seem like they are a threat to the region anymore.

items.en: They are definitely stealing Pokémon. Investigate the Totally Unsuspicious Frigate.
items.zh: 他们肯定是在偷神奇宝贝。调查完全没有可疑之处的护卫舰。
items.normEn: They are definitely stealing Pokémon. Investigate the Totally Unsuspicious Frigate.

items.en: They are options you can select
items.zh: 它们是您可以选择的选项
items.normEn: They are options you can select

items.en: They came here from a different world. Dropped rudely into our world against their will. We know nothing about them. They could be dangerous. They are almost certainly extremely wary and combative.
items.zh: 他们从不同的世界来到这里。违背他们的意愿，粗暴地闯入我们的世界。我们对他们一无所知。他们可能很危险。几乎可以肯定，他们非常警惕和好斗。
items.normEn: They came here from a different world. Dropped rudely into our world against their will. We know nothing about them. They could be dangerous. They are almost certainly extremely wary and combative.

items.en: They can attract wild Pokémon to the Farm that can be captured, some of which can only be obtained this way.
items.zh: 它们可以吸引野生神奇宝贝到可以捕获的农场，其中一些只能通过这种方式获得。
items.normEn: They can attract wild Pokémon to the Farm that can be captured, some of which can only be obtained this way.

items.en: They can be exchanged for different items or Pokémon in Berry Master Shops.
items.zh: 它们可以在浆果大师商店中兑换不同的物品或神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: They can be exchanged for different items or Pokémon in Berry Master Shops.

items.en: They can be used in the underground to restore energy.
items.zh: 它们可以在地下使用来恢复能量。
items.normEn: They can be used in the underground to restore energy.

items.en: They can be used on plots for different effects:
items.zh: 它们可以在绘图上使用以获得不同的效果：
items.normEn: They can be used on plots for different effects:

items.en: They can be used to combine myself and my steeds. However, they are incomplete. You must intertwine the hair from their manes for them to work. I expect they will occasionally leave such hair behind upon being defeated.
items.zh: 它们可以用来将我和我的战马结合起来。然而，它们是不完整的。你必须把它们鬃毛上的头发缠在一起，它们才能工作。我预计他们在被击败后偶尔会留下这样的头发。
items.normEn: They can be used to combine myself and my steeds. However, they are incomplete. You must intertwine the hair from their manes for them to work. I expect they will occasionally leave such hair behind upon being defeated.

items.en: They come wandering back when the weather changes, though. I wonder if a strong Pokémon is calling them?
items.zh: 不过，当天气发生变化时，它们就会回来。不知道是不是有强大的神奇宝贝在召唤它们呢？
items.normEn: They come wandering back when the weather changes, though. I wonder if a strong Pokémon is calling them?

items.en: They do not guarantee a successful dungeon clear, and will charge regardless of the outcome.
items.zh: 他们不保证地下城通关成功，并且无论结果如何都会收费。
items.normEn: They do not guarantee a successful dungeon clear, and will charge regardless of the outcome.

items.en: They Don't Work on Ultra Beasts? That's False Advertising!
items.zh: 他们对超级野兽不起作用？这就是虚假广告！
items.normEn: They Don't Work on Ultra Beasts? That's False Advertising!

items.en: They each also have different attack efficiencies, which will determine how much attack you gain compared to manually hatching the Pokémon yourself.
items.zh: 它们各自也有不同的攻击效率，这将决定与您自己手动孵化神奇宝贝相比，您获得多少攻击力。
items.normEn: They each also have different attack efficiencies, which will determine how much attack you gain compared to manually hatching the Pokémon yourself.

items.en: They fortunately do return home when the weather changes, at least. I wonder what sort of creature is calling them? A strong Pokémon, perhaps?
items.zh: 幸运的是，至少当天气变化时，他们确实会回家。我想知道是什么样的生物在召唤它们？也许是强大的神奇宝贝？
items.normEn: They fortunately do return home when the weather changes, at least. I wonder what sort of creature is calling them? A strong Pokémon, perhaps?

items.en: They have special Auras that can provide Gameplay bonuses.
items.zh: 他们有特殊的光环，可以提供游戏奖励。
items.normEn: They have special Auras that can provide Gameplay bonuses.

items.en: They haven't been seen in Unova for millions of years! If one is here now, it's sure to be a little confused about what the world is like.
items.zh: 他们已经数百万年没有在合众国出现了！如果一个人现在在这里，肯定会对这个世界到底是什么样子感到有点困惑。
items.normEn: They haven't been seen in Unova for millions of years! If one is here now, it's sure to be a little confused about what the world is like.

items.en: They look real strong, so you probably can't catch 'em right off the bat. I'd try weakening them first.
items.zh: 它们看起来非常强大，所以你可能无法立即抓住它们。我会先尝试削弱它们。
items.normEn: They look real strong, so you probably can't catch 'em right off the bat. I'd try weakening them first.

items.en: They must be lying, how can that be true?!
items.zh: 他们一定是在说谎，这怎么可能是真的？！
items.normEn: They must be lying, how can that be true?!

items.en: They need you to prove you're strong enough to deal with the possible dangers. Defeat the Swords of Justice!
items.zh: 他们需要你证明你有足够的力量应对可能的危险。击败正义之剑！
items.normEn: They need you to prove you're strong enough to deal with the possible dangers. Defeat the Swords of Justice!

items.en: They require specific Berries to happen.
items.zh: 它们需要特定的浆果才能发生。
items.normEn: They require specific Berries to happen.

items.en: They said that it is a virus that can spread in the Pokémon Day Care. They said that Pokémon can only spread or catch the virus if they aren’t ready to hatch yet, and that they need to share a type with one another.
items.zh: 他们说这是一种可以在神奇宝贝日托中心传播的病毒。他们说，神奇宝贝只有在尚未准备好孵化时才能传播或感染病毒，并且它们需要彼此共享一种类型。
items.normEn: They said that it is a virus that can spread in the Pokémon Day Care. They said that Pokémon can only spread or catch the virus if they aren’t ready to hatch yet, and that they need to share a type with one another.

items.en: They simply can't resist berries that match their colors - just plant a few and they'll soon come wandering in.
items.zh: 它们根本无法抗拒与它们颜色相配的浆果——只要种几颗，它们很快就会进来。
items.normEn: They simply can't resist berries that match their colors - just plant a few and they'll soon come wandering in.

items.en: They told me that I had to let them have free reign in town, or there would be trouble. They're out at the Colosseum causing trouble.
items.zh: 他们告诉我，我必须让他们在城里自由支配，否则就会有麻烦。他们在罗马斗兽场制造麻烦。
items.normEn: They told me that I had to let them have free reign in town, or there would be trouble. They're out at the Colosseum causing trouble.

items.en: They usually require a Berry changing into other and are related with flavour profiles or use of objects.
items.zh: 它们通常需要将浆果转变为其他浆果，并且与风味特征或物体的使用有关。
items.normEn: They usually require a Berry changing into other and are related with flavour profiles or use of objects.

items.en: They were flying really fast, I bet Pokémon that fast will only challenge trainers who have proven they are as strong as Champion Wallace...
items.zh: 他们飞得非常快，我敢打赌神奇宝贝这么快只会挑战那些已经证明自己和冠军华莱士一样强大的训练家......
items.normEn: They were flying really fast, I bet Pokémon that fast will only challenge trainers who have proven they are as strong as Champion Wallace...

items.en: They were heading south, towards Professor Rowan's lab!
items.zh: 他们正在向南行驶，前往罗文教授的实验室！
items.normEn: They were heading south, towards Professor Rowan's lab!

items.en: They were trying to clone an ancient Pokémon in the mansion... I wonder if they succeeded.
items.zh: 他们试图在宅邸中克隆一只古老的神奇宝贝……不知道他们是否成功了。
items.normEn: They were trying to clone an ancient Pokémon in the mansion... I wonder if they succeeded.

items.en: They will only breed Pokémon based on your current Hatchery filters.
items.zh: 他们只会根据您当前的孵化场过滤器来培育神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: They will only breed Pokémon based on your current Hatchery filters.

items.en: They're all here! That took quite a while, but it was well worth it!
items.zh: 他们都在这里！这花了相当长的时间，但这是非常值得的！
items.normEn: They're all here! That took quite a while, but it was well worth it!

items.en: They're so loyal, and so fast! I give them letters to take to a friend in Galar in the morning, and I have a response back by supper!
items.zh: 他们是如此忠诚，而且速度如此之快！我早上给他们写信，让他们转交给伽勒尔的朋友，晚饭前就收到了回复！
items.normEn: They're so loyal, and so fast! I give them letters to take to a friend in Galar in the morning, and I have a response back by supper!

items.en: They're using Parasect to navigate the Eterna Forest. Clear out a Parasect and they should get trapped!
items.zh: 他们使用 Parasect 在永恒森林中导航。清除寄生虫，他们就会被困住！
items.normEn: They're using Parasect to navigate the Eterna Forest. Clear out a Parasect and they should get trapped!

items.en: This artifact belongs in a museum—or maybe just my backpack!
items.zh: 这件文物属于博物馆——或者也许只是我的背包！
items.normEn: This artifact belongs in a museum—or maybe just my backpack!

items.en: This Berry can be cored out and dried to make a whistle. Blowing through its hole makes an indescribable sound.
items.zh: 这种浆果可以去核并干燥以制成哨子。从它的孔中吹气会发出难以形容的声音。
items.normEn: This Berry can be cored out and dried to make a whistle. Blowing through its hole makes an indescribable sound.

items.en: This Berry can be eaten as is or boiled to obtain an extract that adds a dash of flavor to food.
items.zh: 这种浆果可以直接食用，也可以煮沸以获得提取物，为食物增添一丝风味。
items.normEn: This Berry can be eaten as is or boiled to obtain an extract that adds a dash of flavor to food.

items.en: This Berry causes other nearby Berries to wither away faster.
items.zh: 这种浆果会导致附近的其他浆果更快地枯萎。
items.normEn: This Berry causes other nearby Berries to wither away faster.

items.en: This Berry contains a substance that generates heat. It can even heat up a chilly heart.
items.zh: 这种浆果含有一种产生热量的物质。甚至可以温暖冰冷的心。
items.normEn: This Berry contains a substance that generates heat. It can even heat up a chilly heart.

items.en: This Berry drifted from a faraway sea. It is now cultivated in the Sinnoh region.
items.zh: 这颗浆果是从遥远的大海漂来的。现在神奥地区也有栽培。
items.normEn: This Berry drifted from a faraway sea. It is now cultivated in the Sinnoh region.

items.en: This Berry endemic to Pinkan Island has an incredibly sweet taste.
items.zh: 这种平坎岛特有的浆果具有令人难以置信的甜味。
items.normEn: This Berry endemic to Pinkan Island has an incredibly sweet taste.

items.en: This berry grows around the waist of certain Snover.
items.zh: 这种浆果生长在某些斯诺弗的腰部。
items.normEn: This berry grows around the waist of certain Snover.

items.en: This Berry has a disagreeable "green" flavor and scent typical of vegetables. It is rich in health-promoting fiber.
items.zh: 这种浆果具有令人不快的“绿色”风味和典型的蔬菜气味。它富含促进健康的纤维。
items.normEn: This Berry has a disagreeable "green" flavor and scent typical of vegetables. It is rich in health-promoting fiber.

items.en: This Berry has a refreshing flavor that strikes a good balance of dryness and sourness. It tastes better chilled.
items.zh: 这种浆果具有清爽的味道，在干燥和酸味之间取得了良好的平衡。冷藏后味道更好。
items.normEn: This Berry has a refreshing flavor that strikes a good balance of dryness and sourness. It tastes better chilled.

items.en: This Berry has a very dry flavor. It has the effect of making other food eaten at the same time taste sweet.
items.zh: 这种浆果有一种非常干的味道。它具有使同时吃的其他食物变甜的作用。
items.normEn: This Berry has a very dry flavor. It has the effect of making other food eaten at the same time taste sweet.

items.en: This Berry is a brilliant green on the outside. Inside, it is packed with a dry-flavored, black-colored flesh.
items.zh: 这种浆果的外表是亮绿色的。里面充满了干味、黑色的果肉。
items.normEn: This Berry is a brilliant green on the outside. Inside, it is packed with a dry-flavored, black-colored flesh.

items.en: This Berry is considered a mirage. It was said to be so strong that it had to be abandoned at the world's edge.
items.zh: 这种浆果被认为是海市蜃楼。据说它是如此强大以至于不得不被遗弃在世界的边缘。
items.normEn: This Berry is considered a mirage. It was said to be so strong that it had to be abandoned at the world's edge.

items.en: This Berry is large and spicy. When eaten during the cold season, it warms the body from inside.
items.zh: 这种浆果又大又辣。在寒冷的季节食用，可以从内部温暖身体。
items.normEn: This Berry is large and spicy. When eaten during the cold season, it warms the body from inside.

items.en: This Berry is oddly shaped, appearing as if someone took a bite out of it. It is packed full of spicy substances.
items.zh: 这颗浆果形状奇特，看起来就像是被人咬了一口一样。它充满了辛辣物质。
items.normEn: This Berry is oddly shaped, appearing as if someone took a bite out of it. It is packed full of spicy substances.

items.en: This Berry is quite sour overall, with the sourness especially concentrated at the pointed end.
items.zh: 这种浆果总体来说很酸，酸味特别集中在尖端。
items.normEn: This Berry is quite sour overall, with the sourness especially concentrated at the pointed end.

items.en: This Berry is said to be a new kind that is a cross of two Berries brought together by winds from far away.
items.zh: 据说这种浆果是一种新品种，是由远方的风吹来的两种浆果杂交而成的。
items.normEn: This Berry is said to be a new kind that is a cross of two Berries brought together by winds from far away.

items.en: This Berry is said to have grown plentiful in the tropics of the past. It boasts an intensely hot spiciness.
items.zh: 据说这种浆果过去在热带地区盛产。它具有强烈的辣味。
items.normEn: This Berry is said to have grown plentiful in the tropics of the past. It boasts an intensely hot spiciness.

items.en: This Berry is said to sense human emotions for the way it swells roundly when a person approaches.
items.zh: 据说这种浆果能感知人类的情绪，因为当有人靠近时，它会圆圆地膨胀。
items.normEn: This Berry is said to sense human emotions for the way it swells roundly when a person approaches.

items.en: This Berry is surrounded by mystery. It is rumored to be imbued with the power of all living things.
items.zh: 这个浆果充满了神秘感。据传它充满了所有生物的力量。
items.normEn: This Berry is surrounded by mystery. It is rumored to be imbued with the power of all living things.

items.en: This Berry is surrounded by mystery. It is rumored to be imbued with the power of the land.
items.zh: 这个浆果充满了神秘感。据传它充满了土地的力量。
items.normEn: This Berry is surrounded by mystery. It is rumored to be imbued with the power of the land.

items.en: This Berry is surrounded by mystery. It is rumored to be imbued with the power of the sea.
items.zh: 这个浆果充满了神秘感。据说它具有海洋的力量。
items.normEn: This Berry is surrounded by mystery. It is rumored to be imbued with the power of the sea.

items.en: This Berry is surrounded by mystery. It is rumored to be imbued with the power of the sky.
items.zh: 这个浆果充满了神秘感。传闻其拥有天空之力。
items.normEn: This Berry is surrounded by mystery. It is rumored to be imbued with the power of the sky.

items.en: This Berry is sweet with a hint of bitterness and has a lingering sweet scent. It is often dried and used to make tea.
items.zh: 这种浆果甜中带点苦味，有一种挥之不去的甜香味。通常将其干燥并用于泡茶。
items.normEn: This Berry is sweet with a hint of bitterness and has a lingering sweet scent. It is often dried and used to make tea.

items.en: This Berry is tremendously bitter. Just one bite is enough to instantly stop hiccups.
items.zh: 这种浆果非常苦。只需咬一口就足以立即停止打嗝。
items.normEn: This Berry is tremendously bitter. Just one bite is enough to instantly stop hiccups.

items.en: This Berry is very big and sour. The juiciness of the pulp accentuates the sourness.
items.zh: 这种浆果又大又酸。果肉的多汁加剧了酸味。
items.normEn: This Berry is very big and sour. The juiciness of the pulp accentuates the sourness.

items.en: This Berry is very tough with a strong flavor. It was used to make medicine by people in the past.
items.zh: 这种浆果非常坚韧，味道浓郁。过去人们用它来制药。
items.normEn: This Berry is very tough with a strong flavor. It was used to make medicine by people in the past.

items.en: This Berry multiplies the effect of Berry plants around it.
items.zh: 这种浆果会倍增周围浆果植物的效果。
items.normEn: This Berry multiplies the effect of Berry plants around it.

items.en: This Berry plant hardens the surrounding soil, decreasing the chances of replanting.
items.zh: 这种浆果植物使周围的土壤变硬，减少了重新种植的机会。
items.normEn: This Berry plant hardens the surrounding soil, decreasing the chances of replanting.

items.en: This Berry plant is very hardy and resistant, making it resistant to mutations, and also decreasing the chance of mutations around it.
items.zh: 这种浆果植物非常耐寒和抵抗力，使其能够抵抗突变，并减少周围发生突变的机会。
items.normEn: This Berry plant is very hardy and resistant, making it resistant to mutations, and also decreasing the chance of mutations around it.

items.en: This Berry progressively curves as it grows. The curvier the Berry, the sweeter and tastier.
items.zh: 这种浆果随着生长逐渐弯曲。浆果越弯曲，越甜、越美味。
items.normEn: This Berry progressively curves as it grows. The curvier the Berry, the sweeter and tastier.

items.en: This Berry promotes the fruiting of nearby Berry plants.
items.zh: 这种浆果可以促进附近浆果植物的结果。
items.normEn: This Berry promotes the fruiting of nearby Berry plants.

items.en: This Berry remains poisonous until fully ripened. Once ripe it has a spicy and sweet complex flavor.
items.zh: 这种浆果在完全成熟之前仍然有毒。成熟后，它具有辛辣和甜味的复杂风味。
items.normEn: This Berry remains poisonous until fully ripened. Once ripe it has a spicy and sweet complex flavor.

items.en: This Berry requires a lot of energy to grow, but isn't fussy about what it consumes, it helps other plants by removing toxins from the soil.
items.zh: 这种浆果需要大量能量才能生长，但它对消耗的能量并不挑剔，它可以通过清除土壤中的毒素来帮助其他植物。
items.normEn: This Berry requires a lot of energy to grow, but isn't fussy about what it consumes, it helps other plants by removing toxins from the soil.

items.en: This Berry resembles the Durin Berry, though its spikes are less pronounced. It is quite delicious when roasted.
items.zh: 这种浆果类似于杜林浆果，但其尖刺不太明显。烤的时候非常好吃。
items.normEn: This Berry resembles the Durin Berry, though its spikes are less pronounced. It is quite delicious when roasted.

items.en: This Berry slows the decay of nearby Berries.
items.zh: 这种浆果可以减缓附近浆果的腐烂速度。
items.normEn: This Berry slows the decay of nearby Berries.

items.en: This Berry turns bitter toward the stem. The dainty flower it grows from doesn't absorb much sunlight.
items.zh: 这种浆果接近茎时会变得苦涩。它生长的娇嫩花朵不吸收太多阳光。
items.normEn: This Berry turns bitter toward the stem. The dainty flower it grows from doesn't absorb much sunlight.

items.en: This Berry's flesh is dotted with countless tiny bubbles of air that keep it afloat in water.
items.zh: 这种浆果的果肉上点缀着无数微小的气泡，使其能够漂浮在水中。
items.normEn: This Berry's flesh is dotted with countless tiny bubbles of air that keep it afloat in water.

items.en: This Berry's gradual process of storing nutrients beneficial to Pokémon health causes it to mature slowly.
items.zh: 这种浆果逐渐储存对神奇宝贝健康有益的营养物质，导致其成熟缓慢。
items.normEn: This Berry's gradual process of storing nutrients beneficial to Pokémon health causes it to mature slowly.

items.en: This Berry's peel is hard, but the flesh inside is very juicy. It is distinguished by its bracing sourness.
items.zh: 这种浆果的果皮很硬，但里面的果肉非常多汁。它以其令人振奋的酸味而著称。
items.normEn: This Berry's peel is hard, but the flesh inside is very juicy. It is distinguished by its bracing sourness.

items.en: This Berry's thick skin and fruit are very tough and dry-tasting. However, every bit of it can be eaten.
items.zh: 这种浆果的皮很厚，果实很坚韧，味道很干。不过，每一点都可以吃。
items.normEn: This Berry's thick skin and fruit are very tough and dry-tasting. However, every bit of it can be eaten.

items.zh: 这种苦涩……却又清爽的感觉。

items.en: This bright red Berry is very spicy and has a provocative flavor. It blooms with delicate, pretty flowers.
items.zh: 这种鲜红色的浆果非常辛辣，具有刺激性的味道。它开出娇嫩、美丽的花朵。
items.normEn: This bright red Berry is very spicy and has a provocative flavor. It blooms with delicate, pretty flowers.

items.en: This calendar will keep you up to date on the latest events and let you start events early.
items.zh: 此日历将使您了解最新活动并让您尽早开始活动。
items.normEn: This calendar will keep you up to date on the latest events and let you start events early.

items.en: This can't be! The mighty Dakim loses again?
items.zh: 这不可能！强大的达基姆又输了？
items.normEn: This can't be! The mighty Dakim loses again?

items.en: This category is in use by the ${...} Pokéball filter${...} and cannot be removed.
items.zh: 此类别已被 ${...} Pokéball 过滤器${...} 使用，无法删除。
items.normEn: This category is in use by the ${...} Pokéball filter${...} and cannot be removed.

items.en: This challenge is activated by default.
items.zh: 默认情况下会激活此挑战。
items.normEn: This challenge is activated by default.

items.zh: 这可能会产生意想不到的后果

items.en: This discovery is essential to understanding underground ecosystems. I’ll keep it!
items.zh: 这一发现对于了解地下生态系统至关重要。我会保留它！
items.normEn: This discovery is essential to understanding underground ecosystems. I’ll keep it!

items.en: This glossy and colorful Berry has a mouthwateringly delicious appearance. However, it is awfully sour.
items.zh: 这种光泽多彩的浆果具有令人垂涎欲滴的美味外观。然而，它非常酸。
items.normEn: This glossy and colorful Berry has a mouthwateringly delicious appearance. However, it is awfully sour.

items.en: This has to be some kind of mistake. I demand a do-over!
items.zh: 这一定是某种错误。我要求重来！
items.normEn: This has to be some kind of mistake. I demand a do-over!

items.en: This inspires Pokémon to train harder.
items.zh: 这激励神奇宝贝更加努力地训练。
items.normEn: This inspires Pokémon to train harder.

items.en: This is a current priority, but there are no set timelines; it will be ready when it is ready.
items.zh: 这是当前的优先事项，但没有设定时间表；准备好了就准备好了。
items.normEn: This is a current priority, but there are no set timelines; it will be ready when it is ready.

items.en: This is a magical place where everybody loves Magikarp!
items.zh: 这是一个神奇的地方，每个人都喜欢鲤鱼王！
items.normEn: This is a magical place where everybody loves Magikarp!

items.en: This is a prime camping spot! Gem and mineral hunters come from all over the world to explore here!
items.zh: 这是一个主要的露营地！来自世界各地的宝石和矿物猎人来到这里探索！
items.normEn: This is a prime camping spot! Gem and mineral hunters come from all over the world to explore here!

items.en: This is a setting on browsers that slows down inactive windows.
items.zh: 这是浏览器上的一项设置，可以减慢非活动窗口的速度。
items.normEn: This is a setting on browsers that slows down inactive windows.

items.en: This is a tool for watering Berries to allow you to operate the farm.
items.zh: 这是一个给浆果浇水的工具，可以让你经营农场。
items.normEn: This is a tool for watering Berries to allow you to operate the farm.

items.en: This is a very, very mystifying Berry. There is no telling how it can be used, or what may happen if it is used.
items.zh: 这是一种非常非常神秘的浆果。目前还不清楚如何使用它，或者使用它会发生什么。
items.normEn: This is a very, very mystifying Berry. There is no telling how it can be used, or what may happen if it is used.

items.en: This is as rare as a Master Ball. We’re keeping it for our... crafting projects.
items.zh: 这和大师球一样罕见。我们将其保留用于我们的……制作项目。
items.normEn: This is as rare as a Master Ball. We’re keeping it for our... crafting projects.

items.en: This is embarrassing... I went and lost to a Trainer who didn't have a single Gym Badge... But that's tough. You were strong, and I was weak. That's all there is. According to Pokémon League rules, I have to give you our Gym Badge since you've beaten me, the Leader. Heres your official Pokémon League Coal Badge.
items.zh: 真是丢人啊……我竟然输给了一个连道馆徽章都没有的训练家……不过这也太难受了吧。你很坚强，而我却很弱小。仅此而已。根据神奇宝贝联盟的规则，既然你打败了我，队长，我就必须给你道馆徽章。这是您的官方神奇宝贝联盟煤炭徽章。
items.normEn: This is embarrassing... I went and lost to a Trainer who didn't have a single Gym Badge... But that's tough. You were strong, and I was weak. That's all there is. According to Pokémon League rules, I have to give you our Gym Badge since you've beaten me, the Leader. Heres your official Pokémon League Coal Badge.

items.en: This is Enamorus, a Pokémon hailed as the Herald of Spring. Enamorus is not particularly given to ill behaviour. But I imagine you'd like to document her for your Pokédex, wouldn't you?
items.zh: 这是被称为春天的使者的神奇宝贝“迷恋”。迷恋并不特别倾向于不良行为。但我想你想为你的图鉴记录她，不是吗？
items.normEn: This is Enamorus, a Pokémon hailed as the Herald of Spring. Enamorus is not particularly given to ill behaviour. But I imagine you'd like to document her for your Pokédex, wouldn't you?

items.en: This is from a region that hasn't been released yet.
items.zh: 这是来自尚未发布的地区。
items.normEn: This is from a region that hasn't been released yet.

items.en: This is it, you've beaten Lysandre at the top of his game in Team Flare Secret HQ, right? He might have something else to say...
items.zh: 就是这样，你已经在耀斑队秘密总部击败了处于巅峰状态的莱桑德尔，对吧？他或许还有别的话要说……
items.normEn: This is it, you've beaten Lysandre at the top of his game in Team Flare Secret HQ, right? He might have something else to say...

items.en: This is Marcia live on the scene! Chaos in Pyrite Town as Team Cipher has returned! Rumors are swirling about an infamous dance machine making a scene!
items.zh: 这是现场的玛西娅！密码队归来，黄铁矿镇一片混乱！关于臭名昭著的舞蹈机器大闹的谣言四起！
items.normEn: This is Marcia live on the scene! Chaos in Pyrite Town as Team Cipher has returned! Rumors are swirling about an infamous dance machine making a scene!

items.en: This is not a valid decoded savefile
items.zh: 这不是有效的解码保存文件
items.normEn: This is not a valid decoded savefile

items.en: This is not a valid savefile
items.zh: 这不是有效的保存文件
items.normEn: This is not a valid savefile

items.en: This is probably still under development.
items.normEn: This is probably still under development.

items.en: This is ridiculous. Talk to Baraz in Kiloude City.
items.zh: 这太荒谬了。与基卢德市的巴拉兹交谈。
items.normEn: This is ridiculous. Talk to Baraz in Kiloude City.

items.en: This is rubbish... My team can't perform if I can't get my own head straight as their Trainer...
items.zh: 这太垃圾了...如果我作为他们的教练不能理清思路，我的团队就无法表现...
items.normEn: This is rubbish... My team can't perform if I can't get my own head straight as their Trainer...

items.en: This is said to be a legendary Berry. Holding it supposedly brings great joy.
items.zh: 据说这是传说中的Berry。据说持有它会带来巨大的快乐。
items.normEn: This is said to be a legendary Berry. Holding it supposedly brings great joy.

items.en: This is sharp and shiny—just my style. It’s staying with me!
items.zh: 这是锐利而闪亮的——这就是我的风格。它留在我身边！
items.normEn: This is sharp and shiny—just my style. It’s staying with me!

items.en: This is the Coral-Eye Badge of the Mikan Gym, to prove that you won your match!
items.zh: 这是蜜柑道馆的珊瑚眼徽章，证明你赢得了比赛！
items.normEn: This is the Coral-Eye Badge of the Mikan Gym, to prove that you won your match!

items.en: This is the development version of the game, do not take your save from this version to the main game!
items.zh: 这是游戏的开发版本，请勿将此版本的保存带到主游戏中！
items.normEn: This is the development version of the game, do not take your save from this version to the main game!

items.en: This is the GS Ball. I found it here recently. Professor Oak seemed very interested. Please deliver it to him at your earliest convenience.
items.zh: 这是 GS 球。我最近在这里找到了它。奥克教授似乎很感兴趣。请在您方便的时候尽早将其交给他。
items.normEn: This is the GS Ball. I found it here recently. Professor Oak seemed very interested. Please deliver it to him at your earliest convenience.

items.en: This is the one I'm most excited to meet. Please come back once you catch it, I will have tea prepared for you.
items.zh: 这是我最高兴见到的人。抓到后请回来，我去给你准备茶。
items.normEn: This is the one I'm most excited to meet. Please come back once you catch it, I will have tea prepared for you.

items.en: This is tiring work, but I have a feeling that we're almost done.
items.zh: 这是一项很累人的工作，但我有一种感觉，我们快完成了。
items.normEn: This is tiring work, but I have a feeling that we're almost done.

items.en: This is too beautiful to part with. It’s coming with me.
items.zh: 这实在是太美丽了，难以割舍。它和我一起来。
items.normEn: This is too beautiful to part with. It’s coming with me.

items.en: This is truly an astounding feat! Congratulations on completing the Pokédex!
items.zh: 这实在是一件令人震惊的壮举！恭喜您完成图鉴！
items.normEn: This is truly an astounding feat! Congratulations on completing the Pokédex!

items.en: This is where your journey begins.
items.zh: 这就是您的旅程开始的地方。
items.normEn: This is where your journey begins.

items.en: This island only has one trial: Captain Ilima's trial in Verdant Cavern, below the Melemele Woods. Come back here after clearing that challenge for your Grand trial battle.
items.zh: 这个岛上只有一项审判：伊利马船长在梅勒梅勒森林下方的翠绿洞穴中进行的审判。完成大试炼战斗的挑战后，请回到这里。
items.normEn: This island only has one trial: Captain Ilima's trial in Verdant Cavern, below the Melemele Woods. Come back here after clearing that challenge for your Grand trial battle.

items.en: This isn't over yet. Stronger Pokémon are being made even now. You'd better get serious about training your Pokémon for our next meeting. Daahahah!
items.zh: 这还没有结束。现在仍在制作更强的神奇宝贝。为了我们下次的会议，你最好认真训练你的神奇宝贝。达哈哈哈！
items.normEn: This isn't over yet. Stronger Pokémon are being made even now. You'd better get serious about training your Pokémon for our next meeting. Daahahah!

items.en: This item is from a region that hasn't been released yet.
items.zh: 该商品来自尚未发布的地区。
items.normEn: This item is from a region that hasn't been released yet.

items.en: This life is not for me... I will become a Karpenter now...
items.zh: 这种生活不适合我……我现在要成为一名卡彭特……
items.normEn: This life is not for me... I will become a Karpenter now...

items.en: This loss shocks me! But a loss is a loss. I admit I didn't work hard enough to win. You earned the MarshBadge.
items.zh: 这个损失让我震惊！但损失就是损失。我承认我没有努力去赢得胜利。您赢得了 MarshBadge。
items.normEn: This loss shocks me! But a loss is a loss. I admit I didn't work hard enough to win. You earned the MarshBadge.

items.en: This might sound cheesy, but I love Milcery so much! I wasn't sure which Alcremie form I liked the most, so I just grabbed a Sweet at random and started to spin and spin for what seemed like an hour.
items.zh: 这可能听起来很俗气，但我非常喜欢 Milcery！我不确定我最喜欢哪种 Alcremie 形式，所以我只是随意抓起一个 Sweet，然后开始旋转，旋转了大约一个小时。
items.normEn: This might sound cheesy, but I love Milcery so much! I wasn't sure which Alcremie form I liked the most, so I just grabbed a Sweet at random and started to spin and spin for what seemed like an hour.

items.en: This new technology only allows up to four stored eggs for now, though.
items.zh: 不过，这项新技术目前最多只能储存四个鸡蛋。
items.normEn: This new technology only allows up to four stored eggs for now, though.

items.en: This place is a lot like the Kanto Safari Zone, except we get a much wider variety of Pokémon coming through here.
items.zh: 这个地方很像关东野生动物区，只不过这里有更多种类的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: This place is a lot like the Kanto Safari Zone, except we get a much wider variety of Pokémon coming through here.

items.en: This Pokémon cannot increase their power any higher!
items.zh: 该神奇宝贝的力量无法再提升！
items.normEn: This Pokémon cannot increase their power any higher!

items.en: This Pokémon doesn't have any ${...} to remove!
items.zh: 该神奇宝贝没有任何可移除的 ${...}！
items.normEn: This Pokémon doesn't have any ${...} to remove!

items.en: This Pokémon should not be obtainable.
items.zh: 该神奇宝贝应该无法获得。
items.normEn: This Pokémon should not be obtainable.

items.en: This power revitalizes and prevents other berries from withering.
items.zh: 这种力量可以使其他浆果恢复活力并防止枯萎。
items.normEn: This power revitalizes and prevents other berries from withering.

items.en: This quest line cannot be paused. It is either a story, progression related, or otherwise required quest.
items.zh: 该任务线无法暂停。它要么是一个故事，要么是与进程相关的，要么是其他必需的任务。
items.normEn: This quest line cannot be paused. It is either a story, progression related, or otherwise required quest.

items.en: This Should Be Enough for Those Elusive Roamers...
items.zh: 这对于那些难以捉摸的漫游者来说应该足够了......
items.normEn: This Should Be Enough for Those Elusive Roamers...

items.en: This somewhat-rare Berry projects an image of luxury, so it is favored as a gift item.
items.zh: 这种较为稀有的浆果给人一种奢华的印象，因此很受青睐作为礼品。
items.normEn: This somewhat-rare Berry projects an image of luxury, so it is favored as a gift item.

items.en: This speaks to me. Its place is with me now.
items.zh: 这对我来说。现在它的位置就在我身边。
items.normEn: This speaks to me. Its place is with me now.

items.en: This stone has the power to cleanse and purify the spirits of Pokémon.
items.zh: 这块石头具有净化神奇宝贝灵魂的力量。
items.normEn: This stone has the power to cleanse and purify the spirits of Pokémon.

items.en: This tab is useful for making sure what your filters match, and which ones take precedence. See the Help tab for more details.
items.zh: 此选项卡可用于确保您的过滤器匹配哪些过滤器以及哪些过滤器优先。请参阅“帮助”选项卡了解更多详细信息。
items.normEn: This tab is useful for making sure what your filters match, and which ones take precedence. See the Help tab for more details.

items.en: This tab will allow you to see exactly which will be chosen, for some scenario you configure with the settings in the tab.
items.zh: 对于使用选项卡中的设置配置的某些场景，此选项卡将允许您准确查看将选择哪些选项。
items.normEn: This tab will allow you to see exactly which will be chosen, for some scenario you configure with the settings in the tab.

items.en: This thing is the best hope we have of saving this planet and everything on it. But you know... It could also be the worst tragedy imaginable for some other world and everything on it.
items.zh: 这是我们拯救这个星球及其上的一切的最大希望。但你知道……这也可能是其他世界及其上的一切所能想象到的最严重的悲剧。
items.normEn: This thing is the best hope we have of saving this planet and everything on it. But you know... It could also be the worst tragedy imaginable for some other world and everything on it.

items.en: This ticket grants access to the Safari Zone right outside Fuchsia City.
items.zh: 持此门票可进入紫红色城外的野生动物区。
items.normEn: This ticket grants access to the Safari Zone right outside Fuchsia City.

items.en: This town is pretty quiet. Most folks here are retired trainers.
items.zh: 这个小镇相当安静。这里的大多数人都是退休教练。
items.normEn: This town is pretty quiet. Most folks here are retired trainers.

items.en: This treasure’s as valuable as diamonds. We’ll hold onto it for now.
items.zh: 这件宝物的价值堪比钻石。我们暂时保留它。
items.normEn: This treasure’s as valuable as diamonds. We’ll hold onto it for now.

items.en: This whole Adven-tour thing was built out of a load of rubbish I scraped together. Even I had my doubts about the whole thing. But you? You went at it with a ton of energy! Thanks for stickin' around and finishin' every part of my Adven-tour!
items.zh: 整个降临节之旅都是我用一堆垃圾搭建起来的。就连我自己也对整件事产生了怀疑。但你呢？你用了巨大的精力去完成它！感谢您坚持并完成我的降临之旅的每一部分！
items.normEn: This whole Adven-tour thing was built out of a load of rubbish I scraped together. Even I had my doubts about the whole thing. But you? You went at it with a ton of energy! Thanks for stickin' around and finishin' every part of my Adven-tour!

items.en: This will throw a Poké Ball and give you a chance of capturing the Pokémon. Provides 10 Safari XP.
items.zh: 这将抛出一个神奇宝贝球，让您有机会捕获神奇宝贝。提供 10 Safari XP。
items.normEn: This will throw a Poké Ball and give you a chance of capturing the Pokémon. Provides 10 Safari XP.

items.en: This world is inhabited by creatures called Pokémon!
items.zh: 这个世界居住着一种叫做神奇宝贝的生物！
items.normEn: This world is inhabited by creatures called Pokémon!

items.en: This young fellow comes here every day.
items.zh: 这个年轻人每天都来这里。
items.normEn: This young fellow comes here every day.

items.en: Those masked trainers went and kidnapped my beloved Plusle! How dare they!
items.zh: 那些蒙面训练家竟然绑架了我心爱的Plusle！他们怎么敢！
items.normEn: Those masked trainers went and kidnapped my beloved Plusle! How dare they!

items.en: Those Pokémon would be better off in the hands of a radical trainer who knows how to use Catch Filters, like me!
items.zh: 这些神奇宝贝在像我这样知道如何使用捕捉过滤器的激进训练师手中会更好！
items.normEn: Those Pokémon would be better off in the hands of a radical trainer who knows how to use Catch Filters, like me!

items.en: Those poor Slowpoke! I'm not doing anything until those disgusting Rockets are gone!
items.zh: 那些可怜的呆呆子！在那些恶心的火箭队消失之前我不会做任何事！
items.normEn: Those poor Slowpoke! I'm not doing anything until those disgusting Rockets are gone!

items.en: Though lately, I've been hearing roars near the waterfalls, but I'm too scared to see for myself what kind of monster is making those sounds.
items.zh: 虽然最近我在瀑布附近听到了咆哮声，但我太害怕了，不敢亲眼看看是什么样的怪物在发出这些声音。
items.normEn: Though lately, I've been hearing roars near the waterfalls, but I'm too scared to see for myself what kind of monster is making those sounds.

items.en: Though this small, delicately-skinned Berry is blue in color, it dyes the mouth black when eaten.
items.zh: 虽然这种果皮娇嫩的小浆果呈蓝色，但食用后却会将口腔染成黑色。
items.normEn: Though this small, delicately-skinned Berry is blue in color, it dyes the mouth black when eaten.

items.en: Throw 1,000 Bait in a Safari Zone
items.zh: 在野生动物区扔 1,000 个诱饵
items.normEn: Throw 1,000 Bait in a Safari Zone

items.en: Throw 1,000 Rocks in a Safari Zone
items.zh: 在野生动物区扔 1,000 块石头
items.normEn: Throw 1,000 Rocks in a Safari Zone

items.en: Throw 10 Bait in a Safari Zone
items.zh: 在野生动物区扔 10 个诱饵
items.normEn: Throw 10 Bait in a Safari Zone

items.en: Throw 10 Rocks in a Safari Zone
items.zh: 在野生动物区扔 10 块石头
items.normEn: Throw 10 Rocks in a Safari Zone

items.en: Throw 100 Bait in a Safari Zone
items.zh: 在野生动物区扔 100 个诱饵
items.normEn: Throw 100 Bait in a Safari Zone

items.en: Throw 100 Rocks in a Safari Zone
items.zh: 在野生动物区扔 100 块石头
items.normEn: Throw 100 Rocks in a Safari Zone

items.en: Throwing a Rock will make the Pokémon angry, and more likely to flee, but easier to catch. Provides 10 Safari XP.
items.zh: 扔石头会让神奇宝贝生气，更有可能逃跑，但更容易被抓住。提供 10 Safari XP。
items.normEn: Throwing a Rock will make the Pokémon angry, and more likely to flee, but easier to catch. Provides 10 Safari XP.

items.en: Throwing any kind of Bait will make the Pokémon eat, and less likely to flee, but harder to catch. Berry Baits change the base rates of the Pokémon, with Razz lowering flee rate, and Nanab increasing catch rate. Only one Berry effect can be present at a time. Provides 5 Safari XP.
items.zh: 投掷任何种类的诱饵都会让神奇宝贝吃东西，并且不太可能逃跑，但更难捕捉。浆果诱饵改变了神奇宝贝的基本比率，拉兹降低了逃跑率，纳纳布提高了捕获率。一次只能出现一种浆果效果。提供 5 Safari XP。
items.normEn: Throwing any kind of Bait will make the Pokémon eat, and less likely to flee, but harder to catch. Berry Baits change the base rates of the Pokémon, with Razz lowering flee rate, and Nanab increasing catch rate. Only one Berry effect can be present at a time. Provides 5 Safari XP.

items.en: Tidy up Key items, Evolution stones selector
items.zh: 整理关键物品，进化石选择器
items.normEn: Tidy up Key items, Evolution stones selector

items.en: Time to give those mysterious boulders the soaking of their life! Return to the Eterna Forest, and prepare for a battle.
items.zh: 是时候让那些神秘的巨石浸透生命了！返回永恒森林，准备战斗。
items.normEn: Time to give those mysterious boulders the soaking of their life! Return to the Eterna Forest, and prepare for a battle.

items.en: Time to head back to Pal Park and teach this little pink snot not to steal important eggs!
items.zh: 是时候回到帕尔公园并教导这个粉红色的小鼻涕虫不要偷重要的鸡蛋了！
items.normEn: Time to head back to Pal Park and teach this little pink snot not to steal important eggs!

items.en: Time to kick off your Alolan vacation! See the sights around Melemele Island.
items.zh: 是时候开始你的阿罗拉假期了！参观梅莱梅莱岛周围的景点。
items.normEn: Time to kick off your Alolan vacation! See the sights around Melemele Island.

items.en: Timer now starts in Dungeons once you have moved
items.zh: 一旦你移动，地下城的计时器就会开始计时
items.normEn: Timer now starts in Dungeons once you have moved

items.en: Tiny hooks grow on the surface of this Berry. It latches on to Pokémon so it can be carried to far-off places.
items.zh: 这种浆果的表面长有微小的钩子。它会附着在神奇宝贝身上，因此可以被带到很远的地方。
items.normEn: Tiny hooks grow on the surface of this Berry. It latches on to Pokémon so it can be carried to far-off places.

items.en: to be able to move to the next region. Any form of the Pokémon is valid even if it isn't the base form.
items.zh: 以便能够移动到下一个区域。任何形态的神奇宝贝都是有效的，即使它不是基本形态。
items.normEn: to be able to move to the next region. Any form of the Pokémon is valid even if it isn't the base form.

items.en: To be honest, I would like to keep this information to myself. But I want to be an honest Trainer in front of Suicune! That's why I am sharing a clue with you.
items.zh: 老实说，我想把这些信息保密。但我想在水君面前做一个诚实的训练家！这就是为什么我要与你分享一条线索。
items.normEn: To be honest, I would like to keep this information to myself. But I want to be an honest Trainer in front of Suicune! That's why I am sharing a clue with you.

items.en: To earn my trust, you need to prove your patience to me. If you can gather 5,000 Grass Gems and bring them to me, then I'll trust your word. If you cannot handle such a task, do not return.
items.zh: 为了赢得我的信任，你需要向我证明你的耐心。如果你能收集到五千颗草晶并带给我，我就相信你的话。如果您无法处理此类任务，请不要返回。
items.normEn: To earn my trust, you need to prove your patience to me. If you can gather 5,000 Grass Gems and bring them to me, then I'll trust your word. If you cannot handle such a task, do not return.

items.en: to grow more berries and earn farm points.
items.zh: 种植更多浆果并赚取农场积分。
items.normEn: to grow more berries and earn farm points.

items.en: To help you on your journey, I will give you these
items.zh: 为了帮助你的旅程，我会给你这些
items.normEn: To help you on your journey, I will give you these

items.en: To help you out, I've added an "Ultra Beast" option to the Encounter Type Pokéball filter setting. You can use this to set up a filter just for Ultra Beasts. Don't forget to enable it and assign Beast Balls!
items.zh: 为了帮助您，我在遭遇类型精灵球过滤器设置中添加了“终极野兽”选项。您可以使用它来设置专门针对 Ultra Beasts 的过滤器。不要忘记启用它并分配野兽球！
items.normEn: To help you out, I've added an "Ultra Beast" option to the Encounter Type Pokéball filter setting. You can use this to set up a filter just for Ultra Beasts. Don't forget to enable it and assign Beast Balls!

items.en: to make the game harder or more complex by modifying mechanics.
items.zh: 通过修改机制使游戏变得更难或更复杂。
items.normEn: to make the game harder or more complex by modifying mechanics.

items.en: To Mega Evolve your Lucario, you need an even stronger bond!
items.zh: 要超级进化你的路卡利欧，你需要更牢固的联系！
items.normEn: To Mega Evolve your Lucario, you need an even stronger bond!

items.en: To rebuild my machine, I will need a hundred power-generating Pokémon to run the machine, shiny pokemon to stabilize the energy matrix, and to conduct a new dig for fossilized Groudon materials. After that, I will need to calibrate the machine using DNA from Groudon itself.
items.zh: 为了重建我的机器，我需要一百只发电神奇宝贝来运行机器，闪亮的神奇宝贝来稳定能量矩阵，并进行新的化石固拉多材料的挖掘。之后，我需要使用固拉多本身的 DNA 来校准机器。
items.normEn: To rebuild my machine, I will need a hundred power-generating Pokémon to run the machine, shiny pokemon to stabilize the energy matrix, and to conduct a new dig for fossilized Groudon materials. After that, I will need to calibrate the machine using DNA from Groudon itself.

items.en: to remove these. The darker options below that are not checked. You can click their
items.zh: 删除这些。下面较暗的选项未选中。你可以点击他们的
items.normEn: to remove these. The darker options below that are not checked. You can click their

items.en: To suddenly start creating heroes left and right... It's complete rubbish!
items.zh: 突然开始左右创造英雄……完全是垃圾！
items.normEn: To suddenly start creating heroes left and right... It's complete rubbish!

items.en: Too bad there are only two new fossils in the Sinnoh region. If there was one more, maybe he could be a Gym Leader too!
items.zh: 遗憾的是，神奥地区只有两块新化石。如果再有一个，说不定他也能成为道馆馆长呢！
items.normEn: Too bad there are only two new fossils in the Sinnoh region. If there was one more, maybe he could be a Gym Leader too!

items.en: Tooltips no longer overstay their welcome on the Farm
items.zh: 工具提示在农场中不再受欢迎
items.normEn: Tooltips no longer overstay their welcome on the Farm

items.en: Tornadus, Thundurus and Landorus have been sighted in the Alabaster Icelands, Cobalt Coastlands and Obsidian Fieldland respectively. Pursue and capture them.
items.zh: 龙卷风、雷霆龙和陆地龙分别在雪花石膏冰岛、钴海岸和黑曜石田地被发现。追击并捕获他们。
items.normEn: Tornadus, Thundurus and Landorus have been sighted in the Alabaster Icelands, Cobalt Coastlands and Obsidian Fieldland respectively. Pursue and capture them.

items.en: Total shiny Pokémon caught no longer adds to your click attack
items.zh: 捕获的闪亮神奇宝贝总数不再增加您的点击攻击
items.normEn: Total shiny Pokémon caught no longer adds to your click attack

items.en: Total shiny Pokémon caught now add to your total click attack
items.zh: 现在捕获的闪亮神奇宝贝总数会添加到您的总点击攻击中
items.normEn: Total shiny Pokémon caught now add to your total click attack

items.en: Totem Marowak can now drop Thick Club
items.zh: 图腾马洛瓦克现在可以掉落粗棒
items.normEn: Totem Marowak can now drop Thick Club

items.en: Town images breaking if they contained a ' character
items.zh: 如果城镇图像包含 ' 字符，它们就会被破坏
items.normEn: Town images breaking if they contained a ' character

items.en: Town Map will now be fully hidden when it is supposed to be
items.zh: 城镇地图现在将在应该隐藏的时候完全隐藏
items.normEn: Town Map will now be fully hidden when it is supposed to be

items.en: Town to be sent to after snorlax and sudowoodo battles
items.zh: 打完snorlax和sudowoodo战斗后将被送往的城镇
items.normEn: Town to be sent to after snorlax and sudowoodo battles

items.en: Towns will show as orange if you have not yet completed the gym
items.zh: 如果您尚未完成健身房，城镇将显示为橙色
items.normEn: Towns will show as orange if you have not yet completed the gym

items.en: Track down the elusive Eon Duo.
items.zh: 追踪难以捉摸的 Eon Duo。
items.normEn: Track down the elusive Eon Duo.

items.en: Track down the mysterious Ultra Beasts
items.normEn: Track down the mysterious Ultra Beasts

items.en: Track down the new boss of the Cipher Lab.
items.zh: 追踪密码实验室的新老板。
items.normEn: Track down the new boss of the Cipher Lab.

items.en: Track down the new boss of the Phenac Stadium.
items.zh: 追踪菲纳克体育场的新老板。
items.normEn: Track down the new boss of the Phenac Stadium.

items.en: Track down the new boss of the Pyrite Building.
items.zh: 追踪黄铁矿大厦的新老板。
items.normEn: Track down the new boss of the Pyrite Building.

items.en: Track down the TV broadcast coming from The Under in Pyrite Town. Clear The Under.
items.zh: 追踪来自黄铁矿镇地下的电视广播。清除下方。
items.normEn: Track down the TV broadcast coming from The Under in Pyrite Town. Clear The Under.

items.en: Trade stone is now Linking cord
items.normEn: Trade stone is now Linking cord

items.en: Trades can only be made within the same category of treasures.
items.zh: 交易只能在同一类别的宝物内进行。
items.normEn: Trades can only be made within the same category of treasures.

items.en: Trading allows you to exchange treasures within the same category. Here’s how it works:
items.zh: 交易可以让您交换同一类别的宝藏。它的工作原理如下：
items.normEn: Trading allows you to exchange treasures within the same category. Here’s how it works:

items.en: Trading always follows a 3 to 1 ratio (e.g., trade 3 treasures to receive 1 new treasure).
items.zh: 交易始终遵循 3 比 1 的比例（例如，交易 3 个宝藏即可获得 1 个新宝藏）。
items.normEn: Trading always follows a 3 to 1 ratio (e.g., trade 3 treasures to receive 1 new treasure).

items.en: Train Kubfu by defeating Dark and Water-type Pokémon.
items.zh: 通过击败暗系和水系神奇宝贝来训练库布夫。
items.normEn: Train Kubfu by defeating Dark and Water-type Pokémon.

items.en: Train Kubfu more by catching or hatching Dark and Water-type Pokémon.
items.zh: 通过捕捉或孵化暗系和水系神奇宝贝来更多地训练库布夫。
items.normEn: Train Kubfu more by catching or hatching Dark and Water-type Pokémon.

items.zh: 关东地下城添加训练师

items.en: Trainers and Background will now show a list of images when changing them on your profile
items.zh: 现在，在您的个人资料上更改图像时，培训师和背景将显示图像列表
items.normEn: Trainers and Background will now show a list of images when changing them on your profile

items.en: Trainers report on sightings of various Genesect holding the same Drives as the Genesect they own.
items.zh: 训练师报告称，目击到不同的盖诺赛克特持有与他们所拥有的盖诺赛克特相同的驱动器。
items.normEn: Trainers report on sightings of various Genesect holding the same Drives as the Genesect they own.
