items.en: Travel to Orre and explore the Outskirt Stand.
items.zh: 前往奥尔并探索郊区看台。
items.normEn: Travel to Orre and explore the Outskirt Stand.

items.en: Travel with Zinnia to Littleroot Town and talk to May.
items.zh: 与百日草一起前往利特尔鲁特镇并与梅交谈。
items.normEn: Travel with Zinnia to Littleroot Town and talk to May.

items.en: Traveling around Alola with you, learning all the things you knew... And seeing Nebby evolve into Lunala under that brilliant moon... I'll never forget those precious memories, $playername$!
items.zh: 和你一起环游阿罗拉，学习你所知道的一切...并看到纳比在灿烂的月亮下进化成露娜拉...我永远不会忘记那些珍贵的回忆，$playername$！
items.normEn: Traveling around Alola with you, learning all the things you knew... And seeing Nebby evolve into Lunala under that brilliant moon... I'll never forget those precious memories, $playername$!

items.en: Traveling around Alola with you, learning all the things you knew... And seeing Nebby evolve into Solgaleo under that radiant sun... I'll never forget those precious memories, $playername$!
items.zh: 和你一起环游阿罗拉，学习你所知道的一切...并看到纳比在灿烂的阳光下进化成索尔迦雷...我永远不会忘记那些珍贵的回忆，$playername$！
items.normEn: Traveling around Alola with you, learning all the things you knew... And seeing Nebby evolve into Solgaleo under that radiant sun... I'll never forget those precious memories, $playername$!

items.en: Traveling on your own can be scary. But remember that there are nice people everywhere you go. So strike up a conversation! You will probably learn something useful.
items.zh: 独自旅行可能会很可怕。但请记住，无论你走到哪里，都有好人。所以开始对话吧！您可能会学到一些有用的东西。
items.normEn: Traveling on your own can be scary. But remember that there are nice people everywhere you go. So strike up a conversation! You will probably learn something useful.

items.en: Travelling to the next Region now requires all of that regions Pokémon (excluding different forms)
items.zh: 现在前往下一个区域需要所有该区域的神奇宝贝（不包括不同形式）
items.normEn: Travelling to the next Region now requires all of that regions Pokémon (excluding different forms)

items.en: Treasure Scanner notifications not respecting the underground item found notification setting
items.zh: 宝藏扫描仪通知不尊重地下物品发现通知设置
items.normEn: Treasure Scanner notifications not respecting the underground item found notification setting

items.en: Trial Site of Ten Carat Hill
items.normEn: Trial Site of Ten Carat Hill

items.en: Trial Site of Vast Poni Canyon
items.zh: 广阔的波尼峡谷试验场
items.normEn: Trial Site of Vast Poni Canyon

items.en: Tried to add ${...} to the hatchery while already being bred!
items.zh: 尝试在已经孵化的情况下将 ${...} 添加到孵化场！
items.normEn: Tried to add ${...} to the hatchery while already being bred!

items.en: Triggers a discharge which will clear tiles in a certain pattern, new patterns become available by levelling up Cell Battery
items.zh: 触发放电，这将清除特定图案中的瓷砖，通过升级电池可以使用新图案
items.normEn: Triggers a discharge which will clear tiles in a certain pattern, new patterns become available by levelling up Cell Battery

items.zh: 修剪图鉴中的搜索文本

items.en: Troops, move out! On to Phenac!
items.normEn: Troops, move out! On to Phenac!

items.en: Try to stop the ultimate weapon if you must. Saving everything... The world is suffering because of this absurd dream...
items.zh: 如果必须的话，尝试阻止终极武器。拯救一切……世界因为这个荒唐的梦想而受苦……
items.normEn: Try to stop the ultimate weapon if you must. Saving everything... The world is suffering because of this absurd dream...

items.en: Turning tail and running? From this puny HUMAN? Pathetic! I was the one to feed you the power you needed so that you could take on Arceus! I was the one who gave you the chance to claw open that space-time rift, driving the deity of space and time mad so that you could drag the creator out from hiding!
items.zh: 扭着尾巴就跑？来自这个微不足道的人类？可怜的！我是那个为你提供所需力量的人，以便你能够对抗阿尔宙斯！是我给了你机会，撬开那条时空裂痕，让时空之神发疯，让你把造物主从隐藏的地方拖出来！
items.normEn: Turning tail and running? From this puny HUMAN? Pathetic! I was the one to feed you the power you needed so that you could take on Arceus! I was the one who gave you the chance to claw open that space-time rift, driving the deity of space and time mad so that you could drag the creator out from hiding!

items.en: Tutorial quest buy Pokéballs amount reduced
items.zh: 教程任务购买精灵球数量减少
items.normEn: Tutorial quest buy Pokéballs amount reduced

items.en: Twenty Thousands Karps Under the Seas
items.normEn: Twenty Thousands Karps Under the Seas

items.en: Two kinds of Vivillon are roaming Kalos and later regions, and ones you've previously caught have returned. Check the Photobook in Santalune City for hints!
items.zh: 有两种 Vivillon 正在卡洛斯和后来的地区漫游，而你之前捕获的那些已经回来了。请查看桑塔鲁恩市的写真集以获取提示！
items.normEn: Two kinds of Vivillon are roaming Kalos and later regions, and ones you've previously caught have returned. Check the Photobook in Santalune City for hints!

items.en: Two Team Rocket Grunts are blocking the entrance to Ruby Path. Defeat them.
items.zh: 两名火箭队士兵正在封锁红宝石之路的入口。打败他们。
items.normEn: Two Team Rocket Grunts are blocking the entrance to Ruby Path. Defeat them.

items.en: Two young heroes... The sword and shield were actually Pokémon... But why would the truth of these ruins be hidden when their stories were depicted in artwork?
items.zh: 两个年轻的英雄……剑和盾实际上是神奇宝贝……但为什么当他们的故事被描绘成艺术品时，这些废墟的真相会被隐藏？
items.normEn: Two young heroes... The sword and shield were actually Pokémon... But why would the truth of these ruins be hidden when their stories were depicted in artwork?

items.en: Types displayed in Pokémon statistics modal
items.zh: 神奇宝贝统计模式中显示的类型
items.normEn: Types displayed in Pokémon statistics modal

items.en: Ula'ula Island people have seen Captain Acerola inside the Thrifty Megamart with a Mimikyu carrying a disk-shaped item, which I suspect is a Silvally Memory.
items.zh: 乌拉乌拉岛的人们在 Thrifty Megamart 里看到了 Acerola 船长和一个 Mimikyu，手里拿着一个圆盘状的物品，我怀疑这是 Silvally Memory。
items.normEn: Ula'ula Island people have seen Captain Acerola inside the Thrifty Megamart with a Mimikyu carrying a disk-shaped item, which I suspect is a Silvally Memory.

items.en: Urgh... You were too strong... ... Th-that's Giovanni's Badge! So it's true? Team Rocket really has disbanded? ...We will abandon this warehouse. But don't think this is over. I won't let this be the end. I will find Giovanni. And I will resurrect Team Rocket! I will... Until then, farewell!

items.en: Waaait... What's this, now? Are you givin' me attitude? Pityin' me, are you?! Gosh, you're such a pain in the neck... You just show up outta nowhere, and just happen to be young and talented... If you're looking to get in my way, well, I think some vile poisons will take care of that!
items.zh: 哇……现在这是什么？你在给我态度吗？你可怜我吧？天哪，你真是让人头疼……你只是凭空出现，而且碰巧又年轻又才华横溢……如果你想妨碍我，好吧，我想一些邪恶的毒药就能解决这个问题！
items.normEn: Waaait... What's this, now? Are you givin' me attitude? Pityin' me, are you?! Gosh, you're such a pain in the neck... You just show up outta nowhere, and just happen to be young and talented... If you're looking to get in my way, well, I think some vile poisons will take care of that!

items.en: Wahahahah! Fine, I lost! You ended up giving me a thrill! Take this Badge!
items.zh: 哇哈哈哈！好吧，我输了！你最终给了我一个惊喜！拿着这个徽章！
items.normEn: Wahahahah! Fine, I lost! You ended up giving me a thrill! Take this Badge!

items.en: Wailmer pail unlocks at 3 Cheri berries instead of 5
items.zh: Wailmer 桶需要 3 个 Cheri 浆果解锁，而不是 5 个
items.normEn: Wailmer pail unlocks at 3 Cheri berries instead of 5

items.en: Wait just one moment! *pant*... *pant*... Hah! Just as I expected! Multiple Max Mushrooms growing in a bunch! My psychic powers picked up on these Max Mushrooms eons before you found them. I believe I should be the first one to get those Max Mushrooms. First come, first served, and all!
items.zh: 请稍等一下！ *喘气*... *喘气*... 哈！正如我所料！多个最大蘑菇生长在一堆！在你发现这些麦克斯蘑菇之前的亿万年里，我的心灵力量就已经被吸收了。我相信我应该是第一个获得那些最大蘑菇的人。先到先得，还有！
items.normEn: Wait just one moment! *pant*... *pant*... Hah! Just as I expected! Multiple Max Mushrooms growing in a bunch! My psychic powers picked up on these Max Mushrooms eons before you found them. I believe I should be the first one to get those Max Mushrooms. First come, first served, and all!

items.en: Wait- what is this darkness in the sky? Oh my goodness! $playername$! In the sky! Another Ultra Wormhole!
items.zh: 等等——天空中的黑暗是什么？哦，我的天啊！ $玩家名$！在天空中！又一个超虫洞！
items.normEn: Wait- what is this darkness in the sky? Oh my goodness! $playername$! In the sky! Another Ultra Wormhole!

items.en: Wait--so you really caught Regigigas from the legends? Well, that doesn't seem to have opened the ruins automatically or anythin', but I imagine Regigigas can open those doors with sheer strength!
items.zh: 等等——这么说你真的从传说中抓到了雷吉加斯？嗯，这似乎并没有自动打开废墟之类的东西，但我想雷吉加斯可以用绝对的力量打开那些门！
items.normEn: Wait--so you really caught Regigigas from the legends? Well, that doesn't seem to have opened the ruins automatically or anythin', but I imagine Regigigas can open those doors with sheer strength!

items.en: Wait--you really caught Articuno, Moltres, and Zapdos from the legends?! Thats's ultra-mega-brilliant! Report away!
items.zh: 等等——你真的抓住了传说中的 Articuno、Moltres 和 Zapdos？！那真是超级辉煌！报告走开！
items.normEn: Wait--you really caught Articuno, Moltres, and Zapdos from the legends?! Thats's ultra-mega-brilliant! Report away!

items.en: Wait--you really caught Calyrex from the legends?! Thats's ultra-mega-brilliant! Report away!
items.zh: 等等——你真的抓住了传说中的Calyrex？！那真是超级辉煌！报告走开！
items.normEn: Wait--you really caught Calyrex from the legends?! Thats's ultra-mega-brilliant! Report away!

items.en: Wait, is that the key to the Distortion World? With that, I could open the gate myself.
items.zh: 等等，这就是扭曲世界的钥匙吗？这样我就可以自己打开门了。
items.normEn: Wait, is that the key to the Distortion World? With that, I could open the gate myself.

items.en: Wait, you got to them? Good for you. Not that it matters to me, I'm still stuck here. This sucks.
items.zh: 等等，你找到他们了吗？对你有好处。这对我来说并不重要，我仍然被困在这里。这太糟糕了。
items.normEn: Wait, you got to them? Good for you. Not that it matters to me, I'm still stuck here. This sucks.

items.en: Wait, you said the book mentioned the Lake Trio, right? Legends say they have existed since the creation of the world, they may know how to enter the Distortion World.
items.zh: 等等，你说书里提到了湖三重奏，对吗？传说他们自创世以来就存在，他们可能知道如何进入扭曲世界。
items.normEn: Wait, you said the book mentioned the Lake Trio, right? Legends say they have existed since the creation of the world, they may know how to enter the Distortion World.

items.en: Wait. You saw a Pichu with a spiked ear?! We used to play with it at that shrine way back when! Looks like it hasn't aged a day!
items.zh: 等待。你看到了长着尖刺耳朵的皮丘吗？！以前我们在那个神社玩过它！看起来一天也没变老！
items.normEn: Wait. You saw a Pichu with a spiked ear?! We used to play with it at that shrine way back when! Looks like it hasn't aged a day!

items.en: Walk 1,000 Steps in a Safari Zone
items.zh: 在野生动物园区步行 1,000 步
items.normEn: Walk 1,000 Steps in a Safari Zone

items.en: Walk 10,000 Steps in a Safari Zone
items.zh: 在野生动物园区步行 10,000 步
items.normEn: Walk 10,000 Steps in a Safari Zone

items.en: Walk 100 Steps in a Safari Zone
items.zh: 在野生动物园区步行 100 步
items.normEn: Walk 100 Steps in a Safari Zone

items.en: Walking in the Safari Zone will now add steps to your eggs
items.zh: 现在，在野生动物区行走将为您的鸡蛋添加步骤
items.normEn: Walking in the Safari Zone will now add steps to your eggs

items.en: Want to help me? No? Ah, you're busy dealing with a group of Team Rocket? Well, I wish you luck with that
items.zh: 想帮助我吗？不？啊，你正忙着对付一群火箭队吗？好吧，祝你好运
items.normEn: Want to help me? No? Ah, you're busy dealing with a group of Team Rocket? Well, I wish you luck with that

items.en: Was that really good training? Looks like I'd better keep my guard up!
items.zh: 这样的训练真的好吗？看来我还是要提高警惕了！
items.normEn: Was that really good training? Looks like I'd better keep my guard up!

items.en: Watch a news report in Littleroot Town about a mysterious Pokémon.
items.zh: 观看小根镇有关神秘神奇宝贝的新闻报道。
items.normEn: Watch a news report in Littleroot Town about a mysterious Pokémon.

items.en: Watch out for mischievous Squirtle around here.
items.zh: 小心这里顽皮的杰尼龟。
items.normEn: Watch out for mischievous Squirtle around here.

items.en: Watch the clock, if you make it to the next floor you'll get a time boost to help you find the boss.
items.zh: 注意时钟，如果你到达下一层，你将获得时间加成来帮助你找到老板。
items.normEn: Watch the clock, if you make it to the next floor you'll get a time boost to help you find the boss.

items.en: We are the new kings of Galar! We're descendents of the first kings!
items.zh: 我们是伽勒尔的新王！我们是最初国王的后裔！
items.normEn: We are the new kings of Galar! We're descendents of the first kings!

items.en: We both got ourselves the same Grass Badge, so how come you're so much stronger?
items.zh: 我们都是同一个草徽章，你怎么就强这么多？
items.normEn: We both got ourselves the same Grass Badge, so how come you're so much stronger?

items.en: We can't just cover up the old filth with new filth!
items.zh: 我们不能用新的污秽来掩盖旧的污秽！
items.normEn: We can't just cover up the old filth with new filth!

items.en: We do seem to meet an awful lot, $playername$. Are you also interested in this old painting? Or are you here for something else? For one of the Meteorite Shards that can serve as a source of power for the Legendary Pokémon that lives in the heavens above.
items.zh: 我们似乎确实遇到了很多人，$playername$。你是否也对这幅老画感兴趣呢？或者你来这里是为了别的事？一颗陨石碎片，可以作为生活在天空中的传说神奇宝贝的力量源泉。
items.normEn: We do seem to meet an awful lot, $playername$. Are you also interested in this old painting? Or are you here for something else? For one of the Meteorite Shards that can serve as a source of power for the Legendary Pokémon that lives in the heavens above.

items.en: We don't have a kahuna on Poni, so I don't have an actual trial or anything...
items.zh: 我们在波尼上没有卡胡纳，所以我没有进行实际的审判或任何东西......
items.normEn: We don't have a kahuna on Poni, so I don't have an actual trial or anything...

items.en: We have always been revered as the resplendent descendents of the real hero...
items.zh: 我们一直被尊为真正英雄的光辉后裔……
items.normEn: We have always been revered as the resplendent descendents of the real hero...

items.en: We have been looking for a Shady Salesman.
items.zh: 我们一直在寻找一个可疑的推销员。
items.normEn: We have been looking for a Shady Salesman.

items.en: We have been watching you, and see that you have tamed the three Pokémon revived by Ho-Oh in the Burned Tower. Show us your power and we shall give you the Clear Bell, which will call Ho-Oh to the Tin Tower.
items.zh: 我们一直在看着你，发现你已经驯服了被火王在烧毁之塔中复活的三只神奇宝贝。向我们展示你的力量，我们会给你透明钟，它会召唤凤王到锡塔。
items.normEn: We have been watching you, and see that you have tamed the three Pokémon revived by Ho-Oh in the Burned Tower. Show us your power and we shall give you the Clear Bell, which will call Ho-Oh to the Tin Tower.

items.en: We have been working on repairing all the damage your... friend did when she was here last. The rocket system here at the Space Center should be able to take you up to the debris field the meteor left behind any time you want!
items.zh: 我们一直在努力修复你的朋友上次来这里时造成的所有损坏。航天中心的火箭系统应该能够随时带你到达流星留下的碎片场！
items.normEn: We have been working on repairing all the damage your... friend did when she was here last. The rocket system here at the Space Center should be able to take you up to the debris field the meteor left behind any time you want!

items.en: We have received word from Mr. Pokémon in Johto! He has made another breakthrough.
items.zh: 我们收到了来自城都的神奇宝贝先生的消息！他又取得了突破。
items.normEn: We have received word from Mr. Pokémon in Johto! He has made another breakthrough.

items.en: We just planted this sapling here. Maybe it will grow into something great some day.
items.zh: 我们刚刚把这棵树苗种在这里。也许有一天它会成长为伟大的事物。
items.normEn: We just planted this sapling here. Maybe it will grow into something great some day.

items.en: We know all the Wishing Stars that Chairman Rose had gathered are here. We celebrities have an advanced level of insight into such things!
items.zh: 我们知道罗斯主席聚集的所有许愿星都在这里。我们名人对于这些事情的洞察力是非常高的！
items.normEn: We know all the Wishing Stars that Chairman Rose had gathered are here. We celebrities have an advanced level of insight into such things!

items.en: We may not have found those fossils, but our real goal was making each other smile! No Pokémon can compare to the feeling of catching your loved one in the same secret act as you! To think we split up to surprise each other with a fossil when the real present is the time we spend together!
items.zh: 我们可能没有找到那些化石，但我们真正的目标是让彼此微笑！没有任何神奇宝贝可以比得上在与你相同的秘密行动中抓住你所爱的人的感觉！想想我们分开是为了给对方一个化石惊喜，而真正的礼物是我们在一起度过的时光！
items.normEn: We may not have found those fossils, but our real goal was making each other smile! No Pokémon can compare to the feeling of catching your loved one in the same secret act as you! To think we split up to surprise each other with a fossil when the real present is the time we spend together!

items.en: We must find a way to calm their nerves. To make them feel at home in our world. Or we must destroy them. Either way, we must understand them. We must catch them.
items.zh: 我们必须想办法安抚他们的紧张情绪。让他们在我们的世界中有宾至如归的感觉。或者我们必须摧毁它们。不管怎样，我们必须理解他们。我们必须抓住他们。
items.normEn: We must find a way to calm their nerves. To make them feel at home in our world. Or we must destroy them. Either way, we must understand them. We must catch them.

items.en: We must retrieve that egg at all costs! Please, you have to chase down the egg-napper!
items.zh: 我们必须不惜一切代价取回那颗蛋！拜托，你一定要追捕那个打鸡蛋的人！
items.normEn: We must retrieve that egg at all costs! Please, you have to chase down the egg-napper!

items.en: We need a bunch of Pinkan Berries to help feed the Pokémon at our theme park, but the twerp keeps zapping us when we try to go collect them.
items.zh: 我们需要一堆 Pinkan 浆果来帮助喂养主题公园的神奇宝贝，但当我们试图去收集它们时，笨蛋却不断攻击我们。
items.normEn: We need a bunch of Pinkan Berries to help feed the Pokémon at our theme park, but the twerp keeps zapping us when we try to go collect them.

items.en: We need a bunch of Pixie Plates, and we need some Fairy Gems to help...uh...pay off the contractor?
items.zh: 我们需要一堆精灵板，我们需要一些仙女宝石来帮助……呃……还清承包商的钱？
items.normEn: We need a bunch of Pixie Plates, and we need some Fairy Gems to help...uh...pay off the contractor?

items.en: We will start off by artificially replicating the massive energy that is triggered at the time of Mega Evolution! We will fire the energy produced from our rocket into space... And create a "warp hole".
items.zh: 我们将从人工复制超级进化时触发的巨大能量开始！我们将把火箭产生的能量发射到太空......并创建一个“曲速孔”。
items.normEn: We will start off by artificially replicating the massive energy that is triggered at the time of Mega Evolution! We will fire the energy produced from our rocket into space... And create a "warp hole".

items.en: We're always happy to help out any young folks who come through though!
items.zh: 我们总是很乐意帮助任何经历过困难的年轻人！
items.normEn: We're always happy to help out any young folks who come through though!

items.en: We're going to hatch Manaphy from this egg and get it to guide us to its Sea Temple.
items.zh: 我们将从这个蛋中孵化出玛纳霏，并让它引导我们前往它的海神殿。
items.normEn: We're going to hatch Manaphy from this egg and get it to guide us to its Sea Temple.

items.en: We're going to make these Pinkan Pokémon perform silly routines and make us a ton of money, no days off for these suckers!
items.zh: 我们要让这些 Pinkan 神奇宝贝执行愚蠢的例行公事，让我们赚很多钱，这些傻瓜没有休息日！
items.normEn: We're going to make these Pinkan Pokémon perform silly routines and make us a ton of money, no days off for these suckers!

items.en: We're gonna have an absolutely champion time!
items.zh: 我们将拥有绝对的冠军时光！
items.normEn: We're gonna have an absolutely champion time!

items.en: We're gonna keep moving forward, by staying at full power all the time!
items.zh: 我们将继续前行，始终保持全力以赴！
items.normEn: We're gonna keep moving forward, by staying at full power all the time!

items.en: We're ready to set sail to the Seafloor Cavern!
items.zh: 我们准备好启航前往海底洞穴了！
items.normEn: We're ready to set sail to the Seafloor Cavern!

items.en: We've been using the electricity we stole from the Power Plant to get everything prepared for activating the ultimate weapon. But it's not like that's all we'll need to use it. Are you following me? We'll need energy absorbed from Pokémon to power the device! Yes! It's the stones on Route 10 that will steal that energy for us and power the ultimate weapon.
items.zh: 我们一直在使用从发电厂偷来的电力来为激活终极武器做好一切准备。但这并不是我们需要使用它的全部。你在跟踪我吗？我们需要从神奇宝贝吸收能量来为设备供电！是的！ 10 号公路上的石头将为我们窃取能量并为终极武器提供动力。
items.normEn: We've been using the electricity we stole from the Power Plant to get everything prepared for activating the ultimate weapon. But it's not like that's all we'll need to use it. Are you following me? We'll need energy absorbed from Pokémon to power the device! Yes! It's the stones on Route 10 that will steal that energy for us and power the ultimate weapon.

items.en: We’ve got stuff here nobody else has got! But keep any Dowsing Machines you have away from the merchandise… especially the RageCandyBars.
items.zh: 我们这里有别人没有的东西！但请将您拥有的任何探矿机远离商品……尤其是 RageCandyBars。
items.normEn: We’ve got stuff here nobody else has got! But keep any Dowsing Machines you have away from the merchandise… especially the RageCandyBars.

items.en: Weather forecast at the Weather Institute in Hoenn
items.zh: 丰缘气象研究所的天气预报
items.normEn: Weather forecast at the Weather Institute in Hoenn

items.en: Weird thing is, both trainers evolved their Pikachu after the battle, but one had a different form from usual! Maybe there's something about Alola that makes certain Pokémon evolve differently? I would check my Evolution Items if I were you.
items.zh: 奇怪的是，两位训练家在战斗后都进化了皮卡丘，但其中一位的形态却与平时不同！也许阿罗拉身上有什么东西让某些神奇宝贝进化得不同？如果我是你，我会检查我的进化物品。
items.normEn: Weird thing is, both trainers evolved their Pikachu after the battle, but one had a different form from usual! Maybe there's something about Alola that makes certain Pokémon evolve differently? I would check my Evolution Items if I were you.

items.en: Welcome back Champ! I have good news and bad news.
items.zh: 欢迎回来冠军！我有好消息和坏消息。
items.normEn: Welcome back Champ! I have good news and bad news.

items.en: Welcome back, $playername$! I can see you've brought back Virizion. Thank you for your assistance towards reuniting the Swords of Justice.
items.zh: 欢迎回来，$playername$！我看得出你已经带回了 Virizion。感谢您为重新统一正义之剑提供的帮助。
items.normEn: Welcome back, $playername$! I can see you've brought back Virizion. Thank you for your assistance towards reuniting the Swords of Justice.

items.en: Welcome back! Now let's see how you did... Yup! You passed my trial! Here you go!
items.zh: 欢迎回来！现在让我们看看你做得如何......是的！你通过了我的考验！干得好！
items.normEn: Welcome back! Now let's see how you did... Yup! You passed my trial! Here you go!

items.en: Welcome to Johto! This is where the first ever Pokémon egg was found long ago.
items.zh: 欢迎来到城都！这是很久以前发现第一个神奇宝贝蛋的地方。
items.normEn: Welcome to Johto! This is where the first ever Pokémon egg was found long ago.

items.en: Welcome to my laboratory, trainer! I am working here to understand the mysterious Interdream Zone.
items.zh: 欢迎来到我的实验室，培训师！我在这里工作是为了了解神秘的Interdream Zone。
items.normEn: Welcome to my laboratory, trainer! I am working here to understand the mysterious Interdream Zone.

items.en: Welcome to Sinnoh! There are many legends and myths here. For example, it is said that trainers that conquer the Lake nearby, Lake Verity, will meet a mythical Pokémon known for Emotion roaming around the region. It sure would have been awesome to partner with that Pokémon in one of my routines!
items.zh: 欢迎来到神奥！这里有许多传说和神话。例如，据说征服附近的真实湖的训练家将会遇到一只以情感在该地区漫游的神话神奇宝贝。如果能在我的日常活动中与那只神奇宝贝搭档，那真是太棒了！
items.normEn: Welcome to Sinnoh! There are many legends and myths here. For example, it is said that trainers that conquer the Lake nearby, Lake Verity, will meet a mythical Pokémon known for Emotion roaming around the region. It sure would have been awesome to partner with that Pokémon in one of my routines!

items.zh: 欢迎来到朋友野生动物园！

items.en: Welcome to the region of Magikarp!
items.normEn: Welcome to the region of Magikarp!

items.en: Welcome to Valencia Island! Well, this tiny beach on Valencia Island. I don't know why I decided to have this lab built below this giant cliff... Can't even get to the rest of the island from here.
items.zh: 欢迎来到巴伦西亚岛！好吧，瓦伦西亚岛上的这个小海滩。我不知道为什么我决定把这个实验室建在这个巨大的悬崖下面……甚至无法从这里到达岛上的其他地方。
items.normEn: Welcome to Valencia Island! Well, this tiny beach on Valencia Island. I don't know why I decided to have this lab built below this giant cliff... Can't even get to the rest of the island from here.

items.en: Welcome! I was asked by an acquaintance to help with his research. What I desire is to bring out the entirety in Pokémon potential! If I can accomplish that, I don't care what it takes!
items.zh: 欢迎！一位熟人请我帮助他的研究。我的愿望是发挥出神奇宝贝的全部潜力！如果我能做到这一点，我不在乎付出什么代价！
items.normEn: Welcome! I was asked by an acquaintance to help with his research. What I desire is to bring out the entirety in Pokémon potential! If I can accomplish that, I don't care what it takes!

items.en: Welcome. I guess you found my secret labs, inside my own café. The world was just too vast...and too full of fools that I couldn't save through my hard work alone...
items.zh: 欢迎。我猜你在我自己的咖啡馆里找到了我的秘密实验室。世界太大了……愚人太多了，光靠我的努力是无法拯救的……
items.normEn: Welcome. I guess you found my secret labs, inside my own café. The world was just too vast...and too full of fools that I couldn't save through my hard work alone...

items.en: Welcome. In our Volunteer House here we take in all kinds of Pokémon to care for them.
items.zh: 欢迎。在我们的志愿者之家，我们收留各种神奇宝贝来照顾它们。
items.normEn: Welcome. In our Volunteer House here we take in all kinds of Pokémon to care for them.

items.en: Well done! I learned much from this battle!
items.zh: 干得好！我从这次战斗中学到了很多东西！
items.normEn: Well done! I learned much from this battle!

items.en: Well I suppose you did deal with that Team Rocket branch on Five Island, so I guess I'll let you stay, as thanks.
items.zh: 好吧，我想你确实和五岛上的火箭队分支打过交道，所以我想我会让你留下来，以示谢意。
items.normEn: Well I suppose you did deal with that Team Rocket branch on Five Island, so I guess I'll let you stay, as thanks.

items.en: Well I'll be! You're quite the trainer!
items.zh: 好吧，我会的！你真是教练啊！
items.normEn: Well I'll be! You're quite the trainer!

items.en: Well mustered! You cleared the first trial like it was nothing! Why, I think this is the first time since Leon that someone was able to handle all six fast Slowpoke on their own! The rest of you tried very hard, too! You were able to catch up to the Slowpoke, but I guess you couldn't defeat them.
items.zh: 集合得好！你就像没事一样通过了第一个考验！为什么，我认为这是自莱昂以来第一次有人能够独自处理所有六个快速的呆呆兽！你们其他人也很努力！你追上了呆呆兽，但我猜你无法打败他们。
items.normEn: Well mustered! You cleared the first trial like it was nothing! Why, I think this is the first time since Leon that someone was able to handle all six fast Slowpoke on their own! The rest of you tried very hard, too! You were able to catch up to the Slowpoke, but I guess you couldn't defeat them.

items.en: Well now! Tell me if you have the answer I desire or not! If you're ready, come at me!
items.zh: 现在好了！告诉我你是否有我想要的答案！如果你准备好了，就来找我吧！
items.normEn: Well now! Tell me if you have the answer I desire or not! If you're ready, come at me!

items.en: Well partner, that was some dang fancy fighting, I'll tell you what.
items.zh: 好吧，伙伴，那是一场非常精彩的战斗，我来告诉你吧。
items.normEn: Well partner, that was some dang fancy fighting, I'll tell you what.

items.en: Well then, I guess I'll just have to keep this wonderful item I was going to give you...
items.zh: 那么，我想我只能保留这个我要送给你的美妙物品了……
items.normEn: Well then, I guess I'll just have to keep this wonderful item I was going to give you...

items.en: Well, good luck to you, then.
items.normEn: Well, good luck to you, then.

items.en: Well, hey! Look who we have here! It's the Champ, wandering all the way into Vast Poni Canyon! You gotta have guts to do that, kid. Not many trainers dare to challenge this place.
items.zh: 嗯，嘿！看看我们这里有谁！这是冠军，一路漫步进入广阔的波尼峡谷！你必须有勇气这么做，孩子。敢于挑战这个地方的训练家并不多。
items.normEn: Well, hey! Look who we have here! It's the Champ, wandering all the way into Vast Poni Canyon! You gotta have guts to do that, kid. Not many trainers dare to challenge this place.

items.en: Well, his hideout is in the Pyrite Cave. But you shouldn't go there.
items.zh: 嗯，他的藏身之处就在黄铁洞里。但你不应该去那里。
items.normEn: Well, his hideout is in the Pyrite Cave. But you shouldn't go there.

items.en: Well, I guess you can already tell. We've been in Haina Desert looking for Tapu Bulu, but the search team stumbled upon this Silvally Memory instead and it looks pretty rare because we couldn't find much information about it. We want to take it in for some experiments, but we knew you wouldn't let us do that so I tried to hide it. Now that you know, my only choice is battling you.
items.zh: 好吧，我想你已经知道了。我们一直在海纳沙漠寻找 Tapu Bulu，但搜索小组却偶然发现了这个 Silvally Memory，它看起来非常罕见，因为我们找不到太多关于它的信息。我们想用它来做一些实验，但我们知道你不会让我们这样做，所以我试图隐藏它。现在你知道了，我唯一的选择就是与你战斗。
items.normEn: Well, I guess you can already tell. We've been in Haina Desert looking for Tapu Bulu, but the search team stumbled upon this Silvally Memory instead and it looks pretty rare because we couldn't find much information about it. We want to take it in for some experiments, but we knew you wouldn't let us do that so I tried to hide it. Now that you know, my only choice is battling you.

items.en: Well, I'll be off. Please give Professor Sycamore my best. My desire... it is for a more beautiful world!
items.zh: 嗯，我这就走了。请向 Sycamore 教授致以最诚挚的谢意。我的愿望……是为了一个更加美丽的世界！
items.normEn: Well, I'll be off. Please give Professor Sycamore my best. My desire... it is for a more beautiful world!

items.en: Well, I'm going back to the lab, goodbye!
items.zh: 好了，我要回实验室了，再见！
items.normEn: Well, I'm going back to the lab, goodbye!

items.en: Well, I'm trying to dig to a secluded island north of here. I've heard there are some unusual Pokémon there.
items.zh: 嗯，我正在尝试挖掘这里北部的一个僻静的岛屿。我听说那里有一些不寻常的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Well, I'm trying to dig to a secluded island north of here. I've heard there are some unusual Pokémon there.

items.en: Well, in that case, I'd better add a little something more. This is the final trial of your island challenge, after all. I hope you're ready for your toughest opponents yet!
items.zh: 好吧，既然如此，我最好再补充一点。毕竟，这是你的岛屿挑战的最终考验。我希望你已经准备好迎接最难对付的对手了！
items.normEn: Well, in that case, I'd better add a little something more. This is the final trial of your island challenge, after all. I hope you're ready for your toughest opponents yet!

items.zh: 好吧，这真是鱼啊！你赢了！

items.en: Well, listen to what this loser has to say. You've got what it takes to go far. Now, go on to the next room and enjoy your next battle!
items.zh: 好吧，听听这个失败者怎么说。你拥有走得更远所需的一切。现在，前往下一个房间，享受下一场战斗吧！
items.normEn: Well, listen to what this loser has to say. You've got what it takes to go far. Now, go on to the next room and enjoy your next battle!

items.en: Well, since he told you to find me, there must be a reason. Unless you're here to help me re-form the Swords of Justice? If so, then thank you for your aid. Meet me in the Moor of Icirrus after you find them. You should look for Terrakion first, somewhere in the depths of the Unova Victory Road. Good luck, Trainer.
items.zh: 好吧，既然他让你来找我，那肯定是有原因的。除非你是来帮我重塑正义之剑的？如果是这样，那么感谢您的帮助。找到他们后，到伊西洛斯的荒原来见我。你应该首先寻找泰拉基翁，它位于合众胜利之路深处的某个地方。祝你好运，教练。
items.normEn: Well, since he told you to find me, there must be a reason. Unless you're here to help me re-form the Swords of Justice? If so, then thank you for your aid. Meet me in the Moor of Icirrus after you find them. You should look for Terrakion first, somewhere in the depths of the Unova Victory Road. Good luck, Trainer.

items.en: Well, that was a shock! Guess I know now why Lee thought he should give you a Pokémon, too...
items.zh: 嗯，这太令人震惊了！我想我现在知道为什么李认为他也应该给你一只神奇宝贝了......
items.normEn: Well, that was a shock! Guess I know now why Lee thought he should give you a Pokémon, too...

items.en: Well, that was definitely a weird guy... Seems like Calem wants to meet you somewhere in Lumiose City, go talk with him.
items.zh: 嗯，这绝对是个奇怪的家伙……看来卡勒姆想在卢米欧斯市的某个地方见到你，去和他谈谈吧。
items.normEn: Well, that was definitely a weird guy... Seems like Calem wants to meet you somewhere in Lumiose City, go talk with him.

items.en: Well, that was extremely awkward... But ignoring that, Lumiose City still hasn't fixed the power outage, go clear the Kalos Power Plant.
items.zh: 好吧，那就太尴尬了……不过不管这些，卢米欧斯城的停电还没解决，去清理卡洛斯发电厂吧。
items.normEn: Well, that was extremely awkward... But ignoring that, Lumiose City still hasn't fixed the power outage, go clear the Kalos Power Plant.

items.en: Well, they're all knocked out. I'll try to talk reason into them when they wake up. Thanks for your help, I'm glad you found Zarude safe.
items.zh: 好吧，他们都被淘汰了。当他们醒来时，我会尝试向他们讲道理。感谢您的帮助，我很高兴您发现扎鲁德安全。
items.normEn: Well, they're all knocked out. I'll try to talk reason into them when they wake up. Thanks for your help, I'm glad you found Zarude safe.

items.en: Well, uh... nice to meet you. I'm Green! So hey, I'm just curious... Are you here because you're also looking for... y'know, something special?
items.zh: 嗯，呃...很高兴认识你。我是绿！所以嘿，我只是好奇...你来这里是因为你也在寻找...你知道，一些特别的东西吗？
items.normEn: Well, uh... nice to meet you. I'm Green! So hey, I'm just curious... Are you here because you're also looking for... y'know, something special?

items.en: Well, well, well! Could these things here be the fabled sword and shield?
items.zh: 好啦好啦！难道这里的这些东西就是传说中的剑与盾吗？
items.normEn: Well, well, well! Could these things here be the fabled sword and shield?

items.en: Well, well, well! They certainly are dirty! They must be fake! I fear to touch them with my bare hands.
items.zh: 好啦好啦！他们当然很脏！他们一定是假的！我害怕徒手触摸它们。
items.normEn: Well, well, well! They certainly are dirty! They must be fake! I fear to touch them with my bare hands.

items.en: Well, well, well? It seems you have rescued the stadiums from their perils. As expected of the Champion.
items.zh: 好吧，好吧，好吧？看来你已经把体育场从危险中拯救出来了。正如冠军所期望的那样。
items.normEn: Well, well, well? It seems you have rescued the stadiums from their perils. As expected of the Champion.

items.en: Well, well, well... I thought I heard someone making some noise over this way!
items.zh: 呃，呃，呃……我好像听到有人在这边发出声音！
items.normEn: Well, well, well... I thought I heard someone making some noise over this way!

items.en: Well, you're in luck! I was talking to an old rival of mine the other day, and she said she was looking for Mewtwo, and that she already had two of its Mega Stones. Unfortunately for her, they were the same one.
items.zh: 嗯，你很幸运！前几天我和我的一个老对手聊天，她说她正在寻找超梦，并且她已经拥有了两颗超级宝石。对她来说不幸的是，他们是同一个人。
items.normEn: Well, you're in luck! I was talking to an old rival of mine the other day, and she said she was looking for Mewtwo, and that she already had two of its Mega Stones. Unfortunately for her, they were the same one.

items.en: Well! Once again, you certainly reeled me in. Please have a good time with Kiawe.
items.zh: 出色地！再次，你确实让我着迷。请与 Kiawe 度过愉快的时光。
items.normEn: Well! Once again, you certainly reeled me in. Please have a good time with Kiawe.

items.en: Well... it's not much of a laboratory yet. I'm working on several projects to help Magikarps reach their full potential. Can you help me out?
items.zh: 嗯……它还算不上是一个实验室。我正在开展几个项目来帮助鲤鱼充分发挥潜力。你能帮我一下吗？
items.normEn: Well... it's not much of a laboratory yet. I'm working on several projects to help Magikarps reach their full potential. Can you help me out?

items.en: Well… Now you… you're an even more wonderful Trainer than I expected. Your sweet fighting style swept me off my feet! Take this!
items.zh: 嗯……现在你……你是一个比我想象的更出色的训练家。你甜美的战斗风格让我神魂颠倒！拿着这个！
items.normEn: Well… Now you… you're an even more wonderful Trainer than I expected. Your sweet fighting style swept me off my feet! Take this!

items.en: Wha? Huh? I lost? How about that! You're worthy of the Storm Badge!
items.zh: 世界卫生大会？啊？我输了？怎么样！你值得拥有风暴徽章！
items.normEn: Wha? Huh? I lost? How about that! You're worthy of the Storm Badge!

items.en: Whaaaaaaaaaat?! You've already caught it?! Hey, no fair! I was planning on catching it first!
items.zh: 哇啊啊啊啊？！你已经抓住了？！嘿，不公平！本来还打算先去抓的！
items.normEn: Whaaaaaaaaaat?! You've already caught it?! Hey, no fair! I was planning on catching it first!

items.en: What a battle! That Audinite will let you Mega Evolve your Audino, under certain circumstances.
items.zh: 真是一场战斗！在某些情况下，Audinite 可以让你超级进化你的 Audino。
items.normEn: What a battle! That Audinite will let you Mega Evolve your Audino, under certain circumstances.

items.en: What a blithering mooncalf I am. How could I let myself lose...
items.zh: 我真是个爱胡言乱语的月犊啊。我怎么能让自己迷失...
items.normEn: What a blithering mooncalf I am. How could I let myself lose...

items.en: What a blunder to have made in front of Zinzolin...
items.zh: 在辛佐林面前犯下多么大的错误啊……
items.normEn: What a blunder to have made in front of Zinzolin...

items.zh: 多么可爱的个人资料啊！

items.en: What a Psystrike to my poor pride...
items.zh: 这对我可怜的自尊来说是多么大的心灵打击啊……
items.normEn: What a Psystrike to my poor pride...

items.en: What a startling development! I never would've thought you were really a chosen one!
items.zh: 多么惊人的发展啊！我没想到你真的是被选中的人！
items.normEn: What a startling development! I never would've thought you were really a chosen one!

items.en: What an amazing trainer! You became Kalos Champion! There is a parade in your honor in Lumiose City. But wait, AZ is there asking you for a battle. Show him what being a Pokémon Trainer is like!
items.zh: 多么了不起的教练啊！你成为了卡洛斯冠军！卢米奥塞市将举行一场纪念您的游行。但是等等，AZ 正在向你发起战斗。向他展示成为一名神奇宝贝训练师是什么样的！
items.normEn: What an amazing trainer! You became Kalos Champion! There is a parade in your honor in Lumiose City. But wait, AZ is there asking you for a battle. Show him what being a Pokémon Trainer is like!

items.en: What an explosive battle! I could tell that you didn't hold anything back!
items.zh: 多么爆炸性的战斗啊！我看得出来，你没有任何保留！
items.normEn: What an explosive battle! I could tell that you didn't hold anything back!

items.en: What an incredible Trainer you are! The Z-Crystal from the pedestal is yours now! It is known as Normalium Z!
items.zh: 你是一位多么令人难以置信的教练啊！底座上的 Z 水晶现在就是你的了！它被称为Normalium Z！
items.normEn: What an incredible Trainer you are! The Z-Crystal from the pedestal is yours now! It is known as Normalium Z!

items.en: What are the EV damage multipliers?
items.normEn: What are the EV damage multipliers?

items.en: What are the odds of finding a roaming Pokémon?
items.zh: 找到漫游神奇宝贝的几率有多大？
items.normEn: What are the odds of finding a roaming Pokémon?

items.en: What are the odds of finding a shiny Pokémon?
items.zh: 找到闪亮的神奇宝贝的几率有多大？
items.normEn: What are the odds of finding a shiny Pokémon?

items.en: What are you saying?! We ended up losing?!
items.zh: 你在说什么？结果我们就输了？！
items.normEn: What are you saying?! We ended up losing?!

items.en: What did you say? Teemphlair was here? What's that? A Pokémon?
items.zh: 你说什么？廷弗莱尔来过这里吗？那是什么？神奇宝贝？
items.normEn: What did you say? Teemphlair was here? What's that? A Pokémon?

items.en: What Do I Gain From Leveling This?
items.normEn: What Do I Gain From Leveling This?

items.en: What do I get for activating challenge modes?
items.zh: 激活挑战模式我能得到什么？
items.normEn: What do I get for activating challenge modes?

items.en: What do I think of Grand trials? They're just like gym battles. Yup, it's totally the same thing. They're even making a Pokémon League.
items.zh: 我对大审判有何看法？他们就像健身房里的战斗一样。是的，这是完全一样的事情。他们甚至正在制作神奇宝贝联盟。
items.normEn: What do I think of Grand trials? They're just like gym battles. Yup, it's totally the same thing. They're even making a Pokémon League.

items.en: What do the Pokérus status filters mean?
items.zh: Pokérus 状态过滤器的含义是什么？
items.normEn: What do the Pokérus status filters mean?

items.en: What Do You Do With All the Eggshells?
items.zh: 你如何处理所有的蛋壳？
items.normEn: What Do You Do With All the Eggshells?

items.en: What do you mean "how is Pikachu floating?", all Pikachu can float! Because, uh... electromagnetism!
items.zh: 什么叫“皮卡丘怎么会飘起来”，所有的皮卡丘都会飘起来！因为，呃...电磁力！
items.normEn: What do you mean "how is Pikachu floating?", all Pikachu can float! Because, uh... electromagnetism!

items.en: What do you mean Grand trials are just like gym battles? It's a totally different thing!
items.zh: 什么叫大试炼就像道馆战斗一样？这是完全不同的事情！
items.normEn: What do you mean Grand trials are just like gym battles? It's a totally different thing!

items.en: What do you think you're doing?!
items.normEn: What do you think you're doing?!

items.en: What does that mean we are? You dare say that our esteemed ancestors were liars?
items.zh: 我们是什么意思？你敢说我们的祖先是骗子？
items.normEn: What does that mean we are? You dare say that our esteemed ancestors were liars?

items.en: What does this tell us about Galar’s legends? More than any hero, there’s those things that appear to be Pokémon that stand out!
items.zh: 这告诉我们关于伽勒尔传说的什么信息？与任何英雄相比，那些看似神奇宝贝的东西更引人注目！
items.normEn: What does this tell us about Galar’s legends? More than any hero, there’s those things that appear to be Pokémon that stand out!

items.en: What in the world are you? How this is possible...? How can a kid like you manage to destroy my dream once again? The precious dream of Team Rocket has become little more than an illusion...
items.zh: 你到底是什么？这怎么可能……？像你这样的孩子怎么能再次摧毁我的梦想呢？火箭队的珍贵梦想已经变成了幻想……
items.normEn: What in the world are you? How this is possible...? How can a kid like you manage to destroy my dream once again? The precious dream of Team Rocket has become little more than an illusion...

items.en: What is it…? Oh? So the great deluge has begun… Bwahahahaha! But of course it has! That is exactly what I have―
items.zh: 这是什么……？哦？于是大洪水开始了……哇哈哈哈哈哈！但当然有！这正是我所拥有的——
items.normEn: What is it…? Oh? So the great deluge has begun… Bwahahahaha! But of course it has! That is exactly what I have―

items.en: What is Pokérus, and what are EVs?
items.zh: 什么是 Pokérus，什么是 EV？
items.normEn: What is Pokérus, and what are EVs?

items.en: What is the EV Attack Bonus?
items.zh: 什么是 EV 攻击奖励？
items.normEn: What is the EV Attack Bonus?

items.en: What is the schedule of the day cycle?
items.zh: 一天的日程安排是怎样的？
items.normEn: What is the schedule of the day cycle?

items.en: What is the small/medium/large restore used for?
items.zh: 小/中/大恢复的用途是什么？
items.normEn: What is the small/medium/large restore used for?

items.zh: 刚刚发生了什么？我输了？！

items.en: What kept you $playername$? Hahaha! I thought you'd turn up if I waited here! I guess Team Rocket slowed you down! Not that I care! I saw you in Saffron, so I decided to see if you got better!
items.zh: 是什么让你$playername$留了下来？哈哈哈！我以为如果我在这里等你就会出现！我猜火箭队拖慢了你的速度！我不在乎！我在藏红花看到了你，所以我决定看看你是否好起来了！
items.normEn: What kept you $playername$? Hahaha! I thought you'd turn up if I waited here! I guess Team Rocket slowed you down! Not that I care! I saw you in Saffron, so I decided to see if you got better!

items.en: What news... So a new challenger has defeated Malva of the Elite Four!
items.zh: 什么消息……新的挑战者击败了四强中的马尔瓦！
items.normEn: What news... So a new challenger has defeated Malva of the Elite Four!

items.en: What the king of Kalos did was reprehensible, but... The ultimate weapon did manage to wash the world clean of that era's filth. Thank you for listening.
items.zh: 卡洛斯之王的所作所为是应该受到谴责的，但是……终极武器确实成功地清洗了世界上那个时代的污秽。感谢您的聆听。
items.normEn: What the king of Kalos did was reprehensible, but... The ultimate weapon did manage to wash the world clean of that era's filth. Thank you for listening.

items.en: What was in that book? Did you find any information on the Distortion World?
items.zh: 那本书里写了什么？你找到关于扭曲世界的资料了吗？
items.normEn: What was in that book? Did you find any information on the Distortion World?

items.en: What was that? My Shadow Pokémon! It doesn't matter though, my teammates escaped with Professor Krane!
items.zh: 那是什么？我的影子宝可梦！不过没关系，我的队友们和克兰教授一起逃走了！
items.normEn: What was that? My Shadow Pokémon! It doesn't matter though, my teammates escaped with Professor Krane!

items.en: What were they planning to accomplish by taking all the Poké Balls for themselves...
items.zh: 他们把所有的神奇宝贝球都占为己有，到底想达到什么目的……
items.normEn: What were they planning to accomplish by taking all the Poké Balls for themselves...

items.en: What, you forgot the password? There're actually two. The first one's "Goldeen need log". And the second one is...
items.zh: 什么，你忘记密码了？实际上有两个。第一个是“黄金需求日志”。而第二个是...
items.normEn: What, you forgot the password? There're actually two. The first one's "Goldeen need log". And the second one is...

items.en: What? It did take long? You went on a whole rescue mission? Seems like I lost track of time while working on my machine with Bill. It's been a lot of fun.
items.zh: 什么？确实花了很长时间？你参加了整个救援任务吗？我和比尔一起在机器上工作时似乎忘记了时间。这很有趣。
items.normEn: What? It did take long? You went on a whole rescue mission? Seems like I lost track of time while working on my machine with Bill. It's been a lot of fun.

items.en: What? Oh you didn't know? The ace Pokémon of Gym Leaders Byron and Roark are resurrected from fossils!
items.zh: 什么？哦，你不知道吗？道馆馆长拜伦和罗克的王牌宝可梦从化石中复活了！
items.normEn: What? Oh you didn't know? The ace Pokémon of Gym Leaders Byron and Roark are resurrected from fossils!

items.en: What? Oh, I'm just talking to myself. I'm not done yet. Please come back later.
items.zh: 什么？哦，我只是自言自语。我还没说完。请稍后再回来。
items.normEn: What? Oh, I'm just talking to myself. I'm not done yet. Please come back later.

items.en: What? Our combination... was shattered! It can't be helped. You've won... So, in recognition, take this Gym Badge.
items.zh: 什么？我们的组合……破碎了！这是没办法的事。你赢了……所以，为了表示认可，请收下这张道馆徽章。
items.normEn: What? Our combination... was shattered! It can't be helped. You've won... So, in recognition, take this Gym Badge.

items.en: WHAT? Recheck the data! Update the course calculations and confirm the new trajectory! But changing trajectories midflight... It's almost like it's alive.
items.zh: 什么？重新核对数据！更新航向计算并确认新的轨迹！但在飞行途中改变轨迹……它几乎就像是活的一样。
items.normEn: WHAT? Recheck the data! Update the course calculations and confirm the new trajectory! But changing trajectories midflight... It's almost like it's alive.

items.en: What? The meteorite for Celio? Yes, I can give that to you. But I need you to do something for me first.
items.zh: 什么？西利奥的陨石？是的，我可以给你。但我需要你先帮我做一件事。
items.normEn: What? The meteorite for Celio? Yes, I can give that to you. But I need you to do something for me first.

items.en: What? Why are you looking at me like that? If you don't wanna battle, I'm going home.
items.zh: 什么？你为什么这样看着我？如果你不想战斗，我就回家了。
items.normEn: What? Why are you looking at me like that? If you don't wanna battle, I'm going home.

items.en: What? You stinker! I took it easy on you, too!
items.zh: 什么？你这个臭东西！我也对你很宽容！
items.normEn: What? You stinker! I took it easy on you, too!

items.en: What? You were there? What happened? What was that purple thing?
items.zh: 什么？你在场吗？发生了什么？那个紫色的东西是什么？
items.normEn: What? You were there? What happened? What was that purple thing?

items.en: What?! They are here already! But they appear to be unable to tell exactly where the scent of the carrots is coming from!
items.zh: 什么？！他们已经在这里了！但他们似乎无法准确分辨出胡萝卜的气味是从哪里来的！
items.normEn: What?! They are here already! But they appear to be unable to tell exactly where the scent of the carrots is coming from!

items.en: What…? What do you mean far more than we thought?! It can't be… Then if it completes its Primal Reversion… N-never mind that! Just keep an eye on it!
items.zh: 什么…？你的意思远远超出我们的想象？！不可能……那么如果它完成了原始回归……不、别介意！只要留意它！
items.normEn: What…? What do you mean far more than we thought?! It can't be… Then if it completes its Primal Reversion… N-never mind that! Just keep an eye on it!

items.zh: 那是什么？上午还是下午？

items.en: What's that? Celebi went back into the forest? Well, follow it!
items.zh: 那是什么？雪拉比回到森林了？嗯，跟着它吧！
items.normEn: What's that? Celebi went back into the forest? Well, follow it!

items.en: What's that? You're gonna stop us!? Heh, yeah right! Bring it on twerp!
items.zh: 那是什么？你要阻止我们吗！？呵呵，对对对！把它带上特沃普！
items.normEn: What's that? You're gonna stop us!? Heh, yeah right! Bring it on twerp!

items.en: What's the big idea? This Pokémon I stole is useless!
items.zh: 有什么大创意？我偷来的这个神奇宝贝没有用！
items.normEn: What's the big idea? This Pokémon I stole is useless!

items.en: What's this? Are you trying to show you're stronger than me? How distasteful! I find your presence most disturbing! You show up at the dojo unannounced and go on to show such talent, even though you're still so young... You dare get in my way? I warned you about my psychic powers, and now you'll experience them firsthand!
items.zh: 这是什么？你是想证明你比我强吗？多么令人厌恶啊！我发现你的存在最令人不安！你还这么年轻，突然出现在道场，还展现出如此天赋……你敢妨碍我？我警告过你我的心灵力量，现在你将亲身体验它们！
items.normEn: What's this? Are you trying to show you're stronger than me? How distasteful! I find your presence most disturbing! You show up at the dojo unannounced and go on to show such talent, even though you're still so young... You dare get in my way? I warned you about my psychic powers, and now you'll experience them firsthand!

items.en: What's this? Well, well. What do we have here? A nosy little trainer has come poking around. Listen up! We're the fashionable team whose very name makes people tremble in fear: Team Flare! Team Flare's goal is to make it so we're the only ones who are happy! We don't care one bit about what happens to other trainers or Pokémon. Get out of here, kid. Don't you know not to play with fire? We'll obliterate you!
items.zh: 这是什么？好吧，好吧。我们这里有什么？一个爱管闲事的小训练师过来闲逛。听着！我们是一支名字让人心惊胆战的时尚队伍：Team Flare！ Team Flare 的目标是让我们成为唯一快乐的人！我们一点也不关心其他训练师或神奇宝贝发生了什么。离开这里，孩子。难道你不知道不要玩火吗？我们会消灭你！
items.normEn: What's this? Well, well. What do we have here? A nosy little trainer has come poking around. Listen up! We're the fashionable team whose very name makes people tremble in fear: Team Flare! Team Flare's goal is to make it so we're the only ones who are happy! We don't care one bit about what happens to other trainers or Pokémon. Get out of here, kid. Don't you know not to play with fire? We'll obliterate you!

items.en: What's up? I got here using my Eon Ticket, what about you?
items.zh: 这是怎么回事？我是用 Eon Ticket 来的，你呢？
items.normEn: What's up? I got here using my Eon Ticket, what about you?

items.en: What's with that?! My Pokémon didn't get a chance to really do their thing at all. Ugh!
items.zh: 那是怎么回事？我的神奇宝贝根本没有机会真正做他们的事情。啊!
items.normEn: What's with that?! My Pokémon didn't get a chance to really do their thing at all. Ugh!

items.en: When a Pokémon is hatched, its attack will increase by 25% of the base amount.
items.zh: 当神奇宝贝孵化时，其攻击力将增加基础攻击力的 25%。
items.normEn: When a Pokémon is hatched, its attack will increase by 25% of the base amount.

items.en: When a Pokémon wanders onto your farm they will appear on a plot next to the Berry and will remain there until interacted with or will flee a couple minutes after the Berry is harvested or withers.
items.zh: 当神奇宝贝漫步到您的农场时，它们会出现在浆果旁边的一块土地上，并会留在那里直到与浆果互动或在浆果收获或枯萎后几分钟逃跑。
items.normEn: When a Pokémon wanders onto your farm they will appear on a plot next to the Berry and will remain there until interacted with or will flee a couple minutes after the Berry is harvested or withers.

items.en: When all treasures have been seen, and the spot that is being mined has at least 1 adjacent tile with a reward
items.zh: 当所有宝藏都已被看到，并且正在开采的地点至少有 1 个相邻的方块且有奖励时
items.normEn: When all treasures have been seen, and the spot that is being mined has at least 1 adjacent tile with a reward

items.en: When all treasures have been seen, and the spot that is being mined has no adjacent tiles with a reward
items.zh: 当所有宝藏都已被看到，并且正在开采的地点没有相邻的带有奖励的图块时
items.normEn: When all treasures have been seen, and the spot that is being mined has no adjacent tiles with a reward

items.en: When an expert digs up a treasure (last click), there is a chance that they will keep the treasure for themselves.
items.zh: 当专家挖出宝藏时（最后点击），他们有机会将宝藏据为己有。
items.normEn: When an expert digs up a treasure (last click), there is a chance that they will keep the treasure for themselves.

items.en: When Are You Going to Breed Yourself?
items.zh: 你什么时候要自己繁殖？
items.normEn: When Are You Going to Breed Yourself?

items.zh: 我什么时候解锁电动汽车？

items.en: When exposed to the light of the sun and leveling up, it will transform into Solgaleo. And it will turn into Lunala with the light of the moon.
items.zh: 当暴露在阳光下并升级时，它会变成索尔迦雷欧。并会随着月光而化为露娜拉。
items.normEn: When exposed to the light of the sun and leveling up, it will transform into Solgaleo. And it will turn into Lunala with the light of the moon.

items.en: When hatching shop eggs, the Pokémon level will no longer be reset
items.zh: 孵化商店鸡蛋时，神奇宝贝等级将不再重置
items.normEn: When hatching shop eggs, the Pokémon level will no longer be reset

items.en: When I beat you, I'll get the secret armor... and then I'll become a Poison-type Gym Leader! I've got to win, no matter what.. I'm gonna go all out and totally beat you. You ready?
items.zh: 等我打败你，我就会得到秘密铠甲……然后我就会成为毒系道馆馆长！无论如何，我一定要赢……我会全力以赴，彻底击败你。你准备好了吗？
items.normEn: When I beat you, I'll get the secret armor... and then I'll become a Poison-type Gym Leader! I've got to win, no matter what.. I'm gonna go all out and totally beat you. You ready?

items.en: When I saw it still running, I tried to catch up to it, but it got into the Oreburgh Tunnel and I lost track of it.
items.zh: 当我看到它还在跑时，我试图追上它，但它进入了奥勒堡隧道，我失去了它的踪迹。
items.normEn: When I saw it still running, I tried to catch up to it, but it got into the Oreburgh Tunnel and I lost track of it.

items.en: When I use a Soothe Bell on Eevee it can evolve into Espeon or Umbreon. It depends on the time. Espeon during the day, Umbreon at night.
items.zh: 当我在 Eevee 上使用 Soothe Bell 时，它可以进化成 Espeon 或 Umbreon。这取决于时间。白天为 Espeon，晚上为 Umbreon。
items.normEn: When I use a Soothe Bell on Eevee it can evolve into Espeon or Umbreon. It depends on the time. Espeon during the day, Umbreon at night.

items.en: When it’s hungry, though, it gets so angry it changes forms.
items.zh: 然而，当它饿了的时候，它就会变得非常愤怒，从而改变形态。
items.normEn: When it’s hungry, though, it gets so angry it changes forms.

items.en: When not all treasures have been seen.
items.zh: 当还没有看到所有的宝藏时。
items.normEn: When not all treasures have been seen.

items.en: When Pokémon are in a Region they're not native to, they will only retain
items.zh: 当神奇宝贝位于非本地区域时，它们只会保留
items.normEn: When Pokémon are in a Region they're not native to, they will only retain

items.en: When purchasing multiple shop Pokémon the shiny chance was only rolled once
items.zh: 当购买多个商店神奇宝贝时，闪亮的机会只会滚动一次
items.normEn: When purchasing multiple shop Pokémon the shiny chance was only rolled once

items.en: When shoveling a fully grown crop it will be harvested instead
items.zh: 当铲掉完全成熟的农作物时，它将被收获
items.normEn: When shoveling a fully grown crop it will be harvested instead

items.en: When storms come along the horizon, they'll run en masse out to Route 16.
items.zh: 当暴风雨沿着地平线袭来时，他们会集体奔向 16 号公路。
items.normEn: When storms come along the horizon, they'll run en masse out to Route 16.

items.en: When the expert performs an action that gains them experience, the player will also gain
items.zh: 当专家执行一项获得经验的行动时，玩家也会获得
items.normEn: When the expert performs an action that gains them experience, the player will also gain

items.en: When the player performs an action that gains experience, the active expert will also gain
items.zh: 当玩家执行获得经验的动作时，活跃专家也会获得
items.normEn: When the player performs an action that gains experience, the active expert will also gain

items.en: When the weather turns really sunny, they'll all run barking out onto Route 16. Honestly, it's quite a racket, and has gotten me into no small amount of trouble.
items.zh: 天气晴朗的时候，他们都会狂吠着跑到16号公路上。说实话，这很吵，给我带来了不小的麻烦。
items.normEn: When the weather turns really sunny, they'll all run barking out onto Route 16. Honestly, it's quite a racket, and has gotten me into no small amount of trouble.

items.en: When they lose all of their vitality, they go to sleep in a secret place. It would be absolutely astounding if you found it!
items.zh: 当他们失去所有的活力时，他们就会在一个秘密的地方沉睡。如果你发现了它，那绝对是令人震惊的！
items.normEn: When they lose all of their vitality, they go to sleep in a secret place. It would be absolutely astounding if you found it!

items.en: When this sweetly spicy Berry's thick skin is peeled, many pieces of the fruit spill out.
items.zh: 当这种甜辣浆果的厚皮被剥掉时，许多水果碎片会溢出来。
items.normEn: When this sweetly spicy Berry's thick skin is peeled, many pieces of the fruit spill out.

items.en: When will more regions be added?
items.zh: 什么时候会增加更多地区？
items.normEn: When will more regions be added?

items.en: When will the development version be fully released?
items.zh: 开发版什么时候全面发布？
items.normEn: When will the development version be fully released?

items.en: When you (not your expert) are searching for a mine, there is a 4% chance for the mine to be a
items.zh: 当您（不是您的专家）正在寻找地雷时，该地雷有 4% 的机会是
items.normEn: When you (not your expert) are searching for a mine, there is a 4% chance for the mine to be a

items.en: When you are ready, click Start!
items.normEn: When you are ready, click Start!

items.en: When you defeat a Pokémon you gain a gem of that Pokémon's type. If the Pokémon has two types you gain one for each! Defeating very strong Pokémon, such as those owned by gym leaders, gets you five!
items.zh: 当你击败神奇宝贝时，你会获得该神奇宝贝类型的宝石。如果神奇宝贝有两种类型，则每种类型都会获得一种！击败非常强大的神奇宝贝（例如道馆老板拥有的神奇宝贝），您将获得五个！
items.normEn: When you defeat a Pokémon you gain a gem of that Pokémon's type. If the Pokémon has two types you gain one for each! Defeating very strong Pokémon, such as those owned by gym leaders, gets you five!

items.en: When you get one, could you, please, come back here so I can see it?
items.zh: 当你得到一个时，可以请你回到这里让我看看吗？
items.normEn: When you get one, could you, please, come back here so I can see it?

items.en: When you have encountered a Pokémon, you will be given 4 options:
items.zh: 当你遇到神奇宝贝时，你会有4个选择：
items.normEn: When you have encountered a Pokémon, you will be given 4 options:

items.en: When you've got your Pokédex open, you can click on a Pokémon's image to see more detailed stats about the Pokémon.
items.zh: 打开神奇宝贝图鉴后，您可以单击神奇宝贝的图像来查看有关神奇宝贝的更多详细统计信息。
items.normEn: When you've got your Pokédex open, you can click on a Pokémon's image to see more detailed stats about the Pokémon.

items.en: When your battery is fully charged up, you can discharge it. This discharge will leave a pattern of cleared tiles behind. With higher level patterns, which damage more tiles, becoming available as you level up.
items.zh: 当电池充满电后，您可以将其放电。这种放电会留下清晰的瓷砖图案。更高级别的图案会损坏更多瓷砖，随着您的升级而变得可用。
items.normEn: When your battery is fully charged up, you can discharge it. This discharge will leave a pattern of cleared tiles behind. With higher level patterns, which damage more tiles, becoming available as you level up.

items.en: When your bond is strong enough, you can Mega Evolve it using a Key Stone! You can buy them in this city!
items.zh: 当你们的联系足够强大时，您可以使用钥匙石来超级进化！你可以在这个城市买到它们！
items.normEn: When your bond is strong enough, you can Mega Evolve it using a Key Stone! You can buy them in this city!

items.en: When your Pokémon evolve their stats are carried over to the evolution. This includes times hatched, EVs, and shiny status.
items.zh: 当你的神奇宝贝进化时，他们的统计数据会延续到进化中。这包括孵化次数、EV 和闪亮状态。
items.normEn: When your Pokémon evolve their stats are carried over to the evolution. This includes times hatched, EVs, and shiny status.

items.en: Where can I play the latest version?
items.normEn: Where can I play the latest version?

items.en: Where can I view more information about my save file?
items.zh: 在哪里可以查看有关我的保存文件的更多信息？
items.normEn: Where can I view more information about my save file?

items.en: Where Did All the Shiny Pokémon Go?
items.zh: 闪闪发光的宝可梦都去哪儿了？
items.normEn: Where Did All the Shiny Pokémon Go?

items.en: Where Do They Find These Trainers?
items.zh: 他们在哪里找到这些培训师？
items.normEn: Where Do They Find These Trainers?

items.en: Whether or not you get to fight at full strength, whether or not luck smiles on you--none of that matters. Only results matter. And a loss is a loss. See, victory shines like a bright light. And right now, you and your Pokémon are shining brilliantly.
items.zh: 无论你是否能够全力战斗，无论运气是否向你微笑——这些都不重要。只有结果才重要。损失就是损失。看吧，胜利就像一道耀眼的光芒。现在，你和你的神奇宝贝正在闪闪发光。
items.normEn: Whether or not you get to fight at full strength, whether or not luck smiles on you--none of that matters. Only results matter. And a loss is a loss. See, victory shines like a bright light. And right now, you and your Pokémon are shining brilliantly.

items.en: Whew, punched through at last. Let's go treasure hunting! Any treasure we find, we haul back to the Warehouse, understood?
items.zh: 呼呼，终于打通了。我们去寻宝吧！我们发现任何宝藏，都会拖回仓库，明白吗？
items.normEn: Whew, punched through at last. Let's go treasure hunting! Any treasure we find, we haul back to the Warehouse, understood?

items.en: Whew! The desert is rough out there, glad you've made it all the way to Nimbasa.
items.zh: 哇！那里的沙漠很崎岖，很高兴你一路到达宁巴萨。
items.normEn: Whew! The desert is rough out there, glad you've made it all the way to Nimbasa.

items.en: Whew! This place is quite a trek from Freezington.
items.zh: 哇！这个地方从弗利青顿出发需要一段长途跋涉。
items.normEn: Whew! This place is quite a trek from Freezington.

items.en: Whew! Well done! As your battles continue, aim for even greater heights!
items.zh: 哇！干得好！随着战斗的继续，瞄准更高的高度！
items.normEn: Whew! Well done! As your battles continue, aim for even greater heights!

items.en: Whew! With skills like that, y'all should head to Phenac City.
items.zh: 哇！有了这样的技能，你们应该去菲纳克城。
items.normEn: Whew! With skills like that, y'all should head to Phenac City.

items.en: while having any tool/Berry selected to safely lock a plot.
items.zh: 同时选择任何工具/浆果来安全锁定情节。
items.normEn: while having any tool/Berry selected to safely lock a plot.

items.en: While I was studying gemstones, I discovered something important. There is another gem that forms a pair with this Ruby. That other gemstone is supposed to be in the Sevii Islands. Please, I need you to go find the other gem.
items.zh: 当我研究宝石时，我发现了一些重要的事情。还有另一种宝石可以与这颗红宝石配对。另一颗宝石应该位于塞维群岛。拜托，我需要你去寻找另一颗宝石。
items.normEn: While I was studying gemstones, I discovered something important. There is another gem that forms a pair with this Ruby. That other gemstone is supposed to be in the Sevii Islands. Please, I need you to go find the other gem.

items.en: While you were gone I discovered that the egg belongs to Manaphy! No wonder the Go-Rock Squad was after it.
items.zh: 你走后我发现那颗蛋是玛纳菲的！难怪摇滚小队会追捕它。
items.normEn: While you were gone I discovered that the egg belongs to Manaphy! No wonder the Go-Rock Squad was after it.

items.en: While you were gone, I was working on optimizing the training regimen for Magikarps. According to my calculations, we are missing a LOT of equipment.
items.zh: 你不在的时候，我正在优化鲤鱼的训练方案。根据我的计算，我们缺少很多设备。
items.normEn: While you were gone, I was working on optimizing the training regimen for Magikarps. According to my calculations, we are missing a LOT of equipment.

items.en: While you were in the Battle Frontier an army of Deoxys attacked. Fight your way out!
items.zh: 当你在战斗边境时，一支代欧奇希斯军队发起了攻击。为你的出路而奋斗！
items.normEn: While you were in the Battle Frontier an army of Deoxys attacked. Fight your way out!

items.en: Who am I? My name is Zinnia, nice to meet you. I have a certain.... connection to the Pokémon of this region, but we can get into that later.
items.zh: 我是谁？我叫百日草，很高兴认识你。我与这个地区的神奇宝贝有某种……联系，但我们可以稍后再讨论。
items.normEn: Who am I? My name is Zinnia, nice to meet you. I have a certain.... connection to the Pokémon of this region, but we can get into that later.

items.en: Who are the awesome people developing this game?
items.zh: 谁是开发这款游戏的杰出人士？
items.normEn: Who are the awesome people developing this game?

items.en: Who sent you to talk to me? Howard Clifford himself? That's a little suspicious, but you seem trustworthy enough.
items.zh: 谁派你来跟我说话的？霍华德·克利福德本人？虽然有点可疑，但看来你还是值得信赖的。
items.normEn: Who sent you to talk to me? Howard Clifford himself? That's a little suspicious, but you seem trustworthy enough.

items.en: Who wants to place a bait on a rematch?
items.zh: 谁愿意在复赛中下诱饵？
items.normEn: Who wants to place a bait on a rematch?

items.en: Who's this? You have a new friend? Zinnia is her name? Nice to meet you!
items.zh: 这是谁？你有新朋友了吗？百日草是她的名字吗？很高兴见到你！
items.normEn: Who's this? You have a new friend? Zinnia is her name? Nice to meet you!

items.en: Whoa, amazing! You're an expert on Pokémon! My research isn't complete yet. Ok, you win. Take this Badge.
items.zh: 哇，太棒了！你是神奇宝贝专家！我的研究还没有完成。好吧，你赢了。拿着这个徽章。
items.normEn: Whoa, amazing! You're an expert on Pokémon! My research isn't complete yet. Ok, you win. Take this Badge.

items.en: Whoa! An actual Pinkan Berry! Now our evil plo- plan! Definitely not evil, our very helpful and good plan!...Ahem. Our plan can now proceed.
items.zh: 哇！真正的 Pinkan 浆果！现在我们的邪恶计划！绝对不是邪恶的，我们非常有帮助和好的计划！......咳咳。我们的计划现在可以继续进行了。
items.normEn: Whoa! An actual Pinkan Berry! Now our evil plo- plan! Definitely not evil, our very helpful and good plan!...Ahem. Our plan can now proceed.

items.en: Whoa! S-spectacular! That Pokémon was protecting this Firium Z. Now it is yours.
items.zh: 哇！ S-壮观！那个神奇宝贝正在保护这个Firium Z。现在它是你的了。
items.normEn: Whoa! S-spectacular! That Pokémon was protecting this Firium Z. Now it is yours.

items.en:
Whoa! That was awesome! You and your Pokémon were both so cool!
Oh yeah! I'm Hau! You should totally check out Iki Town! We're holding a festival soon!
items.zh:
哇！太棒了！你和你的神奇宝贝都太酷了！
哦耶！我是豪！你绝对应该去壹岐镇看看！我们马上就要举办节日了！
items.normEn:
Whoa! That was awesome! You and your Pokémon were both so cool!
Oh yeah! I'm Hau! You should totally check out Iki Town! We're holding a festival soon!

items.en: Whoa! What the- Where am I? How did I get here? Last thing I can remember I was in Reflection Cave when this little Pokémon with hoops threw something at me… Oh you’ve beaten the Pokémon League? Maybe you can find it roaming around the region so you can tame that little prankster. Now how am I gonna get home…
items.zh: 哇！什么-我在哪儿？我是怎么到这里的？我记得的最后一件事是，我在反射洞里，这个带圈的小神奇宝贝向我扔了一些东西……哦，你已经打败了神奇宝贝联盟？也许你会发现它在该地区漫游，这样你就可以驯服那个小恶作剧者。现在我要怎么回家……
items.normEn: Whoa! What the- Where am I? How did I get here? Last thing I can remember I was in Reflection Cave when this little Pokémon with hoops threw something at me… Oh you’ve beaten the Pokémon League? Maybe you can find it roaming around the region so you can tame that little prankster. Now how am I gonna get home…

items.en: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger splash than I expected! You swamped me! Okay, you've got me. Take this Gym Badge!
items.zh: 哇哇哇！你引起的轰动比我想象的要大得多！你淹没了我！好吧，你有我了。收下这张健身徽章吧！
items.normEn: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger splash than I expected! You swamped me! Okay, you've got me. Take this Gym Badge!

items.en: Why Am I Still Doing This?!
items.normEn: Why Am I Still Doing This?!

items.en: Why am I still playing catch-up to you?!
items.normEn: Why am I still playing catch-up to you?!

items.en: Why Can't I Make a Diamond Shovel?
items.zh: 为什么我不能制作钻石铲？
items.normEn: Why Can't I Make a Diamond Shovel?

items.en: Why Do They Have To Work in Shifts?
items.zh: 为什么他们必须轮班工作？
items.normEn: Why Do They Have To Work in Shifts?

items.en: Why hello there. Nothing strange going on here. Please move along.
items.zh: 为什么你好。这里没有什么奇怪的事情发生。请一起走。
items.normEn: Why hello there. Nothing strange going on here. Please move along.

items.en: Why Is My Voltorb Upside Down?
items.zh: 为什么我的 Voltorb 是颠倒的？
items.normEn: Why Is My Voltorb Upside Down?

items.en: Why should I be breeding Pokémon?
items.zh: 我为什么要培育神奇宝贝？
items.normEn: Why should I be breeding Pokémon?

items.en: Why so shocked? Was it your first time seeing an Ultra Beast? Those mysterious creatures that live beyond the Ultra Wormholes, the holes that suddenly open in the sky and lead to Ultra Space... It would serve you well to remember this.
items.zh: 为何如此震惊？你是第一次见到究极异兽吗？那些生活在究极虫洞之外的神秘生物，天空中突然打开并通向究极空间的洞……记住这一点会对你很有帮助。
items.normEn: Why so shocked? Was it your first time seeing an Ultra Beast? Those mysterious creatures that live beyond the Ultra Wormholes, the holes that suddenly open in the sky and lead to Ultra Space... It would serve you well to remember this.

items.en: Why, hello! Here to look for fossils as well?
items.zh: 为什么，你好！也来这里寻找化石吗？
items.normEn: Why, hello! Here to look for fossils as well?

items.en: Why, you ask? That's because I need a lot of Dungeon Tokens to pay for an amazing rod so I can fish for every single water pokémon! Sadly, it costs too much and I can't afford it because I have to take care of my sisters. Oh, you can help me? Thank you, but I have nothing to offer in return.
items.zh: 你问为什么？那是因为我需要大量的地下城代币来购买一根神奇的鱼竿，这样我才能钓到每一个水神奇宝贝！可悲的是，它的费用太高了，我负担不起，因为我必须照顾我的姐妹们。哦，你能帮我吗？谢谢你，但我没有什么可以回报的。
items.normEn: Why, you ask? That's because I need a lot of Dungeon Tokens to pay for an amazing rod so I can fish for every single water pokémon! Sadly, it costs too much and I can't afford it because I have to take care of my sisters. Oh, you can help me? Thank you, but I have nothing to offer in return.

items.en: Why? Why must...you always...Always, always, always, always...Get in my way!
items.zh: 为什么？为什么一定要……你总是……总是、总是、总是、总是……妨碍我！
items.normEn: Why? Why must...you always...Always, always, always, always...Get in my way!

items.en: Why? Why you?! Why do you have the blessing of Arceus?!
items.zh: 为什么？为什么是你？！为什么你能得到阿尔宙斯的祝福？！
items.normEn: Why? Why you?! Why do you have the blessing of Arceus?!

items.en: Wild shiny Pokémon will now always drop their rare hold item upon being defeated
items.zh: 野生闪亮神奇宝贝现在在被击败时总是会掉落稀有的持有物品
items.normEn: Wild shiny Pokémon will now always drop their rare hold item upon being defeated

items.en: Will I Ever Need All This Help?
items.zh: 我需要所有这些帮助吗？
items.normEn: Will I Ever Need All This Help?

items.en: Will my progress be carried over on release?
items.zh: 我的进度会在发布时延续吗？
items.normEn: Will my progress be carried over on release?

items.en: With interesting thoughts about Team Flare in your head, you decide to challenge the Cyllage City Gym to become stronger.
items.zh: 脑海中浮现出关于耀焰队的有趣想法，你决定挑战 Cyllage City 道馆，让自己变得更强。
items.normEn: With interesting thoughts about Team Flare in your head, you decide to challenge the Cyllage City Gym to become stronger.

items.en: With Protein your Pokémon will become even stronger when you breed them. I hear they sell it at the Indigo Plateau.
items.zh: 有了蛋白质，你的神奇宝贝在繁殖时会变得更加强大。我听说靛蓝高原上有卖的。
items.normEn: With Protein your Pokémon will become even stronger when you breed them. I hear they sell it at the Indigo Plateau.

items.en: With that, you can stamp your ticket to the noble Galar region!
items.zh: 这样就可以在前往高贵的伽勒尔地区的车票上盖章了！
items.normEn: With that, you can stamp your ticket to the noble Galar region!

items.en: With the default catch filters, you will see that both "Caught" and "New Shiny" meet their conditions, but the "New Shiny" filter is the one used for catching. The filter furthest down in your list that matches all conditions is the one used. The highlighted filters are ones that matched the scenario.
items.zh: 使用默认的捕获过滤器，您将看到“Caught”和“New Shiny”都满足其条件，但“New Shiny”过滤器是用于捕获的过滤器。列表中最靠下的、符合所有条件的过滤器就是所使用的过滤器。突出显示的过滤器是与场景匹配的过滤器。
items.normEn: With the default catch filters, you will see that both "Caught" and "New Shiny" meet their conditions, but the "New Shiny" filter is the one used for catching. The filter furthest down in your list that matches all conditions is the one used. The highlighted filters are ones that matched the scenario.

items.en: With the power contained within, I will become the King of the Sea - far stronger than the old fool guiding us before!
items.zh: 凭借其中蕴含的力量，我将成为海之王——远比之前引导我们的老傻瓜强大！
items.normEn: With the power contained within, I will become the King of the Sea - far stronger than the old fool guiding us before!

items.en: With the power of the Tidal Bell, we call to Lugia! Guardian of the Whirl Islands!
items.zh: 凭借潮汐之钟的力量，我们呼唤洛奇亚！漩涡群岛的守护者！
items.normEn: With the power of the Tidal Bell, we call to Lugia! Guardian of the Whirl Islands!

items.en: With this amazing new team of mine, I'll finally beat you, my strongest rival!
items.zh: 凭借我这支令人惊叹的新团队，我终于击败了你，我最强的对手！
items.normEn: With this amazing new team of mine, I'll finally beat you, my strongest rival!

items.en: With this robot, we can explore the deserts of Orre! Surely Chobin and $playername$ will find something interesting!
items.zh: 有了这个机器人，我们就可以探索奥尔沙漠了！ Chobin 和 $playername$ 肯定会发现一些有趣的东西！
items.normEn: With this robot, we can explore the deserts of Orre! Surely Chobin and $playername$ will find something interesting!

items.en: Withered berries statistics not increasing correctly
items.zh: 枯萎浆果统计数据未正确增加
items.normEn: Withered berries statistics not increasing correctly

items.en: Witness the battle between the Red Genesect and another powerful Pokémon in Castelia City.
items.zh: 在卡斯特利亚市见证红色盖诺赛克特与另一只强大神奇宝贝之间的战斗。
items.normEn: Witness the battle between the Red Genesect and another powerful Pokémon in Castelia City.

items.en: Witnessing the noble spirits of you and your Pokémon in battle has really touched my heart...
items.zh: 目睹你和你的神奇宝贝在战斗中展现出的高贵精神真的让我很感动……
items.normEn: Witnessing the noble spirits of you and your Pokémon in battle has really touched my heart...

items.en: Woah there, tester! This quest is still under development! You should go out there and test the story in the meantime, yeah!
items.zh: 哇哦，测试员！该任务仍在开发中！与此同时，你应该出去测试一下这个故事，是的！
items.normEn: Woah there, tester! This quest is still under development! You should go out there and test the story in the meantime, yeah!

items.en: Woah! I'm shocked at your strength! But you've only just begun my real trial. Now you have to go around to all the captains in Alola!
items.zh: 哇哦！我对你的实力感到震惊！但你对我真正的考验才刚刚开始。现在你必须去找阿罗拉的所有队长！
items.normEn: Woah! I'm shocked at your strength! But you've only just begun my real trial. Now you have to go around to all the captains in Alola!

items.en: Wonderful! Do You Like To Collect Things?
items.zh: 精彩的！你喜欢收集东西吗？
items.normEn: Wonderful! Do You Like To Collect Things?

items.en: Wonderful. I'm grateful that we had a chance to meet and battle. It reminded me that Pokémon battles are about working with others to meet our challenges together.
items.zh: 精彩的。我很感激我们有机会见面并战斗。它提醒我，神奇宝贝对战就是与他人合作，共同应对挑战。
items.normEn: Wonderful. I'm grateful that we had a chance to meet and battle. It reminded me that Pokémon battles are about working with others to meet our challenges together.

items.en: Worse, if what I overheard is true then this time, you're about to commit an error more abominable than before!
items.zh: 更糟糕的是，如果我无意中听到的是真的，那么这一次，你将犯下比以前更严重的错误！
items.normEn: Worse, if what I overheard is true then this time, you're about to commit an error more abominable than before!

items.en: Would you be able to bring Ash here? I think the 3 of us together should be able to calm the lot of them down. He's probably still at the Master Dojo.
items.zh: 你能带阿什来这里吗？我想我们三个人一起应该能够让他们平静下来。他大概还在大师道场。
items.normEn: Would you be able to bring Ash here? I think the 3 of us together should be able to calm the lot of them down. He's probably still at the Master Dojo.

items.en: Would you catch that Pokémon and show it to me, please?
items.zh: 请你抓住那个神奇宝贝并把它给我看好吗？
items.normEn: Would you catch that Pokémon and show it to me, please?

items.en: Would you do me the favour of protecting me from wild Pokémon at the Old Cemetery and Snowslide Slope? I wish to grow a Shaderoot Carrot and an Iceroot Carrot which I believe could draw out my loyal steeds.
items.zh: 你能帮我一个忙，保护我免受旧墓地和雪滑坡的野生神奇宝贝的侵害吗？我希望种植一个影根胡萝卜和一个冰根胡萝卜，我相信它们可以吸引我忠诚的战马。
items.normEn: Would you do me the favour of protecting me from wild Pokémon at the Old Cemetery and Snowslide Slope? I wish to grow a Shaderoot Carrot and an Iceroot Carrot which I believe could draw out my loyal steeds.

items.en: Would you mind farming some Pinkan Berries to help us grow our supply? We don't know how to, but we've heard the Berry Master in Kanto could be helpful?
items.zh: 您介意种植一些 Pinkan 浆果来帮助我们增加供应吗？我们不知道该怎么做，但我们听说关东的浆果大师可能会有所帮助？
items.normEn: Would you mind farming some Pinkan Berries to help us grow our supply? We don't know how to, but we've heard the Berry Master in Kanto could be helpful?

items.en: Would you take a look at that! Now that's something you don't see every day... This place definitely feels like the stuff of legend. See that! The sword and the shield! The legends really were true!
items.zh: 你能看一下吗！这是你每天都看不到的东西……这个地方绝对感觉像是传说中的东西。看到那个！剑与盾！传说果然是真的！
items.normEn: Would you take a look at that! Now that's something you don't see every day... This place definitely feels like the stuff of legend. See that! The sword and the shield! The legends really were true!

items.en: Wow you're pretty good at the farm, $playername$! I'll go buy the palm tree seeds right this instant!
items.zh: 哇，你的农场很厉害，$playername$！我现在就去买棕榈树种子！
items.normEn: Wow you're pretty good at the farm, $playername$! I'll go buy the palm tree seeds right this instant!

items.en: Wow, that was some back breaking work... But I have done it!
items.zh: 哇，这真是一项艰巨的工作……但我已经做到了！
items.normEn: Wow, that was some back breaking work... But I have done it!

items.en: Wow, that's a lot of stuff! This place is starting to look like a proper lab now!
items.zh: 哇，这么多东西！这个地方现在开始看起来像一个合适的实验室了！
items.normEn: Wow, that's a lot of stuff! This place is starting to look like a proper lab now!

items.en: Wow, these battles are intense. It's getting hard to keep up with you... I think I need a break.
items.zh: 哇，这些战斗很激烈。很难跟上你的脚步了……我想我需要休息一下。
items.normEn: Wow, these battles are intense. It's getting hard to keep up with you... I think I need a break.

items.en: Wow, you actually beat Celebi! It looked like it had fun! It's ran off for now, but maybe if you find it again, it'll let you catch it.
items.zh: 哇，你居然打败了雪拉比！看起来玩得很开心！它现在已经跑掉了，但也许如果你再次找到它，它会让你抓住它。
items.normEn: Wow, you actually beat Celebi! It looked like it had fun! It's ran off for now, but maybe if you find it again, it'll let you catch it.

items.en: Wow, you caught us AND you beat us. You've won all our games so far! But Braviary still wants to get to know you even better. Up to the roof we go! All right, Braviary! Why not test out their strength for yourself?
items.zh: 哇，你抓住了我们并且击败了我们。到目前为止，您已经赢得了我们所有的比赛！但 Braviary 仍然想进一步了解您。我们去屋顶吧！好吧，布拉维里！为什么不亲自测试一下他们的实力呢？
items.normEn: Wow, you caught us AND you beat us. You've won all our games so far! But Braviary still wants to get to know you even better. Up to the roof we go! All right, Braviary! Why not test out their strength for yourself?

items.en: Wow, you're even stronger than I thought! Looks like you've cleared all three of Akala's trials! Here! A gift for such an inspiring young Trainer!
items.zh: 哇，你比我想象的还要强！看起来你已经完成了阿卡拉的全部三项试炼！这里！送给如此鼓舞人心的年轻教练的礼物！
items.normEn: Wow, you're even stronger than I thought! Looks like you've cleared all three of Akala's trials! Here! A gift for such an inspiring young Trainer!

items.en: Wow, you're strong! Well, I guess that's that. Here, you can have this.
items.zh: 哇，你好强啊！嗯，我想就是这样。在这里，你可以拥有这个。
items.normEn: Wow, you're strong! Well, I guess that's that. Here, you can have this.

items.en: Wow, you're the cream of the 'karp, alright!
items.zh: 哇，你真是卡普中的佼佼者，好吧！
items.normEn: Wow, you're the cream of the 'karp, alright!

items.en: Wow, you've been drinking your Training Sodas!
items.zh: 哇，你一直在喝训练苏打水！
items.normEn: Wow, you've been drinking your Training Sodas!

items.en: Wow, you've got some strong Pokémon! You might be able to beat Team Cipher! I heard they re-activated their operations at the Cipher Lab.
items.zh: 哇，你有一些强大的神奇宝贝！你也许能够击败Team Cipher！我听说他们重新启动了密码实验室的运作。
items.normEn: Wow, you've got some strong Pokémon! You might be able to beat Team Cipher! I heard they re-activated their operations at the Cipher Lab.

items.zh: 哇！一个真实的、活生生的盖诺赛克特！

items.en: Wow! Absolutely no one could have seen this coming! You think you might find Lysandre in Lumiose City where you first met him. Look for him!
items.zh: 哇！绝对没有人能预见到这一幕！你认为你可能会在你第一次见到莱桑德尔的卢米奥塞市找到他。去找他！
items.normEn: Wow! Absolutely no one could have seen this coming! You think you might find Lysandre in Lumiose City where you first met him. Look for him!
