items.en: Wow! I'll let you buy some of my super fancy stones, now that I know you're a serious trainer!
items.zh: 哇！既然我知道你是一位认真的训练师，我就让你买一些我的超级宝石！
items.normEn: Wow! I'll let you buy some of my super fancy stones, now that I know you're a serious trainer!

items.en: Wow! That's great! You're pretty good!
items.zh: 哇！那太棒了！你真不错啊！
items.normEn: Wow! That's great! You're pretty good!

items.en: Wow! The Crown Tundra is filled with wild fossil Pokémon! I've heard stories of these snowfields protecting the Pokémon living here, but this level of sanctuary is insane!
items.zh: 哇！皇冠苔原充满了野生神奇宝贝化石！我听说过这些雪原保护住在这里的神奇宝贝的故事，但这种级别的庇护所太疯狂了！
items.normEn: Wow! The Crown Tundra is filled with wild fossil Pokémon! I've heard stories of these snowfields protecting the Pokémon living here, but this level of sanctuary is insane!

items.en: Wow! You are strong, after all! I couldn't beat you today, but one of these days, I'll catch up to you!
items.zh: 哇！毕竟你很强！今天我没能打败你，但总有一天我会追上你的！
items.normEn: Wow! You are strong, after all! I couldn't beat you today, but one of these days, I'll catch up to you!

items.en: Wow! You're great! You've earned my respect! I think your focus and will bowled us over totally. Oh, that's right! I'm supposed to give you this!
items.zh: 哇！你太棒了！你赢得了我的尊重！我认为你的专注和意志会让我们彻底崩溃。哦，原来如此！我应该给你这个！
items.normEn: Wow! You're great! You've earned my respect! I think your focus and will bowled us over totally. Oh, that's right! I'm supposed to give you this!

items.en: Wow! You're too much, all right! You can have the CascadeBadge to show that you beat me.
items.zh: 哇！你太过分了，好吧！你可以拥有 CascadeBadge 来证明你打败了我。
items.normEn: Wow! You're too much, all right! You can have the CascadeBadge to show that you beat me.

items.en: Wow. You're just as amazing as ever. You're truly worthy of your title.
items.zh: 哇。你一如既往地令人惊奇。你确实配得上你的称号。
items.normEn: Wow. You're just as amazing as ever. You're truly worthy of your title.

items.en: Wrap up your research project by talking to Dr. Splash in Hoppy Town.
items.zh: 与 Hoppy Town 的 Splash 博士交谈，结束您的研究项目。
items.normEn: Wrap up your research project by talking to Dr. Splash in Hoppy Town.

items.en: Wrong! There is a fourth! Did you know you can find all of the Oricorio forms on the farm? One of them doesn't appear anywhere else!
items.zh: 错误的！还有第四个！您知道您可以在农场找到所有 Oricorio 表格吗？其中之一没有出现在其他地方！
items.normEn: Wrong! There is a fourth! Did you know you can find all of the Oricorio forms on the farm? One of them doesn't appear anywhere else!

items.en: Xerosic offers you the possibility to stop the ultimate weapon in Lumiose City. Blue or Red Button, press one!
items.zh: Xerosic 为您提供了阻止 Lumiose City 终极武器的可能性。蓝色或红色按钮，按一个！
items.normEn: Xerosic offers you the possibility to stop the ultimate weapon in Lumiose City. Blue or Red Button, press one!

items.en: xExp is now the Lucky Egg
items.normEn: xExp is now the Lucky Egg

items.en: Xurkitree has been spotted at Memorial Hill and Lush Jungle!
items.zh: Xurkitree 已在纪念山和郁郁葱葱的丛林中被发现！
items.normEn: Xurkitree has been spotted at Memorial Hill and Lush Jungle!

items.en: Y'all got any more of them Mega Stones?
items.zh: 你们还有更多巨型石头吗？
items.normEn: Y'all got any more of them Mega Stones?

items.en: Y'know, Zacian and Zamazenta got the Rusted Sword and the Rusted Shield back, right?
items.zh: 你知道，扎西安和扎马森塔拿回了生锈之剑和生锈之盾，对吧？
items.normEn: Y'know, Zacian and Zamazenta got the Rusted Sword and the Rusted Shield back, right?

items.en: Ya boy Guzma is here. Defeat him in the Aether Foundation dungeon. Lusamine is next.
items.zh: 古兹马小子来了。在以太基金会地牢中击败他。下一个是露莎米奈。
items.normEn: Ya boy Guzma is here. Defeat him in the Aether Foundation dungeon. Lusamine is next.

items.en: Yaaay! This is my favorite part! I wanna see just how good you are! So, why not have a battle with little old me? Just say the word when you're ready!
items.zh: 耶！这是我最喜欢的部分！我倒要看看你到底有多厉害！那么，何不和小老我来一场战斗呢？准备好后就说吧！
items.normEn: Yaaay! This is my favorite part! I wanna see just how good you are! So, why not have a battle with little old me? Just say the word when you're ready!

items.en: Yeah I lost, but I'm gonna learn from your battle style and everythin'!
items.zh: 是的，我输了，但我会学习你的战斗风格和一切！
items.normEn: Yeah I lost, but I'm gonna learn from your battle style and everythin'!

items.en: Yeah, whatever! I was leaving anyways.
items.zh: 是啊，无论如何！无论如何我都要离开了。
items.normEn: Yeah, whatever! I was leaving anyways.

items.en: Yeah, yeah, you're just a bit better than me, as usual.
items.zh: 是啊，是啊，你只是比我好一点，和往常一样。
items.normEn: Yeah, yeah, you're just a bit better than me, as usual.

items.en: Yeh believe in yer Pokémon... And they believe in yeh, too... Mighty oaks from acorns grow. Go on, then. Yeh've earned it. Here's yer own Plant Badge, sprout.
items.zh: 你相信你的神奇宝贝......他们也相信你......强大的橡树从橡子中生长出来。那么，继续吧。耶已经赚到了。这是你自己的植物徽章，芽芽。
items.normEn: Yeh believe in yer Pokémon... And they believe in yeh, too... Mighty oaks from acorns grow. Go on, then. Yeh've earned it. Here's yer own Plant Badge, sprout.

items.en: Yep! The rules are simple. Whoever wins will complete the trial! The winner will be granted the secret armor of the Master Dojo!
items.zh: 是的！规则很简单。谁获胜，谁就完成试炼！获胜者将获得大师道场的秘密铠甲！
items.normEn: Yep! The rules are simple. Whoever wins will complete the trial! The winner will be granted the secret armor of the Master Dojo!

items.en: Yes, I am one of the Draconid people. One of those ancient folk tasked with passing down the knowledge of Mega Evolution—with the great lore of Lord Rayquaza, who was the beginning of all.
items.zh: 是的，我是天龙人之一。那些古老的民间人物之一，肩负着传承超级进化知识的使命——以及烈空坐领主的伟大传说，他是一切的开始。
items.normEn: Yes, I am one of the Draconid people. One of those ancient folk tasked with passing down the knowledge of Mega Evolution—with the great lore of Lord Rayquaza, who was the beginning of all.

items.en: Yes, I heard that Professor Krane was kidnapped from the Pokémon HQ Lab. There's some shady characters up on Mount Battle who might know more.
items.zh: 是的，我听说克兰教授被从神奇宝贝总部实验室绑架了。 Mount Battle 上有一些可疑的人物可能知道更多。
items.normEn: Yes, I heard that Professor Krane was kidnapped from the Pokémon HQ Lab. There's some shady characters up on Mount Battle who might know more.

items.en: Yes, in short, it makes it possible for Necrozma to fuse with the light of the Legendary Pokémon Solgaleo! This is the Colress Machine No. 1198, officially dubbed the N-Solarizer!
items.zh: 是的，简而言之，它使得奈克洛兹玛能够与传奇神奇宝贝索尔迦雷欧的光芒融合！这是Colress Machine No. 1198，正式名称为N-Solarizer！
items.normEn: Yes, in short, it makes it possible for Necrozma to fuse with the light of the Legendary Pokémon Solgaleo! This is the Colress Machine No. 1198, officially dubbed the N-Solarizer!

items.en: Yes, once a Pokémon is shiny, it will always remain shiny.
items.zh: 是的，一旦神奇宝贝变得闪亮，它就会永远保持闪亮。
items.normEn: Yes, once a Pokémon is shiny, it will always remain shiny.

items.en: Yes, they give an extra 100% bonus to Click Attack.
items.zh: 是的，他们为点击攻击提供了额外的 100% 奖励。
items.normEn: Yes, they give an extra 100% bonus to Click Attack.

items.en: Yes, you can unlock up to 4 quest slots.
items.zh: 是的，您最多可以解锁 4 个任务槽位。
items.normEn: Yes, you can unlock up to 4 quest slots.

items.en: Yes! Download a copy of the save file from
items.zh: 是的！从以下位置下载保存文件的副本
items.normEn: Yes! Download a copy of the save file from

items.en: Yes! Expose your true, barbaric, brutish nature...and reveal to us exactly who the false kings are!
items.zh: 是的！暴露你的真实、野蛮、野蛮本性……并向我们揭露谁是假国王！
items.normEn: Yes! Expose your true, barbaric, brutish nature...and reveal to us exactly who the false kings are!

items.en: Yes! Finally! The moment I have been waiting for! I have gathered enough Key Stones to draw out the latent power in Rayquaza and stop the impending disaster!
items.zh: 是的！最后！我一直在等待的那一刻！我已经收集了足够的钥匙石，可以引出烈空座的潜在力量，阻止即将到来的灾难！
items.normEn: Yes! Finally! The moment I have been waiting for! I have gathered enough Key Stones to draw out the latent power in Rayquaza and stop the impending disaster!

items.en: Yes! That's the one! It's Pikachu, right? Ohhh, I've wanted to meet it for so long. Such a cutie. You deserve this Thunder Stone!
items.zh: 是的！就是这个！是皮卡丘吧？呵呵，我想见见它很久了。真是个可爱的人。这颗雷霆石你值得拥有！
items.normEn: Yes! That's the one! It's Pikachu, right? Ohhh, I've wanted to meet it for so long. Such a cutie. You deserve this Thunder Stone!

items.en: Yes! You have emerged victorious! You and your Pokémon have become quite a delightful team! Off to Lush Jungle? It's been a while since I last visited Akala.
items.zh: 是的！你已经胜利了！你和你的神奇宝贝已经成为一支令人愉快的团队！前往郁郁葱葱的丛林？自从我上次访问阿卡拉以来已经有一段时间了。
items.normEn: Yes! You have emerged victorious! You and your Pokémon have become quite a delightful team! Off to Lush Jungle? It's been a while since I last visited Akala.

items.en: Yes... That was a fine battle. I shall reward you for this great victory. This is the Fairy Badge. It is yours now. Its beauty is captivating, is it not? ... ... ... ... ... ... Ah... Do forgive me. I was so captivated, I forgot for a moment that it is yours.
items.zh: 是的……那是一场精彩的战斗。我将奖励你这次伟大的胜利。这就是妖精徽章。现在它是你的了。它的美丽令人着迷，不是吗？ ………………啊……请原谅我。我太着迷了，一时忘记了这是你的。
items.normEn: Yes... That was a fine battle. I shall reward you for this great victory. This is the Fairy Badge. It is yours now. Its beauty is captivating, is it not? ... ... ... ... ... ... Ah... Do forgive me. I was so captivated, I forgot for a moment that it is yours.

items.en: Yesterday was my first day working on Mount Lanakila. I was up there maintaining the paths to the new Pokémon League.
items.zh: 昨天是我在拉纳基拉山工作的第一天。我在那里维护通往新神奇宝贝联盟的道路。
items.normEn: Yesterday was my first day working on Mount Lanakila. I was up there maintaining the paths to the new Pokémon League.

items.en: Yikes! You're better than I expected!
items.zh: 哎呀！你比我想象的还要好！
items.normEn: Yikes! You're better than I expected!

items.en: Yo, think about the bus drivers! If we take this bus stop, they can all chill!
items.zh: 哟，想想公交车司机吧！如果我们坐这个公交车站，他们就都可以冷静下来了！
items.normEn: Yo, think about the bus drivers! If we take this bus stop, they can all chill!

items.en: Yo, traveler! The name's Ryuki! You've come here to battle against a star like me, haven't you? No? Why's that? I see, you're looking for something?
items.zh: 哟，旅行者！名字叫琉璃！你来这里就是为了和我这样的明星战斗的，不是吗？不？这是为什么呢？我明白了，你在找东西吗？
items.normEn: Yo, traveler! The name's Ryuki! You've come here to battle against a star like me, haven't you? No? Why's that? I see, you're looking for something?

items.en: Yo, wasn't that Suicune just now? I only caught a quick glimpse, but I thought I saw Suicune running on the waves.
items.zh: 哟，刚才那不是水君吗？我只瞥见了一眼，但我以为我看到了水君在海浪上奔跑。
items.normEn: Yo, wasn't that Suicune just now? I only caught a quick glimpse, but I thought I saw Suicune running on the waves.

items.en: Yo! Find any cool stuff in chests lately?
items.zh: 哟！最近在箱子里发现了什么很酷的东西吗？
items.normEn: Yo! Find any cool stuff in chests lately?

items.en:
You and the others were great.
Now I'd like to give you and your fellow challengers something you really deserve. The Sea Ruby badge. It's yours.
items.zh: 你和其他人都很棒。现在我想给你和你的挑战者同伴一些你真正应得的东西。海红宝石徽章。这是你的。
items.normEn: You and the others were great. Now I'd like to give you and your fellow challengers something you really deserve. The Sea Ruby badge. It's yours.

items.en: You and your Pokémon are both excellent and elegant. To have been able to battle against such a splendid team... My Pokémon and I learned a lot! I offer you my thanks.
items.zh: 你和你的神奇宝贝都非常优秀而且优雅。能够和如此优秀的队伍对战……我和我的神奇宝贝学到了很多东西！我向你表示感谢。
items.normEn: You and your Pokémon are both excellent and elegant. To have been able to battle against such a splendid team... My Pokémon and I learned a lot! I offer you my thanks.

items.en: You and your Pokémon seem completely in step with one another.
items.zh: 你和你的神奇宝贝看起来完全步调一致。
items.normEn: You and your Pokémon seem completely in step with one another.

items.en: You are almost there! One more time traversing through the Team Flare Secret HQ and you'll get to the end! Fifth step: Beating Team Flare Lysandre.
items.zh: 你快到了！再穿越一次耀斑小队秘密总部，你就会到达终点！第五步：击败 Flare Lysandre 队。
items.normEn: You are almost there! One more time traversing through the Team Flare Secret HQ and you'll get to the end! Fifth step: Beating Team Flare Lysandre.

items.en: You are being stalked by Absol, the Disaster Pokémon. Capture it or hatch your own to befriend it.
items.zh: 你正被灾难神奇宝贝阿勃索尔跟踪。捕获它或孵化自己的动物来与它交朋友。
items.normEn: You are being stalked by Absol, the Disaster Pokémon. Capture it or hatch your own to befriend it.

items.en: You are challenged by Pokémon Trainer Lillie! Welcome her to the world of trainers by battling her at the Altar of the Sunne and Moone.
items.zh: 神奇宝贝训练家莉莉艾向你发起挑战！欢迎她来到训练师的世界，在苏尼和穆恩祭坛与她战斗。
items.normEn: You are challenged by Pokémon Trainer Lillie! Welcome her to the world of trainers by battling her at the Altar of the Sunne and Moone.

items.en: You are getting close. Resume delving into the Team Flare Secret HQ! Fourth step: Beating Team Flare Mable.
items.zh: 你正在接近。继续深入研究耀斑队的秘密总部！第四步：击败 Flare Mable 团队。
items.normEn: You are getting close. Resume delving into the Team Flare Secret HQ! Fourth step: Beating Team Flare Mable.

items.en: You are indeed powerful. I think you can help Zinnia.
items.zh: 你确实很强大。我想你可以帮助百日草。
items.normEn: You are indeed powerful. I think you can help Zinnia.

items.en: You are my favorite for sure
items.normEn: You are my favorite for sure

items.en: You are really something! You and your Pokémon have developed strong bonds by spending time together and by caring about one another. That's why you and your Pokémon are so strong.
items.zh: 你还真是个东西啊！你和你的神奇宝贝通过花时间在一起并互相关心而建立了牢固的联系。这就是为什么你和你的神奇宝贝如此强大。
items.normEn: You are really something! You and your Pokémon have developed strong bonds by spending time together and by caring about one another. That's why you and your Pokémon are so strong.

items.en: You are the new Alola League champion!
items.zh: 你是新的阿罗拉联盟冠军！
items.normEn: You are the new Alola League champion!

items.en: You are the new Galar League champion!
items.zh: 你是新任伽勒尔联盟冠军！
items.normEn: You are the new Galar League champion!

items.en: You are the new Hoenn League champion!
items.zh: 你是新任丰缘联赛冠军！
items.normEn: You are the new Hoenn League champion!

items.en: You are the new Johto League champion!
items.zh: 你是新任城都联赛冠军！
items.normEn: You are the new Johto League champion!

items.en: You are the new Kalos League champion!
items.zh: 你是新的卡洛斯联盟冠军！
items.normEn: You are the new Kalos League champion!

items.en: You are the new Pokémon League champion!
items.zh: 你是新的神奇宝贝联盟冠军！
items.normEn: You are the new Pokémon League champion!

items.en: You are the new Sinnoh League champion!
items.zh: 你是新的神奥联赛冠军！
items.normEn: You are the new Sinnoh League champion!

items.en: You are the new Unova League champion!
items.zh: 你是新的合众联盟冠军！
items.normEn: You are the new Unova League champion!

items.en: You are too late to stop me! The R drug puts Pokémon in a frenzied state, and allows us to control them with the right equipment! You led me straight to Mewtwo, and now I will take control of the most powerful Pokémon in the world!
items.zh: 你来不及阻止我了！ R药可以让神奇宝贝陷入疯狂状态，让我们可以用合适的装备来控制它们！你带领我直接找到了超梦，现在我将掌控世界上最强大的神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: You are too late to stop me! The R drug puts Pokémon in a frenzied state, and allows us to control them with the right equipment! You led me straight to Mewtwo, and now I will take control of the most powerful Pokémon in the world!

items.en: You are very lucky! I just now found a fossil! But it's one I already have, so I'll give it to you!
items.zh: 你很幸运！我刚刚发现了化石！不过我已经有了，所以我就把它给你吧！
items.normEn: You are very lucky! I just now found a fossil! But it's one I already have, so I'll give it to you!

items.en: You beat me... Guess you must not be so bad after all, huh?
items.zh: 你打败了我……我想你的实力应该也没有那么差吧？
items.normEn: You beat me... Guess you must not be so bad after all, huh?

items.en: You brought Ash? Fantastic! And just in time, the Zarude are starting to wake up. Ash, could you have your Pokémon help me explain to them what's going on?
items.zh: 你把阿什带来了？极好的！就在此时，扎鲁德人开始苏醒。小智，你能让你的神奇宝贝帮我向他们解释一下发生了什么事吗？
items.normEn: You brought Ash? Fantastic! And just in time, the Zarude are starting to wake up. Ash, could you have your Pokémon help me explain to them what's going on?

items.en: You calmed down Xerneas and it ran away to the back of the lab.
items.zh: 你让哲尔尼亚斯平静下来，它就跑到了实验室的后面。
items.normEn: You calmed down Xerneas and it ran away to the back of the lab.

items.en: You calmed down Yveltal and it ran away to the back of the lab.
items.zh: 你让伊维尔塔尔平静下来，它就跑到了实验室的后面。
items.normEn: You calmed down Yveltal and it ran away to the back of the lab.

items.en: You can adjust your Catch Filters to catch any Shadow Pokémon now too.
items.zh: 您现在也可以调整捕捉过滤器来捕捉任何暗影神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: You can adjust your Catch Filters to catch any Shadow Pokémon now too.

items.en: You can change the browser flags, but this is
items.zh: 您可以更改浏览器标志，但这是
items.normEn: You can change the browser flags, but this is

items.en: You can click Gems in the Start Menu to boost your damage using these gems. For example, using rock gems you can boost the super effective damage of your rock type Pokémon! Those flying types had better watch out for your might!
items.zh: 您可以单击开始菜单中的宝石来使用这些宝石来提高伤害。例如，使用岩石宝石可以提高岩石类型神奇宝贝的超级有效伤害！飞行系的人可要注意一下自己的实力了！
items.normEn: You can click Gems in the Start Menu to boost your damage using these gems. For example, using rock gems you can boost the super effective damage of your rock type Pokémon! Those flying types had better watch out for your might!

items.en: You can click on it to inflict damage
items.zh: 你可以点击它来造成伤害
items.normEn: You can click on it to inflict damage

items.en: You can complete your quest for ${...} Quest Points!
items.zh: 您只需花费 ${...} 任务点即可完成您的任务！
items.normEn: You can complete your quest for ${...} Quest Points!

items.en: You can deactivate the challenges at any point, but they cannot be activated later.
items.zh: 您可以随时停用挑战，但以后无法激活它们。
items.normEn: You can deactivate the challenges at any point, but they cannot be activated later.

items.en: You can even use this to eliminate immunities! By using electric gems to boost your electric type immune damage, your electric Pokémon can suddenly do damage against ground types!
items.zh: 您甚至可以用它来消除免疫力！通过使用电宝石来增强你的电系免疫伤害，你的电系神奇宝贝可以突然对地面类型造成伤害！
items.normEn: You can even use this to eliminate immunities! By using electric gems to boost your electric type immune damage, your electric Pokémon can suddenly do damage against ground types!

items.en: You can follow your progress in your Pokédex.
items.zh: 您可以在图鉴中追踪您的进度。
items.normEn: You can follow your progress in your Pokédex.

items.zh: 您可以将鼠标悬停（或点击）

items.en: You can leave early and return to your checkpoint later on.
items.zh: 您可以提前离开并稍后返回检查站。
items.normEn: You can leave early and return to your checkpoint later on.

items.en: You can leave your level 100 Pokémon here in the hatchery to gain an egg of the same Pokémon.
items.zh: 您可以将等级为 100 的神奇宝贝留在孵化场中，以获得同一个神奇宝贝的蛋。
items.normEn: You can leave your level 100 Pokémon here in the hatchery to gain an egg of the same Pokémon.

items.en: You can leave your level 100 Pokémon with us up at the Hatchery. Breeding them will reset their level, but they will be stronger! They gain 25% of their base attack!
items.zh: 您可以将您的 100 级神奇宝贝留在孵化场。培育它们会重置它们的等级，但它们会变得更强！他们获得基础攻击力的 25%！
items.normEn: You can leave your level 100 Pokémon with us up at the Hatchery. Breeding them will reset their level, but they will be stronger! They gain 25% of their base attack!

items.en: You can lock specific plots by toggling on the lock with the lock button
items.zh: 您可以通过使用锁定按钮打开锁定来锁定特定绘图
items.normEn: You can lock specific plots by toggling on the lock with the lock button

items.en: You can now store an additional four eggs in the queue! His research has really gained speed.
items.zh: 您现在可以在队列中存储额外的四个鸡蛋！他的研究速度确实加快了。
items.normEn: You can now store an additional four eggs in the queue! His research has really gained speed.

items.en: You can now travel on to
items.normEn: You can now travel on to

items.en: You can progress to the next route after you have defeated 10 Pokémon.
items.zh: 击败 10 只神奇宝贝后即可进入下一条路线。
items.normEn: You can progress to the next route after you have defeated 10 Pokémon.

items.en: You can see in Geosenge Town the Team Flare Grunt you battled earlier. Approach him once more.
items.zh: 你可以在巨石镇看到你之前战斗过的团队闪光步兵。再一次靠近他。
items.normEn: You can see in Geosenge Town the Team Flare Grunt you battled earlier. Approach him once more.

items.en: You can still buy and find them, so the related achievements can still be completed. After getting them you can get a money refund by inputting the code: "REFUND-VITAMINS" (one use only).
items.zh: 你仍然可以购买和找到它们，因此相关成就仍然可以完成。收到后，您可以通过输入代码“REFUND-VITAMINS”（仅限一次）获得退款。
items.normEn: You can still buy and find them, so the related achievements can still be completed. After getting them you can get a money refund by inputting the code: "REFUND-VITAMINS" (one use only).

items.en: You can still buy or find these items even if you can't use them.
items.zh: 即使您无法使用这些物品，您仍然可以购买或找到它们。
items.normEn: You can still buy or find these items even if you can't use them.

items.en: You can still get gems and use them to buy items such as flutes or Pokémon.
items.zh: 您仍然可以获得宝石并用它们购买笛子或神奇宝贝等物品。
items.normEn: You can still get gems and use them to buy items such as flutes or Pokémon.

items.en: You can unlock a plot by using the toggle or pressing
items.zh: 您可以使用切换开关或按
items.normEn: You can unlock a plot by using the toggle or pressing

items.en: You can use evolution items by clicking
items.zh: 您可以通过点击使用进化物品
items.normEn: You can use evolution items by clicking

items.en: You can use the Contagious Poké Ball selector (unlocked after getting Pokérus) to focus catching Pokémon with less than 50 EVs. Note that setting this selector to "Do not catch" will prevent you from catching any Contagious Pokémon, even if your Caught selector has a Poké Ball set.
items.zh: 您可以使用传染性神奇宝贝球选择器（获得神奇宝贝后解锁）来集中捕捉 EV 数少于 50 的神奇宝贝。请注意，将此选择器设置为“不捕捉”将阻止您捕捉任何传染性神奇宝贝，即使您的“捕捉”选择器具有神奇宝贝球套装。
items.normEn: You can use the Contagious Poké Ball selector (unlocked after getting Pokérus) to focus catching Pokémon with less than 50 EVs. Note that setting this selector to "Do not catch" will prevent you from catching any Contagious Pokémon, even if your Caught selector has a Poké Ball set.

items.en: You can use the Poké Ball Selector to select which type of Poké Ball to use on specific Pokémon based on caught status.
items.zh: 您可以使用神奇宝贝球选择器根据捕获的状态选择对特定神奇宝贝使用哪种类型的神奇宝贝球。
items.normEn: You can use the Poké Ball Selector to select which type of Poké Ball to use on specific Pokémon based on caught status.

items.en: You can use the Shop Amount Button settings to make it easy for big purchases, too!
items.zh: 您也可以使用“商店金额按钮”设置来轻松进行大额购买！
items.normEn: You can use the Shop Amount Button settings to make it easy for big purchases, too!

items.en: You can't access that dungeon right now!
items.zh: 你现在无法进入那个地牢！
items.normEn: You can't access that dungeon right now!

items.en: You can't access this dungeon right now because all of its bosses are locked.
items.zh: 你现在无法进入这个地牢，因为它的所有 Boss 都被锁定了。
items.normEn: You can't access this dungeon right now because all of its bosses are locked.

items.en: You can't currently afford to hire me...
items.normEn: You can't currently afford to hire me...

items.en: You can't enter this dungeon right now.
items.zh: 你现在不能进入这个地牢。
items.normEn: You can't enter this dungeon right now.

items.en: You can't miss them: they wear black glasses and they'll try to play tricks on you.
items.zh: 你不能错过他们：他们戴着黑眼镜，他们会试图捉弄你。
items.normEn: You can't miss them: they wear black glasses and they'll try to play tricks on you.

items.en: You can't stop us! We will use the DNA Splicers to awaken the true power of the legendary Dragon-type Pokémon! We will steal the Splicers from the Opelucid City gym leader!
items.zh: 你无法阻止我们！我们将使用DNA拼接器来唤醒传说中的龙系神奇宝贝的真正力量！我们将从 Opelucid City 健身房领导者那里偷走拼接器！
items.normEn: You can't stop us! We will use the DNA Splicers to awaken the true power of the legendary Dragon-type Pokémon! We will steal the Splicers from the Opelucid City gym leader!

items.en: You can't use an evolution item on a Pokémon if it's in the hatchery...
items.zh: 如果神奇宝贝在孵化场中，则无法在神奇宝贝上使用进化物品......
items.normEn: You can't use an evolution item on a Pokémon if it's in the hatchery...

items.zh: 您还无法访问此扩展坞！${...}
items.normEn: You cannot access this dock yet!${...}

items.zh: 您还没有能力购买此升级。
items.normEn: You cannot afford to buy this upgrade yet.

items.normEn: You cannot afford to do that!

items.zh: 您不能对孵化场中的神奇宝贝使用 ${...}。

items.en: You caught all the Ultra Beasts!
items.zh: 你抓住了所有究极异兽！
items.normEn: You caught all the Ultra Beasts!

items.en: You caught Regieleki and Regidrago from the legends? Well that's that then! Smashin'! I'll mark this expedition done!
items.zh: 你抓住了传说中的雷吉莱基和雷吉德拉戈吗？好吧，那就这样吧！粉碎！我将标记这次探险完成！
items.normEn: You caught Regieleki and Regidrago from the legends? Well that's that then! Smashin'! I'll mark this expedition done!

items.en:
You caught the last rare Vivillon (Poké Ball).
Congratulations!
items.zh: 您捕获了最后一个稀有的 Vivillon（精灵球）。恭喜！
items.normEn: You caught the last rare Vivillon (Poké Ball). Congratulations!

items.en: You cheater! I have seen Rowlet giving you money!!!
items.zh: 你这个骗子！我看见罗莱特给你钱了！！！
items.normEn: You cheater! I have seen Rowlet giving you money!!!

items.en: You could build your own Houndour pack and find out, but if it's strong enough to call five hundred Pokémon, it probably wouldn't give anyone weaker than Diantha the time of day.
items.zh: 你可以建立自己的猎犬包并找出答案，但如果它强大到足以召唤五百只神奇宝贝，它可能不会给任何比黛安莎弱的人一天中的时间。
items.normEn: You could build your own Houndour pack and find out, but if it's strong enough to call five hundred Pokémon, it probably wouldn't give anyone weaker than Diantha the time of day.

items.en: You could not complete the dungeon in time.
items.normEn: You could not complete the dungeon in time.

items.en: You defeated Eternamax Eternatus once more. Talk to Leon in Energy Plant.
items.zh: 你再次击败了永恒巨轮永恒者。与能源工厂的莱昂交谈。
items.normEn: You defeated Eternamax Eternatus once more. Talk to Leon in Energy Plant.

items.en: You defeated Galarian Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres multiple times each. Ask Peony what to do next.
items.zh: 您曾多次击败加拉瑞阿提库诺、闪电鸟和莫尔特雷斯。询问牡丹下一步该怎么做。
items.normEn: You defeated Galarian Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres multiple times each. Ask Peony what to do next.

items.en: You defeated Lady Lilligant once again!
items.zh: 你再次击败了莉莉甘特女士！
items.normEn: You defeated Lady Lilligant once again!

items.en: You defeated Lord Arcanine once again!
items.zh: 你再次击败了阿尔卡尼恩领主！
items.normEn: You defeated Lord Arcanine once again!

items.en: You defeated Lord Avalugg once again!
items.zh: 你再次击败了阿瓦鲁格大人！
items.normEn: You defeated Lord Avalugg once again!

items.en: You defeated Lord Electrode once again!
items.zh: 你再次击败了电极领主！
items.normEn: You defeated Lord Electrode once again!

items.en: You defeated Lord Kleavor once again!
items.zh: 你再次击败了克利沃勋爵！
items.normEn: You defeated Lord Kleavor once again!

items.en: You deserve every credit for coming this far as a Trainer of Pokémon. You do seem to know what is needed. Yes, what a Trainer needs is a virtuous heart. Pokémon touch the good hearts of Trainers and learn good from wrong. They touch the good hearts of Trainers and grow strong. Go! Go onwards! The Champion is waiting!
items.zh: 作为一名神奇宝贝训练师，你能走到这一步，值得所有的赞誉。看来你确实知道需要什么。是的，修炼者需要的是一颗善良的心。神奇宝贝触动了训练家的善良之心，并从错误中吸取教训。他们触动了训练师的善良之心并变得坚强。去！继续前进！冠军正在等待！
items.normEn: You deserve every credit for coming this far as a Trainer of Pokémon. You do seem to know what is needed. Yes, what a Trainer needs is a virtuous heart. Pokémon touch the good hearts of Trainers and learn good from wrong. They touch the good hearts of Trainers and grow strong. Go! Go onwards! The Champion is waiting!

items.en:
You did a fine job.
And now, as Kumquat Island gym leader, and a member of the Orange Crew, I happily present this token of your victory.
items.zh: 你做得很好。现在，作为金橘岛道馆的领队和橙色船员的一员，我很高兴地向你们赠送这个胜利的象征。
items.normEn: You did a fine job. And now, as Kumquat Island gym leader, and a member of the Orange Crew, I happily present this token of your victory.

items.en: You did a good thing, freeing that Plusle from those goons. I think they were all part of the evil organization I've been hearing about: Team Cipher!
items.zh: 你做了一件好事，把Plusle从那些暴徒手中救了出来。我认为他们都是我听说过的邪恶组织的一部分：Team Cipher！
items.normEn: You did a good thing, freeing that Plusle from those goons. I think they were all part of the evil organization I've been hearing about: Team Cipher!

items.en: You did it! You saved Hoenn and maybe the whole planet by destroying the meteor!
items.zh: 你做到了！你摧毁了流星，拯救了丰缘，甚至拯救了整个星球！
items.normEn: You did it! You saved Hoenn and maybe the whole planet by destroying the meteor!

items.en: You did it! You saved Kalos! There is nothing else to do except to continue your journey to beat the Kalos Pokémon League!
items.zh: 你做到了！你救了卡洛斯！除了继续击败卡洛斯神奇宝贝联盟的旅程之外，别无他法！
items.normEn: You did it! You saved Kalos! There is nothing else to do except to continue your journey to beat the Kalos Pokémon League!

items.en: You did it! Your bond with Rayquaza is strong enough to bring out its Mega Evolution!
items.zh: 你做到了！你与烈空座的羁绊足够强大，足以引发它的超级进化！
items.normEn: You did it! Your bond with Rayquaza is strong enough to bring out its Mega Evolution!

items.en: You do not have any more ${...}
items.normEn: You do not have any more ${...}

items.en: You don't get anything special for having challenges active, but each challenge will give you a ribbon on your trainer profile.
items.zh: 积极参与挑战不会给您带来任何特别的好处，但每次挑战都会在您的教练个人资料中添加一条丝带。
items.normEn: You don't get anything special for having challenges active, but each challenge will give you a ribbon on your trainer profile.

items.zh: 您已经没有任何 ${...} 了...

items.en: You don't have any free egg slots
items.zh: 您没有任何免费的鸡蛋槽
items.normEn: You don't have any free egg slots

items.en: You don't have any free egg slots.
items.zh: 您没有任何免费的鸡蛋槽。
items.normEn: You don't have any free egg slots.

items.en: You don't have enough ${...} to buy ${...} ${...}!
items.normEn: You don't have enough ${...} to buy ${...} ${...}!

items.en: You don't have enough Dungeon Tokens.
items.zh: 您没有足够的地下城令牌。
items.normEn: You don't have enough Dungeon Tokens.

items.en: You don't have enough gems to use this Flute.
items.zh: 您没有足够的宝石来使用这把长笛。
items.normEn: You don't have enough gems to use this Flute.

items.en: You don't just look strong, you're strong fo' reals! Eh, I was swept away, too! Oh yeah, yo. I was so surprised that I forgot! I gotta give this to you!
items.zh: 你不只是外表坚强，你是真正的坚强！嗯，我也被迷倒了！哦，是的，哟。我太惊讶了，竟然忘记了！我必须把这个给你！
items.normEn: You don't just look strong, you're strong fo' reals! Eh, I was swept away, too! Oh yeah, yo. I was so surprised that I forgot! I gotta give this to you!

items.en: You don't want to mess with him, I promise! Oh? You do?
items.zh: 你不想惹他，我保证！哦？你做？
items.normEn: You don't want to mess with him, I promise! Oh? You do?

items.en: You eventually found a trainer standing where Mewtwo once did in Cerulean Cave. Talk to Green.
items.zh: 你最终发现一名训练师站在超梦曾经在蔚蓝洞窟里站过的地方。与格林交谈。
items.normEn: You eventually found a trainer standing where Mewtwo once did in Cerulean Cave. Talk to Green.

items.en: You failed to protect any of the lake guardians. They have been taken to Veilstone City. So that's what that strange building was... Clear Team Galactic HQ in Veilstone City.
items.zh: 你没能保护任何湖泊守护者。他们被带到了面纱城。原来那栋奇怪的建筑就是……清除位于面纱城的银河队总部。
items.normEn: You failed to protect any of the lake guardians. They have been taken to Veilstone City. So that's what that strange building was... Clear Team Galactic HQ in Veilstone City.

items.en: You finally captured Regieleki and Regidrago. Go report back to Peony!
items.zh: 你终于捕获了雷吉莱基和雷吉德拉戈。去给牡丹汇报吧！
items.normEn: You finally captured Regieleki and Regidrago. Go report back to Peony!

items.en: You find a crate of Luxury Balls in the wreckage.
items.zh: 你在残骸中发现了一箱豪华球。
items.normEn: You find a crate of Luxury Balls in the wreckage.

items.en: You found a key to the Cipher Key Lair. Find out what's inside!
items.zh: 您找到了密码钥匙巢穴的钥匙。看看里面有什么！
items.normEn: You found a key to the Cipher Key Lair. Find out what's inside!

items.en: You found a pulsating Green Gemstone. Take a closer look.
items.zh: 您发现了一颗脉动的绿色宝石。仔细看看。
items.normEn: You found a pulsating Green Gemstone. Take a closer look.

items.zh: 您获得了 1 颗永恒之石！
您获得了 10 个伟大的球！
您获得了 10 颗稀有糖果！

items.en: You gained 10,000 Farm Points and 100 Cheri Berries!
items.zh: 您获得了 10,000 农场点数和 100 个 Cheri 浆果！
items.normEn: You gained 10,000 Farm Points and 100 Cheri Berries!

items.en: You gained 3 random Held Items, that boosts a specific type!
items.zh: 您获得了 3 个随机持有物品，可增强特定类型！
items.normEn: You gained 3 random Held Items, that boosts a specific type!

items.en: You Get a Pokémon, You Get a Pokémon, Everyone Gets a Pokémon!
items.zh: 你得到一个神奇宝贝，你得到一个神奇宝贝，每个人都得到一个神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: You Get a Pokémon, You Get a Pokémon, Everyone Gets a Pokémon!

items.en: You go to the lowest level of the Team Flare Secret HQ as Lysandre told you to. There you find Xerneas and Yveltal fighting each other! Fight them yourself and calm them down!
items.zh: 按照莱桑德尔的指示，你前往耀斑团队秘密总部的最底层。在那里你会发现哲尔尼亚斯和伊维尔塔尔正在互相战斗！亲自与他们战斗并让他们平静下来！
items.normEn: You go to the lowest level of the Team Flare Secret HQ as Lysandre told you to. There you find Xerneas and Yveltal fighting each other! Fight them yourself and calm them down!

items.zh: 您获得了 Eon 门票！
你这个可恶的小训练家！

items.en: You have a certain look... You're the kid who stood in front of me in Viridian City! I'm on my way to Goldenrod City to answer the call and join my team. Are you going to get in my way?
items.zh: 你长得有一定的样子……你就是在常磐城站在我面前的那个小子！我正在前往满金城的路上，接听电话并加入我的团队。你要妨碍我吗？
items.normEn: You have a certain look... You're the kid who stood in front of me in Viridian City! I'm on my way to Goldenrod City to answer the call and join my team. Are you going to get in my way?

items.en: You have already redeemed this code.
items.normEn: You have already redeemed this code.

items.en:
You have an active Safari in ${...}.
Do you want to quit that Safari and start a new one?
items.zh: 您在 ${...} 有一个活跃的 Safari。您想退出 Safari 并开始一个新的吗？
items.normEn: You have an active Safari in ${...}. Do you want to quit that Safari and start a new one?

items.en: You have beautifully proven that the bond between people can be extended to the bond between people and Pokémon. We all appreciate that you have lived up to our expectations. This Clear Bell will signal to Ho-Oh that you are worthy of its attentions.
items.zh: 你完美地证明了人与人之间的联系可以延伸到人与神奇宝贝之间的联系。我们都很感激您没有辜负我们的期望。这个透明的铃铛会向凤王发出信号，表明你值得它的关注。
items.normEn: You have beautifully proven that the bond between people can be extended to the bond between people and Pokémon. We all appreciate that you have lived up to our expectations. This Clear Bell will signal to Ho-Oh that you are worthy of its attentions.

items.en: You have captured Regigigas, now go report back to Peony.
items.zh: 你已经抓获了雷吉加斯，现在去向牡丹报告吧。
items.normEn: You have captured Regigigas, now go report back to Peony.

items.en: You have captured Regirock, Regice, and Registeel, now go report back to Peony.
items.zh: 你已经占领了雷吉洛克、雷吉斯和雷吉斯蒂尔，现在去向牡丹报告。
items.normEn: You have captured Regirock, Regice, and Registeel, now go report back to Peony.

items.en: You have certainly noticed but one of the Pokémon you've fought at the Giant Chasm is invading this town.
items.zh: 您肯定已经注意到，您在巨大裂缝中战斗过的神奇宝贝之一正在入侵这个城镇。
items.normEn: You have certainly noticed but one of the Pokémon you've fought at the Giant Chasm is invading this town.

items.zh: 你已经完成了一个任务！

items.en: You have completed your quest and claimed ${...} Quest Points!
items.zh: 您已完成任务并领取了 ${...} 任务积分！
items.normEn: You have completed your quest and claimed ${...} Quest Points!

items.en: You have disabled auto saving! Be sure to manually save before exiting or any progress will be lost!
items.zh: 您已禁用自动保存！请务必在退出前手动保存，否则任何进度都将丢失！
items.normEn: You have disabled auto saving! Be sure to manually save before exiting or any progress will be lost!

items.zh: 您已获得 20 个思维板！
您已获得 500 颗心灵宝石！

items.en: You have gained a Mega Stone for ${...}!
items.zh: 您已花费 ${...} 获得了一块巨型宝石！
items.normEn: You have gained a Mega Stone for ${...}!

items.en: You have grown up so much since you first left with
items.zh: 自从你第一次离开以来，你已经长大了很多
items.normEn: You have grown up so much since you first left with

items.en: You have my thanks for protecting the village, human child. Although, unfortunately, this has also caused my loyal steeds to flee.
items.zh: 我感谢你保护了村庄，人类的孩子。虽然，不幸的是，这也导致了我忠诚的战马的逃亡。
items.normEn: You have my thanks for protecting the village, human child. Although, unfortunately, this has also caused my loyal steeds to flee.

items.en: You have no active multipliers of this type
items.zh: 您没有此类型的有效乘数
items.normEn: You have no active multipliers of this type

items.en: You have received a Mystery Gift for completing the National Shiny Dex!
items.zh: 完成国家闪亮 Dex 后，您已收到一份神秘礼物！
items.normEn: You have received a Mystery Gift for completing the National Shiny Dex!

items.en: You have skipped the tutorial, and found a stash of Dungeon Tokens with a Dungeon Ticket.
items.zh: 您跳过了教程，并发现了一堆带有地下城门票的地下城代币。
items.normEn: You have skipped the tutorial, and found a stash of Dungeon Tokens with a Dungeon Ticket.

items.en: You have stumbled upon Zinzolin and a Team Plasma Grunt in Lacunosa Town. Defeat the grunt.
items.zh: 您在拉库诺萨镇偶然发现了辛佐林和等离子队步兵。击败咕噜声。
items.normEn: You have stumbled upon Zinzolin and a Team Plasma Grunt in Lacunosa Town. Defeat the grunt.

items.en: You have successfully completed the dungeon.
items.normEn: You have successfully completed the dungeon.

items.en: You hear the echoes of bad rap and low self-esteem in the distance. Clear Diglett's Tunnel.
items.zh: 你会听到远处传来坏说唱和自卑的回声。清理迪格利特的隧道。
items.normEn: You hear the echoes of bad rap and low self-esteem in the distance. Clear Diglett's Tunnel.

items.en: You heard rumors of Diantha being in Coumarine City. Go there to check if you can see her.
items.zh: 你听说过黛安莎在香豆素城的传闻。去那里看看你是否能看到她。
items.normEn: You heard rumors of Diantha being in Coumarine City. Go there to check if you can see her.

items.en: You know what sucks? The other islands are off limits for some arbitrary reason. There is no explanation. Just can't go there.
items.zh: 你知道什么很糟糕吗？其他岛屿因某种任意原因而被禁止进入。没有解释。只是不能去那里。
items.normEn: You know what sucks? The other islands are off limits for some arbitrary reason. There is no explanation. Just can't go there.

items.en: You know what? You are fired, I no longer need you. Now, give me the key to the Distortion World or I will take it by force!
items.zh: 你知道吗？你被解雇了，我不再需要你了。现在，把扭曲世界的钥匙给我，不然我就强行夺走它！
items.normEn: You know what? You are fired, I no longer need you. Now, give me the key to the Distortion World or I will take it by force!

items.en: You little... You knocked out my stupid pawns!
items.zh: 你这个小东西……你把我的愚蠢棋子打掉了！
items.normEn: You little... You knocked out my stupid pawns!

items.en: You made it to Mahogany without troubles? Did you see anything suspicious?
items.zh: 你顺利到达桃花心木了吗？你看到什么可疑的东西了吗？
items.normEn: You made it to Mahogany without troubles? Did you see anything suspicious?

items.en:
You managed to beat stage ${...}.
You received ${...} Battle Points.
You received ${...} Pokédollars.
items.zh: 您成功击败了阶段 ${...}。您收到了 ${...} 战斗积分。您收到了 ${...} Pokédollars。
items.normEn: You managed to beat stage ${...}. You received ${...} Battle Points. You received ${...} Pokédollars.

items.en: You may even earn the @Poké Crew, @Code Contributor or @Developer roles in Discord.
items.zh: 您甚至可能在 Discord 中获得 @Poké Crew、@Code Contributor 或 @Developer 角色。
items.normEn: You may even earn the @Poké Crew, @Code Contributor or @Developer roles in Discord.

items.en: You may have beaten me, but when I lose, I go out in style!
items.zh: 你可能打败了我，但当我输了，我就会潇洒地出去！
items.normEn: You may have beaten me, but when I lose, I go out in style!

items.en: You may have beaten me... again, but when I lose, I go out in style! But first hear this, pip-squeak! Team Flare is gonna use the stones on Route 10 and a fantastic treasure to make everyone on our team happy! In this world the ones who have power are the ones who win with flair!
items.zh: 你可能再次击败了我，但当我输了，我就会潇洒地出去！但首先听到这个，吱吱声！ Flare 团队将使用 10 号公路上的石头和奇妙的宝藏来让我们团队中的每个人都开心！这个世界上，只有拥有力量的人，才能以天赋取胜！
items.normEn: You may have beaten me... again, but when I lose, I go out in style! But first hear this, pip-squeak! Team Flare is gonna use the stones on Route 10 and a fantastic treasure to make everyone on our team happy! In this world the ones who have power are the ones who win with flair!

items.en: You messed up my rhythm! I just can't, no, I just can't do it! Shouldn't you be paying more attention to what's happening in the Pyrite Buiding than to me?
items.zh: 你打乱了我的节奏！我就是做不到，不，我就是做不到！你不是应该比我更关注黄铁大厦里发生的事情吗？
items.normEn: You messed up my rhythm! I just can't, no, I just can't do it! Shouldn't you be paying more attention to what's happening in the Pyrite Buiding than to me?

items.en: You might've heard about the Swords of Justice. They seem to be really worried recently and that also worries me, but you seem to be a really nice fellow so I'll tell you how to find their leader, Cobalion.
items.zh: 你可能听说过正义之剑。他们最近似乎很担心，这也让我担心，但你似乎是一个非常好的人，所以我会告诉你如何找到他们的领导者 Cobalion。
items.normEn: You might've heard about the Swords of Justice. They seem to be really worried recently and that also worries me, but you seem to be a really nice fellow so I'll tell you how to find their leader, Cobalion.

items.en: You must be $playername$, the trainer Wa... People are talking about.
items.zh: 你一定是$playername$，训练师Wa...人们正在谈论。
items.normEn: You must be $playername$, the trainer Wa... People are talking about.

items.zh: 您必须位于以下区域之一：${...}
items.normEn: You must be in one of the following regions: ${...}

items.normEn: You must be in the ${...} dungeon

items.normEn: You must be in the ${...} gym.

items.normEn: You must be in the ${...} region

items.zh: 您必须手动击败道馆馆长 10 次。
items.normEn: You must defeat the Gym Leader manually 10 times.

items.en: You must defeat the league champion of the current region. If you have regional Pokedex challenge active you must obtain all Pokémon available in the current region.
items.zh: 你必须击败当前地区的联赛冠军。如果您有地区性 Pokedex 挑战活动，您必须获得当前地区所有可用的 Pokémon。
items.normEn: You must defeat the league champion of the current region. If you have regional Pokedex challenge active you must obtain all Pokémon available in the current region.

items.en: You must know a meteorite has landed in this area... What are you saying? You already found it?!
items.zh: 你一定知道有陨石降落在这片区域……你在说什么？你已经找到了吗？！
items.normEn: You must know a meteorite has landed in this area... What are you saying? You already found it?!

items.en: You must pay an upfront cost for however many attempts you want to run of the dungeon
items.zh: 无论你想尝试多少次地下城，你都必须支付预付费用
items.normEn: You must pay an upfront cost for however many attempts you want to run of the dungeon

items.en: You must sign in to Discord before attempting to use this code
items.zh: 在尝试使用此代码之前，您必须登录 Discord
items.normEn: You must sign in to Discord before attempting to use this code

items.en: You need to be in the ${...} subregion of ${...}.
items.zh: 您需要位于 ${...} 的 ${...} 子区域中。
items.normEn: You need to be in the ${...} subregion of ${...}.

items.en: You need to clear Weather Institute first to unlock this feature.
items.zh: 您需要先通关气象研究所才能解锁此功能。
items.normEn: You need to clear Weather Institute first to unlock this feature.

items.en: You need to have cleared the dungeon at least 10 times in order to make use of Dungeon Guides.
items.zh: 您需要至少通关地下城 10 次才能使用地下城指南。
items.normEn: You need to have cleared the dungeon at least 10 times in order to make use of Dungeon Guides.

items.en: You need to progress further to unlock this pokemon.
items.zh: 你需要进一步进步才能解锁这个神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: You need to progress further to unlock this pokemon.

items.en: You need to progress in the Shadows in the Desert quest line to unlock this feature.
items.zh: 您需要在沙漠中的阴影任务线中取得进展才能解锁此功能。
items.normEn: You need to progress in the Shadows in the Desert quest line to unlock this feature.

items.en: You need to reach the ${...} region.
items.normEn: You need to reach the ${...} region.

items.en: You non-celebrities are not suited to having such valuable things. Hand them over to us.
items.zh: 你们非名人不适合拥有这么贵重的东西。把它们交给我们。
items.normEn: You non-celebrities are not suited to having such valuable things. Hand them over to us.

items.en: You Pressed F12 by Any Chance?
items.zh: 您有机会按过 F12 吗？
items.normEn: You Pressed F12 by Any Chance?

items.en: You pressed it! Oh ho ho! You pressed the blue switch! Winner, winner! Congratulations!
items.zh: 你按了！哦嗬嗬！你按下了蓝色开关！赢家，赢家！恭喜！
items.normEn: You pressed it! Oh ho ho! You pressed the blue switch! Winner, winner! Congratulations!

items.en: You probably need to train a little before going looking for more of Silvally memories. Catch or hatch 100 Water, Grass, Fire, Electric, Ground and Ice types.
items.zh: 在寻找更多席尔瓦利记忆之前，您可能需要进行一些训练。捕获或孵化 100 种水、草、火、电、地面和冰类型。
items.normEn: You probably need to train a little before going looking for more of Silvally memories. Catch or hatch 100 Water, Grass, Fire, Electric, Ground and Ice types.

items.en: You pushed it! Oh ho ho! You pushed the little red button! Too bad...for you!
items.zh: 你推的！哦嗬嗬！你按下了红色小按钮！太糟糕了……对你来说！
items.normEn: You pushed it! Oh ho ho! You pushed the little red button! Too bad...for you!

items.en: You ran out of gems for the ${...}'s effect!
items.zh: 您已经用完了 ${...} 效果的宝石！
items.normEn: You ran out of gems for the ${...}'s effect!

items.en: You really aren't one of the usual Galaxy buffoons if you could defeat my partner... Well fought, Munchlax.
items.zh: 如果你能打败我的搭档，你就真的不是一般的银河小丑了……打得好，Munchlax。
items.normEn: You really aren't one of the usual Galaxy buffoons if you could defeat my partner... Well fought, Munchlax.

items.en: You really deserve that trophy. You're a great Pokémon trainer.
items.zh: 你真的值得那个奖杯。你是一位出色的神奇宝贝训练家。
items.normEn: You really deserve that trophy. You're a great Pokémon trainer.

items.en: You received Mewtwonite X from Green!
items.zh: 您从 Green 收到了 Mewtwonite X！
items.normEn: You received Mewtwonite X from Green!

items.en: You received Mewtwonite Y from Anomaly Mewtwo!
items.zh: 您从 Anomaly Mewtwo 收到了 Mewtwonite Y！
items.normEn: You received Mewtwonite Y from Anomaly Mewtwo!

items.en: You remember the Pokémon we met in the Slumbering Weald?
items.zh: 你还记得我们在沉睡森林遇到的神奇宝贝吗？
items.normEn: You remember the Pokémon we met in the Slumbering Weald?

items.en: You run after Lysandre and while going through the Labs you find a jailed mysterious man in Lumiose City. It seems like he has a story to tell...
items.zh: 你追赶莱桑德尔，在穿过实验室时，你在卢米奥塞市发现了一名被监禁的神秘男子。看来他有故事要讲……
items.normEn: You run after Lysandre and while going through the Labs you find a jailed mysterious man in Lumiose City. It seems like he has a story to tell...

items.en: You said that the real heroes were Pokémon! You just carelessly changed history!
items.zh: 你说真正的英雄是神奇宝贝！你只是不小心改变了历史！
items.normEn: You said that the real heroes were Pokémon! You just carelessly changed history!

items.en: You saved us! Thank you so much! You're an astounding Pokémon Trainer.
items.zh: 你救了我们！太感谢了！你是一位令人惊叹的神奇宝贝训练师。
items.normEn: You saved us! Thank you so much! You're an astounding Pokémon Trainer.

items.en: You say I look familiar? Oh, you've probably seen me with Kukui. He's my husband!
items.zh: 你说我看起来很眼熟？哦，你可能见过我和库库伊在一起。他是我丈夫！
items.normEn: You say I look familiar? Oh, you've probably seen me with Kukui. He's my husband!

items.en: You see how good they are now, yes? No more sneering at them!
items.zh: 你看他们现在有多好，是吗？别再嘲笑他们了！
items.normEn: You see how good they are now, yes? No more sneering at them!

items.en: You see that beautiful gemstone in Grant's gym? There is no mistake, that is a genuine Mega Stone!
items.zh: 你看到格兰特健身房里那颗美丽的宝石了吗？没有错，那是真正的巨石！
items.normEn: You see that beautiful gemstone in Grant's gym? There is no mistake, that is a genuine Mega Stone!

items.en: You seem like the adventuring type. Tell you what. How about Bill stays here with me to work on this machine, and you go fetch my Meteorite for me.
items.zh: 你看起来像是喜欢冒险的人。告诉你什么。比尔留在这儿和我一起修理这台机器怎么样，你去帮我取陨石吧。
items.normEn: You seem like the adventuring type. Tell you what. How about Bill stays here with me to work on this machine, and you go fetch my Meteorite for me.

items.en: You seem to be around where Suicune would appear. Well, that's OK. My desire to search for Suicune is far beyond yours... My grandpa was...quite into myths. I've heard so many stories about Suicune from him.
items.zh: 你似乎就在水君出现的地方附近。嗯，没关系。我对寻找水君的渴望远远超过了你……我的爷爷……非常沉迷于神话。我从他那里听过很多关于水君的故事。
items.normEn: You seem to be around where Suicune would appear. Well, that's OK. My desire to search for Suicune is far beyond yours... My grandpa was...quite into myths. I've heard so many stories about Suicune from him.

items.en: You seemed to be in perfect sync with your Pokémon—weren't you? Um... Since we've come this far together, why don't I show you some more of the city?
items.zh: 你似乎与你的神奇宝贝完美同步，不是吗？嗯……既然我们已经走到了这一步，我为什么不带你多看看这个城市呢？
items.normEn: You seemed to be in perfect sync with your Pokémon—weren't you? Um... Since we've come this far together, why don't I show you some more of the city?

items.en: You should be halfway through. Go further in the Team Flare Secret HQ! Third step: Beating Team Flare Bryony.
items.zh: 你应该已经完成​​一半了。在 Team Flare 秘密总部走得更远！第三步：击败 Flare Bryony 队。
items.normEn: You should be halfway through. Go further in the Team Flare Secret HQ! Third step: Beating Team Flare Bryony.

items.en: You should go check it out!
items.normEn: You should go check it out!

items.en: You should go now and see what's there!
items.zh: 你现在应该去看看那里有什么！
items.normEn: You should go now and see what's there!

items.en: You showed at least a little effort, so I decided I should let you win!
items.zh: 你至少表现出了一点努力，所以我决定让你赢！
items.normEn: You showed at least a little effort, so I decided I should let you win!

items.en: You snagged a Magnet from Miror B's Voltorb!
items.zh: 您从 Miror B 的 Voltorb 中夺取了一块磁铁！
items.normEn: You snagged a Magnet from Miror B's Voltorb!

items.en: You still can buy them, so you can complete the related achievements.
items.zh: 您仍然可以购买它们，以便完成相关成就。
items.normEn: You still can buy them, so you can complete the related achievements.

items.en: You still can click in the very first battle of the game.
items.zh: 您仍然可以点击游戏的第一场战斗。
items.normEn: You still can click in the very first battle of the game.

items.en: You three are the only ones who successfully finished the second trial! You've pushed each other to greater heights and helped each other grow. So I'd say it's time to finally see who is stronger... in a Pokémon battle!
items.zh: 成功完成第二关考验的，就只有你们三个了！你们将彼此推向更高的高度，并帮助彼此成长。所以我想说，是时候在神奇宝贝对战中看看谁更强了！
items.normEn: You three are the only ones who successfully finished the second trial! You've pushed each other to greater heights and helped each other grow. So I'd say it's time to finally see who is stronger... in a Pokémon battle!

items.zh: 你向 ${...} 扔了一块石头

items.en: You want to know about Celebi? It hasn't been seen in a long time.
items.zh: 你想了解雪拉比吗？已经很久没有见到了。
items.normEn: You want to know about Celebi? It hasn't been seen in a long time.

items.en: You want to know which one can only be found on the farm? I'm sure you can figure that out yourself. Simple process of elimination, really.
items.zh: 您想知道哪一种只能在农场找到吗？我相信你自己能弄清楚。确实，简单的消除过程。
items.normEn: You want to know which one can only be found on the farm? I'm sure you can figure that out yourself. Simple process of elimination, really.

items.en: You want to know why we have been forcing those Pokémon to rampage? We did it in order to expose the true nature of Zacian and Zamazenta!
items.zh: 你想知道为什么我们要强迫那些神奇宝贝横冲直撞吗？我们这样做是为了揭露Zacian和Zamazenta的真实本质！
items.normEn: You want to know why we have been forcing those Pokémon to rampage? We did it in order to expose the true nature of Zacian and Zamazenta!

items.en: You were a great ally, $playername$. I feel it'd be a wise decision on my part if I joined your team, but that's a decision for you to make. If you decide you wish for me to join your team, you can look for me in the depths of Pinwheel Forest.
items.zh: 你是一个伟大的盟友，$playername$。我觉得加入你的团队对我来说是一个明智的决定，但这是你的决定。如果你决定让我加入你的队伍，你可以在风车森林深处寻找我。
items.normEn: You were a great ally, $playername$. I feel it'd be a wise decision on my part if I joined your team, but that's a decision for you to make. If you decide you wish for me to join your team, you can look for me in the depths of Pinwheel Forest.

items.en: You were awarded a ${...} for defeating the Super Nerd!
items.zh: 您因击败超级书呆子而获得 ${...} 奖励！
items.normEn: You were awarded a ${...} for defeating the Super Nerd!

items.en: You were awarded a Fighting Egg for defeating Black Belt Kiyo.
items.zh: 您因击败黑带清而获得战斗蛋。
items.normEn: You were awarded a Fighting Egg for defeating Black Belt Kiyo.

items.en: You were awarded a Fighting Egg for defeating the Fighting Dojo!
items.zh: 您因击败格斗道场而获得了格斗蛋！
items.normEn: You were awarded a Fighting Egg for defeating the Fighting Dojo!

items.en: You were awarded a Fighting Egg for defeating the Galactic Grunts.
items.zh: 您因击败银河步兵而获得了一枚战斗蛋。
items.normEn: You were awarded a Fighting Egg for defeating the Galactic Grunts.

items.en: You were awarded a Key Stone from Wallace!
items.normEn: You were awarded a Key Stone from Wallace!

items.en: You were awarded a Key Stone!
items.normEn: You were awarded a Key Stone!

items.en: You were awarded a Light Ball for defeating Red.
items.zh: 您因击败红队而获得光球。
items.normEn: You were awarded a Light Ball for defeating Red.

items.en: You were awarded a Magikarp Biscuit!
items.normEn: You were awarded a Magikarp Biscuit!

items.en: You were going to Frost Cavern for Pokémon, but what you found there is Team Flare instead! Clear it!
items.zh: 你本来要去冰霜洞窟看神奇宝贝，但你发现那里却是团队耀斑！清除它！
items.normEn: You were going to Frost Cavern for Pokémon, but what you found there is Team Flare instead! Clear it!

items.en: You were so distracted by Necrozma you forgot about the Z Crystal! Find the Trial Site in the Mount Lanakila dungeon.
items.zh: 你被奈克洛兹玛搞得心烦意乱，以至于忘记了 Z 水晶！在拉纳基拉山地牢中找到审判地点。
items.normEn: You were so distracted by Necrozma you forgot about the Z Crystal! Find the Trial Site in the Mount Lanakila dungeon.

items.en: You were strong enough to take down my prized team of Pokémon. In recognition of that power, I give you this: the Mine Badge!
items.zh: 你足够强大，足以击败我珍贵的神奇宝贝团队。为了表彰这种力量，我给你这个：矿井徽章！
items.normEn: You were strong enough to take down my prized team of Pokémon. In recognition of that power, I give you this: the Mine Badge!

items.en: You were wise to seek me out. Howard Clifford has been deceiving you. He is the one making the R drug, and....
items.zh: 你来找我真是明智之举。霍华德·克利福德一直在欺骗你。他是R药的制造者，而且……
items.normEn: You were wise to seek me out. Howard Clifford has been deceiving you. He is the one making the R drug, and....

items.en: You will also have to progress to the Dock in
items.normEn: You will also have to progress to the Dock in

items.en: You will forever be a friend of the Draconid people.
items.zh: 你将永远是天龙人的朋友。
items.normEn: You will forever be a friend of the Draconid people.

items.en: You will gain access to a queue in the hatchery once you reach the Johto region, and more queue slots for each new region reached after that.
items.zh: 到达城都地区后，您将可以进入孵化场的队列，之后到达的每个新区域都会有更多的队列空位。
items.normEn: You will gain access to a queue in the hatchery once you reach the Johto region, and more queue slots for each new region reached after that.

items.en: You will not be able to recover your savefile!
items.zh: 您将无法恢复您的保存文件！
items.normEn: You will not be able to recover your savefile!

items.en: You will now choose a starter each time you reach a new region
items.zh: 现在，每次到达新地区时，您都将选择一个首发者
items.normEn: You will now choose a starter each time you reach a new region

items.en: You will now start the game with 25 Pokéballs
items.zh: 现在您将拥有 25 个 Pokéball 来开始游戏
items.normEn: You will now start the game with 25 Pokéballs

items.en: You wish to keep them from us? No matter. This time we've brought much stronger Pokémon to thoroughly trounce you with!
items.zh: 你想让他们远离我们吗？不管。这次我们带来了更强大的神奇宝贝来彻底击败你！
items.normEn: You wish to keep them from us? No matter. This time we've brought much stronger Pokémon to thoroughly trounce you with!

items.en: You witnessed 3 powerful looking bird pokemon resembling Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres fighting over the fruit of the Dyna Tree. Upon noticing you, they attack!
items.zh: 您目睹了 3 种看起来强大的鸟类神奇宝贝，例如 Articuno、Zapdos 和 Moltres，它们正在争夺 Dyna Tree 的果实。一旦发现你，他们就会发起攻击！
items.normEn: You witnessed 3 powerful looking bird pokemon resembling Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres fighting over the fruit of the Dyna Tree. Upon noticing you, they attack!

items.en: You won’t find a Pokémon as wonderful as my favorite Rapidash in those Typed Eggs in the shops, but they might hatch rare Pokémon you can’t find anywhere else!
items.zh: 你不会在商店里的打字蛋中找到像我最喜欢的急速兽那样美妙的神奇宝贝，但它们可能会孵化出你在其他地方找不到的稀有神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: You won’t find a Pokémon as wonderful as my favorite Rapidash in those Typed Eggs in the shops, but they might hatch rare Pokémon you can’t find anywhere else!

items.en: You- or should I say you and your Pokémon- make quite the interesting team! I do hope you'll come to Verdant Cavern and attempt my trial!
items.zh: 你——或者我应该说你和你的神奇宝贝——组成了一个非常有趣的团队！我真心希望你能来青翠洞窟尝试我的试炼！
items.normEn: You- or should I say you and your Pokémon- make quite the interesting team! I do hope you'll come to Verdant Cavern and attempt my trial!

items.en: You, Enamorus and her brethren have something in common: you tend to stir the pot of life. Do not mistake me - I mean this positively.
items.zh: 你，迷恋者和她的弟兄们有一些共同点：你倾向于搅动生命的锅。不要误会我——我的意思是积极的。
items.normEn: You, Enamorus and her brethren have something in common: you tend to stir the pot of life. Do not mistake me - I mean this positively.

items.en: You, Klara and Avery have happened upon the same Max Mushroom in Warm-Up Tunnel. Defeat them both to win it.
items.zh: 你、克拉拉和艾弗里在热身隧道中碰巧发现了同一个最大蘑菇。击败他们两人即可获胜。
items.normEn: You, Klara and Avery have happened upon the same Max Mushroom in Warm-Up Tunnel. Defeat them both to win it.

items.en: You, Professor Kukui, Professor Burnet, Hau, Hapu, and everyone else... I'm so glad I got to meet everyone!
items.zh: 您、Kukui 教授、Burnet 教授、Hau、Hapu 以及其他所有人……我很高兴见到大家！
items.normEn: You, Professor Kukui, Professor Burnet, Hau, Hapu, and everyone else... I'm so glad I got to meet everyone!

items.en: You! Not again! I'll be there first next time! Having followed it here, I'm starting to understand what Suicune is after.
items.zh: 你！不会再有！下次我会第一个到的！跟着这里，我开始明白水君追求的是什么了。
items.normEn: You! Not again! I'll be there first next time! Having followed it here, I'm starting to understand what Suicune is after.

items.en: You! So you're a Trainer who fights while believing in your Pokémon, are you?
items.zh: 你！那么您是一名相信自己的神奇宝贝并进行战斗的训练家，是吗？
items.normEn: You! So you're a Trainer who fights while believing in your Pokémon, are you?

items.en: You... are you a Pokémon Ranger? ...No? Well, no matter.
items.zh: 你……你是神奇宝贝游骑兵吗？ ...不？好吧，没关系。
items.normEn: You... are you a Pokémon Ranger? ...No? Well, no matter.

items.en: You'd have to be as crazy as Kaminko to go looking for it.
items.zh: 你必须像卡明科一样疯狂才能去寻找它。
items.normEn: You'd have to be as crazy as Kaminko to go looking for it.

items.en: You'll get special items if you reach special milestone stages.
items.zh: 如果您达到特殊的里程碑阶段，您将获得特殊物品。
items.normEn: You'll get special items if you reach special milestone stages.

items.en: You'll have to catch a ton before you find the Prison Bottle. Maybe... 100?
items.zh: 在找到监狱之瓶之前，你必须捕获大量的东西。也许……100？
items.normEn: You'll have to catch a ton before you find the Prison Bottle. Maybe... 100?

items.en: You'll have to let me welcome you with a battle, or my name ain't Willie!
items.zh: 你必须让我用一场战斗来欢迎你，否则我的名字就不是威利了！
items.normEn: You'll have to let me welcome you with a battle, or my name ain't Willie!

items.en: You're a rather impressive trainer $playername$, but there's no way you can beat me. Come back when you're stronger.
items.zh: 你是一位相当令人印象深刻的训练师$playername$，但你不可能打败我。等你更强了再回来吧。
items.normEn: You're a rather impressive trainer $playername$, but there's no way you can beat me. Come back when you're stronger.

items.en: You’re a trainer, right? It’s me, the Poké Dude! I’m the guy on Teachy TV!
items.zh: 你是一名教练，对吧？是我，神奇宝贝！我是Teachy TV 上的那个人！
items.normEn: You’re a trainer, right? It’s me, the Poké Dude! I’m the guy on Teachy TV!

items.en: You're actually very strong. It's very possible that Cobalion trusted you to find us. Well then, where are we supposed to meet? The Moor of Icirrus? Very well, I shall make my way there, then. You should come, too. Cobalion should know where you might find our companion, Virizion.
items.zh: 你其实很强。 Cobalion 很可能相信你会找到我们。那么，我们应该在哪里见面呢？伊西洛斯的摩尔人？很好，那么我就去那里吧。你也应该来。 Cobalion 应该知道你在哪里可以找到我们的同伴 Virizion。
items.normEn: You're actually very strong. It's very possible that Cobalion trusted you to find us. Well then, where are we supposed to meet? The Moor of Icirrus? Very well, I shall make my way there, then. You should come, too. Cobalion should know where you might find our companion, Virizion.

items.en: You're an amazing Pokémon Trainer. My Pokémon and I are happy because for the first time in quite a while--about two years, I'd say--we could fight with our full strength. This is an official League Gym Badge. But this is just a stepping-stone.
items.zh: 你是一位了不起的神奇宝贝训练师。我和我的神奇宝贝很高兴，因为很长一段时间（我想说大约两年）以来我们第一次可以全力战斗。这是官方联盟道馆徽章。但这只是一个踏脚石。
items.normEn: You're an amazing Pokémon Trainer. My Pokémon and I are happy because for the first time in quite a while--about two years, I'd say--we could fight with our full strength. This is an official League Gym Badge. But this is just a stepping-stone.

items.en: You're as strong as ever. But... It's too late! There's no hope for you now! Go down to the lowest floor, and see for yourself!
items.zh: 你还是一如既往的坚强。但是……已经太晚了！你现在已经没有希望了！到最底层去看看吧！
items.normEn: You're as strong as ever. But... It's too late! There's no hope for you now! Go down to the lowest floor, and see for yourself!

items.en: You're back! How did it go with the Zarude?
items.zh: 你回来了！ Zarude 的进展如何？
items.normEn: You're back! How did it go with the Zarude?

items.en: You're back! I can see already you look closer to Kubfu, and its training is going well! It isn't quite ready yet, however! To switch it up a little, you should now have it help you with catching some Water and Dark-type Pokémon!
items.zh: 你回来了！我可以看到您已经离 Kubfu 越来越近了，它的训练进展顺利！然而，它还没有完全准备好！稍微改变一下，你现在应该可以让它帮助你捕捉一些水系和暗系神奇宝贝！
items.normEn: You're back! I can see already you look closer to Kubfu, and its training is going well! It isn't quite ready yet, however! To switch it up a little, you should now have it help you with catching some Water and Dark-type Pokémon!

items.en: You're back! So I take it you saw one? A Gigantamax Pikachu, huh? Yeah, I saw one of those too! I also saw 2 others: Meowth and Eevee. Maybe you'll see them when you go back in.
items.zh: 你回来了！所以我想你看到了一个？超极巨皮卡丘吧？是的，我也看到了其中之一！我还看到了另外两个：Meowth 和 Eevee。也许当你回去的时候你会看到他们。
items.normEn: You're back! So I take it you saw one? A Gigantamax Pikachu, huh? Yeah, I saw one of those too! I also saw 2 others: Meowth and Eevee. Maybe you'll see them when you go back in.

items.en: You're chasing after them too, right? Good luck catching up to them!
items.zh: 你也在追他们，对吗？祝你好运，赶上他们！
items.normEn: You're chasing after them too, right? Good luck catching up to them!

items.en: You're doing things according to your beliefs and morals. I understand now...
items.zh: 你按照你的信仰和道德做事。我现在明白了...
items.normEn: You're doing things according to your beliefs and morals. I understand now...

items.en: You're encountering Pokémon at a really good clip, aren't you? Congratulations! You completed the Pokédex!
items.zh: 你在一个非常好的剪辑中遇到了神奇宝贝，不是吗？恭喜！您完成了图鉴！
items.normEn: You're encountering Pokémon at a really good clip, aren't you? Congratulations! You completed the Pokédex!

items.en: You're good at raising Pokémon, right? We called you here to compete in the ten leagues around the island and pick up our poor Magikarp's spirits!
items.zh: 你很擅长饲养神奇宝贝，对吧？我们召集你们来这里是为了参加岛上的十个联赛并重振我们可怜的鲤鱼王的精神！
items.normEn: You're good at raising Pokémon, right? We called you here to compete in the ten leagues around the island and pick up our poor Magikarp's spirits!

items.en: You're quite something, youngster. I like how you and your Pokémon earned the win by working as one. That's what makes you so strong. Ahahaha! I think that you can go as far as you want.
items.zh: 你真是了不起，年轻人。我喜欢你和你的神奇宝贝通过团结一致赢得胜利。这就是让你如此坚强的原因。啊哈哈哈！我认为你可以走多远就走多远。
items.normEn: You're quite something, youngster. I like how you and your Pokémon earned the win by working as one. That's what makes you so strong. Ahahaha! I think that you can go as far as you want.

items.en: You're quite strong. Oh yes... very strong, indeed. I certainly didn't expect you to be so interesting. But it matters not, we already have enough energy to power the device. I do hope we can meet again!
items.zh: 你很强啊。哦，是的……确实非常强。我当然没想到你这么有趣。但这并不重要，我们已经有足够的能量来为设备供电。我真希望我们能再次见面！
items.normEn: You're quite strong. Oh yes... very strong, indeed. I certainly didn't expect you to be so interesting. But it matters not, we already have enough energy to power the device. I do hope we can meet again!

items.en: You're really something...and I'm a man of my word. So, here's that treasure.
items.zh: 你真是了不起……而我是一个言出必行的人。所以，这就是那个宝藏。
items.normEn: You're really something...and I'm a man of my word. So, here's that treasure.

items.en: You're sayin' you saw them and that's what you were tellin' me about? Ah, sorry 'bout that. Anyway, you should go find 'em.
items.zh: 你是说你看到了他们，这就是你告诉我的？啊，对此感到抱歉。无论如何，你应该去找他们。
items.normEn: You're sayin' you saw them and that's what you were tellin' me about? Ah, sorry 'bout that. Anyway, you should go find 'em.

items.en: You're saying you saw some Pokémon that looked like.... Hang on, Chief! There's breaking news on the telly! They're sayin' dodgy bird Pokémon are poppin' up left and right!
items.zh: 你是说你看到了一些神奇宝贝，看起来像……等一下，酋长！电视里传来重磅新闻！他们说狡猾的小鸟神奇宝贝正在左右弹出！
items.normEn: You're saying you saw some Pokémon that looked like.... Hang on, Chief! There's breaking news on the telly! They're sayin' dodgy bird Pokémon are poppin' up left and right!

items.en: You're some kind of special! You're worthy of sharing my camaraderie as a friend.
items.zh: 你有点特别！你值得分享我作为朋友的友情。
items.normEn: You're some kind of special! You're worthy of sharing my camaraderie as a friend.

items.en: You're the best, kiddo! I'm sure she'll love the ring I'll buy her with these diamonds!
items.zh: 你是最棒的，孩子！我确信她会喜欢我会给她买的镶有这些钻石的戒指！
items.normEn: You're the best, kiddo! I'm sure she'll love the ring I'll buy her with these diamonds!

items.en: You're the Champion, right? I need your help on a small errand.
items.zh: 你是冠军，对吧？我需要你帮忙处理一件小事。
items.normEn: You're the Champion, right? I need your help on a small errand.

items.en: You're too late, $playername$! I have uncovered the secrets of the Blue Orb, despite Maxie's meddling!
items.zh: 你来得太晚了，$playername$！尽管马克西插手，我还是揭开了蓝色球体的秘密！
items.normEn: You're too late, $playername$! I have uncovered the secrets of the Blue Orb, despite Maxie's meddling!

items.en: You're too late, $playername$! I have uncovered the secrets of the Red Orb, despite Archie's meddling!
items.zh: 你来得太晚了，$playername$！尽管阿奇插手，我还是揭开了红色球体的秘密！
items.normEn: You're too late, $playername$! I have uncovered the secrets of the Red Orb, despite Archie's meddling!

items.en: You're too late! We already took everything we needed!
items.zh: 你来得太晚了！我们已经拿走了我们需要的一切！
items.normEn: You're too late! We already took everything we needed!

items.en: You've been a great help. Thanks again. Maybe we'll meet again some day...
items.zh: 你帮了很大的忙。再次感谢。也许有一天我们会再次见面……
items.normEn: You've been a great help. Thanks again. Maybe we'll meet again some day...

items.en: You've cornered the Go-Rock Commander outside the Old Chateau! Time to finish this.
items.zh: 您已将 Go-Rock 指挥官逼到了老城堡外！是时候完成这件事了。
items.normEn: You've cornered the Go-Rock Commander outside the Old Chateau! Time to finish this.

items.en: You've finally defeated Kyurem, sealing it within the Giant Chasm forever. Talk to the Swords of Justice in the Giant Chasm.
items.zh: 你终于击败了酋雷姆，将其永远封印在巨大裂缝中。与巨大峡谷中的正义之剑交谈。
items.normEn: You've finally defeated Kyurem, sealing it within the Giant Chasm forever. Talk to the Swords of Justice in the Giant Chasm.

items.en: You've finally found Kyurem! Defeat it with the help of the Swords of Justice.
items.zh: 你终于找到酋雷姆了！在正义之剑的帮助下击败它。
items.normEn: You've finally found Kyurem! Defeat it with the help of the Swords of Justice.

items.en: You've finally obtained enough Wishing Pieces to attract every Gigantamax Pokémon to the Max Lair! Tell Peonia about your achievement in Max Lair.
items.zh: 您终于获得了足够的许愿碎片来吸引所有超极巨化神奇宝贝来到最大巢穴！告诉佩妮娅你在麦克斯莱尔的成就。
items.normEn: You've finally obtained enough Wishing Pieces to attract every Gigantamax Pokémon to the Max Lair! Tell Peonia about your achievement in Max Lair.

items.en: You've found Terrakion! Talk to them about the reunion.
items.zh: 你找到了泰拉基昂！与他们谈论重聚的事情。
items.normEn: You've found Terrakion! Talk to them about the reunion.

items.en: You've helped with the power outage problem, now the gym in Lumiose City is back up and you can challenge it!
items.zh: 你已经帮助解决了停电问题，现在卢米奥塞市的健身房已经恢复，你可以挑战它了！
items.normEn: You've helped with the power outage problem, now the gym in Lumiose City is back up and you can challenge it!

items.en: You've made your point. I can see you are not one to be trifled with.
items.zh: 你已经表达了你的观点。我看得出你不是一个好惹的人。
items.normEn: You've made your point. I can see you are not one to be trifled with.

items.en: You've received every available reward. Congratulations!
items.zh: 您已收到所有可用奖励。恭喜！
items.normEn: You've received every available reward. Congratulations!

items.en: You've shown me everything I wanted to see and more. You have been a very nice trainer! My grandson could learn one thing or two from you, ho, ho!
items.zh: 你向我展示了我想看到的一切，甚至更多。你是一位非常好的教练！我的孙子可以从你身上学到一两件事，嗬，嗬！
items.normEn: You've shown me everything I wanted to see and more. You have been a very nice trainer! My grandson could learn one thing or two from you, ho, ho!

items.en: Young Trainer, you... No, it wasn't you alone. You and your Pokémon have shown me a whole new depth of field! Fantastic! Just fantastic!
items.zh: 少训练家，你……不，不是你一个人。你和你的神奇宝贝向我展示了全新的景深！极好的！太棒了！
items.normEn: Young Trainer, you... No, it wasn't you alone. You and your Pokémon have shown me a whole new depth of field! Fantastic! Just fantastic!

items.en: Your bonds with your Pokémon are really strong. Although, I don't like losing much...
items.zh: 你和你的神奇宝贝的联系非常牢固。虽然我不喜欢失去太多...
items.normEn: Your bonds with your Pokémon are really strong. Although, I don't like losing much...

items.en: Your browser does not support desktop notifications.
items.zh: 您的浏览器不支持桌面通知。
items.normEn: Your browser does not support desktop notifications.

items.en: Your browser is blocking desktop notifications.
items.zh: 您的浏览器正在阻止桌面通知。
items.normEn: Your browser is blocking desktop notifications.

items.en: Your Cell Battery has discharged with the move '${...}'
items.zh: 您的电池已放电并移动“${...}”
items.normEn: Your Cell Battery has discharged with the move '${...}'

items.en: Your Item Bag has a bunch of nifty features! Take stuff in the Held Items pocket, for instance. You can use a Held Item to empower your Pokémon or acquire unique effects. How do you use it? Well, here’s how it works.
items.zh: 您的物品包有很多漂亮的功能！例如，以持有物品口袋中的东西为例。您可以使用持有物品来增强您的神奇宝贝或获得独特的效果。你如何使用它？嗯，这就是它的工作原理。
items.normEn: Your Item Bag has a bunch of nifty features! Take stuff in the Held Items pocket, for instance. You can use a Held Item to empower your Pokémon or acquire unique effects. How do you use it? Well, here’s how it works.

items.en: Your journey isn't over yet, a whole world awaits you! Onwards to Johto!
items.zh: 你的旅程还没有结束，整个世界在等着你！前往城都！
items.normEn: Your journey isn't over yet, a whole world awaits you! Onwards to Johto!

items.en: Your local part of the day must be ${...}
items.zh: 您当天的本地时间必须是 ${...}
items.normEn: Your local part of the day must be ${...}

items.en: Your Meteorite Shards combine into a Meteorite!
items.zh: 你的陨石碎片组合成陨石！
items.normEn: Your Meteorite Shards combine into a Meteorite!

items.en: Your new friend waited until my back was turned, stole my Key Stone, and skipped town!
items.zh: 你的新朋友等到我转身的时候，偷走了我的钥匙石，然后逃离了城镇！
items.normEn: Your new friend waited until my back was turned, stole my Key Stone, and skipped town!

items.en: Your pink is still lacking, but you're an excellent Trainer with some excellent Pokémon.
items.zh: 你的粉红色仍然缺乏，但你是一位优秀的训练家，拥有一些优秀的神奇宝贝。
items.normEn: Your pink is still lacking, but you're an excellent Trainer with some excellent Pokémon.

items.en: Your Poké Ball Filters will be used when attempting to capture a Wanderer. Farm Hands can also be used for this by enabling their Manage Wanderers setting.
items.zh: 当尝试捕捉流浪者时，将使用您的神奇宝贝球过滤器。农场帮手也可以通过启用管理流浪者设置来实现此目的。
items.normEn: Your Poké Ball Filters will be used when attempting to capture a Wanderer. Farm Hands can also be used for this by enabling their Manage Wanderers setting.

items.en: Your Pokémon go away when they evolve
items.zh: 你的神奇宝贝进化后就会消失
items.normEn: Your Pokémon go away when they evolve

items.en: Your Pokémon go away when they evolve.
items.zh: 你的神奇宝贝进化后就会消失。
items.normEn: Your Pokémon go away when they evolve.

items.en: Your restore rate has grown so much that this tool has now become free to use.
items.zh: 您的恢复率已经大大提高，该工具现在可以免费使用。
items.normEn: Your restore rate has grown so much that this tool has now become free to use.

items.en: Your safari exploration will end when you have run out of Poké Balls. You can freely leave and re-enter without having to pay the fee again as long as you still have Poké Balls remaining.
items.zh: 当您用完神奇宝贝球时，您的野生动物探索就会结束。只要您还有剩余的精灵球，您就可以自由离开和重新进入，无需再次支付费用。
items.normEn: Your safari exploration will end when you have run out of Poké Balls. You can freely leave and re-enter without having to pay the fee again as long as you still have Poké Balls remaining.

items.en: Your save file will likely be compatible with the final release.
items.zh: 您的保存文件可能会与最终版本兼容。
items.normEn: Your save file will likely be compatible with the final release.

items.en: Your scales are full of heart!
items.normEn: Your scales are full of heart!

items.zh: 你的实力还是让人震惊！

items.en: Your strength nearly made me want to turn and run in my bare feet.
items.zh: 你的力量几乎让我想转身赤脚奔跑。
items.normEn: Your strength nearly made me want to turn and run in my bare feet.

items.zh: 你们的团队配合也太棒了！

items.en: Your Underground Battery has been fully charged and is ready to be discharged.
items.zh: 您的地下电池已充满电并准备放电。
items.normEn: Your Underground Battery has been fully charged and is ready to be discharged.

items.en: Your Underground level has increased to ${...}!
items.normEn: Your Underground level has increased to ${...}!

items.en: Your underground level will affect the following:
items.zh: 您的地下层将影响以下内容：
items.normEn: Your underground level will affect the following:

items.en: Your victory doesn't matter, we got what we came for!
items.zh: 你的胜利并不重要，我们得到了我们的目的！
items.normEn: Your victory doesn't matter, we got what we came for!

items.en: Zacian and Zamazenta are rampaging in Energy Plant. Defeat them!
items.zh: 扎西安和扎马森塔在能源工厂里横冲直撞。打败他们！
items.normEn: Zacian and Zamazenta are rampaging in Energy Plant. Defeat them!

items.en: Zaruza! Zaru Zaru! Zarude!.. Nope, they're too angry to listen. Looks like you'll have to fight them if we want to calm them down. Zarude are strong, but I'm sure you'll be fine if you are anywhere near as strong as Ash.
items.zh: 扎鲁扎！扎鲁扎鲁！ Zarude！...不，他们太生气了，听不进去。看来如果我们想让他们平静下来你就得和他们战斗。扎鲁德很强大，但我相信如果你和小智一样强大的话，你会没事的。
items.normEn: Zaruza! Zaru Zaru! Zarude!.. Nope, they're too angry to listen. Looks like you'll have to fight them if we want to calm them down. Zarude are strong, but I'm sure you'll be fine if you are anywhere near as strong as Ash.

items.en: Zero's Ambition questline re-starting or starting early
items.zh: 零的野心任务线重新开始或提前开始
items.normEn: Zero's Ambition questline re-starting or starting early

items.en: Zinnia has gone to the top of the Sky Pillar to try to summon Rayquaza. Please, try to help her. This Key Stone may help you.
items.zh: 百日草已经前往天柱顶端，试图召唤烈空坐。请尝试帮助她。这块钥匙石可能会帮助你。
items.normEn: Zinnia has gone to the top of the Sky Pillar to try to summon Rayquaza. Please, try to help her. This Key Stone may help you.

items.en: Zinnia is the current Lorekeeper of our people, who has inherited the knowledge and power to summon Lord Rayquaza when disaster imperils the world.
items.zh: 百日草是我们人民的现任博学者，她继承了知识和力量，可以在灾难危及世界时召唤烈空扎领主。
items.normEn: Zinnia is the current Lorekeeper of our people, who has inherited the knowledge and power to summon Lord Rayquaza when disaster imperils the world.

items.en: Zinnia.... I thought I could trust her after she found the Red Orb for me, but I guess not. She stole my Key Stone!
items.zh: 百日草......我以为在她为我找到红色球体后我可以信任她，但我想不是。她偷了我的钥匙石！
items.normEn: Zinnia.... I thought I could trust her after she found the Red Orb for me, but I guess not. She stole my Key Stone!

items.en: Zzz... Hm? Oh yes, the forest. It was most peculiar - when I laid down upon the flowerbed I had the strangest dream of a basket full of Pokémon. At least, I think it was a dream... It did not strike me as one of the usual inhabitants of the area.
items.zh: 兹兹……嗯？哦，是的，森林。这是最奇怪的——当我躺在花坛上时，我做了一个最奇怪的梦，梦见了一篮子神奇宝贝。至少，我认为这是一个梦……作为该地区的常住居民之一，我并没有想到它。
items.normEn: Zzz... Hm? Oh yes, the forest. It was most peculiar - when I laid down upon the flowerbed I had the strangest dream of a basket full of Pokémon. At least, I think it was a dream... It did not strike me as one of the usual inhabitants of the area.

items.en: Zzzzt!!! How'zzz it going, kiddo? Feelin' calm under the Alolan moon?
items.zh: 嘶嘶！！！怎么样，孩子？阿罗拉月光下感觉平静吗？
items.normEn: Zzzzt!!! How'zzz it going, kiddo? Feelin' calm under the Alolan moon?

items.en: Zzzzt!!! How'zzz it going, kiddo? Havin' fun in the Alolan sun?
items.zh: 嘶嘶！！！怎么样，孩子？在阿罗拉的阳光下玩得开心吗？
items.normEn: Zzzzt!!! How'zzz it going, kiddo? Havin' fun in the Alolan sun?

items.en: Zzzzt!!! You've almost made it, kiddo! Championship is on the horizzzon! I'm rootin' for ya!
items.zh: 嘶嘶！！！你快成功了，孩子！冠军指日可待！我支持你！
items.normEn: Zzzzt!!! You've almost made it, kiddo! Championship is on the horizzzon! I'm rootin' for ya!
